    poisAT d hd lam h n i = ∑ j : Spin, channelPMF lam h i j * poisT d hd lam h n j := rfl
theorem poisA_toReal_rec (d : ℝ) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam)
    (n : ℕ) (i : Spin) :
    (poisA d hd0 lam h (n + 1) i).toReal =
      d * ∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * (poisA d hd0 lam h n j).toReal +
        d ^ 2 * ((poisAM d hd0 lam h n i).toReal * (poisAM d hd0 lam h n i).toReal) := by
  rw [poisA_rec]
  change (ENNReal.ofReal d * ∑ j : Spin, channelPMF lam h i j * poisA d hd0 lam h n j +
      ENNReal.ofReal (d ^ 2) * (poisAM d hd0 lam h n i * poisAM d hd0 lam h n i)).toReal =
    d * ∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * (poisA d hd0 lam h n j).toReal +
      d ^ 2 * ((poisAM d hd0 lam h n i).toReal * (poisAM d hd0 lam h n i).toReal)
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_add
      (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (poisA_finset_ne_top d hd0 hd1 lam h n i))
      (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
        (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (poisAM_ne_top d hd0 lam h n i) (poisAM_ne_top d hd0 lam h n i))),
    ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_mul,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hd0, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ d ^ 2),
    ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun j _ => ENNReal.mul_ne_top ((channelPMF lam h i).apply_ne_top j)
      (poisA_ne_top d hd0 hd1 lam h n j))]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul, toReal_channelPMF]
theorem poisB_toReal_rec (d : ℝ) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam)
    (n : ℕ) (i : Spin) :
    (poisB d hd0 lam h (n + 1) i).toReal =
      d * ∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * (poisB d hd0 lam h n j).toReal +
        d ^ 2 * ((poisAM d hd0 lam h n i).toReal * (poisAT d hd0 lam h n i).toReal) := by
  rw [poisB_rec]
  change (ENNReal.ofReal d * ∑ j : Spin, channelPMF lam h i j * poisB d hd0 lam h n j +
      ENNReal.ofReal (d ^ 2) * (poisAM d hd0 lam h n i * poisAT d hd0 lam h n i)).toReal =
    d * ∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * (poisB d hd0 lam h n j).toReal +
      d ^ 2 * ((poisAM d hd0 lam h n i).toReal * (poisAT d hd0 lam h n i).toReal)
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_add
      (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (poisB_finset_ne_top d hd0 hd1 lam h n i))
      (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
        (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (poisAM_ne_top d hd0 lam h n i) (poisAT_ne_top d hd0 lam h n i))),
    ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_mul,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hd0, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ d ^ 2),
    ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun j _ => ENNReal.mul_ne_top ((channelPMF lam h i).apply_ne_top j)
      (poisB_ne_top d hd0 hd1 lam h n j))]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul, toReal_channelPMF]
theorem poisC_toReal_rec (d : ℝ) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam)
    (n : ℕ) (i : Spin) :
    (poisC d hd0 lam h (n + 1) i).toReal =
      d * ∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * (poisC d hd0 lam h n j).toReal +
        d ^ 2 * ((poisAT d hd0 lam h n i).toReal * (poisAT d hd0 lam h n i).toReal) := by
  rw [poisC_rec]
  change (ENNReal.ofReal d * ∑ j : Spin, channelPMF lam h i j * poisC d hd0 lam h n j +
      ENNReal.ofReal (d ^ 2) * (poisAT d hd0 lam h n i * poisAT d hd0 lam h n i)).toReal =
    d * ∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * (poisC d hd0 lam h n j).toReal +
      d ^ 2 * ((poisAT d hd0 lam h n i).toReal * (poisAT d hd0 lam h n i).toReal)
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_add
      (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (poisC_finset_ne_top d hd0 hd1 lam h n i))
      (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
        (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (poisAT_ne_top d hd0 lam h n i) (poisAT_ne_top d hd0 lam h n i))),
    ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_mul,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hd0, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ d ^ 2),
    ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun j _ => ENNReal.mul_ne_top ((channelPMF lam h i).apply_ne_top j)
      (poisC_ne_top d hd0 hd1 lam h n j))]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul, toReal_channelPMF]
noncomputable def poisV (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam) (n : ℕ) (i : Spin) : ℝ :=
  (poisA d hd lam h n i).toReal - (2 / 3) * (poisB d hd lam h n i).toReal
    + (1 / 9) * (poisC d hd lam h n i).toReal
theorem cross_term_eq (d lam : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (e : ℝ) :
    d ^ 2 * (d ^ n * (1 / 3 + lam ^ (n + 1) * e)) ^ 2
      - (2 / 3) * (d ^ 2 * (d ^ n * (1 / 3 + lam ^ (n + 1) * e)) * d ^ n)
      + (1 / 9) * (d ^ 2 * (d ^ n) ^ 2) = ((d * lam) ^ 2) ^ (n + 1) * e ^ 2 := by
  have hpow : ((d * lam) ^ 2) ^ (n + 1) = (d * lam) ^ (2 * n) * ((d * lam) ^ 2) := by
    rw [pow_succ]
    congr 1
    rw [← pow_mul]
  rw [hpow, mul_pow, mul_pow, mul_pow]
  have hd2 : d ^ (2 * n) = d ^ n * d ^ n := by
    rw [show 2 * n = n + n by ring, pow_add]
  rw [hd2]
  ring
theorem poisV_step_alg (d lam : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (e A B C : ℝ) :
    (d * A + d ^ 2 * ((d ^ n * (1 / 3 + lam ^ (n + 1) * e)) *
        (d ^ n * (1 / 3 + lam ^ (n + 1) * e))))
      - (2 / 3) * (d * B + d ^ 2 * ((d ^ n * (1 / 3 + lam ^ (n + 1) * e)) * d ^ n))
      + (1 / 9) * (d * C + d ^ 2 * (d ^ n * d ^ n))
    = d * (A - (2 / 3) * B + (1 / 9) * C)
      + ((d * lam) ^ 2) ^ (n + 1) * e ^ 2 := by
  have h := cross_term_eq d lam n e
  linarith
theorem poisA_zero (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam) (i : Spin) :
    poisA d hd lam h 0 i = (if i = (1 : Spin) then (1 : ENNReal) else 0) := by
  unfold poisA poissonLaw observedLaw
  change (∑' o : Spin, (PMF.pure i : PMF Spin) o * (census 0 o * census 0 o)) = _
  rw [tsum_eq_single i]
  · rw [PMF.pure_apply_self]
    simp [census]
  · intro o ho
    rw [PMF.pure_apply, if_neg ho]
    simp
theorem poisB_zero (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam) (i : Spin) :
    poisB d hd lam h 0 i = (if i = (1 : Spin) then (1 : ENNReal) else 0) := by
  unfold poisB poissonLaw observedLaw
  change (∑' o : Spin, (PMF.pure i : PMF Spin) o * (census 0 o * totalCensus 0 o)) = _
  rw [tsum_eq_single i]
  · rw [PMF.pure_apply_self]
    simp [census, totalCensus]
  · intro o ho
    rw [PMF.pure_apply, if_neg ho]
    simp
theorem poisV_zero (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam) (i : Spin) :
    poisV d hd lam h 0 i = eSpin i ^ 2 := by
  rw [poisV, poisA_zero, poisB_zero, poisC_zero]
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [eSpin]
theorem sum_channel_mul_real (lam : ℝ) (i : Spin) (a b c : Spin → ℝ) :
    (∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * a j) - (2 / 3) * (∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * b j)
      + (1 / 9) * (∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * c j)
    = ∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * (a j - (2 / 3) * b j + (1 / 9) * c j) := by
  rw [Finset.mul_sum (Finset.univ) (fun j => channel lam i j * b j) (2/3 : ℝ),
    Finset.mul_sum (Finset.univ) (fun j => channel lam i j * c j) (1/9 : ℝ)]
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring
theorem poisV_rec (d : ℝ) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : 1 ≤ d)
    (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam) (n : ℕ) (i : Spin) :
    poisV d hd0 lam h (n + 1) i =
      d * ∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * poisV d hd0 lam h n j
        + ((d * lam) ^ 2) ^ (n + 1) * eSpin i ^ 2 := by
  rw [poisV, poisA_toReal_rec d hd0 hd1 lam h n i,
    poisB_toReal_rec d hd0 hd1 lam h n i, poisC_toReal_rec d hd0 hd1 lam h n i,
    poisAM_toReal d hd0 lam h n i, poisAT_toReal d hd0 lam h n i]
  have hAB : (∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * (poisA d hd0 lam h n j).toReal) -
      (2 / 3) * (∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * (poisB d hd0 lam h n j).toReal) +
      (1 / 9) * (∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * (poisC d hd0 lam h n j).toReal)
      = ∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * poisV d hd0 lam h n j := by
    rw [sum_channel_mul_real]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [poisV]
  rw [poisV_step_alg d lam n (eSpin i) _ _ _, hAB]
theorem tsum_three {α : Type*} (a b c : α → ℝ) (ha : Summable a) (hb : Summable b) (hc : Summable c) :
    (∑' x, (a x - (2 / 3) * b x + (1 / 9) * c x))
      = (∑' x, a x) - (2 / 3) * (∑' x, b x) + (1 / 9) * (∑' x, c x) := by
  have hb' : Summable fun x => (2 / 3 : ℝ) * b x := hb.mul_left _
  have hc' : Summable fun x => (1 / 9 : ℝ) * c x := hc.mul_left _
  rw [Summable.tsum_add (f := fun x => a x - (2 / 3) * b x) (g := fun x => (1/9) * c x)
      (ha.sub hb') hc']
  rw [Summable.tsum_sub (f := a) (g := fun x => (2 / 3) * b x) ha hb']
  rw [tsum_mul_left (f := b) (a := (2/3:ℝ)), tsum_mul_left (f := c) (a := (1/9:ℝ))]
theorem leafSq_pointwise (n : ℕ) (o : Observation n) :
    (leafSum eSpin n o) ^ 2 =
      (census n o * census n o).toReal
        - (2 / 3) * (census n o * totalCensus n o).toReal
        + (1 / 9) * (totalCensus n o * totalCensus n o).toReal := by
  rw [leafSum_eSpin_eq, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_mul]
  have h : (totalCensus n o * totalCensus n o).toReal = (totalCensus n o).toReal ^ 2 := by
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul]; ring
  rw [h]; ring
theorem summable_A (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam) (n : ℕ) (i : Spin) :
    Summable (fun o : Observation n =>
      (poissonLaw d hd lam h n i o).toReal * (census n o * census n o).toReal) :=
  TheoremOS.Probability.summable_toReal_mul_toReal _ _
    (poisA_ne_top d hd hd1 lam h n i)
theorem summable_B (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam) (n : ℕ) (i : Spin) :
    Summable (fun o : Observation n =>
      (poissonLaw d hd lam h n i o).toReal * (census n o * totalCensus n o).toReal) :=
  TheoremOS.Probability.summable_toReal_mul_toReal _ _
    (poisB_ne_top d hd hd1 lam h n i)
theorem summable_C (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam) (n : ℕ) (i : Spin) :
    Summable (fun o : Observation n =>
      (poissonLaw d hd lam h n i o).toReal * (totalCensus n o * totalCensus n o).toReal) :=
  TheoremOS.Probability.summable_toReal_mul_toReal _ _
    (poisC_ne_top d hd hd1 lam h n i)
theorem tsum_A (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam) (n : ℕ) (i : Spin) :
    (∑' o : Observation n,
      (poissonLaw d hd lam h n i o).toReal * (census n o * census n o).toReal)
      = (poisA d hd lam h n i).toReal :=
  TheoremOS.Probability.tsum_toReal_mul_toReal _ _ (poisA_ne_top d hd hd1 lam h n i)
theorem tsum_B (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam) (n : ℕ) (i : Spin) :
    (∑' o : Observation n,
      (poissonLaw d hd lam h n i o).toReal * (census n o * totalCensus n o).toReal)
      = (poisB d hd lam h n i).toReal :=
  TheoremOS.Probability.tsum_toReal_mul_toReal _ _ (poisB_ne_top d hd hd1 lam h n i)
theorem tsum_C (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam) (n : ℕ) (i : Spin) :
    (∑' o : Observation n,
      (poissonLaw d hd lam h n i o).toReal * (totalCensus n o * totalCensus n o).toReal)
      = (poisC d hd lam h n i).toReal :=
  TheoremOS.Probability.tsum_toReal_mul_toReal _ _ (poisC_ne_top d hd hd1 lam h n i)
theorem poisV_eq_leaf (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam) (n : ℕ) (i : Spin) :
    poisV d hd lam h n i =
      ∑' o : Observation n,
        (poissonLaw d hd lam h n i o).toReal * (leafSum eSpin n o) ^ 2 := by
  have h1 := summable_A d hd hd1 lam h n i
  have h2 := summable_B d hd hd1 lam h n i
  have h3 := summable_C d hd hd1 lam h n i
  have h2' : Summable (fun o : Observation n =>
      (2 / 3) * ((poissonLaw d hd lam h n i o).toReal *
        (census n o * totalCensus n o).toReal)) := h2.mul_left _
  have h3' : Summable (fun o : Observation n =>
      (1 / 9) * ((poissonLaw d hd lam h n i o).toReal *
        (totalCensus n o * totalCensus n o).toReal)) := h3.mul_left _
  have hsub := h1.sub h2'
  have hall := hsub.add h3'
  have hcongr : (∑' o : Observation n,
        (poissonLaw d hd lam h n i o).toReal * (leafSum eSpin n o) ^ 2)
      = (∑' o : Observation n,
          ((poissonLaw d hd lam h n i o).toReal * (census n o * census n o).toReal
            - (2 / 3) * ((poissonLaw d hd lam h n i o).toReal
                * (census n o * totalCensus n o).toReal)
            + (1 / 9) * ((poissonLaw d hd lam h n i o).toReal
                * (totalCensus n o * totalCensus n o).toReal))) := by
    apply tsum_congr
    intro o
    rw [leafSq_pointwise]
    ring
  rw [hcongr, tsum_three _ _ _ h1 h2 h3, tsum_A d hd hd1 lam h n i,
    tsum_B d hd hd1 lam h n i, tsum_C d hd hd1 lam h n i, poisV]
theorem poisLeaf_summable (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam) (n : ℕ) (i : Spin) :
    Summable (fun o : Observation n =>
      (poissonLaw d hd lam h n i o).toReal * (leafSum eSpin n o) ^ 2) := by
  have h1 := summable_A d hd hd1 lam h n i
  have h2 := summable_B d hd hd1 lam h n i
  have h3 := summable_C d hd hd1 lam h n i
  have h2' : Summable (fun o : Observation n =>
      (2 / 3) * ((poissonLaw d hd lam h n i o).toReal *
        (census n o * totalCensus n o).toReal)) := h2.mul_left _
  have h3' : Summable (fun o : Observation n =>
      (1 / 9) * ((poissonLaw d hd lam h n i o).toReal *
        (totalCensus n o * totalCensus n o).toReal)) := h3.mul_left _
  refine ((h1.sub h2').add h3').congr fun o => ?_
  rw [leafSq_pointwise]
  ring
theorem key_coeff (d lam : ℝ) (hd : 1 < d) (hcrit : 1 < d * lam ^ 2) :
    d * ((4 / 9) / (1 - 1 / (d * lam ^ 2))) + (4 / 9) * ((d * lam) ^ 2)
      = ((4 / 9) / (1 - 1 / (d * lam ^ 2))) * ((d * lam) ^ 2) := by
  set r : ℝ := d * lam ^ 2 with hr
  have hr1 : 1 < r := hcrit
  have hr0 : 0 < r := lt_trans zero_lt_one hr1
  have hrne : r - 1 ≠ 0 := by intro h; nlinarith
  have hC : (4 / 9 : ℝ) / (1 - 1 / r) = (4 / 9) * r / (r - 1) := by
    have hr' : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr0
    field_simp
  have hs : (d * lam) ^ 2 = d * r := by rw [hr]; ring
  rw [hC, hs]
  field_simp
  ring
theorem C_mul_one_sub_q (d lam : ℝ) (hd : 1 < d) (hcrit : 1 < d * lam ^ 2) :
    ((4 / 9) / (1 - 1 / (d * lam ^ 2))) * (1 - 1 / (d * lam ^ 2)) = 4 / 9 := by
  set r : ℝ := d * lam ^ 2 with hr
  have hr1 : 1 < r := hcrit
  have hr0 : 0 < r := lt_trans zero_lt_one hr1
  have hq : 0 < 1 - 1 / r := by
    have h : 1 / r < 1 := by rw [div_lt_one hr0]; linarith
    linarith
  have hqne : (1 - 1 / r) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hqne]
theorem poisV_bound (d : ℝ) (hd : 1 < d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam)
    (hcrit : 1 < d * lam ^ 2) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Spin),
      poisV d (le_trans (by norm_num) hd.le) lam h n i ≤
        ((4 / 9) / (1 - 1 / (d * lam ^ 2))) * ((d * lam) ^ 2) ^ n := by
  intro n
  set C : ℝ := (4 / 9) / (1 - 1 / (d * lam ^ 2)) with hCdef
  set s : ℝ := (d * lam) ^ 2 with hsdef
  have hd0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ d := le_of_lt (lt_trans zero_lt_one hd)
  have hd1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ d := le_of_lt hd
  have hr0 : 0 < d * lam ^ 2 := lt_trans zero_lt_one hcrit
  have hq : 1 / (d * lam ^ 2) < 1 := by rw [div_lt_one hr0]; linarith
  have hqpos : 0 < 1 - 1 / (d * lam ^ 2) := by linarith
  have hCpos : 0 < C := by rw [hCdef]; positivity
  have hCq : C * (1 - 1 / (d * lam ^ 2)) = 4 / 9 := by
    rw [hCdef]; exact C_mul_one_sub_q d lam hd hcrit
  have hkey : d * C + (4 / 9) * s = C * s := by
    rw [hCdef, hsdef]; exact key_coeff d lam hd hcrit
  have hsnn : 0 ≤ s := by rw [hsdef]; positivity
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro i
      rw [poisV_zero]
      calc eSpin i ^ 2 ≤ 4 / 9 := eSpin_sq_le i
        _ = C * (1 - 1 / (d * lam ^ 2)) := hCq.symm
        _ ≤ C * 1 := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hCpos.le
            have hp : 0 ≤ 1 / (d * lam ^ 2) := by positivity
            linarith
        _ = C * s ^ 0 := by rw [pow_zero, mul_one]
  | succ n ih =>
      intro i
      rw [poisV_rec d hd0 hd1 lam h n i]
      have hrow : (∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * (C * s ^ n)) = C * s ^ n := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, channel_sum, one_mul]
      have hsn : 0 ≤ s ^ n := pow_nonneg hsnn n
      have hb1 : (∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * poisV d hd0 lam h n j)
          ≤ C * s ^ n := by
        calc (∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * poisV d hd0 lam h n j)
            ≤ ∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * (C * s ^ n) := by
              apply Finset.sum_le_sum
              intro j _
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih j) (channel_nonneg h i j)
          _ = C * s ^ n := hrow
      have he : eSpin i ^ 2 ≤ 4 / 9 := eSpin_sq_le i
      have hs1 : 0 ≤ s ^ (n + 1) := pow_nonneg hsnn _
      calc d * (∑ j : Spin, channel lam i j * poisV d hd0 lam h n j)
            + s ^ (n + 1) * eSpin i ^ 2
          ≤ d * (C * s ^ n) + s ^ (n + 1) * (4 / 9) := by
            apply add_le_add
            · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb1 hd0
            · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he hs1
        _ = s ^ n * (d * C + (4 / 9) * s) := by
            rw [pow_succ]; ring
        _ = s ^ n * (C * s) := by rw [hkey]
        _ = C * s ^ (n + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
theorem poissonLeaf_second_moment (d : ℝ) (hd : 1 < d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam)
    (hcrit : 1 < d * lam ^ 2) :
    ((∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Spin),
        Summable (fun o : Observation n =>
          (poissonLaw d (le_trans (by norm_num) hd.le) lam h n i o).toReal *
            (leafSum eSpin n o) ^ 2)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Spin),
        (∑' o : Observation n,
          (poissonLaw d (le_trans (by norm_num) hd.le) lam h n i o).toReal *
            (leafSum eSpin n o) ^ 2) ≤
          ((4 / 9) / (1 - 1 / (d * lam ^ 2))) * ((d : ℝ) * lam) ^ (2 * n))) := by
  have hd0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ d := le_of_lt (lt_trans zero_lt_one hd)
  have hd1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ d := le_of_lt hd
  refine ⟨fun n i => poisLeaf_summable d hd0 hd1 lam h n i, fun n i => ?_⟩
  rw [← poisV_eq_leaf d hd0 hd1 lam h n i]
  rw [show ((d : ℝ) * lam) ^ (2 * n) = ((d * lam) ^ 2) ^ n from by rw [← pow_mul]]
  exact poisV_bound d hd lam h hcrit n i
theorem poissonLeaf_moments (d : ℝ) (hd : 1 < d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam)
    (hcrit : 1 < d * lam ^ 2) :
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Spin),
        (∑' o : Observation n,
          (poissonLaw d (le_trans (by norm_num) hd.le) lam h n i o).toReal * leafSum eSpin n o)
          = ((d : ℝ) * lam) ^ n * eSpin i)
      ∧ ((∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Spin), Summable (fun o : Observation n =>
            (poissonLaw d (le_trans (by norm_num) hd.le) lam h n i o).toReal *
              (leafSum eSpin n o) ^ 2))
        ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Spin),
            (∑' o : Observation n,
              (poissonLaw d (le_trans (by norm_num) hd.le) lam h n i o).toReal *
                (leafSum eSpin n o) ^ 2) ≤
              ((4 / 9) / (1 - 1 / (d * lam ^ 2))) * ((d : ℝ) * lam) ^ (2 * n))) := by
  exact ⟨poissonLeaf_first_moment d hd lam h hcrit,
    poissonLeaf_second_moment d hd lam h hcrit⟩
theorem regular_supercritical (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam)
    (hcrit : 1 < (b : ℝ) * lam ^ 2) : Reconstructs (regularAdvantage b lam h) := by
  set r : ℝ := (b : ℝ) * lam ^ 2 with hr
  set s : ℝ := ((b : ℝ) * lam) ^ 2 with hs
  set Q : ℝ := 4 * r / (9 * (r - 1)) with hQ
  have hr1 : 1 < r := hcrit
  have hr0 : 0 < r := lt_trans zero_lt_one hr1
  have hrm1 : 0 < r - 1 := by linarith
  have hQpos : 0 < Q := by rw [hQ]; positivity
  have hs_pos : 0 < s := by
    rw [hs]
    apply sq_pos_of_ne_zero
    have hbpos : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 0 < 2) hb)
    have hlam : lam ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      rw [hr, hz] at hr0
      simp at hr0
    exact mul_ne_zero hbpos.ne' hlam
  have hTV : ∀ n : ℕ, (1 : ℝ) / (4 * Q) ≤
      TheoremOS.Probability.pmfTV (regularLaw b lam h n (1 : Spin)) (regularLaw b lam h n (0 : Spin)) := by
    intro n
    set p : PMF (Observation n) := regularLaw b lam h n (1 : Spin) with hp_def
    set q : PMF (Observation n) := regularLaw b lam h n (0 : Spin) with hq_def
    set S : Observation n → ℝ := fun o => (census n o).toReal with hS_def
    have hp_sum : Summable fun a => (p a).toReal * S a ^ 2 := by
      have hA : (∑' a : Observation n, p a * (census n a * census n a)) ≠ ⊤ := by
        have := regA_ne_top b lam h n (1 : Spin)
        simpa [regA, p] using this
      have hsA := TheoremOS.Probability.summable_toReal_mul_toReal p
        (fun a => census n a * census n a) hA
      simpa [S, pow_two, ENNReal.toReal_mul] using hsA
    have hq_sum : Summable fun a => (q a).toReal * S a ^ 2 := by
      have hA : (∑' a : Observation n, q a * (census n a * census n a)) ≠ ⊤ := by
        have := regA_ne_top b lam h n (0 : Spin)
        simpa [regA, q] using this
      have hsA := TheoremOS.Probability.summable_toReal_mul_toReal q
        (fun a => census n a * census n a) hA
      simpa [S, pow_two, ENNReal.toReal_mul] using hsA
    have hM1 : (∑' o : Observation n, (p o).toReal * S o) =
        (regM b lam h n (1 : Spin)).toReal := by
      rw [show (∑' o : Observation n, (p o).toReal * S o) =
          ∑' o : Observation n, (p o).toReal * (census n o).toReal by rfl]
      rw [TheoremOS.Probability.tsum_toReal_mul_toReal p (fun o => census n o)
        (by simpa [p, regM] using regM_ne_top b lam h n (1 : Spin))]
      simp [p, regM]
    have hM0 : (∑' o : Observation n, (q o).toReal * S o) =
        (regM b lam h n (0 : Spin)).toReal := by
      rw [show (∑' o : Observation n, (q o).toReal * S o) =
          ∑' o : Observation n, (q o).toReal * (census n o).toReal by rfl]
      rw [TheoremOS.Probability.tsum_toReal_mul_toReal q (fun o => census n o)
        (by simpa [q, regM] using regM_ne_top b lam h n (0 : Spin))]
      simp [q, regM]
    have hmean : (∑' o : Observation n, (p o).toReal * S o) -
        (∑' o : Observation n, (q o).toReal * S o) = ((b : ℝ) * lam) ^ n := by
      rw [hM1, hM0, regM_formula, regM_formula]
      have hsub : eSpin (1 : Spin) - eSpin (0 : Spin) = 1 := eSpin_one_sub_zero
      have : (b : ℝ) ^ n * (1 / 3 + lam ^ n * eSpin 1) -
          (b : ℝ) ^ n * (1 / 3 + lam ^ n * eSpin 0) =
          (b : ℝ) ^ n * lam ^ n * (eSpin 1 - eSpin 0) := by ring
      rw [this, hsub, mul_one, mul_pow]
    have hsquare : ((∑' o : Observation n, (p o).toReal * S o) -
        (∑' o : Observation n, (q o).toReal * S o)) ^ 2 = s ^ n := by
      rw [hmean, hs]
      exact (pow_right_comm _ 2 n).symm
    have hW1 : (∑' o : Observation n, (p o).toReal * (S o - regC b n) ^ 2) =
        regW b lam h n (1 : Spin) := by
      simp [regW, p, S]
    have hW0 : (∑' o : Observation n, (q o).toReal * (S o - regC b n) ^ 2) =
        regW b lam h n (0 : Spin) := by
      simp [regW, q, S]
    have hWsum : (∑' o : Observation n, (p o).toReal * (S o - regC b n) ^ 2) +
        (∑' o : Observation n, (q o).toReal * (S o - regC b n) ^ 2) ≤
        2 * (Q * s ^ n) := by
      rw [hW1, hW0]
      have h1 : regW b lam h n (1 : Spin) ≤ Q * s ^ n := by
        simpa [Q, s, r, hQ, hs, hr] using regW_bound b hb lam h hcrit n (1 : Spin)
      have h0 : regW b lam h n (0 : Spin) ≤ Q * s ^ n := by
        simpa [Q, s, r, hQ, hs, hr] using regW_bound b hb lam h hcrit n (0 : Spin)
      linarith
    have hmain := TheoremOS.Probability.sq_sub_le_pmfTV_mul_centred p q S (regC b n)
      hp_sum hq_sum
    have hle : s ^ n ≤ 2 * TheoremOS.Probability.pmfTV p q * (2 * (Q * s ^ n)) := by
      calc
        s ^ n = ((∑' o : Observation n, (p o).toReal * S o) -
            (∑' o : Observation n, (q o).toReal * S o)) ^ 2 := hsquare.symm
        _ ≤ 2 * TheoremOS.Probability.pmfTV p q * ((∑' o : Observation n,
              (p o).toReal * (S o - regC b n) ^ 2) +
              (∑' o : Observation n, (q o).toReal * (S o - regC b n) ^ 2)) := hmain
        _ ≤ 2 * TheoremOS.Probability.pmfTV p q * (2 * (Q * s ^ n)) := by
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hWsum
              have htv0 : 0 ≤ TheoremOS.Probability.pmfTV p q := TheoremOS.Probability.pmfTV_nonneg p q
              positivity
    have hspos : 0 < s ^ n := pow_pos hs_pos n
    have hquad : 1 ≤ 4 * Q * TheoremOS.Probability.pmfTV p q := by
      have hle' : s ^ n ≤ (4 * Q * s ^ n) * TheoremOS.Probability.pmfTV p q := by
        calc
          s ^ n ≤ 2 * TheoremOS.Probability.pmfTV p q * (2 * (Q * s ^ n)) := hle
          _ = (4 * Q * s ^ n) * TheoremOS.Probability.pmfTV p q := by ring
      have hle2 : s ^ n * 1 ≤ s ^ n * (4 * Q * TheoremOS.Probability.pmfTV p q) := by
        calc
          s ^ n * 1 = s ^ n := by ring
          _ ≤ (4 * Q * s ^ n) * TheoremOS.Probability.pmfTV p q := hle'
          _ = s ^ n * (4 * Q * TheoremOS.Probability.pmfTV p q) := by ring
      exact (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left hspos).mp hle2
    have htv : (1 : ℝ) / (4 * Q) ≤ TheoremOS.Probability.pmfTV p q := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * Q)]
      simpa [mul_comm] using hquad
    simpa [p, q] using htv
  have hAdv : ∀ n : ℕ, (1 : ℝ) / (12 * Q) ≤
      TheoremOS.Probability.reconAdvantage (regularLaw b lam h n) := by
    intro n
    have htv := hTV n
    have hcard := TheoremOS.Probability.pmfTV_le_card_mul_reconAdvantage
      (regularLaw b lam h n) (1 : Spin) (0 : Spin)
    have hcard3 : (Fintype.card Spin : ℝ) = 3 := by simp
    rw [hcard3] at hcard
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) / (4 * Q) ≤ 3 * TheoremOS.Probability.reconAdvantage
        (regularLaw b lam h n) := htv.trans hcard
    have heq : (1 : ℝ) / (4 * Q) = 3 * (1 / (12 * Q)) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [heq] at h1
    exact (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)).mp h1
  have hbc := isBroadcastLaw_observedLaw (PMF.pure b) lam h
  have hiff := hbc.exists_pos_tendsto_iff
    (leaf := fun i : Spin => i) (up := fun _ s => s) (law := observedLaw (PMF.pure b) lam h)
    (fun _ _ hij => hij) (fun _ _ _ hij => hij)
  have hpos : ∃ ε, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ n : ℕ,
      ε ≤ TheoremOS.Probability.reconAdvantage (observedLaw (PMF.pure b) lam h n) := by
    refine ⟨1 / (12 * Q), by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro n
    simpa [regularLaw] using hAdv n
  rcases hiff.mpr hpos with ⟨L, hL, hlim⟩
  refine ⟨L, hL, ?_⟩
  have hfun : regularAdvantage b lam h = fun n =>
      TheoremOS.Probability.reconAdvantage (observedLaw (PMF.pure b) lam h n) := by
    funext n
    simp only [regularAdvantage, regularLaw]
    exact advantage_eq_reconAdvantage (regularLaw b lam h n)
  rw [hfun]
  exact hlim
theorem poisson_supercritical (d : ℝ) (hd : 1 < d) (lam : ℝ) (h : Admissible lam)
    (hcrit : 1 < d * lam ^ 2) : Reconstructs (poissonAdvantage d hd lam h) :=
  poisson_reconstructs_of_leaf_moments d hd lam h hcrit
    (poissonLeaf_first_moment d hd lam h hcrit)
    (poissonLeaf_second_moment d hd lam h hcrit)

end ThreeState

end OAI

import Mathlib

/-! # TheoremOS auto-library module `ThreeStateChannelSpectrum`

Defines the transition matrix of the symmetric three-state channel, P(lam)(i,j) = (1+2lam)/3 for i=j and (1-lam)/3 otherwise, and proves its eigenvector action: P(lam) *ᵥ x = ((1-lam)/3 * sum_i x_i) • 1 + lam • x, together with the n-step version (P(lam)^n) *ᵥ x = ((1-lam^n)/3 * sum_i x_i) • 1 + lam^n • x. Taking x to be a difference of unit vectors and the uniform vector gives P(lam)^n(i,j) - 1/3 = lam^n (delta_ij - 1/3), so correlations decay exactly like lam^n. This is the standard eigenvalue computation underlying the Kesten-Stigum reconstruction threshold.

Planned use for the triggering challenge:
* OAI.ThreeState.regular_supercritical: Use TheoremOS.Auto.ThreeStateChannelSpectrum.channelMatrix_pow_mulVec. The challenge's channel is exactly channelMatrix lam (it is defined by the same if i=j then (1+2*lam)/3 else (1-lam)/3). Apply the power identity to the vector x = e_a - u, where e_a is a unit vector at root state a and u is the constant vector 1/3; its coordinate sum is 1 - 3*(1/3) = 0, so the first summand vanishes and (channelMatrix lam ^ n) *ᵥ x = lam^n • x. Reading coordinates gives P^n(a,j) - 1/3 = lam^n (delta_{a j} - 1/3): the n-step transition probabilities approach uniform at rate lam^n. This supplies the correlation decay needed to compare the root-a law with the uniform mixture, since after n generations the signal-to-noise ratio scales like b^n * lam^{2n} = (b * lam^2)^n, and the hypothesis hcrit : 1 < b * lam^2 makes this grow. All premises of the lemma (a real lam, a natural n, an arbitrary real vector on Fin 3) are immediate; the only input used is the definition of channelMatrix, which unfolds to the challenge's channel. The Poisson case is identical with b replaced by d.
* Remaining: Relate the real channel matrix to the PMF channelPMF: show the entries of channelPMF are ENNReal.ofReal of channelMatrix entries and that (channelPMF lam h i j).toReal = channelMatrix lam i j.
* Remaining: Iterate the broadcast to obtain the n-step law of a single leaf given the root: the leaf-state marginal is the n-th convolution power of the channel, so the power identity yields its deviation lambda^n (delta_ij - 1/3) from uniform.
* Remaining: Expand the tree: the offspring law needs its first and second moments; for regular b the observed law at depth n is a b^n-fold independent sample, and for Poisson d the offspring moments come from the exponential generating function of poissonOffspring.
* Remaining: Control the effect of the root on the marginal by a chi-square/second-moment computation, then convert the resulting squared-distance (Hellinger/chi-square) estimate into the total-variation quantities appearing in advantage.
* Remaining: Use the existing TheoremOS.Probability.TreeReconstruction library for pmfTV and reconAdvantage, and prove the bridge identity that the challenge's advantage (sum over observations of marginal times half the sum of posterior deviations) equals (1/3) times the sum over the three root states of pmfTV of law i from the uniform mixture.
* Remaining: Handle the degenerate observations where the marginal mass is zero, using the if-then-else convention in posterior without changing the value of advantage.
* Remaining: Prove monotonicity/convergence of the resulting scalar recursion when 1 < b * lam^2 (regular case) and 1 < d * lam^2 (Poisson case), obtaining Filter.Tendsto ... atTop (nhds L) for the two advantage sequences.
* Remaining: Assemble the two headline theorems regular_supercritical and poisson_supercritical from the above, using Admissible to ensure channel_nonneg so that channelPMF is a genuine PMF.

Sources:
* H. Kesten and B. P. Stigum, Additional limit theorems for indecomposable multidimensional Galton-Watson processes, Ann. Math. Statist. 37 (1966).
* E. Mossel, Survey: Information flow on trees, in Graphs, Morphisms and Statistical Physics, DIMACS Ser. Discrete Math. Theoret. Comput. Sci. 63 (2004).
* C. Borgs, J. Chayes, L. Lovasz and K. Vesztergombi, Counting graph homomorphisms, in Topics in Discrete Mathematics (2006), for the symmetric-channel spectral decomposition.

Written by the TheoremOS library planner and proved by a TheoremOS solver run before solving the problem
recorded in the pool record. Only declarations Lean accepted with no gaps are kept. -/

/-!
# The spectrum of the three-state symmetric channel

The channel matrix `P(lam)` with entries `(1 + 2*lam)/3` on the diagonal and
`(1 - lam)/3` off the diagonal is `((1 - lam)/3) smul J + lam smul 1`, where `J`
is the all-ones matrix.  Consequently its action on a vector `x` splits off the
component along the constant vector:
`P(lam) *ᵥ x = ((1 - lam)/3 * sum i, x i) smul 1 + lam smul x`.
Iterating gives
`(P(lam)^n) *ᵥ x = ((1 - lam^n)/3 * sum i, x i) smul 1 + lam^n smul x`,
so the deviation of the `n`-step transition probabilities from the uniform
distribution decays like `lam^n`.  This is the eigenvalue computation behind the
Kesten-Stigum threshold for reconstruction on trees.
-/

open Matrix
open scoped BigOperators

namespace TheoremOS.Auto.ThreeStateChannelSpectrum

/-- The transition matrix of the symmetric three-state channel with parameter `lam`. -/
noncomputable def channelMatrix (lam : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  fun i j => if i = j then (1 + 2 * lam) / 3 else (1 - lam) / 3

/-- The channel acts on a vector by keeping a `lam` fraction of its deviation from the
constant vector and replacing its mean by the same mean. -/
theorem channelMatrix_mulVec_eq (lam : ℝ) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    channelMatrix lam *ᵥ x
      = ((1 - lam) / 3 * ∑ i, x i) • (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) + lam • x := by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [channelMatrix, Matrix.mulVec_apply_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring

/-- The `n`-step transition matrix keeps only a `lam^n` fraction of the deviation
from the uniform vector. -/
theorem channelMatrix_pow_mulVec (lam : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    (channelMatrix lam ^ n) *ᵥ x
      = ((1 - lam ^ n) / 3 * ∑ i, x i) • (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) + lam ^ n • x := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ih, channelMatrix_mulVec_eq]
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;>
        simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, pow_succ] <;> ring

end TheoremOS.Auto.ThreeStateChannelSpectrum

import Mathlib

/-!
# Cofinite subspaces and asymptotic moduli of a seminorm

For a real normed space `X`, a closed subspace of finite codimension is *cofinite*
(`IsCofinite F`). For a function `N : X → ℝ` (usually an equivalent seminorm), a point `x`, a
parameter `t` and a cofinite `F`, the inner infima are
`asympOneSidedInner N t x F = inf {N(x + t y) - 1 : y ∈ F, N y = 1}`,
`asympAveragedInner N t x F = inf {(N(x + t y) + N(x - t y))/2 - 1 : y ∈ F, 1 ≤ N y}` and its unit
version `asympAveragedUnitInner` (directions with `N y = 1`); taking `sup` over cofinite `F` gives
`asympOneSided`/`asympAveraged`, and `inf` over `N x = 1` gives the moduli
`asympOneSidedModulus`/`asympAveragedModulus`. Contents: `⊤`, finite intersections and kernels of
continuous functionals (more generally of continuous maps to finite-dimensional spaces) are
cofinite; in an infinite-dimensional space every cofinite subspace contains `N`-unit vectors when
`a‖·‖ ≤ N`; Hahn–Banach for a seminorm `N ≤ b‖·‖` (`exists_clm_eq_one_le`); the generic bounds
`max 0 (|t| - 2) ≤ one-sided ≤ |t|` and `max 0 (|t| - 1) ≤ averaged ≤ |t|` at every unit point and
for the moduli; the convexity step `N(x + c y) + N(x - c y) ≤ N(x + y) + N(x - y)` for `c ∈ [0, 1]`
and the identity `asympAveragedInner = asympAveragedUnitInner` for seminorms; antitonicity of the
inner infima in `F`.

Sources: W. B. Johnson, J. Lindenstrauss, D. Preiss and G. Schechtman, Almost Fréchet
differentiability of Lipschitz mappings between infinite-dimensional Banach spaces, Proc. London
Math. Soc. 84 (2002) 711–746, Section 2 (asymptotic moduli); V. D. Milman, Geometric theory of
Banach spaces II, Russian Math. Surveys 26 (1971) 79–163, Section 4.6; M. Fabian, P. Habala,
P. Hájek, V. Montesinos and V. Zizler, *Banach Space Theory*, Springer CMS Books, 2011, Theorem 2.1
(Hahn–Banach) and Section 2.3 (closed subspaces of finite codimension). Textbook material; nothing
here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: a set `{F | IsClosed (F : Set X) ∧ FiniteDimensional ℝ (X ⧸ F)}` is
`{F | IsCofinite F}` by `rfl`. Nested `sInf`/`sSup`/`sInf` definitions of the form
`sInf {r | ∃ x, N x = 1 ∧ r = sSup {a | ∃ F, IsCofinite F ∧ a = sInf {b | ∃ y, y ∈ F ∧ N y = 1 ∧
b = N (x + t • y) - 1}}}` are `asympOneSidedModulus N t` by `rfl` (also with `∃ F ∈ S`, with the
pair `∃ y ∈ F` and with `averagedIncrement` unfolded); the averaged versions with `1 ≤ N y` and
`/ 2` likewise. A supremum over `Set.range` of a function on the subtype of cofinite subspaces is
rewritten with `sSup_range_cofinite`. `((2 : ℕ) : ℝ)` is `2` by `Nat.cast_ofNat`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Analysis

open Set

noncomputable section

variable {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]

/-- A closed linear subspace of finite codimension. -/
def IsCofinite (F : Submodule ℝ X) : Prop :=
  IsClosed (F : Set X) ∧ FiniteDimensional ℝ (X ⧸ F)

namespace IsCofinite

theorem top : IsCofinite (⊤ : Submodule ℝ X) := ⟨isClosed_univ, inferInstance⟩

theorem inf {F G : Submodule ℝ X} (hF : IsCofinite F) (hG : IsCofinite G) : IsCofinite (F ⊓ G) := by
  refine ⟨by simpa using hF.1.inter hG.1, ?_⟩
  have := hF.2
  have := hG.2
  have hker : (F.mkQ.prod G.mkQ).ker = F ⊓ G := by
    rw [LinearMap.ker_prod, Submodule.ker_mkQ, Submodule.ker_mkQ]
  exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
    ((Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hker).symm.trans (F.mkQ.prod G.mkQ).quotKerEquivRange).symm

/-- The kernel of a continuous linear map to a finite-dimensional space is cofinite. -/
theorem ker {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (ℓ : X →L[ℝ] E) : IsCofinite (LinearMap.ker (ℓ : X →ₗ[ℝ] E)) :=
  ⟨ℓ.isClosed_ker, LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (ℓ : X →ₗ[ℝ] E).quotKerEquivRange.symm⟩

theorem ker_functional (ℓ : X →L[ℝ] ℝ) : IsCofinite (LinearMap.ker (ℓ : X →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) := ker ℓ

/-- In an infinite-dimensional space a cofinite subspace is nonzero. -/
theorem ne_bot (hX : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℝ X) {F : Submodule ℝ X} (hF : IsCofinite F) :
    F ≠ ⊥ := by
  rintro rfl
  have := hF.2
  exact hX (LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot ⊥ rfl))

/-- In an infinite-dimensional space a cofinite subspace contains `N`-unit vectors when
`a ‖·‖ ≤ N` with `0 < a`. -/
theorem exists_unit (hX : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℝ X) {F : Submodule ℝ X} (hF : IsCofinite F)
    (N : Seminorm ℝ X) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hN : ∀ x, a * ‖x‖ ≤ N x) :
    ∃ y ∈ F, N y = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨y, hyF, hy0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot (hF.ne_bot hX)
  have hNy : 0 < N y := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos ha (norm_pos_iff.mpr hy0)) (hN y)
  refine ⟨(N y)⁻¹ • y, F.smul_mem _ hyF, ?_⟩
  rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hNy, inv_mul_cancel₀ hNy.ne']

end IsCofinite

/-- Supremum over the subtype of cofinite subspaces, rewritten as a supremum over a set. -/
theorem sSup_range_cofinite (g : Submodule ℝ X → ℝ) :
    sSup (Set.range fun F : {F : Submodule ℝ X // IsClosed (F : Set X) ∧
      FiniteDimensional ℝ (X ⧸ F)} => g F.val) = sSup {a | ∃ F, IsCofinite F ∧ a = g F} := by
  congr 1
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨F, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨F.val, F.property, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨F, hF⟩, rfl⟩

/-- Hahn–Banach for a seminorm `N ≤ b ‖·‖`: a continuous functional `ℓ ≤ N` with `ℓ x = 1`. -/
theorem exists_clm_eq_one_le (N : Seminorm ℝ X) {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) {x : X}
    (hx : N x = 1) : ∃ ℓ : X →L[ℝ] ℝ, ℓ x = 1 ∧ ∀ z, ℓ z ≤ N z := by
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hx
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgN⟩ := exists_extension_of_le_sublinear
    (LinearPMap.mkSpanSingleton x (1 : ℝ) hx0) N
    (fun c hc z => by rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc])
    (fun z w => map_add_le_add N z w) (by
      rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hz
      rw [LinearPMap.mkSpanSingleton'_apply]
      simp only [RingHom.id_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, map_smul_eq_mul, hx, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact le_abs_self c)
  have hgx : g x = 1 := by
    have := hg ⟨x, Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self x⟩
    rw [this]
    exact LinearPMap.mkSpanSingleton_apply ℝ ℝ hx0 1
  have hbound : ∀ z, ‖g z‖ ≤ b * ‖z‖ := by
    intro z
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
    constructor
    · have := (hgN (-z)).trans (hNb (-z))
      rw [map_neg, norm_neg] at this
      linarith
    · exact (hgN z).trans (hNb z)
  exact ⟨g.mkContinuous b hbound, by simpa using hgx, fun z => by simpa using hgN z⟩

section Moduli

/-- `inf {N(x + t y) - 1 : y ∈ F, N y = 1}`. -/
def asympOneSidedInner (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) : ℝ :=
  sInf {b | ∃ y : X, y ∈ F ∧ N y = 1 ∧ b = N (x + t • y) - 1}

/-- `sup` of `asympOneSidedInner` over cofinite subspaces. -/
def asympOneSided (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : X) : ℝ :=
  sSup {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympOneSidedInner N t x F}

/-- The one-sided asymptotic modulus: `inf` of `asympOneSided` over `N x = 1`. -/
def asympOneSidedModulus (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sInf {r | ∃ x : X, N x = 1 ∧ r = asympOneSided N t x}

/-- `inf {(N(x + t y) + N(x - t y))/2 - 1 : y ∈ F, 1 ≤ N y}`. -/
def asympAveragedInner (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) : ℝ :=
  sInf {b | ∃ y : X, y ∈ F ∧ 1 ≤ N y ∧ b = (N (x + t • y) + N (x - t • y)) / 2 - 1}

/-- The same infimum over directions with `N y = 1`. -/
def asympAveragedUnitInner (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) : ℝ :=
  sInf {b | ∃ y : X, y ∈ F ∧ N y = 1 ∧ b = (N (x + t • y) + N (x - t • y)) / 2 - 1}

/-- `sup` of `asympAveragedInner` over cofinite subspaces. -/
def asympAveraged (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : X) : ℝ :=
  sSup {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympAveragedInner N t x F}

/-- The averaged asymptotic (midpoint) modulus. -/
def asympAveragedModulus (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sInf {r | ∃ x : X, N x = 1 ∧ r = asympAveraged N t x}

/-- An `sInf` of a set all of whose elements are `≤ c` with `0 ≤ c` is `≤ c`, whether or not the
set is empty. -/
theorem sInf_le_of_forall_mem_le {s : Set ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hs : BddBelow s) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∀ b ∈ s, b ≤ c) : sInf s ≤ c := by
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ⟨b, hb⟩
  · simpa using hc
  · exact (csInf_le hs hb).trans (h b hb)

variable (N : Seminorm ℝ X)

theorem bddBelow_asympOneSidedInner (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    BddBelow {b | ∃ y : X, y ∈ F ∧ N y = 1 ∧ b = N (x + t • y) - 1} :=
  ⟨-1, by rintro b ⟨y, -, -, rfl⟩; linarith [apply_nonneg N (x + t • y)]⟩

theorem asympOneSidedInner_le_abs {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    asympOneSidedInner N t x F ≤ |t| :=
  sInf_le_of_forall_mem_le (bddBelow_asympOneSidedInner N t x F) (abs_nonneg t) (by
    rintro b ⟨y, -, hy, rfl⟩
    have := map_add_le_add N x (t • y)
    rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hx, hy] at this
    linarith)

/-- On the kernel of a functional `ℓ ≤ N` with `ℓ x = 1` the inner infimum is nonnegative. -/
theorem asympOneSidedInner_ker_nonneg {x : X} {ℓ : X →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hℓx : ℓ x = 1) (hℓ : ∀ z, ℓ z ≤ N z)
    (t : ℝ) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    0 ≤ asympOneSidedInner N t x (F ⊓ LinearMap.ker (ℓ : X →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) := by
  refine Real.sInf_nonneg ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, hy, -, rfl⟩
  have hy0 : ℓ y = 0 := (Submodule.mem_inf.mp hy).2
  have := hℓ (x + t • y)
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, hℓx, hy0, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero] at this
  linarith

theorem bddAbove_asympOneSided {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    BddAbove {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympOneSidedInner (⇑N) t x F} :=
  ⟨|t|, by rintro a ⟨F, -, rfl⟩; exact asympOneSidedInner_le_abs N hx F⟩

theorem asympOneSidedInner_le {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) {F : Submodule ℝ X}
    (hF : IsCofinite F) : asympOneSidedInner N t x F ≤ asympOneSided N t x :=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_asympOneSided N hx) ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩

theorem asympOneSided_le_abs {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) : asympOneSided N t x ≤ |t| :=
  Real.sSup_le (by rintro a ⟨F, -, rfl⟩; exact asympOneSidedInner_le_abs N hx F) (abs_nonneg t)

/-- `0 ≤ D(x, t)` at an `N`-unit point when `N ≤ b ‖·‖` (Hahn–Banach). -/
theorem asympOneSided_nonneg {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    0 ≤ asympOneSided N t x := by
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓx, hℓ⟩ := exists_clm_eq_one_le N hNb hx
  have h := asympOneSidedInner_ker_nonneg N hℓx hℓ t ⊤
  rw [top_inf_eq] at h
  exact h.trans (asympOneSidedInner_le N hx (IsCofinite.ker_functional ℓ))

/-- `|t| - 2 ≤ inf` over all unit directions, by the triangle inequality. -/
theorem abs_sub_two_le_asympOneSidedInner_top {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    |t| - 2 ≤ asympOneSidedInner N t x ⊤ := by
  refine le_csInf ⟨_, x, Submodule.mem_top, hx, rfl⟩ ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, -, hy, rfl⟩
  have := map_sub_le_add N (x + t • y) x
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hy, hx] at this
  linarith

/-- Generic bounds `max 0 (|t| - 2) ≤ D(x, t) ≤ |t|` at an `N`-unit point. -/
theorem max_le_asympOneSided {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    max 0 (|t| - 2) ≤ asympOneSided N t x :=
  max_le (asympOneSided_nonneg N hNb hx)
    ((abs_sub_two_le_asympOneSidedInner_top N hx).trans (asympOneSidedInner_le N hx IsCofinite.top))

theorem asympOneSidedModulus_le_abs (t : ℝ) : asympOneSidedModulus N t ≤ |t| :=
  sInf_le_of_forall_mem_le ⟨|t| - 2, by
      rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact (abs_sub_two_le_asympOneSidedInner_top N hx).trans
        (asympOneSidedInner_le N hx IsCofinite.top)⟩
    (abs_nonneg t) (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact asympOneSided_le_abs N hx)

theorem asympOneSidedModulus_nonneg {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ asympOneSidedModulus N t :=
  Real.sInf_nonneg (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact asympOneSided_nonneg N hNb hx)

/-- Generic lower bound for the modulus, given one `N`-unit vector. -/
theorem max_le_asympOneSidedModulus {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) (hX : ∃ x, N x = 1)
    (t : ℝ) : max 0 (|t| - 2) ≤ asympOneSidedModulus N t := by
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hX
  exact le_csInf ⟨_, x₀, hx₀, rfl⟩ (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact max_le_asympOneSided N hNb hx)

/-- A larger subspace has a smaller inner infimum (when the smaller one has unit vectors). -/
theorem asympOneSidedInner_anti {t : ℝ} {x : X} {F G : Submodule ℝ X} (hFG : F ≤ G)
    (hF : ∃ y ∈ F, N y = 1) : asympOneSidedInner N t x G ≤ asympOneSidedInner N t x F := by
  obtain ⟨y, hyF, hy⟩ := hF
  exact csInf_le_csInf (bddBelow_asympOneSidedInner N t x G) ⟨_, y, hyF, hy, rfl⟩
    (by rintro b ⟨z, hz, hz1, rfl⟩; exact ⟨z, hFG hz, hz1, rfl⟩)

/-- Two sets of reals with `B ⊆ A`, every element of `A` above some element of `B` and `A`
bounded below have the same infimum (also when they are empty). -/
theorem sInf_eq_of_subset_of_forall_exists_le {A B : Set ℝ} (hA : BddBelow A) (hBA : B ⊆ A)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ A, ∃ b ∈ B, b ≤ a) : sInf A = sInf B := by
  rcases B.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hB
  · have : A = ∅ := by
      ext a
      simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      intro ha
      obtain ⟨b, hb, -⟩ := h a ha
      exact hb
    rw [this]
  · exact le_antisymm (csInf_le_csInf hA hB hBA)
      (le_csInf (hB.mono hBA) fun a ha => by
        obtain ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ := h a ha
        exact (csInf_le (hA.mono hBA) hb).trans hba)

/-- Convexity step: `N(x + c y) + N(x - c y) ≤ N(x + y) + N(x - y)` for `0 ≤ c ≤ 1`. -/
theorem add_smul_add_sub_smul_le {c : ℝ} (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1) (x y : X) :
    N (x + c • y) + N (x - c • y) ≤ N (x + y) + N (x - y) := by
  have e1 : x + c • y = ((1 + c) / 2) • (x + y) + ((1 - c) / 2) • (x - y) := by module
  have e2 : x - c • y = ((1 - c) / 2) • (x + y) + ((1 + c) / 2) • (x - y) := by module
  have h1 := map_add_le_add N (((1 + c) / 2) • (x + y)) (((1 - c) / 2) • (x - y))
  have h2 := map_add_le_add N (((1 - c) / 2) • (x + y)) (((1 + c) / 2) • (x - y))
  rw [← e1] at h1
  rw [← e2] at h2
  simp only [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + c) / 2),
    abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 - c) / 2)] at h1 h2
  linarith

theorem bddBelow_asympAveragedInner (P : X → Prop) (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    BddBelow {b | ∃ y : X, y ∈ F ∧ P y ∧ b = (N (x + t • y) + N (x - t • y)) / 2 - 1} :=
  ⟨-1, by
    rintro b ⟨y, -, -, rfl⟩
    linarith [apply_nonneg N (x + t • y), apply_nonneg N (x - t • y)]⟩

/-- For a seminorm, directions with `1 ≤ N y` and with `N y = 1` give the same averaged
infimum. -/
theorem asympAveragedInner_eq_unit (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    asympAveragedInner N t x F = asympAveragedUnitInner N t x F := by
  refine sInf_eq_of_subset_of_forall_exists_le (bddBelow_asympAveragedInner N _ t x F)
    (by rintro b ⟨y, hyF, hy, rfl⟩; exact ⟨y, hyF, hy.ge, rfl⟩) ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, hyF, hy, rfl⟩
  have hpos : 0 < N y := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hy
  refine ⟨_, ⟨(N y)⁻¹ • y, F.smul_mem _ hyF, ?_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hpos, inv_mul_cancel₀ hpos.ne']
  · have := add_smul_add_sub_smul_le N (inv_nonneg.mpr hpos.le) (inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hy) x
      (t • y)
    rw [smul_comm (N y)⁻¹ t y] at this
    linarith

theorem asympAveragedInner_le_abs {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    asympAveragedInner N t x F ≤ |t| := by
  rw [asympAveragedInner_eq_unit]
  refine sInf_le_of_forall_mem_le (bddBelow_asympAveragedInner N _ t x F) (abs_nonneg t) ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, -, hy, rfl⟩
  have h1 := map_add_le_add N x (t • y)
  have h2 := map_sub_le_add N x (t • y)
  rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hx, hy] at h1 h2
  linarith

theorem asympAveragedInner_ker_nonneg {x : X} {ℓ : X →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hℓx : ℓ x = 1)
    (hℓ : ∀ z, ℓ z ≤ N z) (t : ℝ) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    0 ≤ asympAveragedInner N t x (F ⊓ LinearMap.ker (ℓ : X →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) := by
  refine Real.sInf_nonneg ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, hy, -, rfl⟩
  have hy0 : ℓ y = 0 := (Submodule.mem_inf.mp hy).2
  have h1 := hℓ (x + t • y)
  have h2 := hℓ (x - t • y)
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_smul, hℓx, hy0, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero,
    sub_zero] at h1 h2
  linarith

/-- `|t| - 1 ≤ inf` over all directions, by the triangle inequality. -/
theorem abs_sub_one_le_asympAveragedInner_top {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    |t| - 1 ≤ asympAveragedInner N t x ⊤ := by
  refine le_csInf ⟨_, x, Submodule.mem_top, hx.ge, rfl⟩ ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, -, hy, rfl⟩
  have := map_sub_le_add N (x + t • y) (x - t • y)
  rw [show x + t • y - (x - t • y) = (2 * t) • y by module, map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_mul, abs_two] at this
  have hty : |t| ≤ |t| * N y := le_mul_of_one_le_right (abs_nonneg t) hy
  linarith

theorem bddAbove_asympAveraged {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    BddAbove {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympAveragedInner (⇑N) t x F} :=
  ⟨|t|, by rintro a ⟨F, -, rfl⟩; exact asympAveragedInner_le_abs N hx F⟩

theorem asympAveragedInner_le {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) {F : Submodule ℝ X}
    (hF : IsCofinite F) : asympAveragedInner N t x F ≤ asympAveraged N t x :=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_asympAveraged N hx) ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩

theorem asympAveraged_le_abs {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) : asympAveraged N t x ≤ |t| :=
  Real.sSup_le (by rintro a ⟨F, -, rfl⟩; exact asympAveragedInner_le_abs N hx F) (abs_nonneg t)

/-- `0 ≤ H(x, t)` at an `N`-unit point when `N ≤ b ‖·‖` (Hahn–Banach). -/
theorem asympAveraged_nonneg {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    0 ≤ asympAveraged N t x := by
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓx, hℓ⟩ := exists_clm_eq_one_le N hNb hx
  have h := asympAveragedInner_ker_nonneg N hℓx hℓ t ⊤
  rw [top_inf_eq] at h
  exact h.trans (asympAveragedInner_le N hx (IsCofinite.ker_functional ℓ))

/-- Generic bounds `max 0 (|t| - 1) ≤ H(x, t) ≤ |t|` at an `N`-unit point. -/
theorem max_le_asympAveraged {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    max 0 (|t| - 1) ≤ asympAveraged N t x :=
  max_le (asympAveraged_nonneg N hNb hx)
    ((abs_sub_one_le_asympAveragedInner_top N hx).trans (asympAveragedInner_le N hx IsCofinite.top))

theorem asympAveragedModulus_le_abs (t : ℝ) : asympAveragedModulus N t ≤ |t| :=
  sInf_le_of_forall_mem_le ⟨|t| - 1, by
      rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact (abs_sub_one_le_asympAveragedInner_top N hx).trans
        (asympAveragedInner_le N hx IsCofinite.top)⟩
    (abs_nonneg t) (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact asympAveraged_le_abs N hx)

theorem asympAveragedModulus_nonneg {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ asympAveragedModulus N t :=
  Real.sInf_nonneg (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact asympAveraged_nonneg N hNb hx)

theorem max_le_asympAveragedModulus {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) (hX : ∃ x, N x = 1)
    (t : ℝ) : max 0 (|t| - 1) ≤ asympAveragedModulus N t := by
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hX
  exact le_csInf ⟨_, x₀, hx₀, rfl⟩ (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact max_le_asympAveraged N hNb hx)

theorem asympAveragedInner_anti {t : ℝ} {x : X} {F G : Submodule ℝ X} (hFG : F ≤ G)
    (hF : ∃ y ∈ F, 1 ≤ N y) : asympAveragedInner N t x G ≤ asympAveragedInner N t x F := by
  obtain ⟨y, hyF, hy⟩ := hF
  exact csInf_le_csInf (bddBelow_asympAveragedInner N _ t x G) ⟨_, y, hyF, hy, rfl⟩
    (by rintro b ⟨z, hz, hz1, rfl⟩; exact ⟨z, hFG hz, hz1, rfl⟩)

/-- Unit-direction form of `asympAveraged`. -/
theorem asympAveraged_eq_unit (t : ℝ) (x : X) :
    asympAveraged N t x =
      sSup {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympAveragedUnitInner N t x F} := by
  simp only [asympAveraged, asympAveragedInner_eq_unit]

/-- Unit-direction form of the averaged modulus. -/
theorem asympAveragedModulus_eq_unit (t : ℝ) :
    asympAveragedModulus N t = sInf {r | ∃ x : X, N x = 1 ∧ r =
      sSup {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympAveragedUnitInner N t x F}} := by
  simp only [asympAveragedModulus, asympAveraged_eq_unit]

end Moduli

end

end TheoremOS.Analysis

import Mathlib

/-!
# The Daugavet property and the slice lemma

A real normed space `X` has the Daugavet property (`HasDaugavetProperty X`) when every rank-one
operator `T = ℓ.smulRight v` satisfies `‖Id + T‖ = 1 + ‖T‖`. The slice lemma of Kadets, Shvidkoy,
Sirotkin and Werner: in such a space, every nonempty slice `{y | ‖y‖ ≤ 1, α < ℓ y}` of the unit
ball contains, for every unit vector `w` and every `ρ > 0`, a unit vector `y` with
`‖w + y‖ ≥ 2 - ρ` (`HasDaugavetProperty.unitSlice`). Along the way: a vector `z` of the unit ball
with `‖z + ℓ z • w‖ > 2 - δ` and `ℓ z ≥ 0` normalises to a unit vector `u` with `ℓ u > 1 - δ` and
`‖u + w‖ > 2 - 3δ` (`exists_unit_of_norm_add_smul_gt`).

Sources: V. M. Kadets, R. V. Shvidkoy, G. G. Sirotkin and D. Werner, *Banach spaces with the
Daugavet property*, Trans. Amer. Math. Soc. 352 (2000) 855–873, §2 (the slice
characterisation, proved here in the direction used: Daugavet equation ⇒ slices); D. Werner,
*Recent progress on the Daugavet property*, Irish Math. Soc. Bull. 46 (2001).
Classical material; nothing here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: `StrongDual ℝ X` is `X →L[ℝ] ℝ`, and `ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell.smulRight v`
applied to `x` is `x + ell x • v` (`ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply`); a definition
`∀ (ell : X →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : X), ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell.smulRight v‖ =
1 + ‖ell.smulRight v‖` is `HasDaugavetProperty X` by `Iff.rfl`, and the slice condition
`∀ w, ‖w‖ = 1 → ∀ ell α, (∃ u, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 ∧ α < ell u) → ∀ ρ, 0 < ρ → ∃ y, ‖y‖ = 1 ∧ α < ell y ∧
2 - ρ ≤ ‖w + y‖` is `HasUnitSliceProperty X`. `‖ell.smulRight v‖ = ‖ell‖ * ‖v‖` is Mathlib's
`ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Analysis

noncomputable section

variable (X : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]

/-- The Daugavet equation `‖Id + T‖ = 1 + ‖T‖` for every rank-one operator `T`. -/
def HasDaugavetProperty : Prop :=
  ∀ (ell : X →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : X),
    ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell.smulRight v‖ = 1 + ‖ell.smulRight v‖

/-- Every nonempty slice of the unit ball contains unit vectors almost antipodal to `-w`. -/
def HasUnitSliceProperty : Prop :=
  ∀ w : X, ‖w‖ = 1 → ∀ (ell : X →L[ℝ] ℝ) (α : ℝ), (∃ u : X, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 ∧ α < ell u) →
    ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∃ y : X, ‖y‖ = 1 ∧ α < ell y ∧ 2 - ρ ≤ ‖w + y‖

variable {X}

/-- Normalisation step of the slice lemma. -/
theorem exists_unit_of_norm_add_smul_gt {ell : X →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hell : ‖ell‖ = 1) {w z : X}
    (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1) (hz0 : 0 ≤ ell z) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : δ < 1)
    (h : 2 - δ < ‖z + ell z • w‖) :
    ∃ u : X, ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ 1 - δ < ell u ∧ 2 - 3 * δ < ‖u + w‖ := by
  have hle : ell z ≤ ‖z‖ := by
    have := ell.le_opNorm z
    rw [hell, one_mul] at this
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this)
  have htri : ‖z + ell z • w‖ ≤ ‖z‖ + ell z := by
    refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [norm_smul, hw, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hz0]
  have hlz : 1 - δ < ell z := by linarith
  have hnz : 1 - δ < ‖z‖ := by linarith
  have hzw : 2 - 2 * δ < ‖z + w‖ := by
    have e : z + ell z • w = (z + w) - (1 - ell z) • w := by
      rw [sub_smul, one_smul]; abel
    have : ‖z + ell z • w‖ ≤ ‖z + w‖ + (1 - ell z) := by
      rw [e]
      refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [norm_smul, hw, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    linarith
  have hzpos : 0 < ‖z‖ := by linarith
  refine ⟨‖z‖⁻¹ • z, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hzpos.ne']
  · rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have : 1 ≤ ‖z‖⁻¹ := (one_le_inv₀ hzpos).mpr hz
    nlinarith
  · have hd : ‖‖z‖⁻¹ • z - z‖ = 1 - ‖z‖ := by
      rw [show ‖z‖⁻¹ • z - z = (‖z‖⁻¹ - 1) • z by rw [sub_smul, one_smul], norm_smul,
        Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ((one_le_inv₀ hzpos).mpr hz)), sub_mul,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ hzpos.ne', one_mul]
    have : ‖z + w‖ ≤ ‖‖z‖⁻¹ • z + w‖ + ‖‖z‖⁻¹ • z - z‖ := by
      calc ‖z + w‖ = ‖(‖z‖⁻¹ • z + w) - (‖z‖⁻¹ • z - z)‖ := by congr 1; abel
        _ ≤ _ := norm_sub_le _ _
    linarith

/-- **Slice lemma** (Kadets–Shvidkoy–Sirotkin–Werner). -/
theorem HasDaugavetProperty.unitSlice (hX : HasDaugavetProperty X) : HasUnitSliceProperty X := by
  intro w hw ell α hslice ρ hρ
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀, hαu₀⟩ := hslice
  by_cases hell : ell = 0
  · subst hell
    refine ⟨w, hw, by simpa using hαu₀, ?_⟩
    rw [← two_smul ℝ w, norm_smul, hw]
    norm_num
    linarith
  have hn : 0 < ‖ell‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hell
  set ell' : X →L[ℝ] ℝ := ‖ell‖⁻¹ • ell with hell'
  have hn' : ‖ell'‖ = 1 := by
    rw [hell', norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn.ne']
  have hα : α / ‖ell‖ < 1 := by
    rw [div_lt_one hn]
    calc α < ell u₀ := hαu₀
      _ ≤ ‖ell u₀‖ := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ ‖ell‖ * ‖u₀‖ := ell.le_opNorm u₀
      _ ≤ ‖ell‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg u₀]
  set δ := min (min (ρ / 3) (1 - α / ‖ell‖)) (1 / 2) with hδ
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := lt_min (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)) (by norm_num)
  have hδ1 : δ < 1 := (min_le_right _ _).trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hδρ : δ ≤ ρ / 3 := (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδα : δ ≤ 1 - α / ‖ell‖ := (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hnorm : ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell'.smulRight w‖ = 2 := by
    rw [hX, ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply, hn', hw]; norm_num
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzgt⟩ := (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell'.smulRight w).exists_lt_apply_of_lt_opNorm
    (r := 2 - δ) (by rw [hnorm]; linarith)
  have happ : ∀ x : X, (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell'.smulRight w) x = x + ell' x • w :=
    fun _ => rfl
  rw [happ] at hzgt
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hz'0, hz'gt⟩ : ∃ z' : X, ‖z'‖ ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ ell' z' ∧ 2 - δ < ‖z' + ell' z' • w‖ := by
    rcases le_total 0 (ell' z) with h0 | h0
    · exact ⟨z, hz.le, h0, hzgt⟩
    · refine ⟨-z, by rw [norm_neg]; exact hz.le, by rw [map_neg]; linarith, ?_⟩
      rw [map_neg, neg_smul, ← neg_add, norm_neg]
      exact hzgt
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hlu, hwu⟩ := exists_unit_of_norm_add_smul_gt hn' hw hz' hz'0 hδ1 hz'gt
  refine ⟨u, hu, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 : α / ‖ell‖ < ell' u := lt_of_le_of_lt (by linarith) hlu
    have e : ell' u = ‖ell‖⁻¹ * ell u := rfl
    rw [e, div_eq_inv_mul] at h1
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h1 (inv_nonneg.mpr hn.le)
  · rw [add_comm]
    linarith

end

end TheoremOS.Analysis
