import Submission.Library.TheoremOS.Probability.Concentration
import Submission.Library.TheoremOS.Probability.Dobrushin

/-!
# Relative entropy, Pinsker and two-point bounds

Finite-distribution facts about `relEntropy p q = ∑ ω, p ω log (p ω / q ω)`. Contents: the
data-processing inequality for a map (`relEntropy_pushforward_le`) and for a row-stochastic kernel
(`relEntropy_vecMul_le`); the Gibbs variational bound `E_p X - log E_q e^X ≤ D(p‖q)`; **Pinsker's
inequality** `2 tvDist(p, q)² ≤ D(p‖q)` and its two-point form `2 (a - b)² ≤ klBernoulli a b`;
the Bhattacharyya bound `e^{-D/2} ≤ ∑ √(p q)`, **Le Cam's inequality** `e^{-D} ≤ 1 - tvDist²` and
the **Bretagnolle–Huber inequality** `e^{-D} / 2 ≤ 1 - tvDist`; the χ² divergence with
`D ≤ χ²` and `tvDist ≤ √χ² / 2`; additivity of `relEntropy` on products; mutual information as
`relEntropy` against the product of the marginals, its nonnegativity and the identity
`I = H(X) + H(Y) - H(X, Y)`; and `D(p‖uniform) = log |Ω| - H(p)`.

Every general `relEntropy p q` statement carries the absolute continuity hypothesis
`∀ ω, q ω = 0 → p ω = 0`. Without it the junk value `log 0 = 0` makes `relEntropy` meaningless,
so check it before applying a lemma. The exceptions are cases where it holds automatically:
`pinsker_bernoulli` (it asks `0 < b < 1`), mutual information (the product of the marginals
vanishes only where `r` does, `marginal_mul_eq_zero`) and `relEntropy_uniform`.

Sources: T. M. Cover and J. A. Thomas, *Elements of Information Theory*, 2nd ed., Wiley, 2006,
Sections 2.3–2.8 and 11.6; A. B. Tsybakov, *Introduction to Nonparametric Estimation*, Springer,
2009, Section 2.4 (Lemmas 2.5–2.6); J. Bretagnolle and C. Huber, Estimation des densités : risque
minimax, Z. Wahrsch. Verw. Gebiete 47 (1979). The Pinsker proof here goes through the Gibbs
variational bound and Hoeffding's lemma for one Bernoulli variable. Textbook material; nothing
here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: `klBernoulli a b` is `relEntropy` of two-point laws (`klBernoulli_eq_relEntropy`), so
`pinsker_bernoulli` reads directly. For a lower bound on a test's error, combine
`bretagnolle_huber` with `prob_sub_prob_le_tvDist`: any event `s` has
`prob p s + prob q sᶜ ≥ 1 - tvDist p q ≥ e^{-D(p‖q)} / 2`. For product laws
`relEntropy_prod` adds the per-coordinate divergences.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.InformationTheory

open Finset Matrix Real
open TheoremOS.Probability
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

variable {Ω Ω' : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Ω']

section DataProcessing

/-- The log-sum inequality on a sub-`Finset`. -/
theorem sum_mul_log_div_le_of_finset (s : Finset Ω) {a b : Ω → ℝ} (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    (hb : ∀ i, 0 ≤ b i) (hab : ∀ i, b i = 0 → a i = 0) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, a i) * log ((∑ i ∈ s, a i) / ∑ i ∈ s, b i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, a i * log (a i / b i) := by
  classical
  have h := sum_mul_log_div_le (a := fun i => if i ∈ s then a i else 0)
    (b := fun i => if i ∈ s then b i else 0)
    (fun i => by split_ifs <;> simp [ha i]) (fun i => by split_ifs <;> simp [hb i])
    (fun i => by split_ifs with hi <;> simp_all)
  have e : ∀ e : Ω → ℝ, ∑ i, (if i ∈ s then e i else 0) = ∑ i ∈ s, e i :=
    fun e => Fintype.sum_ite_mem s e
  have e' : ∀ i, (if i ∈ s then a i else 0) * log ((if i ∈ s then a i else 0) /
      if i ∈ s then b i else 0) = if i ∈ s then a i * log (a i / b i) else 0 := fun i => by
    split_ifs <;> simp
  simp only [e', e] at h
  exact h

/-- **Data processing**: relative entropy does not increase under a map. -/
theorem relEntropy_pushforward_le [DecidableEq Ω'] (f : Ω → Ω') {p q : Ω → ℝ}
    (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (hq : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ q ω) (hpq : ∀ ω, q ω = 0 → p ω = 0) :
    relEntropy (pushforward f p) (pushforward f q) ≤ relEntropy p q := by
  unfold relEntropy pushforward
  calc ∑ y, (∑ ω with f ω = y, p ω) * log ((∑ ω with f ω = y, p ω) / ∑ ω with f ω = y, q ω)
      ≤ ∑ y, ∑ ω with f ω = y, p ω * log (p ω / q ω) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun y _ => sum_mul_log_div_le_of_finset _ hp hq hpq
    _ = ∑ ω, p ω * log (p ω / q ω) := Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ f _

/-- **Data processing**: relative entropy does not increase under a row-stochastic kernel. -/
theorem relEntropy_vecMul_le {K : Matrix Ω Ω' ℝ} (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y)
    (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, K x y = 1) {p q : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (hq : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ q ω)
    (hpq : ∀ ω, q ω = 0 → p ω = 0) :
    relEntropy (p ᵥ* K) (q ᵥ* K) ≤ relEntropy p q := by
  have hterm : ∀ x y, p x * K x y * log (p x * K x y / (q x * K x y)) =
      K x y * (p x * log (p x / q x)) := fun x y => by
    rcases (hK x y).eq_or_lt with h0 | hpos
    · rw [← h0]; ring
    · rw [mul_div_mul_right _ _ hpos.ne']; ring
  have h1 : ∀ y, (p ᵥ* K) y * log ((p ᵥ* K) y / (q ᵥ* K) y) ≤
      ∑ x, K x y * (p x * log (p x / q x)) := fun y => by
    have h := sum_mul_log_div_le (a := fun x => p x * K x y) (b := fun x => q x * K x y)
      (fun x => mul_nonneg (hp x) (hK x y)) (fun x => mul_nonneg (hq x) (hK x y))
      (fun x hx => by
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hx with h | h
        · rw [hpq x h, zero_mul]
        · rw [h, mul_zero])
    simp only [hterm] at h
    simpa only [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct] using h
  calc relEntropy (p ᵥ* K) (q ᵥ* K) ≤ ∑ y, ∑ x, K x y * (p x * log (p x / q x)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun y _ => h1 y
    _ = relEntropy p q := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        simp only [← Finset.sum_mul, hrow, one_mul, relEntropy]

end DataProcessing

section Pinsker

/-- The **Gibbs variational bound** (Donsker–Varadhan): `E_p X - log E_q e^X ≤ D(p‖q)`. -/
theorem expectation_sub_log_le_relEntropy {p q : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p)
    (hq : IsDistribution q) (hpq : ∀ ω, q ω = 0 → p ω = 0) (X : Ω → ℝ) :
    expectation p X - log (∑ ω, q ω * exp (X ω)) ≤ relEntropy p q := by
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ : ∃ Z, Z = ∑ ω, q ω * exp (X ω) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hZ]
  have hZpos : 0 < Z := by
    obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ : ∃ ω, 0 < q ω := by
      by_contra h
      have : ∑ ω, q ω ≤ 0 := Finset.sum_nonpos fun ω _ => not_lt.1 fun hω => h ⟨ω, hω⟩
      linarith [hq.sum_eq_one]
    rw [hZ]
    calc 0 < q ω * exp (X ω) := mul_pos hω (exp_pos _)
      _ ≤ ∑ ω, q ω * exp (X ω) := Finset.single_le_sum
          (fun ω _ => mul_nonneg (hq.nonneg ω) (exp_pos _).le) (Finset.mem_univ ω)
  have hr : IsDistribution fun ω => q ω * exp (X ω) / Z :=
    ⟨fun ω => div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hq.nonneg ω) (exp_pos _).le) hZpos.le, by
      show ∑ ω, q ω * exp (X ω) / Z = 1
      rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← hZ, div_self hZpos.ne']⟩
  have hpr : ∀ ω, q ω * exp (X ω) / Z = 0 → p ω = 0 := fun ω h => by
    rcases div_eq_zero_iff.mp h with h | h
    · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
      · exact hpq ω h
      · exact absurd h (exp_pos _).ne'
    · exact absurd h hZpos.ne'
  have h0 := relEntropy_nonneg hp hr hpr
  have key : ∀ ω, p ω * log (p ω / (q ω * exp (X ω) / Z)) =
      p ω * log (p ω / q ω) - p ω * X ω + p ω * log Z := fun ω => by
    by_cases h0 : p ω = 0
    · simp [h0]
    have hq0 : q ω ≠ 0 := fun h => h0 (hpq ω h)
    rw [div_div_eq_mul_div, log_div (mul_ne_zero h0 hZpos.ne') (mul_ne_zero hq0 (exp_pos _).ne'),
      log_mul h0 hZpos.ne', log_mul hq0 (exp_pos _).ne', log_exp, log_div h0 hq0]
    ring
  have hsum : relEntropy p (fun ω => q ω * exp (X ω) / Z) =
      relEntropy p q - expectation p X + log Z := by
    simp only [relEntropy, key, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, expectation,
      ← Finset.sum_mul, hp.sum_eq_one, one_mul]
  linarith

/-- **Pinsker's inequality**: `2 tvDist(p, q)² ≤ D(p‖q)`. -/
theorem pinsker [DecidableEq Ω] {p q : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (hq : IsDistribution q)
    (hpq : ∀ ω, q ω = 0 → p ω = 0) : 2 * tvDist p q ^ 2 ≤ relEntropy p q := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : Finset Ω, A = ({ω | q ω < p ω} : Finset Ω) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hgap : prob p A - prob q A = tvDist p q := by
    rw [hA]; exact prob_sub_prob_lt_eq_tvDist (by rw [hp.sum_eq_one, hq.sum_eq_one])
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, t = tvDist p q := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← ht] at hgap ⊢
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := ht ▸ tvDist_nonneg p q
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, a = prob q A := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := ha ▸ prob_nonneg hq.nonneg A
  have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := ha ▸ prob_le_one hq A
  have h := expectation_sub_log_le_relEntropy hp hq hpq fun ω => if ω ∈ A then 4 * t else 0
  have hE : expectation p (fun ω => if ω ∈ A then 4 * t else 0) = 4 * t * prob p A := by
    rw [expectation, prob, Finset.mul_sum, ← Fintype.sum_ite_mem A]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => ?_
    split_ifs
    · ring
    · ring
  have hZ : ∑ ω, q ω * exp (if ω ∈ A then 4 * t else 0) = a * exp (4 * t) + (1 - a) := by
    have : ∀ ω, q ω * exp (if ω ∈ A then 4 * t else 0) =
        q ω + if ω ∈ A then q ω * (exp (4 * t) - 1) else 0 := fun ω => by
      split_ifs
      · ring
      · simp
    simp only [this, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Fintype.sum_ite_mem, ← Finset.sum_mul,
      hq.sum_eq_one]
    rw [ha, prob]
    ring
  have hb := bernoulli_exp_le ha0 ha1 (4 * t)
  have hexp : a * exp (4 * t) + (1 - a) ≤ exp (4 * t * a + 2 * t ^ 2) := by
    have e0 : exp (4 * t * (1 - a)) = exp (4 * t) * exp (-(4 * t * a)) := by
      rw [← exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    have e1 : a * exp (4 * t * (1 - a)) + (1 - a) * exp (-(4 * t * a)) =
        (a * exp (4 * t) + (1 - a)) * exp (-(4 * t * a)) := by
      rw [e0]; ring
    have e2 : exp ((4 * t) ^ 2 / 8) = exp (4 * t * a + 2 * t ^ 2) * exp (-(4 * t * a)) := by
      rw [← exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    rw [e1, e2] at hb
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hb (exp_pos _)
  have hpos : 0 < a * exp (4 * t) + (1 - a) := by
    have := one_le_exp (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * t)
    nlinarith
  have hlog : log (a * exp (4 * t) + (1 - a)) ≤ 4 * t * a + 2 * t ^ 2 := by
    calc log (a * exp (4 * t) + (1 - a)) ≤ log (exp (4 * t * a + 2 * t ^ 2)) :=
          log_le_log hpos hexp
      _ = 4 * t * a + 2 * t ^ 2 := log_exp _
  rw [hE, hZ] at h
  have hpA : prob p A = a + t := by linarith
  rw [hpA] at h
  nlinarith

/-- **Pinsker's inequality**, square-root form: `tvDist p q ≤ √(D(p‖q) / 2)`. -/
theorem tvDist_le_sqrt_relEntropy [DecidableEq Ω] {p q : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p)
    (hq : IsDistribution q) (hpq : ∀ ω, q ω = 0 → p ω = 0) :
    tvDist p q ≤ √(relEntropy p q / 2) :=
  le_sqrt_of_sq_le (by linarith [pinsker hp hq hpq])

/-- Two-point **Pinsker**: `2 (a - b)² ≤ klBernoulli a b`. -/
theorem pinsker_bernoulli {a b : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (hb0 : 0 < b) (hb1 : b < 1) :
    2 * (a - b) ^ 2 ≤ klBernoulli a b := by
  have hd : ∀ {c : ℝ}, 0 ≤ c → c ≤ 1 → IsDistribution fun x : Bool => if x then c else 1 - c :=
    fun hc0 hc1 => ⟨fun x => by cases x <;> simp <;> linarith, by rw [Fintype.sum_bool]; simp⟩
  have h := pinsker (hd ha0 ha1) (hd hb0.le hb1.le) fun x hx => by
    cases x <;> simp at hx ⊢ <;> linarith
  have htv : tvDist (fun x : Bool => if x then a else 1 - a) (fun x => if x then b else 1 - b) =
      |a - b| := by
    rw [tvDist, Fintype.sum_bool]
    simp only [↓reduceIte, Bool.false_eq_true]
    rw [show 1 - a - (1 - b) = -(a - b) by ring, abs_neg]
    ring
  rw [klBernoulli_eq_relEntropy, ← sq_abs (a - b), ← htv]
  exact h

/-- The **Bhattacharyya bound** `e^{-D(p‖q)/2} ≤ ∑ √(p q)`. -/
theorem exp_neg_relEntropy_div_two_le {p q : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p)
    (hq : IsDistribution q) (hpq : ∀ ω, q ω = 0 → p ω = 0) :
    exp (-(relEntropy p q / 2)) ≤ ∑ ω, √(p ω * q ω) := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, s = ∑ ω, √(p ω * q ω) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hs]
  have hspos : 0 < s := by
    obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ : ∃ ω, 0 < p ω := by
      by_contra h
      have : ∑ ω, p ω ≤ 0 := Finset.sum_nonpos fun ω _ => not_lt.1 fun hω => h ⟨ω, hω⟩
      linarith [hp.sum_eq_one]
    have hqω : 0 < q ω := lt_of_le_of_ne (hq.nonneg ω) fun h => hω.ne' (hpq ω h.symm)
    rw [hs]
    calc 0 < √(p ω * q ω) := sqrt_pos.2 (mul_pos hω hqω)
      _ ≤ ∑ ω, √(p ω * q ω) := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun ω => √(p ω * q ω))
          (fun ω _ => sqrt_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ ω)
  have hr : IsDistribution fun ω => √(p ω * q ω) / s :=
    ⟨fun ω => div_nonneg (sqrt_nonneg _) hspos.le, by
      show ∑ ω, √(p ω * q ω) / s = 1
      rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← hs, div_self hspos.ne']⟩
  have hpr : ∀ ω, √(p ω * q ω) / s = 0 → p ω = 0 := fun ω h => by
    rcases div_eq_zero_iff.mp h with h | h
    · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp ((sqrt_eq_zero (mul_nonneg (hp.nonneg ω) (hq.nonneg ω))).mp h)
        with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact hpq ω h
    · exact absurd h hspos.ne'
  have h0 := relEntropy_nonneg hp hr hpr
  have key : ∀ ω, p ω * log (p ω / (√(p ω * q ω) / s)) =
      p ω * log (p ω / q ω) / 2 + p ω * log s := fun ω => by
    by_cases h0 : p ω = 0
    · simp [h0]
    have hp0 : 0 < p ω := lt_of_le_of_ne (hp.nonneg ω) (Ne.symm h0)
    have hq0 : 0 < q ω := lt_of_le_of_ne (hq.nonneg ω) fun h => h0 (hpq ω h.symm)
    have hsq : 0 < √(p ω * q ω) := sqrt_pos.2 (mul_pos hp0 hq0)
    rw [div_div_eq_mul_div, log_div (mul_ne_zero h0 hspos.ne') hsq.ne', log_mul h0 hspos.ne',
      log_sqrt (mul_nonneg hp0.le hq0.le), log_mul h0 hq0.ne', log_div h0 hq0.ne']
    ring
  have hsum : relEntropy p (fun ω => √(p ω * q ω) / s) = relEntropy p q / 2 + log s := by
    simp only [relEntropy, key, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_mul,
      hp.sum_eq_one, one_mul]
  have hlog : -(relEntropy p q / 2) ≤ log s := by linarith
  calc exp (-(relEntropy p q / 2)) ≤ exp (log s) := exp_le_exp.2 hlog
    _ = s := exp_log hspos

/-- **Le Cam's inequality** `e^{-D(p‖q)} ≤ 1 - tvDist(p, q)²`. -/
theorem exp_neg_relEntropy_le_one_sub_sq {p q : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p)
    (hq : IsDistribution q) (hpq : ∀ ω, q ω = 0 → p ω = 0) :
    exp (-relEntropy p q) ≤ 1 - tvDist p q ^ 2 := by
  have hB := exp_neg_relEntropy_div_two_le hp hq hpq
  have hmin := tvDist_eq_one_sub_sum_min hp hq
  have hmax : ∑ ω, max (p ω) (q ω) = 1 + tvDist p q := by
    have e : ∀ ω, max (p ω) (q ω) = p ω + q ω - min (p ω) (q ω) := fun ω => by
      have := min_add_max (p ω) (q ω)
      linarith
    simp only [e, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, hp.sum_eq_one, hq.sum_eq_one]
    linarith
  have hmn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ min (p ω) (q ω) := fun ω => le_min (hp.nonneg ω) (hq.nonneg ω)
  have hmx : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ max (p ω) (q ω) := fun ω => (hp.nonneg ω).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hcs : (∑ ω, √(p ω * q ω)) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ ω, min (p ω) (q ω)) * ∑ ω, max (p ω) (q ω) := by
    have e : ∀ ω, √(p ω * q ω) = √(min (p ω) (q ω)) * √(max (p ω) (q ω)) := fun ω => by
      rw [← sqrt_mul (hmn ω), min_mul_max]
    have hs1 : ∀ ω, √(min (p ω) (q ω)) ^ 2 = min (p ω) (q ω) := fun ω => sq_sqrt (hmn ω)
    have hs2 : ∀ ω, √(max (p ω) (q ω)) ^ 2 = max (p ω) (q ω) := fun ω => sq_sqrt (hmx ω)
    have h := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ (fun ω => √(min (p ω) (q ω)))
      fun ω => √(max (p ω) (q ω))
    simp only [hs1, hs2] at h
    simp only [e]
    exact h
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ exp (-(relEntropy p q / 2)) := (exp_pos _).le
  calc exp (-relEntropy p q) = exp (-(relEntropy p q / 2)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [sq, ← exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ (∑ ω, √(p ω * q ω)) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hB0 hB 2
    _ ≤ (∑ ω, min (p ω) (q ω)) * ∑ ω, max (p ω) (q ω) := hcs
    _ = 1 - tvDist p q ^ 2 := by
        rw [hmax, show ∑ ω, min (p ω) (q ω) = 1 - tvDist p q by linarith]
        ring

/-- The **Bretagnolle–Huber inequality** `e^{-D(p‖q)} / 2 ≤ 1 - tvDist(p, q)`. -/
theorem bretagnolle_huber {p q : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (hq : IsDistribution q)
    (hpq : ∀ ω, q ω = 0 → p ω = 0) : exp (-relEntropy p q) / 2 ≤ 1 - tvDist p q := by
  have h := exp_neg_relEntropy_le_one_sub_sq hp hq hpq
  have h0 := tvDist_nonneg p q
  have h1 := tvDist_le_one hp hq
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (tvDist p q - 1)]

end Pinsker

section ChiSquare

/-- The χ² divergence `∑ (p - q)² / q`. -/
def chiSq (p q : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ ω, (p ω - q ω) ^ 2 / q ω

lemma chiSq_eq {p q : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (hq : IsDistribution q)
    (hpq : ∀ ω, q ω = 0 → p ω = 0) : chiSq p q = ∑ ω, p ω ^ 2 / q ω - 1 := by
  have e : ∀ ω, (p ω - q ω) ^ 2 / q ω = p ω ^ 2 / q ω - 2 * p ω + q ω := fun ω => by
    by_cases h : q ω = 0
    · simp [h, hpq ω h]
    · field_simp
      ring
  simp only [chiSq, e, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    hp.sum_eq_one, hq.sum_eq_one]
  ring

/-- `D(p‖q) ≤ χ²(p‖q)`. -/
theorem relEntropy_le_chiSq {p q : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (hq : IsDistribution q)
    (hpq : ∀ ω, q ω = 0 → p ω = 0) : relEntropy p q ≤ chiSq p q := by
  rw [chiSq_eq hp hq hpq, ← hp.sum_eq_one, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun ω _ => ?_
  by_cases h0 : p ω = 0
  · simp [h0]
  have hp0 : 0 < p ω := lt_of_le_of_ne (hp.nonneg ω) (Ne.symm h0)
  have hq0 : 0 < q ω := lt_of_le_of_ne (hq.nonneg ω) fun h => h0 (hpq ω h.symm)
  have hl := log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hp0 hq0)
  calc p ω * log (p ω / q ω) ≤ p ω * (p ω / q ω - 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl hp0.le
    _ = p ω ^ 2 / q ω - p ω := by ring

/-- `tvDist p q ≤ √χ²(p‖q) / 2`. -/
theorem tvDist_le_sqrt_chiSq {p q : Ω → ℝ} (hq : IsDistribution q)
    (hpq : ∀ ω, q ω = 0 → p ω = 0) : tvDist p q ≤ √(chiSq p q) / 2 := by
  have e : ∀ ω, |p ω - q ω| = √(q ω) * (|p ω - q ω| / √(q ω)) := fun ω => by
    by_cases h : q ω = 0
    · simp [h, hpq ω h]
    · have : √(q ω) ≠ 0 := sqrt_ne_zero'.2 (lt_of_le_of_ne (hq.nonneg ω) (Ne.symm h))
      field_simp
  have hs : ∀ ω, (|p ω - q ω| / √(q ω)) ^ 2 = (p ω - q ω) ^ 2 / q ω := fun ω => by
    rw [div_pow, sq_abs, sq_sqrt (hq.nonneg ω)]
  have hq2 : ∀ ω, √(q ω) ^ 2 = q ω := fun ω => sq_sqrt (hq.nonneg ω)
  have h := Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt Finset.univ (fun ω => √(q ω))
    fun ω => |p ω - q ω| / √(q ω)
  simp only [hq2, hs, hq.sum_eq_one, sqrt_one, one_mul, ← e] at h
  rw [tvDist, chiSq]
  linarith

end ChiSquare

section Product

/-- Relative entropy adds on products. -/
theorem relEntropy_prod {p q : Ω → ℝ} {p' q' : Ω' → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p)
    (hp' : IsDistribution p') (hpq : ∀ ω, q ω = 0 → p ω = 0) (hpq' : ∀ ω, q' ω = 0 → p' ω = 0) :
    relEntropy (fun x : Ω × Ω' => p x.1 * p' x.2) (fun x => q x.1 * q' x.2) =
      relEntropy p q + relEntropy p' q' := by
  have e : ∀ a b, p a * p' b * log (p a * p' b / (q a * q' b)) =
      p' b * (p a * log (p a / q a)) + p a * (p' b * log (p' b / q' b)) := fun a b => by
    by_cases h1 : p a = 0
    · simp [h1]
    by_cases h2 : p' b = 0
    · simp [h2]
    have hq1 : q a ≠ 0 := fun h => h1 (hpq a h)
    have hq2 : q' b ≠ 0 := fun h => h2 (hpq' b h)
    rw [mul_div_mul_comm, log_mul (div_ne_zero h1 hq1) (div_ne_zero h2 hq2)]
    ring
  rw [relEntropy, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [e, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, hp.sum_eq_one,
    hp'.sum_eq_one, one_mul, relEntropy]

end Product

section MutualInformation

/-- Mutual information of a joint law: `relEntropy` against the product of its marginals. -/
def mutualInfo (r : Ω × Ω' → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  relEntropy r fun x => marginalLeft r x.1 * marginalRight r x.2

variable {r : Ω × Ω' → ℝ}

lemma marginal_mul_eq_zero (hr : ∀ x, 0 ≤ r x) (x : Ω × Ω')
    (h : marginalLeft r x.1 * marginalRight r x.2 = 0) : r x = 0 := by
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
  · exact le_antisymm (h ▸ le_marginalLeft hr x) (hr x)
  · exact le_antisymm (h ▸ le_marginalRight hr x) (hr x)

theorem mutualInfo_nonneg (hr : IsDistribution r) : 0 ≤ mutualInfo r := by
  have h1 := hr.marginalLeft
  have h2 := hr.marginalRight
  have hq : IsDistribution fun x : Ω × Ω' => marginalLeft r x.1 * marginalRight r x.2 :=
    ⟨fun x => mul_nonneg (h1.nonneg _) (h2.nonneg _), by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, h2.sum_eq_one, mul_one, h1.sum_eq_one]⟩
  exact relEntropy_nonneg hr hq (marginal_mul_eq_zero hr.nonneg)

/-- `I(X; Y) = H(X) + H(Y) - H(X, Y)`. -/
theorem mutualInfo_eq (hr : IsDistribution r) :
    mutualInfo r = entropy (marginalLeft r) + entropy (marginalRight r) - entropy r := by
  have hsupp := marginal_mul_eq_zero hr.nonneg
  have hlog : ∑ x : Ω × Ω', r x * log (marginalLeft r x.1 * marginalRight r x.2) =
      ∑ x : Ω × Ω', r x * log (marginalLeft r x.1) +
        ∑ x : Ω × Ω', r x * log (marginalRight r x.2) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
    by_cases hx : r x = 0
    · simp [hx]
    have ha : marginalLeft r x.1 ≠ 0 := fun h => hx (hsupp x (by rw [h, zero_mul]))
    have hb : marginalRight r x.2 ≠ 0 := fun h => hx (hsupp x (by rw [h, mul_zero]))
    rw [log_mul ha hb, mul_add]
  have hleft : ∑ x : Ω × Ω', r x * log (marginalLeft r x.1) = -entropy (marginalLeft r) := by
    rw [entropy_eq_neg_sum, neg_neg, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp only [marginalLeft, Finset.sum_mul]
  have hright : ∑ x : Ω × Ω', r x * log (marginalRight r x.2) = -entropy (marginalRight r) := by
    rw [entropy_eq_neg_sum, neg_neg, Fintype.sum_prod_type_right]
    simp only [marginalRight, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [mutualInfo, relEntropy_eq_sub hsupp, hlog, hleft, hright, entropy_eq_neg_sum r]
  ring

end MutualInformation

/-- `D(p‖uniform) = log |Ω| - H(p)`. -/
theorem relEntropy_uniform [Nonempty Ω] {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) :
    relEntropy p (uniform Ω) = log (Fintype.card Ω) - entropy p := by
  have hN : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hu : ∀ ω, uniform Ω ω = (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ := fun _ => rfl
  rw [relEntropy_eq_sub fun ω h => absurd ((hu ω).symm.trans h) (inv_ne_zero hN),
    entropy_eq_neg_sum]
  simp only [hu, log_inv, mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hp.sum_eq_one,
    one_mul]
  ring

end

end TheoremOS.InformationTheory

import Mathlib

/-!
# Shannon entropy of finite distributions

Weights `p : ι → ℝ` on a finite type, entropy `H p = ∑ i, negMulLog (p i)` in nats, and the
relative entropy `D(p‖q) = ∑ i, p i * log (p i / q i)`. Contents: `0 ≤ H p ≤ log |ι|` for a
distribution, the uniform distribution attains `log |ι|`, Gibbs' inequality in an unnormalized
form, nonnegativity of relative entropy, the log-sum inequality, invariance under relabeling,
additivity on products, subadditivity of joint entropy, and monotonicity under pushforward.

Sources: T. M. Cover and J. A. Thomas, *Elements of Information Theory*, 2nd ed., Wiley, 2006,
Chapter 2 (Theorem 2.6.3 information inequality, Theorem 2.6.4 `H ≤ log |𝒳|`, Theorem 2.6.6
independence bound, Theorem 2.7.1 log-sum inequality, Problem 2.4 entropy of a function).
Textbook material; nothing here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: a statement defining `entropy p := ∑ i, Real.negMulLog (p i)` is `entropy p` here by
`rfl`; `-(∑ i, p i * Real.log (p i))` is `entropy p` by `entropy_eq_neg_sum`; base-2 entropy is
`entropy p / Real.log 2`; `Real.binEntropy q` is the entropy of `![q, 1 - q]`-style weights on
`Bool` (`entropy_bool`).
-/

namespace TheoremOS.InformationTheory

open Finset Real
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]

/-- Shannon entropy in nats. -/
def entropy (p : ι → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i, negMulLog (p i)

lemma entropy_eq_neg_sum (p : ι → ℝ) : entropy p = -∑ i, p i * log (p i) := by
  simp [entropy, negMulLog, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

/-- Nonnegative weights summing to one. -/
structure IsDistribution (p : ι → ℝ) : Prop where
  nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i
  sum_eq_one : ∑ i, p i = 1

namespace IsDistribution

variable {p : ι → ℝ}

lemma le_one (hp : IsDistribution p) (i : ι) : p i ≤ 1 := by
  rw [← hp.sum_eq_one]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hp.nonneg j) (Finset.mem_univ i)

lemma nonempty (hp : IsDistribution p) : Nonempty ι := by
  by_contra h
  rw [not_nonempty_iff] at h
  have := hp.sum_eq_one
  simp at this

end IsDistribution

/-- A pointwise form of `log x ≤ x - 1`: `a log b ≤ a log a + (b - a)` when `b = 0 → a = 0`. -/
lemma mul_log_le_mul_log_add_sub {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : b = 0 → a = 0) :
    a * log b ≤ a * log a + (b - a) := by
  rcases ha.eq_or_lt with rfl | ha
  · simpa using hb
  have hb' : 0 < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hb (fun h => ha.ne' (hab h.symm))
  have key := log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hb' ha)
  rw [log_div hb'.ne' ha.ne'] at key
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key ha.le
  have e : a * (b / a - 1) = b - a := by field_simp
  nlinarith [h, e]

/-- **Gibbs' inequality**, unnormalized: for nonnegative weights with `∑ q ≤ ∑ p` and
`q i = 0 → p i = 0`, `∑ p log q ≤ ∑ p log p`. -/
theorem sum_mul_log_le_sum_mul_log {p q : ι → ℝ} (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hq : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i)
    (hpq : ∀ i, q i = 0 → p i = 0) (hsum : ∑ i, q i ≤ ∑ i, p i) :
    ∑ i, p i * log (q i) ≤ ∑ i, p i * log (p i) := by
  have h : ∑ i, p i * log (q i) ≤ ∑ i, (p i * log (p i) + (q i - p i)) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_log_le_mul_log_add_sub (hp i) (hq i) (hpq i)
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at h
  linarith

/-- Gibbs' inequality for distributions: `H p ≤ -∑ p log q`. -/
theorem entropy_le_crossEntropy {p q : ι → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (hq : IsDistribution q)
    (hpq : ∀ i, q i = 0 → p i = 0) : entropy p ≤ -∑ i, p i * log (q i) := by
  rw [entropy_eq_neg_sum, neg_le_neg_iff]
  exact sum_mul_log_le_sum_mul_log hp.nonneg hq.nonneg hpq (by rw [hp.sum_eq_one, hq.sum_eq_one])

/-- Relative entropy (Kullback–Leibler divergence) in nats; terms with `p i = 0` vanish. -/
def relEntropy (p q : ι → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i, p i * log (p i / q i)

lemma relEntropy_eq_sub {p q : ι → ℝ} (hpq : ∀ i, q i = 0 → p i = 0) :
    relEntropy p q = ∑ i, p i * log (p i) - ∑ i, p i * log (q i) := by
  rw [relEntropy, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  by_cases hp0 : p i = 0
  · simp [hp0]
  have hq0 : q i ≠ 0 := fun h => hp0 (hpq i h)
  rw [log_div hp0 hq0]
  ring

/-- **Information inequality**: `0 ≤ D(p‖q)` for distributions with `q i = 0 → p i = 0`. -/
theorem relEntropy_nonneg {p q : ι → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (hq : IsDistribution q)
    (hpq : ∀ i, q i = 0 → p i = 0) : 0 ≤ relEntropy p q := by
  rw [relEntropy_eq_sub hpq, sub_nonneg]
  exact sum_mul_log_le_sum_mul_log hp.nonneg hq.nonneg hpq (by rw [hp.sum_eq_one, hq.sum_eq_one])

theorem entropy_nonneg {p : ι → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) : 0 ≤ entropy p :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => negMulLog_nonneg (hp.nonneg i) (hp.le_one i)

/-- The uniform weights `1 / |ι|`. -/
def uniform (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] : ι → ℝ := fun _ => (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹

lemma isDistribution_uniform [Nonempty ι] : IsDistribution (uniform ι) where
  nonneg _ := by unfold uniform; positivity
  sum_eq_one := by
    have : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
    simp [uniform, Finset.card_univ, this]

lemma entropy_uniform [Nonempty ι] : entropy (uniform ι) = log (Fintype.card ι) := by
  have : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  simp only [entropy, uniform, negMulLog, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, log_inv]
  field_simp

/-- `H p ≤ log |ι|`. -/
theorem entropy_le_log_card {p : ι → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) :
    entropy p ≤ log (Fintype.card ι) := by
  have := hp.nonempty
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have h := entropy_le_crossEntropy hp isDistribution_uniform
    (fun i h => absurd h (inv_ne_zero hc.ne'))
  simp only [uniform, log_inv, mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, neg_neg, ← Finset.sum_mul,
    hp.sum_eq_one, one_mul] at h
  exact h

/-- Entropy does not depend on the labelling. -/
lemma entropy_comp_equiv (e : κ ≃ ι) (p : ι → ℝ) : entropy (p ∘ e) = entropy p := by
  simp only [entropy, Function.comp]
  exact e.sum_comp (fun i => negMulLog (p i))

/-- Weights on `Bool` with `p true = q`, `p false = 1 - q` have entropy `binEntropy q`. -/
lemma entropy_bool {p : Bool → ℝ} {q : ℝ} (htrue : p true = q) (hfalse : p false = 1 - q) :
    entropy p = binEntropy q := by
  rw [entropy, Fintype.sum_bool, htrue, hfalse, binEntropy_eq_negMulLog_add_negMulLog_one_sub]

/-- **Additivity** on independent pairs: `H(p ⊗ q) = H p + H q`. -/
theorem entropy_prod {p : ι → ℝ} {q : κ → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (hq : IsDistribution q) :
    entropy (fun x : ι × κ => p x.1 * q x.2) = entropy p + entropy q := by
  simp only [entropy, negMulLog_mul, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  · simp only [← Finset.sum_mul, hq.sum_eq_one, one_mul]
  · rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [← Finset.sum_mul, hp.sum_eq_one, one_mul]

/-- The first marginal of weights on `ι × κ`. -/
def marginalLeft (r : ι × κ → ℝ) (i : ι) : ℝ := ∑ j, r (i, j)

/-- The second marginal of weights on `ι × κ`. -/
def marginalRight (r : ι × κ → ℝ) (j : κ) : ℝ := ∑ i, r (i, j)

lemma IsDistribution.marginalLeft {r : ι × κ → ℝ} (hr : IsDistribution r) :
    IsDistribution (marginalLeft r) where
  nonneg i := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hr.nonneg (i, j)
  sum_eq_one := by rw [← hr.sum_eq_one, Fintype.sum_prod_type]; rfl

lemma IsDistribution.marginalRight {r : ι × κ → ℝ} (hr : IsDistribution r) :
    IsDistribution (marginalRight r) where
  nonneg j := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hr.nonneg (i, j)
  sum_eq_one := by rw [← hr.sum_eq_one, Fintype.sum_prod_type_right]; rfl

omit [Fintype ι] in
lemma le_marginalLeft {r : ι × κ → ℝ} (hr : ∀ x, 0 ≤ r x) (x : ι × κ) : r x ≤ marginalLeft r x.1 :=
  Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => r (x.1, j)) (fun _ _ => hr _) (Finset.mem_univ x.2)

omit [Fintype κ] in
lemma le_marginalRight {r : ι × κ → ℝ} (hr : ∀ x, 0 ≤ r x) (x : ι × κ) : r x ≤ marginalRight r x.2 :=
  Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => r (i, x.2)) (fun _ _ => hr _) (Finset.mem_univ x.1)

/-- **Subadditivity** (independence bound): `H(X, Y) ≤ H X + H Y`. -/
theorem entropy_le_entropy_marginalLeft_add_marginalRight {r : ι × κ → ℝ} (hr : IsDistribution r) :
    entropy r ≤ entropy (marginalLeft r) + entropy (marginalRight r) := by
  have h1 := hr.marginalLeft
  have h2 := hr.marginalRight
  have hq : IsDistribution (fun x : ι × κ => marginalLeft r x.1 * marginalRight r x.2) :=
    ⟨fun x => mul_nonneg (h1.nonneg _) (h2.nonneg _), by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, h2.sum_eq_one, mul_one, h1.sum_eq_one]⟩
  have hsupp : ∀ x : ι × κ, marginalLeft r x.1 * marginalRight r x.2 = 0 → r x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hx with h | h
    · exact le_antisymm (h ▸ le_marginalLeft hr.nonneg x) (hr.nonneg x)
    · exact le_antisymm (h ▸ le_marginalRight hr.nonneg x) (hr.nonneg x)
  have hlog : ∑ x : ι × κ, r x * log (marginalLeft r x.1 * marginalRight r x.2) =
      ∑ x : ι × κ, r x * log (marginalLeft r x.1) + ∑ x : ι × κ, r x * log (marginalRight r x.2) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
    by_cases hx : r x = 0
    · simp [hx]
    have ha : marginalLeft r x.1 ≠ 0 := fun h => hx (hsupp x (by rw [h, zero_mul]))
    have hb : marginalRight r x.2 ≠ 0 := fun h => hx (hsupp x (by rw [h, mul_zero]))
    rw [log_mul ha hb, mul_add]
  have hleft : ∑ x : ι × κ, r x * log (marginalLeft r x.1) = -entropy (marginalLeft r) := by
    rw [entropy_eq_neg_sum, neg_neg, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp only [marginalLeft, Finset.sum_mul]
  have hright : ∑ x : ι × κ, r x * log (marginalRight r x.2) = -entropy (marginalRight r) := by
    rw [entropy_eq_neg_sum, neg_neg, Fintype.sum_prod_type_right]
    simp only [marginalRight, Finset.sum_mul]
  have h := entropy_le_crossEntropy hr hq hsupp
  rw [hlog, hleft, hright] at h
  linarith

/-- `negMulLog` is subadditive on `[0, ∞)`. -/
lemma negMulLog_add_le {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    negMulLog (a + b) ≤ negMulLog a + negMulLog b := by
  rcases ha.eq_or_lt with rfl | ha'
  · simp
  have h1 : log a ≤ log (a + b) := log_le_log ha' (by linarith)
  have h2 : b * log b ≤ b * log (a + b) := by
    rcases hb.eq_or_lt with rfl | hb'
    · simp
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (log_le_log hb' (by linarith)) hb
  simp only [negMulLog]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 ha]

lemma negMulLog_sum_le {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) :
    negMulLog (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, negMulLog (f i) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha]
    have hs : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i := fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
    calc negMulLog (f a + ∑ i ∈ s, f i)
        ≤ negMulLog (f a) + negMulLog (∑ i ∈ s, f i) :=
          negMulLog_add_le (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)) (Finset.sum_nonneg hs)
      _ ≤ negMulLog (f a) + ∑ i ∈ s, negMulLog (f i) := by linarith [ih hs]

/-- The pushforward of weights along `f`. -/
def pushforward [DecidableEq κ] (f : ι → κ) (p : ι → ℝ) (j : κ) : ℝ := ∑ i with f i = j, p i

lemma IsDistribution.pushforward [DecidableEq κ] {p : ι → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (f : ι → κ) :
    IsDistribution (pushforward f p) :=
  ⟨fun _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hp.nonneg i, by
    rw [← hp.sum_eq_one]; exact Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ f p⟩

/-- **Entropy of a function**: `H(f(X)) ≤ H(X)`. -/
theorem entropy_pushforward_le [DecidableEq κ] {p : ι → ℝ} (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (f : ι → κ) :
    entropy (pushforward f p) ≤ entropy p := by
  calc entropy (pushforward f p) = ∑ j, negMulLog (∑ i with f i = j, p i) := rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ j, ∑ i with f i = j, negMulLog (p i) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => negMulLog_sum_le _ fun i _ => hp i
    _ = entropy p := Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ f (fun i => negMulLog (p i))

/-- **Log-sum inequality**: `(∑ a) log (∑ a / ∑ b) ≤ ∑ a log (a / b)` for nonnegative weights with
`b i = 0 → a i = 0`. -/
theorem sum_mul_log_div_le {a b : ι → ℝ} (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (hb : ∀ i, 0 ≤ b i)
    (hab : ∀ i, b i = 0 → a i = 0) :
    (∑ i, a i) * log ((∑ i, a i) / ∑ i, b i) ≤ ∑ i, a i * log (a i / b i) := by
  set A := ∑ i, a i with hA
  set B := ∑ i, b i with hB
  have hterm : ∀ i, a i * log (a i / b i) = a i * log (a i) - a i * log (b i) := by
    intro i
    by_cases h0 : a i = 0
    · simp [h0]
    rw [log_div h0 (fun h => h0 (hab i h))]
    ring
  rcases (show 0 ≤ A from Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => ha i).eq_or_lt with hA0 | hA0
  · rw [← hA0, zero_mul]
    have hA0' : ∑ i, a i = 0 := by rw [← hA]; exact hA0.symm
    have hz : ∀ i, a i = 0 := fun i =>
      (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun j _ => ha j).mp hA0' i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    simp [hz]
  have hB0 : 0 < B := by
    refine (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hb i).lt_of_ne fun h => hA0.ne' ?_
    have hz : ∀ i, b i = 0 := fun i =>
      (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun j _ => hb j).mp h.symm i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => hab i (hz i)
  set c := A / B with hc
  have hc0 : 0 < c := div_pos hA0 hB0
  have hgibbs := sum_mul_log_le_sum_mul_log ha (fun i => mul_nonneg (hb i) hc0.le)
    (fun i h => hab i ((mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_right hc0.ne'))
    (le_of_eq (by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← hB, ← hA, hc]; field_simp))
  have hsplit : ∑ i, a i * log (b i * c) = ∑ i, a i * log (b i) + A * log c := by
    rw [hA, Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    by_cases h0 : a i = 0
    · simp [h0]
    rw [log_mul (fun h => h0 (hab i h)) hc0.ne', mul_add]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hterm i, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  linarith

end

end TheoremOS.InformationTheory

import Submission.Library.TheoremOS.InformationTheory.Entropy

/-!
# Submodularity of joint entropy and Shearer's lemma

Shearer's lemma for an abstract monotone submodular set function `f` with `f ∅ = 0`, in a
fractional form (weights covering every point with total weight at least one) and in the
`k`-fold cover form; Han's inequality is the cover by the sets `U \ {i}`. The entropy layer:
the law `pushforward X p` of a random variable on a finite weighted space, monotonicity under
functions, invariance under injective maps, the inequality `H(X, Y) + H(Z) ≤ H(X) + H(Y)` when
`Z` is a function of `X` and of `Y` (nonnegativity of conditional mutual information),
`H(X, Y, Z) + H(Z) ≤ H(X, Z) + H(Y, Z)`, and the joint entropy `jointEntropy p X S` of a
subfamily `(X i)_{i ∈ S}` as a monotone submodular set function. Counting: for a finite family
`𝓕` of functions on a finite index type and a `k`-fold cover `F`,
`#𝓕 ^ k ≤ ∏ j, #(𝓕 restricted to F j)`, and the discrete Loomis–Whitney inequality
`#𝓕 ^ (n - 1) ≤ ∏ i, #(𝓕 restricted to the complement of i)`.

Sources: F. R. K. Chung, R. L. Graham, P. Frankl and J. B. Shearer, *Some intersection theorems
for ordered sets and graphs*, J. Combin. Theory Ser. A 43 (1986) 23–37 (Shearer's lemma);
T. S. Han, *Nonnegative entropy measures of multivariate symmetric correlations*, Inform. and
Control 36 (1978) 133–156; J. Radhakrishnan, *Entropy and counting*, in Computational
Mathematics, Modelling and Algorithms, 2003 (Shearer's lemma and the projection bound);
M. Madiman and P. Tetali, *Information inequalities for joint distributions, with
interpretations and applications*, IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory 56 (2010) 2699–2713 (fractional
covers of submodular functions); T. M. Cover and J. A. Thomas, *Elements of Information
Theory*, 2nd ed., Wiley, 2006, Sections 2.5–2.6 and 17.6. Textbook material; nothing here is
specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: `pushforward X p` is the law of `X : Ω → α` under weights `p` on `Ω`; a statement about
weights `r` on a product `∀ i, β i` is `jointEntropy r (fun i x => x i) univ = entropy r`
(`jointEntropy_univ_coord`); a family of random variables `X : ι → Ω → α` with a common value
type is the constant-family case `β := fun _ => α`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.InformationTheory

open Finset Real
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

/-! ### Shearer's lemma for submodular set functions -/

section Submodular

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {f : Finset ι → ℝ}

/-- Diminishing returns: adding `a ∉ U` to `B ⊆ U` gains at least as much as adding it to `U`. -/
lemma submodular_insert_sub_le
    (hsub : ∀ S T, f (S ∪ T) + f (S ∩ T) ≤ f S + f T) {B U : Finset ι} {a : ι} (hBU : B ⊆ U)
    (ha : a ∉ U) : f (insert a U) - f U ≤ f (insert a B) - f B := by
  have h := hsub (insert a B) U
  rw [insert_union, union_eq_right.2 hBU, insert_inter_of_notMem ha, inter_eq_left.2 hBU] at h
  linarith

/-- **Shearer's lemma, fractional form**, for a monotone submodular `f` with `f ∅ = 0`: if every
point of `U` lies in sets `F j` of total weight at least one, then `f U ≤ ∑ j, w j f (U ∩ F j)`. -/
theorem fractional_shearer_of_submodular (hmono : ∀ S T, S ⊆ T → f S ≤ f T)
    (hsub : ∀ S T, f (S ∪ T) + f (S ∩ T) ≤ f S + f T) (hempty : f ∅ = 0) {κ : Type*}
    (s : Finset κ) (F : κ → Finset ι) {w : κ → ℝ} (hw : ∀ j ∈ s, 0 ≤ w j) (U : Finset ι)
    (hcover : ∀ i ∈ U, 1 ≤ ∑ j ∈ s with i ∈ F j, w j) :
    f U ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, w j * f (U ∩ F j) := by
  induction U using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    simp only [empty_inter, hempty, mul_zero, sum_const_zero, le_refl]
  | @insert a U haU ih =>
    have ih := ih fun i hi => hcover i (mem_insert_of_mem hi)
    have ha := hcover a (mem_insert_self a U)
    set δ := f (insert a U) - f U with hδ
    have hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ := sub_nonneg.2 (hmono _ _ (subset_insert a U))
    have hterm : ∀ j ∈ s, (if a ∈ F j then w j else 0) * δ ≤
        w j * (f (insert a U ∩ F j) - f (U ∩ F j)) := by
      intro j hj
      by_cases haF : a ∈ F j
      · rw [ite_eq_left haF, insert_inter_of_mem haF]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (submodular_insert_sub_le hsub inter_subset_left haU) (hw j hj)
      · rw [ite_eq_right haF, insert_inter_of_notMem haF, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    have hsum : δ ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, w j * (f (insert a U ∩ F j) - f (U ∩ F j)) := by
      calc δ ≤ (∑ j ∈ s with a ∈ F j, w j) * δ := le_mul_of_one_le_left hδ0 ha
        _ = ∑ j ∈ s, (if a ∈ F j then w j else 0) * δ := by rw [sum_filter, sum_mul]
        _ ≤ _ := sum_le_sum hterm
    have hsplit : ∑ j ∈ s, w j * f (insert a U ∩ F j) =
        ∑ j ∈ s, w j * f (U ∩ F j) +
          ∑ j ∈ s, w j * (f (insert a U ∩ F j) - f (U ∩ F j)) := by
      rw [← sum_add_distrib]
      exact sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring
    linarith

omit [DecidableEq ι] in
lemma nonneg_of_submodular (hmono : ∀ S T, S ⊆ T → f S ≤ f T) (hempty : f ∅ = 0)
    (S : Finset ι) : 0 ≤ f S := by
  simpa [hempty] using hmono ∅ S (empty_subset S)

/-- **Shearer's lemma** for a monotone submodular `f` with `f ∅ = 0`: if every point of `U`
lies in at least `k` of the sets `F j`, `j ∈ s`, then `k f U ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, f (U ∩ F j)`. -/
theorem shearer_of_submodular (hmono : ∀ S T, S ⊆ T → f S ≤ f T)
    (hsub : ∀ S T, f (S ∪ T) + f (S ∩ T) ≤ f S + f T) (hempty : f ∅ = 0) {κ : Type*}
    (s : Finset κ) (F : κ → Finset ι) {k : ℕ} (U : Finset ι)
    (hcover : ∀ i ∈ U, k ≤ #{j ∈ s | i ∈ F j}) :
    k * f U ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, f (U ∩ F j) := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
  · rw [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
    exact sum_nonneg fun j _ => nonneg_of_submodular hmono hempty _
  have hk' : (0 : ℝ) < k := Nat.cast_pos.2 hk
  have h := fractional_shearer_of_submodular hmono hsub hempty s F (w := fun _ => (k : ℝ)⁻¹)
    (fun _ _ => inv_nonneg.2 hk'.le) U (fun i hi => by
      simp only [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      rw [le_mul_inv_iff₀ hk', one_mul]
      exact_mod_cast hcover i hi)
  rw [← mul_sum] at h
  rw [← le_inv_mul_iff₀ hk']
  exact h

/-- **Han's inequality** for a monotone submodular `f` with `f ∅ = 0`:
`(|U| - 1) f U ≤ ∑ i ∈ U, f (U \ {i})`. -/
theorem han_of_submodular (hmono : ∀ S T, S ⊆ T → f S ≤ f T)
    (hsub : ∀ S T, f (S ∪ T) + f (S ∩ T) ≤ f S + f T) (hempty : f ∅ = 0) (U : Finset ι) :
    ((#U - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * f U ≤ ∑ i ∈ U, f (U.erase i) := by
  have h := shearer_of_submodular hmono hsub hempty U (fun i => U.erase i) (k := #U - 1) U
    (fun i hi => by
      rw [← card_erase_of_mem hi]
      exact card_le_card fun j hj => mem_filter.2
        ⟨mem_of_mem_erase hj, mem_erase.2 ⟨fun h => ne_of_mem_erase hj h.symm, hi⟩⟩)
  simpa only [inter_erase, inter_self] using h

end Submodular

/-! ### Entropy of random variables on a finite weighted space -/

section RandomVariable

variable {Ω α β γ : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ]
  [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]

/-- Integrating against the law: `∑ a, (X_* p) a φ a = ∑ ω, p ω φ (X ω)`. -/
lemma sum_pushforward_mul (X : Ω → α) (p : Ω → ℝ) (φ : α → ℝ) :
    ∑ a, pushforward X p a * φ a = ∑ ω, p ω * φ (X ω) := by
  calc ∑ a, pushforward X p a * φ a = ∑ a, ∑ ω with X ω = a, p ω * φ (X ω) := by
        refine sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
        rw [pushforward, sum_mul]
        exact sum_congr rfl fun ω hω => by rw [(mem_filter.1 hω).2]
    _ = ∑ ω, p ω * φ (X ω) := sum_fiberwise univ X fun ω => p ω * φ (X ω)

omit [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] in
lemma pushforward_id [DecidableEq Ω] (p : Ω → ℝ) : pushforward (fun ω => ω) p = p := by
  funext ω
  simp [pushforward, filter_eq']

omit [Fintype β] in
/-- The law of `g ∘ X` is the pushforward of the law of `X`. -/
lemma pushforward_comp (X : Ω → α) (g : α → β) (p : Ω → ℝ) :
    pushforward g (pushforward X p) = pushforward (fun ω => g (X ω)) p := by
  funext b
  have h := sum_pushforward_mul X p fun a => if g a = b then 1 else 0
  simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, ← sum_filter] at h
  exact h

omit [Fintype α] in
lemma pushforward_nonneg {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (X : Ω → α) (a : α) :
    0 ≤ pushforward X p a :=
  sum_nonneg fun ω _ => hp ω

/-- **Data processing**: `H(g(X)) ≤ H(X)`. -/
theorem entropy_pushforward_comp_le {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (X : Ω → α) (g : α → β) :
    entropy (pushforward (fun ω => g (X ω)) p) ≤ entropy (pushforward X p) := by
  rw [← pushforward_comp]
  exact entropy_pushforward_le (pushforward_nonneg hp X) g

/-- Random variables that are functions of each other have the same entropy. -/
theorem entropy_pushforward_eq_of_comp {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) {X : Ω → α}
    {Y : Ω → β} (f : α → β) (g : β → α) (hY : ∀ ω, Y ω = f (X ω)) (hX : ∀ ω, X ω = g (Y ω)) :
    entropy (pushforward Y p) = entropy (pushforward X p) := by
  have hY' : Y = fun ω => f (X ω) := funext hY
  have hX' : X = fun ω => g (Y ω) := funext hX
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [hY']; exact entropy_pushforward_comp_le hp X f
  · rw [hX']; exact entropy_pushforward_comp_le hp Y g

omit [Fintype α] in
lemma pushforward_const {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (a : α) :
    pushforward (fun _ => a) p = fun b => if b = a then 1 else 0 := by
  funext b
  by_cases h : b = a
  · subst h
    simp [pushforward, hp.sum_eq_one]
  · simp [pushforward, Ne.symm h, h]

/-- A constant has entropy zero. -/
lemma entropy_pushforward_const {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (a : α) :
    entropy (pushforward (fun _ => a) p) = 0 := by
  rw [pushforward_const hp, entropy]
  exact sum_eq_zero fun b _ => by split_ifs <;> simp

/-- The law of an injective image has the same entropy. -/
theorem entropy_pushforward_of_injective {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) {g : Ω → α}
    (hg : Function.Injective g) : entropy (pushforward g p) = entropy p := by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm (entropy_pushforward_le hp g) ?_
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty Ω with hΩ | hΩ
  · simp [entropy, pushforward]
  have hinv : ∀ ω, Function.invFun g (g ω) = ω := Function.leftInverse_invFun hg
  calc entropy p = entropy (pushforward (fun ω => Function.invFun g (g ω)) p) := by
        simp only [hinv, pushforward_id]
    _ ≤ entropy (pushforward g p) :=
        entropy_pushforward_comp_le hp g (Function.invFun g)

/-- **Submodularity of entropy**: if `Z = g(X) = h(Y)` is a common function of `X` and `Y`, then
`H(X, Y) + H(Z) ≤ H(X) + H(Y)`; this is `I(X; Y | Z) ≥ 0`. -/
theorem entropy_pair_add_le {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β)
    (g : α → γ) (h : β → γ) (hgh : ∀ ω, g (X ω) = h (Y ω)) :
    entropy (pushforward (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) p) + entropy (pushforward (fun ω => g (X ω)) p) ≤
      entropy (pushforward X p) + entropy (pushforward Y p) := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r, r = pushforward (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁⟩ : ∃ r₁, r₁ = pushforward X p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂⟩ : ∃ r₂, r₂ = pushforward Y p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L, L = pushforward (fun ω => g (X ω)) p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hr, ← hr₁, ← hr₂, ← hL]
  have hrd : IsDistribution r := by rw [hr]; exact hp.pushforward _
  have hr0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ r x := hrd.nonneg
  have hr₁0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ r₁ a := fun a => by rw [hr₁]; exact pushforward_nonneg hp.nonneg X a
  have hr₂0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ r₂ b := fun b => by rw [hr₂]; exact pushforward_nonneg hp.nonneg Y b
  have hL0 : ∀ c, 0 ≤ L c := fun c => by rw [hL]; exact pushforward_nonneg hp.nonneg _ c
  have hfst : pushforward Prod.fst r = r₁ := by rw [hr, hr₁, pushforward_comp]
  have hsnd : pushforward Prod.snd r = r₂ := by rw [hr, hr₂, pushforward_comp]
  have hLX : pushforward g r₁ = L := by rw [hr₁, hL, pushforward_comp]
  have hLY : pushforward h r₂ = L := by
    rw [hr₂, hL, pushforward_comp]
    exact congrArg (fun F => pushforward F p) (funext fun ω => (hgh ω).symm)
  have hsupp : ∀ x : α × β, r x ≠ 0 → g x.1 = h x.2 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hr] at hx
    obtain ⟨ω, hω, -⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hx
    have hxω : (X ω, Y ω) = x := (mem_filter.1 hω).2
    subst hxω
    exact hgh ω
  have hle₁ : ∀ x : α × β, r x ≤ r₁ x.1 := by
    intro x
    rw [← hfst]
    exact single_le_sum (fun y _ => hr0 y) (mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ x, rfl⟩)
  have hle₂ : ∀ x : α × β, r x ≤ r₂ x.2 := by
    intro x
    rw [← hsnd]
    exact single_le_sum (fun y _ => hr0 y) (mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ x, rfl⟩)
  have hLge : ∀ a, r₁ a ≤ L (g a) := by
    intro a
    rw [← hLX]
    exact single_le_sum (fun y _ => hr₁0 y) (mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ a, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q : α × β → ℝ, ∀ a b,
      q (a, b) = if g a = h b then r₁ a * r₂ b / L (g a) else 0 :=
    ⟨fun x => if g x.1 = h x.2 then r₁ x.1 * r₂ x.2 / L (g x.1) else 0, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hpos : ∀ a b, r (a, b) ≠ 0 → 0 < r₁ a ∧ 0 < r₂ b ∧ 0 < L (g a) := by
    intro a b hx
    have h1 : 0 < r₁ a := lt_of_lt_of_le ((hr0 _).lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hx)) (hle₁ (a, b))
    have h2 : 0 < r₂ b := lt_of_lt_of_le ((hr0 _).lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hx)) (hle₂ (a, b))
    exact ⟨h1, h2, lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (hLge a)⟩
  have hq0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ q x := by
    rintro ⟨a, b⟩
    rw [hq]
    split_ifs
    · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hr₁0 a) (hr₂0 b)) (hL0 _)
    · exact le_rfl
  have hqr : ∀ x, q x = 0 → r x = 0 := by
    rintro ⟨a, b⟩ hqx
    by_contra hx
    have hab : g a = h b := hsupp (a, b) hx
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hpos a b hx
    rw [hq, ite_eq_left hab] at hqx
    exact (div_pos (mul_pos h1 h2) h3).ne' hqx
  have hqsum : ∑ x, q x ≤ ∑ x, r x := by
    rw [hrd.sum_eq_one, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    calc ∑ a, ∑ b, q (a, b) = ∑ a, r₁ a / L (g a) * ∑ b with h b = g a, r₂ b := by
          refine sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
          rw [mul_sum, sum_filter]
          refine sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
          rw [hq]
          by_cases hab : g a = h b
          · rw [ite_eq_left hab, ite_eq_left hab.symm]
            ring
          · rw [ite_eq_right hab, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hab)]
      _ = ∑ a, r₁ a / L (g a) * L (g a) := by
          refine sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
          rw [← hLY]
          rfl
      _ ≤ ∑ a, r₁ a := by
          refine sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_
          rcases (hL0 (g a)).eq_or_lt with h0 | h0
          · rw [← h0, mul_zero]
            exact hr₁0 a
          · exact (div_mul_cancel₀ (r₁ a) h0.ne').le
      _ = 1 := by rw [hr₁]; exact (hp.pushforward X).sum_eq_one
  have hlog : ∑ x, r x * log (q x) = ∑ x, r x * log (r₁ x.1) + ∑ x, r x * log (r₂ x.2) -
      ∑ x, r x * log (L (g x.1)) := by
    rw [← sum_add_distrib, ← sum_sub_distrib]
    refine sum_congr rfl ?_
    rintro ⟨a, b⟩ _
    dsimp only
    by_cases hx : r (a, b) = 0
    · simp [hx]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hpos a b hx
    rw [hq, ite_eq_left (hsupp (a, b) hx), log_div (mul_pos h1 h2).ne' h3.ne',
      log_mul h1.ne' h2.ne']
    ring
  have hs1 : ∑ x, r x * log (r₁ x.1) = -entropy r₁ := by
    rw [entropy_eq_neg_sum, neg_neg, ← hfst, sum_pushforward_mul]
  have hs2 : ∑ x, r x * log (r₂ x.2) = -entropy r₂ := by
    rw [entropy_eq_neg_sum, neg_neg, ← hsnd, sum_pushforward_mul]
  have hLr : pushforward (fun x : α × β => g x.1) r = L := by
    rw [← hLX, ← hfst, pushforward_comp]
  have hsL : ∑ x, r x * log (L (g x.1)) = -entropy L := by
    rw [entropy_eq_neg_sum, neg_neg, ← hLr, sum_pushforward_mul]
  have hgibbs := sum_mul_log_le_sum_mul_log hr0 hq0 hqr hqsum
  rw [hlog, hs1, hs2, hsL] at hgibbs
  rw [entropy_eq_neg_sum r]
  linarith

/-- **Subadditivity**: `H(X, Y) ≤ H(X) + H(Y)`. -/
theorem entropy_pair_le {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) :
    entropy (pushforward (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) p) ≤
      entropy (pushforward X p) + entropy (pushforward Y p) := by
  have h := entropy_pair_add_le hp X Y (fun _ => ()) (fun _ => ()) fun _ => rfl
  have h0 : entropy (pushforward (fun _ : Ω => ()) p) = 0 := entropy_pushforward_const hp ()
  linarith

/-- **Submodularity**, three-variable form: `H(X, Y, Z) + H(Z) ≤ H(X, Z) + H(Y, Z)`. -/
theorem entropy_triple_add_le {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β)
    (Z : Ω → γ) :
    entropy (pushforward (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω, Z ω)) p) + entropy (pushforward Z p) ≤
      entropy (pushforward (fun ω => (X ω, Z ω)) p) +
        entropy (pushforward (fun ω => (Y ω, Z ω)) p) := by
  have h := entropy_pair_add_le hp (fun ω => (X ω, Z ω)) (fun ω => (Y ω, Z ω))
    Prod.snd Prod.snd fun _ => rfl
  have e : entropy (pushforward (fun ω => ((X ω, Z ω), (Y ω, Z ω))) p) =
      entropy (pushforward (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω, Z ω)) p) :=
    entropy_pushforward_eq_of_comp hp.nonneg (fun t => ((t.1, t.2.2), (t.2.1, t.2.2)))
      (fun s => (s.1.1, s.2.1, s.1.2)) (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)
  have h' : entropy (pushforward (fun ω => ((X ω, Z ω), (Y ω, Z ω))) p) +
      entropy (pushforward Z p) ≤ entropy (pushforward (fun ω => (X ω, Z ω)) p) +
        entropy (pushforward (fun ω => (Y ω, Z ω)) p) := h
  linarith

end RandomVariable

/-! ### Joint entropy of subfamilies -/

section Family

variable {ι Ω : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {β : ι → Type*}

/-- The subfamily `(X i ω)_{i ∈ S}`, with `none` off `S`. -/
def restrictOpt (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) (S : Finset ι) (ω : Ω) : ∀ i, Option (β i) :=
  fun i => if i ∈ S then some (X i ω) else none

/-- Forget the coordinates outside `S`. -/
def maskOpt (S : Finset ι) (y : ∀ i, Option (β i)) : ∀ i, Option (β i) :=
  fun i => if i ∈ S then y i else none

lemma maskOpt_restrictOpt (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) (S T : Finset ι) (ω : Ω) :
    maskOpt S (restrictOpt X T ω) = restrictOpt X (T ∩ S) ω := by
  funext i
  by_cases hS : i ∈ S <;> by_cases hT : i ∈ T <;> simp [maskOpt, restrictOpt, hS, hT]

lemma restrictOpt_empty (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) : restrictOpt X ∅ = fun _ _ => none := by
  funext ω i
  simp [restrictOpt]

variable [Fintype ι] [Fintype Ω] [∀ i, Fintype (β i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (β i)]

/-- The joint entropy `H((X i)_{i ∈ S})` under weights `p`. -/
def jointEntropy (p : Ω → ℝ) (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) (S : Finset ι) : ℝ :=
  entropy (pushforward (restrictOpt X S) p)

lemma jointEntropy_empty {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) :
    jointEntropy p X ∅ = 0 := by
  rw [jointEntropy, restrictOpt_empty]
  exact entropy_pushforward_const hp _

lemma jointEntropy_mono {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) {S T : Finset ι}
    (hST : S ⊆ T) : jointEntropy p X S ≤ jointEntropy p X T := by
  have h : restrictOpt X S = fun ω => maskOpt S (restrictOpt X T ω) := by
    funext ω
    rw [maskOpt_restrictOpt, inter_eq_right.2 hST]
  unfold jointEntropy
  rw [h]
  exact entropy_pushforward_comp_le hp (restrictOpt X T) (maskOpt S)

/-- **Submodularity of joint entropy**: `H(X_{S ∪ T}) + H(X_{S ∩ T}) ≤ H(X_S) + H(X_T)`. -/
theorem jointEntropy_union_add_inter_le {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p)
    (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) (S T : Finset ι) :
    jointEntropy p X (S ∪ T) + jointEntropy p X (S ∩ T) ≤
      jointEntropy p X S + jointEntropy p X T := by
  have h := entropy_pair_add_le hp (restrictOpt X S) (restrictOpt X T) (maskOpt T) (maskOpt S)
    fun ω => by rw [maskOpt_restrictOpt, maskOpt_restrictOpt, inter_comm]
  have hT : (fun ω => maskOpt T (restrictOpt X S ω)) = restrictOpt X (S ∩ T) := by
    funext ω
    rw [maskOpt_restrictOpt]
  have e := entropy_pushforward_eq_of_comp hp.nonneg (X := restrictOpt X (S ∪ T))
    (Y := fun ω => (restrictOpt X S ω, restrictOpt X T ω))
    (fun y => (maskOpt S y, maskOpt T y)) (fun z i => if i ∈ S then z.1 i else z.2 i)
    (fun ω => by
      rw [maskOpt_restrictOpt, maskOpt_restrictOpt, union_inter_cancel_left,
        union_inter_cancel_right])
    (fun ω => by
      funext i
      by_cases hS : i ∈ S <;> by_cases hT : i ∈ T <;> simp [restrictOpt, hS, hT])
  rw [hT, e] at h
  exact h

/-- **Shearer's lemma** for entropy: if every coordinate of `U` lies in at least `k` of the sets
`F j`, `j ∈ s`, then `k H(X_U) ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, H(X_{U ∩ F j})`. -/
theorem jointEntropy_shearer {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i)
    {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (F : κ → Finset ι) {k : ℕ} (U : Finset ι)
    (hcover : ∀ i ∈ U, k ≤ #{j ∈ s | i ∈ F j}) :
    k * jointEntropy p X U ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, jointEntropy p X (U ∩ F j) :=
  shearer_of_submodular (f := jointEntropy p X) (fun _ _ h => jointEntropy_mono hp.nonneg X h)
    (jointEntropy_union_add_inter_le hp X) (jointEntropy_empty hp X) s F U hcover

/-- **Shearer's lemma**, fractional form: if every coordinate of `U` lies in sets `F j` of total
weight at least one, then `H(X_U) ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, w j H(X_{U ∩ F j})`. -/
theorem jointEntropy_fractional_shearer {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p)
    (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (F : κ → Finset ι) {w : κ → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ j ∈ s, 0 ≤ w j) (U : Finset ι) (hcover : ∀ i ∈ U, 1 ≤ ∑ j ∈ s with i ∈ F j, w j) :
    jointEntropy p X U ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, w j * jointEntropy p X (U ∩ F j) :=
  fractional_shearer_of_submodular (f := jointEntropy p X)
    (fun _ _ h => jointEntropy_mono hp.nonneg X h) (jointEntropy_union_add_inter_le hp X)
    (jointEntropy_empty hp X) s F hw U hcover

/-- **Han's inequality**: `(|U| - 1) H(X_U) ≤ ∑ i ∈ U, H(X_{U \ {i}})`. -/
theorem jointEntropy_han {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i)
    (U : Finset ι) :
    ((#U - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * jointEntropy p X U ≤ ∑ i ∈ U, jointEntropy p X (U.erase i) :=
  han_of_submodular (f := jointEntropy p X) (fun _ _ h => jointEntropy_mono hp.nonneg X h)
    (jointEntropy_union_add_inter_le hp X) (jointEntropy_empty hp X) U

/-- The joint entropy of the whole family is the entropy of the law of the tuple. -/
lemma jointEntropy_univ {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) :
    jointEntropy p X univ = entropy (pushforward (fun ω i => X i ω) p) := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun (y : ∀ i, β i) (i : ι) => some (y i) :=
    fun y z h => funext fun i => Option.some.inj (congrFun h i)
  have h : pushforward (fun (y : ∀ i, β i) (i : ι) => some (y i))
      (pushforward (fun ω i => X i ω) p) = pushforward (restrictOpt X univ) p := by
    rw [pushforward_comp]
    congr 1
    funext ω i
    simp [restrictOpt]
  rw [jointEntropy, ← h]
  exact entropy_pushforward_of_injective (pushforward_nonneg hp _) hinj

/-- For weights `r` on a product, the coordinates have joint entropy `entropy r`. -/
lemma jointEntropy_univ_coord {r : (∀ i, β i) → ℝ} (hr : ∀ x, 0 ≤ r x) :
    jointEntropy r (fun i x => x i) univ = entropy r := by
  rw [jointEntropy_univ hr, pushforward_id]

/-- The joint entropy of one coordinate is its entropy. -/
lemma jointEntropy_singleton {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) (i : ι) :
    jointEntropy p X {i} = entropy (pushforward (X i) p) := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun b : β i => Function.update (fun _ => none) i (some b) :=
    fun b c h => by simpa using congrFun h i
  have h : pushforward (fun b : β i => Function.update (fun _ => none) i (some b))
      (pushforward (X i) p) = pushforward (restrictOpt X {i}) p := by
    rw [pushforward_comp]
    congr 1
    funext ω j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj
      simp [restrictOpt]
    · simp [restrictOpt, hj]
  rw [jointEntropy, ← h]
  exact entropy_pushforward_of_injective (pushforward_nonneg hp _) hinj

/-- **Subadditivity**: `H((X i)_i) ≤ ∑ i, H(X i)`. -/
theorem jointEntropy_univ_le_sum {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) :
    jointEntropy p X univ ≤ ∑ i, entropy (pushforward (X i) p) := by
  have h := jointEntropy_shearer hp X univ (fun i => {i}) (k := 1) univ fun i _ =>
    card_pos.2 ⟨i, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ i, mem_singleton_self i⟩⟩
  simp only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul, univ_inter] at h
  simpa only [jointEntropy_singleton hp.nonneg] using h

end Family

/-! ### Counting: projections of a finite family of functions -/

section Counting

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]

lemma isDistribution_uniformOn {A : Finset α} (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    IsDistribution (fun a => if a ∈ A then (#A : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0) where
  nonneg a := by positivity
  sum_eq_one := by
    have hc : (#A : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 (card_pos.2 hA).ne'
    rw [Fintype.sum_ite_mem, sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc]

/-- The uniform distribution on `A` has entropy `log |A|`. -/
lemma entropy_uniformOn (A : Finset α) :
    entropy (fun a => if a ∈ A then (#A : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0) = log #A := by
  rcases A.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hA
  · simp [entropy]
  have hc : (#A : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 (card_pos.2 hA).ne'
  simp only [entropy, apply_ite negMulLog, negMulLog_zero, Fintype.sum_ite_mem, sum_const,
    nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [negMulLog, log_inv, neg_mul_neg, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, one_mul]

/-- `H q ≤ log |A|` for a distribution `q` vanishing off `A`. -/
theorem entropy_le_log_card_of_support {q : α → ℝ} (hq : IsDistribution q) {A : Finset α}
    (hA : ∀ a ∉ A, q a = 0) : entropy q ≤ log #A := by
  have hsum : ∑ a ∈ A, q a = 1 := by
    rw [← hq.sum_eq_one]
    exact sum_subset (subset_univ A) fun a _ ha => hA a ha
  have hne : A.Nonempty := by
    rcases A.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | h
    · simp at hsum
    · exact h
  have hc : (#A : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 (card_pos.2 hne).ne'
  have h := entropy_le_crossEntropy hq (isDistribution_uniformOn hne) fun a ha => by
    by_cases haA : a ∈ A
    · simp [haA, hc] at ha
    · exact hA a haA
  have hcross : ∑ a, q a * log (if a ∈ A then (#A : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0) = -log #A := by
    rw [← sum_subset (subset_univ A) fun a _ ha => by simp [hA a ha]]
    rw [sum_congr rfl fun a ha => by rw [ite_eq_left ha, log_inv], ← sum_mul, hsum]
    ring
  rw [hcross, neg_neg] at h
  exact h

omit [Fintype α] in
lemma pushforward_eq_zero_of_notMem_image {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] {q : Ω → ℝ} {A : Finset Ω}
    (hA : ∀ ω ∉ A, q ω = 0) (f : Ω → α) {b : α} (hb : b ∉ A.image f) :
    pushforward f q b = 0 :=
  sum_eq_zero fun ω hω => hA ω fun hωA =>
    hb (by rw [← (mem_filter.1 hω).2]; exact mem_image_of_mem f hωA)

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {β : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (β i)]
  [∀ i, DecidableEq (β i)]

omit [∀ i, Fintype (β i)] in
lemma card_image_restrictOpt (𝓕 : Finset (∀ i, β i)) (S : Finset ι) :
    #(𝓕.image (restrictOpt (fun i x => x i) S)) = #(𝓕.image S.restrict) := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun (y : ∀ i : S, β i) (i : ι) =>
      if hi : i ∈ S then some (y ⟨i, hi⟩) else none := by
    intro y z h
    funext i
    simpa [i.2] using congrFun h i
  have h : 𝓕.image (restrictOpt (fun i x => x i) S) = (𝓕.image S.restrict).image
      fun (y : ∀ i : S, β i) (i : ι) => if hi : i ∈ S then some (y ⟨i, hi⟩) else none := by
    rw [image_image]
    congr 1
  rw [h, card_image_of_injective _ hinj]

/-- **Shearer's lemma, counting form**: if every coordinate lies in at least `k` of the sets
`F j`, `j ∈ s`, then `k log |𝓕| ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, log |𝓕 restricted to F j|`. -/
theorem log_card_shearer (𝓕 : Finset (∀ i, β i)) {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (F : κ → Finset ι)
    {k : ℕ} (hcover : ∀ i, k ≤ #{j ∈ s | i ∈ F j}) :
    k * log #𝓕 ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, log #(𝓕.image (F j).restrict) := by
  rcases 𝓕.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
  · simp
  have hu := isDistribution_uniformOn hne
  have h := jointEntropy_shearer hu (fun i x => x i) s F univ fun i _ => hcover i
  rw [jointEntropy_univ_coord hu.nonneg, entropy_uniformOn] at h
  refine h.trans (sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_)
  rw [univ_inter, ← card_image_restrictOpt, jointEntropy]
  refine entropy_le_log_card_of_support (hu.pushforward _) fun y hy =>
    pushforward_eq_zero_of_notMem_image (fun x hx => ?_) _ hy
  simp [hx]

/-- **Shearer's lemma, product form**: if every coordinate lies in at least `k ≠ 0` of the sets
`F j`, `j ∈ s`, then `|𝓕| ^ k ≤ ∏ j ∈ s, |𝓕 restricted to F j|`. -/
theorem card_pow_le_prod_card_shearer (𝓕 : Finset (∀ i, β i)) {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ)
    (F : κ → Finset ι) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (hcover : ∀ i, k ≤ #{j ∈ s | i ∈ F j}) :
    #𝓕 ^ k ≤ ∏ j ∈ s, #(𝓕.image (F j).restrict) := by
  rcases 𝓕.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
  · simp [zero_pow hk]
  have hpos : ∀ j ∈ s, (0 : ℝ) < #(𝓕.image (F j).restrict) := fun j _ =>
    Nat.cast_pos.2 (card_pos.2 (hne.image _))
  have h := log_card_shearer 𝓕 s F hcover
  rw [← log_pow, ← log_prod fun j hj => (hpos j hj).ne'] at h
  have h' : ((#𝓕 : ℝ) ^ k) ≤ ∏ j ∈ s, (#(𝓕.image (F j).restrict) : ℝ) :=
    (log_le_log_iff (pow_pos (Nat.cast_pos.2 (card_pos.2 hne)) k) (prod_pos hpos)).1 h
  exact_mod_cast h'

omit [∀ i, Fintype (β i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (β i)] in
lemma card_erase_cover (i : ι) : Fintype.card ι - 1 ≤ #{j | i ∈ (univ : Finset ι).erase j} := by
  rw [← Finset.card_univ, ← card_erase_of_mem (mem_univ i)]
  exact card_le_card fun j hj => mem_filter.2
    ⟨mem_univ j, mem_erase.2 ⟨fun h => ne_of_mem_erase hj h.symm, mem_univ i⟩⟩

/-- The **discrete Loomis–Whitney inequality**, logarithmic form:
`(n - 1) log |𝓕| ≤ ∑ i, log |𝓕 restricted to ι \ {i}|` for `n = |ι|`. -/
theorem log_card_loomis_whitney (𝓕 : Finset (∀ i, β i)) :
    ((Fintype.card ι - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * log #𝓕 ≤
      ∑ i, log #(𝓕.image ((univ : Finset ι).erase i).restrict) :=
  log_card_shearer 𝓕 univ (fun i => univ.erase i) card_erase_cover

/-- The **discrete Loomis–Whitney inequality**: `|𝓕| ^ (n - 1) ≤ ∏ i, |𝓕 restricted to
ι \ {i}|` for `n = |ι| ≥ 2`. -/
theorem card_pow_le_prod_card_loomis_whitney (𝓕 : Finset (∀ i, β i))
    (hι : 2 ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
    #𝓕 ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) ≤ ∏ i, #(𝓕.image ((univ : Finset ι).erase i).restrict) :=
  card_pow_le_prod_card_shearer 𝓕 univ (fun i => univ.erase i) (by omega) card_erase_cover

end Counting

end

end TheoremOS.InformationTheory
