import Submission.Library.TheoremOS.Probability.FiniteProbability

/-!
# Dobrushin's ergodicity coefficient

For a matrix `P : Matrix Ω Ω' ℝ` with nonempty row index, `dobrushin P` is the largest total
variation distance between two rows. Contents: the overlap form `tvDist p q = 1 - ∑ min (p, q)`
of two distributions and the Doeblin bound it gives; Dobrushin's contraction
`tvDist (μ ᵥ* P) (ν ᵥ* P) ≤ dobrushin P * tvDist μ ν` for weights of equal mass (no sign
condition on `P`); `0 ≤ dobrushin P ≤ 1` for kernels, `dobrushin P = 0` iff all rows agree, and
`dobrushin P ≤ 1 - ε` under the minorization `ε ν ≤ P x` for all `x`; submultiplicativity
`dobrushin (P * Q) ≤ dobrushin P * dobrushin Q` and `dobrushin (P ^ t) ≤ dobrushin P ^ t`;
convergence to a stationary vector at rate `dobrushin P ^ t`, from a start state or a start
vector, and uniqueness of the stationary distribution when `dobrushin P < 1`; the comparison
`d(t) ≤ dobrushin (P ^ t) ≤ 2 d(t)` with the worst-case distance
`d(t) = max_x tvDist ((P ^ t) x) ν`, hence `d(k t) ≤ (2 d(t)) ^ k`.

Sources: D. A. Levin and Y. Peres, *Markov Chains and Mixing Times*, 2nd ed., AMS, 2017,
§4.3 (convergence under a Doeblin minorization), §4.4 (`d(t) ≤ d̄(t) ≤ 2 d(t)` and
submultiplicativity of `d̄`), §4.5 (`d(k t) ≤ (2 d(t)) ^ k`); E. Seneta, *Non-negative Matrices and
Markov Chains*, 2nd ed., Springer, 1981, Chapter 3 (coefficients of ergodicity); R. L. Dobrushin,
"Central limit theorem for nonstationary Markov chains I", Theory Probab. Appl. 1 (1956).
Textbook material; nothing here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: `dobrushin P` is `Finset.univ.sup' _ fun xy : Ω × Ω => tvDist (P xy.1) (P xy.2)`;
`dobrushin_le_iff` turns a bound on it into a bound on every pair of rows. `d̄(t)` in the sources
is `dobrushin (P ^ t)`. The row `(P * Q) x` is `P x ᵥ* Q` by `row_mul_eq_vecMul`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Probability

open Finset Matrix
open TheoremOS.InformationTheory
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

variable {Ω Ω' Ω'' : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Ω'] [Fintype Ω'']

section Overlap

lemma min_eq_add_sub_abs_div_two (a b : ℝ) : min a b = (a + b - |a - b|) / 2 := by
  rcases le_total a b with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.2 h)]; ring
  · rw [min_eq_right h, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 h)]; ring

/-- The overlap form of total variation: `tvDist p q = 1 - ∑ min (p, q)`. -/
theorem tvDist_eq_one_sub_sum_min {p q : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (hq : IsDistribution q) :
    tvDist p q = 1 - ∑ ω, min (p ω) (q ω) := by
  simp only [min_eq_add_sub_abs_div_two, ← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, hp.sum_eq_one, hq.sum_eq_one, tvDist]
  ring

/-- **Doeblin bound**: weights below both distributions bound their distance by `1 - ∑ m`. -/
theorem tvDist_le_one_sub_sum {p q m : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (hq : IsDistribution q)
    (hmp : ∀ ω, m ω ≤ p ω) (hmq : ∀ ω, m ω ≤ q ω) : tvDist p q ≤ 1 - ∑ ω, m ω := by
  rw [tvDist_eq_one_sub_sum_min hp hq]
  have : ∑ ω, m ω ≤ ∑ ω, min (p ω) (q ω) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun ω _ => le_min (hmp ω) (hmq ω)
  linarith

end Overlap

section Coefficient

/-- **Dobrushin's ergodicity coefficient**: the largest total variation distance between two rows. -/
def dobrushin [Nonempty Ω] (P : Matrix Ω Ω' ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty fun xy : Ω × Ω => tvDist (P xy.1) (P xy.2)

variable [Nonempty Ω] {P : Matrix Ω Ω' ℝ}

lemma tvDist_row_le_dobrushin (P : Matrix Ω Ω' ℝ) (x y : Ω) :
    tvDist (P x) (P y) ≤ dobrushin P :=
  Finset.le_sup' (fun xy : Ω × Ω => tvDist (P xy.1) (P xy.2)) (Finset.mem_univ (x, y))

lemma dobrushin_le_iff {c : ℝ} : dobrushin P ≤ c ↔ ∀ x y, tvDist (P x) (P y) ≤ c := by
  refine ⟨fun h x y => (tvDist_row_le_dobrushin P x y).trans h, fun h => ?_⟩
  exact Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun xy _ => h xy.1 xy.2

lemma dobrushin_nonneg (P : Matrix Ω Ω' ℝ) : 0 ≤ dobrushin P := by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty Ω›
  simpa using tvDist_row_le_dobrushin P x x

lemma dobrushin_le_one (hP : ∀ x, IsDistribution (P x)) : dobrushin P ≤ 1 :=
  dobrushin_le_iff.2 fun x y => tvDist_le_one (hP x) (hP y)

theorem dobrushin_eq_zero_iff : dobrushin P = 0 ↔ ∀ x y, P x = P y := by
  constructor
  · intro h x y
    have := tvDist_row_le_dobrushin P x y
    exact (tvDist_eq_zero_iff _ _).1 (le_antisymm (h ▸ this) (tvDist_nonneg _ _))
  · intro h
    refine le_antisymm (dobrushin_le_iff.2 fun x y => ?_) (dobrushin_nonneg P)
    rw [h x y, tvDist_self]

/-- **Doeblin minorization**: weights `m` below every row give `dobrushin P ≤ 1 - ∑ m`. -/
theorem dobrushin_le_one_sub_sum (hP : ∀ x, IsDistribution (P x)) {m : Ω' → ℝ}
    (hm : ∀ x y, m y ≤ P x y) : dobrushin P ≤ 1 - ∑ y, m y :=
  dobrushin_le_iff.2 fun x x' => tvDist_le_one_sub_sum (hP x) (hP x') (hm x) (hm x')

/-- The minorization `ε ν ≤ P x` by a distribution `ν` gives `dobrushin P ≤ 1 - ε`. -/
theorem dobrushin_le_one_sub (hP : ∀ x, IsDistribution (P x)) {ν : Ω' → ℝ} (hν : IsDistribution ν)
    {ε : ℝ} (hm : ∀ x y, ε * ν y ≤ P x y) : dobrushin P ≤ 1 - ε := by
  have := dobrushin_le_one_sub_sum hP hm
  rwa [← Finset.mul_sum, hν.sum_eq_one, mul_one] at this

/-- Any reference vector `ν` gives `dobrushin P ≤ 2 max_x tvDist (P x) ν`. -/
theorem dobrushin_le_two_mul_sup (P : Matrix Ω Ω' ℝ) (ν : Ω' → ℝ) :
    dobrushin P ≤ 2 * Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty fun x => tvDist (P x) ν := by
  refine dobrushin_le_iff.2 fun x x' => ?_
  have hx := Finset.le_sup' (fun x => tvDist (P x) ν) (Finset.mem_univ x)
  have hx' := Finset.le_sup' (fun x => tvDist (P x) ν) (Finset.mem_univ x')
  have := tvDist_triangle (P x) ν (P x')
  rw [tvDist_comm ν] at this
  linarith

end Coefficient

section Contraction

variable {P : Matrix Ω Ω' ℝ}

omit [Fintype Ω'] in
/-- The one-step identity behind the contraction: with `μ - ν = a - b`, `∑ a = ∑ b = T`,
`T ((μ ᵥ* P) y - (ν ᵥ* P) y) = ∑ x, ∑ x', a x * b x' * (P x y - P x' y)`. -/
lemma mul_vecMul_sub_vecMul {μ ν a b : Ω → ℝ} {T : ℝ} (hab : ∀ x, μ x - ν x = a x - b x)
    (hsa : ∑ x, a x = T) (hsb : ∑ x, b x = T) (y : Ω') :
    T * ((μ ᵥ* P) y - (ν ᵥ* P) y) = ∑ x, ∑ x', a x * b x' * (P x y - P x' y) := by
  have e1 : (μ ᵥ* P) y - (ν ᵥ* P) y = ∑ x, (a x - b x) * P x y := by
    simp only [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← sub_mul, hab]
  have r1 : ∀ x, ∑ x', a x * b x' * P x y = T * (a x * P x y) := fun x => by
    rw [← hsb, Finset.sum_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x' _ => by ring
  have r2 : ∀ x', ∑ x, a x * b x' * P x' y = T * (b x' * P x' y) := fun x' => by
    rw [← hsa, Finset.sum_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => by ring
  calc T * ((μ ᵥ* P) y - (ν ᵥ* P) y)
      = ∑ x, T * (a x * P x y) - ∑ x, T * (b x * P x y) := by
        rw [e1, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => by ring
    _ = ∑ x, ∑ x', a x * b x' * P x y - ∑ x', ∑ x, a x * b x' * P x' y := by
        simp only [r1, r2]
    _ = ∑ x, ∑ x', a x * b x' * (P x y - P x' y) := by
        simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        congr 1
        exact Finset.sum_comm

/-- **Dobrushin's contraction**: if every two rows of `P` are within `δ` in total variation, then
`tvDist (μ ᵥ* P) (ν ᵥ* P) ≤ δ * tvDist μ ν` for weights of equal mass. -/
theorem tvDist_vecMul_le_mul {δ : ℝ} (hδ : ∀ x x', tvDist (P x) (P x') ≤ δ) {μ ν : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : ∑ x, μ x = ∑ x, ν x) : tvDist (μ ᵥ* P) (ν ᵥ* P) ≤ δ * tvDist μ ν := by
  rcases (tvDist_nonneg μ ν).eq_or_lt with h0 | hT
  · obtain rfl := (tvDist_eq_zero_iff μ ν).1 h0.symm
    simp
  set T := tvDist μ ν with hTdef
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : Ω → ℝ, a = fun x => max (μ x - ν x) 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : Ω → ℝ, b = fun x => max (ν x - μ x) 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ha0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x := fun x => by rw [ha]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hb0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ b x := fun x => by rw [hb]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hsa : ∑ x, a x = T := by rw [hTdef, tvDist_eq_sum_max h, ha]
  have hsb : ∑ x, b x = T := by rw [hTdef, tvDist_comm, tvDist_eq_sum_max h.symm, hb]
  have hab : ∀ x, μ x - ν x = a x - b x := fun x => by
    rcases le_total 0 (μ x - ν x) with hx | hx
    · simp only [ha, hb, max_eq_left hx, max_eq_right (by linarith : ν x - μ x ≤ 0)]; ring
    · simp only [ha, hb, max_eq_right hx, max_eq_left (by linarith : 0 ≤ ν x - μ x)]; ring
  have hrow : ∀ x x', ∑ y, |P x y - P x' y| ≤ 2 * δ := fun x x' => by
    have := hδ x x'
    rw [tvDist] at this
    linarith
  have hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ := by
    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty Ω with hne | hne
    · simp [hTdef, tvDist] at hT
    · obtain ⟨x⟩ := hne
      simpa using hδ x x
  have hbound : T * ∑ y, |(μ ᵥ* P) y - (ν ᵥ* P) y| ≤ T * T * (2 * δ) := by
    calc T * ∑ y, |(μ ᵥ* P) y - (ν ᵥ* P) y|
        = ∑ y, |∑ x, ∑ x', a x * b x' * (P x y - P x' y)| := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => ?_
          rw [← mul_vecMul_sub_vecMul hab hsa hsb y, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hT.le]
      _ ≤ ∑ y, ∑ x, ∑ x', a x * b x' * |P x y - P x' y| := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun y _ => (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun x' _ => le_of_eq ?_
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (ha0 x) (hb0 x'))]
      _ = ∑ x, ∑ x', a x * b x' * ∑ y, |P x y - P x' y| := by
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ ∑ x, ∑ x', a x * b x' * (2 * δ) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun x' _ =>
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hrow x x') (mul_nonneg (ha0 x) (hb0 x'))
      _ = T * T * (2 * δ) := by
          simp only [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, hsa, hsb]
  have htv := tvDist_eq_sum_div_two (μ ᵥ* P) (ν ᵥ* P)
  have hle : T * tvDist (μ ᵥ* P) (ν ᵥ* P) ≤ T * (δ * T) := by
    rw [← htv]
    nlinarith
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hle hT

/-- Dobrushin's contraction with the coefficient itself. -/
theorem tvDist_vecMul_le_dobrushin_mul [Nonempty Ω] (P : Matrix Ω Ω' ℝ) {μ ν : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : ∑ x, μ x = ∑ x, ν x) : tvDist (μ ᵥ* P) (ν ᵥ* P) ≤ dobrushin P * tvDist μ ν :=
  tvDist_vecMul_le_mul (tvDist_row_le_dobrushin P) h

/-- A matrix with unit row sums preserves total mass. -/
lemma sum_vecMul (hP : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) (μ : Ω → ℝ) : ∑ y, (μ ᵥ* P) y = ∑ x, μ x := by
  simp only [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, hP, mul_one]

omit [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Ω''] in
lemma row_mul_eq_vecMul (P : Matrix Ω Ω' ℝ) (Q : Matrix Ω' Ω'' ℝ) (x : Ω) :
    (P * Q) x = P x ᵥ* Q := rfl

/-- **Submultiplicativity**: `dobrushin (P * Q) ≤ dobrushin P * dobrushin Q` when the rows of `P`
have equal sums (for instance, `P` is a kernel). -/
theorem dobrushin_mul_le [Nonempty Ω] [Nonempty Ω'] (hP : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1)
    (Q : Matrix Ω' Ω'' ℝ) : dobrushin (P * Q) ≤ dobrushin P * dobrushin Q := by
  refine dobrushin_le_iff.2 fun x x' => ?_
  rw [row_mul_eq_vecMul, row_mul_eq_vecMul]
  calc tvDist (P x ᵥ* Q) (P x' ᵥ* Q) ≤ dobrushin Q * tvDist (P x) (P x') :=
        tvDist_vecMul_le_dobrushin_mul Q (by rw [hP x, hP x'])
    _ ≤ dobrushin Q * dobrushin P :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (tvDist_row_le_dobrushin P x x') (dobrushin_nonneg Q)
    _ = dobrushin P * dobrushin Q := mul_comm _ _

omit [Fintype Ω'] in
/-- With `dobrushin P < 1`, two stationary vectors of equal mass coincide. -/
theorem eq_of_vecMul_eq_of_dobrushin_lt_one [Nonempty Ω] {P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ}
    (hδ : dobrushin P < 1) {ν ν' : Ω → ℝ} (hν : ν ᵥ* P = ν) (hν' : ν' ᵥ* P = ν')
    (h : ∑ x, ν x = ∑ x, ν' x) : ν = ν' := by
  have hc := tvDist_vecMul_le_dobrushin_mul P h
  rw [hν, hν'] at hc
  have h0 : tvDist ν ν' = 0 := by
    nlinarith [tvDist_nonneg ν ν', dobrushin_nonneg P]
  exact (tvDist_eq_zero_iff ν ν').1 h0

end Contraction

section Powers

variable [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω] {P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ}

theorem dobrushin_pow_le (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω) (t : ℕ) :
    dobrushin (P ^ t) ≤ dobrushin P ^ t := by
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    rw [_root_.pow_zero, _root_.pow_zero]
    exact dobrushin_le_one (isDistribution_row (one_mem (rowStochastic ℝ Ω)))
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [_root_.pow_succ, _root_.pow_succ]
    exact (dobrushin_mul_le (sum_row_of_mem_rowStochastic (pow_mem hP t)) P).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih (dobrushin_nonneg P))

omit [Nonempty Ω] in
lemma vecMul_pow_eq_self {ν : Ω → ℝ} (hν : ν ᵥ* P = ν) (t : ℕ) : ν ᵥ* P ^ t = ν := by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ t ih => rw [_root_.pow_succ, ← Matrix.vecMul_vecMul, ih, hν]

omit [Nonempty Ω] in
lemma isDistribution_single (x : Ω) : IsDistribution (Pi.single x 1 : Ω → ℝ) where
  nonneg y := by
    by_cases hy : y = x
    · subst hy; simp
    · simp [hy]
  sum_eq_one := by simp

/-- The distance of a row of `P ^ t` from a distribution stationary for `P` is at most
`dobrushin (P ^ t)`. -/
theorem tvDist_pow_row_le_dobrushin {ν : Ω → ℝ} (hν : IsDistribution ν) (hνP : ν ᵥ* P = ν)
    (t : ℕ) (x : Ω) : tvDist ((P ^ t) x) ν ≤ dobrushin (P ^ t) := by
  have hx := isDistribution_single x
  calc tvDist ((P ^ t) x) ν = tvDist (Pi.single x 1 ᵥ* P ^ t) (ν ᵥ* P ^ t) := by
        rw [single_one_vecMul, Matrix.row_apply', vecMul_pow_eq_self hνP]
    _ ≤ dobrushin (P ^ t) * tvDist (Pi.single x 1) ν :=
        tvDist_vecMul_le_dobrushin_mul _ (hx.sum_eq_one.trans hν.sum_eq_one.symm)
    _ ≤ dobrushin (P ^ t) * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (tvDist_le_one hx hν) (dobrushin_nonneg _)
    _ = dobrushin (P ^ t) := mul_one _

/-- **Convergence at the Dobrushin rate** from a start vector. -/
theorem tvDist_vecMul_pow_le (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω) {μ ν : Ω → ℝ} (hνP : ν ᵥ* P = ν)
    (h : ∑ x, μ x = ∑ x, ν x) (t : ℕ) :
    tvDist (μ ᵥ* P ^ t) ν ≤ dobrushin P ^ t * tvDist μ ν :=
  calc tvDist (μ ᵥ* P ^ t) ν = tvDist (μ ᵥ* P ^ t) (ν ᵥ* P ^ t) := by
        rw [vecMul_pow_eq_self hνP]
    _ ≤ dobrushin (P ^ t) * tvDist μ ν := tvDist_vecMul_le_dobrushin_mul _ h
    _ ≤ dobrushin P ^ t * tvDist μ ν :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (dobrushin_pow_le hP t) (tvDist_nonneg _ _)

/-- **Convergence at the Dobrushin rate** from a start state. -/
theorem tvDist_pow_row_le_dobrushin_pow (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω) {ν : Ω → ℝ}
    (hν : IsDistribution ν) (hνP : ν ᵥ* P = ν) (t : ℕ) (x : Ω) :
    tvDist ((P ^ t) x) ν ≤ dobrushin P ^ t :=
  (tvDist_pow_row_le_dobrushin hν hνP t x).trans (dobrushin_pow_le hP t)

/-- **Doeblin's theorem**: under the minorization `ε ν' ≤ P x` for a distribution `ν'`, every row
of `P ^ t` is within `(1 - ε) ^ t` of a stationary distribution. -/
theorem tvDist_pow_row_le_of_minorization (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω) {ν : Ω → ℝ}
    (hν : IsDistribution ν) (hνP : ν ᵥ* P = ν) {ν' : Ω → ℝ} (hν' : IsDistribution ν')
    {ε : ℝ} (hm : ∀ x y, ε * ν' y ≤ P x y) (t : ℕ) (x : Ω) :
    tvDist ((P ^ t) x) ν ≤ (1 - ε) ^ t :=
  (tvDist_pow_row_le_dobrushin_pow hP hν hνP t x).trans
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (dobrushin_nonneg P)
      (dobrushin_le_one_sub (isDistribution_row hP) hν' hm) t)

/-- The worst-case distance `d(t) = max_x tvDist ((P ^ t) x) ν` is at most `dobrushin (P ^ t)`. -/
theorem sup_tvDist_pow_row_le_dobrushin {ν : Ω → ℝ} (hν : IsDistribution ν) (hνP : ν ᵥ* P = ν)
    (t : ℕ) :
    Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun x => tvDist ((P ^ t) x) ν) ≤ dobrushin (P ^ t) :=
  Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun x _ => tvDist_pow_row_le_dobrushin hν hνP t x

/-- `d(k t) ≤ (2 d(t)) ^ k` for the worst-case distance `d` to a stationary distribution. -/
theorem sup_tvDist_pow_row_mul_le (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω) {ν : Ω → ℝ}
    (hν : IsDistribution ν) (hνP : ν ᵥ* P = ν) (t k : ℕ) :
    Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun x => tvDist ((P ^ (t * k)) x) ν) ≤
      (2 * Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty fun x => tvDist ((P ^ t) x) ν) ^ k :=
  calc Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun x => tvDist ((P ^ (t * k)) x) ν)
      ≤ dobrushin ((P ^ t) ^ k) := by
        rw [← _root_.pow_mul]
        exact sup_tvDist_pow_row_le_dobrushin hν hνP (t * k)
    _ ≤ dobrushin (P ^ t) ^ k := dobrushin_pow_le (pow_mem hP t) k
    _ ≤ _ := pow_le_pow_left₀ (dobrushin_nonneg _) (dobrushin_le_two_mul_sup _ ν) k

end Powers

end

end TheoremOS.Probability

import Submission.Library.TheoremOS.InformationTheory.Entropy

/-!
# Finite probability and total variation distance

Weights `p : Ω → ℝ` on a finite type, with `IsDistribution p` (nonnegative, sum one) from
`TheoremOS.InformationTheory.Entropy`. Contents: expectation `expectation p X = ∑ ω, p ω * X ω`
and event probability `prob p s = ∑ ω ∈ s, p ω`; linearity and monotonicity, the union bound,
complements, Markov's and Chebyshev's inequalities, variance `E X² - (E X)²`, and the second
moment bound `(E X)² ≤ P(X ≠ 0) · E X²`. Total variation `tvDist p q = ½ ∑ |p - q|`: a
pseudometric, at most one between distributions, the maximal event gap, contraction under
pushforwards and under row-stochastic kernels (`Matrix.rowStochastic`), the coupling bound,
the `√|Ω|` comparison with the `ℓ²` distance, and subadditivity on products. Markov chains:
a row-stochastic matrix maps distributions to distributions, detailed balance gives a
stationary vector, averages `n⁻¹ ∑ i, K i` of kernels are kernels with the common stationary
vectors, the heat-bath (Glauber) kernel of an equivalence relation is a kernel reversible for
its weights, and the distance to a stationary distribution (from a start vector, a start state,
or the worst start state) is nonincreasing.

Sources: D. A. Levin and Y. Peres, *Markov Chains and Mixing Times*, 2nd ed., AMS, 2017,
§1.6 (detailed balance), §3.3 (Glauber dynamics), §4.1–4.2 (total variation, couplings), §4.4 (the distance `d(t)` is
nonincreasing); N. Alon and J. H. Spencer, *The Probabilistic Method*, 4th ed., Wiley, 2016,
Chapter 4 (Markov, Chebyshev, second moment). Textbook material; nothing here is specific to a
benchmark problem.

Bridges: a statement defining total variation as `(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ y, |p y - q y|` is
`tvDist p q` by `rfl`; the forms `(1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * ∑ …` and `(∑ …) / 2` are
`tvDist_eq_natCast_half` and `tvDist_eq_sum_div_two`; a sum over `Finset.univ` written through a
definition such as `allGraphStates` unfolds to `∑ y` first; the constant `1 / N` with
`N = Fintype.card Ω` is `InformationTheory.uniform Ω` by `uniform_eq_one_div`. The row
`(P ^ (t + 1)) x` is `(P ^ t) x ᵥ* P` by `pow_succ_row`, and a start vector `μ` evolves as
`μ ᵥ* P ^ t`. A site kernel `if sameExcept i x y then w y / ∑ z, (if sameExcept i x z then w z
else 0) else 0` is `heatBath (sameExcept i) w` by `rfl`, and `(n : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, K i` is covered by
`inv_natCast_smul_sum_mem_rowStochastic` and `vecMul_inv_natCast_smul_sum`. Short names such
as `expectation`, `variance` and `heatBath` also occur in problem namespaces; write
`TheoremOS.Probability.variance` etc. when both are in scope.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Probability

open Finset Matrix
open TheoremOS.InformationTheory
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

variable {Ω Ω' : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Ω']

/-- Expectation of `X` under the weights `p`. -/
def expectation (p : Ω → ℝ) (X : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ ω, p ω * X ω

/-- Mass of the event `s` under the weights `p`. -/
def prob (p : Ω → ℝ) (s : Finset Ω) : ℝ := ∑ ω ∈ s, p ω

section Expectation

lemma expectation_add (p X Y : Ω → ℝ) :
    expectation p (X + Y) = expectation p X + expectation p Y := by
  simp [expectation, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

lemma expectation_sub (p X Y : Ω → ℝ) :
    expectation p (X - Y) = expectation p X - expectation p Y := by
  simp [expectation, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

lemma expectation_const_mul (p X : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    expectation p (fun ω => c * X ω) = c * expectation p X := by
  simp only [expectation, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => by ring

lemma expectation_const {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (c : ℝ) :
    expectation p (fun _ => c) = c := by
  simp only [expectation, ← Finset.sum_mul, hp.sum_eq_one, one_mul]

lemma expectation_mono {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) {X Y : Ω → ℝ} (h : ∀ ω, X ω ≤ Y ω) :
    expectation p X ≤ expectation p Y :=
  Finset.sum_le_sum fun ω _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h ω) (hp ω)

lemma expectation_nonneg {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ X ω) :
    0 ≤ expectation p X :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun ω _ => mul_nonneg (hp ω) (hX ω)

lemma prob_eq_expectation_indicator (p : Ω → ℝ) (s : Finset Ω) [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] :
    prob p s = expectation p (fun ω => if ω ∈ s then 1 else 0) := by
  simp [prob, expectation]

omit [Fintype Ω] in
lemma prob_nonneg {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (s : Finset Ω) : 0 ≤ prob p s :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun ω _ => hp ω

omit [Fintype Ω] in
lemma prob_mono {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) {s t : Finset Ω} (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    prob p s ≤ prob p t :=
  Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hst fun ω _ _ => hp ω

lemma prob_univ {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) : prob p Finset.univ = 1 :=
  hp.sum_eq_one

lemma prob_le_one {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (s : Finset Ω) : prob p s ≤ 1 :=
  (prob_mono hp.nonneg (Finset.subset_univ s)).trans_eq (prob_univ hp)

lemma prob_compl [DecidableEq Ω] {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (s : Finset Ω) :
    prob p sᶜ = 1 - prob p s := by
  have h := Finset.sum_compl_add_sum s p
  rw [hp.sum_eq_one] at h
  simp only [prob]
  linarith

omit [Fintype Ω] in
/-- The union bound for two events. -/
lemma prob_union_le [DecidableEq Ω] {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (s t : Finset Ω) :
    prob p (s ∪ t) ≤ prob p s + prob p t := by
  have h := Finset.sum_union_inter (s₁ := s) (s₂ := t) (f := p)
  have h0 : 0 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ s ∩ t, p ω := Finset.sum_nonneg fun ω _ => hp ω
  simp only [prob]
  linarith
omit [Fintype Ω] in
/-- The union bound for a finite family of events. -/
lemma prob_biUnion_le [DecidableEq Ω] {ι : Type*} {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω)
    (I : Finset ι) (s : ι → Finset Ω) :
    prob p (I.biUnion s) ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, prob p (s i) := by
  classical
  induction I using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [prob]
  | @insert a I ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.biUnion_insert, Finset.sum_insert ha]
    exact (prob_union_le hp _ _).trans (by linarith)

/-- **Markov's inequality**. -/
theorem markov {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ X ω) {a : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) : prob p {ω | a ≤ X ω} ≤ expectation p X / a := by
  rw [le_div_iff₀ ha]
  calc prob p {ω | a ≤ X ω} * a = ∑ ω ∈ {ω | a ≤ X ω}, p ω * a := by
        rw [prob, Finset.sum_mul]
    _ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ {ω | a ≤ X ω}, p ω * X ω := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun ω hω => ?_
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.mem_filter.1 hω).2 (hp ω)
    _ ≤ expectation p X :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
          fun ω _ _ => mul_nonneg (hp ω) (hX ω)

/-- Variance `E (X - E X)²`. -/
def variance (p : Ω → ℝ) (X : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  expectation p (fun ω => (X ω - expectation p X) ^ 2)

lemma variance_nonneg {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (X : Ω → ℝ) : 0 ≤ variance p X :=
  expectation_nonneg hp fun _ => sq_nonneg _

lemma expectation_sub_const_sq {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : Ω → ℝ) (m : ℝ) :
    expectation p (fun ω => (X ω - m) ^ 2) =
      expectation p (fun ω => X ω ^ 2) - 2 * m * expectation p X + m ^ 2 := by
  have h : ∀ ω, p ω * (X ω - m) ^ 2 = p ω * X ω ^ 2 - 2 * m * (p ω * X ω) + m ^ 2 * p ω :=
    fun ω => by ring
  simp only [expectation, h, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    hp.sum_eq_one, mul_one]

/-- `Var X = E X² - (E X)²`. -/
theorem variance_eq {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : Ω → ℝ) :
    variance p X = expectation p (fun ω => X ω ^ 2) - expectation p X ^ 2 := by
  rw [variance, expectation_sub_const_sq hp]
  ring

lemma sq_expectation_le {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : Ω → ℝ) :
    expectation p X ^ 2 ≤ expectation p (fun ω => X ω ^ 2) := by
  have := variance_nonneg hp.nonneg X
  rw [variance_eq hp] at this
  linarith

/-- **Chebyshev's inequality**. -/
theorem chebyshev {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : Ω → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    prob p {ω | a ≤ |X ω - expectation p X|} ≤ variance p X / a ^ 2 := by
  have hset : ({ω | a ≤ |X ω - expectation p X|} : Finset Ω) =
      ({ω | a ^ 2 ≤ (X ω - expectation p X) ^ 2} : Finset Ω) :=
    Finset.filter_congr fun ω _ => by
      rw [← sq_abs (X ω - expectation p X)]
      exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ ha.le (abs_nonneg _) two_ne_zero).symm
  rw [hset]
  exact markov hp.nonneg (fun _ => sq_nonneg _) (pow_pos ha 2)
/-- The **second moment bound** `(E X)² ≤ P(X ≠ 0) · E X²` (Cauchy–Schwarz on the support). -/
theorem sq_expectation_le_prob_ne_zero_mul {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (X : Ω → ℝ) :
    expectation p X ^ 2 ≤ prob p {ω | X ω ≠ 0} * expectation p (fun ω => X ω ^ 2) := by
  have h1 : ∀ ω, √(p ω) ^ 2 = p ω := fun ω => Real.sq_sqrt (hp ω)
  have hE : expectation p X = ∑ ω ∈ {ω | X ω ≠ 0}, √(p ω) * (√(p ω) * X ω) := by
    have h : ∀ ω, √(p ω) * (√(p ω) * X ω) = p ω * X ω := fun ω => by
      rw [← mul_assoc, Real.mul_self_sqrt (hp ω)]
    simp only [h]
    rw [expectation, Finset.sum_filter_of_ne]
    intro ω _ hω
    exact right_ne_zero_of_mul hω
  rw [hE]
  calc (∑ ω ∈ {ω | X ω ≠ 0}, √(p ω) * (√(p ω) * X ω)) ^ 2
      ≤ (∑ ω ∈ {ω | X ω ≠ 0}, √(p ω) ^ 2) * ∑ ω ∈ {ω | X ω ≠ 0}, (√(p ω) * X ω) ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq _ _ _
    _ ≤ prob p {ω | X ω ≠ 0} * expectation p (fun ω => X ω ^ 2) := by
        have h2 : ∀ ω, (√(p ω) * X ω) ^ 2 = p ω * X ω ^ 2 := fun ω => by rw [mul_pow, h1]
        simp only [h1, h2]
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (prob_nonneg hp _)
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
          fun ω _ _ => mul_nonneg (hp ω) (sq_nonneg _)

/-- The **second moment method**: `P(X ≠ 0) ≥ (E X)² / E X²`. -/
theorem sq_expectation_div_le_prob_ne_zero {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (X : Ω → ℝ) :
    expectation p X ^ 2 / expectation p (fun ω => X ω ^ 2) ≤ prob p {ω | X ω ≠ 0} := by
  rcases (expectation_nonneg hp fun ω => sq_nonneg (X ω)).eq_or_lt with h | h
  · rw [← h, div_zero]
    exact prob_nonneg hp _
  · rw [div_le_iff₀ h]
    exact sq_expectation_le_prob_ne_zero_mul hp X

end Expectation

section TotalVariation

/-- Total variation distance `½ ∑ |p - q|`. -/
def tvDist (p q : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ ω, |p ω - q ω|

lemma tvDist_eq_natCast_half (p q : Ω → ℝ) :
    (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * ∑ ω, |p ω - q ω| = tvDist p q := by
  norm_num [tvDist]

lemma tvDist_eq_sum_div_two (p q : Ω → ℝ) : (∑ ω, |p ω - q ω|) / 2 = tvDist p q := by
  rw [tvDist]
  ring

lemma tvDist_comm (p q : Ω → ℝ) : tvDist p q = tvDist q p := by
  simp only [tvDist, abs_sub_comm]

@[simp] lemma tvDist_self (p : Ω → ℝ) : tvDist p p = 0 := by
  simp [tvDist]

lemma tvDist_nonneg (p q : Ω → ℝ) : 0 ≤ tvDist p q :=
  mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun ω _ => abs_nonneg _)

lemma tvDist_triangle (p q r : Ω → ℝ) : tvDist p r ≤ tvDist p q + tvDist q r := by
  simp only [tvDist, ← mul_add, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum fun ω _ => ?_) (by norm_num)
  exact abs_sub_le (p ω) (q ω) (r ω)

lemma tvDist_eq_zero_iff (p q : Ω → ℝ) : tvDist p q = 0 ↔ p = q := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' : ∑ ω, |p ω - q ω| = 0 := by
      simpa [tvDist] using h
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun ω _ => abs_nonneg _] at h'
    funext ω
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (abs_eq_zero.1 (h' ω (Finset.mem_univ ω)))
  · rintro rfl
    exact tvDist_self p
/-- For weights of equal total mass, `tvDist p q = ∑ (p - q)⁺`. -/
lemma tvDist_eq_sum_max {p q : Ω → ℝ} (h : ∑ ω, p ω = ∑ ω, q ω) :
    tvDist p q = ∑ ω, max (p ω - q ω) 0 := by
  have h0 : ∑ ω, (p ω - q ω) = 0 := by rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, h, sub_self]
  have habs : ∀ x : ℝ, |x| = 2 * max x 0 - x := fun x => by
    rcases le_total 0 x with hx | hx
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg hx, max_eq_left hx]; ring
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos hx, max_eq_right hx]; ring
  simp only [tvDist, habs, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, h0, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring

/-- Every event gap is at most the total variation distance. -/
theorem prob_sub_prob_le_tvDist {p q : Ω → ℝ} (h : ∑ ω, p ω = ∑ ω, q ω) (s : Finset Ω) :
    prob p s - prob q s ≤ tvDist p q := by
  rw [tvDist_eq_sum_max h, prob, prob, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  calc ∑ ω ∈ s, (p ω - q ω) ≤ ∑ ω ∈ s, max (p ω - q ω) 0 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun ω _ => le_max_left _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ ω, max (p ω - q ω) 0 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ s)
          fun ω _ _ => le_max_right _ _

theorem abs_prob_sub_prob_le_tvDist {p q : Ω → ℝ} (h : ∑ ω, p ω = ∑ ω, q ω) (s : Finset Ω) :
    |prob p s - prob q s| ≤ tvDist p q := by
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · have := prob_sub_prob_le_tvDist h.symm s
    rw [tvDist_comm] at this
    linarith
  · exact prob_sub_prob_le_tvDist h s

/-- The event `{q < p}` attains the total variation distance. -/
theorem prob_sub_prob_lt_eq_tvDist {p q : Ω → ℝ} (h : ∑ ω, p ω = ∑ ω, q ω) :
    prob p {ω | q ω < p ω} - prob q {ω | q ω < p ω} = tvDist p q := by
  rw [tvDist_eq_sum_max h, prob, prob, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => ?_
  split_ifs with hω
  · exact (max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.2 hω.le)).symm
  · exact (max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.2 (not_lt.1 hω))).symm

/-- Total variation is the largest event gap. -/
theorem isGreatest_tvDist {p q : Ω → ℝ} (h : ∑ ω, p ω = ∑ ω, q ω) :
    IsGreatest (Set.range fun s : Finset Ω => prob p s - prob q s) (tvDist p q) :=
  ⟨⟨_, prob_sub_prob_lt_eq_tvDist h⟩, by
    rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩
    exact prob_sub_prob_le_tvDist h s⟩

lemma tvDist_le_one {p q : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (hq : IsDistribution q) :
    tvDist p q ≤ 1 := by
  rw [← prob_sub_prob_lt_eq_tvDist (hp.sum_eq_one.trans hq.sum_eq_one.symm)]
  have h1 := prob_le_one hp {ω | q ω < p ω}
  have h2 := prob_nonneg hq.nonneg {ω | q ω < p ω}
  linarith

/-- Total variation does not increase under a pushforward. -/
theorem tvDist_pushforward_le [DecidableEq Ω'] (f : Ω → Ω') (p q : Ω → ℝ) :
    tvDist (pushforward f p) (pushforward f q) ≤ tvDist p q := by
  simp only [tvDist]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by norm_num)
  calc ∑ y, |pushforward f p y - pushforward f q y|
      = ∑ y, |∑ ω with f ω = y, (p ω - q ω)| := by
        simp only [pushforward, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    _ ≤ ∑ y, ∑ ω with f ω = y, |p ω - q ω| :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun y _ => Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ = ∑ ω, |p ω - q ω| := Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ f _
/-- Total variation does not increase under a row-stochastic kernel. -/
theorem tvDist_vecMul_le [DecidableEq Ω] {P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ} (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω)
    (p q : Ω → ℝ) : tvDist (p ᵥ* P) (q ᵥ* P) ≤ tvDist p q := by
  simp only [tvDist]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by norm_num)
  calc ∑ y, |(p ᵥ* P) y - (q ᵥ* P) y| = ∑ y, |∑ x, (p x - q x) * P x y| := by
        simp [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    _ ≤ ∑ y, ∑ x, |(p x - q x) * P x y| :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun y _ => Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ = ∑ x, |p x - q x| := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
        simp only [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (nonneg_of_mem_rowStochastic hP), ← Finset.mul_sum,
          sum_row_of_mem_rowStochastic hP, mul_one]

/-- The **coupling inequality**: `tvDist p q ≤ P(X ≠ Y)` for any coupling `(X, Y)`. -/
theorem tvDist_marginal_le [DecidableEq Ω] {r : Ω × Ω → ℝ} (hr : ∀ x, 0 ≤ r x) :
    tvDist (marginalLeft r) (marginalRight r) ≤ ∑ x with x.1 ≠ x.2, r x := by
  have hdiff : ∀ a, marginalLeft r a - marginalRight r a =
      ∑ b, ((if a ≠ b then r (a, b) else 0) - if b ≠ a then r (b, a) else 0) := by
    intro a
    simp only [marginalLeft, marginalRight, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · subst hab; simp
    · simp [hab, Ne.symm hab]
  have hS : ∑ x with x.1 ≠ x.2, r x = ∑ a, ∑ b, if a ≠ b then r (a, b) else 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  have hswap : ∑ a, ∑ b, (if b ≠ a then r (b, a) else 0) =
      ∑ a, ∑ b, if a ≠ b then r (a, b) else 0 := Finset.sum_comm
  have hnn : ∀ a b, 0 ≤ if a ≠ b then r (a, b) else 0 := fun a b => by
    split_ifs
    · exact hr _
    · exact le_rfl
  calc tvDist (marginalLeft r) (marginalRight r)
      = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ a, |∑ b, ((if a ≠ b then r (a, b) else 0) -
          if b ≠ a then r (b, a) else 0)| := by
        simp only [tvDist, hdiff]
    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ a, ∑ b, ((if a ≠ b then r (a, b) else 0) +
          if b ≠ a then r (b, a) else 0) := by
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_) (by norm_num)
        refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => ?_)
        rw [abs_le]
        constructor <;> linarith [hnn a b, hnn b a]
    _ = ∑ x with x.1 ≠ x.2, r x := by
        rw [hS]
        simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hswap]
        ring

/-- `tvDist p q ≤ ½ √|Ω| ‖p - q‖₂`. -/
theorem tvDist_le_sqrt_card_mul (p q : Ω → ℝ) :
    tvDist p q ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * √(Fintype.card Ω) * √(∑ ω, (p ω - q ω) ^ 2) := by
  have h := Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt Finset.univ (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) fun ω => |p ω - q ω|
  simp only [one_mul, one_pow, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one,
    sq_abs] at h
  rw [tvDist, mul_assoc]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (by norm_num)

/-- Total variation is subadditive on products. -/
theorem tvDist_prod_le {p q : Ω → ℝ} {p' q' : Ω' → ℝ} (hq : IsDistribution q)
    (hp' : IsDistribution p') :
    tvDist (fun x : Ω × Ω' => p x.1 * p' x.2) (fun x => q x.1 * q' x.2) ≤
      tvDist p q + tvDist p' q' := by
  have key : ∀ x : Ω × Ω', |p x.1 * p' x.2 - q x.1 * q' x.2| ≤
      |p x.1 - q x.1| * p' x.2 + q x.1 * |p' x.2 - q' x.2| := fun x => by
    calc |p x.1 * p' x.2 - q x.1 * q' x.2|
        = |(p x.1 - q x.1) * p' x.2 + q x.1 * (p' x.2 - q' x.2)| := by congr 1; ring
      _ ≤ |(p x.1 - q x.1) * p' x.2| + |q x.1 * (p' x.2 - q' x.2)| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = |p x.1 - q x.1| * p' x.2 + q x.1 * |p' x.2 - q' x.2| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hp'.nonneg _), abs_of_nonneg (hq.nonneg _)]
  calc tvDist (fun x : Ω × Ω' => p x.1 * p' x.2) (fun x => q x.1 * q' x.2)
      ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ x : Ω × Ω', (|p x.1 - q x.1| * p' x.2 + q x.1 * |p' x.2 - q' x.2|) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => key x) (by norm_num)
    _ = tvDist p q + tvDist p' q' := by
        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
        simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul, hp'.sum_eq_one,
          hq.sum_eq_one, mul_one, one_mul, tvDist]
        ring

lemma uniform_eq_one_div : uniform Ω = fun _ => 1 / (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) := by
  funext ω
  simp [uniform]

end TotalVariation
section MarkovChain

variable [DecidableEq Ω] {P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ}

/-- A row-stochastic kernel maps distributions to distributions. -/
lemma isDistribution_vecMul (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω) {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) :
    IsDistribution (p ᵥ* P) where
  nonneg y := Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => mul_nonneg (hp.nonneg x) (nonneg_of_mem_rowStochastic hP)
  sum_eq_one := by
    simp only [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, sum_row_of_mem_rowStochastic hP, mul_one, hp.sum_eq_one]

/-- Each row of a row-stochastic matrix is a distribution. -/
lemma isDistribution_row (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω) (x : Ω) : IsDistribution (P x) :=
  ⟨fun _ => nonneg_of_mem_rowStochastic hP, sum_row_of_mem_rowStochastic hP x⟩

lemma pow_succ_row (P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ) (t : ℕ) (x : Ω) : (P ^ (t + 1)) x = (P ^ t) x ᵥ* P := by
  funext y
  rw [_root_.pow_succ, Matrix.mul_apply]
  rfl

omit [DecidableEq Ω] in
/-- **Detailed balance** implies stationarity. -/
theorem vecMul_eq_of_detailedBalance {ν : Ω → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1)
    (hrev : ∀ x y, ν x * P x y = ν y * P y x) : ν ᵥ* P = ν := by
  funext y
  calc (ν ᵥ* P) y = ∑ x, ν x * P x y := rfl
    _ = ∑ x, ν y * P y x := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => hrev x y
    _ = ν y := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hrow y, mul_one]

/-- An average of row-stochastic kernels is row stochastic. -/
lemma inv_card_smul_sum_mem_rowStochastic {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    {K : ι → Matrix Ω Ω ℝ} (hK : ∀ i, K i ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω) :
    (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, K i ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω := by
  rw [mem_rowStochastic_iff_sum]
  constructor
  · intro x y
    simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity)
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => nonneg_of_mem_rowStochastic (hK i))
  · intro x
    simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [sum_row_of_mem_rowStochastic (hK _), Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 Fintype.card_ne_zero)

/-- The distance from a stationary `ν` is nonincreasing along the chain. -/
theorem tvDist_vecMul_pow_succ_le (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω) {ν : Ω → ℝ} (hν : ν ᵥ* P = ν)
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : tvDist (μ ᵥ* P ^ (t + 1)) ν ≤ tvDist (μ ᵥ* P ^ t) ν :=
  calc tvDist (μ ᵥ* P ^ (t + 1)) ν = tvDist ((μ ᵥ* P ^ t) ᵥ* P) (ν ᵥ* P) := by
        rw [hν, _root_.pow_succ, Matrix.vecMul_vecMul]
    _ ≤ tvDist (μ ᵥ* P ^ t) ν := tvDist_vecMul_le hP _ _

theorem antitone_tvDist_vecMul_pow (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω) {ν : Ω → ℝ} (hν : ν ᵥ* P = ν)
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) : Antitone fun t : ℕ => tvDist (μ ᵥ* P ^ t) ν :=
  antitone_nat_of_succ_le fun t => tvDist_vecMul_pow_succ_le hP hν μ t

/-- The distance of the row `(P ^ t) x` from a stationary `ν` is nonincreasing in `t`. -/
theorem antitone_tvDist_pow_row (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω) {ν : Ω → ℝ} (hν : ν ᵥ* P = ν)
    (x : Ω) : Antitone fun t : ℕ => tvDist ((P ^ t) x) ν :=
  antitone_nat_of_succ_le fun t =>
    calc tvDist ((P ^ (t + 1)) x) ν = tvDist ((P ^ t) x ᵥ* P) (ν ᵥ* P) := by
          rw [hν, pow_succ_row]
      _ ≤ tvDist ((P ^ t) x) ν := tvDist_vecMul_le hP _ _

/-- The worst-case distance `d(t) = max_x ‖P^t(x, ·) - ν‖_TV` is nonincreasing. -/
theorem antitone_sup_tvDist_pow_row [Nonempty Ω] (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω) {ν : Ω → ℝ}
    (hν : ν ᵥ* P = ν) :
    Antitone fun t : ℕ => Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty fun x => tvDist ((P ^ t) x) ν :=
  antitone_nat_of_succ_le fun t =>
    Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun x hx =>
      (antitone_tvDist_pow_row hP hν x (Nat.le_succ t)).trans
        (Finset.le_sup' (fun x => tvDist ((P ^ t) x) ν) hx)

section HeatBath

omit [DecidableEq Ω] in
/-- The **heat-bath (Glauber) kernel**: from `x`, resample within the `R`-class of `x`
proportionally to `w`. A site update `y ↦ w y / ∑_{z ~ᵢ x} w z` on configurations agreeing off
a site `i` is `heatBath (sameExcept i) w` by `rfl`. -/
def heatBath (R : Ω → Ω → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (w : Ω → ℝ) : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ := fun x y =>
  if R x y then w y / ∑ z, (if R x z then w z else 0) else 0

omit [DecidableEq Ω] in
lemma sum_heatBath {R : Ω → Ω → Prop} [DecidableRel R] {w : Ω → ℝ} (hR : ∀ x, R x x)
    (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x) (x : Ω) : ∑ y, heatBath R w x y = 1 := by
  have hZ : 0 < ∑ z, (if R x z then w z else 0) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa [hR x] using hw x)
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun z => if R x z then w z else 0)
        (fun z _ => by split_ifs <;> simp [(hw z).le]) (Finset.mem_univ x))
  have h : ∀ y, heatBath R w x y = (if R x y then w y else 0) / ∑ z, (if R x z then w z else 0) :=
    fun y => by unfold heatBath; split_ifs <;> simp
  simp only [h, ← Finset.sum_div]
  exact div_self hZ.ne'

lemma heatBath_mem_rowStochastic {R : Ω → Ω → Prop} [DecidableRel R] {w : Ω → ℝ}
    (hR : ∀ x, R x x) (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x) : heatBath R w ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω := by
  rw [mem_rowStochastic_iff_sum]
  refine ⟨fun x y => ?_, sum_heatBath hR hw⟩
  unfold heatBath
  split_ifs
  · exact div_nonneg (hw y).le
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun z _ => by split_ifs <;> simp [(hw z).le])
  · exact le_rfl

omit [DecidableEq Ω] in
/-- The heat-bath kernel of an equivalence relation is reversible for `w`. -/
theorem heatBath_detailedBalance {R : Ω → Ω → Prop} [DecidableRel R] (hR : Equivalence R)
    (w : Ω → ℝ) (x y : Ω) : w x * heatBath R w x y = w y * heatBath R w y x := by
  unfold heatBath
  by_cases hxy : R x y
  · have hZ : ∑ z, (if R x z then w z else 0) = ∑ z, (if R y z then w z else 0) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => by
        have : R x z ↔ R y z := ⟨hR.trans (hR.symm hxy), hR.trans hxy⟩
        simp only [this]
    simp only [hxy, hR.symm hxy, ite_true, hZ]
    ring
  · have hyx : ¬R y x := fun h => hxy (hR.symm h)
    simp [hxy, hyx]

omit [DecidableEq Ω] in
/-- The weights `w` are stationary for their heat-bath kernel. -/
theorem vecMul_heatBath {R : Ω → Ω → Prop} [DecidableRel R] (hR : Equivalence R)
    {w : Ω → ℝ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x) : w ᵥ* heatBath R w = w :=
  vecMul_eq_of_detailedBalance (sum_heatBath hR.refl hw) (heatBath_detailedBalance hR w)

end HeatBath

/-- The uniform average `n⁻¹ ∑ i, K i` of `n ≠ 0` kernels is a kernel. -/
lemma inv_natCast_smul_sum_mem_rowStochastic {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    {K : Fin n → Matrix Ω Ω ℝ} (hK : ∀ i, K i ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω) :
    (n : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, K i ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω := by
  simpa using inv_card_smul_sum_mem_rowStochastic hK

omit [DecidableEq Ω] in
/-- A vector stationary for each of `K i` is stationary for their average. -/
lemma vecMul_inv_card_smul_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] {K : ι → Matrix Ω Ω ℝ}
    {ν : Ω → ℝ} (hK : ∀ i, ν ᵥ* K i = ν) : ν ᵥ* ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, K i) = ν := by
  rw [Matrix.vecMul_smul, Matrix.vecMul_sum]
  simp only [hK, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_smul]
  rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 Fintype.card_ne_zero), one_smul]

omit [DecidableEq Ω] in
lemma vecMul_inv_natCast_smul_sum {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {K : Fin n → Matrix Ω Ω ℝ} {ν : Ω → ℝ}
    (hK : ∀ i, ν ᵥ* K i = ν) : ν ᵥ* ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, K i) = ν := by
  simpa using vecMul_inv_card_smul_sum hK

end MarkovChain

end

end TheoremOS.Probability

import Submission.Library.TheoremOS.Probability.SphereLaw

/-!
# Gaussian integration by parts

Stein's identity and its multivariate forms. Contents: for `X ~ gaussianReal μ v`,
`E[(X - μ) • f X] = v • E[f' X]` when `f` has derivative `f'` everywhere and the three integrals
exist (`integral_sub_smul_gaussianReal`, real form `integral_sub_mul_gaussianReal`), the case
`v = 0` included; the same with the integrability conditions replaced by polynomial growth bounds
`‖f x‖, ‖f' x‖ ≤ C (1 + ‖x‖)^k` (`_of_growth`, centred form
`integral_mul_gaussianReal_zero_of_growth`), using that polynomially bounded measurable functions
are integrable for every `IsGaussian` measure (`integrable_of_norm_le_poly`); the central moments
`E[(X - μ)^(n+2)] = (n+1) v E[(X - μ)^n]`, odd central moments `0` and
`E[(X - μ)^(2n)] = v^n ∏_{i<n} (2i+1)`; the derivative of `gaussianPDFReal`; for the standard
Gaussian `stdGaussian E` on a finite-dimensional inner product space,
`E[⟪x, u⟫ • f x] = E[f' x u]` for Fréchet-differentiable `f` (`integral_inner_smul_stdGaussian`,
with a polynomial-growth form); for independent coordinates
`Measure.pi fun j => gaussianReal 0 (v j)` on `ι → ℝ`,
`E[x i • f x] = v i • E[f' x (Pi.single i 1)]` (`integral_coord_smul_pi_gaussianReal`, zero
variances allowed, with a polynomial-growth form in the sup norm), via `pi_gaussianReal_eq_map`,
the product as the image of `stdGaussian` under the coordinatewise scaling `gaussianScale v`; for
an affine image `y = m + A x` of `stdGaussian`,
`E[⟪y - m, w⟫ • f y] = E[f' y (A (A† w))]`; and for `multivariateGaussian μ S` with `S`
positive semidefinite, `E[⟪y - μ, w⟫ • f y] = E[f' y (S w)]`.

Sources: C. M. Stein, "Estimation of the mean of a multivariate normal distribution", Ann.
Statist. 9 (1981), 1135–1151, Lemmas 1–2 (one-dimensional and multivariate identities);
I. Nourdin and G. Peccati, *Normal Approximations with Malliavin Calculus*, Cambridge University
Press, 2012, Chapters 3–4 (Stein's lemma, multivariate Gaussian integration by parts);
M. Talagrand, *Mean Field Models for Spin Glasses*, Vol. I, Springer, 2011, and D. Panchenko,
*The Sherrington–Kirkpatrick Model*, Springer, 2013, Chapter 1 (Gaussian integration by parts for
independent coordinates); P. Billingsley, *Probability and Measure*, 3rd ed., Wiley, 1995,
Section 21 (moments of the normal distribution). Textbook material; nothing here is specific to a
benchmark problem.

Bridges: a disorder law `Measure.pi fun _ : I => gaussianReal 0 σ` is the coordinate form with
`v := fun _ => σ`, so `simpa [disorderLaw] using integral_coord_mul_pi_gaussianReal_of_growth
(fun _ => σ) e hf hfb hf'b` gives `∫ W, W e * f W = σ * ∫ W, f' W (Pi.single e 1)`; definitions
such as `standardGaussian := gaussianReal 0 1` and `gaussianProduct ι := Measure.pi fun _ =>
standardGaussian` unfold the same way with `v := fun _ => 1`. A coordinate function `W ↦ W e` has
derivative `hasFDerivAt_apply e W` with `‖ContinuousLinearMap.proj e‖ ≤ 1` from
`ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound` and `norm_le_pi_norm`; for a differentiable `f` take
`f' := fderiv ℝ f` with `(hdiff x).hasFDerivAt`. For a shifted argument,
`∫ z, z * U (x + √s * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 = √s * ∫ z, U' (x + √s * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1` follows
from `integral_mul_gaussianReal_zero_of_growth` after first proving
`HasDerivAt (fun z => x + √s * z) √s z` with
`simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id' z).const_mul _).const_add x`
(composing directly leaves `√s * 1`). The growth forms do not cover exponentially growing
integrands such as partition functions, which need the integrable forms, and nested products
`Measure.pi fun _ => Measure.pi fun _ => …` must first be identified with a single product.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Probability

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Real Matrix
open scoped ENNReal NNReal RealInnerProductSpace MatrixOrder Matrix.Norms.L2Operator

noncomputable section

section Growth

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
  [SecondCountableTopology E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [NormedAddCommGroup F]

/-- Under a Gaussian law every function of polynomial growth is integrable. -/
lemma integrable_of_norm_le_poly (ν : Measure E) [IsGaussian ν] {g : E → F}
    (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g ν) {C : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hb : ∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k) :
    Integrable g ν := by
  have h1 : MemLp (fun x : E => ‖x‖) k ν :=
    (IsGaussian.memLp_id ν k (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top k)).norm
  have hm := (memLp_const (μ := ν) (p := (k : ℝ≥0∞)) (1 : ℝ)).add h1
  have hi : Integrable (fun x : E => (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k) ν := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
    · simp only [pow_zero]; exact integrable_const 1
    · refine (hm.integrable_norm_pow hk.ne').congr (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + ‖x‖)]
  exact (hi.const_mul C).mono' hg (ae_of_all _ hb)

end Growth

section Real

variable {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F] {μ : ℝ} {v : ℝ≥0}

/-- The Gaussian density solves `p' = -((x - μ) / v) p`. -/
lemma hasDerivAt_gaussianPDFReal (μ : ℝ) (v : ℝ≥0) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (gaussianPDFReal μ v) (-((x - μ) / v) * gaussianPDFReal μ v x) x := by
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun y => -(y - μ) ^ 2 / (2 * (v : ℝ))) (-(2 * (x - μ)) / (2 * v)) x := by
    have := ((hasDerivAt_id x).sub_const μ).pow 2
    simpa using (this.neg).div_const (2 * (v : ℝ))
  have h2 := (h.exp).const_mul (√(2 * π * v))⁻¹
  rw [gaussianPDFReal_def]
  convert h2 using 1
  by_cases hv : (v : ℝ) = 0
  · simp [hv]
  · field_simp

omit [CompleteSpace F] in
lemma integrable_gaussianReal_iff (hv : v ≠ 0) {f : ℝ → F} :
    Integrable f (gaussianReal μ v) ↔ Integrable (fun x => gaussianPDFReal μ v x • f x) := by
  rw [gaussianReal_of_var_ne_zero _ hv,
    integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul' (measurable_gaussianPDF μ v)
      (ae_of_all _ fun _ => gaussianPDF_lt_top)]
  simp [gaussianPDF, gaussianPDFReal_nonneg]

/-- **Stein's identity** for `N(μ, v)`: `E[(X - μ) f(X)] = v E[f'(X)]`, for `f` with derivative
`f'` such that `f`, `(x - μ) • f x` and `f'` are integrable. The case `v = 0` is the Dirac mass. -/
theorem integral_sub_smul_gaussianReal {f f' : ℝ → F} (hf : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    (hfi : Integrable f (gaussianReal μ v))
    (hxf : Integrable (fun x => (x - μ) • f x) (gaussianReal μ v))
    (hf' : Integrable f' (gaussianReal μ v)) :
    ∫ x, (x - μ) • f x ∂gaussianReal μ v = (v : ℝ) • ∫ x, f' x ∂gaussianReal μ v := by
  by_cases hv : v = 0
  · rw [hv, gaussianReal_zero_var, integral_dirac]
    simp
  have hv' : (v : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hv
  rw [integrable_gaussianReal_iff hv] at hfi hxf hf'
  rw [integral_gaussianReal_eq_integral_smul hv, integral_gaussianReal_eq_integral_smul hv]
  have hp' : Integrable fun x =>
      ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ (-((x - μ) / v) * gaussianPDFReal μ v x) (f x) := by
    refine (hxf.smul (-(v : ℝ)⁻¹)).congr (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    ring
  have h := integral_bilinear_hasDerivAt_right_eq_neg_left_of_integrable
    (L := ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) (u := gaussianPDFReal μ v) (v := f)
    (u' := fun x => -((x - μ) / v) * gaussianPDFReal μ v x) (v' := f')
    (fun x _ => hasDerivAt_gaussianPDFReal μ v x) (fun x _ => hf x)
    (by simpa using hf') hp' (by simpa using hfi)
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply] at h
  have h3 : ∫ x, gaussianPDFReal μ v x • (x - μ) • f x =
      -(v : ℝ) • ∫ x, (-((x - μ) / v) * gaussianPDFReal μ v x) • f x := by
    rw [← integral_smul]
    congr 1
    funext x
    rw [smul_smul, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  rw [h3, h, smul_neg, neg_smul]

/-- Real-valued Stein identity: `∫ (x - μ) f(x) = v ∫ f'(x)` under `N(μ, v)`. -/
theorem integral_sub_mul_gaussianReal {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    (hfi : Integrable f (gaussianReal μ v))
    (hxf : Integrable (fun x => (x - μ) * f x) (gaussianReal μ v))
    (hf' : Integrable f' (gaussianReal μ v)) :
    ∫ x, (x - μ) * f x ∂gaussianReal μ v = v * ∫ x, f' x ∂gaussianReal μ v :=
  integral_sub_smul_gaussianReal hf hfi hxf hf'

omit [CompleteSpace F] in
lemma norm_sub_smul_le {f : ℝ → F} {C : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k)
    (x : ℝ) : ‖(x - μ) • f x‖ ≤ (1 + ‖μ‖) * C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (k + 1) := by
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by simpa using (norm_nonneg _).trans (hb 0)
  have h1 : ‖x - μ‖ ≤ (1 + ‖μ‖) * (1 + ‖x‖) := by
    nlinarith [norm_sub_le x μ, norm_nonneg x, norm_nonneg μ,
      mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg x) (norm_nonneg μ)]
  rw [norm_smul]
  calc ‖x - μ‖ * ‖f x‖ ≤ ((1 + ‖μ‖) * (1 + ‖x‖)) * (C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k) :=
        mul_le_mul h1 (hb x) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    _ = (1 + ‖μ‖) * C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (k + 1) := by ring

/-- Stein's identity for `N(μ, v)` when `f` and `f'` grow at most polynomially; the integrability
side conditions are discharged automatically. -/
theorem integral_sub_smul_gaussianReal_of_growth {f f' : ℝ → F} (hf : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    {C : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k)
    (hf'b : ∀ x, ‖f' x‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k) :
    ∫ x, (x - μ) • f x ∂gaussianReal μ v = (v : ℝ) • ∫ x, f' x ∂gaussianReal μ v := by
  have hc : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hf x).continuousAt
  have hd : f' = deriv f := funext fun x => (hf x).deriv.symm
  have hm' : AEStronglyMeasurable f' (gaussianReal μ v) := by
    rw [hd]; exact aestronglyMeasurable_deriv f _
  refine integral_sub_smul_gaussianReal hf
    (integrable_of_norm_le_poly _ hc.aestronglyMeasurable hfb) ?_
    (integrable_of_norm_le_poly _ hm' hf'b)
  exact integrable_of_norm_le_poly _ (by fun_prop) (norm_sub_smul_le hfb)

/-- Centred Stein identity `E[X f(X)] = v E[f'(X)]` for `X ~ N(0, v)` and real `f`, `f'` of
polynomial growth. -/
theorem integral_mul_gaussianReal_zero_of_growth {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    {C : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k)
    (hf'b : ∀ x, ‖f' x‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k) :
    ∫ x, x * f x ∂gaussianReal 0 v = v * ∫ x, f' x ∂gaussianReal 0 v := by
  simpa using integral_sub_smul_gaussianReal_of_growth (μ := 0) (v := v) hf hfb hf'b

lemma integrable_sub_pow_gaussianReal (n : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x => (x - μ) ^ n) (gaussianReal μ v) := by
  have h : MemLp (fun x : ℝ => x - μ) n (gaussianReal μ v) :=
    (memLp_id_gaussianReal n).sub (memLp_const μ)
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · simp
  · exact (h.integrable_norm_pow hn.ne').mono'
      (by fun_prop : Continuous fun x : ℝ => (x - μ) ^ n).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => (norm_pow _ _).le)

/-- Central moment recursion: `E[(X - μ)^(n+2)] = (n+1) v E[(X - μ)^n]` under `N(μ, v)`. -/
theorem integral_sub_pow_add_two_gaussianReal (n : ℕ) :
    ∫ x, (x - μ) ^ (n + 2) ∂gaussianReal μ v =
      (n + 1) * v * ∫ x, (x - μ) ^ n ∂gaussianReal μ v := by
  have hd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => (y - μ) ^ (n + 1)) ((n + 1 : ℝ) * (x - μ) ^ n) x := by
    intro x
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id' x).sub_const μ).fun_pow (n + 1)
  have h := integral_sub_mul_gaussianReal (μ := μ) (v := v) hd
    (integrable_sub_pow_gaussianReal (n + 1))
    ((integrable_sub_pow_gaussianReal (n + 2)).congr (ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      show (x - μ) ^ (n + 2) = (x - μ) * (x - μ) ^ (n + 1); ring))
    ((integrable_sub_pow_gaussianReal n).const_mul _)
  have hl : ∫ x, (x - μ) ^ (n + 2) ∂gaussianReal μ v =
      ∫ x, (x - μ) * (x - μ) ^ (n + 1) ∂gaussianReal μ v := by
    congr 1; funext x; ring
  rw [hl, h, integral_const_mul]
  ring

theorem integral_sub_pow_odd_gaussianReal (n : ℕ) :
    ∫ x, (x - μ) ^ (2 * n + 1) ∂gaussianReal μ v = 0 := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [mul_zero, zero_add, pow_one]
    have hi : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x) (gaussianReal μ v) :=
      (memLp_id_gaussianReal 1).integrable le_rfl
    rw [integral_sub hi (integrable_const μ)]
    simp [integral_id_gaussianReal]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [show 2 * (n + 1) + 1 = 2 * n + 1 + 2 by ring, integral_sub_pow_add_two_gaussianReal, ih,
      mul_zero]

/-- Even central moments: `E[(X - μ)^(2n)] = v^n ∏_{i<n} (2i+1) = v^n (2n-1)!!`. -/
theorem integral_sub_pow_even_gaussianReal (n : ℕ) :
    ∫ x, (x - μ) ^ (2 * n) ∂gaussianReal μ v =
      (v : ℝ) ^ n * ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (2 * (i : ℝ) + 1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 2 by ring, integral_sub_pow_add_two_gaussianReal, ih,
      Finset.prod_range_succ]
    push_cast
    ring

end Real

section Std

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] in
/-- The standard Gaussian density `φ` satisfies `∇φ(x) = -φ(x) x`. -/
lemma hasFDerivAt_gaussianDensity (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (gaussianDensity E) (-gaussianDensity E x • innerSL ℝ x) x := by
  have h1 := (((hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq x).hasFDerivAt.const_mul (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))).exp).const_mul
    ((2 * π) ^ ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) / 2))⁻¹
  have he : gaussianDensity E =
      fun y => ((2 * π) ^ ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) / 2))⁻¹ *
        Real.exp (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖y‖ ^ 2) := by
    funext y; rw [gaussianDensity]; congr 2; ring
  rw [he]
  convert h1 using 1
  ext u
  simp
  ring

lemma integral_stdGaussian_eq_integral_smul (g : E → F) :
    ∫ x, g x ∂stdGaussian E = ∫ x, gaussianDensity E x • g x := by
  rw [stdGaussian_eq_withDensity, integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul
    continuous_gaussianDensity.measurable.ennreal_ofReal
      (ae_of_all _ fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
  simp [gaussianDensity_nonneg]

lemma integrable_stdGaussian_iff {g : E → F} :
    Integrable g (stdGaussian E) ↔ Integrable (fun x => gaussianDensity E x • g x) := by
  rw [stdGaussian_eq_withDensity, integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul'
    continuous_gaussianDensity.measurable.ennreal_ofReal
      (ae_of_all _ fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
  simp [gaussianDensity_nonneg]

/-- **Gaussian integration by parts** on a finite-dimensional inner product space:
`E[⟪X, u⟫ f(X)] = E[f'(X) u]` for `X` standard Gaussian, when `f`, `⟪x, u⟫ • f x` and `f' x u`
are integrable. -/
theorem integral_inner_smul_stdGaussian {f : E → F} {f' : E → E →L[ℝ] F} (u : E)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (f' x) x) (hfi : Integrable f (stdGaussian E))
    (hxf : Integrable (fun x => ⟪x, u⟫ • f x) (stdGaussian E))
    (hf' : Integrable (fun x => f' x u) (stdGaussian E)) :
    ∫ x, ⟪x, u⟫ • f x ∂stdGaussian E = ∫ x, f' x u ∂stdGaussian E := by
  rw [integrable_stdGaussian_iff] at hfi hxf hf'
  rw [integral_stdGaussian_eq_integral_smul, integral_stdGaussian_eq_integral_smul]
  have hp' : Integrable fun x => ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ
      ((-gaussianDensity E x • innerSL ℝ x) u) (f x) := by
    refine hxf.neg.congr (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
    simp [smul_smul]
  have h := integral_bilinear_hasFDerivAt_right_eq_neg_left_of_integrable
    (B := ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) (f := gaussianDensity E) (g := f) (v := u)
    (f' := fun x => -gaussianDensity E x • innerSL ℝ x) (g' := f')
    hp' (by simpa using hf') (by simpa using hfi)
    (fun x _ => hasFDerivAt_gaussianDensity x) (fun x _ => hf x)
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply] at h
  rw [h, ← integral_neg]
  congr 1
  funext x
  simp [smul_smul]

/-- Real-valued Gaussian integration by parts: `∫ ⟪x, u⟫ f(x) = ∫ f'(x) u`. -/
theorem integral_inner_mul_stdGaussian {f : E → ℝ} {f' : E → E →L[ℝ] ℝ} (u : E)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (f' x) x) (hfi : Integrable f (stdGaussian E))
    (hxf : Integrable (fun x => ⟪x, u⟫ * f x) (stdGaussian E))
    (hf' : Integrable (fun x => f' x u) (stdGaussian E)) :
    ∫ x, ⟪x, u⟫ * f x ∂stdGaussian E = ∫ x, f' x u ∂stdGaussian E :=
  integral_inner_smul_stdGaussian u hf hfi hxf hf'

/-- Gaussian integration by parts for real `f` whose value and derivative grow at most
polynomially, `|f x| ≤ C (1 + ‖x‖)^k` and `‖f' x‖ ≤ C (1 + ‖x‖)^k`. -/
theorem integral_inner_mul_stdGaussian_of_growth {f : E → ℝ} {f' : E → E →L[ℝ] ℝ} (u : E)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (f' x) x) {C : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k)
    (hf'b : ∀ x, ‖f' x‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k) :
    ∫ x, ⟪x, u⟫ * f x ∂stdGaussian E = ∫ x, f' x u ∂stdGaussian E := by
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by simpa using (norm_nonneg _).trans (hfb 0)
  have hc : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hf x).continuousAt
  have hd : (fun x => f' x u) = fun x => fderiv ℝ f x u := funext fun x => by rw [(hf x).fderiv]
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => f' x u) (stdGaussian E) := by
    rw [hd]; exact (measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ f u).aestronglyMeasurable
  refine integral_inner_mul_stdGaussian u hf
    (integrable_of_norm_le_poly _ hc.aestronglyMeasurable hfb) ?_
    (integrable_of_norm_le_poly _ hm (C := ‖u‖ * C) (k := k) fun x => ?_)
  · refine integrable_of_norm_le_poly _ (by fun_prop) (C := ‖u‖ * C) (k := k + 1) fun x => ?_
    rw [norm_mul]
    calc ‖⟪x, u⟫‖ * ‖f x‖ ≤ (‖u‖ * (1 + ‖x‖)) * (C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k) := by
          refine mul_le_mul ?_ (hfb x) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          rw [real_inner_comm]
          refine (norm_inner_le_norm u x).trans ?_
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith [norm_nonneg x]) (norm_nonneg u)
      _ = ‖u‖ * C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (k + 1) := by ring
  · calc ‖f' x u‖ ≤ ‖f' x‖ * ‖u‖ := (f' x).le_opNorm u
      _ ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k * ‖u‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hf'b x) (norm_nonneg u)
      _ = ‖u‖ * C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k := by ring

end Std

section Pi

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

/-- Coordinatewise scaling `z ↦ (√(v i) z i)ᵢ` from `EuclideanSpace ℝ ι` to `ι → ℝ`. -/
def gaussianScale (v : ι → ℝ≥0) : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →L[ℝ] (ι → ℝ) :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun i => √(v i : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.proj i

omit [Fintype ι] in
lemma gaussianScale_apply (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (i : ι) :
    gaussianScale v z i = √(v i : ℝ) * z i := rfl

omit [Fintype ι] in
lemma gaussianScale_single [DecidableEq ι] (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (i : ι) :
    gaussianScale v (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) = √(v i : ℝ) • Pi.single i 1 := by
  funext j
  rw [gaussianScale_apply]
  by_cases h : j = i
  · subst h; simp
  · simp [h]

/-- A product of centred real Gaussians is the image of the standard Gaussian under coordinatewise
scaling. -/
lemma pi_gaussianReal_eq_map (v : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    Measure.pi (fun i => gaussianReal 0 (v i)) =
      (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).map (gaussianScale v) := by
  rw [← map_pi_eq_stdGaussian, Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  have hc : (gaussianScale v ∘ WithLp.toLp 2) = fun (x : ι → ℝ) i => √(v i : ℝ) * x i := rfl
  rw [hc]
  have h := Measure.pi_map_pi (μ := fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1)
    (f := fun i (t : ℝ) => √(v i : ℝ) * t) (fun i => by fun_prop)
  rw [h]
  congr 1
  funext i
  rw [gaussianReal_map_const_mul]
  congr 1
  · simp
  · ext; simp

instance isGaussian_pi_gaussianReal (v : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    IsGaussian (Measure.pi fun i => gaussianReal 0 (v i)) := by
  rw [pi_gaussianReal_eq_map]; infer_instance

/-- **Gaussian integration by parts for independent coordinates**: if `x` has independent
`N(0, v j)` coordinates then `E[x i f(x)] = v i E[∂ᵢ f(x)]`, where `∂ᵢ f(x) = f' x (Pi.single i 1)`.
The case `v i = 0` is included. -/
theorem integral_coord_smul_pi_gaussianReal [DecidableEq ι] (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (i : ι)
    {f : (ι → ℝ) → F} {f' : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F} (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    (hfi : Integrable f (Measure.pi fun j => gaussianReal 0 (v j)))
    (hxf : Integrable (fun x => x i • f x) (Measure.pi fun j => gaussianReal 0 (v j)))
    (hf' : Integrable (fun x => f' x (Pi.single i 1)) (Measure.pi fun j => gaussianReal 0 (v j))) :
    ∫ x, x i • f x ∂Measure.pi (fun j => gaussianReal 0 (v j)) =
      (v i : ℝ) • ∫ x, f' x (Pi.single i 1) ∂Measure.pi (fun j => gaussianReal 0 (v j)) := by
  rw [pi_gaussianReal_eq_map] at hfi hxf hf' ⊢
  have hT : AEMeasurable (gaussianScale v) (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) := by fun_prop
  rw [integral_map hT hxf.aestronglyMeasurable, integral_map hT hf'.aestronglyMeasurable]
  have hfi₀ := (integrable_map_measure hfi.aestronglyMeasurable hT).1 hfi
  have hxf₀ := (integrable_map_measure hxf.aestronglyMeasurable hT).1 hxf
  have hf'₀ := (integrable_map_measure hf'.aestronglyMeasurable hT).1 hf'
  by_cases hv : v i = 0
  · simp [gaussianScale_apply, hv]
  have hc : √(v i : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, Real.sqrt_eq_zero (NNReal.coe_nonneg _)]; exact_mod_cast hv
  have hH : ∀ z, HasFDerivAt (fun z => f (gaussianScale v z))
      ((f' (gaussianScale v z)).comp (gaussianScale v)) z :=
    fun z => (hf _).comp z (gaussianScale v).hasFDerivAt
  have hxf₁ : Integrable (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι =>
      ⟪z, EuclideanSpace.single i 1⟫ • f (gaussianScale v z)) (stdGaussian _) := by
    refine (hxf₀.smul (√(v i : ℝ))⁻¹).congr (ae_of_all _ fun z => ?_)
    simp [gaussianScale_apply, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, smul_smul, hc]
  have hf'₁ : Integrable (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι =>
      ((f' (gaussianScale v z)).comp (gaussianScale v)) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))
      (stdGaussian _) := by
    refine (hf'₀.smul (√(v i : ℝ))).congr (ae_of_all _ fun z => ?_)
    simp [gaussianScale_single]
  have key := integral_inner_smul_stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) hH hfi₀ hxf₁ hf'₁
  calc ∫ z, gaussianScale v z i • f (gaussianScale v z) ∂stdGaussian _
      = √(v i : ℝ) • ∫ z, ⟪z, EuclideanSpace.single i 1⟫ • f (gaussianScale v z)
          ∂stdGaussian _ := by
        rw [← integral_smul]; congr 1; funext z
        simp [gaussianScale_apply, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, smul_smul]
    _ = √(v i : ℝ) • ∫ z, ((f' (gaussianScale v z)).comp (gaussianScale v))
          (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) ∂stdGaussian _ := by rw [key]
    _ = (v i : ℝ) • ∫ z, f' (gaussianScale v z) (Pi.single i 1) ∂stdGaussian _ := by
        rw [← integral_smul, ← integral_smul]; congr 1; funext z
        simp [gaussianScale_single, smul_smul, Real.mul_self_sqrt]

/-- Real-valued form: `E[x i f(x)] = v i E[∂ᵢ f(x)]` for independent `N(0, v j)` coordinates. -/
theorem integral_coord_mul_pi_gaussianReal [DecidableEq ι] (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (i : ι)
    {f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ} {f' : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    (hfi : Integrable f (Measure.pi fun j => gaussianReal 0 (v j)))
    (hxf : Integrable (fun x => x i * f x) (Measure.pi fun j => gaussianReal 0 (v j)))
    (hf' : Integrable (fun x => f' x (Pi.single i 1)) (Measure.pi fun j => gaussianReal 0 (v j))) :
    ∫ x, x i * f x ∂Measure.pi (fun j => gaussianReal 0 (v j)) =
      v i * ∫ x, f' x (Pi.single i 1) ∂Measure.pi (fun j => gaussianReal 0 (v j)) :=
  integral_coord_smul_pi_gaussianReal v i hf hfi hxf hf'

/-- The coordinate identity when `f` and `f'` grow at most polynomially (sup norm on `ι → ℝ`). -/
theorem integral_coord_mul_pi_gaussianReal_of_growth [DecidableEq ι] (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (i : ι)
    {f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ} {f' : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    {C : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k)
    (hf'b : ∀ x, ‖f' x‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k) :
    ∫ x, x i * f x ∂Measure.pi (fun j => gaussianReal 0 (v j)) =
      v i * ∫ x, f' x (Pi.single i 1) ∂Measure.pi (fun j => gaussianReal 0 (v j)) := by
  have hc : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hf x).continuousAt
  have hd : (fun x => f' x (Pi.single i 1)) = fun x => fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single i 1) :=
    funext fun x => by rw [(hf x).fderiv]
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => f' x (Pi.single i 1))
      (Measure.pi fun j => gaussianReal 0 (v j)) := by
    rw [hd]; exact (measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ f _).aestronglyMeasurable
  refine integral_coord_mul_pi_gaussianReal v i hf
    (integrable_of_norm_le_poly _ hc.aestronglyMeasurable hfb) ?_
    (integrable_of_norm_le_poly _ hm (C := C * ‖(Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℝ)‖) (k := k) fun x => ?_)
  · refine integrable_of_norm_le_poly _ (by fun_prop) (C := C) (k := k + 1) fun x => ?_
    rw [norm_mul]
    calc ‖x i‖ * ‖f x‖ ≤ (1 + ‖x‖) * (C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k) :=
          mul_le_mul ((norm_le_pi_norm x i).trans (by linarith [norm_nonneg x])) (hfb x)
            (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (k + 1) := by ring
  · calc ‖f' x (Pi.single i 1)‖ ≤ ‖f' x‖ * ‖(Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℝ)‖ := (f' x).le_opNorm _
      _ ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k * ‖(Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℝ)‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hf'b x) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = C * ‖(Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℝ)‖ * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k := by ring

end Pi

section Affine

variable {E G F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace ℝ G]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
  [NormedSpace ℝ F]

/-- Gaussian integration by parts for an affine image `y = m + A x` of the standard Gaussian, whose
covariance is `A A†`: `E[⟪y - m, w⟫ f(y)] = E[f'(y) (A A† w)]`. -/
theorem integral_inner_sub_smul_map_stdGaussian (A : E →L[ℝ] G) (m w : G) {f : G → F}
    {f' : G → G →L[ℝ] F} (hf : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt f (f' y) y)
    (hfi : Integrable f ((stdGaussian E).map fun x => m + A x))
    (hxf : Integrable (fun y => ⟪y - m, w⟫ • f y) ((stdGaussian E).map fun x => m + A x))
    (hf' : Integrable (fun y => f' y (A (A.adjoint w))) ((stdGaussian E).map fun x => m + A x)) :
    ∫ y, ⟪y - m, w⟫ • f y ∂(stdGaussian E).map (fun x => m + A x) =
      ∫ y, f' y (A (A.adjoint w)) ∂(stdGaussian E).map (fun x => m + A x) := by
  have hT : AEMeasurable (fun x => m + A x) (stdGaussian E) := by fun_prop
  rw [integral_map hT hxf.aestronglyMeasurable, integral_map hT hf'.aestronglyMeasurable]
  have hfi₀ := (integrable_map_measure hfi.aestronglyMeasurable hT).1 hfi
  have hxf₀ := (integrable_map_measure hxf.aestronglyMeasurable hT).1 hxf
  have hf'₀ := (integrable_map_measure hf'.aestronglyMeasurable hT).1 hf'
  have hH : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt (fun x => f (m + A x)) ((f' (m + A x)).comp A) x :=
    fun x => (hf _).comp x (A.hasFDerivAt.const_add m)
  have hxf₁ : Integrable (fun x => ⟪x, A.adjoint w⟫ • f (m + A x)) (stdGaussian E) :=
    hxf₀.congr (ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      simp [Function.comp, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right])
  have key := integral_inner_smul_stdGaussian (A.adjoint w) hH hfi₀ hxf₁ hf'₀
  simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right] using key

/-- Gaussian integration by parts for `multivariateGaussian μ S` with `S` positive semidefinite:
`E[⟪y - μ, w⟫ f(y)] = E[f'(y) (S w)]`; for `w = e_i` this is
`E[(y_i - μ_i) f(y)] = ∑_j S i j E[∂_j f(y)]`. -/
theorem integral_inner_sub_smul_multivariateGaussian {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {μ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {S : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hS : S.PosSemidef) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → F} {f' : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →L[ℝ] F}
    (hf : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt f (f' y) y) (hfi : Integrable f (multivariateGaussian μ S))
    (hxf : Integrable (fun y => ⟪y - μ, w⟫ • f y) (multivariateGaussian μ S))
    (hf' : Integrable (fun y => f' y (toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) S w)) (multivariateGaussian μ S)) :
    ∫ y, ⟪y - μ, w⟫ • f y ∂multivariateGaussian μ S =
      ∫ y, f' y (toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) S w) ∂multivariateGaussian μ S := by
  have hA : (toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (CFC.sqrt S))
      ((toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (CFC.sqrt S)).adjoint w) = toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) S w := by
    rw [IsSelfAdjoint.adjoint_eq ((CFC.sqrt_nonneg S).isSelfAdjoint.map _),
      ← ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ← ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ← map_mul,
      CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self _ hS.nonneg]
  rw [← hA] at hf' ⊢
  exact integral_inner_sub_smul_map_stdGaussian _ μ w hf hfi hxf hf'

end Affine
end

end TheoremOS.Probability
