import Submission.Library.TheoremOS.Probability.FiniteProbability

/-!
# The Lovász Local Lemma

The finite-weight **Lovász Local Lemma** in its lopsided asymmetric form, its symmetric
corollary, and the product-measure bridge that supplies its dependency hypothesis. Contents:
`avoid A T`, the outcomes in none of the events `A i` with `i ∈ T`; the **lopsided dependency**
condition `IsLopsidedDependency A p N`: `P(A i ∩ avoid T) ≤ P(A i) P(avoid T)` whenever `T` misses
`i` and its neighbourhood `N i`; the **asymmetric LLL**: if `0 ≤ x i < 1` and
`P(A i) ≤ x i ∏_{j ∈ N i} (1 - x j)`, then `P(no A i) ≥ ∏ (1 - x i) > 0`, so some outcome avoids
every event; the conditional form `P(A i ∩ avoid T) ≤ x i P(avoid T)` that drives it; the
**symmetric LLL**: `e q (d + 1) ≤ 1` with `P(A i) ≤ q` and `|N i| ≤ d` suffices; the estimate
`exp (-1) ≤ (1 - 1/(d+1))^d`; and for a **product measure** on `κ → α`, independence of events
determined by disjoint coordinate sets, which gives lopsided dependency for events with
variable sets `vbl i` when `N i` contains every `j ≠ i` whose variables meet `vbl i`.

Sources: P. Erdős and L. Lovász, Problems and results on 3-chromatic hypergraphs and some related
questions (1975); J. Spencer, Asymptotic lower bounds for Ramsey functions, Discrete Math. 20
(1977); N. Alon and J. Spencer, *The Probabilistic Method*, 4th ed., Wiley, 2016, Chapter 5
(Lemma 5.1.1, Corollary 5.1.2). Textbook material; nothing here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: outcomes are a `Fintype Ω` with weights `p : Ω → ℝ` (`IsDistribution p`); events are
`A : ι → Finset Ω` and a neighbourhood is `N : ι → Finset ι`. For random assignments
`ω : κ → α` with independent coordinates of law `μ`, `p = productWeight μ`; an event that only
reads the coordinates in `V` is `DependsOn A V`, and `isLopsidedDependency_of_dependsOn` turns
a variable-set description into the dependency hypothesis.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Probability

open Finset
open TheoremOS.InformationTheory
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

section Avoid

variable {ι Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]

/-- The outcomes in none of the events `A i`, `i ∈ T`. -/
def avoid (A : ι → Finset Ω) (T : Finset ι) : Finset Ω := {ω | ∀ i ∈ T, ω ∉ A i}

variable (A : ι → Finset Ω)

lemma mem_avoid {T : Finset ι} {ω : Ω} : ω ∈ avoid A T ↔ ∀ i ∈ T, ω ∉ A i := by
  simp [avoid]

@[simp] lemma avoid_empty : avoid A ∅ = Finset.univ := by
  ext ω
  simp [mem_avoid]

lemma avoid_anti {T T' : Finset ι} (h : T ⊆ T') : avoid A T' ⊆ avoid A T := fun _ hω =>
  (mem_avoid A).2 fun i hi => (mem_avoid A).1 hω i (h hi)

/-- **Lopsided dependency**: avoiding events outside the neighbourhood `N i` does not make
`A i` more likely. -/
def IsLopsidedDependency (p : Ω → ℝ) (N : ι → Finset ι) : Prop :=
  ∀ i (T : Finset ι), Disjoint T (N i) → i ∉ T →
    prob p (A i ∩ avoid A T) ≤ prob p (A i) * prob p (avoid A T)

variable [DecidableEq ι]

lemma avoid_insert (a : ι) (T : Finset ι) : avoid A (insert a T) = avoid A T \ A a := by
  ext ω
  simp only [mem_avoid, Finset.forall_mem_insert, Finset.mem_sdiff]
  exact and_comm

lemma prob_avoid_insert (p : Ω → ℝ) (a : ι) (T : Finset ι) :
    prob p (avoid A (insert a T)) = prob p (avoid A T) - prob p (A a ∩ avoid A T) := by
  rw [avoid_insert]
  have h := Finset.sum_union (f := p) (Finset.disjoint_sdiff_inter (avoid A T) (A a))
  rw [Finset.sdiff_union_inter] at h
  rw [Finset.inter_comm]
  simp only [prob]
  linarith

end Avoid

section LLL

variable {ι Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [DecidableEq ι] {A : ι → Finset Ω}
  {p : Ω → ℝ} {x : ι → ℝ}

/-- Peeling: if each `j ∈ S` satisfies `P(A j ∩ avoid W) ≤ x j P(avoid W)` for the sets `W`
between `U` and `U ∪ S` missing `j`, then `P(avoid (U ∪ S)) ≥ ∏_{S} (1 - x) P(avoid U)`. -/
theorem prod_mul_prob_avoid_le (hx1 : ∀ i, x i ≤ 1) {U S : Finset ι} (hUS : Disjoint U S)
    (hS : ∀ j ∈ S, ∀ W, U ⊆ W → W ⊆ U ∪ S → j ∉ W →
      prob p (A j ∩ avoid A W) ≤ x j * prob p (avoid A W)) :
    (∏ j ∈ S, (1 - x j)) * prob p (avoid A U) ≤ prob p (avoid A (U ∪ S)) := by
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a S ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.disjoint_insert_right] at hUS
    have ih' := ih hUS.2 fun j hj W hUW hWS hjW =>
      hS j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj) W hUW
        (hWS.trans (Finset.union_subset_union_right (Finset.subset_insert a S))) hjW
    have haW : a ∉ U ∪ S := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_union, not_or]
      exact ⟨hUS.1, ha⟩
    have h1 := hS a (Finset.mem_insert_self a S) (U ∪ S) Finset.subset_union_left
      (Finset.union_subset_union_right (Finset.subset_insert a S)) haW
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.union_insert, prob_avoid_insert]
    have h0 : 0 ≤ 1 - x a := sub_nonneg.2 (hx1 a)
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih' h0
    nlinarith

/-- The conditional form of the **Lovász Local Lemma**: `P(A i ∩ avoid T) ≤ x i P(avoid T)`
for every `T` missing `i`. -/
theorem prob_inter_avoid_le (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) {N : ι → Finset ι}
    (hdep : IsLopsidedDependency A p N) (hx0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hx1 : ∀ i, x i ≤ 1)
    (hA : ∀ i, prob p (A i) ≤ x i * ∏ j ∈ N i, (1 - x j)) (i : ι) (T : Finset ι)
    (hiT : i ∉ T) : prob p (A i ∩ avoid A T) ≤ x i * prob p (avoid A T) := by
  induction T using Finset.strongInduction generalizing i with
  | H T ih =>
  have hdisj : Disjoint (T \ N i) (T ∩ N i) := Finset.disjoint_sdiff_inter T (N i)
  have hpeel := prod_mul_prob_avoid_le (A := A) (p := p) hx1 hdisj fun j hj W hUW hWS hjW => by
    have hWT : W ⊆ T := hWS.trans (by rw [Finset.sdiff_union_inter])
    have hWne : W ≠ T := fun h => hjW (h ▸ (Finset.mem_inter.1 hj).1)
    exact ih W (Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.2 ⟨hWT, hWne⟩) j hjW
  rw [Finset.sdiff_union_inter] at hpeel
  have hprod : ∏ j ∈ N i, (1 - x j) ≤ ∏ j ∈ T ∩ N i, (1 - x j) := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_sdiff (Finset.inter_subset_right (s₁ := T))]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left
      (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => sub_nonneg.2 (hx1 j))
      (Finset.prod_le_one₀ (fun j _ => sub_nonneg.2 (hx1 j))
        fun j _ => sub_le_self _ (hx0 j))
  have hU : Disjoint (T \ N i) (N i) := Finset.sdiff_disjoint
  have hiU : i ∉ T \ N i := fun h => hiT (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 h).1
  have hQ := prob_nonneg hp (avoid A (T \ N i))
  calc prob p (A i ∩ avoid A T) ≤ prob p (A i ∩ avoid A (T \ N i)) :=
        prob_mono hp (Finset.inter_subset_inter le_rfl (avoid_anti A Finset.sdiff_subset))
    _ ≤ prob p (A i) * prob p (avoid A (T \ N i)) := hdep i _ hU hiU
    _ ≤ x i * (∏ j ∈ T ∩ N i, (1 - x j)) * prob p (avoid A (T \ N i)) := by
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((hA i).trans ?_) hQ
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (hx0 i)
    _ ≤ x i * prob p (avoid A T) := by
        rw [mul_assoc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpeel (hx0 i)

/-- The asymmetric **Lovász Local Lemma** (lopsided form): if `0 ≤ x i ≤ 1` and
`P(A i) ≤ x i ∏_{j ∈ N i} (1 - x j)`, then `P(avoid T) ≥ ∏_{i ∈ T} (1 - x i)`. -/
theorem prod_le_prob_avoid (hp : IsDistribution p) {N : ι → Finset ι}
    (hdep : IsLopsidedDependency A p N) (hx0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hx1 : ∀ i, x i ≤ 1)
    (hA : ∀ i, prob p (A i) ≤ x i * ∏ j ∈ N i, (1 - x j)) (T : Finset ι) :
    ∏ i ∈ T, (1 - x i) ≤ prob p (avoid A T) := by
  have h := prod_mul_prob_avoid_le (A := A) (p := p) hx1 (Finset.disjoint_empty_left T)
    fun j _ W _ _ hjW => prob_inter_avoid_le hp.nonneg hdep hx0 hx1 hA j W hjW
  rwa [avoid_empty, prob_univ hp, mul_one, Finset.empty_union] at h

/-- With `x i < 1` the events are avoided simultaneously with positive weight. -/
theorem prob_avoid_pos (hp : IsDistribution p) {N : ι → Finset ι}
    (hdep : IsLopsidedDependency A p N) (hx0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hx1 : ∀ i, x i < 1)
    (hA : ∀ i, prob p (A i) ≤ x i * ∏ j ∈ N i, (1 - x j)) (T : Finset ι) :
    0 < prob p (avoid A T) :=
  (Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => sub_pos.2 (hx1 i)).trans_le
    (prod_le_prob_avoid hp hdep hx0 (fun i => (hx1 i).le) hA T)

/-- Under the hypotheses of the Local Lemma some outcome lies in none of the `A i`, `i ∈ T`. -/
theorem exists_forall_not_mem_of_lll (hp : IsDistribution p) {N : ι → Finset ι}
    (hdep : IsLopsidedDependency A p N) (hx0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hx1 : ∀ i, x i < 1)
    (hA : ∀ i, prob p (A i) ≤ x i * ∏ j ∈ N i, (1 - x j)) (T : Finset ι) :
    ∃ ω, ∀ i ∈ T, ω ∉ A i := by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ := Finset.nonempty_of_sum_ne_zero (prob_avoid_pos hp hdep hx0 hx1 hA T).ne'
  exact ⟨ω, (mem_avoid A).1 hω⟩

omit [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [DecidableEq ι] in
/-- `exp (-1) ≤ (1 - 1/(d+1))^d`, the estimate behind the symmetric Local Lemma. -/
theorem exp_neg_one_le_one_sub_inv_pow (d : ℕ) :
    Real.exp (-1) ≤ (1 - 1 / ((d : ℝ) + 1)) ^ d := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos d with rfl | hd
  · simp only [pow_zero, Real.exp_le_one_iff]
    norm_num
  have hd' : (0 : ℝ) < d := Nat.cast_pos.2 hd
  have hy : 1 - 1 / ((d : ℝ) + 1) = d / (d + 1) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - 1 / ((d : ℝ) + 1) := by rw [hy]; positivity
  have hinv : (1 - 1 / ((d : ℝ) + 1))⁻¹ = 1 + 1 / d := by
    rw [hy, inv_div]
    field_simp
  have hlog : Real.log (1 + 1 / d) ≤ 1 / d := by
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 + 1 / d by positivity)
    linarith
  have hl : Real.log (1 - 1 / ((d : ℝ) + 1)) = -Real.log (1 + 1 / d) := by
    rw [← hinv, Real.log_inv, neg_neg]
  have hdd : (d : ℝ) * (1 / d) = 1 := by field_simp
  have key : -1 ≤ (d : ℝ) * Real.log (1 - 1 / ((d : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    rw [hl]
    nlinarith
  calc Real.exp (-1) ≤ Real.exp ((d : ℝ) * Real.log (1 - 1 / ((d : ℝ) + 1))) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.2 key
    _ = (1 - 1 / ((d : ℝ) + 1)) ^ d := by
        rw [← Real.log_pow, Real.exp_log (pow_pos hpos d)]

/-- The **symmetric Lovász Local Lemma**: if `P(A i) ≤ q`, `|N i| ≤ d` and `e q (d + 1) ≤ 1`,
then the events are avoided simultaneously with positive weight. -/
theorem prob_avoid_pos_of_symmetric (hp : IsDistribution p) {N : ι → Finset ι}
    (hdep : IsLopsidedDependency A p N) {q : ℝ} {d : ℕ} (hq : ∀ i, prob p (A i) ≤ q)
    (hN : ∀ i, (N i).card ≤ d) (hqd : Real.exp 1 * q * (d + 1) ≤ 1) (T : Finset ι) :
    0 < prob p (avoid A T) := by
  have he : 0 < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_pos 1
  have hq' : q ≤ Real.exp (-1) / (d + 1) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity), Real.exp_neg, ← one_div, le_div_iff₀ he]
    linarith
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos d with rfl | hd
  · have hN0 : ∀ i, N i = ∅ := fun i => Finset.card_eq_zero.1 (Nat.le_zero.1 (hN i))
    refine prob_avoid_pos (x := fun _ => 1 / 2) hp hdep (fun _ => by norm_num)
      (fun _ => by norm_num) (fun i => ?_) T
    rw [hN0 i, Finset.prod_empty, mul_one]
    refine (hq i).trans (hq'.trans ?_)
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)]
    rw [Real.exp_neg, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, div_one]
    exact inv_le_of_inv_le₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num; linarith)
  have hd1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d := Nat.one_le_cast.2 hd
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / ((d : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  have hx1 : 1 / ((d : ℝ) + 1) < 1 := by
    rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]
    linarith
  refine prob_avoid_pos (x := fun _ => 1 / ((d : ℝ) + 1)) hp hdep (fun _ => hx0)
    (fun _ => hx1) (fun i => ?_) T
  rw [Finset.prod_const]
  have hpow : (1 - 1 / ((d : ℝ) + 1)) ^ d ≤ (1 - 1 / ((d : ℝ) + 1)) ^ (N i).card :=
    pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by linarith) (by linarith) (hN i)
  calc prob p (A i) ≤ Real.exp (-1) / (d + 1) := (hq i).trans hq'
    _ = 1 / ((d : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (-1) := by ring
    _ ≤ 1 / ((d : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - 1 / ((d : ℝ) + 1)) ^ (N i).card :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((exp_neg_one_le_one_sub_inv_pow d).trans hpow) hx0

/-- The symmetric Local Lemma in existence form: some outcome lies in none of the `A i`. -/
theorem exists_forall_not_mem_of_symmetric (hp : IsDistribution p) {N : ι → Finset ι}
    (hdep : IsLopsidedDependency A p N) {q : ℝ} {d : ℕ} (hq : ∀ i, prob p (A i) ≤ q)
    (hN : ∀ i, (N i).card ≤ d) (hqd : Real.exp 1 * q * (d + 1) ≤ 1) (T : Finset ι) :
    ∃ ω, ∀ i ∈ T, ω ∉ A i := by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ := Finset.nonempty_of_sum_ne_zero
    (prob_avoid_pos_of_symmetric hp hdep hq hN hqd T).ne'
  exact ⟨ω, (mem_avoid A).1 hω⟩

end LLL

section ProductMeasure

/-- The product weight of `ω : κ → α` with independent coordinates of law `μ`. -/
def productWeight {κ α : Type*} [Fintype κ] (μ : α → ℝ) (ω : κ → α) : ℝ := ∏ k, μ (ω k)

/-- The event `A` only reads the coordinates in `V`. -/
def DependsOn {κ α : Type*} (A : Finset (κ → α)) (V : Finset κ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ω ω' : κ → α, (∀ k ∈ V, ω k = ω' k) → (ω ∈ A ↔ ω' ∈ A)

/-- Coordinates in `V` from `ω`, the rest from `ω'`. -/
def hybrid {κ α : Type*} [DecidableEq κ] (V : Finset κ) (ω ω' : κ → α) : κ → α :=
  fun k => if k ∈ V then ω k else ω' k

variable {κ α : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]

omit [Fintype κ] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] in
@[simp] lemma hybrid_hybrid (V : Finset κ) (ω ω' : κ → α) :
    hybrid V (hybrid V ω ω') (hybrid V ω' ω) = ω := by
  funext k
  by_cases hk : k ∈ V <;> simp [hybrid, hk]

omit [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] in
lemma productWeight_hybrid_mul (μ : α → ℝ) (V : Finset κ) (ω ω' : κ → α) :
    productWeight μ (hybrid V ω ω') * productWeight μ (hybrid V ω' ω) =
      productWeight μ ω * productWeight μ ω' := by
  simp only [productWeight, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  by_cases hk : k ∈ V
  · simp only [hybrid, hk, ↓reduceIte]
  · simp only [hybrid, hk, ↓reduceIte]
    exact mul_comm _ _

omit [DecidableEq α] in
lemma sum_productWeight {μ : α → ℝ} (hμ : ∑ a, μ a = 1) :
    ∑ ω : κ → α, productWeight μ ω = 1 := by
  have h := Finset.prod_univ_sum (fun _ : κ => (Finset.univ : Finset α)) fun _ a => μ a
  simp only [hμ, Finset.prod_const_one, Fintype.piFinset_univ] at h
  exact h.symm

omit [DecidableEq α] in
lemma isDistribution_productWeight {μ : α → ℝ} (hμ : IsDistribution μ) :
    IsDistribution (productWeight (κ := κ) μ) where
  nonneg ω := Finset.prod_nonneg fun k _ => hμ.nonneg (ω k)
  sum_eq_one := sum_productWeight hμ.sum_eq_one

/-- **Independence under a product measure**: events reading disjoint coordinate sets `V` and
`Vᶜ` are independent. -/
theorem prob_inter_eq_mul_of_dependsOn {μ : α → ℝ} (hμ : ∑ a, μ a = 1)
    {A B : Finset (κ → α)} {V : Finset κ} (hA : DependsOn A V) (hB : DependsOn B Vᶜ) :
    prob (productWeight μ) (A ∩ B) = prob (productWeight μ) A * prob (productWeight μ) B := by
  have hAh : ∀ ω ω' : κ → α, hybrid V ω ω' ∈ A ↔ ω ∈ A := fun ω ω' =>
    hA _ _ fun k hk => by simp [hybrid, hk]
  have hBh : ∀ ω ω' : κ → α, hybrid V ω' ω ∈ B ↔ ω ∈ B := fun ω ω' =>
    hB _ _ fun k hk => by simp [hybrid, Finset.mem_compl.1 hk]
  have hR : prob (productWeight μ) A * prob (productWeight μ) B =
      ∑ x : (κ → α) × (κ → α), if x.1 ∈ A ∧ x.2 ∈ B then
        productWeight μ x.1 * productWeight μ x.2 else 0 := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, prob, prob, Finset.sum_mul_sum, ← Fintype.sum_ite_mem A]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    by_cases ha : a ∈ A
    · simp only [ha, true_and, ↓reduceIte]
      exact (Fintype.sum_ite_mem B _).symm
    · simp [ha]
  have hL : prob (productWeight μ) (A ∩ B) =
      ∑ x : (κ → α) × (κ → α), if x.1 ∈ A ∩ B then
        productWeight μ x.1 * productWeight μ x.2 else 0 := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, prob, ← Fintype.sum_ite_mem (A ∩ B)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    by_cases ha : a ∈ A ∩ B
    · simp only [ha, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, sum_productWeight hμ, mul_one]
    · simp only [ha, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  have hinv : Function.Involutive fun x : (κ → α) × (κ → α) =>
      (hybrid V x.1 x.2, hybrid V x.2 x.1) := fun x => by simp
  rw [hL, hR]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (hinv.bijective.sum_comp fun x : (κ → α) × (κ → α) =>
    if x.1 ∈ A ∧ x.2 ∈ B then productWeight μ x.1 * productWeight μ x.2 else 0)
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  simp only [hAh, hBh, productWeight_hybrid_mul, Finset.mem_inter]

/-- Events with variable sets `vbl i` under a product measure are lopsidedly dependent on any
`N` that contains every `j ≠ i` whose variables meet `vbl i`. -/
theorem isLopsidedDependency_of_dependsOn {ι : Type*} {μ : α → ℝ} (hμ : ∑ a, μ a = 1)
    {A : ι → Finset (κ → α)} {vbl : ι → Finset κ} (hA : ∀ i, DependsOn (A i) (vbl i))
    {N : ι → Finset ι} (hN : ∀ i j, j ≠ i → ¬Disjoint (vbl i) (vbl j) → j ∈ N i) :
    IsLopsidedDependency A (productWeight μ) N := by
  intro i T hT hiT
  refine (prob_inter_eq_mul_of_dependsOn hμ (hA i) ?_).le
  intro ω ω' h
  have key : ∀ j ∈ T, (ω ∉ A j ↔ ω' ∉ A j) := fun j hj => by
    have hji : j ≠ i := fun e => hiT (e ▸ hj)
    have hjN : j ∉ N i := Finset.disjoint_left.1 hT hj
    have hdisj : Disjoint (vbl i) (vbl j) := by
      by_contra hc
      exact hjN (hN i j hji hc)
    exact not_congr (hA j ω ω' fun k hk =>
      h k (Finset.mem_compl.2 (Finset.disjoint_right.1 hdisj hk)))
  simp only [mem_avoid]
  exact ⟨fun H j hj => (key j hj).1 (H j hj), fun H j hj => (key j hj).2 (H j hj)⟩

/-- A cylinder event fixing the coordinates in `V` to `a` has weight `∏_{k ∈ V} μ (a k)`. -/
theorem prob_cylinder {μ : α → ℝ} (hμ : ∑ b, μ b = 1) (V : Finset κ) (a : κ → α)
    [DecidablePred fun ω : κ → α => ∀ k ∈ V, ω k = a k] :
    prob (productWeight μ) ({ω | ∀ k ∈ V, ω k = a k} : Finset (κ → α)) =
      ∏ k ∈ V, μ (a k) := by
  have hpt : ∀ ω : κ → α, (if ∀ k ∈ V, ω k = a k then productWeight μ ω else 0) =
      ∏ k, (if k ∈ V then (if ω k = a k then μ (ω k) else 0) else μ (ω k)) := fun ω => by
    unfold productWeight
    by_cases h : ∀ k ∈ V, ω k = a k
    · rw [ite_eq_left h]
      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      by_cases hk : k ∈ V
      · rw [ite_eq_left hk, ite_eq_left (h k hk)]
      · rw [ite_eq_right hk]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h]
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hne⟩ : ∃ k ∈ V, ω k ≠ a k := by
        by_contra hc
        exact h fun k hk => by_contra fun hne => hc ⟨k, hk, hne⟩
      symm
      refine Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ k) ?_
      rw [ite_eq_left hk, ite_eq_right hne]
  have hfac := (Finset.prod_univ_sum (fun _ : κ => (Finset.univ : Finset α))
    fun k b => if k ∈ V then (if b = a k then μ b else 0) else μ b).symm
  rw [Fintype.piFinset_univ] at hfac
  rw [prob, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => hpt ω, hfac,
    ← Fintype.prod_ite_mem V]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  by_cases hk : k ∈ V
  · simp only [hk, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ]
  · simp only [hk, ↓reduceIte, hμ]

end ProductMeasure

end

end TheoremOS.Probability

import Submission.Library.TheoremOS.Probability.SpectralGap

/-!
# Lower bounds for mixing

Tools that show a finite Markov chain has *not* mixed yet. Contents: the test-function bound
`|E_μ f - E_ν f| ≤ 2 M tvDist μ ν` for `|f| ≤ M`; **eigenfunction bounds**: for `P f = θ f`
with `θ ≠ 1` and a stationary `π`, `E_π f = 0` and `|θ|^t |f x| ≤ 2 ‖f‖∞ tvDist (P^t x) π`,
so rows within `ε` of `π` force `|θ|^t ≤ 2ε` and `t ≥ log (1/(2ε)) / log (1/|θ|)`; the
**edge flow** `Q(S, T) = ∑_{x ∈ S, y ∈ T} π x P x y` and the **bottleneck ratio**
`Φ(S) = Q(S, Sᶜ) / π(S)`; for reversible chains the Dirichlet form of `1_S` is `Q(S, Sᶜ)` and
its variance is `π(S) π(Sᶜ)`, giving the easy half of **Cheeger's inequality**
`γ π(S) π(Sᶜ) ≤ Q(S, Sᶜ)` and `γ ≤ 2 Φ(S)` when `π(S) ≤ 1/2`; the **bottleneck lower bound**:
some `x ∈ S` has `tvDist (P^t x) π ≥ π(Sᶜ) - t Φ(S)`, hence rows within `1/4` at time `t`
force `1 ≤ 4 t Φ(S)`; convexity `tvDist (μ K) ν ≤ ∑ μ x tvDist (K x) ν`; and **Wilson's
distinguishing statistic**: if `E_μ f - E_ν f ≥ r σ` and both variances are at most `σ²`, then
`tvDist μ ν ≥ 1 - 8 / r²`.

Sources: D. A. Levin and Y. Peres, *Markov Chains and Mixing Times*, 2nd ed., AMS, 2017,
Sections 7.1–7.3, 12.2 and 13.3 (Theorem 7.4, Proposition 7.9, Theorem 12.5, Theorem 13.10);
D. B. Wilson, Mixing times of lozenge tiling and card shuffling Markov chains, Ann. Appl.
Probab. 14 (2004). Textbook material; nothing here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: `P` is a `Matrix Ω Ω ℝ` with `P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω`, a stationary law is `π ᵥ* P = π`,
and a reversible one satisfies `hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x`. Events are
`Finset Ω`; `prob π S` is `∑ x ∈ S, π x`, and `condLaw π S` is `π` conditioned on `S`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Probability

open Finset Matrix
open TheoremOS.InformationTheory
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

variable {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]

section TestFunctions

/-- A function bounded by `M` separates two weight vectors by at most `2 M tvDist`. -/
theorem abs_expectation_sub_le {μ ν f : Ω → ℝ} {M : ℝ} (hf : ∀ ω, |f ω| ≤ M) :
    |expectation μ f - expectation ν f| ≤ 2 * M * tvDist μ ν := by
  have h : expectation μ f - expectation ν f = ∑ ω, (μ ω - ν ω) * f ω := by
    simp only [expectation, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [h]
  calc |∑ ω, (μ ω - ν ω) * f ω| ≤ ∑ ω, |μ ω - ν ω| * M :=
        (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun ω _ => by
          rw [abs_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hf ω) (abs_nonneg _))
    _ = 2 * M * tvDist μ ν := by
        rw [tvDist, ← Finset.sum_mul]
        ring

end TestFunctions

section Eigen

variable [DecidableEq Ω] {P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ} {f : Ω → ℝ} {θ : ℝ}

lemma pow_mulVec_of_eigen (hf : P *ᵥ f = θ • f) (t : ℕ) : P ^ t *ᵥ f = θ ^ t • f := by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [_root_.pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ih, Matrix.mulVec_smul, hf, smul_smul,
      ← _root_.pow_succ]

omit [DecidableEq Ω] in
/-- Stationary expectations of an eigenfunction with eigenvalue `θ ≠ 1` vanish. -/
lemma expectation_eq_zero_of_eigen {π : Ω → ℝ} (hπP : π ᵥ* P = π) (hf : P *ᵥ f = θ • f)
    (hθ : θ ≠ 1) : expectation π f = 0 := by
  have h : expectation π (P *ᵥ f) = expectation π f := by
    change π ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ f) = π ⬝ᵥ f
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, hπP]
  have h' : expectation π (θ • f) = θ * expectation π f := by
    simp only [expectation, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => by ring
  rw [hf, h'] at h
  have : (θ - 1) * expectation π f = 0 := by linarith
  exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.2 hθ)

/-- The **eigenfunction lower bound**: `|θ|^t |f x| ≤ 2 ‖f‖∞ tvDist (P^t x) π`. -/
theorem pow_abs_mul_le_tvDist {π : Ω → ℝ} (hπP : π ᵥ* P = π) (hf : P *ᵥ f = θ • f)
    (hθ : θ ≠ 1) {M : ℝ} (hM : ∀ ω, |f ω| ≤ M) (t : ℕ) (x : Ω) :
    |θ| ^ t * |f x| ≤ 2 * M * tvDist ((P ^ t) x) π := by
  have h1 : expectation ((P ^ t) x) f = θ ^ t * f x := by
    change (P ^ t *ᵥ f) x = _
    rw [pow_mulVec_of_eigen hf t, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have h2 := abs_expectation_sub_le (μ := (P ^ t) x) (ν := π) hM
  rw [h1, expectation_eq_zero_of_eigen hπP hf hθ, sub_zero, abs_mul, abs_pow] at h2
  exact h2

/-- If every row is within `ε` of `π` at time `t`, a nonzero eigenfunction with eigenvalue
`θ ≠ 1` has `|θ|^t ≤ 2 ε`. -/
theorem pow_abs_le_two_mul_of_eigen {π : Ω → ℝ} (hπP : π ᵥ* P = π) (hf : P *ᵥ f = θ • f)
    (hθ : θ ≠ 1) (hf0 : f ≠ 0) {t : ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (ht : ∀ x, tvDist ((P ^ t) x) π ≤ ε) :
    |θ| ^ t ≤ 2 * ε := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, f y ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    exact hf0 (funext fun y => not_not.1 fun hy => h ⟨y, hy⟩)
  obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ (fun ω => |f ω|) ⟨y, mem_univ y⟩
  have hM : ∀ ω, |f ω| ≤ |f x| := fun ω => hx ω (mem_univ ω)
  have hpos : 0 < |f x| := (abs_pos.2 hy).trans_le (hM y)
  have h1 := pow_abs_mul_le_tvDist hπP hf hθ hM t x
  have h2 : 2 * |f x| * tvDist ((P ^ t) x) π ≤ 2 * |f x| * ε :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ht x) (by positivity)
  have h3 : |θ| ^ t * |f x| ≤ 2 * ε * |f x| := by linarith
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h3 hpos

/-- **Relaxation lower bound on mixing**: rows within `ε` of `π` at time `t` force
`t log (1/|θ|) ≥ log (1/(2ε))` for every nonzero eigenfunction with eigenvalue `θ ∉ {0, 1}`. -/
theorem log_le_mul_log_of_eigen {π : Ω → ℝ} (hπP : π ᵥ* P = π) (hf : P *ᵥ f = θ • f)
    (hθ : θ ≠ 1) (hθ0 : θ ≠ 0) (hf0 : f ≠ 0) {t : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (ht : ∀ x, tvDist ((P ^ t) x) π ≤ ε) :
    Real.log (1 / (2 * ε)) ≤ t * Real.log (1 / |θ|) := by
  have h := pow_abs_le_two_mul_of_eigen hπP hf hθ hf0 ht
  have hpos : 0 < |θ| ^ t := pow_pos (abs_pos.2 hθ0) t
  have hl := Real.log_le_log hpos h
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hl
  rw [one_div, one_div, Real.log_inv, Real.log_inv, mul_neg]
  linarith

end Eigen

section Bottleneck

variable {π : Ω → ℝ} {P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ}

/-- The **edge flow** `Q(S, T) = ∑_{x ∈ S, y ∈ T} π x P x y`. -/
def edgeFlow (π : Ω → ℝ) (P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ) (S T : Finset Ω) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x ∈ S, ∑ y ∈ T, π x * P x y

omit [Fintype Ω] in
lemma edgeFlow_nonneg (hπ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ π x) (hP : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y) (S T : Finset Ω) :
    0 ≤ edgeFlow π P S T :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun y _ => mul_nonneg (hπ x) (hP x y)

omit [Fintype Ω] in
/-- Reversibility makes the edge flow symmetric. -/
lemma edgeFlow_comm (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x) (S T : Finset Ω) :
    edgeFlow π P S T = edgeFlow π P T S := by
  rw [edgeFlow, edgeFlow, Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => hrev x y

variable [DecidableEq Ω]

/-- The **bottleneck ratio** `Φ(S) = Q(S, Sᶜ) / π(S)`. -/
def bottleneckRatio (π : Ω → ℝ) (P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ) (S : Finset Ω) : ℝ :=
  edgeFlow π P S Sᶜ / prob π S

lemma bottleneckRatio_nonneg (hπ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ π x) (hP : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y) (S : Finset Ω) :
    0 ≤ bottleneckRatio π P S :=
  div_nonneg (edgeFlow_nonneg hπ hP S Sᶜ) (prob_nonneg hπ S)

/-- The variance of an indicator is `π(S) π(Sᶜ)`. -/
lemma variance_indicator (hπ : IsDistribution π) (S : Finset Ω) :
    variance π (fun x => if x ∈ S then 1 else 0) = prob π S * prob π Sᶜ := by
  have h1 := prob_eq_expectation_indicator π S
  have h2 : expectation π (fun x => (if x ∈ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ^ 2) = prob π S := by
    rw [h1]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => by by_cases hω : ω ∈ S <;> simp [hω]
  rw [variance_eq hπ, h2, ← h1, prob_compl hπ]
  ring

/-- For a reversible chain the Dirichlet form of `1_S` is the edge flow `Q(S, Sᶜ)`. -/
theorem dirichletForm_indicator (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1)
    (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x) (S : Finset Ω) :
    dirichletForm π P (fun x => if x ∈ S then 1 else 0) = edgeFlow π P S Sᶜ := by
  have h := two_mul_dirichletForm hrow hrev (fun x => if x ∈ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
  have hsq : ∀ x y, π x * P x y * ((if x ∈ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - if y ∈ S then 1 else 0) ^ 2
      = (if x ∈ S then (if y ∈ Sᶜ then π x * P x y else 0) else 0)
        + (if y ∈ S then (if x ∈ Sᶜ then π y * P y x else 0) else 0) := fun x y => by
    by_cases hx : x ∈ S <;> by_cases hy : y ∈ S <;> simp [hx, hy, hrev x y]
  have hA : ∑ x, ∑ y, (if x ∈ S then (if y ∈ Sᶜ then π x * P x y else 0) else 0)
      = edgeFlow π P S Sᶜ := by
    rw [edgeFlow, ← Fintype.sum_ite_mem S]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
    by_cases hx : x ∈ S
    · simp only [hx, ↓reduceIte]
      exact Fintype.sum_ite_mem _ _
    · simp [hx]
  have hB : ∑ x, ∑ y, (if y ∈ S then (if x ∈ Sᶜ then π y * P y x else 0) else 0)
      = edgeFlow π P S Sᶜ := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact hA
  simp only [hsq, Finset.sum_add_distrib, hA, hB] at h
  linarith

/-- The easy half of **Cheeger's inequality**: a spectral gap `γ` of a reversible chain gives
`γ π(S) π(Sᶜ) ≤ Q(S, Sᶜ)`. -/
theorem HasSpectralGap.mul_prob_mul_prob_le {γ : ℝ} (hγ : HasSpectralGap π P γ)
    (hπ : IsDistribution π) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1)
    (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x) (S : Finset Ω) :
    γ * (prob π S * prob π Sᶜ) ≤ edgeFlow π P S Sᶜ := by
  have h := hγ fun x => if x ∈ S then 1 else 0
  rwa [variance_indicator hπ S, dirichletForm_indicator hrow hrev S] at h

/-- A spectral gap is at most twice the bottleneck ratio of any `S` with `0 < π(S) ≤ 1/2`. -/
theorem HasSpectralGap.le_two_mul_bottleneckRatio {γ : ℝ} (hγ : HasSpectralGap π P γ)
    (hπ : IsDistribution π) (hP : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1)
    (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x) {S : Finset Ω} (hS : 0 < prob π S)
    (hS2 : prob π S ≤ 1 / 2) : γ ≤ 2 * bottleneckRatio π P S := by
  have h := hγ.mul_prob_mul_prob_le hπ hrow hrev S
  rw [prob_compl hπ] at h
  have hQ := edgeFlow_nonneg hπ.nonneg hP S Sᶜ
  have key : γ * prob π S ≤ 2 * edgeFlow π P S Sᶜ := by
    rcases le_or_gt 0 γ with hγ0 | hγ0
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hγ0 hS.le) (sub_nonneg.2 hS2)]
    · nlinarith [mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hγ0 hS]
  rw [bottleneckRatio, mul_div_assoc', le_div_iff₀ hS]
  exact key

/-- `π` conditioned on `S`. -/
def condLaw (π : Ω → ℝ) (S : Finset Ω) (x : Ω) : ℝ := if x ∈ S then π x / prob π S else 0

lemma isDistribution_condLaw (hπ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ π x) {S : Finset Ω} (hS : 0 < prob π S) :
    IsDistribution (condLaw π S) where
  nonneg x := by
    unfold condLaw
    split_ifs
    · exact div_nonneg (hπ x) hS.le
    · exact le_rfl
  sum_eq_one := by
    simp only [condLaw]
    rw [Fintype.sum_ite_mem, ← Finset.sum_div]
    exact div_self hS.ne'

lemma prob_condLaw_compl (S : Finset Ω) : prob (condLaw π S) Sᶜ = 0 :=
  Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx => by simp [condLaw, Finset.mem_compl.1 hx]

lemma prob_compl_le_tvDist_condLaw (hπ : IsDistribution π) {S : Finset Ω}
    (hS : 0 < prob π S) : prob π Sᶜ ≤ tvDist π (condLaw π S) := by
  have h := prob_sub_prob_le_tvDist
    (hπ.sum_eq_one.trans (isDistribution_condLaw hπ.nonneg hS).sum_eq_one.symm) Sᶜ
  rwa [prob_condLaw_compl, sub_zero] at h

lemma vecMul_condLaw_apply (S : Finset Ω) (y : Ω) :
    (condLaw π S ᵥ* P) y = (∑ x ∈ S, π x * P x y) / prob π S := by
  simp only [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, condLaw, ite_mul, zero_mul]
  rw [Fintype.sum_ite_mem, Finset.sum_div]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => by ring

/-- One step from `π` conditioned on `S` moves it by at most the bottleneck ratio. -/
theorem tvDist_vecMul_condLaw_le (hπ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ π x) (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω)
    (hπP : π ᵥ* P = π) {S : Finset Ω} (hS : 0 < prob π S) :
    tvDist (condLaw π S ᵥ* P) (condLaw π S) ≤ bottleneckRatio π P S := by
  have hμ := isDistribution_condLaw hπ hS
  rw [tvDist_eq_sum_max ((isDistribution_vecMul hP hμ).sum_eq_one.trans hμ.sum_eq_one.symm)]
  have hterm : ∀ y, max ((condLaw π S ᵥ* P) y - condLaw π S y) 0 ≤
      if y ∈ Sᶜ then (∑ x ∈ S, π x * P x y) / prob π S else 0 := fun y => by
    rw [vecMul_condLaw_apply]
    by_cases hy : y ∈ S
    · have hle : ∑ x ∈ S, π x * P x y ≤ π y := by
        calc ∑ x ∈ S, π x * P x y ≤ ∑ x, π x * P x y :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ S)
                fun x _ _ => mul_nonneg (hπ x) (nonneg_of_mem_rowStochastic hP)
          _ = π y := congrFun hπP y
      have h2 : (∑ x ∈ S, π x * P x y) / prob π S - condLaw π S y ≤ 0 := by
        simp only [condLaw, hy, ↓reduceIte]
        exact sub_nonpos.2 (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hle hS.le)
      rw [max_eq_right h2]
      simp [hy]
    · have hy' : y ∈ Sᶜ := Finset.mem_compl.2 hy
      simp only [condLaw, hy, hy', ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
      exact max_le le_rfl (div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ =>
        mul_nonneg (hπ x) (nonneg_of_mem_rowStochastic hP)) hS.le)
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum fun y _ => hterm y).trans_eq ?_
  rw [Fintype.sum_ite_mem, bottleneckRatio, edgeFlow, ← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_comm]

/-- `t` steps from `π` conditioned on `S` move it by at most `t Φ(S)`. -/
theorem tvDist_vecMul_pow_condLaw_le (hπ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ π x) (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω)
    (hπP : π ᵥ* P = π) {S : Finset Ω} (hS : 0 < prob π S) (t : ℕ) :
    tvDist (condLaw π S ᵥ* P ^ t) (condLaw π S) ≤ t * bottleneckRatio π P S := by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ t ih =>
    have h1 := tvDist_triangle (condLaw π S ᵥ* P ^ (t + 1)) (condLaw π S ᵥ* P ^ t)
      (condLaw π S)
    have h2 : tvDist (condLaw π S ᵥ* P ^ (t + 1)) (condLaw π S ᵥ* P ^ t) ≤
        bottleneckRatio π P S := by
      rw [_root_.pow_succ', ← Matrix.vecMul_vecMul]
      exact (tvDist_vecMul_le (pow_mem hP t) _ _).trans (tvDist_vecMul_condLaw_le hπ hP hπP hS)
    rw [Nat.cast_succ, add_mul, one_mul]
    linarith

omit [DecidableEq Ω] in
/-- Total variation to a fixed law is convex in the starting law: for a distribution `μ`,
`tvDist (μ K) ν ≤ ∑ μ x tvDist (K x) ν`. -/
theorem tvDist_vecMul_le_sum {μ : Ω → ℝ} (hμ : IsDistribution μ) (K : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ)
    (ν : Ω → ℝ) : tvDist (μ ᵥ* K) ν ≤ ∑ x, μ x * tvDist (K x) ν := by
  have h : ∀ y, (μ ᵥ* K) y - ν y = ∑ x, μ x * (K x y - ν y) := fun y => by
    change ∑ x, μ x * K x y - ν y = _
    simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hμ.sum_eq_one, one_mul]
  calc tvDist (μ ᵥ* K) ν = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ y, |∑ x, μ x * (K x y - ν y)| := by
        simp only [tvDist, h]
    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ y, ∑ x, |μ x * (K x y - ν y)| :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (Finset.sum_le_sum fun y _ => Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _) (by norm_num)
    _ = ∑ x, μ x * tvDist (K x) ν := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
        simp only [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hμ.nonneg x), tvDist, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        ring

/-- The **bottleneck lower bound**: some `x ∈ S` has `tvDist (P^t x) π ≥ π(Sᶜ) - t Φ(S)`. -/
theorem exists_mem_le_tvDist_pow_row (hπ : IsDistribution π) (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω)
    (hπP : π ᵥ* P = π) {S : Finset Ω} (hS : 0 < prob π S) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ x ∈ S, prob π Sᶜ - t * bottleneckRatio π P S ≤ tvDist ((P ^ t) x) π := by
  have hμ := isDistribution_condLaw hπ.nonneg hS
  have h1 := prob_compl_le_tvDist_condLaw hπ hS
  have h2 := tvDist_vecMul_pow_condLaw_le hπ.nonneg hP hπP hS t
  have h3 := tvDist_triangle π (condLaw π S ᵥ* P ^ t) (condLaw π S)
  have h4 := tvDist_vecMul_le_sum hμ (P ^ t) π
  have hne : S.Nonempty := Finset.nonempty_of_sum_ne_zero hS.ne'
  obtain ⟨x, hxS, hx⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image S (fun z => tvDist ((P ^ t) z) π) hne
  have h5 : ∑ z, condLaw π S z * tvDist ((P ^ t) z) π ≤ tvDist ((P ^ t) x) π := by
    calc ∑ z, condLaw π S z * tvDist ((P ^ t) z) π
        ≤ ∑ z, condLaw π S z * tvDist ((P ^ t) x) π := Finset.sum_le_sum fun z _ => by
          by_cases hz : z ∈ S
          · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hx z hz) (hμ.nonneg z)
          · simp [condLaw, hz]
      _ = tvDist ((P ^ t) x) π := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hμ.sum_eq_one, one_mul]
  refine ⟨x, hxS, ?_⟩
  rw [tvDist_comm π (condLaw π S ᵥ* P ^ t)] at h3
  linarith

/-- If every row is within `ε` of `π` at time `t`, then `π(Sᶜ) - ε ≤ t Φ(S)` for each `S`
with `π(S) > 0`. -/
theorem prob_compl_sub_le_mul_bottleneckRatio (hπ : IsDistribution π)
    (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω) (hπP : π ᵥ* P = π) {S : Finset Ω} (hS : 0 < prob π S)
    {t : ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (ht : ∀ x, tvDist ((P ^ t) x) π ≤ ε) :
    prob π Sᶜ - ε ≤ t * bottleneckRatio π P S := by
  obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := exists_mem_le_tvDist_pow_row hπ hP hπP hS t
  linarith [ht x]

/-- Rows within `1/4` of `π` at time `t` force `1 ≤ 4 t Φ(S)` whenever `0 < π(S) ≤ 1/2`. -/
theorem one_le_four_mul_bottleneckRatio (hπ : IsDistribution π) (hP : P ∈ rowStochastic ℝ Ω)
    (hπP : π ᵥ* P = π) {S : Finset Ω} (hS : 0 < prob π S) (hS2 : prob π S ≤ 1 / 2) {t : ℕ}
    (ht : ∀ x, tvDist ((P ^ t) x) π ≤ 1 / 4) : 1 ≤ 4 * (t * bottleneckRatio π P S) := by
  have h := prob_compl_sub_le_mul_bottleneckRatio hπ hP hπP hS ht
  rw [prob_compl hπ] at h
  linarith

end Bottleneck

section Wilson

/-- **Wilson's distinguishing statistic**: if `E_μ f - E_ν f ≥ r σ` and both variances are at
most `σ²`, then `tvDist μ ν ≥ 1 - 8 / r²`. -/
theorem one_sub_le_tvDist_of_expectation_sub {μ ν : Ω → ℝ} (hμ : IsDistribution μ)
    (hν : IsDistribution ν) (f : Ω → ℝ) {r σ : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hgap : r * σ ≤ expectation μ f - expectation ν f) (hvμ : variance μ f ≤ σ ^ 2)
    (hvν : variance ν f ≤ σ ^ 2) : 1 - 8 / r ^ 2 ≤ tvDist μ ν := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, expectation μ f - expectation ν f = 2 * d := ⟨_, (mul_div_cancel₀ _
    (two_ne_zero (α := ℝ))).symm⟩
  have hd0 : r * σ / 2 ≤ d := by linarith
  have hdpos : 0 < d := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hd0
  have hratio : σ ^ 2 / d ^ 2 ≤ 4 / r ^ 2 := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul hd0 hd0 (by positivity) hdpos.le]
  have hvar : ∀ {p : Ω → ℝ}, variance p f ≤ σ ^ 2 → variance p f / d ^ 2 ≤ 4 / r ^ 2 :=
    fun h => (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h (by positivity)).trans hratio
  let A : Finset Ω := {ω | expectation ν f + d ≤ f ω}
  have hAc : prob μ Aᶜ ≤ 4 / r ^ 2 := by
    refine (prob_mono hμ.nonneg ?_).trans ((chebyshev hμ f hdpos).trans (hvar hvμ))
    intro ω hω
    simp only [A, Finset.mem_compl, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      not_le] at hω
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    rw [abs_sub_comm]
    exact (by linarith : d ≤ expectation μ f - f ω).trans (le_abs_self _)
  have hA : prob ν A ≤ 4 / r ^ 2 := by
    refine (prob_mono hν.nonneg ?_).trans ((chebyshev hν f hdpos).trans (hvar hvν))
    intro ω hω
    simp only [A, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hω
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact (by linarith : d ≤ f ω - expectation ν f).trans (le_abs_self _)
  have hT := prob_sub_prob_le_tvDist (hμ.sum_eq_one.trans hν.sum_eq_one.symm) A
  rw [prob_compl hμ] at hAc
  have h8 : 8 / r ^ 2 = 4 / r ^ 2 + 4 / r ^ 2 := by ring
  linarith

end Wilson

end

import Mathlib

/-!
# Random k-SAT: counting, moments and the clause stream

Counting and probability facts behind the first- and second-moment method for random formulas.
Contents: for any clauses `C`, assignments `A` and relation `sat : C → A → Prop`, the formulas
`F : Fin m → C` satisfied by `a` number `s_a^m` with `s_a` the number of clauses `a` satisfies
(`natCard_forall_sat`); the **union bound** `#{satisfiable F} ≤ ∑_a s_a^m` and its ratio form
`#{satisfiable F} / |C|^m ≤ |A| (s/|C|)^m` when every `s_a ≤ s`; `N_{m+1} ≤ |C| N_m`, so the
satisfiable fraction is antitone in `m`; the **first moment** `∑_F X F = ∑_a s_a^m` and
**second moment** `∑_F (X F)^2 = ∑_{a,b} s_{ab}^m` of the number `X F` of satisfying assignments,
`s_{ab}` the number of clauses both satisfy, and the **second-moment method**
`(∑_F X F)^2 ≤ #{satisfiable F} ∑_F (X F)^2`. The **survival recursion** `filterStep sat`
(average of `f` over the solution sets `S.filter (sat c)`) iterated `m` times averages `f` over all
`m`-clause formulas (`filterStep_iterate`); from the indicator of non-emptiness it gives the
fraction of formulas that some assignment of `S` satisfies. For an i.i.d. clause stream
`Measure.infinitePi fun _ : ℕ => μ`: `P(first m clauses lie in t) = μ t ^ m`; the union bound
`P(some a ∈ S satisfies the first m clauses) ≤ ∑_{a ∈ S} P(a satisfies a clause)^m ≤ |S| q^m`;
almost sure eventual unsatisfiability when every `a ∈ S` fails a clause with positive
probability; and, for the uniform law on a finite clause type, the probability of an event about
the first `m` clauses is its share of the `|C|^m` formulas (`infinitePi_uniformOn_prefix`), with
the forms for "some `a ∈ S` satisfies the first `m` clauses", its complement, one clause falsifying
all of `S`, and the survival recursion. Clause models on `n` variables: `KClause n k` (a `k`-set
of variables with the value making each literal true) and `SignClause n k` (sign vectors
`Fin n → Option Bool` with `k` entries present), equivalent via `signClauseEquiv`; there are
`C(n,k) 2^k` clauses, an assignment satisfies `C(n,k) (2^k - 1)` and falsifies `C(n,k)`; the
clauses falsified by every assignment of `T ∋ a₀` number `C(d,k)` with `d` the number of variables
where `T` agrees with `a₀`; the clauses satisfied by both `a` and `b` number
`C(n,k) 2^k - 2 C(n,k) + C(z,k)` with `z` the number of variables where they agree. The
**first-moment bound** `P(satisfiable) ≤ 2^n (1 - 2^{-k})^m` for `m` uniform random clauses with
`k ≤ n`, in counting form for any clause model with these counts (`satisfiable_div_le_of_natCard`)
and in stream form (`infinitePi_uniformOn_exists_forall_sat_le_of_natCard`), and almost sure
eventual unsatisfiability of the uniform clause stream.

Sources: J. Franco and M. Paull, "Probabilistic analysis of the Davis–Putnam procedure for solving
the satisfiability problem", Discrete Appl. Math. 5 (1983), 77–87 (first-moment bound);
V. Chvátal and B. Reed, "Mick gets some (the odds are on his side)", FOCS 1992 (random k-SAT);
D. Achlioptas and C. Moore, "Random k-SAT: two moments suffice to cross a sharp threshold", SIAM
J. Comput. 36 (2006), 740–762 (second moment through pair overlaps); D. Achlioptas, "Random
satisfiability", Chapter 8 of *Handbook of Satisfiability*, IOS Press, 2009; N. Alon and
J. Spencer, *The Probabilistic Method*, 4th ed., Wiley, 2016, Chapter 4 (second-moment method).
Textbook material; nothing here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: a clause type defined as `(s : {s : Finset (Fin n) // s.card = k}) × (s.1 → Bool)` with
`Satisfies c a := ∃ v : c.1.1, a v = c.2 v` is `KClause n k` with `KClause.Sat` after unfolding,
so `natCard_kclause`, `natCard_kclause_sat`, `natCard_kclause_forall_not_sat` and
`exists_kclause_not_sat` close goals stated with it by `exact`; `rw` needs them restated first,
e.g. `have h : Nat.card (Clause n k) = n.choose k * 2 ^ k := natCard_kclause`. A sign-vector type
`{C : Fin n → Option Bool // (univ.filter fun i => (C i).isSome).card = k}` with
`∃ i, C.val i = some (σ i)` is `SignClause n k` with `SignClause.Sat`. Ratios written with
`Fintype.card` become `Nat.card` by `simp only [Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]`. A recursion
`f ↦ fun S => (∑ c, f (S.filter (Satisfies c))) / Fintype.card C` is `filterStep` by `rfl`. A stream
law `Measure.infinitePi fun _ => uniformOn Set.univ` on a clause type with its own `Fintype`,
`MeasurableSpace` and `MeasurableSingletonClass` instances matches the generic lemmas after
unfolding the law; supply `Nonempty` from `exists_kclause_not_sat`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Probability

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter Topology Finset
open scoped ENNReal

noncomputable section

section Count

variable {C A : Type*} (sat : C → A → Prop)

/-- The formulas `F : Fin m → C` satisfied by a fixed assignment are the `m`-tuples of clauses it
satisfies. -/
lemma natCard_forall_sat (a : A) (m : ℕ) :
    Nat.card {F : Fin m → C // ∀ j, sat (F j) a} = Nat.card {c // sat c a} ^ m := by
  rw [Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypePiEquivPi (p := fun (_ : Fin m) (c : C) => sat c a)),
    Nat.card_pi]
  simp

/-- **Union bound** over assignments: the number of satisfiable `m`-clause formulas is at most
`∑_a (number of clauses a satisfies)^m`. -/
lemma natCard_exists_forall_sat_le [Fintype A] [Finite C] (m : ℕ) :
    Nat.card {F : Fin m → C // ∃ a, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} ≤ ∑ a, Nat.card {c // sat c a} ^ m := by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite C
  simp_rw [← natCard_forall_sat sat, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype]
  calc #{F : Fin m → C | ∃ a, ∀ j, sat (F j) a}
      = #(univ.biUnion fun a => ({F | ∀ j, sat (F j) a} : Finset (Fin m → C))) := by
        congr 1
        ext F
        simp
    _ ≤ _ := card_biUnion_le

/-- **First-moment bound** as a ratio: if every assignment satisfies at most `s` of the clauses,
the fraction of `m`-clause formulas that are satisfiable is at most `|A| (s/|C|)^m`. -/
lemma natCard_exists_forall_sat_div_le [Fintype A] [Finite C] (m s : ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ a, Nat.card {c // sat c a} ≤ s) :
    (Nat.card {F : Fin m → C // ∃ a, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} : ℝ) / Nat.card (Fin m → C) ≤
      Nat.card A * ((s : ℝ) / Nat.card C) ^ m := by
  have hN : Nat.card {F : Fin m → C // ∃ a, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} ≤ Nat.card A * s ^ m := by
    refine (natCard_exists_forall_sat_le sat m).trans ?_
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← smul_eq_mul, ← Finset.card_univ]
    exact Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ _ fun a _ => Nat.pow_le_pow_left (hs a) m
  rw [Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_fin, Nat.cast_pow, div_pow, mul_div_assoc']
  gcongr
  exact_mod_cast hN

/-- One more clause can only lower the number of satisfiable formulas, relative to the number of
formulas: `N_{m+1} ≤ |C| N_m`. -/
lemma natCard_exists_forall_sat_succ_le [Finite C] (m : ℕ) :
    Nat.card {F : Fin (m + 1) → C // ∃ a, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} ≤
      Nat.card C * Nat.card {F : Fin m → C // ∃ a, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} := by
  rw [← Nat.card_prod]
  refine Nat.card_le_card_of_injective
    (fun F => (F.1 0, ⟨Fin.tail F.1, F.2.imp fun a ha j => ha j.succ⟩)) ?_
  intro F G h
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, Subtype.mk.injEq] at h
  exact Subtype.ext ((Fin.cons_self_tail F.1).symm.trans (h.2 ▸ h.1 ▸ Fin.cons_self_tail G.1))

/-- The satisfiable fraction of `m`-clause formulas is antitone in `m`. -/
lemma natCard_exists_forall_sat_div_antitone [Finite C] :
    Antitone fun m => (Nat.card {F : Fin m → C // ∃ a, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} : ℝ) /
      Nat.card (Fin m → C) := by
  refine antitone_nat_of_succ_le fun m => ?_
  simp only [Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_fin, Nat.cast_pow]
  rcases (Nat.card C).eq_zero_or_pos with h0 | hpos
  · simp [h0]
    positivity
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.card C := by exact_mod_cast hpos
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity), pow_succ]
  have := natCard_exists_forall_sat_succ_le sat m
  have h' : (Nat.card {F : Fin (m + 1) → C // ∃ a, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} : ℝ) ≤
      Nat.card C * Nat.card {F : Fin m → C // ∃ a, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} := by exact_mod_cast this
  nlinarith [pow_pos hc m]

/-- **First moment**: summed over all formulas, the number of satisfying assignments is
`∑_a (number of clauses a satisfies)^m`. -/
lemma sum_natCard_sat [Fintype A] [Fintype C] (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ F : Fin m → C, Nat.card {a // ∀ j, sat (F j) a} = ∑ a, Nat.card {c // sat c a} ^ m := by
  classical
  simp_rw [← natCard_forall_sat sat, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype,
    Finset.card_filter]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

/-- **Second moment**: summed over all formulas, the square of the number of satisfying
assignments is `∑_{a,b} (number of clauses both a and b satisfy)^m`. -/
lemma sum_natCard_sat_sq [Fintype A] [Fintype C] (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ F : Fin m → C, Nat.card {a // ∀ j, sat (F j) a} ^ 2 =
      ∑ p : A × A, Nat.card {c // sat c p.1 ∧ sat c p.2} ^ m := by
  rw [← sum_natCard_sat (fun c (p : A × A) => sat c p.1 ∧ sat c p.2) m]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun F _ => ?_
  rw [sq, ← Nat.card_prod]
  refine Nat.card_congr ((Equiv.subtypeProdEquivProd).symm.trans (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight ?_))
  intro p
  simp only [forall_and]

/-- **Second-moment method**: the number of satisfiable formulas is at least
`(∑_F X F)^2 / ∑_F (X F)^2`, where `X F` is the number of assignments satisfying `F`. -/
lemma sq_sum_natCard_sat_le [Fintype A] [Fintype C] (m : ℕ) :
    ((∑ a, Nat.card {c // sat c a} ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      Nat.card {F : Fin m → C // ∃ a, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} *
        ((∑ p : A × A, Nat.card {c // sat c p.1 ∧ sat c p.2} ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
  classical
  rw [← sum_natCard_sat, ← sum_natCard_sat_sq]
  set X : (Fin m → C) → ℕ := fun F => Nat.card {a // ∀ j, sat (F j) a}
  have hX : ∀ F, X F ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ a, ∀ j, sat (F j) a := fun F => by
    rw [Nat.card_ne_zero, nonempty_subtype]
    exact and_iff_left inferInstance
  have hcard : Nat.card {F : Fin m → C // ∃ a, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} = #{F | X F ≠ 0} := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype]
    simp_rw [hX]
  rw [hcard, ← Finset.sum_filter_ne_zero, ← Finset.sum_filter_ne_zero (f := fun F => X F ^ 2)]
  push_cast
  simp_rw [show ∀ F, (X F ^ 2 ≠ 0) ↔ X F ≠ 0 from fun F => by simp]
  exact sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq

end Count

section Average

variable {C A : Type*} [Fintype C] (sat : C → A → Prop) [DecidableRel sat]

/-- One step of the **survival recursion**: average `f` over the solution set left after one
uniformly random clause filters `S`. -/
def filterStep (f : Finset A → ℝ) (S : Finset A) : ℝ :=
  (∑ c : C, f (S.filter (sat c))) / Fintype.card C

/-- `m` steps of the survival recursion average `f` over all `m`-clause formulas:
`filterStep^[m] f S = |C|^{-m} ∑_F f {a ∈ S | a satisfies F}`. -/
lemma filterStep_iterate (f : Finset A → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (S : Finset A) :
    (filterStep sat)^[m] f S =
      (∑ F : Fin m → C, f (S.filter fun a => ∀ j, sat (F j) a)) / Fintype.card C ^ m := by
  induction m generalizing S with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', filterStep]
    simp_rw [ih, Finset.filter_filter]
    have he : ∀ g : (Fin (m + 1) → C) → ℝ, ∑ F, g F = ∑ p : C × (Fin m → C), g (Fin.cons p.1 p.2) :=
      fun g => (Fintype.sum_equiv (Fin.consEquiv fun _ => C) _ _ fun _ => rfl).symm
    rw [he, Fintype.sum_prod_type, ← Finset.sum_div, div_div, ← pow_succ]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun F _ => ?_
    congr 1
    ext a
    simp [Fin.forall_fin_succ]

/-- The survival recursion started from the indicator of non-emptiness is the fraction of
`m`-clause formulas that some assignment in `S` satisfies. -/
lemma filterStep_iterate_nonempty (m : ℕ) (S : Finset A) :
    (filterStep sat)^[m] (fun T => if T.Nonempty then 1 else 0) S =
      (Nat.card {F : Fin m → C // ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} : ℝ) / Fintype.card C ^ m := by
  classical
  rw [filterStep_iterate, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.card_filter]
  push_cast
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun F _ => ?_
  simp [Finset.filter_nonempty_iff]

end Average

section Stream

variable {C A : Type*} [MeasurableSpace C] (sat : C → A → Prop)

/-- Under an i.i.d. clause stream the first `m` clauses all lie in `t` with probability
`μ t ^ m`. -/
lemma infinitePi_forall_lt_mem (μ : Measure C) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {t : Set C}
    (ht : MeasurableSet t) (m : ℕ) :
    Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => μ) {ω | ∀ i < m, ω i ∈ t} = μ t ^ m := by
  have : {ω : ℕ → C | ∀ i < m, ω i ∈ t} = Set.pi (Finset.range m : Set ℕ) fun _ => t := by
    ext ω
    simp
  rw [this, Measure.infinitePi_pi _ fun _ _ => ht, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_range]

section Countable

variable [MeasurableSingletonClass C] [Countable C]

/-- **Union bound** for an i.i.d. clause stream: some assignment of `S` satisfies the first `m`
clauses with probability at most `∑_{a ∈ S} P(a satisfies a clause)^m`. -/
lemma infinitePi_exists_forall_sat_le (μ : Measure C) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (S : Finset A)
    (m : ℕ) :
    Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => μ) {ω | ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a} ≤
      ∑ a ∈ S, μ {c | sat c a} ^ m := by
  have : {ω : ℕ → C | ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a} =
      ⋃ a ∈ S, {ω | ∀ i < m, ω i ∈ {c | sat c a}} := by
    ext ω
    simp
  rw [this]
  refine (measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _).trans_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_)
  exact infinitePi_forall_lt_mem μ (Set.to_countable _).measurableSet m

/-- If each assignment of `S` satisfies a random clause with probability at most `q`, some
assignment of `S` satisfies the first `m` clauses with probability at most `|S| q^m`. -/
lemma infinitePi_exists_forall_sat_le_card_mul (μ : Measure C) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : Finset A) {q : ℝ≥0∞} (hq : ∀ a ∈ S, μ {c | sat c a} ≤ q) (m : ℕ) :
    Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => μ) {ω | ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a} ≤
      #S * q ^ m := by
  refine (infinitePi_exists_forall_sat_le sat μ S m).trans ?_
  rw [← nsmul_eq_mul]
  exact Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ _ fun a ha => by gcongr; exact hq a ha

/-- If every assignment of `S` fails a random clause with positive probability, then almost
surely some finite prefix of the stream is satisfied by no assignment of `S`. -/
lemma infinitePi_forall_exists_forall_sat_eq_zero (μ : Measure C) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : Finset A) (hS : ∀ a ∈ S, μ {c | sat c a} < 1) :
    Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => μ) {ω | ∀ m, ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a} = 0 := by
  set q := S.sup fun a => μ {c | sat c a}
  have hq1 : q < 1 := (Finset.sup_lt_iff (by simp)).2 hS
  have hsub : ∀ m, {ω : ℕ → C | ∀ m, ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a} ⊆
      {ω | ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a} := fun m ω hω => hω m
  have hle : ∀ m, Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => μ)
      {ω | ∀ m, ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a} ≤ #S * q ^ m := fun m =>
    (measure_mono (hsub m)).trans (infinitePi_exists_forall_sat_le_card_mul sat μ S
      (fun a ha => Finset.le_sup (f := fun a => μ {c | sat c a}) ha) m)
  have ht : Tendsto (fun m => (#S : ℝ≥0∞) * q ^ m) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul (ENNReal.tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hq1)
      (Or.inr (by simp))
  exact le_antisymm (ge_of_tendsto' ht hle) zero_le

end Countable

variable [MeasurableSingletonClass C] [Fintype C]

/-- Under the uniform law on a finite clause set, a fixed assignment satisfies a random clause
with probability (number of clauses it satisfies) / (number of clauses). -/
lemma uniformOn_univ_sat (a : A) :
    uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C) {c | sat c a} = Nat.card {c // sat c a} / Fintype.card C := by
  rw [uniformOn_univ, Measure.count_apply_finite _ (Set.toFinite _),
    ← Nat.card_eq_card_finite_toFinset]
  rfl

/-- An assignment that some clause falsifies satisfies a uniformly random clause with
probability `< 1`. -/
lemma uniformOn_univ_sat_lt_one {a : A} (h : ∃ c, ¬ sat c a) :
    uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C) {c | sat c a} < 1 := by
  classical
  rw [uniformOn_univ_sat]
  have hlt : Nat.card {c // sat c a} < Fintype.card C := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
    exact Fintype.card_subtype_lt hc
  have hpos : (Fintype.card C : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by
    have : Nonempty C := ⟨h.choose⟩
    simp
  rw [ENNReal.div_lt_iff (Or.inl hpos) (Or.inl (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _)), one_mul]
  exact_mod_cast hlt

/-- Under the i.i.d. uniform stream on a finite clause set, an event about the first `m`
clauses has probability equal to its share of the `|C|^m` formulas with `m` clauses. -/
lemma infinitePi_uniformOn_prefix [Nonempty C] (m : ℕ) (P : (Fin m → C) → Prop) :
    (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C))
      {ω | P fun j : Fin m => ω j}).toReal = (Nat.card {F // P F} : ℝ) / Fintype.card C ^ m := by
  classical
  set μ := uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C)
  let r : (ℕ → C) → (Fin m → C) := fun ω j => ω j
  have hr : Measurable r := by fun_prop
  have hmap : (Measure.infinitePi fun _ : ℕ => μ).map r = Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => μ := by
    refine (Measure.pi_eq fun t ht => ?_).symm
    rw [Measure.map_apply hr (.univ_pi ht)]
    have : r ⁻¹' Set.univ.pi t = Set.pi (Finset.range m : Set ℕ)
        (fun i => if h : i < m then t ⟨i, h⟩ else Set.univ) := by
      ext ω
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_pi, Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio, r]
      constructor
      · intro h i hi
        simpa [hi] using h ⟨i, hi⟩
      · intro h j
        simpa [j.2] using h j j.2
    rw [this, Measure.infinitePi_pi _ (fun i _ => by split_ifs <;> simp [ht _]), Finset.prod_range]
    simp
  have hpi : (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => μ) = uniformOn Set.univ := by
    have := uniformOn_pi (ι := Fin m) (f := fun _ => (Set.univ : Set C))
    rw [Set.pi_univ] at this
    exact this.symm
  have hset : {ω : ℕ → C | P fun j : Fin m => ω j} = r ⁻¹' {F | P F} := rfl
  rw [hset, ← Measure.map_apply hr (Set.toFinite _).measurableSet, hmap, hpi, uniformOn_univ,
    Measure.count_apply_finite _ (Set.toFinite _), ← Nat.card_eq_card_finite_toFinset,
    ENNReal.toReal_div]
  simp [Fintype.card_subtype]

/-- Under the i.i.d. uniform clause stream, the probability that some assignment of `S`
satisfies the first `m` clauses is the fraction of `m`-clause formulas that one of them
satisfies. -/
lemma infinitePi_uniformOn_exists_forall_sat [Nonempty C] (S : Finset A) (m : ℕ) :
    (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C))
      {ω | ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a}).toReal =
      (Nat.card {F : Fin m → C // ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} : ℝ) / Fintype.card C ^ m := by
  have : {ω : ℕ → C | ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a} =
      {ω | ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ j : Fin m, sat (ω j) a} := by
    ext ω
    simp [Fin.forall_iff]
  rw [this]
  exact infinitePi_uniformOn_prefix m fun F => ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ j, sat (F j) a

/-- The complementary event: no assignment of `S` satisfies the first `m` clauses. -/
lemma infinitePi_uniformOn_not_exists_forall_sat [Nonempty C] (S : Finset A) (m : ℕ) :
    (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C))
      {ω | ¬ ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a}).toReal =
      1 - (Nat.card {F : Fin m → C // ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} : ℝ) / Fintype.card C ^ m := by
  classical
  have : {ω : ℕ → C | ¬ ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a} =
      {ω | ¬ ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ j : Fin m, sat (ω j) a} := by
    ext ω
    simp [Fin.forall_iff]
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card C ^ m := by positivity
  rw [this, infinitePi_uniformOn_prefix m fun F => ¬ ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ j, sat (F j) a,
    Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    Nat.cast_sub (Fintype.card_subtype_le _), Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_pow,
    sub_div, div_self hc.ne']

/-- The survival recursion started from the indicator of non-emptiness is the probability, under
the i.i.d. uniform clause stream, that some assignment of `S` satisfies the first `m` clauses. -/
lemma filterStep_iterate_nonempty_eq_infinitePi [Nonempty C] [DecidableRel sat] (S : Finset A)
    (m : ℕ) :
    (filterStep sat)^[m] (fun T => if T.Nonempty then 1 else 0) S =
      (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C))
        {ω | ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a}).toReal := by
  rw [filterStep_iterate_nonempty, infinitePi_uniformOn_exists_forall_sat]

/-- One clause of the i.i.d. uniform stream falsifies every assignment of `S` with probability
(number of clauses falsifying all of `S`) / (number of clauses). -/
lemma infinitePi_uniformOn_forall_not_sat_one [Nonempty C] (S : Finset A) :
    (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C))
      {ω | ¬ ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < 1, sat (ω i) a}).toReal =
      (Nat.card {c // ∀ a ∈ S, ¬ sat c a} : ℝ) / Fintype.card C := by
  have : {ω : ℕ → C | ¬ ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < 1, sat (ω i) a} =
      {ω | (fun F : Fin 1 → C => ∀ a ∈ S, ¬ sat (F 0) a) fun j => ω j} := by
    ext ω
    simp
  rw [this, infinitePi_uniformOn_prefix 1 fun F => ∀ a ∈ S, ¬ sat (F 0) a, pow_one]
  congr 2
  exact Nat.card_congr ((Equiv.funUnique (Fin 1) C).subtypeEquiv fun F => Iff.rfl)

end Stream

section KClause

variable {n k : ℕ}

/-- A **`k`-clause** on `n` variables: a set of `k` variables together with, for each of them,
the value that makes its literal true. -/
abbrev KClause (n k : ℕ) := (s : {s : Finset (Fin n) // s.card = k}) × (s.1 → Bool)

/-- An assignment satisfies a `k`-clause when it agrees with it on some variable of the clause. -/
def KClause.Sat (c : KClause n k) (a : Fin n → Bool) : Prop := ∃ v : c.1.1, a v = c.2 v

/-- There are `C(n,k) 2^k` clauses of width `k` on `n` variables. -/
lemma natCard_kclause : Nat.card (KClause n k) = n.choose k * 2 ^ k := by
  rw [Nat.card_sigma]
  have : ∀ s : {s : Finset (Fin n) // s.card = k}, Nat.card (s.1 → Bool) = 2 ^ k := fun s => by
    rw [Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := Bool), Fintype.card_bool,
      Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_coe, s.2]
  simp_rw [this, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_finset_len, Fintype.card_fin,
    smul_eq_mul]

/-- The clauses falsified by every assignment of a set `T ∋ a₀` are the clauses on `k` variables
where all of `T` agrees with `a₀`, with the literals that `a₀` falsifies: there are
`C(d, k)` of them, `d` the number of such variables. -/
lemma natCard_kclause_forall_not_sat (T : Finset (Fin n → Bool)) {a₀ : Fin n → Bool}
    (h₀ : a₀ ∈ T) :
    Nat.card {c : KClause n k // ∀ a ∈ T, ¬ c.Sat a} =
      (#{v | ∀ a ∈ T, a v = a₀ v}).choose k := by
  classical
  set D : Finset (Fin n) := {v | ∀ a ∈ T, a v = a₀ v}
  have hσ : ∀ c : KClause n k, (∀ a ∈ T, ¬ c.Sat a) → ∀ v, c.2 v = !a₀ v := fun c hc v => by
    have h : ¬ a₀ v = c.2 v := fun h => hc a₀ h₀ ⟨v, h⟩
    cases h1 : c.2 v <;> cases h2 : a₀ v <;> simp_all
  rw [← Finset.card_powersetCard, ← Fintype.card_coe, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  refine Nat.card_congr
    { toFun := fun c => ⟨c.1.1.1, Finset.mem_powersetCard.2 ⟨fun v hv => ?_, c.1.1.2⟩⟩
      invFun := fun s => ⟨⟨⟨s.1, (Finset.mem_powersetCard.1 s.2).2⟩, fun v => !a₀ v⟩, ?_⟩
      left_inv := ?_
      right_inv := fun s => rfl }
  · simp only [D, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    intro a ha
    have h3 : ¬ a v = c.1.2 ⟨v, hv⟩ := fun h => c.2 a ha ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, h⟩
    rw [hσ c.1 c.2 ⟨v, hv⟩] at h3
    cases h : a v <;> cases h' : a₀ v <;> simp_all
  · intro a ha ⟨v, hv⟩
    have hvD := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.1 s.2).1 v.2
    simp only [D, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hvD
    rw [hvD a ha] at hv
    cases h : a₀ v <;> simp_all
  · rintro ⟨⟨s, σ⟩, hc⟩
    have := hσ ⟨s, σ⟩ hc
    simp only [Subtype.mk.injEq, Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq, true_and]
    exact funext fun v => (this v).symm

/-- A fixed assignment falsifies exactly `C(n,k)` of the `k`-clauses. -/
lemma natCard_kclause_not_sat (a : Fin n → Bool) :
    Nat.card {c : KClause n k // ¬ c.Sat a} = n.choose k := by
  have := natCard_kclause_forall_not_sat (k := k) {a} (Finset.mem_singleton_self a)
  simp only [Finset.mem_singleton, forall_eq] at this
  rw [this]
  simp

/-- A fixed assignment satisfies exactly `C(n,k) (2^k - 1)` of the `k`-clauses. -/
lemma natCard_kclause_sat (a : Fin n → Bool) :
    Nat.card {c : KClause n k // c.Sat a} = n.choose k * (2 ^ k - 1) := by
  classical
  have h := Nat.card_congr (Equiv.sumCompl fun c : KClause n k => c.Sat a)
  rw [Nat.card_sum, natCard_kclause, natCard_kclause_not_sat] at h
  rw [Nat.mul_sub_one]
  omega

/-- **Pair count** for the second moment: the clauses satisfied by both `a` and `b` number
`C(n,k) 2^k - 2 C(n,k) + C(z,k)`, `z` the number of variables where `a` and `b` agree. -/
lemma natCard_kclause_sat_and (a b : Fin n → Bool) :
    Nat.card {c : KClause n k // c.Sat a ∧ c.Sat b} + 2 * n.choose k =
      n.choose k * 2 ^ k + (#{v | a v = b v}).choose k := by
  classical
  have hz := natCard_kclause_forall_not_sat (k := k) {a, b}
    (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self b))
  have hz' : (#{v | ∀ x ∈ ({a, b} : Finset (Fin n → Bool)), x v = b v}) = #{v | a v = b v} := by
    congr 1
    ext v
    simp
  rw [hz'] at hz
  have ha := natCard_kclause_not_sat (k := k) a
  have hb := natCard_kclause_not_sat (k := k) b
  have hN := natCard_kclause (n := n) (k := k)
  simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype] at hz ha hb hN ⊢
  have hu := Finset.card_union_add_card_inter
    ({c | ¬ c.Sat a} : Finset (KClause n k)) {c | ¬ c.Sat b}
  have hc := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (univ : Finset (KClause n k)))
    fun c : KClause n k => c.Sat a ∧ c.Sat b
  rw [← Finset.filter_or, ← Finset.filter_and] at hu
  have e1 : ({c | ¬ c.Sat a ∨ ¬ c.Sat b} : Finset (KClause n k)) =
      ({c | ¬ (c.Sat a ∧ c.Sat b)} : Finset (KClause n k)) :=
    Finset.filter_congr fun c _ => by tauto
  have e2 : ({c | ¬ c.Sat a ∧ ¬ c.Sat b} : Finset (KClause n k)) =
      ({c | ∀ x ∈ ({a, b} : Finset (Fin n → Bool)), ¬ c.Sat x} : Finset (KClause n k)) :=
    Finset.filter_congr fun c _ => by simp
  rw [e1, e2, hz, ha, hb] at hu
  rw [Finset.card_univ] at hc
  omega

/-- For `k ≤ n` some `k`-clause falsifies any given assignment. -/
lemma exists_kclause_not_sat (hk : k ≤ n) (a : Fin n → Bool) : ∃ c : KClause n k, ¬ c.Sat a := by
  have h : 0 < Nat.card {c : KClause n k // ¬ c.Sat a} := by
    rw [natCard_kclause_not_sat]
    exact Nat.choose_pos hk
  obtain ⟨⟨c, hc⟩⟩ := (Nat.card_pos_iff.1 h).1
  exact ⟨c, hc⟩

end KClause

section SignClause

variable {n k : ℕ}

/-- A `k`-clause as a **sign vector**: each variable is absent (`none`) or carries the value that
makes its literal true, and exactly `k` variables are present. -/
abbrev SignClause (n k : ℕ) :=
  {C : Fin n → Option Bool // (Finset.univ.filter fun i => (C i).isSome).card = k}

/-- An assignment satisfies a sign-vector clause when it agrees with it on a present variable. -/
def SignClause.Sat (C : SignClause n k) (a : Fin n → Bool) : Prop := ∃ i, C.1 i = some (a i)

/-- Two `k`-clauses with the same variables and the same literal values are equal. -/
lemma KClause.ext {c d : KClause n k} (h : c.1.1 = d.1.1)
    (h' : ∀ v (hc : v ∈ c.1.1) (hd : v ∈ d.1.1), c.2 ⟨v, hc⟩ = d.2 ⟨v, hd⟩) : c = d := by
  obtain ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, σ⟩ := c
  obtain ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, τ⟩ := d
  simp only at h
  subst h
  simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq, true_and]
  exact funext fun v => h' v.1 v.2 v.2

/-- Sign vectors and (variable set, literal values) pairs are the same `k`-clauses. -/
def signClauseEquiv : SignClause n k ≃ KClause n k where
  toFun C := ⟨⟨Finset.univ.filter fun i => (C.1 i).isSome, C.2⟩, fun v => (C.1 v).getD false⟩
  invFun c := ⟨fun i => if h : i ∈ c.1.1 then some (c.2 ⟨i, h⟩) else none, by
    refine Eq.trans ?_ c.1.2
    congr 1
    ext i
    by_cases h : i ∈ c.1.1 <;> simp [h]⟩
  left_inv C := by
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun i => ?_)
    cases h : C.1 i <;> simp [h]
  right_inv c := by
    refine KClause.ext ?_ fun v hc hd => ?_
    · ext i
      by_cases h : i ∈ c.1.1 <;> simp [h]
    · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hc
      simp [hd]

/-- `signClauseEquiv` preserves satisfaction. -/
lemma signClauseEquiv_sat (C : SignClause n k) (a : Fin n → Bool) :
    (signClauseEquiv C).Sat a ↔ C.Sat a := by
  simp only [KClause.Sat, SignClause.Sat, signClauseEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, h⟩
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Option.isSome_iff_exists] at hv
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hv
    exact ⟨v, by simp_all⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, h⟩
    exact ⟨⟨i, by simp [h]⟩, by simp [h]⟩

/-- There are `C(n,k) 2^k` sign-vector clauses of width `k`. -/
lemma natCard_signClause : Nat.card (SignClause n k) = n.choose k * 2 ^ k := by
  rw [Nat.card_congr signClauseEquiv, natCard_kclause]

/-- A fixed assignment satisfies exactly `C(n,k) (2^k - 1)` sign-vector clauses. -/
lemma natCard_signClause_sat (a : Fin n → Bool) :
    Nat.card {C : SignClause n k // C.Sat a} = n.choose k * (2 ^ k - 1) := by
  rw [← natCard_kclause_sat a]
  exact Nat.card_congr (signClauseEquiv.subtypeEquiv fun C => (signClauseEquiv_sat C a).symm)

end SignClause

section FirstMoment

/-- **First-moment bound for random `k`-SAT** in any clause model with `C(n,k) 2^k` clauses of
which each assignment satisfies `C(n,k) (2^k - 1)` (`k ≤ n`): the fraction of `m`-clause formulas
that are satisfiable is at most `2^n (1 - 2^{-k})^m`. -/
lemma satisfiable_div_le_of_natCard {n k : ℕ} {C : Type*} [Finite C]
    (sat : C → (Fin n → Bool) → Prop) (hk : k ≤ n) (hN : Nat.card C = n.choose k * 2 ^ k)
    (hs : ∀ a, Nat.card {c // sat c a} = n.choose k * (2 ^ k - 1)) (m : ℕ) :
    (Nat.card {F : Fin m → C // ∃ a, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} : ℝ) / Nat.card (Fin m → C) ≤
      2 ^ n * (1 - ((2 : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹) ^ m := by
  have h := natCard_exists_forall_sat_div_le sat m (n.choose k * (2 ^ k - 1)) fun a => (hs a).le
  have hA : Nat.card (Fin n → Bool) = 2 ^ n := by simp
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < n.choose k := by exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_pos hk
  have h1 : (1 : ℕ) ≤ 2 ^ k := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  rw [hA, hN] at h
  convert h using 3
  · push_cast
    ring
  · rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub h1, Nat.cast_pow]
    field_simp
    ring

/-- The first-moment bound for `k`-clauses. -/
lemma natCard_kclause_satisfiable_div_le {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) (m : ℕ) :
    (Nat.card {F : Fin m → KClause n k // ∃ a, ∀ j, (F j).Sat a} : ℝ) /
      Nat.card (Fin m → KClause n k) ≤ 2 ^ n * (1 - ((2 : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹) ^ m :=
  satisfiable_div_le_of_natCard (fun c a => KClause.Sat c a) hk natCard_kclause
    natCard_kclause_sat m

/-- The first-moment bound for sign-vector clauses. -/
lemma natCard_signClause_satisfiable_div_le {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) (m : ℕ) :
    (Nat.card {F : Fin m → SignClause n k // ∃ a, ∀ j, (F j).Sat a} : ℝ) /
      Nat.card (Fin m → SignClause n k) ≤ 2 ^ n * (1 - ((2 : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹) ^ m :=
  satisfiable_div_le_of_natCard (fun C a => SignClause.Sat C a) hk natCard_signClause
    natCard_signClause_sat m

section StreamModel

variable {n k : ℕ} {C : Type*} [Fintype C] [MeasurableSpace C] [MeasurableSingletonClass C]
  (sat : C → (Fin n → Bool) → Prop)

/-- **First-moment bound, stream form**: under the i.i.d. uniform stream on a clause model with
`C(n,k) 2^k` clauses of which each assignment satisfies `C(n,k) (2^k - 1)` (`k ≤ n`), some
assignment satisfies the first `m` clauses with probability at most `2^n (1 - 2^{-k})^m`. -/
lemma infinitePi_uniformOn_exists_forall_sat_le_of_natCard (hk : k ≤ n)
    (hN : Nat.card C = n.choose k * 2 ^ k)
    (hs : ∀ a, Nat.card {c // sat c a} = n.choose k * (2 ^ k - 1)) (m : ℕ) :
    (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C))
      {ω | ∃ a, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a}).toReal ≤ 2 ^ n * (1 - ((2 : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹) ^ m := by
  have : Nonempty C := by
    have h : 0 < Nat.card C := by rw [hN]; exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.choose_pos hk) (by positivity)
    exact (Nat.card_pos_iff.1 h).1
  have e : {ω : ℕ → C | ∃ a, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a} =
      {ω | ∃ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n → Bool)), ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a} := by
    simp
  have h := satisfiable_div_le_of_natCard sat hk hN hs m
  rw [Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_fin, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := C)] at h
  rw [e, infinitePi_uniformOn_exists_forall_sat]
  simpa using h

/-- Under the i.i.d. uniform stream on a clause model in which every assignment is falsified by
some clause, almost surely some finite prefix is unsatisfiable. -/
lemma infinitePi_uniformOn_forall_exists_forall_sat_eq_zero [Nonempty C]
    (h : ∀ a, ∃ c, ¬ sat c a) :
    Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C))
      {ω | ∀ m, ∃ a, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a} = 0 := by
  have := infinitePi_forall_exists_forall_sat_eq_zero sat (uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C))
    Finset.univ fun a _ => uniformOn_univ_sat_lt_one sat (h a)
  simpa using this

end StreamModel

end FirstMoment

end

end TheoremOS.Probability

import Submission.Library.TheoremOS.Probability.RandomKSAT

/-!
# Random k-SAT: the first-moment density

The first-moment upper bound on the random `k`-SAT threshold. Contents: the density
`ksatFirstMomentDensity k = log 2 / (-log (1 - 2^{-k}))`; `b^n q^⌊c n⌋ → 0` for `0 < q < 1` and
`c > log b / (-log q)` (`tendsto_pow_mul_pow_floor`), in particular
`2^n (1 - 2^{-k})^⌊c n⌋ → 0` above the density; so with `⌊c n⌋` uniform random clauses of width
`k ≥ 1` the fraction of satisfiable sign-vector formulas tends to `0`, and under the uniform
clause stream the probability that the first `⌊c n⌋` clauses are satisfiable tends to `0`, for any
clause model with `C(n,k) 2^k` clauses of which each assignment satisfies `C(n,k) (2^k - 1)`.

Sources: J. Franco and M. Paull, "Probabilistic analysis of the Davis–Putnam procedure for solving
the satisfiability problem", Discrete Appl. Math. 5 (1983), 77–87; V. Chvátal and B. Reed, "Mick
gets some (the odds are on his side)", FOCS 1992; D. Achlioptas, "Random satisfiability", Chapter 8
of *Handbook of Satisfiability*, IOS Press, 2009 (the bound `r_k ≤ 2^k log 2`). Textbook material;
nothing here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: `log 2 / (-log (1 - ((2 : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹))` is `ksatFirstMomentDensity k` by `rfl`. The
counting and stream statements reuse the clause models of `TheoremOS.Probability.RandomKSAT`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Probability

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter Topology

noncomputable section

/-- The **first-moment density** of random `k`-SAT, `log 2 / (-log (1 - 2^{-k}))`: above it the
expected number of satisfying assignments of a formula with `c n` clauses tends to `0`. -/
def ksatFirstMomentDensity (k : ℕ) : ℝ := Real.log 2 / (-Real.log (1 - ((2 : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹))

/-- `b^n q^⌊c n⌋ → 0` when `0 < q < 1` and `c > log b / (-log q)`. -/
lemma tendsto_pow_mul_pow_floor {b q c : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (hc : Real.log b / (-Real.log q) < c) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => b ^ n * q ^ ⌊c * n⌋₊) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hL : 0 < -Real.log q := neg_pos.2 (Real.log_neg hq0 hq1)
  set ε := c * (-Real.log q) - Real.log b with hε
  have hε0 : 0 < ε := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hL] at hc
    linarith
  have hbound : ∀ n : ℕ, b ^ n * q ^ ⌊c * n⌋₊ ≤ q⁻¹ * Real.exp (-ε) ^ n := fun n => by
    have hfl : c * n - 1 ≤ (⌊c * n⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
      have := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (c * n)
      rcases le_or_gt 0 (c * n) with h0 | h0
      · linarith
      · have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ⌊c * n⌋₊ := Nat.cast_nonneg _
        linarith
    have hqm : q ^ ⌊c * n⌋₊ ≤ Real.exp ((c * n - 1) * Real.log q) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hq0, Real.exp_le_exp, mul_comm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_right hfl (Real.log_neg hq0 hq1).le
    have hbn : b ^ n = Real.exp (n * Real.log b) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hb, mul_comm]
    calc b ^ n * q ^ ⌊c * n⌋₊
        ≤ Real.exp (n * Real.log b) * Real.exp ((c * n - 1) * Real.log q) := by
          rw [hbn]
          gcongr
      _ = q⁻¹ * Real.exp (-ε) ^ n := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_log (inv_pos.2 hq0), ← Real.exp_add,
            Real.log_inv, hε]
          congr 1
          ring
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => q⁻¹ * Real.exp (-ε) ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (Real.exp_pos _).le
      (Real.exp_lt_one_iff.2 (neg_neg_of_pos hε0))).const_mul q⁻¹
  exact squeeze_zero (fun n => by positivity) hbound ht

/-- Above the first-moment density, `2^n (1 - 2^{-k})^⌊c n⌋ → 0`. -/
lemma tendsto_two_pow_mul_pow_floor {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {c : ℝ}
    (hc : ksatFirstMomentDensity k < c) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) ^ n * (1 - ((2 : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹) ^ ⌊c * n⌋₊) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ k := by simpa using pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hk
  have hi : ((2 : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by linarith)
  have hi0 : 0 < ((2 : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ := by positivity
  exact tendsto_pow_mul_pow_floor two_pos (by linarith) (by linarith) hc

/-- Above the first-moment density, random `k`-SAT with sign-vector clauses and `⌊c n⌋` clauses
is unsatisfiable with probability tending to `1`. -/
lemma tendsto_natCard_signClause_satisfiable_div {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {c : ℝ}
    (hc : ksatFirstMomentDensity k < c) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
      (Nat.card {F : Fin ⌊c * n⌋₊ → SignClause n k // ∃ a, ∀ j, (F j).Sat a} : ℝ) /
        Nat.card (Fin ⌊c * n⌋₊ → SignClause n k)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  refine squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun n => by positivity)
    ((eventually_ge_atTop k).mono fun n hn => natCard_signClause_satisfiable_div_le hn _)
    (tendsto_two_pow_mul_pow_floor hk hc)

/-- Above the first-moment density, under the uniform clause stream of any clause model with
`C(n,k) 2^k` clauses of which each assignment satisfies `C(n,k) (2^k - 1)`, the first `⌊c n⌋`
clauses are satisfiable with probability tending to `0`. -/
lemma tendsto_infinitePi_uniformOn_exists_forall_sat {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {c : ℝ}
    (hc : ksatFirstMomentDensity k < c) (C : ℕ → Type*) [∀ n, Fintype (C n)]
    [∀ n, MeasurableSpace (C n)] [∀ n, MeasurableSingletonClass (C n)]
    (sat : ∀ n, C n → (Fin n → Bool) → Prop) (hN : ∀ n, Nat.card (C n) = n.choose k * 2 ^ k)
    (hs : ∀ n a, Nat.card {x // sat n x a} = n.choose k * (2 ^ k - 1)) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (C n)))
      {ω | ∃ a, ∀ i < ⌊c * n⌋₊, sat n (ω i) a}).toReal) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
  squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)
    ((eventually_ge_atTop k).mono fun n hn =>
      infinitePi_uniformOn_exists_forall_sat_le_of_natCard (sat n) hn (hN n) (hs n) _)
    (tendsto_two_pow_mul_pow_floor hk hc)

end

end TheoremOS.Probability
