import Mathlib

/-!
# Edit distance and longest common subsequences

Unit-cost edit distance on lists. Contents: length-indexed chains `StepChain R n x y` of a step
relation (concatenation, reversal for symmetric steps, monotone images, Lipschitz potentials);
single edits `IsEditStep` (insertion, deletion, substitution at any position) with their
constructors, symmetry, context closure and length bound; `editDist x y`, the least number of
edits, as a metric on `List α` (`editDist_self`, `editDist_eq_zero_iff`, `editDist_comm`,
`editDist_triangle`); `|x| ≤ |y| + ed`, `ed ≤ |x| + |y|`, `ed ≤ max |x| |y|`, the Hamming bound for
equal lengths, prefix/suffix and concatenation bounds; `lcsLength x y`, the longest common
subsequence, with `max |x| |y| ≤ lcs + ed` and `ed + 2 lcs ≤ |x| + |y|`; and the block-code bounds
`ed (map f x) (map f y) ≤ ed x y` and `ed (flatMap c x) (flatMap c y) ≤ w · ed x y` when every
codeword has length `w`.

Sources: V. I. Levenshtein, Binary codes capable of correcting deletions, insertions, and
reversals, Soviet Physics Doklady 10 (1966) 707–710; R. A. Wagner and M. J. Fischer, The
string-to-string correction problem, J. ACM 21 (1974) 168–173; D. Gusfield, *Algorithms on Strings,
Trees, and Sequences*, Cambridge University Press, 1997, Sections 11.1–11.3 and 11.6. Textbook
material; nothing here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: a statement with its own inductive single edit (`insert`/`delete`/`substitute` written as
`p ++ q ↦ p ++ a :: q`, `p ++ a :: q ↦ p ++ q`, `p ++ a :: q ↦ p ++ b :: q`) and its own script
inductive gets `Script x y n ↔ StepChain IsEditStep n x y` by induction in each direction, using
`IsEditStep.insert`/`delete`/`substitute` one way and `rcases` on `IsEditStep` the other way; then
`sInf {n | Script x y n} = editDist x y` by `sInf_eq_editDist`. A longest common subsequence
defined as `sSup {n | ∃ z, z <+ x ∧ z <+ y ∧ z.length = n}` is `lcsLength x y` by `rfl`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Combinatorics

open List

universe u v

section StepChain

variable {β : Type u}

/-- `StepChain R n x y`: `y` is reached from `x` by exactly `n` steps of `R`. -/
inductive StepChain (R : β → β → Prop) : ℕ → β → β → Prop
  | nil (x : β) : StepChain R 0 x x
  | cons {n : ℕ} {x y z : β} : R x y → StepChain R n y z → StepChain R (n + 1) x z

variable {R : β → β → Prop}

theorem StepChain.of_eq {m n : ℕ} {x y : β} (h : StepChain R m x y) (hmn : m = n) :
    StepChain R n x y := hmn ▸ h

theorem StepChain.single {x y : β} (h : R x y) : StepChain R 1 x y := .cons h (.nil y)

theorem StepChain.eq_of_zero {x y : β} (h : StepChain R 0 x y) : x = y := by
  cases h
  rfl

theorem StepChain.trans {m n : ℕ} {x y z : β} (h₁ : StepChain R m x y)
    (h₂ : StepChain R n y z) : StepChain R (m + n) x z := by
  induction h₁ with
  | nil x => exact h₂.of_eq (Nat.zero_add n).symm
  | cons hxy _ ih => exact (StepChain.cons hxy (ih h₂)).of_eq (by omega)

/-- Reversal of a chain of a symmetric relation. -/
theorem StepChain.symm (hR : ∀ a b, R a b → R b a) {n : ℕ} {x y : β}
    (h : StepChain R n x y) : StepChain R n y x := by
  induction h with
  | nil x => exact .nil x
  | cons hxy _ ih => exact ih.trans (.single (hR _ _ hxy))

/-- Image of a chain under a map sending `R`-steps to `R'`-steps. -/
theorem StepChain.map {γ : Type v} {R' : γ → γ → Prop} (g : β → γ)
    (hg : ∀ a b, R a b → R' (g a) (g b)) {n : ℕ} {x y : β} (h : StepChain R n x y) :
    StepChain R' n (g x) (g y) := by
  induction h with
  | nil x => exact .nil _
  | cons hxy _ ih => exact .cons (hg _ _ hxy) ih

theorem StepChain.mono {R' : β → β → Prop} (hR : ∀ a b, R a b → R' a b) {n : ℕ} {x y : β}
    (h : StepChain R n x y) : StepChain R' n x y :=
  h.map id hR

/-- A potential that grows by at most one per step grows by at most `n` along `n` steps. -/
theorem StepChain.le_add (φ : β → ℕ) (hφ : ∀ a b, R a b → φ b ≤ φ a + 1) {n : ℕ} {x y : β}
    (h : StepChain R n x y) : φ y ≤ φ x + n := by
  induction h with
  | nil x => exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
  | cons hxy _ ih => have := hφ _ _ hxy; omega

/-- Real-valued form: a potential with increments at most `c` grows by at most `n c`. -/
theorem StepChain.le_add_mul (φ : β → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hφ : ∀ a b, R a b → φ b ≤ φ a + c) {n : ℕ}
    {x y : β} (h : StepChain R n x y) : φ y ≤ φ x + n * c := by
  induction h with
  | nil x => simp
  | cons hxy _ ih =>
    have := hφ _ _ hxy
    push_cast
    linarith

end StepChain

section EditStep

variable {α : Type u}

/-- One unit-cost edit: an insertion, a deletion or a substitution, at any position. -/
def IsEditStep (u v : List α) : Prop :=
  (∃ p q : List α, ∃ a : α, u = p ++ q ∧ v = p ++ a :: q) ∨
  (∃ p q : List α, ∃ a : α, u = p ++ a :: q ∧ v = p ++ q) ∨
  (∃ p q : List α, ∃ a b : α, u = p ++ a :: q ∧ v = p ++ b :: q)

namespace IsEditStep

theorem insert (p q : List α) (a : α) : IsEditStep (p ++ q) (p ++ a :: q) :=
  Or.inl ⟨p, q, a, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem delete (p q : List α) (a : α) : IsEditStep (p ++ a :: q) (p ++ q) :=
  Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨p, q, a, rfl, rfl⟩)

theorem substitute (p q : List α) (a b : α) : IsEditStep (p ++ a :: q) (p ++ b :: q) :=
  Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨p, q, a, b, rfl, rfl⟩)

theorem symm {u v : List α} (h : IsEditStep u v) : IsEditStep v u := by
  rcases h with ⟨p, q, a, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, q, a, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, q, a, b, rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact delete p q a
  · exact insert p q a
  · exact substitute p q b a

theorem insert_head (a : α) (x : List α) : IsEditStep x (a :: x) := insert [] x a

theorem delete_head (a : α) (x : List α) : IsEditStep (a :: x) x := delete [] x a

theorem substitute_head (a b : α) (x : List α) : IsEditStep (a :: x) (b :: x) :=
  substitute [] x a b

theorem append_left (w : List α) {u v : List α} (h : IsEditStep u v) :
    IsEditStep (w ++ u) (w ++ v) := by
  rcases h with ⟨p, q, a, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, q, a, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, q, a, b, rfl, rfl⟩
  · simpa using insert (w ++ p) q a
  · simpa using delete (w ++ p) q a
  · simpa using substitute (w ++ p) q a b

theorem append_right (w : List α) {u v : List α} (h : IsEditStep u v) :
    IsEditStep (u ++ w) (v ++ w) := by
  rcases h with ⟨p, q, a, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, q, a, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, q, a, b, rfl, rfl⟩
  · simpa using insert p (q ++ w) a
  · simpa using delete p (q ++ w) a
  · simpa using substitute p (q ++ w) a b

theorem cons (c : α) {u v : List α} (h : IsEditStep u v) : IsEditStep (c :: u) (c :: v) :=
  append_left [c] h

theorem length_le {u v : List α} (h : IsEditStep u v) : v.length ≤ u.length + 1 := by
  rcases h with ⟨p, q, a, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, q, a, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, q, a, b, rfl, rfl⟩ <;>
    simp <;> omega

theorem map {γ : Type v} (f : α → γ) {u v : List α} (h : IsEditStep u v) :
    IsEditStep (u.map f) (v.map f) := by
  rcases h with ⟨p, q, a, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, q, a, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, q, a, b, rfl, rfl⟩
  · simpa using insert (p.map f) (q.map f) (f a)
  · simpa using delete (p.map f) (q.map f) (f a)
  · simpa using substitute (p.map f) (q.map f) (f a) (f b)

end IsEditStep

/-- Unit-cost edit distance: the least length of an edit chain from `x` to `y`. -/
noncomputable def editDist (x y : List α) : ℕ := sInf {n | StepChain IsEditStep n x y}

/-- Deleting every letter of `x` takes `|x|` steps. -/
theorem stepChain_length_nil (x : List α) : StepChain IsEditStep x.length x [] := by
  induction x with
  | nil => exact .nil _
  | cons a x ih => exact (StepChain.cons (IsEditStep.delete_head a x) ih).of_eq (by simp)

/-- Delete all of `x`, then insert all of `y`. -/
theorem stepChain_length_add (x y : List α) :
    StepChain IsEditStep (x.length + y.length) x y :=
  (stepChain_length_nil x).trans ((stepChain_length_nil y).symm fun _ _ h => h.symm)

theorem editDist_le {n : ℕ} {x y : List α} (h : StepChain IsEditStep n x y) :
    editDist x y ≤ n :=
  Nat.sInf_le h

/-- The infimum is attained. -/
theorem stepChain_editDist (x y : List α) : StepChain IsEditStep (editDist x y) x y :=
  Nat.sInf_mem (s := {n | StepChain IsEditStep n x y}) ⟨_, stepChain_length_add x y⟩

/-- Bridge: any predicate equivalent to the chain predicate has the same infimum. -/
theorem sInf_eq_editDist {P : ℕ → Prop} {x y : List α}
    (hP : ∀ n, P n ↔ StepChain IsEditStep n x y) : sInf {n | P n} = editDist x y := by
  unfold editDist
  congr 1
  ext n
  exact hP n

theorem editDist_le_length_add (x y : List α) : editDist x y ≤ x.length + y.length :=
  editDist_le (stepChain_length_add x y)

@[simp] theorem editDist_self (x : List α) : editDist x x = 0 :=
  Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (editDist_le (.nil x))

theorem editDist_eq_zero_iff {x y : List α} : editDist x y = 0 ↔ x = y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := stepChain_editDist x y
    rw [h] at this
    exact this.eq_of_zero
  · rintro rfl
    exact editDist_self x

theorem editDist_pos {x y : List α} (h : x ≠ y) : 0 < editDist x y :=
  Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (mt editDist_eq_zero_iff.mp h)

theorem editDist_comm (x y : List α) : editDist x y = editDist y x :=
  le_antisymm (editDist_le ((stepChain_editDist y x).symm fun _ _ h => h.symm))
    (editDist_le ((stepChain_editDist x y).symm fun _ _ h => h.symm))

theorem editDist_triangle (x y z : List α) : editDist x z ≤ editDist x y + editDist y z :=
  editDist_le ((stepChain_editDist x y).trans (stepChain_editDist y z))

theorem IsEditStep.editDist_le_one {u v : List α} (h : IsEditStep u v) : editDist u v ≤ 1 :=
  editDist_le (.single h)

/-- Lengths are `1`-Lipschitz for the edit distance. -/
theorem length_le_length_add_editDist (x y : List α) : y.length ≤ x.length + editDist x y :=
  (stepChain_editDist x y).le_add List.length fun _ _ h => h.length_le

theorem length_sub_length_le_editDist (x y : List α) : y.length - x.length ≤ editDist x y := by
  have := length_le_length_add_editDist x y
  omega

theorem editDist_append_left (w x y : List α) : editDist (w ++ x) (w ++ y) ≤ editDist x y :=
  editDist_le ((stepChain_editDist x y).map (w ++ ·) fun _ _ h => h.append_left w)

theorem editDist_append_right (w x y : List α) : editDist (x ++ w) (y ++ w) ≤ editDist x y :=
  editDist_le ((stepChain_editDist x y).map (· ++ w) fun _ _ h => h.append_right w)

theorem editDist_cons_cons_self (a : α) (x y : List α) :
    editDist (a :: x) (a :: y) ≤ editDist x y :=
  editDist_append_left [a] x y

/-- Concatenation is subadditive. -/
theorem editDist_append_le (x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : List α) :
    editDist (x₁ ++ x₂) (y₁ ++ y₂) ≤ editDist x₁ y₁ + editDist x₂ y₂ :=
  (editDist_triangle _ (y₁ ++ x₂) _).trans
    (add_le_add (editDist_append_right x₂ x₁ y₁) (editDist_append_left y₁ x₂ y₂))

theorem editDist_cons_cons_le (a b : α) (x y : List α) :
    editDist (a :: x) (b :: y) ≤ editDist x y + 1 :=
  (editDist_triangle _ (b :: x) _).trans (by
    have := (IsEditStep.substitute_head a b x).editDist_le_one
    have := editDist_cons_cons_self b x y
    omega)

theorem editDist_cons_left_le (a : α) (x y : List α) :
    editDist (a :: x) y ≤ editDist x y + 1 :=
  (editDist_triangle _ x _).trans (by
    have := (IsEditStep.delete_head a x).editDist_le_one
    omega)

theorem editDist_cons_right_le (a : α) (x y : List α) :
    editDist x (a :: y) ≤ editDist x y + 1 := by
  rw [editDist_comm, editDist_comm x y]
  exact editDist_cons_left_le a y x

@[simp] theorem editDist_nil_left (y : List α) : editDist [] y = y.length :=
  le_antisymm (by simpa using editDist_le_length_add [] y)
    (by simpa using length_le_length_add_editDist [] y)

@[simp] theorem editDist_nil_right (x : List α) : editDist x [] = x.length := by
  rw [editDist_comm, editDist_nil_left]

/-- Substitute along the shorter word, then insert or delete the rest. -/
theorem editDist_le_max_length : ∀ x y : List α, editDist x y ≤ max x.length y.length
  | [], y => by simp
  | x, [] => by simp
  | a :: x, b :: y => by
    have h := editDist_le_max_length x y
    have h' := editDist_cons_cons_le a b x y
    simp only [List.length_cons]
    omega

/-- For equal lengths the edit distance is at most the number of mismatched positions. -/
theorem editDist_le_countP_zip [DecidableEq α] :
    ∀ x y : List α, x.length = y.length →
      editDist x y ≤ (x.zip y).countP (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2)
  | [], [], _ => by simp
  | [], _ :: _, h => by simp at h
  | _ :: _, [], h => by simp at h
  | a :: x, b :: y, h => by
    have ih := editDist_le_countP_zip x y (by simpa using h)
    have hab : editDist (a :: x) (b :: y) ≤ editDist x y + (if a = b then 0 else 1) := by
      split_ifs with hab
      · subst hab
        simpa using editDist_cons_cons_self a x y
      · exact editDist_cons_cons_le a b x y
    rw [List.zip_cons_cons, List.countP_cons]
    split_ifs at hab ⊢ with h₁ h₂ h₂
    all_goals first | omega | (exfalso; simp_all)

/-- Deleting the letters outside a subsequence. -/
theorem stepChain_of_sublist {z x : List α} (h : z <+ x) :
    StepChain IsEditStep (x.length - z.length) x z := by
  induction h with
  | slnil => exact .nil _
  | cons a h ih =>
    have hle := h.length_le
    exact (StepChain.cons (IsEditStep.delete_head a _) ih).of_eq (by simp only [length_cons]; omega)
  | cons_cons a h ih =>
    exact (ih.map (a :: ·) fun _ _ hs => hs.cons a).of_eq (by simp)

theorem editDist_le_of_sublist {z x : List α} (h : z <+ x) :
    editDist x z ≤ x.length - z.length :=
  editDist_le (stepChain_of_sublist h)

/-- Length of a longest common subsequence. -/
noncomputable def lcsLength (x y : List α) : ℕ :=
  sSup {n | ∃ z : List α, z <+ x ∧ z <+ y ∧ z.length = n}

theorem bddAbove_lcs (x y : List α) :
    BddAbove {n | ∃ z : List α, z <+ x ∧ z <+ y ∧ z.length = n} :=
  ⟨x.length, by rintro n ⟨z, hx, -, rfl⟩; exact hx.length_le⟩

theorem exists_lcs (x y : List α) :
    ∃ z : List α, z <+ x ∧ z <+ y ∧ z.length = lcsLength x y :=
  Nat.sSup_mem (s := {n | ∃ z : List α, z <+ x ∧ z <+ y ∧ z.length = n})
    ⟨0, [], nil_sublist _, nil_sublist _, rfl⟩ (bddAbove_lcs x y)

theorem length_le_lcsLength {z x y : List α} (hx : z <+ x) (hy : z <+ y) :
    z.length ≤ lcsLength x y :=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_lcs x y) ⟨z, hx, hy, rfl⟩

theorem lcsLength_le_length_left (x y : List α) : lcsLength x y ≤ x.length := by
  obtain ⟨z, hx, -, hz⟩ := exists_lcs x y
  exact hz ▸ hx.length_le

theorem lcsLength_le_length_right (x y : List α) : lcsLength x y ≤ y.length := by
  obtain ⟨z, -, hy, hz⟩ := exists_lcs x y
  exact hz ▸ hy.length_le

theorem lcsLength_comm (x y : List α) : lcsLength x y = lcsLength y x := by
  obtain ⟨z, hx, hy, hz⟩ := exists_lcs x y
  obtain ⟨z', hy', hx', hz'⟩ := exists_lcs y x
  exact le_antisymm (hz ▸ length_le_lcsLength hy hx) (hz' ▸ length_le_lcsLength hx' hy')

@[simp] theorem lcsLength_self (x : List α) : lcsLength x x = x.length :=
  le_antisymm (lcsLength_le_length_left x x) (length_le_lcsLength (Sublist.refl x) (Sublist.refl x))

/-- A subsequence of `p ++ a :: q` loses at most one letter when `a` is removed. -/
theorem exists_sublist_of_sublist_insert {z p q : List α} {a : α} (h : z <+ p ++ a :: q) :
    ∃ z', z' <+ p ++ q ∧ z' <+ z ∧ z.length ≤ z'.length + 1 := by
  obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl, h₁, h₂⟩ := List.sublist_append_iff.mp h
  rcases List.sublist_cons_iff.mp h₂ with h₂ | ⟨r, rfl, hr⟩
  · exact ⟨l₁ ++ l₂, h₁.append h₂, Sublist.refl _, by omega⟩
  · refine ⟨l₁ ++ r, h₁.append hr, (Sublist.refl l₁).append (sublist_cons_self a r), ?_⟩
    simp only [length_append, length_cons]
    omega

theorem IsEditStep.lcsLength_le {u v : List α} (h : IsEditStep u v) (y : List α) :
    lcsLength u y ≤ lcsLength v y + 1 := by
  obtain ⟨z, hzu, hzy, hz⟩ := exists_lcs u y
  rw [← hz]
  rcases h with ⟨p, q, a, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, q, a, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, q, a, b, rfl, rfl⟩
  · have : z <+ p ++ a :: q :=
      hzu.trans ((Sublist.refl p).append (sublist_cons_self a q))
    exact (length_le_lcsLength this hzy).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  · obtain ⟨z', h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := exists_sublist_of_sublist_insert hzu
    exact h₃.trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (length_le_lcsLength h₁ (h₂.trans hzy)) 1)
  · obtain ⟨z', h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := exists_sublist_of_sublist_insert hzu
    have : z' <+ p ++ b :: q := h₁.trans ((Sublist.refl p).append (sublist_cons_self b q))
    exact h₃.trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (length_le_lcsLength this (h₂.trans hzy)) 1)

/-- `|y| ≤ lcs(x, y) + ed(x, y)`. -/
theorem length_le_lcsLength_add_editDist (x y : List α) :
    y.length ≤ lcsLength x y + editDist x y := by
  have := (stepChain_editDist x y).le_add (fun w => lcsLength w y)
    fun _ _ h => h.symm.lcsLength_le y
  simpa using this

theorem length_left_le_lcsLength_add_editDist (x y : List α) :
    x.length ≤ lcsLength x y + editDist x y := by
  rw [lcsLength_comm, editDist_comm]
  exact length_le_lcsLength_add_editDist y x

theorem max_length_le_lcsLength_add_editDist (x y : List α) :
    max x.length y.length ≤ lcsLength x y + editDist x y :=
  max_le (length_left_le_lcsLength_add_editDist x y) (length_le_lcsLength_add_editDist x y)

/-- Delete down to a longest common subsequence, then insert back up. -/
theorem editDist_add_two_mul_lcsLength_le (x y : List α) :
    editDist x y + 2 * lcsLength x y ≤ x.length + y.length := by
  obtain ⟨z, hx, hy, hz⟩ := exists_lcs x y
  have h₁ := editDist_le_of_sublist hx
  have h₂ := editDist_le_of_sublist hy
  have h₃ := editDist_triangle x z y
  rw [editDist_comm z y] at h₃
  have := hx.length_le
  have := hy.length_le
  omega

/-- Equal lengths: `|x| - lcs ≤ ed ≤ 2 (|x| - lcs)`. -/
theorem length_sub_lcsLength_le_editDist (x y : List α) :
    x.length - lcsLength x y ≤ editDist x y := by
  have := length_left_le_lcsLength_add_editDist x y
  omega

theorem editDist_le_two_mul_length_sub_lcsLength {x y : List α} (h : x.length = y.length) :
    editDist x y ≤ 2 * (x.length - lcsLength x y) := by
  have := editDist_add_two_mul_lcsLength_le x y
  have := lcsLength_le_length_left x y
  omega

/-- A word map that sends each single edit to at most `w` edits expands `ed` by at most `w`. -/
theorem editDist_le_mul_of_step {γ : Type v} (g : List α → List γ) (w : ℕ)
    (hg : ∀ u v, IsEditStep u v → editDist (g u) (g v) ≤ w) (x y : List α) :
    editDist (g x) (g y) ≤ w * editDist x y := by
  suffices ∀ n x y, StepChain IsEditStep n x y → editDist (g x) (g y) ≤ w * n from
    this _ _ _ (stepChain_editDist x y)
  intro n x y h
  induction h with
  | nil x => simp
  | cons hxy _ ih =>
    calc editDist (g _) (g _) ≤ editDist (g _) (g _) + editDist (g _) (g _) :=
          editDist_triangle _ _ _
      _ ≤ w + w * _ := add_le_add (hg _ _ hxy) ih
      _ = w * (_ + 1) := by ring

/-- Letter-by-letter relabelling does not increase the edit distance. -/
theorem editDist_map_le {γ : Type v} (f : α → γ) (x y : List α) :
    editDist (x.map f) (y.map f) ≤ editDist x y := by
  simpa using editDist_le_mul_of_step (List.map f) 1
    (fun _ _ h => (h.map f).editDist_le_one) x y

/-- Block codes: replacing every letter by a codeword of length `w` expands `ed` by at most `w`. -/
theorem editDist_flatMap_le {γ : Type v} (c : α → List γ) (w : ℕ)
    (hc : ∀ a, (c a).length = w) (x y : List α) :
    editDist (x.flatMap c) (y.flatMap c) ≤ w * editDist x y := by
  refine editDist_le_mul_of_step (fun l => l.flatMap c) w ?_ x y
  intro u v h
  rcases h with ⟨p, q, a, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, q, a, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, q, a, b, rfl, rfl⟩
  · simp only [flatMap_append, flatMap_cons]
    calc editDist (p.flatMap c ++ q.flatMap c) (p.flatMap c ++ (c a ++ q.flatMap c))
        ≤ editDist ([] ++ q.flatMap c) (c a ++ q.flatMap c) := editDist_append_left _ _ _
      _ ≤ editDist [] (c a) := editDist_append_right _ _ _
      _ = w := by simp [hc]
  · simp only [flatMap_append, flatMap_cons]
    calc editDist (p.flatMap c ++ (c a ++ q.flatMap c)) (p.flatMap c ++ q.flatMap c)
        ≤ editDist (c a ++ q.flatMap c) ([] ++ q.flatMap c) := editDist_append_left _ _ _
      _ ≤ editDist (c a) [] := editDist_append_right _ _ _
      _ = w := by simp [hc]
  · simp only [flatMap_append, flatMap_cons]
    calc editDist (p.flatMap c ++ (c a ++ q.flatMap c)) (p.flatMap c ++ (c b ++ q.flatMap c))
        ≤ editDist (c a ++ q.flatMap c) (c b ++ q.flatMap c) := editDist_append_left _ _ _
      _ ≤ editDist (c a) (c b) := editDist_append_right _ _ _
      _ ≤ max (c a).length (c b).length := editDist_le_max_length _ _
      _ = w := by simp [hc]

end EditStep

end TheoremOS.Combinatorics

import Mathlib

/-!
# Independent sets and colourings of finite graphs

Lower bounds for the independence number `indepNum` and upper bounds for the chromatic number of a
finite simple graph. Contents: `n ≤ k α` for a `k`-colouring, hence `n ≤ χ α`; greedy colouring
with `Δ + 1` colours; the Caro–Wei bound `∑ v, 1/(d(v)+1) ≤ α` (and its version inside a vertex
set); the Turán form `n² / (2|E| + n) ≤ α`; `n ≤ (Δ + 1) α`; and `Δ ≤ α` for triangle-free
graphs.

Sources: Y. Caro, New results on the independence number, Tel Aviv Univ. tech. report (1979);
V. K. Wei, A lower bound on the stability number of a simple graph, Bell Labs memo (1981);
N. Alon and J. Spencer, *The Probabilistic Method*, 4th ed., Wiley, 2016, Section 6.1 (Turán);
R. Diestel, *Graph Theory*, 5th ed., Springer, 2017, Section 5.2 (greedy colouring). Textbook
material; nothing here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: `card_div_averageDegree_succ_le_indepNum` is `n / (d + 1) ≤ α` with the average degree
`d = 2|E| / n` written out. On a finite graph `G.chromaticNumber.toNat` is the chromatic number
(`chromaticNumber_ne_top`), as in `card_le_chromaticNumber_toNat_mul_indepNum`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Combinatorics

open Finset SimpleGraph

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)

section Colouring

/-- A `k`-colouring has a colour class of size `≥ n/k`: `n ≤ k α`. -/
theorem card_le_mul_indepNum_of_coloring {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (C : G.Coloring α) :
    Fintype.card V ≤ Fintype.card α * G.indepNum := by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.card_univ, Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := C) (t := univ)
    (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_coe.2 (mem_univ _))]
  calc ∑ c, #{v ∈ (univ : Finset V) | C v = c} ≤ ∑ _c : α, G.indepNum :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun c _ => IsIndepSet.card_le_indepNum fun x hx y hy hxy hadj => by
          simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hx hy
          exact C.valid hadj (hx.trans hy.symm)
    _ = Fintype.card α * G.indepNum := by rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, smul_eq_mul]

theorem card_le_mul_indepNum_of_colorable {k : ℕ} (h : G.Colorable k) :
    Fintype.card V ≤ k * G.indepNum := by
  simpa using card_le_mul_indepNum_of_coloring G h.some

/-- `n ≤ χ α`. -/
theorem card_le_chromaticNumber_toNat_mul_indepNum :
    Fintype.card V ≤ G.chromaticNumber.toNat * G.indepNum :=
  card_le_mul_indepNum_of_colorable G (colorable_chromaticNumber_of_fintype G)

theorem chromaticNumber_ne_top : G.chromaticNumber ≠ ⊤ :=
  chromaticNumber_ne_top_iff_exists.2 ⟨_, colorable_of_fintype G⟩

/-- Greedy colouring inside a vertex set: `Δ + 1` colours suffice on `S`. -/
theorem exists_coloring_on_maxDegree_succ [DecidableRel G.Adj] (S : Finset V) :
    ∃ c : V → Fin (G.maxDegree + 1), ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, G.Adj x y → c x ≠ c y := by
  classical
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨fun _ => 0, by simp⟩
  | @insert v S hvS ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ih
    have hlt : #((S.filter (G.Adj v)).image c) < #(univ : Finset (Fin (G.maxDegree + 1))) := by
      calc #((S.filter (G.Adj v)).image c) ≤ #(S.filter (G.Adj v)) := card_image_le
        _ ≤ #(G.neighborFinset v) := card_le_card fun w hw => by
            rw [mem_neighborFinset]; exact (mem_filter.1 hw).2
        _ = G.degree v := card_neighborFinset_eq_degree G v
        _ ≤ G.maxDegree := G.degree_le_maxDegree v
        _ < #(univ : Finset (Fin (G.maxDegree + 1))) := by simp
    obtain ⟨a, -, ha⟩ := exists_mem_notMem_of_card_lt_card hlt
    refine ⟨Function.update c v a, fun x hx y hy hxy => ?_⟩
    rw [mem_insert] at hx hy
    have hxv : ∀ {w}, w ∈ S → w ≠ v := fun hw h => hvS (h ▸ hw)
    rcases hx with rfl | hx <;> rcases hy with rfl | hy
    · exact (G.irrefl hxy).elim
    · rw [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne (hxv hy)]
      exact fun h => ha (h ▸ mem_image_of_mem c (mem_filter.2 ⟨hy, hxy⟩))
    · rw [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne (hxv hx)]
      exact fun h => ha (h.symm ▸ mem_image_of_mem c (mem_filter.2 ⟨hx, hxy.symm⟩))
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne (hxv hx), Function.update_of_ne (hxv hy)]
      exact hc x hx y hy hxy

/-- Greedy colouring: every finite graph is `(Δ + 1)`-colourable. -/
theorem colorable_maxDegree_succ [DecidableRel G.Adj] : G.Colorable (G.maxDegree + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_coloring_on_maxDegree_succ G univ
  exact ⟨Coloring.mk c fun h => hc _ (mem_univ _) _ (mem_univ _) h⟩

theorem chromaticNumber_le_maxDegree_succ [DecidableRel G.Adj] :
    G.chromaticNumber ≤ G.maxDegree + 1 := by
  exact_mod_cast (colorable_maxDegree_succ G).chromaticNumber_le

theorem chromaticNumber_toNat_le_maxDegree_succ [DecidableRel G.Adj] :
    G.chromaticNumber.toNat ≤ G.maxDegree + 1 :=
  ENat.toNat_le_of_le_natCast (by exact_mod_cast chromaticNumber_le_maxDegree_succ G)

/-- `n ≤ (Δ + 1) α`. -/
theorem card_le_maxDegree_succ_mul_indepNum [DecidableRel G.Adj] :
    Fintype.card V ≤ (G.maxDegree + 1) * G.indepNum :=
  card_le_mul_indepNum_of_colorable G (colorable_maxDegree_succ G)

end Colouring

section CaroWei

variable [DecidableRel G.Adj]

omit [Fintype V] in
/-- Caro–Wei inside a vertex set: `S` contains an independent set of size at least
`∑ v ∈ S, 1 / (d_S(v) + 1)`, where `d_S(v)` counts the neighbours of `v` in `S`. -/
theorem exists_isIndepSet_sum_le (S : Finset V) :
    ∃ I ⊆ S, G.IsIndepSet (I : Set V) ∧
      ∑ v ∈ S, (1 : ℝ) / (#{w ∈ S | G.Adj v w} + 1) ≤ #I := by
  classical
  induction S using Finset.strongInduction with
  | H S ih =>
  rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
  · exact ⟨∅, Finset.Subset.rfl, by simp, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hvS, hmin⟩ := S.exists_min_image (fun u => #{w ∈ S | G.Adj u w}) hne
  have hS'S : S.filter (fun w => ¬(w = v ∨ G.Adj v w)) ⊂ S :=
    filter_ssubset.2 ⟨v, hvS, fun h => h (Or.inl rfl)⟩
  obtain ⟨I, hIS, hI, hIsum⟩ := ih _ hS'S
  have hvI : v ∉ I := fun h => (mem_filter.1 (hIS h)).2 (Or.inl rfl)
  refine ⟨insert v I, insert_subset hvS (hIS.trans (filter_subset _ _)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [coe_insert]
    refine hI.insert_of_notMem (by simpa using hvI) fun b hb => ?_
    have hb' := (mem_filter.1 (hIS hb)).2
    exact ⟨fun h => hb' (Or.inr h), fun h => hb' (Or.inr h.symm)⟩
  have hcardN : #{w ∈ S | w = v ∨ G.Adj v w} = #{w ∈ S | G.Adj v w} + 1 := by
    have : ({w ∈ S | w = v ∨ G.Adj v w} : Finset V) = insert v {w ∈ S | G.Adj v w} := by
      ext w
      by_cases hw : w = v
      · subst hw; simp [hvS]
      · simp [hw]
    rw [this, card_insert_of_notMem (by simp)]
  have hN : ∑ u ∈ S with u = v ∨ G.Adj v u, (1 : ℝ) / (#{w ∈ S | G.Adj u w} + 1) ≤ 1 := by
    calc ∑ u ∈ S with u = v ∨ G.Adj v u, (1 : ℝ) / (#{w ∈ S | G.Adj u w} + 1)
        ≤ ∑ u ∈ S with u = v ∨ G.Adj v u, (1 : ℝ) / (#{w ∈ S | G.Adj v w} + 1) := by
          refine sum_le_sum fun u hu => one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) ?_
          exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_right (hmin u (mem_filter.1 hu).1) 1
      _ = 1 := by
          rw [sum_const, hcardN, nsmul_eq_mul]
          push_cast
          field_simp
  have hS' : ∑ u ∈ S with ¬(u = v ∨ G.Adj v u), (1 : ℝ) / (#{w ∈ S | G.Adj u w} + 1) ≤ #I := by
    refine le_trans (sum_le_sum fun u _ => ?_) hIsum
    have hc : #{w ∈ S.filter (fun w => ¬(w = v ∨ G.Adj v w)) | G.Adj u w}
        ≤ #{w ∈ S | G.Adj u w} := card_le_card (filter_subset_filter _ (filter_subset _ _))
    gcongr
  have hsplit := sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not S (fun u => u = v ∨ G.Adj v u)
    (fun u => (1 : ℝ) / (#{w ∈ S | G.Adj u w} + 1))
  beta_reduce at hsplit
  rw [card_insert_of_notMem hvI, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  linarith

/-- The Caro–Wei bound `∑ v, 1 / (d(v) + 1) ≤ α`. -/
theorem sum_one_div_degree_succ_le_indepNum :
    ∑ v, (1 : ℝ) / (G.degree v + 1) ≤ G.indepNum := by
  obtain ⟨I, -, hI, hsum⟩ := exists_isIndepSet_sum_le G univ
  have hdeg : ∀ v, G.degree v = #{w ∈ (univ : Finset V) | G.Adj v w} := fun v => by
    rw [← card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, neighborFinset_eq_filter]
  simp_rw [hdeg]
  exact hsum.trans (by exact_mod_cast hI.card_le_indepNum)

/-- Turán's bound in Caro–Wei form: `n² / (2|E| + n) ≤ α`. -/
theorem card_sq_div_le_indepNum :
    (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * #G.edgeFinset + Fintype.card V) ≤ G.indepNum := by
  refine le_trans ?_ (sum_one_div_degree_succ_le_indepNum G)
  have h := sq_sum_div_le_sum_sq_div (univ : Finset V) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
    (g := fun v => (G.degree v : ℝ) + 1) fun v _ => by positivity
  have hsum : ∑ v, ((G.degree v : ℝ) + 1) = 2 * #G.edgeFinset + Fintype.card V := by
    rw [sum_add_distrib, ← Nat.cast_sum, sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges]
    simp
  simp only [sum_const, card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, one_pow] at h
  rwa [hsum] at h

/-- The same bound with the average degree `d = 2|E| / n`: `n / (d + 1) ≤ α`. -/
theorem card_div_averageDegree_succ_le_indepNum :
    (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / (2 * #G.edgeFinset / Fintype.card V + 1) ≤ G.indepNum := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Fintype.card V) with h0 | hpos
  · simp [h0]
  have hn : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [div_add_one hn, div_div_eq_mul_div, ← sq]
  exact card_sq_div_le_indepNum G

end CaroWei

section TriangleFree

variable [DecidableRel G.Adj]

/-- In a triangle-free graph every neighbourhood is independent: `d(v) ≤ α`. -/
theorem degree_le_indepNum_of_cliqueFree_three (h : G.CliqueFree 3) (v : V) :
    G.degree v ≤ G.indepNum := by
  rw [← card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
  exact IsIndepSet.card_le_indepNum (by
    rw [coe_neighborFinset]; exact G.isIndepSet_neighborSet_of_triangleFree h v)

theorem maxDegree_le_indepNum_of_cliqueFree_three (h : G.CliqueFree 3) :
    G.maxDegree ≤ G.indepNum :=
  G.maxDegree_le_of_forall_degree_le _ (degree_le_indepNum_of_cliqueFree_three G h)

end TriangleFree

end TheoremOS.Combinatorics

import Mathlib

/-!
# Graph Ramsey numbers

`RamseyGraph s t V` says every simple graph on `V` has an `s`-clique or an independent set of size
`t`; `ramseyNumber s t` is the least `N` with `RamseyGraph s t (Fin N)`. Contents: transfer along
embeddings and cardinality, symmetry, monotonicity in `s` and `t`, the values for `s ≤ 2`, the
Erdős–Szekeres step `R(s+1,t+1) ≤ R(s,t+1) + R(s+1,t)`, the bound `R(s+1,t+1) ≤ C(s+t,s)`, the
diagonal bound `R(k+1,k+1) ≤ 4^k`, and the characterization by `cliqueNum` and `indepNum`.

Sources: P. Erdős and G. Szekeres, A combinatorial problem in geometry, Compositio Math. 2 (1935);
R. L. Graham, B. L. Rothschild and J. H. Spencer, *Ramsey Theory*, 2nd ed., Wiley, 1990,
Section 4.1; S. Jukna, *Extremal Combinatorics*, 2nd ed., Springer, 2011, Section 4.1. Textbook
material; nothing here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: a statement `∀ G : SimpleGraph (Fin N), (∃ A, G.IsNClique s A) ∨ (∃ B, G.IsNIndepSet t B)`
is `RamseyGraph s t (Fin N)` by `Iff.rfl`; with `Gᶜ.IsNClique t B` instead, rewrite
by `isNClique_compl` (`ramseyGraph_iff_compl`). A Ramsey number defined as
`sInf {N | RamseyProperty s t N}` is `ramseyNumber s t` once the property is identified.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Combinatorics

open Finset SimpleGraph

/-- Every graph on `V` has an `s`-clique or an independent set of size `t`. -/
def RamseyGraph (s t : ℕ) (V : Type*) : Prop :=
  ∀ G : SimpleGraph V, (∃ A : Finset V, G.IsNClique s A) ∨ ∃ B : Finset V, G.IsNIndepSet t B

theorem ramseyGraph_iff_compl (s t : ℕ) (V : Type*) :
    RamseyGraph s t V ↔
      ∀ G : SimpleGraph V,
        (∃ A : Finset V, G.IsNClique s A) ∨ ∃ B : Finset V, Gᶜ.IsNClique t B := by
  simp only [RamseyGraph, isNClique_compl]

section Transfer

variable {V W : Type*}

/-- A clique of a pulled-back graph maps to a clique. -/
theorem isNClique_map_of_comap {G : SimpleGraph W} (f : V ↪ W) {n : ℕ} {A : Finset V}
    (h : (G.comap f).IsNClique n A) : G.IsNClique n (A.map f) := by
  refine ⟨?_, by rw [Finset.card_map, h.card_eq]⟩
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  simp only [Finset.coe_map, Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe] at hx hy
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hy
  exact h.isClique ha hb fun hab => hxy (congrArg f hab)

/-- An independent set of a pulled-back graph maps to an independent set. -/
theorem isNIndepSet_map_of_comap {G : SimpleGraph W} (f : V ↪ W) {n : ℕ} {B : Finset V}
    (h : (G.comap f).IsNIndepSet n B) : G.IsNIndepSet n (B.map f) := by
  refine ⟨?_, by rw [Finset.card_map, h.card_eq]⟩
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  simp only [Finset.coe_map, Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe] at hx hy
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hy
  exact h.isIndepSet ha hb fun hab => hxy (congrArg f hab)

/-- `RamseyGraph` pulls back along embeddings. -/
theorem RamseyGraph.of_embedding {s t : ℕ} (h : RamseyGraph s t V) (f : V ↪ W) :
    RamseyGraph s t W := by
  intro G
  rcases h (G.comap f) with ⟨A, hA⟩ | ⟨B, hB⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨A.map f, isNClique_map_of_comap f hA⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨B.map f, isNIndepSet_map_of_comap f hB⟩

theorem RamseyGraph.of_card_le [Fintype V] [Fintype W] {s t : ℕ} (h : RamseyGraph s t V)
    (hc : Fintype.card V ≤ Fintype.card W) : RamseyGraph s t W :=
  h.of_embedding (Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le hc).some

theorem RamseyGraph.of_equiv {s t : ℕ} (h : RamseyGraph s t V) (e : V ≃ W) : RamseyGraph s t W :=
  h.of_embedding e.toEmbedding

theorem RamseyGraph.symm {s t : ℕ} (h : RamseyGraph s t V) : RamseyGraph t s V := by
  intro G
  rcases h Gᶜ with ⟨A, hA⟩ | ⟨B, hB⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨A, by simpa using hA⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨B, by simpa using hB⟩

theorem ramseyGraph_comm {s t : ℕ} : RamseyGraph s t V ↔ RamseyGraph t s V :=
  ⟨RamseyGraph.symm, RamseyGraph.symm⟩

/-- Monotonicity: smaller cliques and independent sets are easier to find. -/
theorem RamseyGraph.mono {s t s' t' : ℕ} (h : RamseyGraph s t V) (hs : s' ≤ s) (ht : t' ≤ t) :
    RamseyGraph s' t' V := by
  intro G
  rcases h G with ⟨A, hA⟩ | ⟨B, hB⟩
  · obtain ⟨A', hA', hc⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq (hA.card_eq ▸ hs)
    exact Or.inl ⟨A', ⟨hA.isClique.subset (by exact_mod_cast hA'), hc⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨B', hB', hc⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq (hB.card_eq ▸ ht)
    exact Or.inr ⟨B', ⟨Set.Pairwise.mono (by exact_mod_cast hB') hB.isIndepSet, hc⟩⟩

end Transfer

section Small

variable {V : Type*}

theorem ramseyGraph_zero_left (t : ℕ) : RamseyGraph 0 t V :=
  fun _ => Or.inl ⟨∅, by simp⟩

theorem ramseyGraph_zero_right (s : ℕ) : RamseyGraph s 0 V :=
  (ramseyGraph_zero_left s).symm

theorem ramseyGraph_one_left [Nonempty V] (t : ℕ) : RamseyGraph 1 t V :=
  fun _ => Or.inl ⟨{Classical.arbitrary V}, by simp⟩

theorem ramseyGraph_one_right [Nonempty V] (s : ℕ) : RamseyGraph s 1 V :=
  (ramseyGraph_one_left s).symm

/-- The empty graph shows `RamseyGraph s t V` fails when `2 ≤ s` and `|V| < t`. -/
theorem not_ramseyGraph_of_card_lt [Fintype V] {s t : ℕ} (hs : 2 ≤ s)
    (ht : Fintype.card V < t) : ¬ RamseyGraph s t V := by
  intro h
  rcases h ⊥ with ⟨A, hA⟩ | ⟨B, hB⟩
  · have := (isNClique_bot_iff.1 hA).1
    omega
  · have := hB.card_eq ▸ Finset.card_le_univ B
    omega

theorem ramseyGraph_two_left [Fintype V] {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ Fintype.card V) :
    RamseyGraph 2 t V := by
  classical
  intro G
  by_cases hE : ∃ x y, G.Adj x y
  · obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := hE
    exact Or.inl ⟨{x, y}, by simp [isNClique_iff, hxy, hxy.ne, card_pair hxy.ne]⟩
  · push Not at hE
    obtain ⟨B, -, hB⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq (s := (univ : Finset V)) (by simpa using ht)
    exact Or.inr ⟨B, ⟨fun x _ y _ _ => hE x y, hB⟩⟩

theorem ramseyGraph_two_left_iff [Fintype V] {t : ℕ} :
    RamseyGraph 2 t V ↔ t ≤ Fintype.card V :=
  ⟨fun h => by by_contra hc; exact not_ramseyGraph_of_card_lt le_rfl (by omega) h,
    ramseyGraph_two_left⟩

end Small

section ErdosSzekeres

/-- The Erdős–Szekeres step: if `RamseyGraph s (t+1)` holds on `a` vertices and
`RamseyGraph (s+1) t` on `b` vertices, then `RamseyGraph (s+1) (t+1)` holds on `a + b`. -/
theorem RamseyGraph.succ_succ {V : Type*} [Fintype V] {s t a b : ℕ}
    (ha : RamseyGraph s (t + 1) (Fin a)) (hb : RamseyGraph (s + 1) t (Fin b))
    (hV : a + b ≤ Fintype.card V) (hab : 0 < a + b) : RamseyGraph (s + 1) (t + 1) V := by
  classical
  intro G
  have hne : (univ : Finset V).Nonempty := by
    rw [← Finset.card_pos, Finset.card_univ]; omega
  obtain ⟨v, -⟩ := hne
  set A := univ.filter fun w => G.Adj v w with hA
  set B := univ.filter fun w => w ≠ v ∧ ¬ G.Adj v w with hB
  have hunion : A ∪ B = univ.erase v := by
    ext w
    simp only [hA, hB, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      Finset.mem_erase, and_true]
    by_cases hw : G.Adj v w
    · simp [hw, hw.ne']
    · simp [hw]
  have hdisj : Disjoint A B := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro w hwA hwB
    simp only [hA, hB, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hwA hwB
    exact hwB.2 hwA
  have hcard : A.card + B.card + 1 = Fintype.card V := by
    rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, hunion, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (mem_univ v),
      Finset.card_univ]
    have : 0 < Fintype.card V := by omega
    omega
  by_cases hAa : a ≤ A.card
  · have hT : RamseyGraph s (t + 1) A := ha.of_card_le (by simpa using hAa)
    rcases hT (G.comap (Function.Embedding.subtype (· ∈ A))) with ⟨C, hC⟩ | ⟨D, hD⟩
    · have hC' := isNClique_map_of_comap _ hC
      refine Or.inl ⟨insert v (C.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (· ∈ A))), hC'.insert ?_⟩
      intro w hw
      simp only [Finset.mem_map, Function.Embedding.coe_subtype] at hw
      obtain ⟨⟨w, hwA⟩, -, rfl⟩ := hw
      simpa [hA] using hwA
    · exact Or.inr ⟨_, isNIndepSet_map_of_comap _ hD⟩
  · have hBb : b ≤ B.card := by omega
    have hT : RamseyGraph (s + 1) t B := hb.of_card_le (by simpa using hBb)
    rcases hT (G.comap (Function.Embedding.subtype (· ∈ B))) with ⟨C, hC⟩ | ⟨D, hD⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨_, isNClique_map_of_comap _ hC⟩
    · have hD' := isNIndepSet_map_of_comap _ hD
      rw [← isNClique_compl] at hD'
      refine Or.inr ⟨insert v (D.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (· ∈ B))), ?_⟩
      rw [← isNClique_compl]
      refine hD'.insert ?_
      intro w hw
      simp only [Finset.mem_map, Function.Embedding.coe_subtype] at hw
      obtain ⟨⟨w, hwB⟩, -, rfl⟩ := hw
      simp only [hB, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hwB
      exact (compl_adj G v w).2 ⟨hwB.1.symm, hwB.2⟩

/-- `RamseyGraph (s+1) (t+1)` holds on `C(s+t, s)` vertices. -/
theorem ramseyGraph_choose (s t : ℕ) : RamseyGraph (s + 1) (t + 1) (Fin ((s + t).choose s)) := by
  induction s generalizing t with
  | zero => simpa using ramseyGraph_one_left (V := Fin 1) (t + 1)
  | succ s ihs =>
    induction t with
    | zero => simpa using ramseyGraph_one_right (V := Fin 1) (s + 1 + 1)
    | succ t iht =>
      have hA := ihs (t + 1)
      rw [show s + (t + 1) = s + t + 1 by omega] at hA
      have hB := iht
      rw [show s + 1 + t = s + t + 1 by omega] at hB
      refine RamseyGraph.succ_succ hA hB ?_ ?_
      · rw [Fintype.card_fin, show s + 1 + (t + 1) = s + t + 1 + 1 by omega,
          Nat.choose_succ_succ' (s + t + 1) s]
      · have := Nat.choose_pos (show s ≤ s + t + 1 by omega)
        omega

end ErdosSzekeres

/-- The Ramsey number: the least `N` with `RamseyGraph s t (Fin N)`. -/
noncomputable def ramseyNumber (s t : ℕ) : ℕ := sInf {N | RamseyGraph s t (Fin N)}

theorem ramseyNumber_nonempty (s t : ℕ) : {N | RamseyGraph s t (Fin N)}.Nonempty := by
  rcases s with _ | s
  · exact ⟨0, ramseyGraph_zero_left t⟩
  rcases t with _ | t
  · exact ⟨0, ramseyGraph_zero_right _⟩
  exact ⟨_, ramseyGraph_choose s t⟩

theorem ramseyGraph_ramseyNumber (s t : ℕ) : RamseyGraph s t (Fin (ramseyNumber s t)) :=
  Nat.sInf_mem (ramseyNumber_nonempty s t)

theorem ramseyNumber_le_of {s t N : ℕ} (h : RamseyGraph s t (Fin N)) : ramseyNumber s t ≤ N :=
  Nat.sInf_le h

/-- `RamseyGraph s t V` holds exactly when `|V| ≥ R(s,t)`. -/
theorem ramseyGraph_iff {V : Type*} [Fintype V] {s t : ℕ} :
    RamseyGraph s t V ↔ ramseyNumber s t ≤ Fintype.card V := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ramseyNumber_le_of (h.of_equiv (Fintype.equivFin V))
  · intro h
    exact (ramseyGraph_ramseyNumber s t).of_card_le (by simpa using h)

theorem ramseyGraph_fin_iff {s t N : ℕ} : RamseyGraph s t (Fin N) ↔ ramseyNumber s t ≤ N := by
  simpa using ramseyGraph_iff (V := Fin N)

theorem ramseyNumber_comm (s t : ℕ) : ramseyNumber s t = ramseyNumber t s := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact ramseyNumber_le_of (ramseyGraph_ramseyNumber t s).symm
  · exact ramseyNumber_le_of (ramseyGraph_ramseyNumber s t).symm

theorem ramseyNumber_mono {s t s' t' : ℕ} (hs : s' ≤ s) (ht : t' ≤ t) :
    ramseyNumber s' t' ≤ ramseyNumber s t :=
  ramseyNumber_le_of ((ramseyGraph_ramseyNumber s t).mono hs ht)

theorem ramseyNumber_zero_left (t : ℕ) : ramseyNumber 0 t = 0 :=
  Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (ramseyNumber_le_of (ramseyGraph_zero_left t))

theorem ramseyNumber_zero_right (s : ℕ) : ramseyNumber s 0 = 0 := by
  rw [ramseyNumber_comm, ramseyNumber_zero_left]

theorem ramseyNumber_pos {s t : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (ht : 0 < t) : 0 < ramseyNumber s t := by
  rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
  intro h0
  have h := ramseyGraph_ramseyNumber s t
  rw [h0] at h
  rcases h ⊥ with ⟨A, hA⟩ | ⟨B, hB⟩
  · have := hA.card_eq ▸ Finset.card_le_univ A
    simp at this; omega
  · have := hB.card_eq ▸ Finset.card_le_univ B
    simp at this; omega

theorem ramseyNumber_one_left {t : ℕ} (ht : 0 < t) : ramseyNumber 1 t = 1 :=
  le_antisymm (ramseyNumber_le_of (ramseyGraph_one_left (V := Fin 1) t))
    (ramseyNumber_pos one_pos ht)

theorem ramseyNumber_one_right {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) : ramseyNumber s 1 = 1 := by
  rw [ramseyNumber_comm, ramseyNumber_one_left hs]

theorem ramseyNumber_two_left (t : ℕ) : ramseyNumber 2 t = t := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact ramseyNumber_le_of (ramseyGraph_two_left (by simp))
  · have := ramseyGraph_two_left_iff.1 (ramseyGraph_ramseyNumber 2 t)
    simpa using this

theorem ramseyNumber_two_right (s : ℕ) : ramseyNumber s 2 = s := by
  rw [ramseyNumber_comm, ramseyNumber_two_left]

/-- The Erdős–Szekeres recursion `R(s+1,t+1) ≤ R(s,t+1) + R(s+1,t)` (for `(s,t) ≠ (0,0)`). -/
theorem ramseyNumber_succ_succ_le {s t : ℕ} (hst : 0 < s + t) :
    ramseyNumber (s + 1) (t + 1) ≤ ramseyNumber s (t + 1) + ramseyNumber (s + 1) t := by
  have hpos : 0 < ramseyNumber s (t + 1) + ramseyNumber (s + 1) t := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos s with rfl | hs
    · have := ramseyNumber_pos (s := 0 + 1) (t := t) (by omega) (by omega)
      omega
    · have := ramseyNumber_pos (s := s) (t := t + 1) hs (by omega)
      omega
  refine ramseyNumber_le_of (RamseyGraph.succ_succ (ramseyGraph_ramseyNumber _ _)
    (ramseyGraph_ramseyNumber _ _) (by simp) hpos)

/-- `R(s+1,t+1) ≤ C(s+t, s)`. -/
theorem ramseyNumber_le_choose (s t : ℕ) : ramseyNumber (s + 1) (t + 1) ≤ (s + t).choose s :=
  ramseyNumber_le_of (ramseyGraph_choose s t)

/-- The diagonal bound `R(k+1,k+1) ≤ 4^k`. -/
theorem ramseyNumber_diag_le (k : ℕ) : ramseyNumber (k + 1) (k + 1) ≤ 4 ^ k := by
  refine (ramseyNumber_le_choose k k).trans ?_
  rw [← two_mul]
  exact Nat.centralBinom_le_four_pow k

/-- `RamseyGraph` through clique and independence numbers. -/
theorem ramseyGraph_iff_cliqueNum {V : Type*} [Fintype V] {s t : ℕ} :
    RamseyGraph s t V ↔ ∀ G : SimpleGraph V, s ≤ G.cliqueNum ∨ t ≤ G.indepNum := by
  constructor
  · intro h G
    rcases h G with ⟨A, hA⟩ | ⟨B, hB⟩
    · exact Or.inl (hA.card_eq ▸ hA.isClique.card_le_cliqueNum)
    · exact Or.inr (hB.card_eq ▸ hB.isIndepSet.card_le_indepNum)
  · intro h
    refine RamseyGraph.mono (s := s) (t := t) ?_ le_rfl le_rfl
    intro G
    rcases h G with hs | ht
    · obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := G.exists_isNClique_cliqueNum
      obtain ⟨A', hA', hc⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq (hA.card_eq ▸ hs)
      exact Or.inl ⟨A', ⟨hA.isClique.subset (by exact_mod_cast hA'), hc⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := G.exists_isNIndepSet_indepNum
      obtain ⟨B', hB', hc⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq (hB.card_eq ▸ ht)
      exact Or.inr ⟨B', ⟨Set.Pairwise.mono (by exact_mod_cast hB') hB.isIndepSet, hc⟩⟩

end TheoremOS.Combinatorics

import Submission.Library.TheoremOS.Combinatorics.Ramsey
import Submission.Library.TheoremOS.Probability.BiasedProduct

/-!
# Erdős's lower bound for diagonal Ramsey numbers

The random-graph argument for `R(k,k)`: a uniformly random graph on `Fin N` has an expected
`2 C(N,k) 2^{-C(k,2)}` cliques or independent sets of size `k`, so `RamseyGraph k k (Fin N)` fails
when this is `< 1`. Contents: graphs from sets of 2-subsets (`graphOfEdges`), the edges inside a
vertex set (`edgesIn`, `C(|A|,2)` of them), the union bound `not_ramseyGraph_of_lt_one`, and the
classical corollary `N ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ k → N < R(k,k)` for `k ≥ 3`, i.e. `2^{k/2} < R(k,k)`.

Sources: P. Erdős, Some remarks on the theory of graphs, Bull. Amer. Math. Soc. 53 (1947);
N. Alon and J. Spencer, *The Probabilistic Method*, 4th ed., Wiley, 2016, Section 1.1. Textbook
material; nothing here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: the probability space is `biasedMass (1/2)` on `Finset (GraphEdge N)` with
`GraphEdge N = {e : Finset (Fin N) // e.card = 2}`; combine `ramseyNumber_gt_of_sq_le` with
`ramseyGraph_fin_iff` to move between the predicate and the number.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Combinatorics

open Finset TheoremOS.Probability

/-- The 2-subsets of `Fin N`, the possible edges of a graph on `Fin N`. -/
abbrev GraphEdge (N : ℕ) := {e : Finset (Fin N) // e.card = 2}

/-- The graph whose edges are the 2-subsets in `s`. -/
def graphOfEdges {N : ℕ} (s : Finset (GraphEdge N)) : SimpleGraph (Fin N) where
  Adj x y := x ≠ y ∧ ∃ e ∈ s, (e : Finset (Fin N)) = {x, y}
  symm.symm x y h :=
    ⟨h.1.symm, by obtain ⟨e, he, hxy⟩ := h.2; exact ⟨e, he, by rw [hxy, pair_comm]⟩⟩
  loopless.irrefl x h := h.1 rfl

theorem graphOfEdges_adj {N : ℕ} (s : Finset (GraphEdge N)) (x y : Fin N) :
    (graphOfEdges s).Adj x y ↔ x ≠ y ∧ ∃ e ∈ s, (e : Finset (Fin N)) = {x, y} := Iff.rfl

/-- The edges inside a vertex set. -/
def edgesIn {N : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin N)) : Finset (GraphEdge N) :=
  univ.filter fun e => (e : Finset (Fin N)) ⊆ A

theorem card_edgesIn {N : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin N)) : (edgesIn A).card = A.card.choose 2 := by
  rw [← card_powersetCard]
  refine Finset.card_bij (fun e _ => (e : Finset (Fin N))) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro e he
    simp only [edgesIn, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at he
    exact mem_powersetCard.2 ⟨he, e.2⟩
  · intro e₁ _ e₂ _ h
    exact Subtype.ext h
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨hA, hc⟩ := mem_powersetCard.1 ht
    exact ⟨⟨t, hc⟩, by simpa [edgesIn] using hA, rfl⟩

theorem edgesIn_subset_of_isClique {N : ℕ} {s : Finset (GraphEdge N)} {A : Finset (Fin N)}
    (h : (graphOfEdges s).IsClique (A : Set (Fin N))) : edgesIn A ⊆ s := by
  intro e he
  simp only [edgesIn, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at he
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, hexy⟩ := card_eq_two.1 e.2
  have hx : x ∈ A := he (by rw [hexy]; simp)
  have hy : y ∈ A := he (by rw [hexy]; simp)
  obtain ⟨-, e', he', he'xy⟩ := (graphOfEdges_adj s x y).1 (h hx hy hxy)
  rwa [show e = e' from Subtype.ext (hexy.trans he'xy.symm)]

theorem edgesIn_subset_compl_of_isIndepSet {N : ℕ} {s : Finset (GraphEdge N)}
    {A : Finset (Fin N)} (h : (graphOfEdges s).IsIndepSet (A : Set (Fin N))) :
    edgesIn A ⊆ sᶜ := by
  intro e he
  simp only [edgesIn, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at he
  rw [mem_compl]
  intro hes
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, hexy⟩ := card_eq_two.1 e.2
  have hx : x ∈ A := he (by rw [hexy]; simp)
  have hy : y ∈ A := he (by rw [hexy]; simp)
  exact h hx hy hxy ((graphOfEdges_adj s x y).2 ⟨hxy, e, hes, hexy⟩)

/-- The union bound: if `2 C(N,k) 2^{-C(k,2)} < 1` then some graph on `Fin N` has neither a
`k`-clique nor an independent set of size `k`. -/
theorem not_ramseyGraph_of_lt_one {N k : ℕ}
    (hlt : 2 * (N.choose k : ℝ) * (1 / 2) ^ k.choose 2 < 1) : ¬ RamseyGraph k k (Fin N) := by
  classical
  intro hR
  set 𝒜 := (univ : Finset (Fin N)).powersetCard k with h𝒜
  have hpt : ∀ s : Finset (GraphEdge N), (1 : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ A ∈ 𝒜, ((if edgesIn A ⊆ s then 1 else 0) + if Disjoint s (edgesIn A) then 1 else 0) := by
    intro s
    rcases hR (graphOfEdges s) with ⟨A, hA⟩ | ⟨A, hA⟩
    · have hA𝒜 : A ∈ 𝒜 := mem_powersetCard.2 ⟨subset_univ _, hA.card_eq⟩
      refine le_trans ?_ (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun A =>
        ((if edgesIn A ⊆ s then (1 : ℝ) else 0) + if Disjoint s (edgesIn A) then 1 else 0))
        (fun A _ => by positivity) hA𝒜)
      rw [ite_eq_left (edgesIn_subset_of_isClique hA.isClique)]
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
    · have hA𝒜 : A ∈ 𝒜 := mem_powersetCard.2 ⟨subset_univ _, hA.card_eq⟩
      refine le_trans ?_ (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun A =>
        ((if edgesIn A ⊆ s then (1 : ℝ) else 0) + if Disjoint s (edgesIn A) then 1 else 0))
        (fun A _ => by positivity) hA𝒜)
      have hd : Disjoint s (edgesIn A) :=
        disjoint_comm.1 (subset_compl_iff_disjoint_right.1 (edgesIn_subset_compl_of_isIndepSet
          hA.isIndepSet))
      rw [ite_eq_left hd]
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (N.choose k : ℝ) * (1 / 2) ^ k.choose 2 := by
    calc (1 : ℝ) = ∑ s, biasedMass (1 / 2) s * 1 := by simp [sum_biasedMass]
      _ ≤ ∑ s, biasedMass (1 / 2) s * ∑ A ∈ 𝒜, ((if edgesIn A ⊆ s then 1 else 0) +
            if Disjoint s (edgesIn A) then 1 else 0) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun s _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpt s)
            (biasedMass_nonneg (by norm_num) (by norm_num) s)
      _ = ∑ A ∈ 𝒜, ((∑ s with edgesIn A ⊆ s, biasedMass (1 / 2) s) +
            ∑ s with Disjoint s (edgesIn A), biasedMass (1 / 2) s) := by
          simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun A _ => ?_
          rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
          split_ifs <;> ring
      _ = 2 * (N.choose k : ℝ) * (1 / 2) ^ k.choose 2 := by
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun A hA => by
            rw [sum_biasedMass_superset, sum_biasedMass_disjoint, card_edgesIn,
              (mem_powersetCard.1 hA).2]]
          rw [Finset.sum_const, h𝒜, card_powersetCard, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
            nsmul_eq_mul]
          norm_num
          ring
  linarith

theorem two_pow_lt_factorial_sq {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) : 2 ^ (k + 2) < (k.factorial) ^ 2 := by
  induction k, hk using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => decide
  | succ k hk ih =>
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ, mul_pow, pow_succ]
    have : 2 ≤ (k + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    calc 2 ^ (k + 2) * 2 < (k.factorial) ^ 2 * 2 := by omega
      _ ≤ (k.factorial) ^ 2 * (k + 1) ^ 2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ this
      _ = (k + 1) ^ 2 * (k.factorial) ^ 2 := mul_comm _ _

theorem two_mul_choose_two_add (k : ℕ) : 2 * k.choose 2 + k = k ^ 2 := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ', Nat.choose_one_right]
    nlinarith

/-- Erdős's bound: for `k ≥ 3` and `N ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ k`, some graph on `Fin N` has neither a
`k`-clique nor an independent set of size `k`. -/
theorem not_ramseyGraph_of_sq_le {N k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hN : N ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ k) :
    ¬ RamseyGraph k k (Fin N) := by
  refine not_ramseyGraph_of_lt_one ?_
  set c := k.choose 2
  have hf : (0 : ℝ) < k.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos k
  have h2c : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ c := by positivity
  have hfac : (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2) < (k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast two_pow_lt_factorial_sq hk
  have hNk : ((N : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ k := by
    rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by exact_mod_cast hN) k
  have hkk : ((2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ k = (2 ^ c) ^ 2 * 2 ^ k := by
    rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add, show k * k = c * 2 + k by
      have := two_mul_choose_two_add k; nlinarith]
  have hsq : (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 < ((k.factorial : ℝ) * 2 ^ c) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow]
    rw [show (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2) = 2 ^ 2 * 2 ^ k by ring] at hfac
    have hb := hNk.trans_eq hkk
    nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hfac (pow_pos h2c 2)]
  have hkey : 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ k < (k.factorial : ℝ) * 2 ^ c :=
    lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 2 (by positivity) hsq
  have hch : (N.choose k : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ k / k.factorial := Nat.choose_le_pow_div k N
  have hinv : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ c * 2 ^ c = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
  have hlt : 2 * (N.choose k : ℝ) < 2 ^ c := by
    have : (N : ℝ) ^ k / k.factorial < 2 ^ c / 2 := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hf (by norm_num)]; linarith
    linarith
  nlinarith [pow_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 by norm_num) c]

/-- `N < R(k,k)` whenever `k ≥ 3` and `N ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ k`; that is, `2^{k/2} < R(k,k)`. -/
theorem ramseyNumber_gt_of_sq_le {N k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hN : N ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ k) :
    N < ramseyNumber k k := by
  by_contra h
  exact not_ramseyGraph_of_sq_le hk hN (ramseyGraph_fin_iff.2 (by omega))

end TheoremOS.Combinatorics

import Mathlib

/-!
# Coordinates in `EuclideanSpace ℝ ι`

Coordinate forms of the norm, inner product and distance of `EuclideanSpace ℝ ι`, for a point
`x` (`x i` is its `i`-th coordinate) and for a vector built as `WithLp.toLp 2 f` or `!₂[a, b, …]`.
Contents: `‖x‖ = √(∑ x i²)`, `⟪x, y⟫ = ∑ x i * y i`, `dist x y ^ 2 = ∑ (x i - y i)²`; spheres and
balls about any center as `∑ (x i - c i)² = r²` (`≤`, `<`); `‖x‖ = r` as `∑ x i² = r²`; the
expansion `x = ∑ i, x i • single i 1` and `toLp 2 f = ∑ i, f i • single i 1`; product index types
`ι × κ` as a double sum; the two- and three-dimensional cases written out; transposes as adjoints,
`⟪toLp (A *ᵥ x), y⟫ = ⟪x, toLp (Aᵀ *ᵥ y)⟫`, and orthogonal matrices (`Matrix.orthogonalGroup`)
as isometries: they preserve inner products, norms and distances.

Sources: S. Axler, *Linear Algebra Done Right*, 3rd ed., Springer, 2015, Chapter 6 (inner
products on `𝐑ⁿ`, orthonormal bases) and §7.C (isometries); Mathlib's `EuclideanSpace` API, of
which this is a thin layer. Textbook material; nothing here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: `!₂[a, b]` is notation for `WithLp.toLp 2 ![a, b]`, so the `toLp` lemmas apply to it, and
the `_fin_two`/`_fin_three` lemmas evaluate `![a, b] 0` etc. A point is applied directly,
`x i`, and `x.ofLp` is the underlying function (`PiLp.toLp_apply`, `WithLp.ofLp_toLp` are `rfl`).
For `U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ` pass `U.property`; `*ᵥ` needs `open Matrix`.
Mathlib already has `EuclideanSpace.norm_eq`, `real_norm_sq_eq`, `dist_eq`, `ball_zero_eq`,
`sphere_zero_eq`, `inner_single_left`, `volume_ball` and `volume_ball_fin_two`; coordinate
Cauchy–Schwarz is `Finset.inner_mul_le_norm_mul_norm` and `Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Geometry

open Finset Matrix WithLp
open scoped BigOperators RealInnerProductSpace

noncomputable section

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]

section Coordinates

lemma norm_eq_sqrt_sum (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) : ‖x‖ = √(∑ i, x i ^ 2) := by
  rw [← EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg x)]

lemma inner_eq_sum (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) : ⟪x, y⟫ = ∑ i, x i * y i := by
  simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _

lemma dist_sq_eq_sum (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) : dist x y ^ 2 = ∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2 := by
  simp only [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Real.dist_eq, sq_abs]

lemma dist_eq_sqrt_sum (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) : dist x y = √(∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2) := by
  rw [← dist_sq_eq_sum, Real.sqrt_sq dist_nonneg]

lemma mem_sphere_iff_sum {x c : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    x ∈ Metric.sphere c r ↔ ∑ i, (x i - c i) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
  rw [Metric.mem_sphere, ← dist_sq_eq_sum, sq_eq_sq₀ dist_nonneg hr]

lemma mem_closedBall_iff_sum {x c : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    x ∈ Metric.closedBall c r ↔ ∑ i, (x i - c i) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := by
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, ← dist_sq_eq_sum, sq_le_sq₀ dist_nonneg hr]

lemma mem_ball_iff_sum {x c : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    x ∈ Metric.ball c r ↔ ∑ i, (x i - c i) ^ 2 < r ^ 2 := by
  rw [Metric.mem_ball, ← dist_sq_eq_sum, sq_lt_sq₀ dist_nonneg hr]

lemma norm_eq_iff_sum {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ‖x‖ = r ↔ ∑ i, x i ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
  rw [← EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg x) hr]

lemma norm_le_iff_sum {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ r ↔ ∑ i, x i ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := by
  rw [← EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg x) hr]

lemma norm_lt_iff_sum {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ‖x‖ < r ↔ ∑ i, x i ^ 2 < r ^ 2 := by
  rw [← EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg x) hr]

lemma norm_eq_one_iff_sum {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} : ‖x‖ = 1 ↔ ∑ i, x i ^ 2 = 1 := by
  rw [norm_eq_iff_sum zero_le_one, one_pow]

end Coordinates

section ToLp

lemma norm_sq_toLp_eq_sum (f : ι → ℝ) : ‖(toLp 2 f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, f i ^ 2 :=
  EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq _

lemma norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_sum (f : ι → ℝ) : ‖(toLp 2 f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)‖ = √(∑ i, f i ^ 2) :=
  norm_eq_sqrt_sum _

lemma inner_toLp_eq_sum (f g : ι → ℝ) :
    ⟪(toLp 2 f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), toLp 2 g⟫ = ∑ i, f i * g i :=
  inner_eq_sum _ _

lemma dist_sq_toLp_eq_sum (f g : ι → ℝ) :
    dist (toLp 2 f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (toLp 2 g) ^ 2 = ∑ i, (f i - g i) ^ 2 :=
  dist_sq_eq_sum _ _

lemma dist_toLp_eq_sqrt_sum (f g : ι → ℝ) :
    dist (toLp 2 f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (toLp 2 g) = √(∑ i, (f i - g i) ^ 2) :=
  dist_eq_sqrt_sum _ _

/-- A point is the sum of its coordinates along the standard basis. -/
lemma sum_smul_single_eq [DecidableEq ι] (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ∑ i, x i • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) = x := by
  ext j
  simp [Pi.single_apply]

lemma toLp_eq_sum_smul_single [DecidableEq ι] (f : ι → ℝ) :
    (toLp 2 f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) = ∑ i, f i • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) :=
  (sum_smul_single_eq _).symm

lemma inner_single_single [DecidableEq ι] (i j : ι) (a b : ℝ) :
    ⟪EuclideanSpace.single i a, EuclideanSpace.single j b⟫ = if i = j then a * b else 0 := by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h; simp
  · simp [h]

/-- On a product index type the squared norm is a double sum. -/
lemma norm_sq_prod_eq_sum (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (ι × κ)) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, ∑ j, x (i, j) ^ 2 := by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, Fintype.sum_prod_type]

end ToLp

section LowDimension

lemma norm_sq_fin_two (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]

lemma norm_fin_two (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ‖x‖ = √(x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) := by
  rw [← norm_sq_fin_two, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg x)]

lemma inner_fin_two (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ⟪x, y⟫ = x 0 * y 0 + x 1 * y 1 := by
  rw [inner_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_two]

lemma dist_sq_fin_two (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    dist x y ^ 2 = (x 0 - y 0) ^ 2 + (x 1 - y 1) ^ 2 := by
  rw [dist_sq_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_two]

lemma dist_fin_two (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    dist x y = √((x 0 - y 0) ^ 2 + (x 1 - y 1) ^ 2) := by
  rw [← dist_sq_fin_two, Real.sqrt_sq dist_nonneg]

lemma norm_sq_fin_three (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 := by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]

lemma norm_fin_three (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ‖x‖ = √(x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2) := by
  rw [← norm_sq_fin_three, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg x)]

lemma inner_fin_three (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    ⟪x, y⟫ = x 0 * y 0 + x 1 * y 1 + x 2 * y 2 := by
  rw [inner_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_three]

lemma dist_sq_fin_three (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    dist x y ^ 2 = (x 0 - y 0) ^ 2 + (x 1 - y 1) ^ 2 + (x 2 - y 2) ^ 2 := by
  rw [dist_sq_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_three]

lemma dist_fin_three (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    dist x y = √((x 0 - y 0) ^ 2 + (x 1 - y 1) ^ 2 + (x 2 - y 2) ^ 2) := by
  rw [← dist_sq_fin_three, Real.sqrt_sq dist_nonneg]

lemma eq_vec_fin_two (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : x = !₂[x 0, x 1] := by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

lemma eq_vec_fin_three (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : x = !₂[x 0, x 1, x 2] := by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

lemma norm_sq_vec_two (a b : ℝ) : ‖!₂[a, b]‖ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
  rw [norm_sq_fin_two]; rfl

lemma norm_vec_two (a b : ℝ) : ‖!₂[a, b]‖ = √(a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
  rw [norm_fin_two]; rfl

lemma inner_vec_two (a b c d : ℝ) : ⟪!₂[a, b], !₂[c, d]⟫ = a * c + b * d := by
  rw [inner_fin_two]; rfl

lemma dist_sq_vec_two (a b c d : ℝ) : dist !₂[a, b] !₂[c, d] ^ 2 = (a - c) ^ 2 + (b - d) ^ 2 := by
  rw [dist_sq_fin_two]; rfl

lemma dist_vec_two (a b c d : ℝ) : dist !₂[a, b] !₂[c, d] = √((a - c) ^ 2 + (b - d) ^ 2) := by
  rw [dist_fin_two]; rfl

lemma norm_sq_vec_three (a b c : ℝ) : ‖!₂[a, b, c]‖ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 := by
  rw [norm_sq_fin_three]; rfl

lemma norm_vec_three (a b c : ℝ) : ‖!₂[a, b, c]‖ = √(a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2) := by
  rw [norm_fin_three]; rfl

lemma inner_vec_three (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    ⟪!₂[a, b, c], !₂[d, e, f]⟫ = a * d + b * e + c * f := by
  rw [inner_fin_three]; rfl

lemma dist_sq_vec_three (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    dist !₂[a, b, c] !₂[d, e, f] ^ 2 = (a - d) ^ 2 + (b - e) ^ 2 + (c - f) ^ 2 := by
  rw [dist_sq_fin_three]; rfl

lemma dist_vec_three (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    dist !₂[a, b, c] !₂[d, e, f] = √((a - d) ^ 2 + (b - e) ^ 2 + (c - f) ^ 2) := by
  rw [dist_fin_three]; rfl

end LowDimension

section Orthogonal

/-- The transpose is the adjoint: `⟪A x, y⟫ = ⟪x, Aᵀ y⟫`. -/
lemma inner_toLp_mulVec (A : Matrix κ ι ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ) :
    ⟪(toLp 2 (A *ᵥ ofLp x) : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ), y⟫ =
      ⟪x, (toLp 2 (Aᵀ *ᵥ ofLp y) : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)⟫ := by
  rw [inner_eq_sum, inner_eq_sum]
  change (A *ᵥ ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ ofLp y = ofLp x ⬝ᵥ (Aᵀ *ᵥ ofLp y)
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_transpose, dotProduct_comm, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, dotProduct_comm]

variable [DecidableEq ι] {U : Matrix ι ι ℝ}

/-- An orthogonal matrix preserves inner products. -/
theorem inner_toLp_mulVec_of_mem_orthogonalGroup (hU : U ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ)
    (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ⟪(toLp 2 (U *ᵥ ofLp x) : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), toLp 2 (U *ᵥ ofLp y)⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫ := by
  rw [inner_toLp_mulVec, ofLp_toLp, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff' ι ℝ).1 hU, Matrix.one_mulVec, toLp_ofLp]

/-- An orthogonal matrix preserves norms. -/
theorem norm_toLp_mulVec_of_mem_orthogonalGroup (hU : U ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) : ‖(toLp 2 (U *ᵥ ofLp x) : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  have h := inner_toLp_mulVec_of_mem_orthogonalGroup hU x x
  rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at h
  exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).1 h

/-- An orthogonal matrix preserves distances. -/
theorem dist_toLp_mulVec_of_mem_orthogonalGroup (hU : U ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ)
    (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    dist (toLp 2 (U *ᵥ ofLp x) : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (toLp 2 (U *ᵥ ofLp y)) = dist x y := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, ← toLp_sub, ← Matrix.mulVec_sub, ← ofLp_sub,
    norm_toLp_mulVec_of_mem_orthogonalGroup hU]

end Orthogonal

end

end TheoremOS.Geometry

import Mathlib

/-!
# Euclidean Ramsey configurations: basic theory

A configuration `a : ι → P` is *Ramsey* (`IsEuclideanRamsey a`) when for every `r ≥ 2` some
`ℝ^D`, `D ≥ 1`, has a monochromatic congruent copy of `a` in every `r`-colouring
(`MonoCopies a D r`). This file proves: congruent copies form an equivalence and are preserved by
isometries; Ramsey transfers along congruence, reindexing and sub-configurations; monotonicity in
the number of colours and in the dimension (zero padding `padZero` is an isometry); every
equilateral configuration, in particular every configuration with at most two distinct points, is
Ramsey; compactness (a finite set of points already forces a monochromatic copy); and the product
theorem: if `a` and `a'` are Ramsey and `p` has `dist (p x) (p y)² = dist (a x.1) (a y.1)² +
dist (a' x.2) (a' y.2)²`, then `p` is Ramsey (`euclideanJoin` realises such products in
`ℝ^(d + d')`).

Sources: P. Erdős, R. L. Graham, P. Montgomery, B. L. Rothschild, J. Spencer and E. G. Straus,
*Euclidean Ramsey theorems I*, J. Combin. Theory Ser. A 14 (1973) 341–363 (the definition, the
compactness argument, products of Ramsey sets, simplices with equal edges via pigeonhole);
R. L. Graham, *Euclidean Ramsey theory*, in *Handbook of Discrete and Computational Geometry*
(J. E. Goodman and J. O'Rourke, eds.) (survey of these facts). Classical material; nothing here is
specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: with `Space d := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)` and
`Congruent a b := ∀ i j, dist (b i) (b j) = dist (a i) (a j)`, a definition
`Ramsey a := ∀ r, 2 ≤ r → ∃ D, 1 ≤ D ∧ ∀ c : Space D → Fin r, ∃ b, Congruent a b ∧ ∃ k, ∀ i,
c (b i) = k` is `IsEuclideanRamsey a` by `Iff.rfl`, and `Congruent a b` is `CongruentCopy a b`.
Products indexed by `Fin s × Fin t` move to `Fin (s * t)` with `IsEuclideanRamsey.comp_equiv`
and `finProdFinEquiv`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Geometry

open Set Function

noncomputable section

/-- `b` is a congruent copy of `a`: all pairwise distances agree. -/
def CongruentCopy {ι P Q : Type*} [Dist P] [Dist Q] (a : ι → P) (b : ι → Q) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, dist (b i) (b j) = dist (a i) (a j)

/-- Every `r`-colouring of `ℝ^D` has a monochromatic congruent copy of `a`. -/
def MonoCopies {ι P : Type*} [Dist P] (a : ι → P) (D r : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D) → Fin r, ∃ b : ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D),
    CongruentCopy a b ∧ ∃ k : Fin r, ∀ i, c (b i) = k

/-- `a` is Ramsey: for every `r ≥ 2` some `ℝ^D` with `D ≥ 1` has `MonoCopies a D r`. -/
def IsEuclideanRamsey {ι P : Type*} [Dist P] (a : ι → P) : Prop :=
  ∀ r : ℕ, 2 ≤ r → ∃ D : ℕ, 1 ≤ D ∧ MonoCopies a D r

variable {ι κ P Q R : Type*}

section Congruent

variable [PseudoMetricSpace P] [PseudoMetricSpace Q] [PseudoMetricSpace R]

theorem CongruentCopy.refl (a : ι → P) : CongruentCopy a a := fun _ _ => rfl

theorem CongruentCopy.symm {a : ι → P} {b : ι → Q} (h : CongruentCopy a b) : CongruentCopy b a :=
  fun i j => (h i j).symm

theorem CongruentCopy.trans {a : ι → P} {b : ι → Q} {c : ι → R} (hab : CongruentCopy a b)
    (hbc : CongruentCopy b c) : CongruentCopy a c := fun i j => (hbc i j).trans (hab i j)

theorem CongruentCopy.comp {a : ι → P} {b : ι → Q} (h : CongruentCopy a b) (f : κ → ι) :
    CongruentCopy (a ∘ f) (b ∘ f) := fun i j => h (f i) (f j)

theorem congruentCopy_comp_isometry (a : ι → P) {g : P → Q} (hg : Isometry g) :
    CongruentCopy a (g ∘ a) := fun i j => hg.dist_eq (a i) (a j)

theorem CongruentCopy.comp_isometry {a : ι → P} {b : ι → Q} (h : CongruentCopy a b) {g : Q → R}
    (hg : Isometry g) : CongruentCopy a (g ∘ b) := h.trans (congruentCopy_comp_isometry b hg)

end Congruent

section Transfer

variable [PseudoMetricSpace P] [PseudoMetricSpace Q]

theorem MonoCopies.of_congruentCopy {a : ι → P} {a' : ι → Q} (h : CongruentCopy a a') {D r : ℕ}
    (ha : MonoCopies a D r) : MonoCopies a' D r := fun c => by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, k, hk⟩ := ha c
  exact ⟨b, h.symm.trans hb, k, hk⟩

theorem IsEuclideanRamsey.of_congruentCopy {a : ι → P} {a' : ι → Q} (h : CongruentCopy a a')
    (ha : IsEuclideanRamsey a) : IsEuclideanRamsey a' := fun r hr => by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hm⟩ := ha r hr
  exact ⟨D, hD, hm.of_congruentCopy h⟩

theorem isEuclideanRamsey_congr {a : ι → P} {a' : ι → Q} (h : CongruentCopy a a') :
    IsEuclideanRamsey a ↔ IsEuclideanRamsey a' :=
  ⟨IsEuclideanRamsey.of_congruentCopy h, IsEuclideanRamsey.of_congruentCopy h.symm⟩

theorem MonoCopies.comp {a : ι → P} {D r : ℕ} (ha : MonoCopies a D r) (f : κ → ι) :
    MonoCopies (a ∘ f) D r := fun c => by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, k, hk⟩ := ha c
  exact ⟨b ∘ f, hb.comp f, k, fun i => hk (f i)⟩

/-- Reindexed configurations of a Ramsey configuration are Ramsey. -/
theorem IsEuclideanRamsey.comp {a : ι → P} (ha : IsEuclideanRamsey a) (f : κ → ι) :
    IsEuclideanRamsey (a ∘ f) := fun r hr => by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hm⟩ := ha r hr
  exact ⟨D, hD, hm.comp f⟩

theorem IsEuclideanRamsey.comp_equiv {a : ι → P} (e : κ ≃ ι) :
    IsEuclideanRamsey (a ∘ e) ↔ IsEuclideanRamsey a :=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa [comp_def] using h.comp e.symm, fun h => h.comp e⟩

/-- Sub-configurations of Ramsey configurations are Ramsey. -/
theorem IsEuclideanRamsey.of_range_subset {a : ι → P} (ha : IsEuclideanRamsey a) {a' : κ → P}
    (h : range a' ⊆ range a) : IsEuclideanRamsey a' := by
  choose f hf using fun j => h (mem_range_self (f := a') j)
  have : a' = a ∘ f := funext fun j => (hf j).symm
  rw [this]
  exact ha.comp f

/-- Fewer colours: `MonoCopies a D r → MonoCopies a D r'` for `r' ≤ r`. -/
theorem MonoCopies.mono_colours {a : ι → P} {D r r' : ℕ} (ha : MonoCopies a D r) (h : r' ≤ r) :
    MonoCopies a D r' := fun c => by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, k, hk⟩ := ha (Fin.castLE h ∘ c)
  refine ⟨b, hb, ?_⟩
  by_cases hι : IsEmpty ι
  · obtain ⟨x⟩ : Nonempty (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D)) := inferInstance
    exact ⟨c x, fun i => isEmptyElim i⟩
  · obtain ⟨i₀⟩ := not_isEmpty_iff.mp hι
    refine ⟨c (b i₀), fun i => Fin.castLE_injective h ?_⟩
    exact (hk i).trans (hk i₀).symm

end Transfer

section Dimension

/-- Zero padding `ℝ^D → ℝ^E` for `D ≤ E`. -/
def padZero {D E : ℕ} (_h : D ≤ E) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin E) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 fun j => if hj : (j : ℕ) < D then x ⟨j, hj⟩ else 0

theorem isometry_padZero {D E : ℕ} (h : D ≤ E) : Isometry (padZero h) := by
  refine Isometry.of_dist_eq fun x y => ?_
  rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_eq, EuclideanSpace.dist_eq]
  congr 1
  symm
  refine Fintype.sum_of_injective (Fin.castLE h) (Fin.castLE_injective h) _ _ ?_ ?_
  · intro j hj
    have hjD : ¬ (j : ℕ) < D := fun hlt => hj ⟨⟨j, hlt⟩, Fin.ext rfl⟩
    simp [padZero, hjD]
  · intro i
    simp [padZero, i.isLt]

theorem MonoCopies.mono_dim [PseudoMetricSpace P] {a : ι → P} {D E r : ℕ} (ha : MonoCopies a D r)
    (h : D ≤ E) : MonoCopies a E r := fun c => by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, k, hk⟩ := ha (c ∘ padZero h)
  exact ⟨padZero h ∘ b, hb.comp_isometry (isometry_padZero h), k, hk⟩

theorem IsEuclideanRamsey.eventually [PseudoMetricSpace P] {a : ι → P} (ha : IsEuclideanRamsey a)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) : ∃ D₀, ∀ D, D₀ ≤ D → MonoCopies a D r := by
  obtain ⟨D₀, -, h⟩ := ha r hr
  exact ⟨D₀, fun D hD => h.mono_dim hD⟩

/-- Ramsey means: for every `r ≥ 2`, all large enough dimensions work. -/
theorem isEuclideanRamsey_iff_eventually [PseudoMetricSpace P] {a : ι → P} :
    IsEuclideanRamsey a ↔ ∀ r : ℕ, 2 ≤ r → ∃ D₀, ∀ D, D₀ ≤ D → MonoCopies a D r :=
  ⟨fun ha _ hr => ha.eventually hr, fun h r hr => by
    obtain ⟨D₀, hD⟩ := h r hr
    exact ⟨max D₀ 1, le_max_right _ _, hD _ (le_max_left _ _)⟩⟩

end Dimension

section Equilateral

lemma dist_single_single_of_ne {D : ℕ} {m m' : Fin D} (hmm : m ≠ m') (t : ℝ) :
    dist (EuclideanSpace.single m t) (EuclideanSpace.single m' t) = √2 * |t| := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  have hsq : ‖EuclideanSpace.single m t - EuclideanSpace.single m' t‖ ^ 2 = (√2 * |t|) ^ 2 := by
    rw [@norm_sub_sq_real, PiLp.norm_single, PiLp.norm_single,
      EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
    simp [hmm, mul_pow]
    ring
  exact (pow_left_inj₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity) two_ne_zero).mp hsq

/-- **Equilateral configurations are Ramsey** (pigeonhole on the vertices of a regular simplex
with `r · |ι| + 1` vertices). -/
theorem isEuclideanRamsey_of_equilateral [Finite ι] [PseudoMetricSpace P] {a : ι → P} {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (h : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → dist (a i) (a j) = δ) : IsEuclideanRamsey a := by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  intro r _
  refine ⟨r * Fintype.card ι + 1, by omega, fun c => ?_⟩
  let v : Fin (r * Fintype.card ι + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (r * Fintype.card ι + 1)) :=
    fun m => EuclideanSpace.single m (δ / √2)
  have hv : ∀ m m', m ≠ m' → dist (v m) (v m') = δ := by
    intro m m' hmm
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < √2 := by positivity
    rw [dist_single_single_of_ne hmm, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hδ h2.le)]
    field_simp
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Fintype.exists_lt_card_fiber_of_mul_lt_card (f := fun m => c (v m))
    (n := Fintype.card ι) (by rw [Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin]; omega)
  set F := Finset.univ.filter fun m => c (v m) = k
  have hcard : Fintype.card ι ≤ F.card := hk.le
  let g : ι → Fin (r * Fintype.card ι + 1) := fun i =>
    F.orderEmbOfFin rfl (Fin.castLE hcard (Fintype.equivFin ι i))
  have hg : Injective g := fun i j hij =>
    (Fintype.equivFin ι).injective (Fin.castLE_injective hcard ((F.orderEmbOfFin rfl).injective hij))
  have hgF : ∀ i, g i ∈ F := fun i => F.orderEmbOfFin_mem rfl _
  refine ⟨fun i => v (g i), fun i j => ?_, k, fun i => (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hgF i)).2⟩
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij; simp
  · rw [hv _ _ (hg.ne hij), h i j hij]

/-- Two-point configurations are Ramsey. -/
theorem isEuclideanRamsey_pair [PseudoMetricSpace P] (x y : P) : IsEuclideanRamsey ![x, y] :=
  isEuclideanRamsey_of_equilateral (δ := dist x y) dist_nonneg fun i j hij => by
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all [dist_comm]

/-- Configurations with at most two distinct points are Ramsey. -/
theorem isEuclideanRamsey_of_range_subset_pair [PseudoMetricSpace P] {a : ι → P} {x y : P}
    (h : range a ⊆ {x, y}) : IsEuclideanRamsey a :=
  (isEuclideanRamsey_pair x y).of_range_subset fun z hz => by
    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp (h hz) with hzx | hzy
    · exact ⟨0, hzx.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨1, (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hzy).symm⟩

theorem isEuclideanRamsey_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton ι] [PseudoMetricSpace P] (a : ι → P) :
    IsEuclideanRamsey a :=
  isEuclideanRamsey_of_equilateral le_rfl fun i j hij => absurd (Subsingleton.elim i j) hij

end Equilateral

section Compactness

/-- **Compactness**: if every `r`-colouring of `ℝ^D` has a monochromatic copy of a finite
configuration, then a finite set `X` of points already contains one for every colouring. -/
theorem MonoCopies.exists_finset [Finite ι] [PseudoMetricSpace P] {a : ι → P} {D r : ℕ}
    (ha : MonoCopies a D r) :
    ∃ X : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D)), ∀ c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D) → Fin r,
      ∃ b : ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D), (∀ i, b i ∈ X) ∧ CongruentCopy a b ∧
        ∃ k : Fin r, ∀ i, c (b i) = k := by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  by_contra hne
  push Not at hne
  let K : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D)) → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D) → Fin r) := fun X =>
    {c | ∀ b : ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D), (∀ i, b i ∈ X) → CongruentCopy a b →
      ∀ k : Fin r, ∃ i, c (b i) ≠ k}
  have hcl : ∀ X, IsClosed (K X) := by
    intro X
    have e : K X = ⋂ (b : ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D)) (_ : ∀ i, b i ∈ X) (_ : CongruentCopy a b),
        {c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D) → Fin r | ∀ k : Fin r, ∃ i, c (b i) ≠ k} := by
      ext c; simp only [K, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rw [e]
    refine isClosed_iInter fun b => isClosed_iInter fun _ => isClosed_iInter fun _ => ?_
    have hcont : Continuous fun c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D) → Fin r => fun i => c (b i) :=
      continuous_pi fun i => continuous_apply (b i)
    exact (isClosed_discrete {f : ι → Fin r | ∀ k : Fin r, ∃ i, f i ≠ k}).preimage hcont
  have hdir : Directed (· ⊇ ·) K := fun X Y => ⟨X ∪ Y,
    fun _ hc b hb => hc b fun i => Finset.mem_union_left _ (hb i),
    fun _ hc b hb => hc b fun i => Finset.mem_union_right _ (hb i)⟩
  have hnon : ∀ X, (K X).Nonempty := fun X => by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hne X
    exact ⟨c, hc⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := IsCompact.nonempty_iInter_of_directed_nonempty_isCompact_isClosed K hdir hnon
    (fun X => (hcl X).isCompact) hcl
  obtain ⟨b, hb, k, hk⟩ := ha c
  rw [Set.mem_iInter] at hc
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hc (Finset.univ.image b) b
    (fun i => Finset.mem_image_of_mem b (Finset.mem_univ i)) hb k
  exact hi (hk i)

end Compactness

section Product

/-- `ℝ^d × ℝ^d' → ℝ^(d + d')`, concatenating coordinates. -/
def euclideanJoin {d d' : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d')) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + d')) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.append (WithLp.ofLp x) (WithLp.ofLp y))

theorem dist_euclideanJoin_sq {d d' : ℕ} (x x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (y y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d')) :
    dist (euclideanJoin x y) (euclideanJoin x' y') ^ 2 = dist x x' ^ 2 + dist y y' ^ 2 := by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq,
    Fin.sum_univ_add]
  simp [euclideanJoin]

/-- **Products of Ramsey configurations are Ramsey.** If `a` and `a'` are Ramsey and
`dist (p x) (p y)² = dist (a x.1) (a y.1)² + dist (a' x.2) (a' y.2)²` (as for
`p x = euclideanJoin (a x.1) (a' x.2)`), then `p` is Ramsey. -/
theorem IsEuclideanRamsey.prod [Finite ι] [PseudoMetricSpace P] [PseudoMetricSpace Q]
    [PseudoMetricSpace R] {a : ι → P} {a' : κ → Q} (ha : IsEuclideanRamsey a)
    (ha' : IsEuclideanRamsey a') {p : ι × κ → R}
    (hp : ∀ x y, dist (p x) (p y) ^ 2 = dist (a x.1) (a y.1) ^ 2 + dist (a' x.2) (a' y.2) ^ 2) :
    IsEuclideanRamsey p := by
  classical
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨D₁, hD₁, h₁⟩ := ha r hr
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := h₁.exists_finset
  -- Colour `ℝ^D₂` by the colour pattern each point induces on the finite set `X`.
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hN2⟩ : ∃ N, Fintype.card (X → Fin r) < N ∧ 2 ≤ N :=
    ⟨Fintype.card (X → Fin r) + 2, by omega, by omega⟩
  let enc : (X → Fin r) → Fin N := fun f => Fin.castLE hN.le (Fintype.equivFin _ f)
  have henc : Injective enc := fun f g h =>
    (Fintype.equivFin _).injective (Fin.castLE_injective hN.le h)
  obtain ⟨D₂, hD₂, h₂⟩ := ha' N hN2
  refine ⟨D₁ + D₂, by omega, fun c => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨b₂, hb₂, k₂, hk₂⟩ :=
    h₂ fun y => enc fun x => c (euclideanJoin (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D₁)) y)
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty κ with hκ | ⟨⟨l₀⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨fun x => isEmptyElim x.2, fun x => isEmptyElim x.2, ⟨0, by omega⟩,
      fun x => isEmptyElim x.2⟩
  have hpat : ∀ l, (fun x : X => c (euclideanJoin (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D₁)) (b₂ l))) =
      fun x : X => c (euclideanJoin (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D₁)) (b₂ l₀)) :=
    fun l => henc ((hk₂ l).trans (hk₂ l₀).symm)
  obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁X, hb₁, k₁, hk₁⟩ := hX fun z => c (euclideanJoin z (b₂ l₀))
  refine ⟨fun x => euclideanJoin (b₁ x.1) (b₂ x.2), fun x y => ?_, k₁, fun x => ?_⟩
  · refine (pow_left_inj₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg two_ne_zero).mp ?_
    rw [dist_euclideanJoin_sq, hb₁, hb₂, hp]
  · have := congrFun (hpat x.2) ⟨b₁ x.1, hb₁X x.1⟩
    simp only at this ⊢
    rw [this]
    exact hk₁ x.1

theorem IsEuclideanRamsey.join [Finite ι] {d d' : ℕ} {a : ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)}
    {a' : κ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d')} (ha : IsEuclideanRamsey a) (ha' : IsEuclideanRamsey a') :
    IsEuclideanRamsey fun x : ι × κ => euclideanJoin (a x.1) (a' x.2) :=
  ha.prod ha' fun _ _ => dist_euclideanJoin_sq _ _ _ _

end Product

end

end TheoremOS.Geometry
