import Submission.Library.TheoremOS.InformationTheory.Entropy

/-!
# Submodularity of joint entropy and Shearer's lemma

Shearer's lemma for an abstract monotone submodular set function `f` with `f ∅ = 0`, in a
fractional form (weights covering every point with total weight at least one) and in the
`k`-fold cover form; Han's inequality is the cover by the sets `U \ {i}`. The entropy layer:
the law `pushforward X p` of a random variable on a finite weighted space, monotonicity under
functions, invariance under injective maps, the inequality `H(X, Y) + H(Z) ≤ H(X) + H(Y)` when
`Z` is a function of `X` and of `Y` (nonnegativity of conditional mutual information),
`H(X, Y, Z) + H(Z) ≤ H(X, Z) + H(Y, Z)`, and the joint entropy `jointEntropy p X S` of a
subfamily `(X i)_{i ∈ S}` as a monotone submodular set function. Counting: for a finite family
`𝓕` of functions on a finite index type and a `k`-fold cover `F`,
`#𝓕 ^ k ≤ ∏ j, #(𝓕 restricted to F j)`, and the discrete Loomis–Whitney inequality
`#𝓕 ^ (n - 1) ≤ ∏ i, #(𝓕 restricted to the complement of i)`.

Sources: F. R. K. Chung, R. L. Graham, P. Frankl and J. B. Shearer, *Some intersection theorems
for ordered sets and graphs*, J. Combin. Theory Ser. A 43 (1986) 23–37 (Shearer's lemma);
T. S. Han, *Nonnegative entropy measures of multivariate symmetric correlations*, Inform. and
Control 36 (1978) 133–156; J. Radhakrishnan, *Entropy and counting*, in Computational
Mathematics, Modelling and Algorithms, 2003 (Shearer's lemma and the projection bound);
M. Madiman and P. Tetali, *Information inequalities for joint distributions, with
interpretations and applications*, IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory 56 (2010) 2699–2713 (fractional
covers of submodular functions); T. M. Cover and J. A. Thomas, *Elements of Information
Theory*, 2nd ed., Wiley, 2006, Sections 2.5–2.6 and 17.6. Textbook material; nothing here is
specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: `pushforward X p` is the law of `X : Ω → α` under weights `p` on `Ω`; a statement about
weights `r` on a product `∀ i, β i` is `jointEntropy r (fun i x => x i) univ = entropy r`
(`jointEntropy_univ_coord`); a family of random variables `X : ι → Ω → α` with a common value
type is the constant-family case `β := fun _ => α`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.InformationTheory

open Finset Real
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

/-! ### Shearer's lemma for submodular set functions -/

section Submodular

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {f : Finset ι → ℝ}

/-- Diminishing returns: adding `a ∉ U` to `B ⊆ U` gains at least as much as adding it to `U`. -/
lemma submodular_insert_sub_le
    (hsub : ∀ S T, f (S ∪ T) + f (S ∩ T) ≤ f S + f T) {B U : Finset ι} {a : ι} (hBU : B ⊆ U)
    (ha : a ∉ U) : f (insert a U) - f U ≤ f (insert a B) - f B := by
  have h := hsub (insert a B) U
  rw [insert_union, union_eq_right.2 hBU, insert_inter_of_notMem ha, inter_eq_left.2 hBU] at h
  linarith

/-- **Shearer's lemma, fractional form**, for a monotone submodular `f` with `f ∅ = 0`: if every
point of `U` lies in sets `F j` of total weight at least one, then `f U ≤ ∑ j, w j f (U ∩ F j)`. -/
theorem fractional_shearer_of_submodular (hmono : ∀ S T, S ⊆ T → f S ≤ f T)
    (hsub : ∀ S T, f (S ∪ T) + f (S ∩ T) ≤ f S + f T) (hempty : f ∅ = 0) {κ : Type*}
    (s : Finset κ) (F : κ → Finset ι) {w : κ → ℝ} (hw : ∀ j ∈ s, 0 ≤ w j) (U : Finset ι)
    (hcover : ∀ i ∈ U, 1 ≤ ∑ j ∈ s with i ∈ F j, w j) :
    f U ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, w j * f (U ∩ F j) := by
  induction U using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    simp only [empty_inter, hempty, mul_zero, sum_const_zero, le_refl]
  | @insert a U haU ih =>
    have ih := ih fun i hi => hcover i (mem_insert_of_mem hi)
    have ha := hcover a (mem_insert_self a U)
    set δ := f (insert a U) - f U with hδ
    have hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ := sub_nonneg.2 (hmono _ _ (subset_insert a U))
    have hterm : ∀ j ∈ s, (if a ∈ F j then w j else 0) * δ ≤
        w j * (f (insert a U ∩ F j) - f (U ∩ F j)) := by
      intro j hj
      by_cases haF : a ∈ F j
      · rw [ite_eq_left haF, insert_inter_of_mem haF]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (submodular_insert_sub_le hsub inter_subset_left haU) (hw j hj)
      · rw [ite_eq_right haF, insert_inter_of_notMem haF, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    have hsum : δ ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, w j * (f (insert a U ∩ F j) - f (U ∩ F j)) := by
      calc δ ≤ (∑ j ∈ s with a ∈ F j, w j) * δ := le_mul_of_one_le_left hδ0 ha
        _ = ∑ j ∈ s, (if a ∈ F j then w j else 0) * δ := by rw [sum_filter, sum_mul]
        _ ≤ _ := sum_le_sum hterm
    have hsplit : ∑ j ∈ s, w j * f (insert a U ∩ F j) =
        ∑ j ∈ s, w j * f (U ∩ F j) +
          ∑ j ∈ s, w j * (f (insert a U ∩ F j) - f (U ∩ F j)) := by
      rw [← sum_add_distrib]
      exact sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring
    linarith

omit [DecidableEq ι] in
lemma nonneg_of_submodular (hmono : ∀ S T, S ⊆ T → f S ≤ f T) (hempty : f ∅ = 0)
    (S : Finset ι) : 0 ≤ f S := by
  simpa [hempty] using hmono ∅ S (empty_subset S)

/-- **Shearer's lemma** for a monotone submodular `f` with `f ∅ = 0`: if every point of `U`
lies in at least `k` of the sets `F j`, `j ∈ s`, then `k f U ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, f (U ∩ F j)`. -/
theorem shearer_of_submodular (hmono : ∀ S T, S ⊆ T → f S ≤ f T)
    (hsub : ∀ S T, f (S ∪ T) + f (S ∩ T) ≤ f S + f T) (hempty : f ∅ = 0) {κ : Type*}
    (s : Finset κ) (F : κ → Finset ι) {k : ℕ} (U : Finset ι)
    (hcover : ∀ i ∈ U, k ≤ #{j ∈ s | i ∈ F j}) :
    k * f U ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, f (U ∩ F j) := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
  · rw [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
    exact sum_nonneg fun j _ => nonneg_of_submodular hmono hempty _
  have hk' : (0 : ℝ) < k := Nat.cast_pos.2 hk
  have h := fractional_shearer_of_submodular hmono hsub hempty s F (w := fun _ => (k : ℝ)⁻¹)
    (fun _ _ => inv_nonneg.2 hk'.le) U (fun i hi => by
      simp only [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      rw [le_mul_inv_iff₀ hk', one_mul]
      exact_mod_cast hcover i hi)
  rw [← mul_sum] at h
  rw [← le_inv_mul_iff₀ hk']
  exact h

/-- **Han's inequality** for a monotone submodular `f` with `f ∅ = 0`:
`(|U| - 1) f U ≤ ∑ i ∈ U, f (U \ {i})`. -/
theorem han_of_submodular (hmono : ∀ S T, S ⊆ T → f S ≤ f T)
    (hsub : ∀ S T, f (S ∪ T) + f (S ∩ T) ≤ f S + f T) (hempty : f ∅ = 0) (U : Finset ι) :
    ((#U - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * f U ≤ ∑ i ∈ U, f (U.erase i) := by
  have h := shearer_of_submodular hmono hsub hempty U (fun i => U.erase i) (k := #U - 1) U
    (fun i hi => by
      rw [← card_erase_of_mem hi]
      exact card_le_card fun j hj => mem_filter.2
        ⟨mem_of_mem_erase hj, mem_erase.2 ⟨fun h => ne_of_mem_erase hj h.symm, hi⟩⟩)
  simpa only [inter_erase, inter_self] using h

end Submodular

/-! ### Entropy of random variables on a finite weighted space -/

section RandomVariable

variable {Ω α β γ : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ]
  [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]

/-- Integrating against the law: `∑ a, (X_* p) a φ a = ∑ ω, p ω φ (X ω)`. -/
lemma sum_pushforward_mul (X : Ω → α) (p : Ω → ℝ) (φ : α → ℝ) :
    ∑ a, pushforward X p a * φ a = ∑ ω, p ω * φ (X ω) := by
  calc ∑ a, pushforward X p a * φ a = ∑ a, ∑ ω with X ω = a, p ω * φ (X ω) := by
        refine sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
        rw [pushforward, sum_mul]
        exact sum_congr rfl fun ω hω => by rw [(mem_filter.1 hω).2]
    _ = ∑ ω, p ω * φ (X ω) := sum_fiberwise univ X fun ω => p ω * φ (X ω)

omit [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] in
lemma pushforward_id [DecidableEq Ω] (p : Ω → ℝ) : pushforward (fun ω => ω) p = p := by
  funext ω
  simp [pushforward, filter_eq']

omit [Fintype β] in
/-- The law of `g ∘ X` is the pushforward of the law of `X`. -/
lemma pushforward_comp (X : Ω → α) (g : α → β) (p : Ω → ℝ) :
    pushforward g (pushforward X p) = pushforward (fun ω => g (X ω)) p := by
  funext b
  have h := sum_pushforward_mul X p fun a => if g a = b then 1 else 0
  simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, ← sum_filter] at h
  exact h

omit [Fintype α] in
lemma pushforward_nonneg {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (X : Ω → α) (a : α) :
    0 ≤ pushforward X p a :=
  sum_nonneg fun ω _ => hp ω

/-- **Data processing**: `H(g(X)) ≤ H(X)`. -/
theorem entropy_pushforward_comp_le {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (X : Ω → α) (g : α → β) :
    entropy (pushforward (fun ω => g (X ω)) p) ≤ entropy (pushforward X p) := by
  rw [← pushforward_comp]
  exact entropy_pushforward_le (pushforward_nonneg hp X) g

/-- Random variables that are functions of each other have the same entropy. -/
theorem entropy_pushforward_eq_of_comp {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) {X : Ω → α}
    {Y : Ω → β} (f : α → β) (g : β → α) (hY : ∀ ω, Y ω = f (X ω)) (hX : ∀ ω, X ω = g (Y ω)) :
    entropy (pushforward Y p) = entropy (pushforward X p) := by
  have hY' : Y = fun ω => f (X ω) := funext hY
  have hX' : X = fun ω => g (Y ω) := funext hX
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [hY']; exact entropy_pushforward_comp_le hp X f
  · rw [hX']; exact entropy_pushforward_comp_le hp Y g

omit [Fintype α] in
lemma pushforward_const {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (a : α) :
    pushforward (fun _ => a) p = fun b => if b = a then 1 else 0 := by
  funext b
  by_cases h : b = a
  · subst h
    simp [pushforward, hp.sum_eq_one]
  · simp [pushforward, Ne.symm h, h]

/-- A constant has entropy zero. -/
lemma entropy_pushforward_const {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (a : α) :
    entropy (pushforward (fun _ => a) p) = 0 := by
  rw [pushforward_const hp, entropy]
  exact sum_eq_zero fun b _ => by split_ifs <;> simp

/-- The law of an injective image has the same entropy. -/
theorem entropy_pushforward_of_injective {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) {g : Ω → α}
    (hg : Function.Injective g) : entropy (pushforward g p) = entropy p := by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm (entropy_pushforward_le hp g) ?_
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty Ω with hΩ | hΩ
  · simp [entropy, pushforward]
  have hinv : ∀ ω, Function.invFun g (g ω) = ω := Function.leftInverse_invFun hg
  calc entropy p = entropy (pushforward (fun ω => Function.invFun g (g ω)) p) := by
        simp only [hinv, pushforward_id]
    _ ≤ entropy (pushforward g p) :=
        entropy_pushforward_comp_le hp g (Function.invFun g)

/-- **Submodularity of entropy**: if `Z = g(X) = h(Y)` is a common function of `X` and `Y`, then
`H(X, Y) + H(Z) ≤ H(X) + H(Y)`; this is `I(X; Y | Z) ≥ 0`. -/
theorem entropy_pair_add_le {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β)
    (g : α → γ) (h : β → γ) (hgh : ∀ ω, g (X ω) = h (Y ω)) :
    entropy (pushforward (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) p) + entropy (pushforward (fun ω => g (X ω)) p) ≤
      entropy (pushforward X p) + entropy (pushforward Y p) := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r, r = pushforward (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁⟩ : ∃ r₁, r₁ = pushforward X p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂⟩ : ∃ r₂, r₂ = pushforward Y p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L, L = pushforward (fun ω => g (X ω)) p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hr, ← hr₁, ← hr₂, ← hL]
  have hrd : IsDistribution r := by rw [hr]; exact hp.pushforward _
  have hr0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ r x := hrd.nonneg
  have hr₁0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ r₁ a := fun a => by rw [hr₁]; exact pushforward_nonneg hp.nonneg X a
  have hr₂0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ r₂ b := fun b => by rw [hr₂]; exact pushforward_nonneg hp.nonneg Y b
  have hL0 : ∀ c, 0 ≤ L c := fun c => by rw [hL]; exact pushforward_nonneg hp.nonneg _ c
  have hfst : pushforward Prod.fst r = r₁ := by rw [hr, hr₁, pushforward_comp]
  have hsnd : pushforward Prod.snd r = r₂ := by rw [hr, hr₂, pushforward_comp]
  have hLX : pushforward g r₁ = L := by rw [hr₁, hL, pushforward_comp]
  have hLY : pushforward h r₂ = L := by
    rw [hr₂, hL, pushforward_comp]
    exact congrArg (fun F => pushforward F p) (funext fun ω => (hgh ω).symm)
  have hsupp : ∀ x : α × β, r x ≠ 0 → g x.1 = h x.2 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hr] at hx
    obtain ⟨ω, hω, -⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hx
    have hxω : (X ω, Y ω) = x := (mem_filter.1 hω).2
    subst hxω
    exact hgh ω
  have hle₁ : ∀ x : α × β, r x ≤ r₁ x.1 := by
    intro x
    rw [← hfst]
    exact single_le_sum (fun y _ => hr0 y) (mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ x, rfl⟩)
  have hle₂ : ∀ x : α × β, r x ≤ r₂ x.2 := by
    intro x
    rw [← hsnd]
    exact single_le_sum (fun y _ => hr0 y) (mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ x, rfl⟩)
  have hLge : ∀ a, r₁ a ≤ L (g a) := by
    intro a
    rw [← hLX]
    exact single_le_sum (fun y _ => hr₁0 y) (mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ a, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q : α × β → ℝ, ∀ a b,
      q (a, b) = if g a = h b then r₁ a * r₂ b / L (g a) else 0 :=
    ⟨fun x => if g x.1 = h x.2 then r₁ x.1 * r₂ x.2 / L (g x.1) else 0, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hpos : ∀ a b, r (a, b) ≠ 0 → 0 < r₁ a ∧ 0 < r₂ b ∧ 0 < L (g a) := by
    intro a b hx
    have h1 : 0 < r₁ a := lt_of_lt_of_le ((hr0 _).lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hx)) (hle₁ (a, b))
    have h2 : 0 < r₂ b := lt_of_lt_of_le ((hr0 _).lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hx)) (hle₂ (a, b))
    exact ⟨h1, h2, lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (hLge a)⟩
  have hq0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ q x := by
    rintro ⟨a, b⟩
    rw [hq]
    split_ifs
    · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hr₁0 a) (hr₂0 b)) (hL0 _)
    · exact le_rfl
  have hqr : ∀ x, q x = 0 → r x = 0 := by
    rintro ⟨a, b⟩ hqx
    by_contra hx
    have hab : g a = h b := hsupp (a, b) hx
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hpos a b hx
    rw [hq, ite_eq_left hab] at hqx
    exact (div_pos (mul_pos h1 h2) h3).ne' hqx
  have hqsum : ∑ x, q x ≤ ∑ x, r x := by
    rw [hrd.sum_eq_one, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    calc ∑ a, ∑ b, q (a, b) = ∑ a, r₁ a / L (g a) * ∑ b with h b = g a, r₂ b := by
          refine sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
          rw [mul_sum, sum_filter]
          refine sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
          rw [hq]
          by_cases hab : g a = h b
          · rw [ite_eq_left hab, ite_eq_left hab.symm]
            ring
          · rw [ite_eq_right hab, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hab)]
      _ = ∑ a, r₁ a / L (g a) * L (g a) := by
          refine sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
          rw [← hLY]
          rfl
      _ ≤ ∑ a, r₁ a := by
          refine sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_
          rcases (hL0 (g a)).eq_or_lt with h0 | h0
          · rw [← h0, mul_zero]
            exact hr₁0 a
          · exact (div_mul_cancel₀ (r₁ a) h0.ne').le
      _ = 1 := by rw [hr₁]; exact (hp.pushforward X).sum_eq_one
  have hlog : ∑ x, r x * log (q x) = ∑ x, r x * log (r₁ x.1) + ∑ x, r x * log (r₂ x.2) -
      ∑ x, r x * log (L (g x.1)) := by
    rw [← sum_add_distrib, ← sum_sub_distrib]
    refine sum_congr rfl ?_
    rintro ⟨a, b⟩ _
    dsimp only
    by_cases hx : r (a, b) = 0
    · simp [hx]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hpos a b hx
    rw [hq, ite_eq_left (hsupp (a, b) hx), log_div (mul_pos h1 h2).ne' h3.ne',
      log_mul h1.ne' h2.ne']
    ring
  have hs1 : ∑ x, r x * log (r₁ x.1) = -entropy r₁ := by
    rw [entropy_eq_neg_sum, neg_neg, ← hfst, sum_pushforward_mul]
  have hs2 : ∑ x, r x * log (r₂ x.2) = -entropy r₂ := by
    rw [entropy_eq_neg_sum, neg_neg, ← hsnd, sum_pushforward_mul]
  have hLr : pushforward (fun x : α × β => g x.1) r = L := by
    rw [← hLX, ← hfst, pushforward_comp]
  have hsL : ∑ x, r x * log (L (g x.1)) = -entropy L := by
    rw [entropy_eq_neg_sum, neg_neg, ← hLr, sum_pushforward_mul]
  have hgibbs := sum_mul_log_le_sum_mul_log hr0 hq0 hqr hqsum
  rw [hlog, hs1, hs2, hsL] at hgibbs
  rw [entropy_eq_neg_sum r]
  linarith

/-- **Subadditivity**: `H(X, Y) ≤ H(X) + H(Y)`. -/
theorem entropy_pair_le {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) :
    entropy (pushforward (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) p) ≤
      entropy (pushforward X p) + entropy (pushforward Y p) := by
  have h := entropy_pair_add_le hp X Y (fun _ => ()) (fun _ => ()) fun _ => rfl
  have h0 : entropy (pushforward (fun _ : Ω => ()) p) = 0 := entropy_pushforward_const hp ()
  linarith

/-- **Submodularity**, three-variable form: `H(X, Y, Z) + H(Z) ≤ H(X, Z) + H(Y, Z)`. -/
theorem entropy_triple_add_le {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β)
    (Z : Ω → γ) :
    entropy (pushforward (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω, Z ω)) p) + entropy (pushforward Z p) ≤
      entropy (pushforward (fun ω => (X ω, Z ω)) p) +
        entropy (pushforward (fun ω => (Y ω, Z ω)) p) := by
  have h := entropy_pair_add_le hp (fun ω => (X ω, Z ω)) (fun ω => (Y ω, Z ω))
    Prod.snd Prod.snd fun _ => rfl
  have e : entropy (pushforward (fun ω => ((X ω, Z ω), (Y ω, Z ω))) p) =
      entropy (pushforward (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω, Z ω)) p) :=
    entropy_pushforward_eq_of_comp hp.nonneg (fun t => ((t.1, t.2.2), (t.2.1, t.2.2)))
      (fun s => (s.1.1, s.2.1, s.1.2)) (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)
  have h' : entropy (pushforward (fun ω => ((X ω, Z ω), (Y ω, Z ω))) p) +
      entropy (pushforward Z p) ≤ entropy (pushforward (fun ω => (X ω, Z ω)) p) +
        entropy (pushforward (fun ω => (Y ω, Z ω)) p) := h
  linarith

end RandomVariable

/-! ### Joint entropy of subfamilies -/

section Family

variable {ι Ω : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {β : ι → Type*}

/-- The subfamily `(X i ω)_{i ∈ S}`, with `none` off `S`. -/
def restrictOpt (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) (S : Finset ι) (ω : Ω) : ∀ i, Option (β i) :=
  fun i => if i ∈ S then some (X i ω) else none

/-- Forget the coordinates outside `S`. -/
def maskOpt (S : Finset ι) (y : ∀ i, Option (β i)) : ∀ i, Option (β i) :=
  fun i => if i ∈ S then y i else none

lemma maskOpt_restrictOpt (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) (S T : Finset ι) (ω : Ω) :
    maskOpt S (restrictOpt X T ω) = restrictOpt X (T ∩ S) ω := by
  funext i
  by_cases hS : i ∈ S <;> by_cases hT : i ∈ T <;> simp [maskOpt, restrictOpt, hS, hT]

lemma restrictOpt_empty (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) : restrictOpt X ∅ = fun _ _ => none := by
  funext ω i
  simp [restrictOpt]

variable [Fintype ι] [Fintype Ω] [∀ i, Fintype (β i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (β i)]

/-- The joint entropy `H((X i)_{i ∈ S})` under weights `p`. -/
def jointEntropy (p : Ω → ℝ) (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) (S : Finset ι) : ℝ :=
  entropy (pushforward (restrictOpt X S) p)

lemma jointEntropy_empty {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) :
    jointEntropy p X ∅ = 0 := by
  rw [jointEntropy, restrictOpt_empty]
  exact entropy_pushforward_const hp _

lemma jointEntropy_mono {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) {S T : Finset ι}
    (hST : S ⊆ T) : jointEntropy p X S ≤ jointEntropy p X T := by
  have h : restrictOpt X S = fun ω => maskOpt S (restrictOpt X T ω) := by
    funext ω
    rw [maskOpt_restrictOpt, inter_eq_right.2 hST]
  unfold jointEntropy
  rw [h]
  exact entropy_pushforward_comp_le hp (restrictOpt X T) (maskOpt S)

/-- **Submodularity of joint entropy**: `H(X_{S ∪ T}) + H(X_{S ∩ T}) ≤ H(X_S) + H(X_T)`. -/
theorem jointEntropy_union_add_inter_le {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p)
    (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) (S T : Finset ι) :
    jointEntropy p X (S ∪ T) + jointEntropy p X (S ∩ T) ≤
      jointEntropy p X S + jointEntropy p X T := by
  have h := entropy_pair_add_le hp (restrictOpt X S) (restrictOpt X T) (maskOpt T) (maskOpt S)
    fun ω => by rw [maskOpt_restrictOpt, maskOpt_restrictOpt, inter_comm]
  have hT : (fun ω => maskOpt T (restrictOpt X S ω)) = restrictOpt X (S ∩ T) := by
    funext ω
    rw [maskOpt_restrictOpt]
  have e := entropy_pushforward_eq_of_comp hp.nonneg (X := restrictOpt X (S ∪ T))
    (Y := fun ω => (restrictOpt X S ω, restrictOpt X T ω))
    (fun y => (maskOpt S y, maskOpt T y)) (fun z i => if i ∈ S then z.1 i else z.2 i)
    (fun ω => by
      rw [maskOpt_restrictOpt, maskOpt_restrictOpt, union_inter_cancel_left,
        union_inter_cancel_right])
    (fun ω => by
      funext i
      by_cases hS : i ∈ S <;> by_cases hT : i ∈ T <;> simp [restrictOpt, hS, hT])
  rw [hT, e] at h
  exact h

/-- **Shearer's lemma** for entropy: if every coordinate of `U` lies in at least `k` of the sets
`F j`, `j ∈ s`, then `k H(X_U) ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, H(X_{U ∩ F j})`. -/
theorem jointEntropy_shearer {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i)
    {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (F : κ → Finset ι) {k : ℕ} (U : Finset ι)
    (hcover : ∀ i ∈ U, k ≤ #{j ∈ s | i ∈ F j}) :
    k * jointEntropy p X U ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, jointEntropy p X (U ∩ F j) :=
  shearer_of_submodular (f := jointEntropy p X) (fun _ _ h => jointEntropy_mono hp.nonneg X h)
    (jointEntropy_union_add_inter_le hp X) (jointEntropy_empty hp X) s F U hcover

/-- **Shearer's lemma**, fractional form: if every coordinate of `U` lies in sets `F j` of total
weight at least one, then `H(X_U) ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, w j H(X_{U ∩ F j})`. -/
theorem jointEntropy_fractional_shearer {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p)
    (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (F : κ → Finset ι) {w : κ → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ j ∈ s, 0 ≤ w j) (U : Finset ι) (hcover : ∀ i ∈ U, 1 ≤ ∑ j ∈ s with i ∈ F j, w j) :
    jointEntropy p X U ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, w j * jointEntropy p X (U ∩ F j) :=
  fractional_shearer_of_submodular (f := jointEntropy p X)
    (fun _ _ h => jointEntropy_mono hp.nonneg X h) (jointEntropy_union_add_inter_le hp X)
    (jointEntropy_empty hp X) s F hw U hcover

/-- **Han's inequality**: `(|U| - 1) H(X_U) ≤ ∑ i ∈ U, H(X_{U \ {i}})`. -/
theorem jointEntropy_han {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i)
    (U : Finset ι) :
    ((#U - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * jointEntropy p X U ≤ ∑ i ∈ U, jointEntropy p X (U.erase i) :=
  han_of_submodular (f := jointEntropy p X) (fun _ _ h => jointEntropy_mono hp.nonneg X h)
    (jointEntropy_union_add_inter_le hp X) (jointEntropy_empty hp X) U

/-- The joint entropy of the whole family is the entropy of the law of the tuple. -/
lemma jointEntropy_univ {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) :
    jointEntropy p X univ = entropy (pushforward (fun ω i => X i ω) p) := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun (y : ∀ i, β i) (i : ι) => some (y i) :=
    fun y z h => funext fun i => Option.some.inj (congrFun h i)
  have h : pushforward (fun (y : ∀ i, β i) (i : ι) => some (y i))
      (pushforward (fun ω i => X i ω) p) = pushforward (restrictOpt X univ) p := by
    rw [pushforward_comp]
    congr 1
    funext ω i
    simp [restrictOpt]
  rw [jointEntropy, ← h]
  exact entropy_pushforward_of_injective (pushforward_nonneg hp _) hinj

/-- For weights `r` on a product, the coordinates have joint entropy `entropy r`. -/
lemma jointEntropy_univ_coord {r : (∀ i, β i) → ℝ} (hr : ∀ x, 0 ≤ r x) :
    jointEntropy r (fun i x => x i) univ = entropy r := by
  rw [jointEntropy_univ hr, pushforward_id]

/-- The joint entropy of one coordinate is its entropy. -/
lemma jointEntropy_singleton {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) (i : ι) :
    jointEntropy p X {i} = entropy (pushforward (X i) p) := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun b : β i => Function.update (fun _ => none) i (some b) :=
    fun b c h => by simpa using congrFun h i
  have h : pushforward (fun b : β i => Function.update (fun _ => none) i (some b))
      (pushforward (X i) p) = pushforward (restrictOpt X {i}) p := by
    rw [pushforward_comp]
    congr 1
    funext ω j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj
      simp [restrictOpt]
    · simp [restrictOpt, hj]
  rw [jointEntropy, ← h]
  exact entropy_pushforward_of_injective (pushforward_nonneg hp _) hinj

/-- **Subadditivity**: `H((X i)_i) ≤ ∑ i, H(X i)`. -/
theorem jointEntropy_univ_le_sum {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : ∀ i, Ω → β i) :
    jointEntropy p X univ ≤ ∑ i, entropy (pushforward (X i) p) := by
  have h := jointEntropy_shearer hp X univ (fun i => {i}) (k := 1) univ fun i _ =>
    card_pos.2 ⟨i, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ i, mem_singleton_self i⟩⟩
  simp only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul, univ_inter] at h
  simpa only [jointEntropy_singleton hp.nonneg] using h

end Family

/-! ### Counting: projections of a finite family of functions -/

section Counting

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]

lemma isDistribution_uniformOn {A : Finset α} (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    IsDistribution (fun a => if a ∈ A then (#A : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0) where
  nonneg a := by positivity
  sum_eq_one := by
    have hc : (#A : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 (card_pos.2 hA).ne'
    rw [Fintype.sum_ite_mem, sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc]

/-- The uniform distribution on `A` has entropy `log |A|`. -/
lemma entropy_uniformOn (A : Finset α) :
    entropy (fun a => if a ∈ A then (#A : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0) = log #A := by
  rcases A.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hA
  · simp [entropy]
  have hc : (#A : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 (card_pos.2 hA).ne'
  simp only [entropy, apply_ite negMulLog, negMulLog_zero, Fintype.sum_ite_mem, sum_const,
    nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [negMulLog, log_inv, neg_mul_neg, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, one_mul]

/-- `H q ≤ log |A|` for a distribution `q` vanishing off `A`. -/
theorem entropy_le_log_card_of_support {q : α → ℝ} (hq : IsDistribution q) {A : Finset α}
    (hA : ∀ a ∉ A, q a = 0) : entropy q ≤ log #A := by
  have hsum : ∑ a ∈ A, q a = 1 := by
    rw [← hq.sum_eq_one]
    exact sum_subset (subset_univ A) fun a _ ha => hA a ha
  have hne : A.Nonempty := by
    rcases A.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | h
    · simp at hsum
    · exact h
  have hc : (#A : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 (card_pos.2 hne).ne'
  have h := entropy_le_crossEntropy hq (isDistribution_uniformOn hne) fun a ha => by
    by_cases haA : a ∈ A
    · simp [haA, hc] at ha
    · exact hA a haA
  have hcross : ∑ a, q a * log (if a ∈ A then (#A : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0) = -log #A := by
    rw [← sum_subset (subset_univ A) fun a _ ha => by simp [hA a ha]]
    rw [sum_congr rfl fun a ha => by rw [ite_eq_left ha, log_inv], ← sum_mul, hsum]
    ring
  rw [hcross, neg_neg] at h
  exact h

omit [Fintype α] in
lemma pushforward_eq_zero_of_notMem_image {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] {q : Ω → ℝ} {A : Finset Ω}
    (hA : ∀ ω ∉ A, q ω = 0) (f : Ω → α) {b : α} (hb : b ∉ A.image f) :
    pushforward f q b = 0 :=
  sum_eq_zero fun ω hω => hA ω fun hωA =>
    hb (by rw [← (mem_filter.1 hω).2]; exact mem_image_of_mem f hωA)

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {β : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (β i)]
  [∀ i, DecidableEq (β i)]

omit [∀ i, Fintype (β i)] in
lemma card_image_restrictOpt (𝓕 : Finset (∀ i, β i)) (S : Finset ι) :
    #(𝓕.image (restrictOpt (fun i x => x i) S)) = #(𝓕.image S.restrict) := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun (y : ∀ i : S, β i) (i : ι) =>
      if hi : i ∈ S then some (y ⟨i, hi⟩) else none := by
    intro y z h
    funext i
    simpa [i.2] using congrFun h i
  have h : 𝓕.image (restrictOpt (fun i x => x i) S) = (𝓕.image S.restrict).image
      fun (y : ∀ i : S, β i) (i : ι) => if hi : i ∈ S then some (y ⟨i, hi⟩) else none := by
    rw [image_image]
    congr 1
  rw [h, card_image_of_injective _ hinj]

/-- **Shearer's lemma, counting form**: if every coordinate lies in at least `k` of the sets
`F j`, `j ∈ s`, then `k log |𝓕| ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, log |𝓕 restricted to F j|`. -/
theorem log_card_shearer (𝓕 : Finset (∀ i, β i)) {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (F : κ → Finset ι)
    {k : ℕ} (hcover : ∀ i, k ≤ #{j ∈ s | i ∈ F j}) :
    k * log #𝓕 ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, log #(𝓕.image (F j).restrict) := by
  rcases 𝓕.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
  · simp
  have hu := isDistribution_uniformOn hne
  have h := jointEntropy_shearer hu (fun i x => x i) s F univ fun i _ => hcover i
  rw [jointEntropy_univ_coord hu.nonneg, entropy_uniformOn] at h
  refine h.trans (sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_)
  rw [univ_inter, ← card_image_restrictOpt, jointEntropy]
  refine entropy_le_log_card_of_support (hu.pushforward _) fun y hy =>
    pushforward_eq_zero_of_notMem_image (fun x hx => ?_) _ hy
  simp [hx]

/-- **Shearer's lemma, product form**: if every coordinate lies in at least `k ≠ 0` of the sets
`F j`, `j ∈ s`, then `|𝓕| ^ k ≤ ∏ j ∈ s, |𝓕 restricted to F j|`. -/
theorem card_pow_le_prod_card_shearer (𝓕 : Finset (∀ i, β i)) {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ)
    (F : κ → Finset ι) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (hcover : ∀ i, k ≤ #{j ∈ s | i ∈ F j}) :
    #𝓕 ^ k ≤ ∏ j ∈ s, #(𝓕.image (F j).restrict) := by
  rcases 𝓕.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
  · simp [zero_pow hk]
  have hpos : ∀ j ∈ s, (0 : ℝ) < #(𝓕.image (F j).restrict) := fun j _ =>
    Nat.cast_pos.2 (card_pos.2 (hne.image _))
  have h := log_card_shearer 𝓕 s F hcover
  rw [← log_pow, ← log_prod fun j hj => (hpos j hj).ne'] at h
  have h' : ((#𝓕 : ℝ) ^ k) ≤ ∏ j ∈ s, (#(𝓕.image (F j).restrict) : ℝ) :=
    (log_le_log_iff (pow_pos (Nat.cast_pos.2 (card_pos.2 hne)) k) (prod_pos hpos)).1 h
  exact_mod_cast h'

omit [∀ i, Fintype (β i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (β i)] in
lemma card_erase_cover (i : ι) : Fintype.card ι - 1 ≤ #{j | i ∈ (univ : Finset ι).erase j} := by
  rw [← Finset.card_univ, ← card_erase_of_mem (mem_univ i)]
  exact card_le_card fun j hj => mem_filter.2
    ⟨mem_univ j, mem_erase.2 ⟨fun h => ne_of_mem_erase hj h.symm, mem_univ i⟩⟩

/-- The **discrete Loomis–Whitney inequality**, logarithmic form:
`(n - 1) log |𝓕| ≤ ∑ i, log |𝓕 restricted to ι \ {i}|` for `n = |ι|`. -/
theorem log_card_loomis_whitney (𝓕 : Finset (∀ i, β i)) :
    ((Fintype.card ι - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * log #𝓕 ≤
      ∑ i, log #(𝓕.image ((univ : Finset ι).erase i).restrict) :=
  log_card_shearer 𝓕 univ (fun i => univ.erase i) card_erase_cover

/-- The **discrete Loomis–Whitney inequality**: `|𝓕| ^ (n - 1) ≤ ∏ i, |𝓕 restricted to
ι \ {i}|` for `n = |ι| ≥ 2`. -/
theorem card_pow_le_prod_card_loomis_whitney (𝓕 : Finset (∀ i, β i))
    (hι : 2 ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
    #𝓕 ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) ≤ ∏ i, #(𝓕.image ((univ : Finset ι).erase i).restrict) :=
  card_pow_le_prod_card_shearer 𝓕 univ (fun i => univ.erase i) (by omega) card_erase_cover

end Counting

end

end TheoremOS.InformationTheory

import Submission.Library.TheoremOS.InformationTheory.Entropy

/-!
# Density matrices, measurements and partial traces

Finite-dimensional quantum probability over `𝕜 = ℝ` or `ℂ`. Contents: `0 ≤ tr (A B)` for
positive semidefinite `A, B` (with its real-part and monotone forms, and `tr (A B)` real for
Hermitian `A, B`); density matrices (`IsDensity ρ`: positive semidefinite, trace one) and their
closure under mixtures, Kronecker products, isometric conjugation and Kraus maps; the diagonal of a
density matrix as a distribution; POVMs (`IsPOVM E`: positive semidefinite, summing to `1`), the
Born rule `a ↦ re tr (E a ρ)` as a distribution, coarse-graining and Kronecker products of POVMs;
pure states `vecMulVec ψ (star ψ)` and the vector form `star ψ ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ ψ)` of the Born rule; the
partial traces `traceRight`, `traceLeft`, their trace, Kronecker, duality and positivity lemmas and
no-signalling; columns and rows of a unitary as distributions, and isometries preserving
`∑ normSq`.

Sources: M. A. Nielsen and I. L. Chuang, *Quantum Computation and Quantum Information*, Cambridge
University Press, 2000, Sections 2.2.3–2.2.6 (POVMs, measurement statistics), 2.4 (density
operators, Theorem 2.5), 2.4.3 (partial trace), 8.2.3 (operator-sum representation); R. A. Horn
and C. R. Johnson, *Matrix Analysis*, 2nd ed., Cambridge University Press, 2013, Section 7.1 and
Theorem 7.5.4 (trace of a product of positive semidefinite matrices). Textbook material; nothing
here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: these statements need `open scoped ComplexOrder` so that `PosSemidef` over `ℂ` makes
sense. A definition `IsState P := P.PosSemidef ∧ trace P = 1` is `IsDensity P` by `Iff.rfl`; a
structure with fields `(∀ a, (E a).PosSemidef)` and `∑ a, E a = 1` gives `IsPOVM E` by
`⟨pos, sum⟩`. Over `ℂ`, `RCLike.re` is `Complex.re` (`RCLike.re_to_complex`) and the unit-vector
hypothesis `∑ i, Complex.normSq (ψ i) = 1` gives `star ψ ⬝ᵥ ψ = 1` by
`star_dotProduct_self_eq_one`. A Born probability written entrywise,
`∑ i, ∑ j, (star (ψ i) * (A i.1 j.1 * B i.2 j.2) * ψ j).re`, is
`re (star ψ ⬝ᵥ ((A ⊗ₖ B) *ᵥ ψ))` by `sum_sum_re_star_mul_kronecker_mul`. Mathlib already has
`PosSemidef.kronecker`, `posSemidef_sum`, `PosSemidef.trace_nonneg`, `trace_kronecker` and
`posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra

open Finset Matrix
open scoped BigOperators Kronecker ComplexOrder MatrixOrder
open TheoremOS.InformationTheory

noncomputable section

variable {ι κ l m n : Type*}

section TraceProduct

variable {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype n]

/-- `0 ≤ tr (A B)` for positive semidefinite `A` and `B`. -/
theorem trace_mul_nonneg {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    0 ≤ trace (A * B) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := CStarAlgebra.nonneg_iff_eq_star_mul_self.mp hA.nonneg
  rw [star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc, trace_mul_comm]
  exact (hB.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same y).trace_nonneg

theorem re_trace_mul_nonneg {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    0 ≤ RCLike.re (trace (A * B)) :=
  (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp (trace_mul_nonneg hA hB)).1

/-- `tr (A B)` is real for Hermitian `A` and `B`. -/
theorem im_trace_mul_eq_zero {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    RCLike.im (trace (A * B)) = 0 := by
  rw [← RCLike.conj_eq_iff_im, ← RCLike.star_def, ← trace_conjTranspose, conjTranspose_mul,
    hA.eq, hB.eq, trace_mul_comm]

theorem ofReal_re_trace_mul {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (RCLike.re (trace (A * B)) : 𝕜) = trace (A * B) :=
  RCLike.conj_eq_iff_re.mp (RCLike.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr (im_trace_mul_eq_zero hA hB))

/-- `B ≤ C` in the Loewner order gives `tr (A B) ≤ tr (A C)` for positive semidefinite `A`. -/
theorem trace_mul_le_trace_mul {A B C : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (hBC : (C - B).PosSemidef) : trace (A * B) ≤ trace (A * C) := by
  have := trace_mul_nonneg hA hBC
  rwa [Matrix.mul_sub, trace_sub, sub_nonneg] at this

theorem re_trace_mul_le_re_trace_mul {A B C : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (hBC : (C - B).PosSemidef) : RCLike.re (trace (A * B)) ≤ RCLike.re (trace (A * C)) :=
  RCLike.re_le_re (trace_mul_le_trace_mul hA hBC)

theorem re_trace_mul_le_re_trace [DecidableEq n] {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (hB : (1 - B).PosSemidef) : RCLike.re (trace (A * B)) ≤ RCLike.re (trace A) := by
  simpa using re_trace_mul_le_re_trace_mul hA hB

end TraceProduct

section Density

variable {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]

/-- A density matrix: positive semidefinite with trace one. -/
def IsDensity (ρ : Matrix n n 𝕜) : Prop := ρ.PosSemidef ∧ trace ρ = 1

lemma isDensity_iff {ρ : Matrix n n 𝕜} : IsDensity ρ ↔ ρ.PosSemidef ∧ trace ρ = 1 := Iff.rfl

namespace IsDensity

variable {ρ σ : Matrix n n 𝕜}

lemma posSemidef (h : IsDensity ρ) : ρ.PosSemidef := h.1

lemma trace_eq_one (h : IsDensity ρ) : trace ρ = 1 := h.2

lemma isHermitian (h : IsDensity ρ) : ρ.IsHermitian := h.1.isHermitian

/-- The diagonal of a density matrix is a probability distribution. -/
theorem isDistribution_diag (h : IsDensity ρ) : IsDistribution fun i => RCLike.re (ρ i i) where
  nonneg _ := (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp h.1.diag_nonneg).1
  sum_eq_one := by
    have : ∑ i, ρ i i = trace ρ := rfl
    rw [← map_sum, this, h.2, RCLike.one_re]

/-- A mixture `∑ w i • ρ i` of density matrices with weights a distribution `w`. -/
theorem sum_smul [Fintype ι] {w : ι → ℝ} (hw : IsDistribution w) {ρ : ι → Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hρ : ∀ i, IsDensity (ρ i)) : IsDensity (∑ i, (w i : 𝕜) • ρ i) := by
  refine ⟨posSemidef_sum _ fun i _ => (hρ i).1.smul (RCLike.ofReal_nonneg.mpr (hw.nonneg i)), ?_⟩
  simp only [trace_sum, trace_smul, (hρ _).2, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact_mod_cast hw.sum_eq_one

theorem kronecker {τ : Matrix m m 𝕜} (hρ : IsDensity ρ) (hτ : IsDensity τ) :
    IsDensity (ρ ⊗ₖ τ) :=
  ⟨hρ.1.kronecker hτ.1, by rw [trace_kronecker, hρ.2, hτ.2, mul_one]⟩

/-- Conjugation `V ρ Vᴴ` by an isometry `Vᴴ V = 1` (for example a unitary). -/
theorem conj_isometry [DecidableEq n] {V : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hV : Vᴴ * V = 1) (hρ : IsDensity ρ) :
    IsDensity (V * ρ * Vᴴ) :=
  ⟨hρ.1.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same V, by rw [trace_mul_cycle, hV, Matrix.one_mul, hρ.2]⟩

/-- A Kraus map `ρ ↦ ∑ K i ρ (K i)ᴴ` with `∑ (K i)ᴴ K i = 1` sends density matrices to density
matrices. -/
theorem sum_kraus [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq n] {K : ι → Matrix m n 𝕜}
    (hK : ∑ i, (K i)ᴴ * K i = 1) (hρ : IsDensity ρ) : IsDensity (∑ i, K i * ρ * (K i)ᴴ) := by
  refine ⟨posSemidef_sum _ fun i _ => hρ.1.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (K i), ?_⟩
  rw [trace_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => trace_mul_cycle (K i) ρ (K i)ᴴ, ← trace_sum,
    ← Finset.sum_mul, hK, Matrix.one_mul, hρ.2]

end IsDensity

end Density

section KroneckerSum

variable {p q R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]

theorem sum_kronecker (s : Finset ι) (A : ι → Matrix l m R) (B : Matrix n p R) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, A i) ⊗ₖ B = ∑ i ∈ s, A i ⊗ₖ B := by
  ext ⟨a, b⟩ ⟨c, d⟩
  simp [Matrix.sum_apply, Finset.sum_mul]

theorem kronecker_sum (A : Matrix l m R) (s : Finset ι) (B : ι → Matrix n p R) :
    A ⊗ₖ (∑ i ∈ s, B i) = ∑ i ∈ s, A ⊗ₖ B i := by
  ext ⟨a, b⟩ ⟨c, d⟩
  simp [Matrix.sum_apply, Finset.mul_sum]

theorem sum_kronecker_sum (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (A : ι → Matrix l m R)
    (B : κ → Matrix n p R) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, A i) ⊗ₖ (∑ j ∈ t, B j) = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ t, A i ⊗ₖ B j := by
  rw [sum_kronecker]
  simp_rw [kronecker_sum]

/-- Measuring a product state with a product observable factorizes. -/
theorem trace_kronecker_mul_kronecker [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A ρ : Matrix m m R)
    (B σ : Matrix n n R) : trace ((A ⊗ₖ B) * (ρ ⊗ₖ σ)) = trace (A * ρ) * trace (B * σ) := by
  rw [← mul_kronecker_mul, trace_kronecker]

end KroneckerSum

section POVM

variable {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]

/-- A POVM: positive semidefinite effects summing to the identity. -/
structure IsPOVM (E : ι → Matrix n n 𝕜) : Prop where
  posSemidef : ∀ a, (E a).PosSemidef
  sum_eq_one : ∑ a, E a = 1

namespace IsPOVM

variable {E : ι → Matrix n n 𝕜}

omit [Fintype n] in
theorem one_sub_posSemidef [DecidableEq ι] (hE : IsPOVM E) (a : ι) : (1 - E a).PosSemidef := by
  rw [← hE.sum_eq_one, ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ a), add_sub_cancel_left]
  exact posSemidef_sum _ fun b _ => hE.posSemidef b

/-- The Born rule: a POVM measured on a density matrix gives a probability distribution. -/
theorem isDistribution_re_trace_mul (hE : IsPOVM E) {ρ : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hρ : IsDensity ρ) :
    IsDistribution fun a => RCLike.re (trace (E a * ρ)) where
  nonneg a := re_trace_mul_nonneg (hE.posSemidef a) hρ.1
  sum_eq_one := by
    rw [← map_sum, ← trace_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul, hE.sum_eq_one, Matrix.one_mul, hρ.2,
      RCLike.one_re]

theorem re_trace_mul_le_one (hE : IsPOVM E) {ρ : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hρ : IsDensity ρ) (a : ι) :
    RCLike.re (trace (E a * ρ)) ≤ 1 :=
  (hE.isDistribution_re_trace_mul hρ).le_one a

omit [Fintype n] in
/-- Coarse-graining a POVM along `f : ι → κ`. -/
theorem fiberwise [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (hE : IsPOVM E) (f : ι → κ) :
    IsPOVM fun c => ∑ a ∈ univ.filter (f · = c), E a where
  posSemidef _ := posSemidef_sum _ fun a _ => hE.posSemidef a
  sum_eq_one := by rw [Finset.sum_fiberwise, hE.sum_eq_one]

theorem kronecker [Fintype κ] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] {F : κ → Matrix m m 𝕜} (hE : IsPOVM E)
    (hF : IsPOVM F) : IsPOVM fun ab : ι × κ => E ab.1 ⊗ₖ F ab.2 where
  posSemidef ab := (hE.posSemidef ab.1).kronecker (hF.posSemidef ab.2)
  sum_eq_one := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, ← sum_kronecker_sum, hE.sum_eq_one, hF.sum_eq_one,
      one_kronecker_one]

end IsPOVM

end POVM

section PureState

variable {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype n]

/-- The trace of `M` against the pure state `ψ ψᴴ` is the quadratic form `ψᴴ M ψ`. -/
theorem trace_mul_vecMulVec_star (M : Matrix n n 𝕜) (ψ : n → 𝕜) :
    trace (M * vecMulVec ψ (star ψ)) = star ψ ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ ψ) := by
  rw [mul_vecMulVec, trace_vecMulVec, dotProduct_comm]

theorem isDensity_vecMulVec_star {ψ : n → 𝕜} (hψ : star ψ ⬝ᵥ ψ = 1) :
    IsDensity (vecMulVec ψ (star ψ)) :=
  ⟨posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star ψ, by rw [trace_vecMulVec, dotProduct_comm, hψ]⟩

/-- An entrywise quadratic form `∑ i, ∑ j, star (ψ i) * M i j * ψ j` is `ψᴴ M ψ`. -/
theorem sum_sum_star_mul_mul (M : Matrix n n 𝕜) (ψ : n → 𝕜) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, star (ψ i) * M i j * ψ j = star ψ ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ ψ) := by
  simp only [dotProduct, mulVec, Finset.mul_sum, Pi.star_apply, mul_assoc]

/-- The Born rule for a unit vector: `a ↦ re (ψᴴ E_a ψ)` is a probability distribution. -/
theorem IsPOVM.isDistribution_re_star_dotProduct [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq n]
    {E : ι → Matrix n n 𝕜} (hE : IsPOVM E) {ψ : n → 𝕜} (hψ : star ψ ⬝ᵥ ψ = 1) :
    IsDistribution fun a => RCLike.re (star ψ ⬝ᵥ (E a *ᵥ ψ)) := by
  simpa only [trace_mul_vecMulVec_star] using
    hE.isDistribution_re_trace_mul (isDensity_vecMulVec_star hψ)

end PureState

section Complex

variable [Fintype n]

/-- `∑ i, normSq (ψ i)` is `ψᴴ ψ`. -/
theorem ofReal_sum_normSq (ψ : n → ℂ) : ((∑ i, Complex.normSq (ψ i) : ℝ) : ℂ) = star ψ ⬝ᵥ ψ := by
  simp [dotProduct, Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]

theorem star_dotProduct_self_eq_one {ψ : n → ℂ} (hψ : ∑ i, Complex.normSq (ψ i) = 1) :
    star ψ ⬝ᵥ ψ = 1 := by
  rw [← ofReal_sum_normSq, hψ, Complex.ofReal_one]

/-- The entrywise Born probability of a product observable `A ⊗ B` on a bipartite vector. -/
theorem sum_sum_re_star_mul_kronecker_mul [Fintype l] [Fintype m] (A : Matrix l l ℂ) (B : Matrix m m ℂ)
    (ψ : l × m → ℂ) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, (star (ψ i) * (A i.1 j.1 * B i.2 j.2) * ψ j).re =
      (star ψ ⬝ᵥ ((A ⊗ₖ B) *ᵥ ψ)).re := by
  rw [← sum_sum_star_mul_mul, Complex.re_sum]
  simp only [Complex.re_sum]
  rfl

/-- Two POVMs measured on a bipartite unit vector give a joint distribution of outcomes. -/
theorem isDistribution_born_kronecker [Fintype l] [DecidableEq l] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] {A : ι → Matrix l l ℂ} {B : κ → Matrix m m ℂ} (hA : IsPOVM A)
    (hB : IsPOVM B) {ψ : l × m → ℂ} (hψ : ∑ i, Complex.normSq (ψ i) = 1) :
    IsDistribution fun ab : ι × κ =>
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (star (ψ i) * (A ab.1 i.1 j.1 * B ab.2 i.2 j.2) * ψ j).re := by
  simp only [sum_sum_re_star_mul_kronecker_mul]
  exact (hA.kronecker hB).isDistribution_re_star_dotProduct (star_dotProduct_self_eq_one hψ)

end Complex

section PartialTrace

variable {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]

/-- The partial trace over the right factor: `(traceRight X) i j = ∑ k, X (i, k) (j, k)`. -/
def traceRight [Fintype n] (X : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) R) : Matrix m m R :=
  fun i j => ∑ k, X (i, k) (j, k)

/-- The partial trace over the left factor: `(traceLeft X) i j = ∑ k, X (k, i) (k, j)`. -/
def traceLeft [Fintype m] (X : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) R) : Matrix n n R :=
  fun i j => ∑ k, X (k, i) (k, j)

lemma traceRight_apply [Fintype n] (X : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) R) (i j : m) :
    traceRight X i j = ∑ k, X (i, k) (j, k) := rfl

lemma traceLeft_apply [Fintype m] (X : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) R) (i j : n) :
    traceLeft X i j = ∑ k, X (k, i) (k, j) := rfl

variable [Fintype m] [Fintype n]

theorem trace_traceRight (X : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) R) : trace (traceRight X) = trace X := by
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, traceRight, Fintype.sum_prod_type]

theorem trace_traceLeft (X : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) R) : trace (traceLeft X) = trace X := by
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, traceLeft, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

end PartialTrace

section PartialTraceRing

variable {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]

omit [Fintype m] in
theorem traceRight_kronecker (A : Matrix m m R) (B : Matrix n n R) :
    traceRight (A ⊗ₖ B) = trace B • A := by
  ext i j
  simp [traceRight, Matrix.trace, ← Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm]

omit [Fintype n] in
theorem traceLeft_kronecker (A : Matrix m m R) (B : Matrix n n R) :
    traceLeft (A ⊗ₖ B) = trace A • B := by
  ext i j
  simp [traceLeft, Matrix.trace, ← Finset.sum_mul]

/-- Duality: measuring `A` on the reduced state is measuring `A ⊗ 1` on the joint state. -/
theorem trace_mul_traceRight [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m m R) (X : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) R) :
    trace (A * traceRight X) = trace ((A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix n n R)) * X) := by
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, traceRight, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
    kronecker_apply, Matrix.one_apply, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, ite_mul, zero_mul,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_comm

theorem trace_mul_traceLeft [DecidableEq m] (B : Matrix n n R) (X : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) R) :
    trace (B * traceLeft X) = trace (((1 : Matrix m m R) ⊗ₖ B) * X) := by
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, traceLeft, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
    kronecker_apply, Matrix.one_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  conv_rhs => enter [2, x, 2, y]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
  calc ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, B i j * X (k, j) (k, i) = ∑ i, ∑ k, ∑ j, B i j * X (k, j) (k, i) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ k, ∑ i, ∑ j, B i j * X (k, j) (k, i) := Finset.sum_comm

/-- No-signalling: summing a product measurement over the outcomes of the right party leaves the
measurement of the left party on the reduced state. -/
theorem sum_trace_kronecker_mul [DecidableEq n] [Fintype κ] (A : Matrix m m R) {F : κ → Matrix n n R}
    (hF : ∑ b, F b = 1) (X : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) R) :
    ∑ b, trace ((A ⊗ₖ F b) * X) = trace (A * traceRight X) := by
  rw [trace_mul_traceRight, ← hF, kronecker_sum, Finset.sum_mul, trace_sum]

theorem sum_trace_kronecker_mul_left [DecidableEq m] [Fintype ι] {E : ι → Matrix m m R}
    (hE : ∑ a, E a = 1) (B : Matrix n n R) (X : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) R) :
    ∑ a, trace ((E a ⊗ₖ B) * X) = trace (B * traceLeft X) := by
  rw [trace_mul_traceLeft, ← hE, sum_kronecker, Finset.sum_mul, trace_sum]

end PartialTraceRing

section PartialTracePositive

variable {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]

omit [Fintype m] in
theorem posSemidef_traceRight {X : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) 𝕜} (hX : X.PosSemidef) :
    (traceRight X).PosSemidef := by
  have : traceRight X = ∑ k, X.submatrix (fun i => (i, k)) (fun i => (i, k)) := by
    ext i j
    simp [traceRight, Matrix.sum_apply]
  rw [this]
  exact posSemidef_sum _ fun k _ => hX.submatrix _

omit [Fintype n] in
theorem posSemidef_traceLeft {X : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) 𝕜} (hX : X.PosSemidef) :
    (traceLeft X).PosSemidef := by
  have : traceLeft X = ∑ k, X.submatrix (fun i => (k, i)) (fun i => (k, i)) := by
    ext i j
    simp [traceLeft, Matrix.sum_apply]
  rw [this]
  exact posSemidef_sum _ fun k _ => hX.submatrix _

/-- The reduced state of a density matrix is a density matrix. -/
theorem isDensity_traceRight {X : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) 𝕜} (hX : IsDensity X) :
    IsDensity (traceRight X) :=
  ⟨posSemidef_traceRight hX.1, by rw [trace_traceRight, hX.2]⟩

theorem isDensity_traceLeft {X : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) 𝕜} (hX : IsDensity X) :
    IsDensity (traceLeft X) :=
  ⟨posSemidef_traceLeft hX.1, by rw [trace_traceLeft, hX.2]⟩

end PartialTracePositive

section Unitary

variable [Fintype m] [Fintype n]

/-- An isometry `Vᴴ V = 1` preserves `∑ normSq`. -/
theorem sum_normSq_mulVec_of_isometry [DecidableEq n] {V : Matrix m n ℂ} (hV : Vᴴ * V = 1)
    (ψ : n → ℂ) : ∑ i, Complex.normSq ((V *ᵥ ψ) i) = ∑ i, Complex.normSq (ψ i) := by
  apply Complex.ofReal_injective
  rw [ofReal_sum_normSq, ofReal_sum_normSq, star_mulVec, dotProduct_mulVec, vecMul_vecMul, hV,
    vecMul_one]

theorem sum_normSq_mulVec_of_mem_unitaryGroup [DecidableEq n] {U : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hU : U ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (ψ : n → ℂ) :
    ∑ i, Complex.normSq ((U *ᵥ ψ) i) = ∑ i, Complex.normSq (ψ i) :=
  sum_normSq_mulVec_of_isometry (V := U) (Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'.mp hU) ψ

omit [Fintype n] in
/-- Each column of an isometry has unit length. -/
theorem sum_normSq_col_of_isometry [DecidableEq n] {V : Matrix m n ℂ} (hV : Vᴴ * V = 1) (j : n) :
    ∑ i, Complex.normSq (V i j) = 1 := by
  apply Complex.ofReal_injective
  have := congrFun (congrFun hV j) j
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq] at this
  simpa [Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self] using this

theorem sum_normSq_col_of_mem_unitaryGroup [DecidableEq n] {U : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hU : U ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (j : n) : ∑ i, Complex.normSq (U i j) = 1 :=
  sum_normSq_col_of_isometry (V := U) (Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'.mp hU) j

theorem sum_normSq_row_of_mem_unitaryGroup [DecidableEq n] {U : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hU : U ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (i : n) : ∑ j, Complex.normSq (U i j) = 1 := by
  apply Complex.ofReal_injective
  have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff.mp hU) i) i
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq] at this
  simpa [Complex.mul_conj] using this

/-- Measuring the column `U *ᵥ e_j` of a unitary in the computational basis: the outcome
distribution `i ↦ normSq (U i j)`. -/
theorem isDistribution_normSq_col [DecidableEq n] {U : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hU : U ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) (j : n) : IsDistribution fun i => Complex.normSq (U i j) :=
  ⟨fun _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg _, sum_normSq_col_of_mem_unitaryGroup hU j⟩

/-- The probability of an event in the outcome of a unit vector is at most one. -/
theorem sum_ite_normSq_le_one {ψ : n → ℂ} (hψ : ∑ i, Complex.normSq (ψ i) = 1) (P : n → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] : ∑ i, (if P i then Complex.normSq (ψ i) else 0) ≤ 1 := by
  rw [← hψ]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
    split_ifs
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact Complex.normSq_nonneg _

end Unitary

end

end TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra

import Mathlib

/-!
# The numerical range of an operator on a complex inner product space

For `T : E →L[ℂ] E`, `numericalRange T = {⟪x, T x⟫ | ‖x‖ = 1}` and
`numericalRadius T = sSup ‖numericalRange T‖`. This file proves: Rayleigh quotients
`⟪x, T x⟫ / ‖x‖²` of nonzero vectors lie in the range; it is nonempty on a nontrivial space and
lies in the closed ball of radius `‖T‖`; eigenvalues lie in it; affine maps act on it,
`W(a • T + b • 1) = (a · + b) '' W(T)`; `W(T†) = conj '' W(T)`; self-adjoint operators have real
numerical range; compressions by isometries shrink it and linear isometric equivalences preserve
it; it is compact in finite dimension; the Toeplitz–Hausdorff theorem (convexity); and
`numericalRadius T ≤ ‖T‖ ≤ 2 · numericalRadius T`.

Sources: O. Toeplitz, *Das algebraische Analogon zu einem Satze von Fejér*, Math. Z. 2 (1918);
F. Hausdorff, *Der Wertvorrat einer Bilinearform*, Math. Z. 3 (1919); K. E. Gustafson and
D. K. M. Rao, *Numerical Range: The Field of Values of Linear Operators and Matrices*, Springer,
1997, Chapter 1 (Toeplitz–Hausdorff via the two-dimensional reduction, the bounds
`w(T) ≤ ‖T‖ ≤ 2 w(T)`); R. A. Horn and C. R. Johnson, *Topics in Matrix Analysis*, Cambridge
University Press, 1991, Chapter 1 (the field of values, its elementary properties). Textbook
material; nothing here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: `numericalRange T` unfolds to `{z | ∃ x, ‖x‖ = 1 ∧ ⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ = z}`, and
`⟪x, y⟫_ℂ` is `inner ℂ x y`, so a set `{z | ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n), ‖u‖ = 1 ∧
inner ℂ u (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n) (𝕜 := ℂ) A u) = z}` is
`numericalRange (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n) (𝕜 := ℂ) A)` by `rfl`. With
`open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator`, `‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM A‖ = ‖A‖` is
`Matrix.l2_opNorm_toEuclideanCLM` (`rfl`). The convention is Mathlib's: the inner product is
conjugate-linear in the first argument.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra

open Set Metric ComplexConjugate
open scoped InnerProductSpace

noncomputable section

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℂ F]

/-- The numerical range (field of values) `{⟪x, T x⟫ | ‖x‖ = 1}`. -/
def numericalRange (T : E →L[ℂ] E) : Set ℂ := {z | ∃ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 ∧ ⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ = z}

/-- The numerical radius `sup {‖z‖ | z ∈ W(T)}` (`0` on the zero space). -/
def numericalRadius (T : E →L[ℂ] E) : ℝ := sSup ((fun z => ‖z‖) '' numericalRange T)

lemma mem_numericalRange {T : E →L[ℂ] E} {z : ℂ} :
    z ∈ numericalRange T ↔ ∃ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 ∧ ⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ = z := Iff.rfl

lemma inner_map_self_mem_numericalRange (T : E →L[ℂ] E) {x : E} (hx : ‖x‖ = 1) :
    ⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ ∈ numericalRange T := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

lemma inner_smul_map_smul (T : E →L[ℂ] E) (c : ℂ) (x : E) :
    ⟪c • x, T (c • x)⟫_ℂ = ((‖c‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ := by
  rw [map_smul, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, ← mul_assoc, Complex.conj_mul']
  push_cast; ring

/-- Rayleigh quotients of nonzero vectors lie in the numerical range. -/
theorem div_norm_sq_mem_numericalRange (T : E →L[ℂ] E) {x : E} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ / ((‖x‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ numericalRange T := by
  have hn : ‖x‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx
  refine ⟨((‖x‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn]
  · rw [inner_smul_map_smul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_norm, div_eq_inv_mul]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    rw [inv_pow]

theorem numericalRange_nonempty [Nontrivial E] (T : E →L[ℂ] E) : (numericalRange T).Nonempty := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (0 : E)
  exact ⟨_, div_norm_sq_mem_numericalRange T hx⟩

theorem norm_le_of_mem_numericalRange {T : E →L[ℂ] E} {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ numericalRange T) :
    ‖z‖ ≤ ‖T‖ := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hz
  calc ‖⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖T x‖ := norm_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ ≤ ‖x‖ * (‖T‖ * ‖x‖) := by gcongr; exact T.le_opNorm x
    _ = ‖T‖ := by rw [hx]; ring

theorem numericalRange_subset_closedBall (T : E →L[ℂ] E) :
    numericalRange T ⊆ closedBall 0 ‖T‖ := fun _ hz => by
  rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  exact norm_le_of_mem_numericalRange hz

theorem isBounded_numericalRange (T : E →L[ℂ] E) : Bornology.IsBounded (numericalRange T) :=
  isBounded_closedBall.subset (numericalRange_subset_closedBall T)

/-- Eigenvalues lie in the numerical range. -/
theorem mem_numericalRange_of_eigenvector {T : E →L[ℂ] E} {μ : ℂ} {x : E} (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (hTx : T x = μ • x) : μ ∈ numericalRange T := by
  have hn : ((‖x‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    have := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx
    exact_mod_cast pow_ne_zero 2 this
  have h := div_norm_sq_mem_numericalRange T hx
  have e : ⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ / ((‖x‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = μ := by
    rw [hTx, inner_smul_right, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, ← RCLike.ofReal_eq_complex_ofReal,
      ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, mul_div_assoc]
    change μ * (((‖x‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / ((‖x‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) = μ
    rw [div_self hn, mul_one]
  rwa [e] at h

theorem mem_numericalRange_of_hasEigenvalue {T : E →L[ℂ] E} {μ : ℂ}
    (h : Module.End.HasEigenvalue (T : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) μ) : μ ∈ numericalRange T := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h.exists_hasEigenvector
  exact mem_numericalRange_of_eigenvector hx.2 (Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hx.1)

/-- In finite dimension the spectrum of the underlying linear map lies in the numerical range. -/
theorem spectrum_subset_numericalRange [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] (T : E →L[ℂ] E) :
    spectrum ℂ (T : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) ⊆ numericalRange T := fun _ hμ =>
  mem_numericalRange_of_hasEigenvalue (Module.End.hasEigenvalue_iff_mem_spectrum.mpr hμ)

section Transformations

lemma inner_map_self_affine (T : E →L[ℂ] E) (a b : ℂ) {x : E} (hx : ‖x‖ = 1) :
    ⟪x, (a • T + b • (1 : E →L[ℂ] E)) x⟫_ℂ = a * ⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ + b := by
  change ⟪x, a • T x + b • x⟫_ℂ = _
  rw [inner_add_right, inner_smul_right, inner_smul_right, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hx]
  simp

/-- Affine maps act on the numerical range: `W(a • T + b • 1) = (a · + b) '' W(T)`. -/
theorem numericalRange_affine (T : E →L[ℂ] E) (a b : ℂ) :
    numericalRange (a • T + b • (1 : E →L[ℂ] E)) = (fun z => a * z + b) '' numericalRange T := by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, (inner_map_self_affine T a b hx).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, inner_map_self_affine T a b hx⟩

theorem numericalRange_smul (T : E →L[ℂ] E) (a : ℂ) :
    numericalRange (a • T) = (fun z => a * z) '' numericalRange T := by
  simpa using numericalRange_affine T a 0

theorem numericalRange_add_smul_one (T : E →L[ℂ] E) (b : ℂ) :
    numericalRange (T + b • (1 : E →L[ℂ] E)) = (fun z => z + b) '' numericalRange T := by
  simpa using numericalRange_affine T 1 b

/-- Compression by an isometry shrinks the numerical range: if `V : F → E` is isometric and
`⟪y, S y⟫ = ⟪V y, T (V y)⟫`, then `W(S) ⊆ W(T)`. -/
theorem numericalRange_subset_of_isometry {S : F →L[ℂ] F} {T : E →L[ℂ] E} (V : F →ₗᵢ[ℂ] E)
    (h : ∀ y, ⟪y, S y⟫_ℂ = ⟪V y, T (V y)⟫_ℂ) : numericalRange S ⊆ numericalRange T := by
  rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨V y, by rw [V.norm_map, hy], (h y).symm⟩

/-- Operators intertwined by a linear isometric equivalence, `S ∘ U = U ∘ T`, have the same
numerical range. -/
theorem numericalRange_eq_of_linearIsometryEquiv {S : F →L[ℂ] F} {T : E →L[ℂ] E} (U : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] F)
    (h : ∀ x, S (U x) = U (T x)) : numericalRange S = numericalRange T := by
  apply Subset.antisymm
  · refine numericalRange_subset_of_isometry U.symm.toLinearIsometry fun y => ?_
    have := h (U.symm y)
    rw [U.apply_symm_apply] at this
    rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toLinearIsometry, ← U.inner_map_map, U.apply_symm_apply, this]
  · refine numericalRange_subset_of_isometry U.toLinearIsometry fun x => ?_
    rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toLinearIsometry, h, U.inner_map_map]

/-- Unitary conjugation preserves the numerical range. -/
theorem numericalRange_unitary_conj [CompleteSpace E] (T : E →L[ℂ] E) (u : unitary (E →L[ℂ] E)) :
    numericalRange ((u : E →L[ℂ] E) * T * star (u : E →L[ℂ] E)) = numericalRange T := by
  refine numericalRange_eq_of_linearIsometryEquiv (Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv u) fun x => ?_
  change (u : E →L[ℂ] E) (T ((star (u : E →L[ℂ] E)) ((u : E →L[ℂ] E) x))) = (u : E →L[ℂ] E) (T x)
  have h1 : (star (u : E →L[ℂ] E)) ((u : E →L[ℂ] E) x) = x :=
    congrArg (fun f : E →L[ℂ] E => f x) (Unitary.star_mul_self_of_mem u.prop)
  rw [h1]

end Transformations

section Adjoint

variable [CompleteSpace E]

lemma inner_map_self_adjoint (T : E →L[ℂ] E) (x : E) :
    ⟪x, (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) x⟫_ℂ = conj ⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ := by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right, inner_conj_symm]

/-- `W(T†) = conj '' W(T)`. -/
theorem numericalRange_adjoint (T : E →L[ℂ] E) :
    numericalRange (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) = conj '' numericalRange T := by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, (inner_map_self_adjoint T x).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, inner_map_self_adjoint T x⟩

theorem numericalRange_star (T : E →L[ℂ] E) : numericalRange (star T) = conj '' numericalRange T := by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint, numericalRange_adjoint]

/-- Self-adjoint operators have real numerical range. -/
theorem im_eq_zero_of_mem_numericalRange {T : E →L[ℂ] E} (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ numericalRange T) : z.im = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨x, -, rfl⟩ := hz
  exact hT.isSymmetric.im_inner_self_apply x

end Adjoint

theorem isCompact_numericalRange [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] (T : E →L[ℂ] E) :
    IsCompact (numericalRange T) := by
  have : ProperSpace E := FiniteDimensional.proper ℂ E
  have h : numericalRange T = (fun x => ⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ) '' sphere (0 : E) 1 := by
    ext z; simp [numericalRange]
  rw [h]
  exact (isCompact_sphere 0 1).image (continuous_id.inner T.continuous)

theorem isClosed_numericalRange [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] (T : E →L[ℂ] E) :
    IsClosed (numericalRange T) :=
  (isCompact_numericalRange T).isClosed

section Convex

/-- The two-dimensional step of Toeplitz–Hausdorff: if `⟪x, S x⟫ = 0` and `⟪y, S y⟫ = 1` for unit
vectors `x`, `y`, then every `t ∈ [0, 1]` lies in `W(S)`. -/
theorem ofReal_mem_numericalRange_of_zero_one {S : E →L[ℂ] E} {x y : E} (hx : ‖x‖ = 1)
    (hy : ‖y‖ = 1) (hx0 : ⟪x, S x⟫_ℂ = 0) (hy1 : ⟪y, S y⟫_ℂ = 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (t : ℂ) ∈ numericalRange S := by
  -- Rotate `y` so that the cross term `⟪x, S w⟫ + ⟪w, S x⟫` is real.
  set R : ℂ := ⟪x, S y⟫_ℂ - conj ⟪y, S x⟫_ℂ with hR
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, hωR⟩ : ∃ ω : ℂ, ‖ω‖ = 1 ∧ (ω * R).im = 0 := by
    by_cases h0 : R = 0
    · exact ⟨1, by simp, by simp [h0]⟩
    · refine ⟨conj R / ((‖R‖ : ℝ) : ℂ), ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_conj, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_norm,
          div_self (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr h0)]
      · rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, Complex.conj_mul', ← Complex.ofReal_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_div,
          Complex.ofReal_im]
  set w : E := ω • y with hw
  have hw1 : ‖w‖ = 1 := by rw [hw, norm_smul, hω, hy, one_mul]
  have hwS : ⟪w, S w⟫_ℂ = 1 := by
    rw [hw, inner_smul_map_smul, hω, hy1]; simp
  set c : ℂ := ⟪x, S w⟫_ℂ + ⟪w, S x⟫_ℂ with hc
  have hcim : c.im = 0 := by
    have e : c = ω * ⟪x, S y⟫_ℂ + conj ω * ⟪y, S x⟫_ℂ := by
      rw [hc, hw, map_smul, inner_smul_right, inner_smul_left]
    have hRim := hωR
    rw [hR] at hRim
    rw [e]
    simp only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, Complex.sub_im,
      Complex.sub_re] at hRim ⊢
    linear_combination hRim
  -- The path `v s = (1 - s) x + s w` and its quadratic form.
  let v : ℝ → E := fun s => ((1 - s : ℝ) : ℂ) • x + ((s : ℝ) : ℂ) • w
  have hq : ∀ s : ℝ, ⟪v s, S (v s)⟫_ℂ = ((s ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + (((1 - s) * s : ℝ) : ℂ) * c := by
    intro s
    simp only [v, map_add, map_smul, inner_add_left, inner_add_right, inner_smul_left,
      inner_smul_right, Complex.conj_ofReal, hx0, hwS, hc]
    push_cast; ring
  have hv0 : ∀ s : ℝ, v s ≠ 0 := by
    intro s hs
    have h1 : ((1 - s : ℝ) : ℂ) • x = ((-s : ℝ) : ℂ) • w := by
      rw [Complex.ofReal_neg, neg_smul, ← sub_eq_zero, sub_neg_eq_add]
      exact hs
    have h2 := congrArg (fun z => ⟪z, S z⟫_ℂ) h1
    simp only [inner_smul_map_smul, hx0, hwS, mul_zero, mul_one, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at h2
    have hs0 : s = 0 := by
      have : (-s) ^ 2 = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h2.symm
      nlinarith
    subst hs0
    have hx' : x ≠ 0 := fun h => by simp [h] at hx
    exact hx' (by simpa [v] using hs)
  have hcont_v : Continuous v := by
    apply Continuous.add
    · exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).smul continuous_const
    · exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_id).smul continuous_const
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => (⟪v s, S (v s)⟫_ℂ).re / ‖v s‖ ^ 2
  have hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 1) := by
    refine (Continuous.continuousOn ?_).div (Continuous.continuousOn ?_) fun s _ => ?_
    · exact Complex.continuous_re.comp (hcont_v.inner (S.continuous.comp hcont_v))
    · exact (continuous_norm.comp hcont_v).pow 2
    · exact pow_ne_zero 2 (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (hv0 s))
  have hf0 : f 0 = 0 := by simp [f, v, hx0]
  have hf1 : f 1 = 1 := by simp [f, v, hwS, hw1]
  obtain ⟨s, -, hs⟩ : ∃ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, f s = t := by
    have := intermediate_value_Icc (zero_le_one' ℝ) hf
    rw [hf0, hf1] at this
    exact this ht
  have hreal : ⟪v s, S (v s)⟫_ℂ = (((⟪v s, S (v s)⟫_ℂ).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp
    · rw [Complex.ofReal_im, hq, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re, hcim]
      ring
  have hmem := div_norm_sq_mem_numericalRange S (hv0 s)
  have ht' : (t : ℂ) = ⟪v s, S (v s)⟫_ℂ / ((‖v s‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [hreal, ← Complex.ofReal_div, ← hs]
  rwa [ht']

/-- **Toeplitz–Hausdorff**: the numerical range is convex. -/
theorem convex_numericalRange (T : E →L[ℂ] E) : Convex ℝ (numericalRange T) := by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ a b ha hb hab
  by_cases hxy : ⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ = ⟪y, T y⟫_ℂ
  · rw [hxy, ← add_smul, hab, one_smul]
    exact ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  set d : ℂ := ⟪y, T y⟫_ℂ - ⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ with hd
  have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hxy)
  set S : E →L[ℂ] E := d⁻¹ • T + (-(d⁻¹ * ⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ)) • (1 : E →L[ℂ] E) with hS
  have hSu : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ = 1 → ⟪u, S u⟫_ℂ = d⁻¹ * (⟪u, T u⟫_ℂ - ⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ) := by
    intro u hu
    rw [hS, inner_map_self_affine T _ _ hu]
    ring
  have hSx : ⟪x, S x⟫_ℂ = 0 := by rw [hSu x hx, sub_self, mul_zero]
  have hSy : ⟪y, S y⟫_ℂ = 1 := by rw [hSu y hy, ← hd, inv_mul_cancel₀ hd0]
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hub⟩ := ofReal_mem_numericalRange_of_zero_one hx hy hSx hSy ⟨hb, by linarith⟩
  refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
  rw [hSu u hu] at hub
  have hua : ⟪u, T u⟫_ℂ = ⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ + (b : ℂ) * d := by
    rw [← hub]; field_simp; ring
  have ha' : (a : ℂ) = 1 - b := by
    rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_add, hab, Complex.ofReal_one]
  rw [hua, hd, Complex.real_smul, Complex.real_smul, ha']
  ring

end Convex

section Radius

theorem bddAbove_norm_numericalRange (T : E →L[ℂ] E) :
    BddAbove ((fun z => ‖z‖) '' numericalRange T) :=
  ⟨‖T‖, by rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩; exact norm_le_of_mem_numericalRange hz⟩

theorem numericalRadius_nonneg (T : E →L[ℂ] E) : 0 ≤ numericalRadius T :=
  Real.sSup_nonneg fun _ ⟨_, _, h⟩ => h ▸ norm_nonneg _

theorem norm_le_numericalRadius {T : E →L[ℂ] E} {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ numericalRange T) :
    ‖z‖ ≤ numericalRadius T :=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_norm_numericalRange T) ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩

theorem numericalRadius_le_norm (T : E →L[ℂ] E) : numericalRadius T ≤ ‖T‖ :=
  Real.sSup_le (by rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩; exact norm_le_of_mem_numericalRange hz) (norm_nonneg T)

/-- `|⟪x, T x⟫| ≤ w(T) ‖x‖²` for every vector. -/
theorem norm_inner_map_self_le (T : E →L[ℂ] E) (x : E) :
    ‖⟪x, T x⟫_ℂ‖ ≤ numericalRadius T * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simp [hx]
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h := norm_le_numericalRadius (div_norm_sq_mem_numericalRange T hx)
  rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hn, div_le_iff₀ hn] at h
  exact h

/-- `|⟪T y, x⟫| ≤ w(T) (‖x‖² + ‖y‖²)`, from the polarization identity and the parallelogram law. -/
theorem norm_inner_map_le (T : E →L[ℂ] E) (x y : E) :
    ‖⟪T y, x⟫_ℂ‖ ≤ numericalRadius T * (‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖y‖ ^ 2) := by
  set w := numericalRadius T
  have key : ∀ z : E, ‖⟪T z, z⟫_ℂ‖ ≤ w * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := fun z => by
    rw [← Complex.norm_conj, inner_conj_symm]; exact norm_inner_map_self_le T z
  have hpol := inner_map_polarization (T : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) x y
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe] at hpol
  rw [hpol, norm_div, show ‖(4 : ℂ)‖ = 4 by norm_num, div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4)]
  have hI : ‖Complex.I • y‖ = ‖y‖ := by rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul]
  have p1 := parallelogram_law_with_norm ℂ x y
  have p2 := parallelogram_law_with_norm ℂ x (Complex.I • y)
  rw [hI] at p2
  have e1 := key (x + y)
  have e2 := key (x - y)
  have e3 := key (x + Complex.I • y)
  have e4 := key (x - Complex.I • y)
  calc ‖⟪T (x + y), x + y⟫_ℂ - ⟪T (x - y), x - y⟫_ℂ +
          Complex.I * ⟪T (x + Complex.I • y), x + Complex.I • y⟫_ℂ -
          Complex.I * ⟪T (x - Complex.I • y), x - Complex.I • y⟫_ℂ‖
      ≤ ‖⟪T (x + y), x + y⟫_ℂ‖ + ‖⟪T (x - y), x - y⟫_ℂ‖ +
          ‖⟪T (x + Complex.I • y), x + Complex.I • y⟫_ℂ‖ +
          ‖⟪T (x - Complex.I • y), x - Complex.I • y⟫_ℂ‖ := by
        refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans ?_
        rw [norm_mul _ ⟪T (x - Complex.I • y), x - Complex.I • y⟫_ℂ, Complex.norm_I, one_mul]
        gcongr
        refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul]
        gcongr
        exact norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ w * ‖x + y‖ ^ 2 + w * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 + w * ‖x + Complex.I • y‖ ^ 2 +
          w * ‖x - Complex.I • y‖ ^ 2 := by gcongr
    _ = (w * (‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖y‖ ^ 2)) * 4 := by linear_combination w * p1 + w * p2

/-- `‖T‖ ≤ 2 w(T)`. -/
theorem norm_le_two_mul_numericalRadius (T : E →L[ℂ] E) : ‖T‖ ≤ 2 * numericalRadius T := by
  set w := numericalRadius T
  have hw := numericalRadius_nonneg T
  refine T.opNorm_le_bound (by positivity) fun y => ?_
  by_cases hTy : T y = 0
  · rw [hTy, norm_zero]; positivity
  have hTn : 0 < ‖T y‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hTy
  set x : E := ((‖y‖ / ‖T y‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) • T y with hxdef
  have hxn : ‖x‖ = ‖y‖ := by
    rw [hxdef, norm_smul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (by positivity), div_mul_cancel₀ _ hTn.ne']
  have hinner : ⟪T y, x⟫_ℂ = ((‖y‖ * ‖T y‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    have hTc : ((‖T y‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hTn.ne'
    rw [hxdef, inner_smul_right, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, ← RCLike.ofReal_eq_complex_ofReal]
    push_cast
    field_simp
  have h := norm_inner_map_le T x y
  rw [hinner, hxn, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)] at h
  by_cases hy : y = 0
  · simp [hy] at hTy
  have hyn : 0 < ‖y‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hy
  have : ‖y‖ * ‖T y‖ ≤ ‖y‖ * (2 * w * ‖y‖) := by nlinarith
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left this hyn

theorem eq_zero_of_numericalRadius_eq_zero {T : E →L[ℂ] E} (h : numericalRadius T = 0) : T = 0 :=
  norm_le_zero_iff.mp (by simpa [h] using norm_le_two_mul_numericalRadius T)

end Radius

section Matrix

variable {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]

/-- Eigenvalues of a matrix lie in the numerical range of its Euclidean operator. -/
theorem mem_numericalRange_toEuclideanCLM_of_mulVec_eq {A : Matrix n n ℂ} {μ : ℂ} {v : n → ℂ}
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hAv : A.mulVec v = μ • v) :
    μ ∈ numericalRange (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ) A) := by
  refine mem_numericalRange_of_eigenvector (x := WithLp.toLp 2 v) (by simpa using hv) ?_
  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanCLM_toLp, hAv, WithLp.toLp_smul]

theorem numericalRange_toEuclideanCLM_conjTranspose (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    numericalRange (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ) A.conjTranspose) =
      conj '' numericalRange (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ) A) := by
  rw [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, map_star, numericalRange_star]

/-- Unitary similarity preserves the numerical range: `W(U A Uᴴ) = W(A)`. -/
theorem numericalRange_toEuclideanCLM_unitary_conj (A : Matrix n n ℂ)
    {U : Matrix n n ℂ} (hU : U ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) :
    numericalRange (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ) (U * A * U.conjTranspose)) =
      numericalRange (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ) A) := by
  have hu := Unitary.map_mem (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ)) hU
  rw [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, map_mul, map_mul, map_star]
  exact numericalRange_unitary_conj _ ⟨_, hu⟩

end Matrix

end

end TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra
