lemma uniformPattern_abs_le (f : ℝ → ℝ) (K : ℝ) (_hf : Continuous f)
    (hK : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ K) (q : OverlapPath) (n : ℕ) :
    |uniformPattern f q n| ≤ K := by
  simpa [uniformPattern] using
    foldr_gaussianTransform_abs_le
      (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (n + 2) =>
        let k := n + 1
        let levelVal := fun j => if j < k then cellAverage q k j else 1
        (levelVal i - (if i.val = 0 then 0 else levelVal (i.val - 1)),
          (i : ℝ) / k))) K hK 0
def patternFunctional (f : ℝ → ℝ) (q : OverlapPath) : ℝ :=
  Filter.limUnder atTop (uniformPattern f q)

 

def isingEntropy (q : OverlapPath) : EReal :=
  ⨆ h : FieldStep,
    ((fieldRecursion h + (∫ u, stepFunction h u * q.val u ∂pathMeasure) / 2 : ℝ) : EReal)

def isingEntropyWitnessPartition : Partition where
  levels := 1
  positive := by norm_num
  cut := fun i : Fin (1 + 1) => (i.val : ℝ)
  ordered := by
    intro i j hij
    exact Nat.cast_lt.mpr hij
  first := by simp
  last := by simp
def isingEntropyWitnessFieldStep : FieldStep where
  partition := isingEntropyWitnessPartition
  value := fun _ => 0
  nonneg := by intro i; rfl
  ordered := by intro i j _; rfl
lemma stepAt_isingEntropyWitnessFieldStep (i : ℕ) :
    stepAt isingEntropyWitnessFieldStep i = 0 := by
  unfold stepAt
  split_ifs <;> rfl
lemma stepFunction_isingEntropyWitnessFieldStep (u : ℝ) :
    stepFunction isingEntropyWitnessFieldStep u = 0 := by
  unfold stepFunction
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i hi
  split_ifs <;> rfl
lemma fieldRecursion_isingEntropyWitnessFieldStep :
    fieldRecursion isingEntropyWitnessFieldStep = 0 := by
  simp [fieldRecursion, isingEntropyWitnessFieldStep, isingEntropyWitnessPartition,
    gaussianTransform, stepAt, Real.log_one]
theorem isingEntropy_nonneg (q : OverlapPath) : (0 : EReal) ≤ isingEntropy q := by
  unfold isingEntropy
  refine le_iSup_of_le (f := fun h : FieldStep =>
    ((fieldRecursion h + (∫ u, stepFunction h u * q.val u ∂pathMeasure) / 2 : ℝ) : EReal))
    isingEntropyWitnessFieldStep ?_
  simp [fieldRecursion_isingEntropyWitnessFieldStep,
    stepFunction_isingEntropyWitnessFieldStep]
def variationalValue (α : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : EReal :=
  ⨅ q : OverlapPath, (α * patternFunctional f q : ℝ) + isingEntropy q

lemma integral_exp_mul_gaussianReal_one (t : ℝ) :
    ∫ z, Real.exp (t * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 = Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) := by
  have h := congrFun (ProbabilityTheory.mgf_id_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1)) t
  simpa [ProbabilityTheory.mgf] using h
lemma integrable_exp_pos_affine (x s : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
  have h : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (Real.sqrt s * z)) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    ProbabilityTheory.integrable_exp_mul_gaussianReal _
  have h2 : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp x * Real.exp (Real.sqrt s * z))
      (gaussianReal 0 1) := h.const_mul _
  refine h2.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => ?_))
  simp only [← Real.exp_add]
lemma integrable_exp_neg_affine (x s : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (-(x + Real.sqrt s * z))) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
  have h : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp ((-Real.sqrt s) * z)) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    ProbabilityTheory.integrable_exp_mul_gaussianReal _
  have h2 : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (-x) * Real.exp ((-Real.sqrt s) * z))
      (gaussianReal 0 1) := h.const_mul _
  refine h2.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => ?_))
  simp only [← Real.exp_add]
  ring_nf
lemma integral_exp_affine {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (t x : ℝ) :
    ∫ z, Real.exp (x + t * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 = Real.exp x * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) := by
  have h := integral_exp_mul_gaussianReal_one t
  calc ∫ z, Real.exp (x + t * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1
      = ∫ z, Real.exp x * Real.exp (t * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := by
        congr 1 with z; rw [Real.exp_add]
    _ = Real.exp x * ∫ z, Real.exp (t * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := integral_const_mul _ _
    _ = Real.exp x * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) := by rw [h]
lemma integrable_cosh_gaussianReal (x s : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun z : ℝ => Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
  have h1 := integrable_exp_pos_affine x s
  have h2 := integrable_exp_neg_affine x s
  have h3 : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (x + Real.sqrt s * z)
      + Real.exp (-(x + Real.sqrt s * z))) (gaussianReal 0 1) := h1.add h2
  have h4 := h3.const_mul ((2:ℝ)⁻¹)
  refine h4.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => ?_))
  simp only [Real.cosh_eq]
  ring
lemma integral_cosh_gaussianReal {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (x : ℝ) :
    ∫ z, Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1
      = Real.cosh x * Real.exp (s / 2) := by
  have hsp : (Real.sqrt s) ^ 2 = s := Real.sq_sqrt hs
  have h1 := integrable_exp_pos_affine x s
  have h2 := integrable_exp_neg_affine x s
  have e1 : ∫ z, Real.exp (x + Real.sqrt s * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1
      = Real.exp x * Real.exp (s / 2) := by
    rw [integral_exp_affine hs, hsp]
  have e2 : ∫ z, Real.exp (-(x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1
      = Real.exp (-x) * Real.exp (s / 2) := by
    have h := integral_exp_mul_gaussianReal_one (-Real.sqrt s)
    calc ∫ z, Real.exp (-(x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1
        = ∫ z, Real.exp (-x) * Real.exp ((-Real.sqrt s) * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := by
          congr 1 with z; rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
      _ = Real.exp (-x) * ∫ z, Real.exp ((-Real.sqrt s) * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 :=
          integral_const_mul _ _
      _ = Real.exp (-x) * Real.exp (((-Real.sqrt s)) ^ 2 / 2) := by rw [h]
      _ = Real.exp (-x) * Real.exp (s / 2) := by
          rw [show ((-Real.sqrt s)) ^ 2 = s by rw [neg_sq, hsp]]
  calc ∫ z, Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1
      = ∫ z, (Real.exp (x + Real.sqrt s * z) + Real.exp (-(x + Real.sqrt s * z))) / 2
          ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := by
        congr 1 with z
        rw [Real.cosh_eq]
    _ = (∫ z, (Real.exp (x + Real.sqrt s * z) + Real.exp (-(x + Real.sqrt s * z)))
          ∂gaussianReal 0 1) / 2 := by rw [integral_div]
    _ = ((∫ z, Real.exp (x + Real.sqrt s * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1)
          + (∫ z, Real.exp (-(x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1)) / 2 := by
        rw [integral_add h1 h2]
    _ = Real.cosh x * Real.exp (s / 2) := by
        rw [e1, e2, Real.cosh_eq]
        ring
lemma exp_mul_le_cosh_rpow {d w : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) {U : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hU : ∀ y, U y ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh y) - w / 2) (y : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (d * U y) ≤ (Real.cosh y) ^ d * Real.exp (-(d * w / 2)) := by
  have hcosh_pos : 0 < Real.cosh y := Real.cosh_pos y
  have h1 : d * U y ≤ d * (Real.log (Real.cosh y) - w / 2) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hU y) hd
  have h2 : Real.exp (d * U y) ≤ Real.exp (d * (Real.log (Real.cosh y) - w / 2)) :=
    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h1
  have h3 : Real.exp (d * (Real.log (Real.cosh y) - w / 2))
      = (Real.cosh y) ^ d * Real.exp (-(d * w / 2)) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hcosh_pos]
    rw [show d * (Real.log (Real.cosh y) - w / 2)
      = Real.log (Real.cosh y) * d + (-(d * w / 2)) by ring]
    rw [Real.exp_add]
  rw [← h3]
  exact h2
lemma integrable_cosh_rpow_gaussianReal {s d : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1)
    (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun z : ℝ => (Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ^ d) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
  have hcosh := integrable_cosh_gaussianReal x s
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z : ℝ => (Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ^ d)
      (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    apply Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
    fun_prop
  refine Integrable.mono hcosh hmeas (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => ?_))
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hpos : 0 < Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z) := Real.cosh_pos _
  rw [abs_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hpos d), abs_of_pos hpos]
  calc (Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ^ d
      ≤ (Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ^ (1:ℝ) := by
        apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le
        · exact Real.one_le_cosh _
        · exact hd1
    _ = Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z) := Real.rpow_one _
lemma integrable_exp_mul_u_gaussianReal {s d w M : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1)
    {U : ℝ → ℝ} (hUmeas : Measurable U)
    (hUup : ∀ x, U x ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh x) - w / 2) (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (d * U (x + Real.sqrt s * z))) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
  have hcosh_rpow := integrable_cosh_rpow_gaussianReal hs hd hd1 x
  have hbound_int : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => (Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ^ d
      * Real.exp (-(d * w / 2))) (gaussianReal 0 1) := hcosh_rpow.mul_const _
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (d * U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)))
      (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    have h2 : Measurable fun z : ℝ => U (x + Real.sqrt s * z) :=
      hUmeas.comp (by fun_prop)
    exact (Real.measurable_exp.comp (h2.const_mul d)).aestronglyMeasurable
  refine Integrable.mono' hbound_int hmeas (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => ?_))
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  exact exp_mul_le_cosh_rpow hd hUup _
lemma integrable_cosh_mul_exp_gaussianReal {s d w : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1)
    (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun z : ℝ => (Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ^ d
      * Real.exp (-(d * w / 2))) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
  have hcosh_rpow := integrable_cosh_rpow_gaussianReal hs hd hd1 x
  exact hcosh_rpow.mul_const _
lemma jensen_step_pos {s d w M : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hd : 0 < d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1)
    {U : ℝ → ℝ} (hUmeas : Measurable U) (hUlow : ∀ x, -M ≤ U x)
    (hUup : ∀ x, U x ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh x) - w / 2) (x : ℝ) :
    ∫ z, Real.exp (d * U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1
      ≤ (Real.cosh x) ^ d * Real.exp (s * d / 2 - d * w / 2) := by
  have hcosh_int : ∫ z, Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1
      = Real.cosh x * Real.exp (s / 2) := integral_cosh_gaussianReal hs x
  have hcosh_int_meas : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z))
      (gaussianReal 0 1) := integrable_cosh_gaussianReal x s
  have hptw : ∀ z, Real.exp (d * U (x + Real.sqrt s * z))
      ≤ (Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ^ d * Real.exp (-(d * w / 2)) :=
    fun z => exp_mul_le_cosh_rpow hd.le hUup _
  have hJensen : (∫ z, Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) ^ d
      ≥ ∫ z, (Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ^ d ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := by
    have hconcave : ConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) (fun y : ℝ => y ^ d) :=
      Real.concaveOn_rpow hd.le hd1
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => y ^ d) (Set.Ici 0) := by
      intro y hy
      exact (Real.continuousAt_rpow_const y d (Or.inr hd.le)).continuousWithinAt
    have hmem : ∀ᵐ z ∂gaussianReal 0 1, Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z) ∈ Set.Ici (0:ℝ) :=
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => (Real.cosh_pos _).le)
    have hint_rpow : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => (Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ^ d)
        (gaussianReal 0 1) := integrable_cosh_rpow_gaussianReal hs hd.le hd1 x
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
      (ConcaveOn.le_map_integral hconcave hcont isClosed_Ici hmem hcosh_int_meas hint_rpow)
  have h_exp_int := integrable_exp_mul_u_gaussianReal (M := M) hs hd.le hd1 hUmeas hUup x
  have h_bound_int := integrable_cosh_mul_exp_gaussianReal hs hd.le hd1 (w := w) x
  calc ∫ z, Real.exp (d * U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1
      ≤ ∫ z, (Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ^ d * Real.exp (-(d * w / 2))
          ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := integral_mono h_exp_int h_bound_int hptw
    _ = (∫ z, (Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ^ d ∂gaussianReal 0 1)
          * Real.exp (-(d * w / 2)) := integral_mul_const _ _
    _ ≤ (∫ z, Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) ^ d
          * Real.exp (-(d * w / 2)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hJensen (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = (Real.cosh x * Real.exp (s / 2)) ^ d * Real.exp (-(d * w / 2)) := by rw [hcosh_int]
    _ = (Real.cosh x) ^ d * Real.exp (s * d / 2 - d * w / 2) := by
        rw [Real.mul_rpow (Real.cosh_pos x).le (Real.exp_pos (s/2)).le]
        rw [show (Real.exp (s / 2)) ^ d = Real.exp (s / 2 * d) by
          rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), Real.log_exp]]
        rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
        congr 2
        ring
lemma integrable_shift_of_bounds {s w M : ℝ} {U : ℝ → ℝ} (hUmeas : Measurable U)
    (hUlow : ∀ y, -M ≤ U y) (hUup : ∀ y, U y ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh y) - w / 2)
    (hwM : -w / 2 ≤ M) (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun z : ℝ => U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
  have hc : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    integrable_cosh_gaussianReal x s
  have hmono : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => M + Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    have := (integrable_const (μ := gaussianReal 0 1) M).add hc
    simpa [add_comm] using this
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z : ℝ => U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    (hUmeas.comp (by fun_prop)).aestronglyMeasurable
  refine Integrable.mono' hmono hmeas (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => ?_))
  have hlog_le : Real.log (Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ≤ Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z) := by
    have h1 : Real.log (Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ≤ Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z) - 1 :=
      Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (Real.cosh_pos _)
    linarith
  have hpos : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z) := (Real.cosh_pos _).le
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
  constructor
  · have := hUlow (x + Real.sqrt s * z); linarith
  · have := hUup (x + Real.sqrt s * z); linarith
lemma integrable_exp_shift_of_bounds {s w M : ℝ} {U : ℝ → ℝ} (hUmeas : Measurable U)
    (hUlow : ∀ y, -M ≤ U y) (hUup : ∀ y, U y ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh y) - w / 2) (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (U (x + Real.sqrt s * z))) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
  have hc : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z) * Real.exp (-(w / 2)))
      (gaussianReal 0 1) := (integrable_cosh_gaussianReal x s).mul_const _
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)))
      (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    (Real.measurable_exp.comp (hUmeas.comp (by fun_prop))).aestronglyMeasurable
  refine Integrable.mono' hc hmeas (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => ?_))
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  simpa using exp_mul_le_cosh_rpow (d := 1) zero_le_one hUup (x + Real.sqrt s * z)
lemma integral_le_log_integral_exp {s w M : ℝ} {U : ℝ → ℝ} (hUmeas : Measurable U)
    (hUlow : ∀ y, -M ≤ U y) (hUup : ∀ y, U y ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh y) - w / 2)
    (hwM : -w / 2 ≤ M) (x : ℝ) :
    ∫ z, U (x + Real.sqrt s * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1
      ≤ Real.log (∫ z, Real.exp (U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) := by
  have hUint := integrable_shift_of_bounds (s := s) (w := w) (M := M) hUmeas hUlow hUup hwM x
  have hGint := integrable_exp_shift_of_bounds (s := s) (w := w) (M := M) hUmeas hUlow hUup x
  set A : ℝ := ∫ z, Real.exp (U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 with hA
  have hApos : 0 < A := by
    have hconst : Integrable (fun _ : ℝ => Real.exp (-M)) (gaussianReal 0 1) := integrable_const _
    have hle : (∫ _z : ℝ, Real.exp (-M) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) ≤ A := by
      rw [hA]
      apply integral_mono hconst hGint
      intro z; exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (hUlow _)
    have hval : (∫ _z : ℝ, Real.exp (-M) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) = Real.exp (-M) := by simp
    rw [hval] at hle
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hle
  set G : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => Real.exp (U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) with hG
  have hGint' : Integrable G (gaussianReal 0 1) := hGint
  have hpoint : ∀ z, U (x + Real.sqrt s * z) ≤ Real.log A + (G z - A) / A := by
    intro z
    have hGpos : 0 < G z := Real.exp_pos _
    have hlogG : Real.log (G z) = U (x + Real.sqrt s * z) := by simp [hG]
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hGpos hApos)
    rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hGpos) (ne_of_gt hApos), hlogG] at this
    have h2 : G z / A - 1 = (G z - A) / A := by field_simp
    linarith [this, h2.le, h2.ge]
  have hright_int : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => Real.log A + (G z - A) / A) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    have h1 : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => (G z - A) / A) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
      ((hGint'.sub (integrable_const A))).div_const A
    exact (integrable_const (Real.log A)).add h1
  have hmono := integral_mono hUint hright_int hpoint
  have hright_val : ∫ z, (Real.log A + (G z - A) / A) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 = Real.log A := by
    have h1 : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => (G z - A) / A) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
      ((hGint'.sub (integrable_const A))).div_const A
    rw [integral_add (integrable_const (Real.log A)) h1]
    have h2 : ∫ z, (G z - A) / A ∂gaussianReal 0 1 = 0 := by
      rw [integral_div]
      rw [integral_sub hGint' (integrable_const A)]
      have hGA : (∫ z, G z ∂gaussianReal 0 1) = A := by rw [hA]
      rw [hGA]
      simp
    rw [h2]
    simp
  rw [hright_val] at hmono
  simpa [hA] using hmono
lemma gaussianTransform_step_upper {s d w M : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1)
    {U : ℝ → ℝ} (hUmeas : Measurable U) (hUlow : ∀ x, -M ≤ U x)
    (hUup : ∀ x, U x ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh x) - w / 2) (hwM : -w / 2 ≤ M) (x : ℝ) :
    gaussianTransform s d U x ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh x) + s / 2 - w / 2 := by
  by_cases hd0 : d = 0
  · simp only [gaussianTransform, hd0, ite_true]
    have hstep := integral_le_log_integral_exp (s := s) (w := w) (M := M)
      hUmeas hUlow hUup hwM x
    have hGint := integrable_exp_shift_of_bounds (s := s) (w := w) (M := M)
      hUmeas hUlow hUup x
    have hbound_int : Integrable (fun z : ℝ =>
        Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z) * Real.exp (-(w / 2))) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
      (integrable_cosh_gaussianReal x s).mul_const _
    have hpoint : ∀ z : ℝ, Real.exp (U (x + Real.sqrt s * z))
        ≤ Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z) * Real.exp (-(w / 2)) := by
      intro z
      have := exp_mul_le_cosh_rpow (d := 1) zero_le_one hUup (x + Real.sqrt s * z)
      simpa using this
    have hA_le : (∫ z, Real.exp (U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1)
        ≤ Real.cosh x * Real.exp (s / 2) * Real.exp (-(w / 2)) := by
      calc ∫ z, Real.exp (U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1
          ≤ ∫ z, Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z) * Real.exp (-(w / 2))
              ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := integral_mono hGint hbound_int hpoint
        _ = (∫ z, Real.cosh (x + Real.sqrt s * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1)
              * Real.exp (-(w / 2)) := integral_mul_const _ _
        _ = Real.cosh x * Real.exp (s / 2) * Real.exp (-(w / 2)) := by
            rw [integral_cosh_gaussianReal hs x]
    have hApos : 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := by
      have hconst : Integrable (fun _ : ℝ => Real.exp (-M)) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
        integrable_const _
      have hle : (∫ _z : ℝ, Real.exp (-M) ∂gaussianReal 0 1)
          ≤ ∫ z, Real.exp (U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := by
        apply integral_mono hconst hGint
        intro z; exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (hUlow _)
      have hval : (∫ _z : ℝ, Real.exp (-M) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) = Real.exp (-M) := by simp
      rw [hval] at hle
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hle
    have hlog_le := Real.log_le_log hApos hA_le
    rw [Real.log_mul (mul_pos (Real.cosh_pos x) (Real.exp_pos (s / 2))).ne'
        (Real.exp_pos (-(w / 2))).ne',
      Real.log_mul (Real.cosh_pos x).ne' (Real.exp_pos (s / 2)).ne',
      Real.log_exp, Real.log_exp] at hlog_le
    linarith
  · have hdpos : 0 < d := lt_of_le_of_ne hd (Ne.symm hd0)
    simp only [gaussianTransform, hd0, ite_false]
    have hJ := jensen_step_pos (M := M) hs hdpos hd1 hUmeas hUlow hUup x
    have hpos_low : 0 < Real.exp (-(d * M)) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hconst : Integrable (fun _ : ℝ => Real.exp (-(d * M))) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
      integrable_const _
    have hGint := integrable_exp_mul_u_gaussianReal (M := M) hs hd hd1 hUmeas hUup x
    have hle : Real.exp (-(d * M))
        ≤ ∫ z, Real.exp (d * U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := by
      calc Real.exp (-(d * M)) = ∫ _z : ℝ, Real.exp (-(d * M)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := by simp
        _ ≤ ∫ z, Real.exp (d * U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 :=
            integral_mono hconst hGint (fun z => Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by
              have := hUlow (x + Real.sqrt s * z); nlinarith))
    have hIpos : 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (d * U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hpos_low hle
    have hlog_le : Real.log (∫ z, Real.exp (d * U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1)
        ≤ Real.log ((Real.cosh x) ^ d * Real.exp (s * d / 2 - d * w / 2)) :=
      Real.log_le_log hIpos hJ
    rw [Real.log_mul (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.cosh_pos x) d).ne'
      (Real.exp_pos (s * d / 2 - d * w / 2)).ne',
      Real.log_rpow (Real.cosh_pos x), Real.log_exp] at hlog_le
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hdpos]
    nlinarith
lemma gaussianTransform_step_lower {s d w M : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1)
    {U : ℝ → ℝ} (hUmeas : Measurable U) (hUlow : ∀ x, -M ≤ U x)
    (hUup : ∀ x, U x ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh x) - w / 2) (hwM : -w / 2 ≤ M) (x : ℝ) :
    -M ≤ gaussianTransform s d U x := by
  by_cases hd0 : d = 0
  · simp only [gaussianTransform, hd0, ite_true]
    have hUint := integrable_shift_of_bounds (s := s) (w := w) (M := M)
      hUmeas hUlow hUup hwM x
    have hconst : Integrable (fun _ : ℝ => -M) (gaussianReal 0 1) := integrable_const _
    have := integral_mono hconst hUint (fun z => hUlow _)
    simpa using this
  · have hdpos : 0 < d := lt_of_le_of_ne hd (Ne.symm hd0)
    simp only [gaussianTransform, hd0, ite_false]
    have hGint := integrable_exp_mul_u_gaussianReal (M := M) hs hd hd1 hUmeas hUup x
    have hconst : Integrable (fun _ : ℝ => Real.exp (-(d * M))) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
      integrable_const _
    have hle : Real.exp (-(d * M))
        ≤ ∫ z, Real.exp (d * U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := by
      calc Real.exp (-(d * M)) = ∫ _z : ℝ, Real.exp (-(d * M)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := by simp
        _ ≤ ∫ z, Real.exp (d * U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 :=
            integral_mono hconst hGint (fun z => Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by
              have := hUlow (x + Real.sqrt s * z); nlinarith))
    have hIpos : 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (d * U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hle
    have hlog : -(d * M) ≤
        Real.log (∫ z, Real.exp (d * U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) := by
      calc -(d * M) = Real.log (Real.exp (-(d * M))) := by rw [Real.log_exp]
        _ ≤ Real.log (∫ z, Real.exp (d * U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) :=
            Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hle
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hdpos]
    nlinarith
lemma measurable_integral_shift {s : ℝ} {U : ℝ → ℝ} (hU : Measurable U) :
    Measurable (fun x : ℝ => ∫ z, U (x + Real.sqrt s * z) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) := by
  have hun : StronglyMeasurable
      (Function.uncurry fun x z : ℝ => U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) := by
    apply hU.stronglyMeasurable.comp_measurable
    fun_prop
  exact (hun.integral_prod_right (ν := gaussianReal 0 1)).measurable
lemma measurable_log_integral_shift {s d : ℝ} {U : ℝ → ℝ} (hU : Measurable U) :
    Measurable (fun x : ℝ => Real.log
      (∫ z, Real.exp (d * U (x + Real.sqrt s * z)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1)) := by
  have hun : StronglyMeasurable
      (Function.uncurry fun x z : ℝ => Real.exp (d * U (x + Real.sqrt s * z))) := by
    apply (Real.measurable_exp.comp (hU.const_mul d)).stronglyMeasurable.comp_measurable
    fun_prop
  exact ((hun.integral_prod_right (ν := gaussianReal 0 1)).measurable.log)
lemma gaussianTransform_measurable {s d : ℝ} {U : ℝ → ℝ} (hU : Measurable U) :
    Measurable (gaussianTransform s d U) := by
  unfold gaussianTransform
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · simp only [if_pos hd]
    exact measurable_integral_shift hU
  · simp only [if_neg hd]
    exact (measurable_log_integral_shift (d := d) hU).div_const d
lemma gaussianTransform_step_upper' {s d c M : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1)
    {U : ℝ → ℝ} (hUmeas : Measurable U) (hUlow : ∀ x, -M ≤ U x)
    (hUup : ∀ x, U x ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh x) + c) (hcM : c ≤ M) (x : ℝ) :
    gaussianTransform s d U x ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh x) + s / 2 + c := by
  have h := gaussianTransform_step_upper (w := -2 * c) hs hd hd1 hUmeas hUlow
    (fun y => by have := hUup y; linarith) (by linarith) x
  calc gaussianTransform s d U x
      ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh x) + s / 2 - (-2 * c) / 2 := h
    _ = Real.log (Real.cosh x) + s / 2 + c := by ring
lemma gaussianTransform_step_lower' {s d c M : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1)
    {U : ℝ → ℝ} (hUmeas : Measurable U) (hUlow : ∀ x, -M ≤ U x)
    (hUup : ∀ x, U x ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh x) + c) (hcM : c ≤ M) (x : ℝ) :
    -M ≤ gaussianTransform s d U x := by
  exact gaussianTransform_step_lower (w := -2 * c) hs hd hd1 hUmeas hUlow
    (fun y => by have := hUup y; linarith) (by linarith) x
lemma fold_gaussianTransform_bounds (L : List (ℝ × ℝ)) (M c : ℝ)
    (hL : ∀ p ∈ L, 0 ≤ p.1 ∧ 0 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ 1)
    (hcM : c + (L.map Prod.fst).sum / 2 ≤ M)
    {V : ℝ → ℝ} (hVmeas : Measurable V) (hVlow : ∀ x, -M ≤ V x)
    (hVup : ∀ x, V x ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh x) + c) :
    (∀ x, L.foldr (fun sd U => gaussianTransform sd.1 sd.2 U) V x
        ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh x) + c + (L.map Prod.fst).sum / 2) ∧
    (∀ x, -M ≤ L.foldr (fun sd U => gaussianTransform sd.1 sd.2 U) V x) ∧
    Measurable (L.foldr (fun sd U => gaussianTransform sd.1 sd.2 U) V) := by
  induction L with
  | nil =>
      refine ⟨fun x => ?_, hVlow, hVmeas⟩
      simpa using hVup x
  | cons a L ih =>
      obtain ⟨ha1, ha2, ha3⟩ := hL a (by simp)
      have htail : ∀ p ∈ L, 0 ≤ p.1 ∧ 0 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ 1 := fun p hp =>
        hL p (by simp [hp])
      have hsum : ((a :: L).map Prod.fst).sum = a.1 + (L.map Prod.fst).sum := by simp
      rw [hsum] at hcM
      have hcM' : c + (L.map Prod.fst).sum / 2 ≤ M := by linarith
      have hih := ih htail hcM'
      set W : ℝ → ℝ := L.foldr (fun sd U => gaussianTransform sd.1 sd.2 U) V with hW
      have hWmeas : Measurable W := hih.2.2
      have hWlow : ∀ x, -M ≤ W x := hih.2.1
      have hWup : ∀ x, W x ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh x) + (c + (L.map Prod.fst).sum / 2) := by
        intro x
        have := hih.1 x
        linarith
      have hcM'' : c + (L.map Prod.fst).sum / 2 ≤ M := hcM'
      have hstep_up : ∀ x, gaussianTransform a.1 a.2 W x
          ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh x) + a.1 / 2 + (c + (L.map Prod.fst).sum / 2) := fun x =>
        gaussianTransform_step_upper' ha1 ha2 ha3 hWmeas hWlow hWup hcM'' x
      have hstep_low : ∀ x, -M ≤ gaussianTransform a.1 a.2 W x := fun x =>
        gaussianTransform_step_lower' ha1 ha2 ha3 hWmeas hWlow hWup hcM'' x
      have hstep_meas : Measurable (gaussianTransform a.1 a.2 W) :=
        gaussianTransform_measurable hWmeas
      have hfold : (a :: L).foldr (fun sd U => gaussianTransform sd.1 sd.2 U) V
          = gaussianTransform a.1 a.2 W := by
        simp [hW]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x
        rw [hfold, hsum]
        have := hstep_up x
        calc gaussianTransform a.1 a.2 W x
            ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh x) + a.1 / 2 + (c + (L.map Prod.fst).sum / 2) := this
          _ = Real.log (Real.cosh x) + c + (a.1 + (L.map Prod.fst).sum) / 2 := by ring
      · intro x
        rw [hfold]
        exact hstep_low x
      · rw [hfold]
        exact hstep_meas
lemma stepAt_nonneg (h : FieldStep) (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ stepAt h i := by
  unfold stepAt
  split_ifs with hi
  · exact h.nonneg _
  · exact le_refl 0
lemma stepAt_mono_of_lt (h : FieldStep) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hj : j < h.partition.levels) : stepAt h i ≤ stepAt h j := by
  have hi : i < h.partition.levels := lt_of_le_of_lt hij hj
  have h1 : stepAt h i = h.value ⟨i, hi⟩ := by simp [stepAt, hi]
  have h2 : stepAt h j = h.value ⟨j, hj⟩ := by simp [stepAt, hj]
  rw [h1, h2]
  exact h.ordered (Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr hij)
lemma cut_nonneg (h : FieldStep) (i : Fin (h.partition.levels + 1)) :
    0 ≤ h.partition.cut i := by
  have hmono : Monotone h.partition.cut := h.partition.ordered.monotone
  have h0 : (⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ h.partition.levels⟩ : Fin (h.partition.levels + 1)) ≤ i :=
    Fin.zero_le i
  have := hmono h0
  rwa [h.partition.first] at this
lemma cut_le_one (h : FieldStep) (i : Fin (h.partition.levels + 1)) :
    h.partition.cut i ≤ 1 := by
  have hmono : Monotone h.partition.cut := h.partition.ordered.monotone
  have hlast : i ≤ (⟨h.partition.levels, Nat.lt_succ_self h.partition.levels⟩ :
      Fin (h.partition.levels + 1)) := Fin.le_last i
  have := hmono hlast
  rwa [h.partition.last] at this
lemma stepAt_increment_nonneg (h : FieldStep) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < h.partition.levels) :
    0 ≤ stepAt h i - (if i = 0 then 0 else stepAt h (i - 1)) := by
  by_cases h0 : i = 0
  · have hzi : stepAt h i = stepAt h 0 := by rw [h0]
    rw [h0, if_pos rfl]
    simp only [sub_zero]
    exact stepAt_nonneg h 0
  · have hle : i - 1 ≤ i := Nat.sub_le i 1
    have hmono := stepAt_mono_of_lt h hle hi
    rw [if_neg h0]
    linarith
lemma sum_increments_eq (h : FieldStep) :
    ((List.ofFn (fun i : Fin h.partition.levels =>
      (stepAt h i - (if i.val = 0 then 0 else stepAt h (i.val - 1)),
        h.partition.cut i.castSucc))).map Prod.fst).sum
      = stepAt h (h.partition.levels - 1) := by
  rw [List.map_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
    (fun i => stepAt h i - (if i = 0 then 0 else stepAt h (i - 1))) h.partition.levels]
  have htel := Finset.sum_range_sub
    (fun i : ℕ => if i = 0 then (0:ℝ) else stepAt h (i - 1)) h.partition.levels
  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range h.partition.levels,
      stepAt h i - (if i = 0 then 0 else stepAt h (i - 1))
        = (if i + 1 = 0 then (0:ℝ) else stepAt h (i + 1 - 1))
          - (if i = 0 then 0 else stepAt h (i - 1)) := by
    intro i hi
    have : i + 1 ≠ 0 := Nat.succ_ne_zero i
    rw [if_neg this, Nat.succ_sub_one]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, htel]
  have h0 : (if (0:ℕ) = 0 then (0:ℝ) else stepAt h (0 - 1)) = 0 := if_pos rfl
  rw [h0, sub_zero]
  have hk : h.partition.levels ≠ 0 := Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp h.partition.positive
  rw [if_neg hk]
lemma increments_mem (h : FieldStep) :
    ∀ p ∈ List.ofFn (fun i : Fin h.partition.levels =>
      (stepAt h i - (if i.val = 0 then 0 else stepAt h (i.val - 1)),
        h.partition.cut i.castSucc)), 0 ≤ p.1 ∧ 0 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ 1 := by
  intro p hp
  rw [List.mem_ofFn] at hp
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hp
  exact ⟨stepAt_increment_nonneg h i.isLt,
    cut_nonneg h i.castSucc, cut_le_one h i.castSucc⟩
theorem fieldRecursion_le_zero (h : FieldStep) : fieldRecursion h ≤ 0 := by
  set k := h.partition.levels with hk
  set W := stepAt h (k - 1) with hW
  have hWnonneg : 0 ≤ W := stepAt_nonneg h (k - 1)
  have hincr := increments_mem h
  have hsum : ((List.ofFn (fun i : Fin k =>
      (stepAt h i - (if i.val = 0 then 0 else stepAt h (i.val - 1)),
        h.partition.cut i.castSucc))).map Prod.fst).sum = W := by
    rw [hW]
    exact sum_increments_eq h
  have hVmeas : Measurable (fun x : ℝ => Real.log (Real.cosh x) - W / 2) := by fun_prop
  have hVlow : ∀ x, -(W / 2) ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh x) - W / 2 := by
    intro x
    have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ Real.cosh x := Real.one_le_cosh x
    have := Real.log_nonneg h1
    linarith
  have hVup : ∀ x, Real.log (Real.cosh x) - W / 2
      ≤ Real.log (Real.cosh x) + (-(W / 2)) := fun x => le_refl _
  have hcM : (-(W / 2)) + ((List.ofFn (fun i : Fin k =>
      (stepAt h i - (if i.val = 0 then 0 else stepAt h (i.val - 1)),
        h.partition.cut i.castSucc))).map Prod.fst).sum / 2 ≤ W / 2 := by
    rw [hsum]; linarith
  have hfold := fold_gaussianTransform_bounds
    (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin k =>
      (stepAt h i - (if i.val = 0 then 0 else stepAt h (i.val - 1)),
        h.partition.cut i.castSucc))) (W / 2) (-(W / 2)) hincr hcM hVmeas hVlow hVup
  have hmain : (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin k =>
      (stepAt h i - (if i.val = 0 then 0 else stepAt h (i.val - 1)),
        h.partition.cut i.castSucc))).foldr
        (fun sd U => gaussianTransform sd.1 sd.2 U)
        (fun x => Real.log (Real.cosh x) - W / 2) 0 ≤ 0 := by
    have h1 := hfold.1 0
    rw [hsum] at h1
    have hc : Real.log (Real.cosh (0:ℝ)) = 0 := by simp
    rw [hc] at h1
    linarith
  simpa [fieldRecursion, hk] using hmain
def zeroPath : OverlapPath where
  val := AEEqFun.const ℝ (0 : ℝ)
  admissible := ⟨fun _ => 0, (AEEqFun.coeFn_const (α := ℝ) (μ := pathMeasure) (β := ℝ) 0).symm, by
    intro a b ha hb hab; exact le_refl 0, by
    intro u hu; exact ⟨le_refl 0, zero_le_one⟩⟩
lemma stepFunction_measurable (h : FieldStep) : Measurable (stepFunction h) := by
  unfold stepFunction
  apply Finset.measurable_sum
  intro i hi
  apply Measurable.ite
  · exact (measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_id).inter
      (measurableSet_lt measurable_id measurable_const)
  · exact measurable_const
  · exact measurable_const
lemma zeroPath_integral (h : FieldStep) :
    ∫ u, stepFunction h u * zeroPath.val u ∂pathMeasure = 0 := by
  have hzero : (zeroPath.val : ℝ → ℝ) =ᵐ[pathMeasure] Function.const ℝ (0:ℝ) := by
    simpa [zeroPath] using
      (AEEqFun.coeFn_const (α := ℝ) (μ := pathMeasure) (β := ℝ) (0:ℝ))
  have : (fun u => stepFunction h u * zeroPath.val u) =ᵐ[pathMeasure] (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [hzero] with u hu
    simp [hu]
  rw [integral_congr_ae this]
  simp
lemma isingEntropy_zeroPath_le_zero : isingEntropy zeroPath ≤ 0 := by
  unfold isingEntropy
  refine iSup_le ?_
  intro h
  rw [zeroPath_integral h]
  have := fieldRecursion_le_zero h
  simpa using (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr this :
    ((fieldRecursion h : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ (0 : EReal))
lemma limUnder_bounds {u : ℕ → ℝ} {K : ℝ} (h : ∀ n, |u n| ≤ K) :
    min (-K) (Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty ℝ)) ≤ Filter.limUnder atTop u ∧
    Filter.limUnder atTop u ≤ max K (Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty ℝ)) := by
  by_cases hconv : ∃ x : ℝ, Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 x)
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hconv
    have hlim : Filter.limUnder atTop u = x := hx.limUnder_eq
    rw [hlim]
    constructor
    · apply le_trans (min_le_left _ _)
      exact ge_of_tendsto hx (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (abs_le.mp (h n)).1))
    · apply le_trans (le_of_tendsto hx (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (abs_le.mp (h n)).2)))
      exact le_max_left _ _
  · have hlim : Filter.limUnder atTop u
        = Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty ℝ) := limUnder_of_not_tendsto hconv
    rw [hlim]
    exact ⟨min_le_right _ _, le_max_right _ _⟩
lemma ereal_iInf_eq_coe_of_bounds {ι : Type*} (f : ι → EReal) (i0 : ι) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ i, (a : EReal) ≤ f i) (hb : f i0 ≤ (b : EReal)) :
    ∃ p : ℝ, (⨅ i, f i) = (p : EReal) := by
  have hle : (a : EReal) ≤ ⨅ i, f i := le_iInf ha
  have hge : (⨅ i, f i) ≤ (b : EReal) := (iInf_le f i0).trans hb
  have hne_bot : (⨅ i, f i) ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hle
    exact EReal.coe_ne_bot a (le_bot_iff.mp hle)
  have hne_top : (⨅ i, f i) ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hge
    exact absurd hge (not_le.mpr (EReal.coe_lt_top b))
  exact ⟨(⨅ i, f i).toReal, (EReal.coe_toReal hne_top hne_bot).symm⟩
theorem variationalValue_real_of_continuous {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (hbounded : ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x, |f x| ≤ K) :
    ∃ p : ℝ, variationalValue α f = (p : EReal) := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hbounded
  let c : ℝ := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty ℝ)
  have hlow : ∀ q : OverlapPath,
      ((α * min (-K) c : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ (α * patternFunctional f q : ℝ) + isingEntropy q := by
    intro q
    have hpt : ∀ n : ℕ, |uniformPattern f q n| ≤ K := uniformPattern_abs_le f K hf hK q
    have hb : min (-K) c ≤ patternFunctional f q := (limUnder_bounds hpt).1
    have hmul : α * min (-K) c ≤ α * patternFunctional f q :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hα
    have hcoe : ((α * min (-K) c : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ ((α * patternFunctional f q : ℝ) : EReal) :=
      EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr hmul
    calc ((α * min (-K) c : ℝ) : EReal)
        ≤ ((α * patternFunctional f q : ℝ) : EReal) := hcoe
      _ ≤ (α * patternFunctional f q : ℝ) + isingEntropy q :=
          le_add_of_nonneg_right (isingEntropy_nonneg q)
  have hup : ((α * patternFunctional f zeroPath : ℝ) : EReal) + isingEntropy zeroPath
      ≤ ((α * max K c : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    have hpt : ∀ n : ℕ, |uniformPattern f zeroPath n| ≤ K :=
      uniformPattern_abs_le f K hf hK zeroPath
    have hb : patternFunctional f zeroPath ≤ max K c := (limUnder_bounds hpt).2
    have hmul : α * patternFunctional f zeroPath ≤ α * max K c :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hα
    have hcoe : ((α * patternFunctional f zeroPath : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ ((α * max K c : ℝ) : EReal) :=
      EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr hmul
    calc ((α * patternFunctional f zeroPath : ℝ) : EReal) + isingEntropy zeroPath
        ≤ ((α * patternFunctional f zeroPath : ℝ) : EReal) + 0 :=
          add_le_add_right isingEntropy_zeroPath_le_zero _
      _ = ((α * patternFunctional f zeroPath : ℝ) : EReal) := add_zero _
      _ ≤ ((α * max K c : ℝ) : EReal) := hcoe
  have hmain := ereal_iInf_eq_coe_of_bounds
    (fun q : OverlapPath => (α * patternFunctional f q : ℝ) + isingEntropy q) zeroPath hlow hup
  simpa [variationalValue] using hmain
end IsingPerceptron

import Mathlib

/-!
# Cofinite subspaces and asymptotic moduli of a seminorm

For a real normed space `X`, a closed subspace of finite codimension is *cofinite*
(`IsCofinite F`). For a function `N : X → ℝ` (usually an equivalent seminorm), a point `x`, a
parameter `t` and a cofinite `F`, the inner infima are
`asympOneSidedInner N t x F = inf {N(x + t y) - 1 : y ∈ F, N y = 1}`,
`asympAveragedInner N t x F = inf {(N(x + t y) + N(x - t y))/2 - 1 : y ∈ F, 1 ≤ N y}` and its unit
version `asympAveragedUnitInner` (directions with `N y = 1`); taking `sup` over cofinite `F` gives
`asympOneSided`/`asympAveraged`, and `inf` over `N x = 1` gives the moduli
`asympOneSidedModulus`/`asympAveragedModulus`. Contents: `⊤`, finite intersections and kernels of
continuous functionals (more generally of continuous maps to finite-dimensional spaces) are
cofinite; in an infinite-dimensional space every cofinite subspace contains `N`-unit vectors when
`a‖·‖ ≤ N`; Hahn–Banach for a seminorm `N ≤ b‖·‖` (`exists_clm_eq_one_le`); the generic bounds
`max 0 (|t| - 2) ≤ one-sided ≤ |t|` and `max 0 (|t| - 1) ≤ averaged ≤ |t|` at every unit point and
for the moduli; the convexity step `N(x + c y) + N(x - c y) ≤ N(x + y) + N(x - y)` for `c ∈ [0, 1]`
and the identity `asympAveragedInner = asympAveragedUnitInner` for seminorms; antitonicity of the
inner infima in `F`.

Sources: W. B. Johnson, J. Lindenstrauss, D. Preiss and G. Schechtman, Almost Fréchet
differentiability of Lipschitz mappings between infinite-dimensional Banach spaces, Proc. London
Math. Soc. 84 (2002) 711–746, Section 2 (asymptotic moduli); V. D. Milman, Geometric theory of
Banach spaces II, Russian Math. Surveys 26 (1971) 79–163, Section 4.6; M. Fabian, P. Habala,
P. Hájek, V. Montesinos and V. Zizler, *Banach Space Theory*, Springer CMS Books, 2011, Theorem 2.1
(Hahn–Banach) and Section 2.3 (closed subspaces of finite codimension). Textbook material; nothing
here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: a set `{F | IsClosed (F : Set X) ∧ FiniteDimensional ℝ (X ⧸ F)}` is
`{F | IsCofinite F}` by `rfl`. Nested `sInf`/`sSup`/`sInf` definitions of the form
`sInf {r | ∃ x, N x = 1 ∧ r = sSup {a | ∃ F, IsCofinite F ∧ a = sInf {b | ∃ y, y ∈ F ∧ N y = 1 ∧
b = N (x + t • y) - 1}}}` are `asympOneSidedModulus N t` by `rfl` (also with `∃ F ∈ S`, with the
pair `∃ y ∈ F` and with `averagedIncrement` unfolded); the averaged versions with `1 ≤ N y` and
`/ 2` likewise. A supremum over `Set.range` of a function on the subtype of cofinite subspaces is
rewritten with `sSup_range_cofinite`. `((2 : ℕ) : ℝ)` is `2` by `Nat.cast_ofNat`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Analysis

open Set

noncomputable section

variable {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]

/-- A closed linear subspace of finite codimension. -/
def IsCofinite (F : Submodule ℝ X) : Prop :=
  IsClosed (F : Set X) ∧ FiniteDimensional ℝ (X ⧸ F)

namespace IsCofinite

theorem top : IsCofinite (⊤ : Submodule ℝ X) := ⟨isClosed_univ, inferInstance⟩

theorem inf {F G : Submodule ℝ X} (hF : IsCofinite F) (hG : IsCofinite G) : IsCofinite (F ⊓ G) := by
  refine ⟨by simpa using hF.1.inter hG.1, ?_⟩
  have := hF.2
  have := hG.2
  have hker : (F.mkQ.prod G.mkQ).ker = F ⊓ G := by
    rw [LinearMap.ker_prod, Submodule.ker_mkQ, Submodule.ker_mkQ]
  exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
    ((Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hker).symm.trans (F.mkQ.prod G.mkQ).quotKerEquivRange).symm

/-- The kernel of a continuous linear map to a finite-dimensional space is cofinite. -/
theorem ker {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (ℓ : X →L[ℝ] E) : IsCofinite (LinearMap.ker (ℓ : X →ₗ[ℝ] E)) :=
  ⟨ℓ.isClosed_ker, LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (ℓ : X →ₗ[ℝ] E).quotKerEquivRange.symm⟩

theorem ker_functional (ℓ : X →L[ℝ] ℝ) : IsCofinite (LinearMap.ker (ℓ : X →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) := ker ℓ

/-- In an infinite-dimensional space a cofinite subspace is nonzero. -/
theorem ne_bot (hX : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℝ X) {F : Submodule ℝ X} (hF : IsCofinite F) :
    F ≠ ⊥ := by
  rintro rfl
  have := hF.2
  exact hX (LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot ⊥ rfl))

/-- In an infinite-dimensional space a cofinite subspace contains `N`-unit vectors when
`a ‖·‖ ≤ N` with `0 < a`. -/
theorem exists_unit (hX : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℝ X) {F : Submodule ℝ X} (hF : IsCofinite F)
    (N : Seminorm ℝ X) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hN : ∀ x, a * ‖x‖ ≤ N x) :
    ∃ y ∈ F, N y = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨y, hyF, hy0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot (hF.ne_bot hX)
  have hNy : 0 < N y := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos ha (norm_pos_iff.mpr hy0)) (hN y)
  refine ⟨(N y)⁻¹ • y, F.smul_mem _ hyF, ?_⟩
  rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hNy, inv_mul_cancel₀ hNy.ne']

end IsCofinite

/-- Supremum over the subtype of cofinite subspaces, rewritten as a supremum over a set. -/
theorem sSup_range_cofinite (g : Submodule ℝ X → ℝ) :
    sSup (Set.range fun F : {F : Submodule ℝ X // IsClosed (F : Set X) ∧
      FiniteDimensional ℝ (X ⧸ F)} => g F.val) = sSup {a | ∃ F, IsCofinite F ∧ a = g F} := by
  congr 1
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨F, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨F.val, F.property, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨F, hF⟩, rfl⟩

/-- Hahn–Banach for a seminorm `N ≤ b ‖·‖`: a continuous functional `ℓ ≤ N` with `ℓ x = 1`. -/
theorem exists_clm_eq_one_le (N : Seminorm ℝ X) {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) {x : X}
    (hx : N x = 1) : ∃ ℓ : X →L[ℝ] ℝ, ℓ x = 1 ∧ ∀ z, ℓ z ≤ N z := by
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hx
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgN⟩ := exists_extension_of_le_sublinear
    (LinearPMap.mkSpanSingleton x (1 : ℝ) hx0) N
    (fun c hc z => by rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc])
    (fun z w => map_add_le_add N z w) (by
      rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hz
      rw [LinearPMap.mkSpanSingleton'_apply]
      simp only [RingHom.id_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, map_smul_eq_mul, hx, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact le_abs_self c)
  have hgx : g x = 1 := by
    have := hg ⟨x, Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self x⟩
    rw [this]
    exact LinearPMap.mkSpanSingleton_apply ℝ ℝ hx0 1
  have hbound : ∀ z, ‖g z‖ ≤ b * ‖z‖ := by
    intro z
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
    constructor
    · have := (hgN (-z)).trans (hNb (-z))
      rw [map_neg, norm_neg] at this
      linarith
    · exact (hgN z).trans (hNb z)
  exact ⟨g.mkContinuous b hbound, by simpa using hgx, fun z => by simpa using hgN z⟩

section Moduli

/-- `inf {N(x + t y) - 1 : y ∈ F, N y = 1}`. -/
def asympOneSidedInner (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) : ℝ :=
  sInf {b | ∃ y : X, y ∈ F ∧ N y = 1 ∧ b = N (x + t • y) - 1}

/-- `sup` of `asympOneSidedInner` over cofinite subspaces. -/
def asympOneSided (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : X) : ℝ :=
  sSup {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympOneSidedInner N t x F}

/-- The one-sided asymptotic modulus: `inf` of `asympOneSided` over `N x = 1`. -/
def asympOneSidedModulus (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sInf {r | ∃ x : X, N x = 1 ∧ r = asympOneSided N t x}

/-- `inf {(N(x + t y) + N(x - t y))/2 - 1 : y ∈ F, 1 ≤ N y}`. -/
def asympAveragedInner (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) : ℝ :=
  sInf {b | ∃ y : X, y ∈ F ∧ 1 ≤ N y ∧ b = (N (x + t • y) + N (x - t • y)) / 2 - 1}

/-- The same infimum over directions with `N y = 1`. -/
def asympAveragedUnitInner (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) : ℝ :=
  sInf {b | ∃ y : X, y ∈ F ∧ N y = 1 ∧ b = (N (x + t • y) + N (x - t • y)) / 2 - 1}

/-- `sup` of `asympAveragedInner` over cofinite subspaces. -/
def asympAveraged (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : X) : ℝ :=
  sSup {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympAveragedInner N t x F}

/-- The averaged asymptotic (midpoint) modulus. -/
def asympAveragedModulus (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sInf {r | ∃ x : X, N x = 1 ∧ r = asympAveraged N t x}

/-- An `sInf` of a set all of whose elements are `≤ c` with `0 ≤ c` is `≤ c`, whether or not the
set is empty. -/
theorem sInf_le_of_forall_mem_le {s : Set ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hs : BddBelow s) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∀ b ∈ s, b ≤ c) : sInf s ≤ c := by
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ⟨b, hb⟩
  · simpa using hc
  · exact (csInf_le hs hb).trans (h b hb)

variable (N : Seminorm ℝ X)

theorem bddBelow_asympOneSidedInner (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    BddBelow {b | ∃ y : X, y ∈ F ∧ N y = 1 ∧ b = N (x + t • y) - 1} :=
  ⟨-1, by rintro b ⟨y, -, -, rfl⟩; linarith [apply_nonneg N (x + t • y)]⟩

theorem asympOneSidedInner_le_abs {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    asympOneSidedInner N t x F ≤ |t| :=
  sInf_le_of_forall_mem_le (bddBelow_asympOneSidedInner N t x F) (abs_nonneg t) (by
    rintro b ⟨y, -, hy, rfl⟩
    have := map_add_le_add N x (t • y)
    rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hx, hy] at this
    linarith)

/-- On the kernel of a functional `ℓ ≤ N` with `ℓ x = 1` the inner infimum is nonnegative. -/
theorem asympOneSidedInner_ker_nonneg {x : X} {ℓ : X →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hℓx : ℓ x = 1) (hℓ : ∀ z, ℓ z ≤ N z)
    (t : ℝ) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    0 ≤ asympOneSidedInner N t x (F ⊓ LinearMap.ker (ℓ : X →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) := by
  refine Real.sInf_nonneg ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, hy, -, rfl⟩
  have hy0 : ℓ y = 0 := (Submodule.mem_inf.mp hy).2
  have := hℓ (x + t • y)
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, hℓx, hy0, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero] at this
  linarith

theorem bddAbove_asympOneSided {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    BddAbove {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympOneSidedInner (⇑N) t x F} :=
  ⟨|t|, by rintro a ⟨F, -, rfl⟩; exact asympOneSidedInner_le_abs N hx F⟩

theorem asympOneSidedInner_le {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) {F : Submodule ℝ X}
    (hF : IsCofinite F) : asympOneSidedInner N t x F ≤ asympOneSided N t x :=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_asympOneSided N hx) ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩

theorem asympOneSided_le_abs {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) : asympOneSided N t x ≤ |t| :=
  Real.sSup_le (by rintro a ⟨F, -, rfl⟩; exact asympOneSidedInner_le_abs N hx F) (abs_nonneg t)

/-- `0 ≤ D(x, t)` at an `N`-unit point when `N ≤ b ‖·‖` (Hahn–Banach). -/
theorem asympOneSided_nonneg {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    0 ≤ asympOneSided N t x := by
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓx, hℓ⟩ := exists_clm_eq_one_le N hNb hx
  have h := asympOneSidedInner_ker_nonneg N hℓx hℓ t ⊤
  rw [top_inf_eq] at h
  exact h.trans (asympOneSidedInner_le N hx (IsCofinite.ker_functional ℓ))

/-- `|t| - 2 ≤ inf` over all unit directions, by the triangle inequality. -/
theorem abs_sub_two_le_asympOneSidedInner_top {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    |t| - 2 ≤ asympOneSidedInner N t x ⊤ := by
  refine le_csInf ⟨_, x, Submodule.mem_top, hx, rfl⟩ ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, -, hy, rfl⟩
  have := map_sub_le_add N (x + t • y) x
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hy, hx] at this
  linarith

/-- Generic bounds `max 0 (|t| - 2) ≤ D(x, t) ≤ |t|` at an `N`-unit point. -/
theorem max_le_asympOneSided {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    max 0 (|t| - 2) ≤ asympOneSided N t x :=
  max_le (asympOneSided_nonneg N hNb hx)
    ((abs_sub_two_le_asympOneSidedInner_top N hx).trans (asympOneSidedInner_le N hx IsCofinite.top))

theorem asympOneSidedModulus_le_abs (t : ℝ) : asympOneSidedModulus N t ≤ |t| :=
  sInf_le_of_forall_mem_le ⟨|t| - 2, by
      rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact (abs_sub_two_le_asympOneSidedInner_top N hx).trans
        (asympOneSidedInner_le N hx IsCofinite.top)⟩
    (abs_nonneg t) (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact asympOneSided_le_abs N hx)

theorem asympOneSidedModulus_nonneg {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ asympOneSidedModulus N t :=
  Real.sInf_nonneg (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact asympOneSided_nonneg N hNb hx)

/-- Generic lower bound for the modulus, given one `N`-unit vector. -/
theorem max_le_asympOneSidedModulus {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) (hX : ∃ x, N x = 1)
    (t : ℝ) : max 0 (|t| - 2) ≤ asympOneSidedModulus N t := by
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hX
  exact le_csInf ⟨_, x₀, hx₀, rfl⟩ (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact max_le_asympOneSided N hNb hx)

/-- A larger subspace has a smaller inner infimum (when the smaller one has unit vectors). -/
theorem asympOneSidedInner_anti {t : ℝ} {x : X} {F G : Submodule ℝ X} (hFG : F ≤ G)
    (hF : ∃ y ∈ F, N y = 1) : asympOneSidedInner N t x G ≤ asympOneSidedInner N t x F := by
  obtain ⟨y, hyF, hy⟩ := hF
  exact csInf_le_csInf (bddBelow_asympOneSidedInner N t x G) ⟨_, y, hyF, hy, rfl⟩
    (by rintro b ⟨z, hz, hz1, rfl⟩; exact ⟨z, hFG hz, hz1, rfl⟩)

/-- Two sets of reals with `B ⊆ A`, every element of `A` above some element of `B` and `A`
bounded below have the same infimum (also when they are empty). -/
theorem sInf_eq_of_subset_of_forall_exists_le {A B : Set ℝ} (hA : BddBelow A) (hBA : B ⊆ A)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ A, ∃ b ∈ B, b ≤ a) : sInf A = sInf B := by
  rcases B.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hB
  · have : A = ∅ := by
      ext a
      simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      intro ha
      obtain ⟨b, hb, -⟩ := h a ha
      exact hb
    rw [this]
  · exact le_antisymm (csInf_le_csInf hA hB hBA)
      (le_csInf (hB.mono hBA) fun a ha => by
        obtain ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ := h a ha
        exact (csInf_le (hA.mono hBA) hb).trans hba)

/-- Convexity step: `N(x + c y) + N(x - c y) ≤ N(x + y) + N(x - y)` for `0 ≤ c ≤ 1`. -/
theorem add_smul_add_sub_smul_le {c : ℝ} (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1) (x y : X) :
    N (x + c • y) + N (x - c • y) ≤ N (x + y) + N (x - y) := by
  have e1 : x + c • y = ((1 + c) / 2) • (x + y) + ((1 - c) / 2) • (x - y) := by module
  have e2 : x - c • y = ((1 - c) / 2) • (x + y) + ((1 + c) / 2) • (x - y) := by module
  have h1 := map_add_le_add N (((1 + c) / 2) • (x + y)) (((1 - c) / 2) • (x - y))
  have h2 := map_add_le_add N (((1 - c) / 2) • (x + y)) (((1 + c) / 2) • (x - y))
  rw [← e1] at h1
  rw [← e2] at h2
  simp only [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + c) / 2),
    abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 - c) / 2)] at h1 h2
  linarith

theorem bddBelow_asympAveragedInner (P : X → Prop) (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    BddBelow {b | ∃ y : X, y ∈ F ∧ P y ∧ b = (N (x + t • y) + N (x - t • y)) / 2 - 1} :=
  ⟨-1, by
    rintro b ⟨y, -, -, rfl⟩
    linarith [apply_nonneg N (x + t • y), apply_nonneg N (x - t • y)]⟩

/-- For a seminorm, directions with `1 ≤ N y` and with `N y = 1` give the same averaged
infimum. -/
theorem asympAveragedInner_eq_unit (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    asympAveragedInner N t x F = asympAveragedUnitInner N t x F := by
  refine sInf_eq_of_subset_of_forall_exists_le (bddBelow_asympAveragedInner N _ t x F)
    (by rintro b ⟨y, hyF, hy, rfl⟩; exact ⟨y, hyF, hy.ge, rfl⟩) ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, hyF, hy, rfl⟩
  have hpos : 0 < N y := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hy
  refine ⟨_, ⟨(N y)⁻¹ • y, F.smul_mem _ hyF, ?_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hpos, inv_mul_cancel₀ hpos.ne']
  · have := add_smul_add_sub_smul_le N (inv_nonneg.mpr hpos.le) (inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hy) x
      (t • y)
    rw [smul_comm (N y)⁻¹ t y] at this
    linarith

theorem asympAveragedInner_le_abs {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    asympAveragedInner N t x F ≤ |t| := by
  rw [asympAveragedInner_eq_unit]
  refine sInf_le_of_forall_mem_le (bddBelow_asympAveragedInner N _ t x F) (abs_nonneg t) ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, -, hy, rfl⟩
  have h1 := map_add_le_add N x (t • y)
  have h2 := map_sub_le_add N x (t • y)
  rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hx, hy] at h1 h2
  linarith

theorem asympAveragedInner_ker_nonneg {x : X} {ℓ : X →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hℓx : ℓ x = 1)
    (hℓ : ∀ z, ℓ z ≤ N z) (t : ℝ) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    0 ≤ asympAveragedInner N t x (F ⊓ LinearMap.ker (ℓ : X →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) := by
  refine Real.sInf_nonneg ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, hy, -, rfl⟩
  have hy0 : ℓ y = 0 := (Submodule.mem_inf.mp hy).2
  have h1 := hℓ (x + t • y)
  have h2 := hℓ (x - t • y)
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_smul, hℓx, hy0, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero,
    sub_zero] at h1 h2
  linarith

/-- `|t| - 1 ≤ inf` over all directions, by the triangle inequality. -/
theorem abs_sub_one_le_asympAveragedInner_top {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    |t| - 1 ≤ asympAveragedInner N t x ⊤ := by
  refine le_csInf ⟨_, x, Submodule.mem_top, hx.ge, rfl⟩ ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, -, hy, rfl⟩
  have := map_sub_le_add N (x + t • y) (x - t • y)
  rw [show x + t • y - (x - t • y) = (2 * t) • y by module, map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_mul, abs_two] at this
  have hty : |t| ≤ |t| * N y := le_mul_of_one_le_right (abs_nonneg t) hy
  linarith

theorem bddAbove_asympAveraged {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    BddAbove {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympAveragedInner (⇑N) t x F} :=
  ⟨|t|, by rintro a ⟨F, -, rfl⟩; exact asympAveragedInner_le_abs N hx F⟩

theorem asympAveragedInner_le {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) {F : Submodule ℝ X}
    (hF : IsCofinite F) : asympAveragedInner N t x F ≤ asympAveraged N t x :=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_asympAveraged N hx) ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩

theorem asympAveraged_le_abs {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) : asympAveraged N t x ≤ |t| :=
  Real.sSup_le (by rintro a ⟨F, -, rfl⟩; exact asympAveragedInner_le_abs N hx F) (abs_nonneg t)

/-- `0 ≤ H(x, t)` at an `N`-unit point when `N ≤ b ‖·‖` (Hahn–Banach). -/
theorem asympAveraged_nonneg {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    0 ≤ asympAveraged N t x := by
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓx, hℓ⟩ := exists_clm_eq_one_le N hNb hx
  have h := asympAveragedInner_ker_nonneg N hℓx hℓ t ⊤
  rw [top_inf_eq] at h
  exact h.trans (asympAveragedInner_le N hx (IsCofinite.ker_functional ℓ))

/-- Generic bounds `max 0 (|t| - 1) ≤ H(x, t) ≤ |t|` at an `N`-unit point. -/
theorem max_le_asympAveraged {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    max 0 (|t| - 1) ≤ asympAveraged N t x :=
  max_le (asympAveraged_nonneg N hNb hx)
    ((abs_sub_one_le_asympAveragedInner_top N hx).trans (asympAveragedInner_le N hx IsCofinite.top))

theorem asympAveragedModulus_le_abs (t : ℝ) : asympAveragedModulus N t ≤ |t| :=
  sInf_le_of_forall_mem_le ⟨|t| - 1, by
      rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact (abs_sub_one_le_asympAveragedInner_top N hx).trans
        (asympAveragedInner_le N hx IsCofinite.top)⟩
    (abs_nonneg t) (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact asympAveraged_le_abs N hx)

theorem asympAveragedModulus_nonneg {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ asympAveragedModulus N t :=
  Real.sInf_nonneg (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact asympAveraged_nonneg N hNb hx)

theorem max_le_asympAveragedModulus {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) (hX : ∃ x, N x = 1)
    (t : ℝ) : max 0 (|t| - 1) ≤ asympAveragedModulus N t := by
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hX
  exact le_csInf ⟨_, x₀, hx₀, rfl⟩ (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact max_le_asympAveraged N hNb hx)

theorem asympAveragedInner_anti {t : ℝ} {x : X} {F G : Submodule ℝ X} (hFG : F ≤ G)
    (hF : ∃ y ∈ F, 1 ≤ N y) : asympAveragedInner N t x G ≤ asympAveragedInner N t x F := by
  obtain ⟨y, hyF, hy⟩ := hF
  exact csInf_le_csInf (bddBelow_asympAveragedInner N _ t x G) ⟨_, y, hyF, hy, rfl⟩
    (by rintro b ⟨z, hz, hz1, rfl⟩; exact ⟨z, hFG hz, hz1, rfl⟩)

/-- Unit-direction form of `asympAveraged`. -/
theorem asympAveraged_eq_unit (t : ℝ) (x : X) :
    asympAveraged N t x =
      sSup {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympAveragedUnitInner N t x F} := by
  simp only [asympAveraged, asympAveragedInner_eq_unit]

/-- Unit-direction form of the averaged modulus. -/
theorem asympAveragedModulus_eq_unit (t : ℝ) :
    asympAveragedModulus N t = sInf {r | ∃ x : X, N x = 1 ∧ r =
      sSup {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympAveragedUnitInner N t x F}} := by
  simp only [asympAveragedModulus, asympAveraged_eq_unit]

end Moduli

end

end TheoremOS.Analysis

import Mathlib

/-!
# The Daugavet property and the slice lemma

A real normed space `X` has the Daugavet property (`HasDaugavetProperty X`) when every rank-one
operator `T = ℓ.smulRight v` satisfies `‖Id + T‖ = 1 + ‖T‖`. The slice lemma of Kadets, Shvidkoy,
Sirotkin and Werner: in such a space, every nonempty slice `{y | ‖y‖ ≤ 1, α < ℓ y}` of the unit
ball contains, for every unit vector `w` and every `ρ > 0`, a unit vector `y` with
`‖w + y‖ ≥ 2 - ρ` (`HasDaugavetProperty.unitSlice`). Along the way: a vector `z` of the unit ball
with `‖z + ℓ z • w‖ > 2 - δ` and `ℓ z ≥ 0` normalises to a unit vector `u` with `ℓ u > 1 - δ` and
`‖u + w‖ > 2 - 3δ` (`exists_unit_of_norm_add_smul_gt`).

Sources: V. M. Kadets, R. V. Shvidkoy, G. G. Sirotkin and D. Werner, *Banach spaces with the
Daugavet property*, Trans. Amer. Math. Soc. 352 (2000) 855–873, §2 (the slice
characterisation, proved here in the direction used: Daugavet equation ⇒ slices); D. Werner,
*Recent progress on the Daugavet property*, Irish Math. Soc. Bull. 46 (2001).
Classical material; nothing here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: `StrongDual ℝ X` is `X →L[ℝ] ℝ`, and `ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell.smulRight v`
applied to `x` is `x + ell x • v` (`ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply`); a definition
`∀ (ell : X →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : X), ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell.smulRight v‖ =
1 + ‖ell.smulRight v‖` is `HasDaugavetProperty X` by `Iff.rfl`, and the slice condition
`∀ w, ‖w‖ = 1 → ∀ ell α, (∃ u, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 ∧ α < ell u) → ∀ ρ, 0 < ρ → ∃ y, ‖y‖ = 1 ∧ α < ell y ∧
2 - ρ ≤ ‖w + y‖` is `HasUnitSliceProperty X`. `‖ell.smulRight v‖ = ‖ell‖ * ‖v‖` is Mathlib's
`ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Analysis

noncomputable section

variable (X : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]

/-- The Daugavet equation `‖Id + T‖ = 1 + ‖T‖` for every rank-one operator `T`. -/
def HasDaugavetProperty : Prop :=
  ∀ (ell : X →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : X),
    ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell.smulRight v‖ = 1 + ‖ell.smulRight v‖

/-- Every nonempty slice of the unit ball contains unit vectors almost antipodal to `-w`. -/
def HasUnitSliceProperty : Prop :=
  ∀ w : X, ‖w‖ = 1 → ∀ (ell : X →L[ℝ] ℝ) (α : ℝ), (∃ u : X, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 ∧ α < ell u) →
    ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∃ y : X, ‖y‖ = 1 ∧ α < ell y ∧ 2 - ρ ≤ ‖w + y‖

variable {X}

/-- Normalisation step of the slice lemma. -/
theorem exists_unit_of_norm_add_smul_gt {ell : X →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hell : ‖ell‖ = 1) {w z : X}
    (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1) (hz0 : 0 ≤ ell z) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : δ < 1)
    (h : 2 - δ < ‖z + ell z • w‖) :
    ∃ u : X, ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ 1 - δ < ell u ∧ 2 - 3 * δ < ‖u + w‖ := by
  have hle : ell z ≤ ‖z‖ := by
    have := ell.le_opNorm z
    rw [hell, one_mul] at this
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this)
  have htri : ‖z + ell z • w‖ ≤ ‖z‖ + ell z := by
    refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [norm_smul, hw, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hz0]
  have hlz : 1 - δ < ell z := by linarith
  have hnz : 1 - δ < ‖z‖ := by linarith
  have hzw : 2 - 2 * δ < ‖z + w‖ := by
    have e : z + ell z • w = (z + w) - (1 - ell z) • w := by
      rw [sub_smul, one_smul]; abel
    have : ‖z + ell z • w‖ ≤ ‖z + w‖ + (1 - ell z) := by
      rw [e]
      refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [norm_smul, hw, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    linarith
  have hzpos : 0 < ‖z‖ := by linarith
  refine ⟨‖z‖⁻¹ • z, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hzpos.ne']
  · rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have : 1 ≤ ‖z‖⁻¹ := (one_le_inv₀ hzpos).mpr hz
    nlinarith
  · have hd : ‖‖z‖⁻¹ • z - z‖ = 1 - ‖z‖ := by
      rw [show ‖z‖⁻¹ • z - z = (‖z‖⁻¹ - 1) • z by rw [sub_smul, one_smul], norm_smul,
        Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ((one_le_inv₀ hzpos).mpr hz)), sub_mul,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ hzpos.ne', one_mul]
    have : ‖z + w‖ ≤ ‖‖z‖⁻¹ • z + w‖ + ‖‖z‖⁻¹ • z - z‖ := by
      calc ‖z + w‖ = ‖(‖z‖⁻¹ • z + w) - (‖z‖⁻¹ • z - z)‖ := by congr 1; abel
        _ ≤ _ := norm_sub_le _ _
    linarith

/-- **Slice lemma** (Kadets–Shvidkoy–Sirotkin–Werner). -/
theorem HasDaugavetProperty.unitSlice (hX : HasDaugavetProperty X) : HasUnitSliceProperty X := by
  intro w hw ell α hslice ρ hρ
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀, hαu₀⟩ := hslice
  by_cases hell : ell = 0
  · subst hell
    refine ⟨w, hw, by simpa using hαu₀, ?_⟩
    rw [← two_smul ℝ w, norm_smul, hw]
    norm_num
    linarith
  have hn : 0 < ‖ell‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hell
  set ell' : X →L[ℝ] ℝ := ‖ell‖⁻¹ • ell with hell'
  have hn' : ‖ell'‖ = 1 := by
    rw [hell', norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn.ne']
  have hα : α / ‖ell‖ < 1 := by
    rw [div_lt_one hn]
    calc α < ell u₀ := hαu₀
      _ ≤ ‖ell u₀‖ := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ ‖ell‖ * ‖u₀‖ := ell.le_opNorm u₀
      _ ≤ ‖ell‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg u₀]
  set δ := min (min (ρ / 3) (1 - α / ‖ell‖)) (1 / 2) with hδ
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := lt_min (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)) (by norm_num)
  have hδ1 : δ < 1 := (min_le_right _ _).trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hδρ : δ ≤ ρ / 3 := (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδα : δ ≤ 1 - α / ‖ell‖ := (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hnorm : ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell'.smulRight w‖ = 2 := by
    rw [hX, ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply, hn', hw]; norm_num
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzgt⟩ := (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell'.smulRight w).exists_lt_apply_of_lt_opNorm
    (r := 2 - δ) (by rw [hnorm]; linarith)
  have happ : ∀ x : X, (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell'.smulRight w) x = x + ell' x • w :=
    fun _ => rfl
  rw [happ] at hzgt
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hz'0, hz'gt⟩ : ∃ z' : X, ‖z'‖ ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ ell' z' ∧ 2 - δ < ‖z' + ell' z' • w‖ := by
    rcases le_total 0 (ell' z) with h0 | h0
    · exact ⟨z, hz.le, h0, hzgt⟩
    · refine ⟨-z, by rw [norm_neg]; exact hz.le, by rw [map_neg]; linarith, ?_⟩
      rw [map_neg, neg_smul, ← neg_add, norm_neg]
      exact hzgt
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hlu, hwu⟩ := exists_unit_of_norm_add_smul_gt hn' hw hz' hz'0 hδ1 hz'gt
  refine ⟨u, hu, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 : α / ‖ell‖ < ell' u := lt_of_le_of_lt (by linarith) hlu
    have e : ell' u = ‖ell‖⁻¹ * ell u := rfl
    rw [e, div_eq_inv_mul] at h1
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h1 (inv_nonneg.mpr hn.le)
  · rw [add_comm]
    linarith

end

end TheoremOS.Analysis

sources.code:
import Mathlib

/-!
# Distortion of finite metric embeddings and Poincaré inequalities

For a finite set `X` with a distance function `ρ : X → X → ℝ` and a map `f` into a pseudometric
space, `maxExpansion ρ f = sup_{x ≠ y} d(fx, fy) / ρ(x, y)`, `maxContraction ρ f =
sup_{x ≠ y} ρ(x, y) / d(fx, fy)` and `embeddingDistortion ρ f` is their product. Contents: bounded
suprema and the pointwise bounds `d ≤ s ρ`, `ρ ≤ r d`; upper bounds from Lipschitz bounds; lower
bounds from two test pairs and `1 ≤ distortion`; the Poincaré method
(`sum_mul_pow_le_embeddingDistortion_pow`): if `∑ a(x,y) d(fx,fy)^q ≤ K ∑ b(x,y) d(fx,fy)^q`
holds for the map `f`, then `∑ a ρ^q ≤ K D^q ∑ b ρ^q` with `D` its distortion; transfer of a
scalar inequality `∑ a |gx - gy| ≤ K ∑ b |gx - gy|` (all `g : X → ℝ`) to maps into `ℓ¹`
(`lp (fun _ : ℕ => ℝ) 1`) and into `PiLp 1`, and of the squared form to `EuclideanSpace` and `ℓ²`;
injective maps of a countable set into `ℓᵖ`; `finToLpOne`, the isometric copy of
`(Fin m → ℝ, ∑ |·|)` inside `ℓ¹`.

Sources: J. Matoušek, *Lectures on Discrete Geometry*, Springer GTM 212, 2002, Chapter 15
(15.1 distortion, 15.4 Poincaré inequalities and lower bounds, 15.5 ℓ₁ via cut metrics);
N. Linial, E. London and Y. Rabinovich, The geometry of graphs and some of its algorithmic
applications, Combinatorica 15 (1995) 215–245, Section 3; P. Enflo, On the nonexistence of uniform
homeomorphisms between Lp-spaces, Ark. Mat. 8 (1969) 103–105. Textbook material; nothing here is
specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: a distortion written as
`sSup {r | ∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ r = ‖f x - f y‖ / ρ x y} * sSup {r | ∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ r = ρ x y / ‖f x - f y‖}`
is `embeddingDistortion ρ f` by `embeddingDistortion_eq_norm`; on a subtype of words with
`ρ x y = (ed x.val y.val : ℝ)` it is the same statement with that `ρ`. A least distortion
`sInf {D | ∃ f, Injective f ∧ D = embeddingDistortion ρ f}` is bounded below with `le_csInf`,
nonemptiness coming from `exists_injective_lp`. A map `F : X → Fin m → ℝ` with bounds on
`∑ i, |F x i - F y i|` gives `fun x => finToLpOne (F x)` with `norm_finToLpOne_sub`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Analysis

open Finset

noncomputable section

variable {X : Type*} {Y : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace Y]

/-- The largest ratio `d(fx, fy) / ρ(x, y)` over distinct pairs. -/
def maxExpansion (ρ : X → X → ℝ) (f : X → Y) : ℝ :=
  sSup {r | ∃ x y : X, x ≠ y ∧ r = dist (f x) (f y) / ρ x y}

/-- The largest ratio `ρ(x, y) / d(fx, fy)` over distinct pairs. -/
def maxContraction (ρ : X → X → ℝ) (f : X → Y) : ℝ :=
  sSup {r | ∃ x y : X, x ≠ y ∧ r = ρ x y / dist (f x) (f y)}

/-- Distortion: the product of the largest expansion and the largest contraction. -/
def embeddingDistortion (ρ : X → X → ℝ) (f : X → Y) : ℝ :=
  maxExpansion ρ f * maxContraction ρ f

theorem embeddingDistortion_eq_norm {E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (ρ : X → X → ℝ)
    (f : X → E) :
    embeddingDistortion ρ f =
      sSup {r | ∃ x y : X, x ≠ y ∧ r = ‖f x - f y‖ / ρ x y} *
        sSup {r | ∃ x y : X, x ≠ y ∧ r = ρ x y / ‖f x - f y‖} := by
  simp only [embeddingDistortion, maxExpansion, maxContraction, dist_eq_norm]

section Bounds

variable [Finite X] (ρ : X → X → ℝ) (f : X → Y)

theorem bddAbove_expansion :
    BddAbove {r | ∃ x y : X, x ≠ y ∧ r = dist (f x) (f y) / ρ x y} :=
  (Set.finite_range fun p : X × X => dist (f p.1) (f p.2) / ρ p.1 p.2).bddAbove.mono
    (by rintro r ⟨x, y, -, rfl⟩; exact ⟨(x, y), rfl⟩)

theorem bddAbove_contraction :
    BddAbove {r | ∃ x y : X, x ≠ y ∧ r = ρ x y / dist (f x) (f y)} :=
  (Set.finite_range fun p : X × X => ρ p.1 p.2 / dist (f p.1) (f p.2)).bddAbove.mono
    (by rintro r ⟨x, y, -, rfl⟩; exact ⟨(x, y), rfl⟩)

variable {ρ f}

theorem div_le_maxExpansion {x y : X} (h : x ≠ y) :
    dist (f x) (f y) / ρ x y ≤ maxExpansion ρ f :=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_expansion ρ f) ⟨x, y, h, rfl⟩

theorem div_le_maxContraction {x y : X} (h : x ≠ y) :
    ρ x y / dist (f x) (f y) ≤ maxContraction ρ f :=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_contraction ρ f) ⟨x, y, h, rfl⟩

/-- `d(fx, fy) ≤ s ρ(x, y)` with `s` the largest expansion. -/
theorem dist_le_maxExpansion_mul {x y : X} (h : x ≠ y) (hρ : 0 < ρ x y) :
    dist (f x) (f y) ≤ maxExpansion ρ f * ρ x y :=
  (div_le_iff₀ hρ).mp (div_le_maxExpansion h)

/-- `ρ(x, y) ≤ r d(fx, fy)` with `r` the largest contraction. -/
theorem le_maxContraction_mul_dist {x y : X} (h : x ≠ y) (hd : 0 < dist (f x) (f y)) :
    ρ x y ≤ maxContraction ρ f * dist (f x) (f y) :=
  (div_le_iff₀ hd).mp (div_le_maxContraction h)

end Bounds

variable {ρ : X → X → ℝ} {f : X → Y}

theorem maxExpansion_nonneg (hρ : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → 0 ≤ ρ x y) : 0 ≤ maxExpansion ρ f :=
  Real.sSup_nonneg (by rintro r ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩; exact div_nonneg dist_nonneg (hρ x y hxy))

theorem maxContraction_nonneg (hρ : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → 0 ≤ ρ x y) : 0 ≤ maxContraction ρ f :=
  Real.sSup_nonneg (by rintro r ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩; exact div_nonneg (hρ x y hxy) dist_nonneg)

theorem embeddingDistortion_nonneg (hρ : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → 0 ≤ ρ x y) :
    0 ≤ embeddingDistortion ρ f :=
  mul_nonneg (maxExpansion_nonneg hρ) (maxContraction_nonneg hρ)

/-- Lipschitz upper bound `d(fx, fy) ≤ s ρ(x, y)` gives `maxExpansion ≤ s`. -/
theorem maxExpansion_le {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hρ : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → 0 < ρ x y)
    (h : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → dist (f x) (f y) ≤ s * ρ x y) : maxExpansion ρ f ≤ s :=
  Real.sSup_le (by rintro r ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩; exact div_le_of_le_mul₀ (hρ x y hxy).le hs (h x y hxy))
    hs

/-- Co-Lipschitz bound `ρ(x, y) ≤ r d(fx, fy)` gives `maxContraction ≤ r`. -/
theorem maxContraction_le {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (h : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → ρ x y ≤ r * dist (f x) (f y)) : maxContraction ρ f ≤ r :=
  Real.sSup_le (by rintro c ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩; exact div_le_of_le_mul₀ dist_nonneg hr (h x y hxy)) hr

theorem embeddingDistortion_le {s r : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hρ : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → 0 < ρ x y)
    (hup : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → dist (f x) (f y) ≤ s * ρ x y)
    (hlow : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → ρ x y ≤ r * dist (f x) (f y)) :
    embeddingDistortion ρ f ≤ s * r :=
  mul_le_mul (maxExpansion_le hs hρ hup) (maxContraction_le hr hlow)
    (maxContraction_nonneg fun x y h => (hρ x y h).le) hs

/-- Two test pairs: the expansion of one pair times the contraction of another. -/
theorem div_mul_div_le_embeddingDistortion [Finite X] (hρ : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → 0 ≤ ρ x y)
    {x y x' y' : X} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hxy' : x' ≠ y') :
    dist (f x) (f y) / ρ x y * (ρ x' y' / dist (f x') (f y')) ≤ embeddingDistortion ρ f :=
  mul_le_mul (div_le_maxExpansion hxy) (div_le_maxContraction hxy')
    (div_nonneg (hρ x' y' hxy') dist_nonneg) (maxExpansion_nonneg hρ)

/-- A finite set with two points and an injective map has distortion at least `1`. -/
theorem one_le_embeddingDistortion [Finite X] (hρ : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → 0 < ρ x y)
    (hf : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → 0 < dist (f x) (f y)) {x y : X} (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    1 ≤ embeddingDistortion ρ f := by
  have h := div_mul_div_le_embeddingDistortion (f := f) (fun a b h => (hρ a b h).le) hxy hxy
  have h1 : dist (f x) (f y) / ρ x y * (ρ x y / dist (f x) (f y)) = 1 := by
    field_simp [(hρ x y hxy).ne', (hf x y hxy).ne']
  linarith

/-- The Poincaré method. If the map satisfies `∑ a d^q ≤ K ∑ b d^q` (`d = d(fx, fy)`), then the
same inequality holds for `ρ` with the loss `D^q`, `D` the distortion. -/
theorem sum_mul_pow_le_embeddingDistortion_pow [Fintype X] (q : ℕ) {a b : X → X → ℝ} {K : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ a x y) (hb : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ b x y) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hρ0 : ∀ x, ρ x x = 0) (hρ : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → 0 < ρ x y)
    (hf : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → 0 < dist (f x) (f y))
    (hP : ∑ x, ∑ y, a x y * dist (f x) (f y) ^ q ≤ K * ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * dist (f x) (f y) ^ q) :
    ∑ x, ∑ y, a x y * ρ x y ^ q ≤
      K * embeddingDistortion ρ f ^ q * ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * ρ x y ^ q := by
  have hρnn : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → 0 ≤ ρ x y := fun x y h => (hρ x y h).le
  have hs := maxExpansion_nonneg (f := f) hρnn
  have hr := maxContraction_nonneg (f := f) hρnn
  have h1 : ∀ x y, a x y * ρ x y ^ q ≤
      maxContraction ρ f ^ q * (a x y * dist (f x) (f y) ^ q) := by
    intro x y
    by_cases hxy : x = y
    · subst hxy
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos q with rfl | hq
      · simp
      · simp [hρ0, zero_pow hq.ne']
    · have := le_maxContraction_mul_dist (ρ := ρ) (f := f) hxy (hf x y hxy)
      calc a x y * ρ x y ^ q ≤ a x y * (maxContraction ρ f * dist (f x) (f y)) ^ q :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (hρ x y hxy).le this q) (ha x y)
        _ = _ := by ring
  have h2 : ∀ x y, b x y * dist (f x) (f y) ^ q ≤
      maxExpansion ρ f ^ q * (b x y * ρ x y ^ q) := by
    intro x y
    by_cases hxy : x = y
    · subst hxy
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos q with rfl | hq
      · simp
      · simp [hρ0, zero_pow hq.ne']
    · have := dist_le_maxExpansion_mul (ρ := ρ) (f := f) hxy (hρ x y hxy)
      calc b x y * dist (f x) (f y) ^ q ≤ b x y * (maxExpansion ρ f * ρ x y) ^ q :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ dist_nonneg this q) (hb x y)
        _ = _ := by ring
  have hA : ∑ x, ∑ y, a x y * ρ x y ^ q ≤
      maxContraction ρ f ^ q * ∑ x, ∑ y, a x y * dist (f x) (f y) ^ q := by
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun y _ => h1 x y
  have hB : ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * dist (f x) (f y) ^ q ≤
      maxExpansion ρ f ^ q * ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * ρ x y ^ q := by
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun y _ => h2 x y
  calc ∑ x, ∑ y, a x y * ρ x y ^ q
      ≤ maxContraction ρ f ^ q * ∑ x, ∑ y, a x y * dist (f x) (f y) ^ q := hA
    _ ≤ maxContraction ρ f ^ q * (K * ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * dist (f x) (f y) ^ q) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP (pow_nonneg hr q)
    _ ≤ maxContraction ρ f ^ q * (K * (maxExpansion ρ f ^ q * ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * ρ x y ^ q)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB hK) (pow_nonneg hr q)
    _ = K * embeddingDistortion ρ f ^ q * ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * ρ x y ^ q := by
        rw [embeddingDistortion, mul_pow]
        ring

section Transfer

variable [Fintype X]

/-- Summing a coordinatewise inequality over a summable family of coordinates. -/
theorem sum_sum_tsum_le {a b : X → X → ℝ} {K : ℝ} (u : X → X → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ x y, Summable (u x y))
    (h : ∀ i, ∑ x, ∑ y, a x y * u x y i ≤ K * ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * u x y i) :
    ∑ x, ∑ y, a x y * ∑' i, u x y i ≤ K * ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * ∑' i, u x y i := by
  have key : ∀ c : X → X → ℝ,
      ∑ x, ∑ y, c x y * ∑' i, u x y i = ∑' i, ∑ x, ∑ y, c x y * u x y i := by
    intro c
    rw [Summable.tsum_finsetSum fun x _ => summable_sum fun y _ => (hu x y).mul_left _]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
    rw [Summable.tsum_finsetSum fun y _ => (hu x y).mul_left _]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => ((hu x y).tsum_mul_left _).symm
  rw [key a, key b, ← ((summable_sum fun x _ => summable_sum fun y _ =>
    (hu x y).mul_left (b x y)).tsum_mul_left K)]
  exact Summable.tsum_le_tsum h (summable_sum fun x _ => summable_sum fun y _ =>
    (hu x y).mul_left _) ((summable_sum fun x _ => summable_sum fun y _ =>
    (hu x y).mul_left _).mul_left K)

theorem norm_lpOne_eq_tsum (v : lp (fun _ : ℕ => ℝ) 1) : ‖v‖ = ∑' i, |v i| := by
  have := lp.norm_eq_tsum_rpow (p := 1) (by simp) v
  simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this

theorem summable_abs_lpOne (v : lp (fun _ : ℕ => ℝ) 1) : Summable fun i => |v i| := by
  have := (lp.memℓp v).summable (p := 1) (by simp)
  simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this

/-- ℓ¹ transfer: a Poincaré inequality for real functions holds for `ℓ¹`-valued maps. -/
theorem poincare_lpOne {a b : X → X → ℝ} {K : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ g : X → ℝ, ∑ x, ∑ y, a x y * |g x - g y| ≤ K * ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * |g x - g y|)
    (F : X → lp (fun _ : ℕ => ℝ) 1) :
    ∑ x, ∑ y, a x y * ‖F x - F y‖ ≤ K * ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * ‖F x - F y‖ := by
  simp only [norm_lpOne_eq_tsum, lp.coeFn_sub, Pi.sub_apply]
  exact sum_sum_tsum_le (fun x y i => |F x i - F y i|)
    (fun x y => by simpa [lp.coeFn_sub] using summable_abs_lpOne (F x - F y))
    fun i => h fun x => F x i

/-- Finite-dimensional ℓ¹ transfer. -/
theorem poincare_piLpOne {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {a b : X → X → ℝ} {K : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ g : X → ℝ, ∑ x, ∑ y, a x y * |g x - g y| ≤ K * ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * |g x - g y|)
    (F : X → PiLp 1 (fun _ : ι => ℝ)) :
    ∑ x, ∑ y, a x y * ‖F x - F y‖ ≤ K * ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * ‖F x - F y‖ := by
  have key : ∀ c : X → X → ℝ, ∑ x, ∑ y, c x y * ‖F x - F y‖ =
      ∑ i, ∑ x, ∑ y, c x y * |(F x).ofLp i - (F y).ofLp i| := by
    intro c
    simp only [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L1, PiLp.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => Finset.sum_comm).trans Finset.sum_comm
  rw [key a, key b, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => h fun x => (F x).ofLp i

/-- Euclidean transfer of a squared Poincaré inequality (Enflo type). -/
theorem poincare_euclidean_sq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {a b : X → X → ℝ} {K : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ g : X → ℝ, ∑ x, ∑ y, a x y * (g x - g y) ^ 2 ≤ K * ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * (g x - g y) ^ 2)
    (F : X → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ∑ x, ∑ y, a x y * ‖F x - F y‖ ^ 2 ≤ K * ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * ‖F x - F y‖ ^ 2 := by
  have key : ∀ c : X → X → ℝ, ∑ x, ∑ y, c x y * ‖F x - F y‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ i, ∑ x, ∑ y, c x y * ((F x).ofLp i - (F y).ofLp i) ^ 2 := by
    intro c
    simp only [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, PiLp.sub_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => Finset.sum_comm).trans Finset.sum_comm
  rw [key a, key b, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => h fun x => (F x).ofLp i

theorem norm_sq_lpTwo_eq_tsum (v : lp (fun _ : ℕ => ℝ) 2) : ‖v‖ ^ 2 = ∑' i, v i ^ 2 := by
  have := lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum (p := 2) (by simp) v
  simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using this

theorem summable_sq_lpTwo (v : lp (fun _ : ℕ => ℝ) 2) : Summable fun i => v i ^ 2 := by
  have := (lp.memℓp v).summable (p := 2) (by simp)
  simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using this

/-- ℓ² transfer of a squared Poincaré inequality. -/
theorem poincare_lpTwo_sq {a b : X → X → ℝ} {K : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ g : X → ℝ, ∑ x, ∑ y, a x y * (g x - g y) ^ 2 ≤ K * ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * (g x - g y) ^ 2)
    (F : X → lp (fun _ : ℕ => ℝ) 2) :
    ∑ x, ∑ y, a x y * ‖F x - F y‖ ^ 2 ≤ K * ∑ x, ∑ y, b x y * ‖F x - F y‖ ^ 2 := by
  simp only [norm_sq_lpTwo_eq_tsum, lp.coeFn_sub, Pi.sub_apply]
  exact sum_sum_tsum_le (fun x y i => (F x i - F y i) ^ 2)
    (fun x y => by simpa [lp.coeFn_sub] using summable_sq_lpTwo (F x - F y))
    fun i => h fun x => F x i

end Transfer

/-- A countable set has injective maps into every `ℓᵖ`, so least distortions are infima over
nonempty sets. -/
theorem exists_injective_lp (X : Type*) [Countable X] (p : ENNReal) :
    ∃ F : X → lp (fun _ : ℕ => ℝ) p, Function.Injective F := by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Countable.exists_injective_nat X
  refine ⟨fun x => lp.single p (e x) (1 : ℝ), fun x y hxy => he ?_⟩
  have := congrArg (fun v : lp (fun _ : ℕ => ℝ) p => v (e x)) hxy
  by_contra hne
  simp [lp.single_apply, Ne.symm hne] at this

/-- The finite vector `v`, padded with zeros, as an element of `ℓ¹`. -/
def finToLpOne {m : ℕ} (v : Fin m → ℝ) : lp (fun _ : ℕ => ℝ) 1 :=
  ⟨fun i => if h : i < m then v ⟨i, h⟩ else 0, by
    refine Memℓp.of_exponent_ge (memℓp_zero ((Set.finite_lt_nat m).subset ?_)) bot_le
    intro i hi
    by_contra h
    have h' : ¬ i < m := h
    exact hi (by simp [h'])⟩

@[simp] theorem finToLpOne_apply {m : ℕ} (v : Fin m → ℝ) (i : ℕ) :
    finToLpOne v i = if h : i < m then v ⟨i, h⟩ else 0 := rfl

/-- `‖finToLpOne v - finToLpOne w‖ = ∑ i, |v i - w i|`. -/
theorem norm_finToLpOne_sub {m : ℕ} (v w : Fin m → ℝ) :
    ‖finToLpOne v - finToLpOne w‖ = ∑ i, |v i - w i| := by
  rw [norm_lpOne_eq_tsum, tsum_eq_sum (s := Finset.range m)]
  · rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    simp
  · intro i hi
    have : ¬ i < m := by simpa using hi
    simp [this]

theorem finToLpOne_injective {m : ℕ} : Function.Injective (finToLpOne (m := m)) := by
  intro v w h
  funext i
  have := congrArg (fun u : lp (fun _ : ℕ => ℝ) 1 => u i.val) h
  simpa using this

end

end TheoremOS.Analysis
