          exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
            (inv43_two_thirds_pointwise_bound_near_one (by rw [hU] at hz; exact hz.1)
              (hmemB z |>.mp (by rw [hU] at hz; exact hz.2)))
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ z in disk, ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) ∂volume := by
          refine lintegral_mono_set ?_
          rw [hU]
          exact Set.inter_subset_left
  have htop : ∫⁻ z in disk,
      ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) ∂volume = ⊤ := by
    have hle : ⊤ ≤ ∫⁻ z in disk,
        ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) ∂volume := by
      rw [← hUtop]
      exact hdom
    exact top_le_iff.mp hle
  exact htop
lemma inv43_det_real_complex_smul_one (c : ℂ) :
    ((c • (1 : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ)) : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ).det = Complex.normSq c := by
  rw [← Complex.restrictScalars_toSpanSingleton c]
  simp [ContinuousLinearMap.det, LinearMap.det_restrictScalars, Algebra.norm_complex_apply,
    Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
lemma inv43_abs_det_fderiv_koebeMap {z : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ 1) :
    |(fderiv ℝ koebeMap z).det| = ‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hd := (schlicht_hasDerivAt_koebeMap hz).complexToReal_fderiv
  rw [hd.fderiv]
  rw [inv43_det_real_complex_smul_one]
  rw [← (schlicht_hasDerivAt_koebeMap hz).deriv]
  rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
lemma inv43_koebeInverse_koebeMap {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ disk) :
    koebeInverse (koebeMap z) = z := by
  exact koebe_schlicht.1.2.leftInvOn_invFunOn.eq hz
lemma deriv_inv43_koebeInverse_koebeMap {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ disk) :
    deriv koebeInverse (koebeMap z) = (1 - z) ^ 3 / (1 + z) := by
  have hki := inv43_koebeInverse_koebeMap hz
  have hmem : koebeMap z ∈ koebeDomain := ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  rw [deriv_koebeInverse (koebeMap z) hmem, hki]
lemma norm_deriv_inv43_koebeInverse_koebeMap {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ disk) :
    ‖deriv koebeInverse (koebeMap z)‖ ^ (4 / 3 : ℝ) =
      ‖1 - z‖ ^ 4 / ‖1 + z‖ ^ (4 / 3 : ℝ) := by
  rw [deriv_inv43_koebeInverse_koebeMap hz]
  rw [norm_div, norm_pow]
  rw [Real.div_rpow (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖1 - z‖ ^ 3)
    (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖1 + z‖) (4 / 3 : ℝ)]
  rw [show (‖1 - z‖ ^ 3) ^ (4 / 3 : ℝ) = ‖1 - z‖ ^ 4 by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖1 - z‖)]
    norm_num]
lemma inv43_real_jacobian_weight {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ disk) :
    ‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ 2 *
        (‖1 - z‖ ^ 4 / ‖1 + z‖ ^ (4 / 3 : ℝ)) =
      ‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) := by
  have hznorm : ‖z‖ < 1 := by
    simpa [disk, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hz
  have hz1 : z ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    subst z
    norm_num at hznorm
  have hB : ‖1 - z‖ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [norm_ne_zero_iff]
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr hz1.symm
  rw [schlicht_deriv_norm hz1]
  by_cases hA : ‖1 + z‖ = 0
  · simp [hA, Real.zero_rpow]
  · have hApos : 0 < ‖1 + z‖ := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hA)
    rw [Real.div_rpow (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖1 + z‖)
      (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖1 - z‖ ^ 3) (2 / 3 : ℝ)]
    have hBexp : (‖1 - z‖ ^ 3) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) = ‖1 - z‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul (norm_nonneg _)]
      norm_num
    rw [hBexp]
    have hAexp : ‖1 + z‖ ^ 2 = ‖1 + z‖ ^ (4 / 3 : ℝ) * ‖1 + z‖ ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hApos]
      norm_num
    rw [div_pow, hAexp]
    field_simp [hA, hB]
lemma inv43_jacobian_weight_mul {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ disk) :
    ENNReal.ofReal |(fderiv ℝ koebeMap z).det| *
        ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeInverse (koebeMap z)‖ ^ (4 / 3 : ℝ)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) := by
  have hznorm : ‖z‖ < 1 := by
    simpa [disk, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hz
  have hz1 : z ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    subst z
    norm_num at hznorm
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (abs_nonneg (fderiv ℝ koebeMap z).det)]
  rw [inv43_abs_det_fderiv_koebeMap hz1]
  rw [norm_deriv_inv43_koebeInverse_koebeMap hz]
  exact congrArg ENNReal.ofReal (inv43_real_jacobian_weight hz)
theorem inv_deriv_four_thirds_not_integrable :
    ¬ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun z => ‖deriv koebeInverse z‖ ^ (4 / 3 : ℝ)) koebeDomain volume := by
  let g : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun w => ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeInverse w‖ ^ (4 / 3 : ℝ))
  have hs : MeasurableSet disk := Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
  let f' : ℂ → ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ := fun z => deriv koebeMap z • (1 : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ)
  have hf' : ∀ z ∈ disk, HasFDerivWithinAt koebeMap (f' z) disk z := by
    intro z hz
    have hznorm : ‖z‖ < 1 := by
      simpa [disk, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hz
    have hz1 : z ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      subst z
      norm_num at hznorm
    simpa [f', (schlicht_hasDerivAt_koebeMap hz1).deriv] using
      ((schlicht_hasDerivAt_koebeMap hz1).complexToReal_fderiv).hasFDerivWithinAt
  have hcov := MeasureTheory.lintegral_image_eq_lintegral_abs_det_fderiv_mul
    (μ := volume) (s := disk) (f := koebeMap) (f' := f') hs hf' koebe_schlicht.1.2 g
  have hweight : ∀ z ∈ disk,
      ENNReal.ofReal |(f' z).det| * g (koebeMap z) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) := by
    intro z hz
    have hznorm : ‖z‖ < 1 := by
      simpa [disk, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hz
    have hz1 : z ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      subst z
      norm_num at hznorm
    dsimp [f', g]
    rw [inv43_det_real_complex_smul_one, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq,
      abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), norm_deriv_inv43_koebeInverse_koebeMap hz,
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg ‖deriv koebeMap z‖)]
    exact congrArg ENNReal.ofReal (inv43_real_jacobian_weight hz)
  have htop : ∫⁻ w in koebeDomain, g w ∂volume = ⊤ := by
    have hcongr : ∫⁻ z in disk,
        ENNReal.ofReal |(f' z).det| * g (koebeMap z) ∂volume =
      ∫⁻ z in disk, ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) ∂volume :=
      MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_congr_fun hs hweight
    change ∫⁻ w in koebeMap '' disk, g w ∂volume = ⊤
    rw [hcov, hcongr]
    simpa [areaMoment] using inv43_areaMoment_two_thirds_top
  intro hInt
  have hlt := hInt.setLIntegral_lt_top
  rw [htop] at hlt
  exact lt_irrefl _ hlt
theorem inv4_neg_two_uniform_bound {n : ℕ} {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ Metric.ball (((1 - ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (-1 : ℂ))
      (((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ n / 4)) :
    (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 6 * (5 * ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ n / 4) ^ (-2 : ℝ) ≤
      ‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (-2 : ℝ) := by
  set r : ℝ := ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ n with hr
  have hrpos : 0 < r := pow_pos (by norm_num) n
  have hrle : r ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hzdisk : z ∈ disk :=
    koebeModel_ball_subset_disk (a := (-1 : ℂ)) (by norm_num) n (by simpa [r] using hz)
  have hznorm : ‖z‖ < 1 := by
    simpa [disk, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hzdisk
  have hz1 : z ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    subst h
    norm_num at hznorm
  have hzneg1 : z ≠ -1 := by
    intro h
    subst h
    rw [norm_neg, norm_one] at hznorm
    norm_num at hznorm
  have hA_le : ‖1 + z‖ ≤ 5 * r / 4 := by
    have h := koebeModel_norm_sub_le (a := (-1 : ℂ)) (by norm_num) n (by simpa [r] using hz)
    simpa [r, add_comm] using h
  have hA_pos : 0 < ‖1 + z‖ := by
    apply norm_pos_iff.mpr
    intro h
    apply hzneg1
    linear_combination h
  have hB_ge : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ ‖1 - z‖ := by
    have htri : ‖(2 : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖1 - z‖ + ‖1 + z‖ := by
      calc ‖(2 : ℂ)‖ = ‖(1 - z) + (1 + z)‖ := by
            congr 1
            ring
        _ ≤ _ := norm_add_le _ _
    rw [show ‖(2 : ℂ)‖ = 2 by norm_num] at htri
    linarith
  have hB_pos : 0 < ‖1 - z‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hB_ge
  have hA_sq_pos : 0 < ‖1 + z‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hA_sq_le : ‖1 + z‖ ^ 2 ≤ (5 * r / 4) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hA_le 2
  have hB6 : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 6 ≤ ‖1 - z‖ ^ 6 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hB_ge 6
  have hchain : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 6 / (5 * r / 4) ^ 2 ≤
      ‖1 - z‖ ^ 6 / ‖1 + z‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 6 / (5 * r / 4) ^ 2
        ≤ ‖1 - z‖ ^ 6 / (5 * r / 4) ^ 2 :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hB6 (sq_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ ‖1 - z‖ ^ 6 / ‖1 + z‖ ^ 2 :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) 6) hA_sq_pos hA_sq_le
  have hneg : ‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (-2 : ℝ) = ‖1 - z‖ ^ 6 / ‖1 + z‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [schlicht_deriv_norm hz1]
    rw [show (-2 : ℝ) = -(2 : ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_neg (by positivity), Real.rpow_two,
      div_pow]
    rw [inv_div]
    congr 1
    rw [show (‖1 - z‖ ^ 3) ^ 2 = ‖1 - z‖ ^ 6 by ring]
  rw [hneg]
  have hscale : (5 * r / 4) ^ (-2 : ℝ) = ((5 * r / 4) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by positivity), Real.rpow_two]
  rw [hscale, div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact hchain
theorem inv4_areaMoment_neg_two_top : areaMoment koebeMap disk (-2) = ⊤ := by
  have h := lintegral_eq_top_of_ball_ge (S := disk)
    (g := fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (-2 : ℝ)))
    (a := (-1 : ℂ)) (by norm_num)
    (fun n => koebeModel_ball_subset_disk (a := (-1 : ℂ)) (by norm_num) n)
    (by fun_prop) (c := (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 6) (by positivity)
    (fun n z hz => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (inv4_neg_two_uniform_bound hz))
  simpa [areaMoment] using h
lemma inv4_jacobian_arith {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hB : 0 < B) :
    (A / B ^ 3) ^ 2 * (B ^ 12 / A ^ 4) = (A / B ^ 3) ^ (-2 : ℝ) := by
  rw [Real.rpow_neg (by positivity), Real.rpow_two]
  field_simp [hA.ne', hB.ne']
lemma inv4_norm_deriv_koebeInverse_koebeMap {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ disk) :
    ‖deriv koebeInverse (koebeMap z)‖ ^ (4 : ℝ) =
      ‖1 - z‖ ^ 12 / ‖1 + z‖ ^ 4 := by
  have hznorm : ‖z‖ < 1 := by
    simpa [disk, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hz
  have hz1 : z ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    subst z
    norm_num at hznorm
  rw [deriv_inv43_koebeInverse_koebeMap hz]
  rw [norm_div, norm_pow]
  rw [show ((4 : ℝ)) = ((4 : ℕ) : ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast, div_pow]
  rw [show (‖1 - z‖ ^ 3) ^ 4 = ‖1 - z‖ ^ 12 by ring]
lemma inv4_abs_det_fderiv_koebeMap' {z : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ 1) :
    |(fderiv ℝ koebeMap z).det| = ‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ 2 :=
  inv43_abs_det_fderiv_koebeMap hz
lemma inv4_real_jacobian_weight {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ disk) :
    ‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ 2 *
        (‖1 - z‖ ^ 12 / ‖1 + z‖ ^ 4) =
      ‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (-2 : ℝ) := by
  have hznorm : ‖z‖ < 1 := by
    simpa [disk, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hz
  have hz1 : z ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    subst z
    norm_num at hznorm
  have hB : 0 < ‖1 - z‖ := by
    rw [norm_pos_iff]
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr hz1.symm
  have hA : 0 < ‖1 + z‖ := by
    rw [norm_pos_iff]
    intro h
    have hz' : z = -1 := by linear_combination h
    subst hz'
    rw [norm_neg, norm_one] at hznorm
    norm_num at hznorm
  rw [schlicht_deriv_norm hz1]
  exact inv4_jacobian_arith hA hB
lemma inv4_jacobian_weight_mul {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ disk) :
    ENNReal.ofReal |(fderiv ℝ koebeMap z).det| *
        ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeInverse (koebeMap z)‖ ^ (4 : ℝ)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (-2 : ℝ)) := by
  have hznorm : ‖z‖ < 1 := by
    simpa [disk, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hz
  have hz1 : z ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    subst z
    norm_num at hznorm
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (abs_nonneg (fderiv ℝ koebeMap z).det)]
  rw [inv43_abs_det_fderiv_koebeMap hz1]
  rw [inv4_norm_deriv_koebeInverse_koebeMap hz]
  exact congrArg ENNReal.ofReal (inv4_real_jacobian_weight hz)
theorem inv_deriv_four_not_integrable :
    ¬ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun z => ‖deriv koebeInverse z‖ ^ (4 : ℝ)) koebeDomain volume := by
  let g : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun w => ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeInverse w‖ ^ (4 : ℝ))
  have hs : MeasurableSet disk := Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
  let f' : ℂ → ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ := fun z => deriv koebeMap z • (1 : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ)
  have hf' : ∀ z ∈ disk, HasFDerivWithinAt koebeMap (f' z) disk z := by
    intro z hz
    have hznorm : ‖z‖ < 1 := by
      simpa [disk, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hz
    have hz1 : z ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      subst z
      norm_num at hznorm
    simpa [f', (schlicht_hasDerivAt_koebeMap hz1).deriv] using
      ((schlicht_hasDerivAt_koebeMap hz1).complexToReal_fderiv).hasFDerivWithinAt
  have hcov := MeasureTheory.lintegral_image_eq_lintegral_abs_det_fderiv_mul
    (μ := volume) (s := disk) (f := koebeMap) (f' := f') hs hf' koebe_schlicht.1.2 g
  have hweight : ∀ z ∈ disk,
      ENNReal.ofReal |(f' z).det| * g (koebeMap z) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (-2 : ℝ)) := by
    intro z hz
    have hznorm : ‖z‖ < 1 := by
      simpa [disk, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hz
    have hz1 : z ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      subst z
      norm_num at hznorm
    dsimp [f', g]
    rw [inv43_det_real_complex_smul_one, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq,
      abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), inv4_norm_deriv_koebeInverse_koebeMap hz,
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg ‖deriv koebeMap z‖)]
    exact congrArg ENNReal.ofReal (inv4_real_jacobian_weight hz)
  have htop : ∫⁻ w in koebeDomain, g w ∂volume = ⊤ := by
    have hcongr : ∫⁻ z in disk,
        ENNReal.ofReal |(f' z).det| * g (koebeMap z) ∂volume =
      ∫⁻ z in disk, ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (-2 : ℝ)) ∂volume :=
      MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_congr_fun hs hweight
    change ∫⁻ w in koebeMap '' disk, g w ∂volume = ⊤
    rw [hcov, hcongr]
    simpa [areaMoment] using inv4_areaMoment_neg_two_top
  intro hInt
  have hlt := hInt.setLIntegral_lt_top
  rw [htop] at hlt
  exact lt_irrefl _ hlt

import Mathlib

/-! # TheoremOS auto-library module `KoebeDerivative`

Records the derivative of the Koebe map w ↦ w/(1-w)^2, namely (1+z)/(1-z)^3 at any z ≠ 1, together with the resulting modulus formula ‖deriv‖ = ‖1+z‖/‖1-z‖^3. These are the standard calculus facts that convert powers of ‖deriv‖ of the Koebe map into the explicit weights ‖1+z‖^a/‖1-z‖^b used in divergence and integrability estimates.

Planned use for the triggering challenge:
* OAI.Brennan.Sharp.sharp_endpoints: Apply TheoremOS.Auto.KoebeDerivative.norm_deriv_koebeMap with z in the unit disk (so z ≠ 1, since 1 ∉ disk) after rewriting the challenge's `koebeMap z = z/(1-z)^2`; this yields ‖deriv koebeMap z‖ = ‖1+z‖/‖1-z‖^3. Raising to the real powers used in the sharp-endpoint computation then gives ‖deriv koebeMap z‖^(2/3) = ‖1+z‖^(2/3)/‖1-z‖^2 and ‖deriv koebeMap z‖^(-2) = ‖1-z‖^6/‖1+z‖^2, which are the pointwise weights compared against ‖z - 1‖^(-2) and ‖z + 1‖^(-2) near the boundary points 1 and -1. The HasDerivAt form supplies the differentiability input for any change-of-variables step.
* Remaining: Comparison of the explicit weights ‖1+z‖^(2/3)/‖1-z‖^2 and ‖1-z‖^6/‖1+z‖^2 with constant multiples of ‖z-1‖^(-2) and ‖z+1‖^(-2) on a neighbourhood inside the disk.
* Remaining: Divergence of the planar integral of ‖z - a‖^t over the unit disk when ‖a‖ = 1 and t ≤ -2 (the failed divergence lemma, still open).
* Remaining: Derivative formula for the inverse of the Koebe map on the Koebe domain and the change-of-variables transport of the two non-integrability statements.
* Remaining: Measurability and the Integrable-iff-lintegral conversion to obtain the two ¬ IntegrableOn conclusions.
* Remaining: Univalence of the Koebe map on the unit disk and the normalisation facts koebeMap 0 = 0, deriv koebeMap 0 = 1 needed for the Schlicht conjunct.

Sources:
* P. L. Duren, Univalent Functions, Springer, 1983 (the Koebe function k(z) = z/(1-z)^2 and its derivative).
* Standard complex calculus: quotient rule, chain rule, ‖w^n‖ = ‖w‖^n and ‖w/v‖ = ‖w‖/‖v‖.

Written by the TheoremOS library planner and proved by a TheoremOS solver run before solving the problem
recorded in the pool record. Only declarations Lean accepted with no gaps are kept. -/

/-!
# The derivative of the Koebe map `z ↦ z / (1 - z)^2`

The Koebe map is the basic example of a schlicht function on the unit disk.  Its
derivative is elementary but is the input to every estimate on the growth of
`‖deriv‖`; the two lemmas below record the value and its modulus in the form in
which power estimates are applied.

`HasDerivAt` is stated for the explicit function so that a caller whose own
definition is syntactically equal to `fun w => w / (1 - w) ^ 2` can rewrite.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Auto.KoebeDerivative

open Complex

/-- Derivative of the Koebe map: away from the pole `z = 1`,
`d/dz (z / (1 - z)^2) = (1 + z) / (1 - z)^3`. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_koebeMap {z : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => w / (1 - w) ^ 2) ((1 + z) / (1 - z) ^ 3) z := by
  have hz' : (1 : ℂ) - z ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hz.symm
  have hden : (1 - z) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hz'
  have hbase := (hasDerivAt_id z).const_sub 1
  have hpow := hbase.pow 2
  have hquot := (hasDerivAt_id z).div hpow (by simpa using hden)
  convert hquot using 1
  · ext w
    rfl
  · simp only [Pi.pow_apply, id_eq]
    field_simp [hz']
    ring

/-- The modulus of the derivative of the Koebe map:
`‖d/dz (z / (1 - z)^2)‖ = ‖1 + z‖ / ‖1 - z‖ ^ 3` for `z ≠ 1`. -/
theorem norm_deriv_koebeMap {z : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ 1) :
    ‖deriv (fun w : ℂ => w / (1 - w) ^ 2) z‖ = ‖1 + z‖ / ‖1 - z‖ ^ 3 := by
  rw [(hasDerivAt_koebeMap hz).deriv, norm_div, norm_pow]

end TheoremOS.Auto.KoebeDerivative

import Mathlib

/-! # TheoremOS auto-library module `ThreeStateChannelSpectrum`

Defines the transition matrix of the symmetric three-state channel, P(lam)(i,j) = (1+2lam)/3 for i=j and (1-lam)/3 otherwise, and proves its eigenvector action: P(lam) *ᵥ x = ((1-lam)/3 * sum_i x_i) • 1 + lam • x, together with the n-step version (P(lam)^n) *ᵥ x = ((1-lam^n)/3 * sum_i x_i) • 1 + lam^n • x. Taking x to be a difference of unit vectors and the uniform vector gives P(lam)^n(i,j) - 1/3 = lam^n (delta_ij - 1/3), so correlations decay exactly like lam^n. This is the standard eigenvalue computation underlying the Kesten-Stigum reconstruction threshold.

Planned use for the triggering challenge:
* OAI.ThreeState.regular_supercritical: Use TheoremOS.Auto.ThreeStateChannelSpectrum.channelMatrix_pow_mulVec. The challenge's channel is exactly channelMatrix lam (it is defined by the same if i=j then (1+2*lam)/3 else (1-lam)/3). Apply the power identity to the vector x = e_a - u, where e_a is a unit vector at root state a and u is the constant vector 1/3; its coordinate sum is 1 - 3*(1/3) = 0, so the first summand vanishes and (channelMatrix lam ^ n) *ᵥ x = lam^n • x. Reading coordinates gives P^n(a,j) - 1/3 = lam^n (delta_{a j} - 1/3): the n-step transition probabilities approach uniform at rate lam^n. This supplies the correlation decay needed to compare the root-a law with the uniform mixture, since after n generations the signal-to-noise ratio scales like b^n * lam^{2n} = (b * lam^2)^n, and the hypothesis hcrit : 1 < b * lam^2 makes this grow. All premises of the lemma (a real lam, a natural n, an arbitrary real vector on Fin 3) are immediate; the only input used is the definition of channelMatrix, which unfolds to the challenge's channel. The Poisson case is identical with b replaced by d.
* Remaining: Relate the real channel matrix to the PMF channelPMF: show the entries of channelPMF are ENNReal.ofReal of channelMatrix entries and that (channelPMF lam h i j).toReal = channelMatrix lam i j.
* Remaining: Iterate the broadcast to obtain the n-step law of a single leaf given the root: the leaf-state marginal is the n-th convolution power of the channel, so the power identity yields its deviation lambda^n (delta_ij - 1/3) from uniform.
* Remaining: Expand the tree: the offspring law needs its first and second moments; for regular b the observed law at depth n is a b^n-fold independent sample, and for Poisson d the offspring moments come from the exponential generating function of poissonOffspring.
* Remaining: Control the effect of the root on the marginal by a chi-square/second-moment computation, then convert the resulting squared-distance (Hellinger/chi-square) estimate into the total-variation quantities appearing in advantage.
* Remaining: Use the existing TheoremOS.Probability.TreeReconstruction library for pmfTV and reconAdvantage, and prove the bridge identity that the challenge's advantage (sum over observations of marginal times half the sum of posterior deviations) equals (1/3) times the sum over the three root states of pmfTV of law i from the uniform mixture.
* Remaining: Handle the degenerate observations where the marginal mass is zero, using the if-then-else convention in posterior without changing the value of advantage.
* Remaining: Prove monotonicity/convergence of the resulting scalar recursion when 1 < b * lam^2 (regular case) and 1 < d * lam^2 (Poisson case), obtaining Filter.Tendsto ... atTop (nhds L) for the two advantage sequences.
* Remaining: Assemble the two headline theorems regular_supercritical and poisson_supercritical from the above, using Admissible to ensure channel_nonneg so that channelPMF is a genuine PMF.

Sources:
* H. Kesten and B. P. Stigum, Additional limit theorems for indecomposable multidimensional Galton-Watson processes, Ann. Math. Statist. 37 (1966).
* E. Mossel, Survey: Information flow on trees, in Graphs, Morphisms and Statistical Physics, DIMACS Ser. Discrete Math. Theoret. Comput. Sci. 63 (2004).
* C. Borgs, J. Chayes, L. Lovasz and K. Vesztergombi, Counting graph homomorphisms, in Topics in Discrete Mathematics (2006), for the symmetric-channel spectral decomposition.

/-!
# The spectrum of the three-state symmetric channel

The channel matrix `P(lam)` with entries `(1 + 2*lam)/3` on the diagonal and
`(1 - lam)/3` off the diagonal is `((1 - lam)/3) smul J + lam smul 1`, where `J`
is the all-ones matrix.  Consequently its action on a vector `x` splits off the
component along the constant vector:
`P(lam) *ᵥ x = ((1 - lam)/3 * sum i, x i) smul 1 + lam smul x`.
Iterating gives
`(P(lam)^n) *ᵥ x = ((1 - lam^n)/3 * sum i, x i) smul 1 + lam^n smul x`,
so the deviation of the `n`-step transition probabilities from the uniform
distribution decays like `lam^n`.  This is the eigenvalue computation behind the
Kesten-Stigum threshold for reconstruction on trees.
-/

open Matrix
open scoped BigOperators

namespace TheoremOS.Auto.ThreeStateChannelSpectrum

/-- The transition matrix of the symmetric three-state channel with parameter `lam`. -/
noncomputable def channelMatrix (lam : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  fun i j => if i = j then (1 + 2 * lam) / 3 else (1 - lam) / 3

/-- The channel acts on a vector by keeping a `lam` fraction of its deviation from the
constant vector and replacing its mean by the same mean. -/
theorem channelMatrix_mulVec_eq (lam : ℝ) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    channelMatrix lam *ᵥ x
      = ((1 - lam) / 3 * ∑ i, x i) • (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) + lam • x := by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [channelMatrix, Matrix.mulVec_apply_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring

/-- The `n`-step transition matrix keeps only a `lam^n` fraction of the deviation
from the uniform vector. -/
theorem channelMatrix_pow_mulVec (lam : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    (channelMatrix lam ^ n) *ᵥ x
      = ((1 - lam ^ n) / 3 * ∑ i, x i) • (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) + lam ^ n • x := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ih, channelMatrix_mulVec_eq]
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;>
        simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, pow_succ] <;> ring

end TheoremOS.Auto.ThreeStateChannelSpectrum

import Mathlib

/-!
# Cofinite subspaces and asymptotic moduli of a seminorm

For a real normed space `X`, a closed subspace of finite codimension is *cofinite*
(`IsCofinite F`). For a function `N : X → ℝ` (usually an equivalent seminorm), a point `x`, a
parameter `t` and a cofinite `F`, the inner infima are
`asympOneSidedInner N t x F = inf {N(x + t y) - 1 : y ∈ F, N y = 1}`,
`asympAveragedInner N t x F = inf {(N(x + t y) + N(x - t y))/2 - 1 : y ∈ F, 1 ≤ N y}` and its unit
version `asympAveragedUnitInner` (directions with `N y = 1`); taking `sup` over cofinite `F` gives
`asympOneSided`/`asympAveraged`, and `inf` over `N x = 1` gives the moduli
`asympOneSidedModulus`/`asympAveragedModulus`. Contents: `⊤`, finite intersections and kernels of
continuous functionals (more generally of continuous maps to finite-dimensional spaces) are
cofinite; in an infinite-dimensional space every cofinite subspace contains `N`-unit vectors when
`a‖·‖ ≤ N`; Hahn–Banach for a seminorm `N ≤ b‖·‖` (`exists_clm_eq_one_le`); the generic bounds
`max 0 (|t| - 2) ≤ one-sided ≤ |t|` and `max 0 (|t| - 1) ≤ averaged ≤ |t|` at every unit point and
for the moduli; the convexity step `N(x + c y) + N(x - c y) ≤ N(x + y) + N(x - y)` for `c ∈ [0, 1]`
and the identity `asympAveragedInner = asympAveragedUnitInner` for seminorms; antitonicity of the
inner infima in `F`.

Sources: W. B. Johnson, J. Lindenstrauss, D. Preiss and G. Schechtman, Almost Fréchet
differentiability of Lipschitz mappings between infinite-dimensional Banach spaces, Proc. London
Math. Soc. 84 (2002) 711–746, Section 2 (asymptotic moduli); V. D. Milman, Geometric theory of
Banach spaces II, Russian Math. Surveys 26 (1971) 79–163, Section 4.6; M. Fabian, P. Habala,
P. Hájek, V. Montesinos and V. Zizler, *Banach Space Theory*, Springer CMS Books, 2011, Theorem 2.1
(Hahn–Banach) and Section 2.3 (closed subspaces of finite codimension). Textbook material; nothing
here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: a set `{F | IsClosed (F : Set X) ∧ FiniteDimensional ℝ (X ⧸ F)}` is
`{F | IsCofinite F}` by `rfl`. Nested `sInf`/`sSup`/`sInf` definitions of the form
`sInf {r | ∃ x, N x = 1 ∧ r = sSup {a | ∃ F, IsCofinite F ∧ a = sInf {b | ∃ y, y ∈ F ∧ N y = 1 ∧
b = N (x + t • y) - 1}}}` are `asympOneSidedModulus N t` by `rfl` (also with `∃ F ∈ S`, with the
pair `∃ y ∈ F` and with `averagedIncrement` unfolded); the averaged versions with `1 ≤ N y` and
`/ 2` likewise. A supremum over `Set.range` of a function on the subtype of cofinite subspaces is
rewritten with `sSup_range_cofinite`. `((2 : ℕ) : ℝ)` is `2` by `Nat.cast_ofNat`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Analysis

open Set

noncomputable section

variable {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]

/-- A closed linear subspace of finite codimension. -/
def IsCofinite (F : Submodule ℝ X) : Prop :=
  IsClosed (F : Set X) ∧ FiniteDimensional ℝ (X ⧸ F)

namespace IsCofinite

theorem top : IsCofinite (⊤ : Submodule ℝ X) := ⟨isClosed_univ, inferInstance⟩

theorem inf {F G : Submodule ℝ X} (hF : IsCofinite F) (hG : IsCofinite G) : IsCofinite (F ⊓ G) := by
  refine ⟨by simpa using hF.1.inter hG.1, ?_⟩
  have := hF.2
  have := hG.2
  have hker : (F.mkQ.prod G.mkQ).ker = F ⊓ G := by
    rw [LinearMap.ker_prod, Submodule.ker_mkQ, Submodule.ker_mkQ]
  exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
    ((Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hker).symm.trans (F.mkQ.prod G.mkQ).quotKerEquivRange).symm

/-- The kernel of a continuous linear map to a finite-dimensional space is cofinite. -/
theorem ker {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (ℓ : X →L[ℝ] E) : IsCofinite (LinearMap.ker (ℓ : X →ₗ[ℝ] E)) :=
  ⟨ℓ.isClosed_ker, LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (ℓ : X →ₗ[ℝ] E).quotKerEquivRange.symm⟩

theorem ker_functional (ℓ : X →L[ℝ] ℝ) : IsCofinite (LinearMap.ker (ℓ : X →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) := ker ℓ

/-- In an infinite-dimensional space a cofinite subspace is nonzero. -/
theorem ne_bot (hX : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℝ X) {F : Submodule ℝ X} (hF : IsCofinite F) :
    F ≠ ⊥ := by
  rintro rfl
  have := hF.2
  exact hX (LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot ⊥ rfl))

/-- In an infinite-dimensional space a cofinite subspace contains `N`-unit vectors when
`a ‖·‖ ≤ N` with `0 < a`. -/
theorem exists_unit (hX : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℝ X) {F : Submodule ℝ X} (hF : IsCofinite F)
    (N : Seminorm ℝ X) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hN : ∀ x, a * ‖x‖ ≤ N x) :
    ∃ y ∈ F, N y = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨y, hyF, hy0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot (hF.ne_bot hX)
  have hNy : 0 < N y := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos ha (norm_pos_iff.mpr hy0)) (hN y)
  refine ⟨(N y)⁻¹ • y, F.smul_mem _ hyF, ?_⟩
  rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hNy, inv_mul_cancel₀ hNy.ne']

end IsCofinite

/-- Supremum over the subtype of cofinite subspaces, rewritten as a supremum over a set. -/
theorem sSup_range_cofinite (g : Submodule ℝ X → ℝ) :
    sSup (Set.range fun F : {F : Submodule ℝ X // IsClosed (F : Set X) ∧
      FiniteDimensional ℝ (X ⧸ F)} => g F.val) = sSup {a | ∃ F, IsCofinite F ∧ a = g F} := by
  congr 1
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨F, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨F.val, F.property, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨F, hF⟩, rfl⟩

/-- Hahn–Banach for a seminorm `N ≤ b ‖·‖`: a continuous functional `ℓ ≤ N` with `ℓ x = 1`. -/
theorem exists_clm_eq_one_le (N : Seminorm ℝ X) {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) {x : X}
    (hx : N x = 1) : ∃ ℓ : X →L[ℝ] ℝ, ℓ x = 1 ∧ ∀ z, ℓ z ≤ N z := by
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hx
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgN⟩ := exists_extension_of_le_sublinear
    (LinearPMap.mkSpanSingleton x (1 : ℝ) hx0) N
    (fun c hc z => by rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc])
    (fun z w => map_add_le_add N z w) (by
      rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hz
      rw [LinearPMap.mkSpanSingleton'_apply]
      simp only [RingHom.id_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, map_smul_eq_mul, hx, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact le_abs_self c)
  have hgx : g x = 1 := by
    have := hg ⟨x, Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self x⟩
    rw [this]
    exact LinearPMap.mkSpanSingleton_apply ℝ ℝ hx0 1
  have hbound : ∀ z, ‖g z‖ ≤ b * ‖z‖ := by
    intro z
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
    constructor
    · have := (hgN (-z)).trans (hNb (-z))
      rw [map_neg, norm_neg] at this
      linarith
    · exact (hgN z).trans (hNb z)
  exact ⟨g.mkContinuous b hbound, by simpa using hgx, fun z => by simpa using hgN z⟩

section Moduli

/-- `inf {N(x + t y) - 1 : y ∈ F, N y = 1}`. -/
def asympOneSidedInner (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) : ℝ :=
  sInf {b | ∃ y : X, y ∈ F ∧ N y = 1 ∧ b = N (x + t • y) - 1}

/-- `sup` of `asympOneSidedInner` over cofinite subspaces. -/
def asympOneSided (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : X) : ℝ :=
  sSup {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympOneSidedInner N t x F}

/-- The one-sided asymptotic modulus: `inf` of `asympOneSided` over `N x = 1`. -/
def asympOneSidedModulus (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sInf {r | ∃ x : X, N x = 1 ∧ r = asympOneSided N t x}

/-- `inf {(N(x + t y) + N(x - t y))/2 - 1 : y ∈ F, 1 ≤ N y}`. -/
def asympAveragedInner (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) : ℝ :=
  sInf {b | ∃ y : X, y ∈ F ∧ 1 ≤ N y ∧ b = (N (x + t • y) + N (x - t • y)) / 2 - 1}

/-- The same infimum over directions with `N y = 1`. -/
def asympAveragedUnitInner (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) : ℝ :=
  sInf {b | ∃ y : X, y ∈ F ∧ N y = 1 ∧ b = (N (x + t • y) + N (x - t • y)) / 2 - 1}

/-- `sup` of `asympAveragedInner` over cofinite subspaces. -/
def asympAveraged (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : X) : ℝ :=
  sSup {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympAveragedInner N t x F}

/-- The averaged asymptotic (midpoint) modulus. -/
def asympAveragedModulus (N : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sInf {r | ∃ x : X, N x = 1 ∧ r = asympAveraged N t x}

/-- An `sInf` of a set all of whose elements are `≤ c` with `0 ≤ c` is `≤ c`, whether or not the
set is empty. -/
theorem sInf_le_of_forall_mem_le {s : Set ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hs : BddBelow s) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∀ b ∈ s, b ≤ c) : sInf s ≤ c := by
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ⟨b, hb⟩
  · simpa using hc
  · exact (csInf_le hs hb).trans (h b hb)

variable (N : Seminorm ℝ X)

theorem bddBelow_asympOneSidedInner (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    BddBelow {b | ∃ y : X, y ∈ F ∧ N y = 1 ∧ b = N (x + t • y) - 1} :=
  ⟨-1, by rintro b ⟨y, -, -, rfl⟩; linarith [apply_nonneg N (x + t • y)]⟩

theorem asympOneSidedInner_le_abs {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    asympOneSidedInner N t x F ≤ |t| :=
  sInf_le_of_forall_mem_le (bddBelow_asympOneSidedInner N t x F) (abs_nonneg t) (by
    rintro b ⟨y, -, hy, rfl⟩
    have := map_add_le_add N x (t • y)
    rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hx, hy] at this
    linarith)

/-- On the kernel of a functional `ℓ ≤ N` with `ℓ x = 1` the inner infimum is nonnegative. -/
theorem asympOneSidedInner_ker_nonneg {x : X} {ℓ : X →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hℓx : ℓ x = 1) (hℓ : ∀ z, ℓ z ≤ N z)
    (t : ℝ) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    0 ≤ asympOneSidedInner N t x (F ⊓ LinearMap.ker (ℓ : X →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) := by
  refine Real.sInf_nonneg ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, hy, -, rfl⟩
  have hy0 : ℓ y = 0 := (Submodule.mem_inf.mp hy).2
  have := hℓ (x + t • y)
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, hℓx, hy0, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero] at this
  linarith

theorem bddAbove_asympOneSided {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    BddAbove {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympOneSidedInner (⇑N) t x F} :=
  ⟨|t|, by rintro a ⟨F, -, rfl⟩; exact asympOneSidedInner_le_abs N hx F⟩

theorem asympOneSidedInner_le {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) {F : Submodule ℝ X}
    (hF : IsCofinite F) : asympOneSidedInner N t x F ≤ asympOneSided N t x :=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_asympOneSided N hx) ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩

theorem asympOneSided_le_abs {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) : asympOneSided N t x ≤ |t| :=
  Real.sSup_le (by rintro a ⟨F, -, rfl⟩; exact asympOneSidedInner_le_abs N hx F) (abs_nonneg t)

/-- `0 ≤ D(x, t)` at an `N`-unit point when `N ≤ b ‖·‖` (Hahn–Banach). -/
theorem asympOneSided_nonneg {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    0 ≤ asympOneSided N t x := by
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓx, hℓ⟩ := exists_clm_eq_one_le N hNb hx
  have h := asympOneSidedInner_ker_nonneg N hℓx hℓ t ⊤
  rw [top_inf_eq] at h
  exact h.trans (asympOneSidedInner_le N hx (IsCofinite.ker_functional ℓ))

/-- `|t| - 2 ≤ inf` over all unit directions, by the triangle inequality. -/
theorem abs_sub_two_le_asympOneSidedInner_top {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    |t| - 2 ≤ asympOneSidedInner N t x ⊤ := by
  refine le_csInf ⟨_, x, Submodule.mem_top, hx, rfl⟩ ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, -, hy, rfl⟩
  have := map_sub_le_add N (x + t • y) x
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hy, hx] at this
  linarith

/-- Generic bounds `max 0 (|t| - 2) ≤ D(x, t) ≤ |t|` at an `N`-unit point. -/
theorem max_le_asympOneSided {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    max 0 (|t| - 2) ≤ asympOneSided N t x :=
  max_le (asympOneSided_nonneg N hNb hx)
    ((abs_sub_two_le_asympOneSidedInner_top N hx).trans (asympOneSidedInner_le N hx IsCofinite.top))

theorem asympOneSidedModulus_le_abs (t : ℝ) : asympOneSidedModulus N t ≤ |t| :=
  sInf_le_of_forall_mem_le ⟨|t| - 2, by
      rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact (abs_sub_two_le_asympOneSidedInner_top N hx).trans
        (asympOneSidedInner_le N hx IsCofinite.top)⟩
    (abs_nonneg t) (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact asympOneSided_le_abs N hx)

theorem asympOneSidedModulus_nonneg {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ asympOneSidedModulus N t :=
  Real.sInf_nonneg (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact asympOneSided_nonneg N hNb hx)

/-- Generic lower bound for the modulus, given one `N`-unit vector. -/
theorem max_le_asympOneSidedModulus {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) (hX : ∃ x, N x = 1)
    (t : ℝ) : max 0 (|t| - 2) ≤ asympOneSidedModulus N t := by
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hX
  exact le_csInf ⟨_, x₀, hx₀, rfl⟩ (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact max_le_asympOneSided N hNb hx)

/-- A larger subspace has a smaller inner infimum (when the smaller one has unit vectors). -/
theorem asympOneSidedInner_anti {t : ℝ} {x : X} {F G : Submodule ℝ X} (hFG : F ≤ G)
    (hF : ∃ y ∈ F, N y = 1) : asympOneSidedInner N t x G ≤ asympOneSidedInner N t x F := by
  obtain ⟨y, hyF, hy⟩ := hF
  exact csInf_le_csInf (bddBelow_asympOneSidedInner N t x G) ⟨_, y, hyF, hy, rfl⟩
    (by rintro b ⟨z, hz, hz1, rfl⟩; exact ⟨z, hFG hz, hz1, rfl⟩)

/-- Two sets of reals with `B ⊆ A`, every element of `A` above some element of `B` and `A`
bounded below have the same infimum (also when they are empty). -/
theorem sInf_eq_of_subset_of_forall_exists_le {A B : Set ℝ} (hA : BddBelow A) (hBA : B ⊆ A)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ A, ∃ b ∈ B, b ≤ a) : sInf A = sInf B := by
  rcases B.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hB
  · have : A = ∅ := by
      ext a
      simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      intro ha
      obtain ⟨b, hb, -⟩ := h a ha
      exact hb
    rw [this]
  · exact le_antisymm (csInf_le_csInf hA hB hBA)
      (le_csInf (hB.mono hBA) fun a ha => by
        obtain ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ := h a ha
        exact (csInf_le (hA.mono hBA) hb).trans hba)

/-- Convexity step: `N(x + c y) + N(x - c y) ≤ N(x + y) + N(x - y)` for `0 ≤ c ≤ 1`. -/
theorem add_smul_add_sub_smul_le {c : ℝ} (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1) (x y : X) :
    N (x + c • y) + N (x - c • y) ≤ N (x + y) + N (x - y) := by
  have e1 : x + c • y = ((1 + c) / 2) • (x + y) + ((1 - c) / 2) • (x - y) := by module
  have e2 : x - c • y = ((1 - c) / 2) • (x + y) + ((1 + c) / 2) • (x - y) := by module
  have h1 := map_add_le_add N (((1 + c) / 2) • (x + y)) (((1 - c) / 2) • (x - y))
  have h2 := map_add_le_add N (((1 - c) / 2) • (x + y)) (((1 + c) / 2) • (x - y))
  rw [← e1] at h1
  rw [← e2] at h2
  simp only [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + c) / 2),
    abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 - c) / 2)] at h1 h2
  linarith

theorem bddBelow_asympAveragedInner (P : X → Prop) (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    BddBelow {b | ∃ y : X, y ∈ F ∧ P y ∧ b = (N (x + t • y) + N (x - t • y)) / 2 - 1} :=
  ⟨-1, by
    rintro b ⟨y, -, -, rfl⟩
    linarith [apply_nonneg N (x + t • y), apply_nonneg N (x - t • y)]⟩

/-- For a seminorm, directions with `1 ≤ N y` and with `N y = 1` give the same averaged
infimum. -/
theorem asympAveragedInner_eq_unit (t : ℝ) (x : X) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    asympAveragedInner N t x F = asympAveragedUnitInner N t x F := by
  refine sInf_eq_of_subset_of_forall_exists_le (bddBelow_asympAveragedInner N _ t x F)
    (by rintro b ⟨y, hyF, hy, rfl⟩; exact ⟨y, hyF, hy.ge, rfl⟩) ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, hyF, hy, rfl⟩
  have hpos : 0 < N y := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hy
  refine ⟨_, ⟨(N y)⁻¹ • y, F.smul_mem _ hyF, ?_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hpos, inv_mul_cancel₀ hpos.ne']
  · have := add_smul_add_sub_smul_le N (inv_nonneg.mpr hpos.le) (inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hy) x
      (t • y)
    rw [smul_comm (N y)⁻¹ t y] at this
    linarith

theorem asympAveragedInner_le_abs {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    asympAveragedInner N t x F ≤ |t| := by
  rw [asympAveragedInner_eq_unit]
  refine sInf_le_of_forall_mem_le (bddBelow_asympAveragedInner N _ t x F) (abs_nonneg t) ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, -, hy, rfl⟩
  have h1 := map_add_le_add N x (t • y)
  have h2 := map_sub_le_add N x (t • y)
  rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hx, hy] at h1 h2
  linarith

theorem asympAveragedInner_ker_nonneg {x : X} {ℓ : X →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hℓx : ℓ x = 1)
    (hℓ : ∀ z, ℓ z ≤ N z) (t : ℝ) (F : Submodule ℝ X) :
    0 ≤ asympAveragedInner N t x (F ⊓ LinearMap.ker (ℓ : X →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) := by
  refine Real.sInf_nonneg ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, hy, -, rfl⟩
  have hy0 : ℓ y = 0 := (Submodule.mem_inf.mp hy).2
  have h1 := hℓ (x + t • y)
  have h2 := hℓ (x - t • y)
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_smul, hℓx, hy0, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero,
    sub_zero] at h1 h2
  linarith

/-- `|t| - 1 ≤ inf` over all directions, by the triangle inequality. -/
theorem abs_sub_one_le_asympAveragedInner_top {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    |t| - 1 ≤ asympAveragedInner N t x ⊤ := by
  refine le_csInf ⟨_, x, Submodule.mem_top, hx.ge, rfl⟩ ?_
  rintro b ⟨y, -, hy, rfl⟩
  have := map_sub_le_add N (x + t • y) (x - t • y)
  rw [show x + t • y - (x - t • y) = (2 * t) • y by module, map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_mul, abs_two] at this
  have hty : |t| ≤ |t| * N y := le_mul_of_one_le_right (abs_nonneg t) hy
  linarith

theorem bddAbove_asympAveraged {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    BddAbove {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympAveragedInner (⇑N) t x F} :=
  ⟨|t|, by rintro a ⟨F, -, rfl⟩; exact asympAveragedInner_le_abs N hx F⟩

theorem asympAveragedInner_le {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) {F : Submodule ℝ X}
    (hF : IsCofinite F) : asympAveragedInner N t x F ≤ asympAveraged N t x :=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_asympAveraged N hx) ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩

theorem asympAveraged_le_abs {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) : asympAveraged N t x ≤ |t| :=
  Real.sSup_le (by rintro a ⟨F, -, rfl⟩; exact asympAveragedInner_le_abs N hx F) (abs_nonneg t)

/-- `0 ≤ H(x, t)` at an `N`-unit point when `N ≤ b ‖·‖` (Hahn–Banach). -/
theorem asympAveraged_nonneg {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    0 ≤ asympAveraged N t x := by
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓx, hℓ⟩ := exists_clm_eq_one_le N hNb hx
  have h := asympAveragedInner_ker_nonneg N hℓx hℓ t ⊤
  rw [top_inf_eq] at h
  exact h.trans (asympAveragedInner_le N hx (IsCofinite.ker_functional ℓ))

/-- Generic bounds `max 0 (|t| - 1) ≤ H(x, t) ≤ |t|` at an `N`-unit point. -/
theorem max_le_asympAveraged {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) {t : ℝ} {x : X} (hx : N x = 1) :
    max 0 (|t| - 1) ≤ asympAveraged N t x :=
  max_le (asympAveraged_nonneg N hNb hx)
    ((abs_sub_one_le_asympAveragedInner_top N hx).trans (asympAveragedInner_le N hx IsCofinite.top))

theorem asympAveragedModulus_le_abs (t : ℝ) : asympAveragedModulus N t ≤ |t| :=
  sInf_le_of_forall_mem_le ⟨|t| - 1, by
      rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact (abs_sub_one_le_asympAveragedInner_top N hx).trans
        (asympAveragedInner_le N hx IsCofinite.top)⟩
    (abs_nonneg t) (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact asympAveraged_le_abs N hx)

theorem asympAveragedModulus_nonneg {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ asympAveragedModulus N t :=
  Real.sInf_nonneg (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact asympAveraged_nonneg N hNb hx)

theorem max_le_asympAveragedModulus {b : ℝ} (hNb : ∀ z, N z ≤ b * ‖z‖) (hX : ∃ x, N x = 1)
    (t : ℝ) : max 0 (|t| - 1) ≤ asympAveragedModulus N t := by
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hX
  exact le_csInf ⟨_, x₀, hx₀, rfl⟩ (by rintro r ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact max_le_asympAveraged N hNb hx)

theorem asympAveragedInner_anti {t : ℝ} {x : X} {F G : Submodule ℝ X} (hFG : F ≤ G)
    (hF : ∃ y ∈ F, 1 ≤ N y) : asympAveragedInner N t x G ≤ asympAveragedInner N t x F := by
  obtain ⟨y, hyF, hy⟩ := hF
  exact csInf_le_csInf (bddBelow_asympAveragedInner N _ t x G) ⟨_, y, hyF, hy, rfl⟩
    (by rintro b ⟨z, hz, hz1, rfl⟩; exact ⟨z, hFG hz, hz1, rfl⟩)

/-- Unit-direction form of `asympAveraged`. -/
theorem asympAveraged_eq_unit (t : ℝ) (x : X) :
    asympAveraged N t x =
      sSup {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympAveragedUnitInner N t x F} := by
  simp only [asympAveraged, asympAveragedInner_eq_unit]

/-- Unit-direction form of the averaged modulus. -/
theorem asympAveragedModulus_eq_unit (t : ℝ) :
    asympAveragedModulus N t = sInf {r | ∃ x : X, N x = 1 ∧ r =
      sSup {a | ∃ F : Submodule ℝ X, IsCofinite F ∧ a = asympAveragedUnitInner N t x F}} := by
  simp only [asympAveragedModulus, asympAveraged_eq_unit]

end Moduli

end

end TheoremOS.Analysis

sources.code:
import Mathlib

/-!
# The Daugavet property and the slice lemma

A real normed space `X` has the Daugavet property (`HasDaugavetProperty X`) when every rank-one
operator `T = ℓ.smulRight v` satisfies `‖Id + T‖ = 1 + ‖T‖`. The slice lemma of Kadets, Shvidkoy,
Sirotkin and Werner: in such a space, every nonempty slice `{y | ‖y‖ ≤ 1, α < ℓ y}` of the unit
ball contains, for every unit vector `w` and every `ρ > 0`, a unit vector `y` with
`‖w + y‖ ≥ 2 - ρ` (`HasDaugavetProperty.unitSlice`). Along the way: a vector `z` of the unit ball
with `‖z + ℓ z • w‖ > 2 - δ` and `ℓ z ≥ 0` normalises to a unit vector `u` with `ℓ u > 1 - δ` and
`‖u + w‖ > 2 - 3δ` (`exists_unit_of_norm_add_smul_gt`).

Sources: V. M. Kadets, R. V. Shvidkoy, G. G. Sirotkin and D. Werner, *Banach spaces with the
Daugavet property*, Trans. Amer. Math. Soc. 352 (2000) 855–873, §2 (the slice
characterisation, proved here in the direction used: Daugavet equation ⇒ slices); D. Werner,
*Recent progress on the Daugavet property*, Irish Math. Soc. Bull. 46 (2001).
Classical material; nothing here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: `StrongDual ℝ X` is `X →L[ℝ] ℝ`, and `ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell.smulRight v`
applied to `x` is `x + ell x • v` (`ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply`); a definition
`∀ (ell : X →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : X), ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell.smulRight v‖ =
1 + ‖ell.smulRight v‖` is `HasDaugavetProperty X` by `Iff.rfl`, and the slice condition
`∀ w, ‖w‖ = 1 → ∀ ell α, (∃ u, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 ∧ α < ell u) → ∀ ρ, 0 < ρ → ∃ y, ‖y‖ = 1 ∧ α < ell y ∧
2 - ρ ≤ ‖w + y‖` is `HasUnitSliceProperty X`. `‖ell.smulRight v‖ = ‖ell‖ * ‖v‖` is Mathlib's
`ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Analysis

noncomputable section

variable (X : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]

/-- The Daugavet equation `‖Id + T‖ = 1 + ‖T‖` for every rank-one operator `T`. -/
def HasDaugavetProperty : Prop :=
  ∀ (ell : X →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : X),
    ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell.smulRight v‖ = 1 + ‖ell.smulRight v‖

/-- Every nonempty slice of the unit ball contains unit vectors almost antipodal to `-w`. -/
def HasUnitSliceProperty : Prop :=
  ∀ w : X, ‖w‖ = 1 → ∀ (ell : X →L[ℝ] ℝ) (α : ℝ), (∃ u : X, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 ∧ α < ell u) →
    ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∃ y : X, ‖y‖ = 1 ∧ α < ell y ∧ 2 - ρ ≤ ‖w + y‖

variable {X}

/-- Normalisation step of the slice lemma. -/
theorem exists_unit_of_norm_add_smul_gt {ell : X →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hell : ‖ell‖ = 1) {w z : X}
    (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1) (hz0 : 0 ≤ ell z) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : δ < 1)
    (h : 2 - δ < ‖z + ell z • w‖) :
    ∃ u : X, ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ 1 - δ < ell u ∧ 2 - 3 * δ < ‖u + w‖ := by
  have hle : ell z ≤ ‖z‖ := by
    have := ell.le_opNorm z
    rw [hell, one_mul] at this
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this)
  have htri : ‖z + ell z • w‖ ≤ ‖z‖ + ell z := by
    refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [norm_smul, hw, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hz0]
  have hlz : 1 - δ < ell z := by linarith
  have hnz : 1 - δ < ‖z‖ := by linarith
  have hzw : 2 - 2 * δ < ‖z + w‖ := by
    have e : z + ell z • w = (z + w) - (1 - ell z) • w := by
      rw [sub_smul, one_smul]; abel
    have : ‖z + ell z • w‖ ≤ ‖z + w‖ + (1 - ell z) := by
      rw [e]
      refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [norm_smul, hw, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    linarith
  have hzpos : 0 < ‖z‖ := by linarith
  refine ⟨‖z‖⁻¹ • z, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hzpos.ne']
  · rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have : 1 ≤ ‖z‖⁻¹ := (one_le_inv₀ hzpos).mpr hz
    nlinarith
  · have hd : ‖‖z‖⁻¹ • z - z‖ = 1 - ‖z‖ := by
      rw [show ‖z‖⁻¹ • z - z = (‖z‖⁻¹ - 1) • z by rw [sub_smul, one_smul], norm_smul,
        Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ((one_le_inv₀ hzpos).mpr hz)), sub_mul,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ hzpos.ne', one_mul]
    have : ‖z + w‖ ≤ ‖‖z‖⁻¹ • z + w‖ + ‖‖z‖⁻¹ • z - z‖ := by
      calc ‖z + w‖ = ‖(‖z‖⁻¹ • z + w) - (‖z‖⁻¹ • z - z)‖ := by congr 1; abel
        _ ≤ _ := norm_sub_le _ _
    linarith

/-- **Slice lemma** (Kadets–Shvidkoy–Sirotkin–Werner). -/
theorem HasDaugavetProperty.unitSlice (hX : HasDaugavetProperty X) : HasUnitSliceProperty X := by
  intro w hw ell α hslice ρ hρ
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀, hαu₀⟩ := hslice
  by_cases hell : ell = 0
  · subst hell
    refine ⟨w, hw, by simpa using hαu₀, ?_⟩
    rw [← two_smul ℝ w, norm_smul, hw]
    norm_num
    linarith
  have hn : 0 < ‖ell‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hell
  set ell' : X →L[ℝ] ℝ := ‖ell‖⁻¹ • ell with hell'
  have hn' : ‖ell'‖ = 1 := by
    rw [hell', norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn.ne']
  have hα : α / ‖ell‖ < 1 := by
    rw [div_lt_one hn]
    calc α < ell u₀ := hαu₀
      _ ≤ ‖ell u₀‖ := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ ‖ell‖ * ‖u₀‖ := ell.le_opNorm u₀
      _ ≤ ‖ell‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg u₀]
  set δ := min (min (ρ / 3) (1 - α / ‖ell‖)) (1 / 2) with hδ
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := lt_min (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)) (by norm_num)
  have hδ1 : δ < 1 := (min_le_right _ _).trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hδρ : δ ≤ ρ / 3 := (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδα : δ ≤ 1 - α / ‖ell‖ := (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hnorm : ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell'.smulRight w‖ = 2 := by
    rw [hX, ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply, hn', hw]; norm_num
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzgt⟩ := (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell'.smulRight w).exists_lt_apply_of_lt_opNorm
    (r := 2 - δ) (by rw [hnorm]; linarith)
  have happ : ∀ x : X, (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X + ell'.smulRight w) x = x + ell' x • w :=
    fun _ => rfl
  rw [happ] at hzgt
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hz'0, hz'gt⟩ : ∃ z' : X, ‖z'‖ ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ ell' z' ∧ 2 - δ < ‖z' + ell' z' • w‖ := by
    rcases le_total 0 (ell' z) with h0 | h0
    · exact ⟨z, hz.le, h0, hzgt⟩
    · refine ⟨-z, by rw [norm_neg]; exact hz.le, by rw [map_neg]; linarith, ?_⟩
      rw [map_neg, neg_smul, ← neg_add, norm_neg]
      exact hzgt
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hlu, hwu⟩ := exists_unit_of_norm_add_smul_gt hn' hw hz' hz'0 hδ1 hz'gt
  refine ⟨u, hu, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 : α / ‖ell‖ < ell' u := lt_of_le_of_lt (by linarith) hlu
    have e : ell' u = ‖ell‖⁻¹ * ell u := rfl
    rw [e, div_eq_inv_mul] at h1
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h1 (inv_nonneg.mpr hn.le)
  · rw [add_comm]
    linarith

end

end TheoremOS.Analysis

import Mathlib

/-!
# Littlewood polynomials, aperiodic correlations and the merit factor

Finite trigonometric polynomials `trigPoly s c t = ∑_{k ∈ s} c k e_k(t)` on `AddCircle T` with
normalised Haar measure: the mean of a character (`integral_fourier_haarAddCircle`) and of a
trigonometric polynomial, Parseval `∫ |∑ c_k e_k|^2 = ∑ |c_k|^2` (`integral_norm_sq_trigPoly`),
integrability of continuous functions, and points where a continuous function is above or below
its mean. `e_1` parametrises the unit circle (`exists_fourier_one_eq`, `forall_norm_eq_one_iff`)
and `e_1(t)^k = e_k(t)` (`fourier_one_pow`).

Aperiodic autocorrelations `c_k = ∑_{j < N - k} a_j a_{j+k}` of a finite sequence over any
commutative ring (`aperiodicCorr`, through the zero extension `zeroExtend`), grouping a double sum
by the difference `j - l` (`sum_sum_mul_eq_sum_aperiodicCorr`), folding symmetric sums over
`(-N, N)` (`sum_Ioo_natAbs`) and `(∑ a_j)^2 = c_0 + 2 ∑_{k ≥ 1} c_k`.

Littlewood polynomials `P_a(z) = ∑_{k < N} a_k z^k` with real coefficients and `±1` sequences
(`IsSigning`): on the circle `|P_a|^2 = ∑_{|k| < N} c_{|k|} e_k`, so `∫ |P_a|^2 = ∑ a_k^2` and
`∫ |P_a|^4 = c_0^2 + 2 ∑_{k=1}^{N-1} c_k^2` (`integral_norm_pow_four_littlewoodPoly`). For a `±1`
sequence with off-peak energy `E = ∑_{k ≥ 1} c_k^2` and merit factor `F = N^2 / (2E)`:
`∫ (|P|^2/N - 1)^2 = 1/F`, `∫ (|P|/√N - 1)^2 ≤ 1/F` and, by Lyapunov's inequality on a probability
space (`integral_rpow_le_integral_rpow_rpow`), `∫ ||P|/√N - 1|^p ≤ F^(-p/2)` for `0 < p ≤ 2`.
Some point of the unit circle has `|P| ≥ √N` and another has `|P| ≤ √N`.

Sources: J. E. Littlewood, *Some Problems in Real and Complex Analysis*, Heath (1968);
P. Borwein, *Computational Excursions in Analysis and Number Theory*, Springer (2002);
M. J. E. Golay, *A class of finite binary sequences with alternate auto-correlation values equal
to zero*, IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory 18 (1972) 449–450 (merit factor); T. Høholdt and
H. E. Jensen, *Determination of the merit factor of Legendre sequences*, IEEE Trans. Inform.
Theory 34 (1988) 161–164 (the `L^4` identity); J. Jedwab, *A survey of the merit factor problem
for binary sequences*, SETA 2004, LNCS 3486 (2005) 30–55; Y. Katznelson, *An Introduction to
Harmonic Analysis*, ch. I (Parseval). Classical material; nothing here is specific to a benchmark
problem. There are no periodic correlations, circulant matrices, parity or mod-4 arguments, and no
constructions of flat or Rudin–Shapiro polynomials.

Bridges: a definition `∑ k : Fin N, (ε k : ℂ) * z ^ (k : ℕ)` is `littlewoodPoly ε z` by `rfl`,
`∀ k, ε k = -1 ∨ ε k = 1` is `IsSigning ε` by `Iff.rfl`, and
`∑ j : Fin (n - k), h ⟨j.val, _⟩ * h ⟨j.val + k, _⟩` is `aperiodicCorr h k`
(`aperiodicCorr_eq_sum_fin`). `UnitAddCircle` is `AddCircle 1`, `Real.rpow x p` is `x ^ p`, and
`(meritFactor a)⁻¹` is `2 * offPeakEnergy a / N ^ 2` (`inv_meritFactor`).
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Analysis

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory AddCircle Finset
open scoped ComplexConjugate

section Circle

variable {T : ℝ}

/-- Continuous functions on the circle are integrable for normalised Haar measure. -/
theorem integrable_haarAddCircle_of_continuous [Fact (0 < T)] {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    {f : AddCircle T → E} (hf : Continuous f) : Integrable f haarAddCircle :=
  hf.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace f)

/-- The integral of a character: `∫ e_n = 1` if `n = 0` and `0` otherwise. -/
theorem integral_fourier_haarAddCircle [Fact (0 < T)] (n : ℤ) :
    ∫ t, fourier n t ∂(haarAddCircle (T := T)) = if n = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
  have h := congrFun (fourierCoeff_fourier (T := T) n) 0
  simp only [fourierCoeff, neg_zero, fourier_zero, one_smul] at h
  rw [h, Pi.single_apply]
  exact if_congr eq_comm rfl rfl

theorem norm_fourier_apply (n : ℤ) (t : AddCircle T) : ‖fourier n t‖ = 1 := by
  simp [fourier_apply]

/-- Every point of the unit circle is `e_1 t` for some `t`. -/
theorem exists_fourier_one_eq [hT : Fact (0 < T)] {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) : ∃ t : AddCircle T, fourier 1 t = z := by
  have hT0 : T ≠ 0 := hT.out.ne'
  refine ⟨((T / (2 * Real.pi) * Complex.arg z : ℝ) : AddCircle T), ?_⟩
  rw [fourier_one, toCircle_apply_mk,
    show 2 * Real.pi / T * (T / (2 * Real.pi) * Complex.arg z) = Complex.arg z by
      field_simp, Circle.coe_exp]
  have := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I z
  rw [hz] at this
  simpa using this

/-- Statements over the unit circle `‖z‖ = 1` are statements over `t ↦ e_1 t`. -/
theorem forall_norm_eq_one_iff [Fact (0 < T)] (P : ℂ → Prop) :
    (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ = 1 → P z) ↔ ∀ t : AddCircle T, P (fourier 1 t) := by
  refine ⟨fun h t => h _ (norm_fourier_apply 1 t), fun h z hz => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := exists_fourier_one_eq (T := T) hz
  exact h t

theorem fourier_one_pow (k : ℕ) (t : AddCircle T) : fourier 1 t ^ k = fourier (k : ℤ) t := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ, ih, ← fourier_add]; push_cast; rfl

/-- A continuous real function on the circle reaches its mean from above somewhere. -/
theorem exists_integral_le_apply [Fact (0 < T)] {g : AddCircle T → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) :
    ∃ t, ∫ s, g s ∂haarAddCircle ≤ g t := by
  obtain ⟨t, -, ht⟩ := isCompact_univ.exists_isMaxOn Set.univ_nonempty hg.continuousOn
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  calc ∫ s, g s ∂haarAddCircle ≤ ∫ _s, g t ∂(haarAddCircle (T := T)) :=
        integral_mono (integrable_haarAddCircle_of_continuous hg)
          (integrable_const _) fun s => ht (Set.mem_univ s)
    _ = g t := by simp

/-- A continuous real function on the circle reaches its mean from below somewhere. -/
theorem exists_apply_le_integral [Fact (0 < T)] {g : AddCircle T → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) :
    ∃ t, g t ≤ ∫ s, g s ∂haarAddCircle := by
  obtain ⟨t, -, ht⟩ := isCompact_univ.exists_isMinOn Set.univ_nonempty hg.continuousOn
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  calc g t = ∫ _s, g t ∂(haarAddCircle (T := T)) := by simp
    _ ≤ ∫ s, g s ∂haarAddCircle :=
        integral_mono (integrable_const _) (integrable_haarAddCircle_of_continuous hg)
          fun s => ht (Set.mem_univ s)

end Circle

section TrigPoly

variable {T : ℝ}

/-- The trigonometric polynomial `t ↦ ∑_{k ∈ s} c k e_k(t)`. -/
def trigPoly (s : Finset ℤ) (c : ℤ → ℂ) (t : AddCircle T) : ℂ :=
  ∑ k ∈ s, c k * fourier k t

theorem continuous_trigPoly (s : Finset ℤ) (c : ℤ → ℂ) : Continuous (trigPoly (T := T) s c) := by
  unfold trigPoly
  fun_prop

/-- The mean of a trigonometric polynomial is its constant coefficient. -/
theorem integrable_trigPoly_term [Fact (0 < T)] (a : ℂ) (k : ℤ) :
    Integrable (fun t : AddCircle T => a * fourier k t) haarAddCircle :=
  integrable_haarAddCircle_of_continuous (continuous_const.mul (fourier k).continuous)

theorem integral_trigPoly [Fact (0 < T)] (s : Finset ℤ) (c : ℤ → ℂ) :
    ∫ t, trigPoly s c t ∂(haarAddCircle (T := T)) = if 0 ∈ s then c 0 else 0 := by
  unfold trigPoly
  rw [integral_finsetSum s fun k _ => integrable_trigPoly_term (c k) k]
  simp_rw [integral_const_mul, integral_fourier_haarAddCircle, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  exact Finset.sum_ite_eq' s 0 c

/-- Parseval for finite trigonometric polynomials. -/
theorem integral_norm_sq_trigPoly [Fact (0 < T)] (s : Finset ℤ) (c : ℤ → ℂ) :
    ∫ t, ‖trigPoly s c t‖ ^ 2 ∂(haarAddCircle (T := T)) = ∑ k ∈ s, ‖c k‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hpt : ∀ t : AddCircle T, ((‖trigPoly s c t‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ∑ j ∈ s, ∑ l ∈ s, c j * conj (c l) * fourier (j - l) t := by
    intro t
    push_cast
    rw [← Complex.mul_conj', trigPoly, map_sum, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    rw [map_mul, ← fourier_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, fourier_add]
    ring
  have hint : ∀ j l : ℤ, Integrable (fun t : AddCircle T => c j * conj (c l) * fourier (j - l) t)
      haarAddCircle := fun j l => integrable_trigPoly_term _ _
  have key : ((∫ t, ‖trigPoly s c t‖ ^ 2 ∂(haarAddCircle (T := T)) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ((∑ k ∈ s, ‖c k‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [← integral_complex_ofReal]
    simp_rw [hpt]
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun j _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun l _ => hint j l]
    simp_rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun l _ => hint _ l, integral_const_mul,
      integral_fourier_haarAddCircle, sub_eq_zero, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq, Complex.mul_conj']
    push_cast
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => by simp [hj]
  exact_mod_cast key

theorem trigPoly_eq_add_erase {s : Finset ℤ} (hs : 0 ∈ s) (c : ℤ → ℂ) (t : AddCircle T) :
    trigPoly s c t = c 0 + trigPoly (s.erase 0) c t := by
  rw [trigPoly, trigPoly, ← Finset.add_sum_erase s _ hs, fourier_zero, mul_one]

theorem trigPoly_div (s : Finset ℤ) (c : ℤ → ℂ) (r : ℂ) (t : AddCircle T) :
    trigPoly s (fun k => c k / r) t = trigPoly s c t / r := by
  rw [trigPoly, trigPoly, Finset.sum_div]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => div_mul_eq_mul_div _ _ _

end TrigPoly

section Correlation

variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

/-- Zero extension of a finite sequence to `ℕ`. -/
def zeroExtend {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → R) (j : ℕ) : R :=
  if h : j < N then a ⟨j, h⟩ else 0

theorem zeroExtend_of_lt {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → R) {j : ℕ} (h : j < N) :
    zeroExtend a j = a ⟨j, h⟩ := by
  simp [zeroExtend, h]

theorem zeroExtend_of_le {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → R) {j : ℕ} (h : N ≤ j) :
    zeroExtend a j = 0 := by
  simp [zeroExtend, Nat.not_lt.2 h]

@[simp] theorem zeroExtend_coe {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → R) (j : Fin N) :
    zeroExtend a j = a j := zeroExtend_of_lt a j.2

theorem zeroExtend_comp {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → R) (j : ℕ) :
    zeroExtend (fun k => φ (a k)) j = φ (zeroExtend a j) := by
  unfold zeroExtend
  split_ifs <;> simp

theorem sum_fin_eq_sum_range_zeroExtend {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → R) (f : ℕ → R → R) :
    ∑ j : Fin N, f j (a j) = ∑ j ∈ range N, f j (zeroExtend a j) := by
  rw [Finset.sum_range]
  simp

/-- The aperiodic autocorrelation `c_k = ∑_{j < N - k} a_j a_{j+k}`. -/
def aperiodicCorr {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → R) (k : ℕ) : R :=
  ∑ j ∈ range (N - k), zeroExtend a j * zeroExtend a (j + k)

/-- The `Fin` form `∑ j : Fin (N - k), a ⟨j, _⟩ a ⟨j + k, _⟩` used in challenge statements. -/
theorem aperiodicCorr_eq_sum_fin {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → R) (k : ℕ) :
    aperiodicCorr a k = ∑ j : Fin (N - k), a ⟨j, by omega⟩ * a ⟨j + k, by omega⟩ := by
  rw [aperiodicCorr, Finset.sum_range]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  have := j.2
  rw [zeroExtend_of_lt a (by omega), zeroExtend_of_lt a (by omega)]

theorem aperiodicCorr_of_le {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → R) {k : ℕ} (hk : N ≤ k) :
    aperiodicCorr a k = 0 := by
  simp [aperiodicCorr, Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hk]

theorem aperiodicCorr_zero {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → R) :
    aperiodicCorr a 0 = ∑ j : Fin N, a j ^ 2 := by
  rw [aperiodicCorr, Nat.sub_zero, Finset.sum_range]
  simp [sq]

theorem aperiodicCorr_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → R)
    (k : ℕ) : aperiodicCorr (fun j => φ (a j)) k = φ (aperiodicCorr a k) := by
  simp [aperiodicCorr, zeroExtend_comp, map_sum]

/-- The pairs `(j, l)` with `j - l = m` contribute the correlation `c_m`. -/
theorem sum_sum_ite_sub_eq_nat {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → R) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ j : Fin N, ∑ l : Fin N, (if (j : ℤ) - l = m then a j * a l else 0) =
      aperiodicCorr a m := by
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have inner : ∀ l : Fin N, ∑ j : Fin N, (if (j : ℤ) - l = m then a j * a l else 0) =
      zeroExtend a (l + m) * zeroExtend a l := by
    intro l
    rw [zeroExtend_coe]
    by_cases h : (l : ℕ) + m < N
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨l + m, h⟩, ite_eq_left (by push_cast; ring), zeroExtend_of_lt a h]
      · intro j _ hj
        refine ite_eq_right fun hc => hj (Fin.ext ?_)
        simp only
        omega
      · simp
    · rw [zeroExtend_of_le a (by omega), zero_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => ite_eq_right fun hc => ?_
      have := j.2
      omega
  simp_rw [inner]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun l => zeroExtend a (l + m) * zeroExtend a l) N, aperiodicCorr,
    ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (Nat.sub_le N m)) ?_]
  · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => mul_comm _ _
  · intro j _ hj
    rw [zeroExtend_of_le a (by simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj; omega), zero_mul]

/-- The fibre of `(j, l) ↦ j - l` over `k` carries the correlation `c_{|k|}`. -/
theorem aperiodicCorr_natAbs_eq_sum_sum {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → R) (k : ℤ) :
    aperiodicCorr a k.natAbs =
      ∑ j : Fin N, ∑ l : Fin N, (if (j : ℤ) - l = k then a j * a l else 0) := by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg k
  · rw [Int.natAbs_natCast, sum_sum_ite_sub_eq_nat]
  · rw [Int.natAbs_neg, Int.natAbs_natCast, ← sum_sum_ite_sub_eq_nat, Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    split_ifs <;> first | ring | (exfalso; omega)

/-- Grouping a double sum over `Fin N × Fin N` by the difference `j - l`. -/
theorem sum_sum_mul_eq_sum_aperiodicCorr {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → R) (w : ℤ → R) :
    ∑ j : Fin N, ∑ l : Fin N, a j * a l * w ((j : ℤ) - l) =
      ∑ k ∈ Ioo (-(N : ℤ)) N, aperiodicCorr a k.natAbs * w k := by
  symm
  simp_rw [aperiodicCorr_natAbs_eq_sum_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ite_mul, zero_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := Ioo (-(N : ℤ)) N)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := Ioo (-(N : ℤ)) N)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq, ite_eq_left]
  simp only [Finset.mem_Ioo]
  have := j.2
  have := l.2
  omega

/-- Folding a symmetric sum over `(-N, N)`. -/
theorem sum_Ioo_natAbs {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → M) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    ∑ k ∈ Ioo (-(N : ℤ)) N, f k.natAbs = f 0 + (∑ k ∈ Ico 1 N, f k + ∑ k ∈ Ico 1 N, f k) := by
  induction N, hN using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
    rw [show Ioo (-((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = {0} by
      ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_Ioo, Finset.mem_singleton]; omega]
    simp
  | succ N hN ih =>
    have hset : Ioo (-((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
        insert (-(N : ℤ)) (insert (N : ℤ) (Ioo (-(N : ℤ)) N)) := by
      ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_Ioo, Finset.mem_insert]; omega
    rw [hset, Finset.sum_insert (by simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Ioo]; omega),
      Finset.sum_insert (by simp only [Finset.mem_Ioo]; omega), ih, Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top hN,
      Int.natAbs_neg, Int.natAbs_natCast]
    abel

/-- `(∑ a_j)^2 = c_0 + 2 ∑_{k ≥ 1} c_k`. -/
theorem sq_sum_eq_aperiodicCorr {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → R) :
    (∑ j, a j) ^ 2 = aperiodicCorr a 0 + 2 * ∑ k ∈ Ico 1 N, aperiodicCorr a k := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N with rfl | hN
  · simp [aperiodicCorr]
  have h := sum_sum_mul_eq_sum_aperiodicCorr a (fun _ => 1)
  simp only [mul_one] at h
  rw [sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum, h, sum_Ioo_natAbs (aperiodicCorr a) hN, two_mul]

end Correlation

section Littlewood

variable {T : ℝ} {N : ℕ}

/-- The Littlewood polynomial `P_a(z) = ∑_{k < N} a_k z^k` with real coefficients. -/
def littlewoodPoly (a : Fin N → ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ k : Fin N, (a k : ℂ) * z ^ (k : ℕ)

/-- `a` is a `±1` sequence. -/
def IsSigning (a : Fin N → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k, a k = -1 ∨ a k = 1

theorem IsSigning.sq_eq_one {a : Fin N → ℝ} (ha : IsSigning a) (k : Fin N) : a k ^ 2 = 1 := by
  rcases ha k with h | h <;> simp [h]

theorem IsSigning.abs_eq_one {a : Fin N → ℝ} (ha : IsSigning a) (k : Fin N) : |a k| = 1 := by
  rcases ha k with h | h <;> simp [h]

theorem IsSigning.sum_sq {a : Fin N → ℝ} (ha : IsSigning a) : ∑ k, a k ^ 2 = N := by
  simp [ha.sq_eq_one]

theorem IsSigning.aperiodicCorr_zero {a : Fin N → ℝ} (ha : IsSigning a) :
    aperiodicCorr a 0 = N := by
  rw [TheoremOS.Analysis.aperiodicCorr_zero, ha.sum_sq]

theorem continuous_littlewoodPoly (a : Fin N → ℝ) : Continuous (littlewoodPoly a) := by
  unfold littlewoodPoly
  fun_prop

/-- The trivial bound `‖P z‖ ≤ N` on the unit circle. -/
theorem norm_littlewoodPoly_le {a : Fin N → ℝ} (ha : ∀ k, |a k| ≤ 1) {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) :
    ‖littlewoodPoly a z‖ ≤ N := by
  calc ‖littlewoodPoly a z‖ ≤ ∑ k : Fin N, ‖(a k : ℂ) * z ^ (k : ℕ)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _k : Fin N, (1 : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => by
        rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, hz, one_pow, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact ha k
    _ = N := by simp

theorem littlewoodPoly_fourier_one (a : Fin N → ℝ) (t : AddCircle T) :
    littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t) = ∑ k : Fin N, (a k : ℂ) * fourier (k : ℤ) t := by
  simp_rw [littlewoodPoly, fourier_one_pow]

/-- On the circle, `|P|^2 = ∑_{|k| < N} c_{|k|} e_k`. -/
theorem norm_sq_littlewoodPoly_fourier (a : Fin N → ℝ) (t : AddCircle T) :
    ((‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      trigPoly (Ioo (-(N : ℤ)) N) (fun k => ((aperiodicCorr a k.natAbs : ℝ) : ℂ)) t := by
  have hc : ∀ k, aperiodicCorr (fun j => (a j : ℂ)) k = ((aperiodicCorr a k : ℝ) : ℂ) := fun k => by
    simpa using aperiodicCorr_map Complex.ofRealHom a k
  push_cast
  rw [← Complex.mul_conj', littlewoodPoly_fourier_one, map_sum, Finset.sum_mul_sum, trigPoly]
  simp_rw [← hc]
  rw [← sum_sum_mul_eq_sum_aperiodicCorr (fun j => (a j : ℂ)) (fun k => fourier k t)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
  rw [map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, ← fourier_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, fourier_add]
  ring

/-- `∫ |P|^2 = ∑ a_k^2`. -/
theorem integral_norm_sq_littlewoodPoly [Fact (0 < T)] (a : Fin N → ℝ) :
    ∫ t, ‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ ^ 2 ∂(haarAddCircle (T := T)) = ∑ k, a k ^ 2 := by
  have key : ((∫ t, ‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ ^ 2 ∂(haarAddCircle (T := T)) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ((∑ k, a k ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [← integral_complex_ofReal]
    simp_rw [norm_sq_littlewoodPoly_fourier]
    rw [integral_trigPoly]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [Int.natAbs_zero, aperiodicCorr_zero]
    · have : N = 0 := by simp only [Finset.mem_Ioo] at h; omega
      subst this
      simp
  exact_mod_cast key

/-- The `L^4` identity `∫ |P|^4 = c_0^2 + 2 ∑_{k=1}^{N-1} c_k^2`. -/
theorem integral_norm_pow_four_littlewoodPoly [Fact (0 < T)] (a : Fin N → ℝ) :
    ∫ t, ‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ ^ 4 ∂(haarAddCircle (T := T)) =
      aperiodicCorr a 0 ^ 2 + 2 * ∑ k ∈ Ico 1 N, aperiodicCorr a k ^ 2 := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N with rfl | hN
  · simp [littlewoodPoly, aperiodicCorr]
  have hpt : ∀ t : AddCircle T, ‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ ^ 4 =
      ‖trigPoly (Ioo (-(N : ℤ)) N) (fun k => ((aperiodicCorr a k.natAbs : ℝ) : ℂ)) t‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro t
    rw [← norm_sq_littlewoodPoly_fourier, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    ring
  have hfold := sum_Ioo_natAbs (fun k => ‖((aperiodicCorr a k : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ^ 2) hN
  simp_rw [hpt]
  rw [integral_norm_sq_trigPoly, hfold]
  simp only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  ring

end Littlewood

section MeritFactor

variable {T : ℝ} {N : ℕ}

/-- The off-peak correlation energy `E = ∑_{k=1}^{N-1} c_k^2`. -/
def offPeakEnergy (a : Fin N → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ k ∈ Ico 1 N, aperiodicCorr a k ^ 2

/-- Golay's merit factor `F = N^2 / (2E)`. -/
def meritFactor (a : Fin N → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (N : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * offPeakEnergy a)

theorem inv_meritFactor (a : Fin N → ℝ) :
    (meritFactor a)⁻¹ = 2 * offPeakEnergy a / N ^ 2 :=
  inv_div _ _

theorem IsSigning.integral_norm_pow_four [Fact (0 < T)] {a : Fin N → ℝ} (ha : IsSigning a) :
    ∫ t, ‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ ^ 4 ∂(haarAddCircle (T := T)) =
      N ^ 2 + 2 * offPeakEnergy a := by
  rw [integral_norm_pow_four_littlewoodPoly, ha.aperiodicCorr_zero, offPeakEnergy]

theorem continuous_norm_littlewoodPoly_fourier (a : Fin N → ℝ) :
    Continuous fun t : AddCircle T => ‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ :=
  ((continuous_littlewoodPoly a).comp (fourier 1).continuous).norm

/-- The variance of `|P|^2 / N` is the inverse merit factor. -/
theorem IsSigning.integral_norm_sq_div_sub_one_sq [Fact (0 < T)] {a : Fin N → ℝ}
    (ha : IsSigning a) (hN : 0 < N) :
    ∫ t, (‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ ^ 2 / N - 1) ^ 2 ∂(haarAddCircle (T := T)) =
      2 * offPeakEnergy a / N ^ 2 := by
  have hN' : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hc := continuous_norm_littlewoodPoly_fourier (T := T) a
  have h4 := ha.integral_norm_pow_four (T := T)
  have h2 := integral_norm_sq_littlewoodPoly (T := T) a
  rw [ha.sum_sq] at h2
  have hpt : ∀ t : AddCircle T, (‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ ^ 2 / N - 1) ^ 2 =
      1 / N ^ 2 * ‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ ^ 4 -
        2 / N * ‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ ^ 2 + 1 := fun t => by
    field_simp
    ring
  simp_rw [hpt]
  rw [integral_add, integral_sub, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, h4, h2]
  · simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
    field_simp
    ring
  · exact integrable_haarAddCircle_of_continuous (continuous_const.mul (hc.pow 4))
  · exact integrable_haarAddCircle_of_continuous (continuous_const.mul (hc.pow 2))
  · exact integrable_haarAddCircle_of_continuous
      ((continuous_const.mul (hc.pow 4)).sub (continuous_const.mul (hc.pow 2)))
  · exact integrable_const _

theorem sub_one_sq_le_sq_sub_one_sq {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : (x - 1) ^ 2 ≤ (x ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 := by
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (x - 1)) (show 0 ≤ x ^ 2 + 2 * x by positivity)]

/-- The `L^2` distance of `|P| / √N` from `1` is at most the inverse merit factor. -/
theorem IsSigning.integral_norm_div_sqrt_sub_one_sq_le [Fact (0 < T)] {a : Fin N → ℝ}
    (ha : IsSigning a) (hN : 0 < N) :
    ∫ t, (‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ / √N - 1) ^ 2 ∂(haarAddCircle (T := T)) ≤
      2 * offPeakEnergy a / N ^ 2 := by
  have hc := continuous_norm_littlewoodPoly_fourier (T := T) a
  rw [← ha.integral_norm_sq_div_sub_one_sq (T := T) hN]
  refine integral_mono (integrable_haarAddCircle_of_continuous (by fun_prop))
    (integrable_haarAddCircle_of_continuous (by fun_prop)) fun t => ?_
  have := sub_one_sq_le_sq_sub_one_sq
    (div_nonneg (norm_nonneg (littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t))) (Real.sqrt_nonneg N))
  rwa [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg N)] at this

/-- Lyapunov's inequality on a probability space: `∫ f^p ≤ (∫ f^q)^(p/q)` for `0 < p ≤ q`. -/
theorem integral_rpow_le_integral_rpow_rpow {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {f : α → ℝ} (hf0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hpq : p ≤ q) (hfq : Integrable (fun x => f x ^ q) μ) (hfp : Integrable (fun x => f x ^ p) μ) :
    ∫ x, f x ^ p ∂μ ≤ (∫ x, f x ^ q ∂μ) ^ (p / q) := by
  have hq : 0 < q := hp.trans_le hpq
  have hpt : ∀ x, (f x ^ q) ^ (p / q) = f x ^ p := fun x => by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul (hf0 x)]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  have h := (Real.concaveOn_rpow (div_pos hp hq).le ((div_le_one hq).2 hpq)).le_map_integral
    (f := fun x => f x ^ q) (μ := μ) (Real.continuous_rpow_const (div_pos hp hq).le).continuousOn
    isClosed_Ici (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => Set.mem_Ici.2 (Real.rpow_nonneg (hf0 x) q))
    hfq (hfp.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => (hpt x).symm))
  simp only [hpt] at h
  exact h

/-- `L^p` flatness for `0 < p ≤ 2` from the merit factor. -/
theorem IsSigning.integral_abs_norm_div_sqrt_sub_one_rpow_le [Fact (0 < T)] {a : Fin N → ℝ}
    (ha : IsSigning a) (hN : 0 < N) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp2 : p ≤ 2) :
    ∫ t, |‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ / √N - 1| ^ p ∂(haarAddCircle (T := T)) ≤
      (2 * offPeakEnergy a / N ^ 2) ^ (p / 2) := by
  have hc := continuous_norm_littlewoodPoly_fourier (T := T) a
  have hg : Continuous fun t : AddCircle T => |‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ / √N - 1| := by
    fun_prop
  have hL := integral_rpow_le_integral_rpow_rpow (μ := haarAddCircle (T := T))
    (f := fun t => |‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ / √N - 1|) (fun t => abs_nonneg _) hp hp2
    (integrable_haarAddCircle_of_continuous (hg.rpow_const fun _ => Or.inr (by norm_num)))
    (integrable_haarAddCircle_of_continuous (hg.rpow_const fun _ => Or.inr hp.le))
  refine hL.trans (Real.rpow_le_rpow (integral_nonneg fun t => by positivity) ?_ (by positivity))
  calc ∫ t, |‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ / √N - 1| ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂(haarAddCircle (T := T)) =
        ∫ t, (‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ / √N - 1) ^ 2 ∂(haarAddCircle (T := T)) := by
        simp_rw [Real.rpow_two, sq_abs]
    _ ≤ _ := ha.integral_norm_div_sqrt_sub_one_sq_le hN

/-- Some point of the unit circle has `√N ≤ ‖P z‖`. -/
theorem IsSigning.exists_sqrt_le_norm {a : Fin N → ℝ} (ha : IsSigning a) :
    ∃ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ = 1 ∧ √N ≤ ‖littlewoodPoly a z‖ := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_integral_le_apply (T := 1)
    (g := fun t => ‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ ^ 2)
    ((continuous_norm_littlewoodPoly_fourier (T := 1) a).pow 2)
  rw [integral_norm_sq_littlewoodPoly, ha.sum_sq] at ht
  refine ⟨fourier 1 t, norm_fourier_apply 1 t, ?_⟩
  simpa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)] using Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ht

/-- Some point of the unit circle has `‖P z‖ ≤ √N`. -/
theorem IsSigning.exists_norm_le_sqrt {a : Fin N → ℝ} (ha : IsSigning a) :
    ∃ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ = 1 ∧ ‖littlewoodPoly a z‖ ≤ √N := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_apply_le_integral (T := 1)
    (g := fun t => ‖littlewoodPoly a (fourier 1 t)‖ ^ 2)
    ((continuous_norm_littlewoodPoly_fourier (T := 1) a).pow 2)
  rw [integral_norm_sq_littlewoodPoly, ha.sum_sq] at ht
  refine ⟨fourier 1 t, norm_fourier_apply 1 t, ?_⟩
  simpa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)] using Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ht

end MeritFactor

end

end TheoremOS.Analysis
