import Submission.Library.TheoremOS.Probability.Dobrushin

/-!
# Reversible chains, Dirichlet forms and spectral gaps

A weight vector `π` and a kernel `P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ` on a finite type; `P *ᵥ f` is the chain
acting on observables. Contents: the `π`-weighted product `piInner π f g = ∑ π f g`, the
Dirichlet form `dirichletForm π P f = ⟨f, f - P f⟩_π`, and the spectral gap in Poincaré form
`HasSpectralGap π P γ : ∀ f, γ · Var_π f ≤ E(f)`. Under detailed balance
`π x P x y = π y P y x` with unit row sums: `P` is self-adjoint for `⟨·,·⟩_π`; the edge form
`2 E(f) = ∑ π x P x y (f x - f y)²` and the pair form `2 Var_π f = ∑ π x π y (f x - f y)²`;
`E(f) ≥ 0`; a lazy kernel (`P x x ≥ 1/2`) is positive semidefinite and satisfies
Cauchy–Schwarz for `⟨u, P v⟩_π`. Consequences of a gap `γ` for a lazy reversible kernel:
`Var_π (P f) ≤ (1-γ)² Var_π f` and its iterate, the `L²` mixing bound
`‖P^t(x,·) - π‖_TV ≤ ½ (1-γ)^t √(1/π x - 1)` (for `γ ≤ 1`), the exponential form
`½ e^{-γt} √(1/π x - 1)` (any `γ`), and the uniform case `√N / 2 · e^{-γt}` for a symmetric
kernel. Bounding the gap: canonical paths (Diaconis–Stroock, Sinclair) — edge lists `Γ x y`
whose increments telescope and whose congestion
`∑ x, ∑ y, π x π y |Γ x y| · edgeMultiplicity (Γ x y) e ≤ B π a P a b` at every edge
`e = (a, b)` give `Var_π f ≤ B E(f)`, so gap `1/B`; paths may be given as vertex lists via
`pathEdges`; and the comparison of Dirichlet forms. Also `t`-step detailed balance and the
recursion bridge `k (t+1) x y = ∑ z, k t x z * P z y` ⟹ `k t = P ^ t`.

Sources: D. A. Levin and Y. Peres, *Markov Chains and Mixing Times*, 2nd ed., AMS, 2017,
§12.1–12.2 (spectral representation, relaxation time, `L²` bound), §13.2–13.4 (Dirichlet form,
spectral gap as a Poincaré constant, comparison, canonical paths); P. Diaconis and D. Stroock,
*Geometric bounds for eigenvalues of Markov chains*, Ann. Appl. Probab. 1 (1991) 36–61;
A. Sinclair, *Improved bounds for mixing rates of Markov chains and multicommodity flow*,
Combin. Probab. Comput. 1 (1992) 351–370; P. Diaconis and L. Saloff-Coste, *Comparison
theorems for reversible Markov chains*, Ann. Appl. Probab. 3 (1993) 696–730. Textbook
material; nothing here is specific to a benchmark problem.

Bridges: an average `(∑ x, f x) / N` with `N = Fintype.card Ω` is
`expectation (uniform Ω) f` by `expectation_uniform`, so a uniform inner product or variance
written that way is `piInner (uniform Ω) f g` or `variance (uniform Ω) f`; an operator
`fun x => ∑ y, K x y * f y` is `K *ᵥ f` by `rfl`; a kernel power defined by recursion
`k 0 = 1`, `k (t+1) x y = ∑ z, k t x z * K z y` is `K ^ t` by `eq_pow_of_recursion`; a sum over
a `Finset` that is `Finset.univ` by definition (`allStates`) unfolds to `∑ x` first. The TV
distance of the row `(P ^ t) x` from `π` is `tvDist ((P ^ t) x) π`.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Probability

open Finset Matrix
open TheoremOS.InformationTheory
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

section Paths

variable {α : Type*}

/-- The consecutive pairs `(v₀, v₁), (v₁, v₂), …` of a vertex list. -/
def pathEdges : List α → List (α × α)
  | [] => []
  | [_] => []
  | a :: b :: l => (a, b) :: pathEdges (b :: l)

/-- Increments along the edges of a vertex list telescope. -/
theorem sum_pathEdges (f : α → ℝ) (a : α) (l : List α) :
    ((pathEdges (a :: l)).map fun e => f e.2 - f e.1).sum =
      f ((a :: l).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil a l)) - f a := by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => simp [pathEdges]
  | cons b l ih =>
    simp only [pathEdges, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ih, List.getLast_cons_cons]
    ring

theorem sum_pathEdges_of_head_last (f : α → ℝ) {l : List α} {x y : α}
    (hx : l.head? = some x) (hy : l.getLast? = some y) :
    ((pathEdges l).map fun e => f e.2 - f e.1).sum = f y - f x := by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons a l =>
    simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hx
    rw [List.getLast?_eq_some_getLast (List.cons_ne_nil a l), Option.some.injEq] at hy
    rw [sum_pathEdges, hy, hx]

/-- Cauchy–Schwarz for a list: `(∑ aᵢ)² ≤ n ∑ aᵢ²`. -/
theorem sq_list_sum_le (l : List ℝ) : l.sum ^ 2 ≤ l.length * (l.map (· ^ 2)).sum := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.sum_cons, List.map_cons, List.length_cons]
    push_cast
    have hQ : 0 ≤ (l.map (· ^ 2)).sum :=
      List.sum_nonneg fun x hx => by
        obtain ⟨y, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
        exact sq_nonneg y
    by_cases hl : l = []
    · subst hl; simp
    have hn : (0 : ℝ) < l.length := by exact_mod_cast List.length_pos_of_ne_nil hl
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((l.length : ℝ) * a - l.sum), mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih
      (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ l.length + 1)]

end Paths

variable {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]

section Forms

/-- The `π`-weighted product `∑ x, π x * f x * g x`. -/
def piInner (π f g : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ x, π x * f x * g x

/-- The Dirichlet form `⟨f, f - P f⟩_π`. -/
def dirichletForm (π : Ω → ℝ) (P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  piInner π f (fun x => f x - (P *ᵥ f) x)

/-- Spectral gap at least `γ`, in Poincaré form: `γ Var_π f ≤ E(f)` for every `f`. -/
def HasSpectralGap (π : Ω → ℝ) (P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ) (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ f : Ω → ℝ, γ * variance π f ≤ dirichletForm π P f

lemma piInner_comm (π f g : Ω → ℝ) : piInner π f g = piInner π g f := by
  unfold piInner
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => by ring

lemma piInner_self_nonneg {π : Ω → ℝ} (hπ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ π x) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ piInner π f f :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => by rw [mul_assoc]; exact mul_nonneg (hπ x) (mul_self_nonneg _)

lemma dirichletForm_eq (π : Ω → ℝ) (P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    dirichletForm π P f = piInner π f f - piInner π f (P *ᵥ f) := by
  simp only [dirichletForm, piInner, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => by ring

/-- An average `(∑ x, f x) / N` is the expectation under the uniform distribution. -/
lemma expectation_uniform (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    expectation (uniform Ω) f = (∑ x, f x) / (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) := by
  simp only [expectation, uniform, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring

lemma HasSpectralGap.mono {π : Ω → ℝ} (hπ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ π x) {P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ} {γ γ' : ℝ}
    (h : HasSpectralGap π P γ) (hγ : γ' ≤ γ) : HasSpectralGap π P γ' := fun f =>
  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hγ (variance_nonneg hπ f)).trans (h f)

/-- **Comparison**: if `E_Q ≤ A E_P` and `Q` has gap `γ`, then `P` has gap `γ / A`. -/
theorem HasSpectralGap.of_dirichletForm_le {π : Ω → ℝ} {P Q : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ} {γ A : ℝ}
    (hA : 0 < A) (hQ : HasSpectralGap π Q γ)
    (hcmp : ∀ f, dirichletForm π Q f ≤ A * dirichletForm π P f) :
    HasSpectralGap π P (γ / A) := fun f => by
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hA]
  linarith [hQ f, hcmp f, mul_comm A (dirichletForm π P f)]

lemma variance_eq_piInner {π g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : expectation π g = 0) :
    variance π g = piInner π g g := by
  unfold variance piInner
  rw [hg]
  simp only [expectation, sub_zero]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => by ring

lemma expectation_sub_const {π : Ω → ℝ} (hπ : IsDistribution π) (f : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    expectation π (fun x => f x - c) = expectation π f - c := by
  simp only [expectation, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hπ.sum_eq_one,
    one_mul]

lemma variance_sub_const {π : Ω → ℝ} (hπ : IsDistribution π) (f : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    variance π (fun x => f x - c) = variance π f := by
  unfold variance
  rw [expectation_sub_const hπ f c]
  simp only [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right]

/-- Pair form of the variance: `2 Var_π f = ∑ x, ∑ y, π x π y (f x - f y)²`. -/
theorem two_mul_variance {π : Ω → ℝ} (hπ : IsDistribution π) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    2 * variance π f = ∑ x, ∑ y, π x * π y * (f x - f y) ^ 2 := by
  have h : ∀ x y, π x * π y * (f x - f y) ^ 2 =
      π y * (π x * f x ^ 2) - 2 * (π x * f x) * (π y * f y) + π x * (π y * f y ^ 2) :=
    fun x y => by ring
  simp only [h, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul,
    ← Finset.mul_sum, hπ.sum_eq_one, one_mul]
  rw [variance_eq hπ]
  simp only [expectation]
  ring

end Forms

section Reversible

variable {π : Ω → ℝ} {P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ}

/-- Detailed balance with unit row sums makes `π` stationary. -/
lemma sum_mul_eq_of_detailedBalance (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1)
    (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x) (y : Ω) : ∑ x, π x * P x y = π y :=
  congrFun (vecMul_eq_of_detailedBalance hrow hrev) y

/-- A reversible kernel is self-adjoint for `⟨·,·⟩_π`. -/
theorem piInner_mulVec_comm (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x) (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    piInner π f (P *ᵥ g) = piInner π (P *ᵥ f) g := by
  simp only [piInner, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by
    linear_combination f y * g x * hrev y x

/-- `∑ x, ∑ y, π x P x y (f x + c f y)² = (1 + c²) ⟨f, f⟩_π + 2c ⟨f, P f⟩_π`. -/
theorem sum_mul_add_smul_sq (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1)
    (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x) (f : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    ∑ x, ∑ y, π x * P x y * (f x + c * f y) ^ 2 =
      (1 + c ^ 2) * piInner π f f + 2 * c * piInner π f (P *ᵥ f) := by
  have h1 : ∑ x, ∑ y, π x * P x y * f x ^ 2 = piInner π f f := by
    unfold piInner
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, hrow x]
    ring
  have h2 : ∑ x, ∑ y, π x * P x y * (f x * f y) = piInner π f (P *ᵥ f) := by
    simp only [piInner, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by ring
  have h3 : ∑ x, ∑ y, π x * P x y * f y ^ 2 = piInner π f f := by
    unfold piInner
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, sum_mul_eq_of_detailedBalance hrow hrev y]
    ring
  have split : ∀ x y, π x * P x y * (f x + c * f y) ^ 2 =
      π x * P x y * f x ^ 2 + 2 * c * (π x * P x y * (f x * f y)) +
        c ^ 2 * (π x * P x y * f y ^ 2) := fun x y => by ring
  simp only [split, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, h1, h2, h3]
  ring

/-- **Edge form**: `2 E(f) = ∑ x, ∑ y, π x P x y (f x - f y)²`. -/
theorem two_mul_dirichletForm (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1)
    (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    2 * dirichletForm π P f = ∑ x, ∑ y, π x * P x y * (f x - f y) ^ 2 := by
  have h := sum_mul_add_smul_sq hrow hrev f (-1)
  simp only [neg_one_mul, ← sub_eq_add_neg] at h
  rw [h, dirichletForm_eq]
  ring

theorem dirichletForm_nonneg (hπ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ π x) (hP : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y)
    (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ dirichletForm π P f := by
  have h := two_mul_dirichletForm hrow hrev f
  have : 0 ≤ ∑ x, ∑ y, π x * P x y * (f x - f y) ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun y _ =>
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hπ x) (hP x y)) (sq_nonneg _)
  linarith

/-- A lazy reversible kernel (`P x x ≥ 1/2`) is positive semidefinite for `⟨·,·⟩_π`. -/
theorem piInner_mulVec_nonneg (hπ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ π x) (hP : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y)
    (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x)
    (hlazy : ∀ x, 1 / 2 ≤ P x x) (f : Ω → ℝ) : 0 ≤ piInner π f (P *ᵥ f) := by
  have h := sum_mul_add_smul_sq hrow hrev f 1
  simp only [one_mul, one_pow, mul_one] at h
  have hdiag : ∀ x, π x * (2 * f x ^ 2) ≤ ∑ y, π x * P x y * (f x + f y) ^ 2 := fun x => by
    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun y => π x * P x y * (f x + f y) ^ 2)
      (fun y _ => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hπ x) (hP x y)) (sq_nonneg _)) (Finset.mem_univ x)
    have hx : π x * (2 * f x ^ 2) ≤ π x * P x x * (f x + f x) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hlazy x) (mul_nonneg (hπ x) (sq_nonneg (f x)))]
    exact hx.trans hle
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum fun x (_ : x ∈ Finset.univ) => hdiag x
  have hval : ∑ x, π x * (2 * f x ^ 2) = 2 * piInner π f f := by
    simp only [piInner, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => by ring
  nlinarith

/-- **Cauchy–Schwarz** for the form `⟨u, P v⟩_π` of a lazy reversible kernel. -/
theorem sq_piInner_mulVec_le (hπ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ π x) (hP : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y)
    (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x)
    (hlazy : ∀ x, 1 / 2 ≤ P x x) (u v : Ω → ℝ) :
    piInner π u (P *ᵥ v) ^ 2 ≤ piInner π u (P *ᵥ u) * piInner π v (P *ᵥ v) := by
  have hsym : piInner π v (P *ᵥ u) = piInner π u (P *ᵥ v) := by
    rw [piInner_mulVec_comm hrev, piInner_comm]
  have hq : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ piInner π v (P *ᵥ v) * (s * s) + 2 * piInner π u (P *ᵥ v) * s +
      piInner π u (P *ᵥ u) := fun s => by
    have h0 := piInner_mulVec_nonneg hπ hP hrow hrev hlazy (u + s • v)
    have hexp : piInner π (u + s • v) (P *ᵥ (u + s • v)) = piInner π u (P *ᵥ u) +
        s * piInner π u (P *ᵥ v) + s * piInner π v (P *ᵥ u) +
          s * s * piInner π v (P *ᵥ v) := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul]
      simp only [piInner, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [hexp, hsym] at h0
    nlinarith
  have hd := discrim_le_zero hq
  unfold discrim at hd
  nlinarith

end Reversible

section Contraction

variable {π : Ω → ℝ} {P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ}

/-- A stationary `π` keeps expectations: `E_π (P f) = E_π f`. -/
lemma expectation_mulVec (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1)
    (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    expectation π (P *ᵥ f) = expectation π f := by
  change π ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ f) = π ⬝ᵥ f
  rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, vecMul_eq_of_detailedBalance hrow hrev]

lemma expectation_pow_mulVec [DecidableEq Ω] (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1)
    (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x) (t : ℕ) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    expectation π (P ^ t *ᵥ f) = expectation π f := by
  change π ⬝ᵥ (P ^ t *ᵥ f) = π ⬝ᵥ f
  rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, vecMul_pow_eq_self (vecMul_eq_of_detailedBalance hrow hrev)]

/-- A gap `γ` contracts mean-zero functions: `‖P g‖²_π ≤ (1-γ)² ‖g‖²_π`. -/
theorem piInner_mulVec_self_le (hπ : IsDistribution π) (hP : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y)
    (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x)
    (hlazy : ∀ x, 1 / 2 ≤ P x x) {γ : ℝ} (hgap : HasSpectralGap π P γ) {g : Ω → ℝ}
    (hg : expectation π g = 0) :
    piInner π (P *ᵥ g) (P *ᵥ g) ≤ (1 - γ) ^ 2 * piInner π g g := by
  have hbound : ∀ h : Ω → ℝ, expectation π h = 0 →
      piInner π h (P *ᵥ h) ≤ (1 - γ) * piInner π h h := fun h hh => by
    have := hgap h
    rw [variance_eq_piInner hh, dirichletForm_eq] at this
    linarith
  have hPg : expectation π (P *ᵥ g) = 0 := by rw [expectation_mulVec hrow hrev, hg]
  have hX : piInner π g (P *ᵥ (P *ᵥ g)) = piInner π (P *ᵥ g) (P *ᵥ g) :=
    piInner_mulVec_comm hrev g (P *ᵥ g)
  have hcs := sq_piInner_mulVec_le hπ.nonneg hP hrow hrev hlazy g (P *ᵥ g)
  rw [hX] at hcs
  have hA := hbound g hg
  have hB := hbound (P *ᵥ g) hPg
  have hA0 := piInner_mulVec_nonneg hπ.nonneg hP hrow hrev hlazy g
  have hB0 := piInner_mulVec_nonneg hπ.nonneg hP hrow hrev hlazy (P *ᵥ g)
  have hX0 := piInner_self_nonneg hπ.nonneg (P *ᵥ g)
  have hG0 := piInner_self_nonneg hπ.nonneg g
  have hsq : piInner π (P *ᵥ g) (P *ᵥ g) ^ 2 ≤
      (1 - γ) ^ 2 * piInner π g g * piInner π (P *ᵥ g) (P *ᵥ g) :=
    calc _ ≤ _ := hcs
      _ ≤ ((1 - γ) * piInner π g g) * ((1 - γ) * piInner π (P *ᵥ g) (P *ᵥ g)) :=
          mul_le_mul hA hB hB0 (hA0.trans hA)
      _ = _ := by ring
  rcases hX0.eq_or_lt with h0 | hpos
  · rw [← h0]
    exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hG0
  · nlinarith

/-- **Variance contraction**: a gap `γ` for a lazy reversible kernel gives
`Var_π (P f) ≤ (1-γ)² Var_π f`. -/
theorem variance_mulVec_le (hπ : IsDistribution π) (hP : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y)
    (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x)
    (hlazy : ∀ x, 1 / 2 ≤ P x x) {γ : ℝ} (hgap : HasSpectralGap π P γ) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    variance π (P *ᵥ f) ≤ (1 - γ) ^ 2 * variance π f := by
  obtain ⟨g, hgdef⟩ : ∃ g : Ω → ℝ, g = fun x => f x - expectation π f := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hg : expectation π g = 0 := by rw [hgdef, expectation_sub_const hπ, sub_self]
  have hPg : P *ᵥ g = fun x => (P *ᵥ f) x - expectation π f := by
    funext x
    simp only [hgdef, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
      ← Finset.sum_mul, hrow x, one_mul]
  have hPg0 : expectation π (P *ᵥ g) = 0 := by rw [expectation_mulVec hrow hrev, hg]
  have h1 : variance π (P *ᵥ f) = piInner π (P *ᵥ g) (P *ᵥ g) := by
    rw [← variance_eq_piInner hPg0, hPg, ← expectation_mulVec hrow hrev f,
      variance_sub_const hπ]
  have h2 : variance π f = piInner π g g := by
    rw [← variance_eq_piInner hg, hgdef, variance_sub_const hπ]
  rw [h1, h2]
  exact piInner_mulVec_self_le hπ hP hrow hrev hlazy hgap hg

theorem variance_pow_mulVec_le [DecidableEq Ω] (hπ : IsDistribution π) (hP : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y)
    (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x)
    (hlazy : ∀ x, 1 / 2 ≤ P x x) {γ : ℝ} (hgap : HasSpectralGap π P γ) (f : Ω → ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    variance π (P ^ t *ᵥ f) ≤ ((1 - γ) ^ 2) ^ t * variance π f := by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [pow_succ' P t, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    calc variance π (P *ᵥ (P ^ t *ᵥ f))
        ≤ (1 - γ) ^ 2 * variance π (P ^ t *ᵥ f) :=
          variance_mulVec_le hπ hP hrow hrev hlazy hgap _
      _ ≤ (1 - γ) ^ 2 * (((1 - γ) ^ 2) ^ t * variance π f) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = ((1 - γ) ^ 2) ^ (t + 1) * variance π f := by ring

/-- `t`-step detailed balance. -/
theorem pow_detailedBalance [DecidableEq Ω] (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x)
    (t : ℕ) (x y : Ω) : π x * (P ^ t) x y = π y * (P ^ t) y x := by
  induction t generalizing x y with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero]
    by_cases h : x = y
    · subst h; rfl
    · rw [Matrix.one_apply_ne h, Matrix.one_apply_ne (Ne.symm h), mul_zero, mul_zero]
  | succ t ih =>
    have hl : π x * (P ^ (t + 1)) x y = ∑ z, π x * ((P ^ t) x z * P z y) := by
      rw [pow_succ, Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
    have hr : π y * (P ^ (t + 1)) y x = ∑ z, π y * (P y z * (P ^ t) z x) := by
      rw [pow_succ', Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [hl, hr]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => by
      linear_combination P z y * ih x z + (P ^ t) z x * hrev z y

end Contraction

section Mixing

variable [DecidableEq Ω] {π : Ω → ℝ} {P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ}

/-- **`L²` mixing bound**: for a lazy reversible kernel with gap `γ ≤ 1`,
`‖P^t(x,·) - π‖_TV ≤ ½ (1-γ)^t √(1/π x - 1)`. -/
theorem tvDist_pow_row_le_of_spectralGap (hπ : IsDistribution π) (hP : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y)
    (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x)
    (hlazy : ∀ x, 1 / 2 ≤ P x x) {γ : ℝ} (hγ : γ ≤ 1) (hgap : HasSpectralGap π P γ)
    {x : Ω} (hx : 0 < π x) (t : ℕ) :
    tvDist ((P ^ t) x) π ≤ 1 / 2 * (1 - γ) ^ t * Real.sqrt (1 / π x - 1) := by
  obtain ⟨h0, hh0⟩ : ∃ h0 : Ω → ℝ, h0 = Pi.single x (1 / π x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hinv : π x * (1 / π x) = 1 := mul_one_div_cancel hx.ne'
  have hu : ∀ y, (P ^ t *ᵥ h0) y * π x = (P ^ t) y x := fun y => by
    simp only [hh0, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct_single]
    rw [mul_assoc, one_div_mul_cancel hx.ne', mul_one]
  have hdiff : ∀ y, (P ^ t) x y - π y = π y * ((P ^ t *ᵥ h0) y - 1) := fun y => by
    have hb := pow_detailedBalance hrev t x y
    rw [← hu y] at hb
    have : π x * ((P ^ t) x y - π y * ((P ^ t *ᵥ h0) y - 1) - π y) = 0 := by
      linear_combination hb
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 this with h | h
    · exact absurd h hx.ne'
    · linarith
  have hE0 : expectation π h0 = 1 := by
    change π ⬝ᵥ h0 = 1
    rw [hh0, dotProduct_single, hinv]
  have hsq : (fun ω => h0 ω ^ 2) = Pi.single x ((1 / π x) ^ 2) := by
    funext ω
    rw [hh0]
    by_cases h : ω = x
    · subst h; simp
    · simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne h]
  have hV0 : variance π h0 = 1 / π x - 1 := by
    rw [variance_eq hπ, hE0, hsq]
    change π ⬝ᵥ Pi.single x ((1 / π x) ^ 2) - 1 ^ 2 = 1 / π x - 1
    rw [dotProduct_single, sq, ← mul_assoc, hinv, one_mul, one_pow]
  have hEu : expectation π (P ^ t *ᵥ h0) = 1 := by
    rw [expectation_pow_mulVec hrow hrev, hE0]
  have hVu : variance π (P ^ t *ᵥ h0) ≤ ((1 - γ) ^ 2) ^ t * (1 / π x - 1) := by
    rw [← hV0]
    exact variance_pow_mulVec_le hπ hP hrow hrev hlazy hgap h0 t
  have hcs : expectation π (fun y => |(P ^ t *ᵥ h0) y - 1|) ≤
      Real.sqrt (variance π (P ^ t *ᵥ h0)) := by
    have h1 := sq_expectation_le hπ (fun y => |(P ^ t *ᵥ h0) y - 1|)
    have h2 : expectation π (fun y => |(P ^ t *ᵥ h0) y - 1| ^ 2) =
        variance π (P ^ t *ᵥ h0) := by
      simp only [variance, hEu, sq_abs]
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (Real.abs_le_sqrt h1)
  have habs : ∀ y, |(P ^ t) x y - π y| = π y * |(P ^ t *ᵥ h0) y - 1| := fun y => by
    rw [hdiff y, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hπ.nonneg y)]
  have hct : 0 ≤ (1 - γ) ^ t := pow_nonneg (by linarith) t
  calc tvDist ((P ^ t) x) π = 1 / 2 * expectation π (fun y => |(P ^ t *ᵥ h0) y - 1|) := by
        simp only [tvDist, habs]
        rfl
    _ ≤ 1 / 2 * Real.sqrt (((1 - γ) ^ 2) ^ t * (1 / π x - 1)) := by
        gcongr
        exact hcs.trans (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hVu)
    _ = 1 / 2 * (1 - γ) ^ t * Real.sqrt (1 / π x - 1) := by
        rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm 2 t, pow_mul, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq hct]
        ring

/-- Exponential form, for any gap `γ`: `‖P^t(x,·) - π‖_TV ≤ ½ e^{-γt} √(1/π x - 1)`. -/
theorem tvDist_pow_row_le_exp (hπ : IsDistribution π) (hP : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y)
    (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x)
    (hlazy : ∀ x, 1 / 2 ≤ P x x) {γ : ℝ} (hgap : HasSpectralGap π P γ) {x : Ω}
    (hx : 0 < π x) (t : ℕ) :
    tvDist ((P ^ t) x) π ≤ 1 / 2 * Real.exp (-(γ * t)) * Real.sqrt (1 / π x - 1) := by
  rcases le_or_gt γ 1 with hγ | hγ
  · refine (tvDist_pow_row_le_of_spectralGap hπ hP hrow hrev hlazy hγ hgap hx t).trans ?_
    have h1 : (1 - γ) ^ t ≤ Real.exp (-(γ * t)) := by
      rw [show -(γ * t) = (t : ℝ) * -γ by ring, Real.exp_nat_mul]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) (by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (-γ)]) t
    gcongr
  · refine (tvDist_pow_row_le_of_spectralGap hπ hP hrow hrev hlazy le_rfl
      (hgap.mono hπ.nonneg hγ.le) hx t).trans ?_
    have h1 : (1 - 1 : ℝ) ^ t ≤ Real.exp (-(γ * t)) := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t with rfl | ht
      · simp
      · rw [sub_self, zero_pow ht.ne']
        exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    gcongr

/-- Uniform case: a lazy symmetric kernel with gap `γ` on `N` states has
`‖P^t(x,·) - uniform‖_TV ≤ √N / 2 · e^{-γt}`. -/
theorem tvDist_pow_row_uniform_le_exp (hP : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1)
    (hsym : ∀ x y, P x y = P y x) (hlazy : ∀ x, 1 / 2 ≤ P x x) {γ : ℝ}
    (hgap : HasSpectralGap (uniform Ω) P γ) (x : Ω) (t : ℕ) :
    tvDist ((P ^ t) x) (uniform Ω) ≤
      Real.sqrt (Fintype.card Ω) / 2 * Real.exp (-(γ * t)) := by
  have : Nonempty Ω := ⟨x⟩
  have hx : 0 < uniform Ω x := by unfold uniform; positivity
  have hrev : ∀ x y, uniform Ω x * P x y = uniform Ω y * P y x := fun x y => by
    rw [hsym x y]
    simp only [uniform]
  have hN : Real.sqrt (1 / uniform Ω x - 1) ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card Ω) := by
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    simp only [uniform, one_div, inv_inv]
    linarith
  calc tvDist ((P ^ t) x) (uniform Ω)
      ≤ 1 / 2 * Real.exp (-(γ * t)) * Real.sqrt (1 / uniform Ω x - 1) :=
        tvDist_pow_row_le_exp isDistribution_uniform hP hrow hrev hlazy hgap hx t
    _ ≤ 1 / 2 * Real.exp (-(γ * t)) * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card Ω) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hN (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

end Mixing

section CanonicalPaths

variable [DecidableEq Ω] {π : Ω → ℝ} {P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ}

omit [Fintype Ω] in
/-- Number of times the edge `e` occurs in the list `l`. -/
def edgeMultiplicity (l : List (Ω × Ω)) (e : Ω × Ω) : ℕ := l.countP fun e' => decide (e' = e)

lemma sum_map_eq_sum_edgeCount (l : List (Ω × Ω)) (D : Ω × Ω → ℝ) :
    (l.map D).sum = ∑ e, (edgeMultiplicity l e : ℝ) * D e := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [edgeMultiplicity]
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ih, edgeMultiplicity, List.countP_cons,
      decide_eq_true_eq, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ite, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero, add_mul,
      ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ,
      ite_true]
    ring

/-- **Canonical paths** (Diaconis–Stroock, Sinclair). Let `Γ x y` be a list of edges whose
increments telescope to `f y - f x`, and let the congestion of every edge `(a, b)` be at most
`B π a P a b`. Then `Var_π f ≤ B E(f)`. -/
theorem variance_le_of_paths (hπ : IsDistribution π) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1)
    (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x) (Γ : Ω → Ω → List (Ω × Ω)) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hΓ : ∀ x y, ((Γ x y).map fun e => f e.2 - f e.1).sum = f y - f x) {B : ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ e : Ω × Ω, ∑ x, ∑ y, π x * π y * (Γ x y).length * edgeMultiplicity (Γ x y) e ≤
      B * (π e.1 * P e.1 e.2)) :
    variance π f ≤ B * dirichletForm π P f := by
  have hpath : ∀ x y, (f x - f y) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ e, ((Γ x y).length : ℝ) *
      edgeMultiplicity (Γ x y) e * (f e.1 - f e.2) ^ 2 := fun x y => by
    have h := sq_list_sum_le ((Γ x y).map fun e => f e.2 - f e.1)
    rw [hΓ, List.length_map, List.map_map, sum_map_eq_sum_edgeCount, Finset.mul_sum] at h
    rw [← neg_sub, neg_sq]
    refine h.trans (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_))
    simp only [Function.comp]
    ring
  have hswap : ∀ g : Ω → Ω → Ω × Ω → ℝ,
      ∑ x, ∑ y, ∑ e, g x y e = ∑ e, ∑ x, ∑ y, g x y e := fun g =>
    (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => Finset.sum_comm).trans Finset.sum_comm
  have hmain : ∑ x, ∑ y, π x * π y * (f x - f y) ^ 2 ≤
      B * ∑ x, ∑ y, π x * P x y * (f x - f y) ^ 2 := by
    calc ∑ x, ∑ y, π x * π y * (f x - f y) ^ 2
        ≤ ∑ x, ∑ y, ∑ e, π x * π y * (((Γ x y).length : ℝ) * edgeMultiplicity (Γ x y) e *
            (f e.1 - f e.2) ^ 2) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun y _ => ?_
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpath x y)
            (mul_nonneg (hπ.nonneg x) (hπ.nonneg y))
      _ = ∑ e, (∑ x, ∑ y, π x * π y * (Γ x y).length * edgeMultiplicity (Γ x y) e) *
            (f e.1 - f e.2) ^ 2 := by
          rw [hswap]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by ring
      _ ≤ ∑ e : Ω × Ω, B * (π e.1 * P e.1 e.2) * (f e.1 - f e.2) ^ 2 :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun e _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB e) (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = B * ∑ x, ∑ y, π x * P x y * (f x - f y) ^ 2 := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by ring
  have hV := two_mul_variance hπ f
  have hE := two_mul_dirichletForm hrow hrev f
  rw [← hV, ← hE] at hmain
  linarith

/-- Spectral gap from canonical paths with congestion `B`: gap at least `1 / B`. -/
theorem hasSpectralGap_of_paths (hπ : IsDistribution π) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1)
    (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x) (Γ : Ω → Ω → List (Ω × Ω))
    (hΓ : ∀ f : Ω → ℝ, ∀ x y, ((Γ x y).map fun e => f e.2 - f e.1).sum = f y - f x)
    {B : ℝ} (hBpos : 0 < B)
    (hB : ∀ e : Ω × Ω, ∑ x, ∑ y, π x * π y * (Γ x y).length * edgeMultiplicity (Γ x y) e ≤
      B * (π e.1 * P e.1 e.2)) :
    HasSpectralGap π P (1 / B) := fun f => by
  rw [one_div, inv_mul_le_iff₀ hBpos]
  exact variance_le_of_paths hπ hrow hrev Γ f (hΓ f) hB

/-- Canonical paths given as vertex lists from `x` to `y`. -/
theorem hasSpectralGap_of_vertexPaths (hπ : IsDistribution π) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1)
    (hrev : ∀ x y, π x * P x y = π y * P y x) (path : Ω → Ω → List Ω)
    (hhead : ∀ x y, (path x y).head? = some x) (hlast : ∀ x y, (path x y).getLast? = some y)
    {B : ℝ} (hBpos : 0 < B)
    (hB : ∀ e : Ω × Ω, ∑ x, ∑ y, π x * π y * (pathEdges (path x y)).length *
      edgeMultiplicity (pathEdges (path x y)) e ≤ B * (π e.1 * P e.1 e.2)) :
    HasSpectralGap π P (1 / B) :=
  hasSpectralGap_of_paths hπ hrow hrev (fun x y => pathEdges (path x y))
    (fun f x y => sum_pathEdges_of_head_last f (hhead x y) (hlast x y)) hBpos hB

end CanonicalPaths

/-- A kernel power defined by recursion is the matrix power. -/
theorem eq_pow_of_recursion [DecidableEq Ω] (P : Matrix Ω Ω ℝ) (k : ℕ → Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (h0 : ∀ x, k 0 x x = 1) (h0' : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → k 0 x y = 0)
    (hs : ∀ t x y, k (t + 1) x y = ∑ z, k t x z * P z y) (t : ℕ) (x y : Ω) :
    k t x y = (P ^ t) x y := by
  induction t generalizing y with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero]
    by_cases h : x = y
    · subst h; rw [h0, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
    · rw [h0' x y h, Matrix.one_apply_ne h]
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [hs, pow_succ, Matrix.mul_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => by rw [ih]

end

end TheoremOS.Probability

import Mathlib

/-!
# The uniform law on the unit sphere and the standard Gaussian

For a finite-dimensional real inner product space `E` with its volume, `sphereLaw E` is the cone
measure `volume.toSphere` normalised to total mass one, a measure on the subtype
`Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1`, and `ambientSphereLaw E` is its push-forward to `E`. Contents: both are
probability measures when `E` is nontrivial; the cone formula
`sphereLaw s = volume (Ioo 0 1 • s) / volume (ball 0 1)`; invariance under every linear isometry
equivalence (`sphereMap f` restricts `f` to the sphere); `‖x‖ = 1` almost surely; the moments
`∫ ⟪x, u⟫ = 0`, `∫ ⟪x, u⟫² = ‖u‖² / dim E` and `∫ ⟪x, u⟫ ⟪x, v⟫ = ⟪u, v⟫ / dim E`; the cap lower
bound `sphereLaw (ball x ε) ≥ (min ε 2 / 4) ^ dim E`; for the standard Gaussian `stdGaussian E`,
the law of `⟪x, u⟫` is `gaussianReal 0 ‖u‖²`, `∫ ⟪x, u⟫ ⟪x, v⟫ = ⟪u, v⟫` and `∫ ‖x‖² = dim E`;
the density `stdGaussian E = volume.withDensity gaussianDensity`; and polar decomposition: every
probability measure with a radial density, in particular `stdGaussian E`, is sent to
`ambientSphereLaw E` by `x ↦ ‖x‖⁻¹ • x`.

Sources: R. Vershynin, *High-Dimensional Probability*, Cambridge University Press, 2018,
Sections 3.3–3.4 (uniform and Gaussian distributions on the sphere, rotation invariance,
isotropy); G. B. Folland, *Real Analysis*, 2nd ed., Wiley, 1999, Section 2.7 (integration in
polar coordinates); R. J. Muirhead, *Aspects of Multivariate Statistical Theory*, Wiley, 1982,
Theorem 1.5.6 (`g / ‖g‖` is uniform on the sphere). Textbook material; nothing here is specific to
a benchmark problem.

Bridges: a statement defining `let σ := (volume : Measure V).toSphere; (σ univ)⁻¹ • σ` on
`Metric.sphere (0 : V) 1` is `sphereLaw V` by `rfl`, and its `map Subtype.val` is
`ambientSphereLaw V`, also by `rfl`. For `V = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)` the instance
`Nontrivial V` needs `NeZero d` (or `have : Nonempty (Fin d) := ⟨⟨0, hd⟩⟩`), and
`finrank_euclideanSpace_fin` rewrites `Module.finrank ℝ V` to `d`; for the ball bound use
`have h := pow_le_sphereLaw_ball (E := V) hε x; rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin] at h`, since
`simpa` may unfold the statement's own sphere measure. Integrals over the subtype move to
`ambientSphereLaw` with `rw [← integral_ambientSphereLaw (fun y : V => g y)]`, giving the function
explicitly so that the rewrite finds the subtype integrand.
-/

namespace TheoremOS.Probability

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Metric
open scoped ENNReal NNReal RealInnerProductSpace Pointwise

noncomputable section

section SphereLaw

variable (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]

/-- The uniform probability law on the unit sphere: the cone measure `volume.toSphere`
normalised to total mass one. -/
def sphereLaw : Measure (sphere (0 : E) 1) :=
  let σ := (volume : Measure E).toSphere
  (σ univ)⁻¹ • σ

/-- The uniform law on the unit sphere as a measure on the ambient space. -/
def ambientSphereLaw : Measure E := (sphereLaw E).map Subtype.val

variable {E}

lemma sphereLaw_apply (s : Set (sphere (0 : E) 1)) :
    sphereLaw E s = ((volume : Measure E).toSphere univ)⁻¹ * (volume : Measure E).toSphere s := by
  simp only [sphereLaw, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

lemma toSphere_univ_ne_top : (volume : Measure E).toSphere univ ≠ ∞ := measure_ne_top _ _

lemma toSphere_univ_ne_zero [Nontrivial E] : (volume : Measure E).toSphere univ ≠ 0 := by
  exact Measure.measure_univ_ne_zero.mpr (volume : Measure E).toSphere_ne_zero

instance isProbabilityMeasure_sphereLaw [Nontrivial E] : IsProbabilityMeasure (sphereLaw E) :=
  ⟨by rw [sphereLaw_apply, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel toSphere_univ_ne_zero toSphere_univ_ne_top]⟩

/-- The cone formula: the mass of `s` is the volume of the open cone over `s` divided by the volume
of the unit ball. -/
theorem sphereLaw_apply' [Nontrivial E] {s : Set (sphere (0 : E) 1)} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    sphereLaw E s = volume (Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 • ((↑) '' s : Set E)) / volume (ball (0 : E) 1) := by
  have hd : (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Module.finrank_pos.ne'
  rw [sphereLaw_apply, (volume : Measure E).toSphere_apply' hs,
    (volume : Measure E).toSphere_apply_univ, ← ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul,
    ENNReal.mul_div_mul_left _ _ hd (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _)]

theorem sphereLaw_real_apply' [Nontrivial E] {s : Set (sphere (0 : E) 1)} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    (sphereLaw E).real s =
      volume.real (Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 • ((↑) '' s : Set E)) / volume.real (ball (0 : E) 1) := by
  rw [measureReal_def, sphereLaw_apply' hs, ENNReal.toReal_div, measureReal_def, measureReal_def]

/-- A linear isometry equivalence restricted to the unit sphere. -/
def sphereMap (f : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) : sphere (0 : E) 1 ≃ᵐ sphere (0 : E) 1 where
  toFun x := ⟨f x, by simp⟩
  invFun x := ⟨f.symm x, by simp⟩
  left_inv x := by ext; simp
  right_inv x := by ext; simp
  measurable_toFun := by
    apply Measurable.subtype_mk
    exact f.continuous.measurable.comp measurable_subtype_coe
  measurable_invFun := by
    apply Measurable.subtype_mk
    exact f.symm.continuous.measurable.comp measurable_subtype_coe

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] in
@[simp] lemma coe_sphereMap (f : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (x : sphere (0 : E) 1) :
    (sphereMap f x : E) = f x := rfl

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] in
@[simp] lemma coe_sphereMap_symm (f : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (x : sphere (0 : E) 1) :
    ((sphereMap f).symm x : E) = f.symm x := rfl

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] in
lemma preimage_cone_sphereMap (f : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (s : Set (sphere (0 : E) 1)) :
    Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 • ((↑) '' (sphereMap f ⁻¹' s) : Set E) =
      f ⁻¹' (Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 • ((↑) '' s : Set E)) := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_smul, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_preimage, exists_exists_and_eq_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨r, hr, sphereMap f x, hx, by simp [map_smul]⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, x, hx, hrx⟩
    refine ⟨r, hr, (sphereMap f).symm x, by simpa using hx, ?_⟩
    apply f.injective
    simpa [map_smul] using hrx

/-- Rotation invariance of the uniform law on the sphere. -/
theorem sphereLaw_map_sphereMap (f : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) : (sphereLaw E).map (sphereMap f) = sphereLaw E := by
  ext s hs
  rw [(sphereMap f).map_apply, sphereLaw_apply, sphereLaw_apply,
    (volume : Measure E).toSphere_apply' ((sphereMap f).measurable hs),
    (volume : Measure E).toSphere_apply' hs, preimage_cone_sphereMap,
    f.measurePreserving.measure_preimage_emb f.toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding]

omit [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] in
lemma measurableEmbedding_sphere_val : MeasurableEmbedding ((↑) : sphere (0 : E) 1 → E) :=
  MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe isClosed_sphere.measurableSet

instance isProbabilityMeasure_ambientSphereLaw [Nontrivial E] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (ambientSphereLaw E) := by
  unfold ambientSphereLaw; infer_instance

lemma ambientSphereLaw_apply {s : Set E} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ambientSphereLaw E s = sphereLaw E ((↑) ⁻¹' s) :=
  Measure.map_apply measurable_subtype_coe hs

/-- Rotation invariance of the ambient uniform law on the sphere. -/
theorem ambientSphereLaw_map (f : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) : (ambientSphereLaw E).map f = ambientSphereLaw E := by
  calc (ambientSphereLaw E).map f = ((sphereLaw E).map (sphereMap f)).map (↑) := by
        rw [ambientSphereLaw, Measure.map_map f.continuous.measurable measurable_subtype_coe,
          Measure.map_map measurable_subtype_coe (sphereMap f).measurable]
        rfl
    _ = ambientSphereLaw E := by rw [sphereLaw_map_sphereMap]; rfl

lemma integral_ambientSphereLaw {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (g : E → F) : ∫ x, g x ∂ambientSphereLaw E = ∫ x : sphere (0 : E) 1, g x ∂sphereLaw E :=
  measurableEmbedding_sphere_val.integral_map g

lemma integral_ambientSphereLaw_comp {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (f : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (g : E → F) :
    ∫ x, g (f x) ∂ambientSphereLaw E = ∫ x, g x ∂ambientSphereLaw E := by
  exact (MeasurePreserving.integral_comp ⟨f.continuous.measurable, ambientSphereLaw_map f⟩
    f.toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding g)

lemma ae_norm_ambientSphereLaw : ∀ᵐ x ∂ambientSphereLaw E, ‖x‖ = 1 := by
  rw [ambientSphereLaw, measurableEmbedding_sphere_val.ae_map_iff]
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by simp

lemma integrable_ambientSphereLaw [Nontrivial E] {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    [NormedSpace ℝ F] {g : E → F} (hg : Continuous g) : Integrable g (ambientSphereLaw E) := by
  rw [ambientSphereLaw, measurableEmbedding_sphere_val.integrable_map_iff]
  have : CompactSpace (sphere (0 : E) 1) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (isCompact_sphere 0 1)
  exact (hg.comp continuous_subtype_val).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
    (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)

lemma integrable_inner_ambientSphereLaw [Nontrivial E] (u : E) :
    Integrable (fun x => ⟪x, u⟫) (ambientSphereLaw E) :=
  integrable_ambientSphereLaw (by fun_prop)

lemma integrable_inner_mul_inner_ambientSphereLaw [Nontrivial E] (u v : E) :
    Integrable (fun x => ⟪x, u⟫ * ⟪x, v⟫) (ambientSphereLaw E) :=
  integrable_ambientSphereLaw (by fun_prop)

lemma integrable_inner_sq_ambientSphereLaw [Nontrivial E] (u : E) :
    Integrable (fun x => ⟪x, u⟫ ^ 2) (ambientSphereLaw E) :=
  integrable_ambientSphereLaw (by fun_prop)

/-- The uniform law on the sphere is centred. -/
theorem integral_inner_ambientSphereLaw (u : E) : ∫ x, ⟪x, u⟫ ∂ambientSphereLaw E = 0 := by
  have h := integral_ambientSphereLaw_comp (LinearIsometryEquiv.neg ℝ) (fun x => ⟪x, u⟫)
  simp only [LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_neg, inner_neg_left, integral_neg] at h
  linarith

lemma integral_inner_sq_ambientSphereLaw_eq {u v : E} (h : ‖u‖ = ‖v‖) :
    ∫ x, ⟪x, u⟫ ^ 2 ∂ambientSphereLaw E = ∫ x, ⟪x, v⟫ ^ 2 ∂ambientSphereLaw E := by
  set ρ := Submodule.reflection (ℝ ∙ (u - v))ᗮ
  have hρ : ρ u = v := Submodule.reflection_sub h
  have key := integral_ambientSphereLaw_comp ρ (fun x => ⟪x, v⟫ ^ 2)
  have hpt : ∀ x, ⟪ρ x, v⟫ = ⟪x, u⟫ := fun x => by
    rw [← hρ, LinearIsometryEquiv.inner_map_map]
  simp_rw [hpt] at key
  exact key

lemma sum_integral_inner_sq_ambientSphereLaw [Nontrivial E] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ E) : ∑ i, ∫ x, ⟪x, b i⟫ ^ 2 ∂ambientSphereLaw E = 1 := by
  rw [← integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_inner_sq_ambientSphereLaw (b i)]
  have hsum : ∀ x : E, ∑ i, ⟪x, b i⟫ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := b.sum_sq_inner_left
  simp_rw [hsum]
  rw [integral_congr_ae (ae_norm_ambientSphereLaw.mono fun x hx => by simp [hx] :
    (fun x : E => ‖x‖ ^ 2) =ᵐ[ambientSphereLaw E] fun _ => (1 : ℝ))]
  simp

/-- Isotropy: `∫ ⟪x, u⟫² = ‖u‖² / dim E` under the uniform law on the sphere. -/
theorem integral_inner_sq_ambientSphereLaw [Nontrivial E] (u : E) :
    ∫ x, ⟪x, u⟫ ^ 2 ∂ambientSphereLaw E = ‖u‖ ^ 2 / Module.finrank ℝ E := by
  set d := Module.finrank ℝ E
  have hd : 0 < d := Module.finrank_pos
  let b := stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E
  let i₀ : Fin d := ⟨0, hd⟩
  have hall : ∀ i, ∫ x, ⟪x, b i⟫ ^ 2 ∂ambientSphereLaw E = ∫ x, ⟪x, b i₀⟫ ^ 2 ∂ambientSphereLaw E :=
    fun i => integral_inner_sq_ambientSphereLaw_eq (by rw [b.orthonormal.1 i, b.orthonormal.1 i₀])
  have hone := sum_integral_inner_sq_ambientSphereLaw b
  simp_rw [hall, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at hone
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hJ : ∫ x, ⟪x, b i₀⟫ ^ 2 ∂ambientSphereLaw E = 1 / d := by
    rw [eq_div_iff hdR.ne']; linarith
  by_cases hu : u = 0
  · simp [hu]
  have hn : 0 < ‖u‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hu
  set w : E := ‖u‖⁻¹ • u
  have hw : ‖w‖ = ‖b i₀‖ := by
    rw [b.orthonormal.1 i₀, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn.ne']
  have hpt : ∀ x, ⟪x, u⟫ ^ 2 = ‖u‖ ^ 2 * ⟪x, w⟫ ^ 2 := fun x => by
    have : u = ‖u‖ • w := by simp [w, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hn.ne']
    conv_lhs => rw [this]
    rw [real_inner_smul_right, mul_pow]
  simp_rw [hpt]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_inner_sq_ambientSphereLaw_eq hw, hJ]
  ring

/-- `∫ ⟪x, u⟫ ⟪x, v⟫ = ⟪u, v⟫ / dim E` under the uniform law on the sphere. -/
theorem integral_inner_mul_inner_ambientSphereLaw [Nontrivial E] (u v : E) :
    ∫ x, ⟪x, u⟫ * ⟪x, v⟫ ∂ambientSphereLaw E = ⟪u, v⟫ / Module.finrank ℝ E := by
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) < Module.finrank ℝ E := by exact_mod_cast Module.finrank_pos
  have h := integral_inner_sq_ambientSphereLaw (E := E) (u + v)
  have hpt : ∀ x, ⟪x, u + v⟫ ^ 2 = ⟪x, u⟫ ^ 2 + ⟪x, v⟫ ^ 2 + 2 * (⟪x, u⟫ * ⟪x, v⟫) :=
    fun x => by rw [inner_add_right]; ring
  simp_rw [hpt] at h
  have i1 := integrable_inner_sq_ambientSphereLaw (E := E) u
  have i2 := integrable_inner_sq_ambientSphereLaw (E := E) v
  have i3 := (integrable_inner_mul_inner_ambientSphereLaw (E := E) u v).const_mul 2
  have i12 : Integrable (fun x => ⟪x, u⟫ ^ 2 + ⟪x, v⟫ ^ 2) (ambientSphereLaw E) := i1.add i2
  rw [integral_add i12 i3, integral_add i1 i2, integral_const_mul,
    integral_inner_sq_ambientSphereLaw, integral_inner_sq_ambientSphereLaw, norm_add_sq_real] at h
  field_simp at h ⊢
  linarith

/-- Cap lower bound: a ball of radius `ε` around a point of the sphere has mass at least
`(min ε 2 / 4) ^ dim E`. -/
theorem pow_le_sphereLaw_ball {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (x : sphere (0 : E) 1) :
    (min ε 2 / 4) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E ≤ (sphereLaw E).real (ball x ε) := by
  have : Nontrivial E := ⟨⟨x, 0, ne_of_apply_ne norm (by simp)⟩⟩
  set d := Module.finrank ℝ E
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast Module.finrank_pos
  have hB : 0 < (volume : Measure E).real (ball 0 1) :=
    ENNReal.toReal_pos (measure_ball_pos _ _ one_pos).ne' measure_ball_lt_top.ne
  have h := (volume : Measure E).toSphereBallBound_mul_measureReal_unitBall_le_toSphere_ball hε x
  have hbound : (Measure.toSphereBallBound d ε : ℝ) = d * (min ε 2 / 4) ^ d := by
    rw [Measure.toSphereBallBound, ite_eq_left ⟨Module.finrank_pos.ne', hε⟩]
    push_cast
    rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hε.le]
  rw [hbound] at h
  have hsl : (sphereLaw E).real (ball x ε) =
      (volume : Measure E).toSphere.real (ball x ε) / (d * (volume : Measure E).real (ball 0 1)) := by
    rw [measureReal_def, sphereLaw_apply, ← ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul, ENNReal.toReal_div,
      ← measureReal_def, ← measureReal_def, Measure.toSphere_real_apply_univ]
  rw [hsl, le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hd hB)]
  nlinarith

end SphereLaw

section Gaussian

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]

lemma memLp_inner_stdGaussian (u : E) (p : ℝ≥0∞) (hp : p ≠ ∞) :
    MemLp (fun x => ⟪x, u⟫) p (stdGaussian E) := by
  have h := IsGaussian.memLp_dual (stdGaussian E) (innerSL ℝ u) p hp
  refine h.congr_norm (by fun_prop) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
  simp [real_inner_comm]

lemma integrable_inner_mul_inner_stdGaussian (u v : E) :
    Integrable (fun x => ⟪x, u⟫ * ⟪x, v⟫) (stdGaussian E) :=
  (memLp_inner_stdGaussian u 2 (by simp)).integrable_mul (memLp_inner_stdGaussian v 2 (by simp))

lemma integrable_inner_sq_stdGaussian (u : E) :
    Integrable (fun x => ⟪x, u⟫ ^ 2) (stdGaussian E) := by
  simpa [sq] using integrable_inner_mul_inner_stdGaussian u u

/-- Under the standard Gaussian, `⟪x, u⟫` has law `N(0, ‖u‖²)`. -/
theorem stdGaussian_map_inner (u : E) :
    (stdGaussian E).map (fun x => ⟪x, u⟫) = gaussianReal 0 (‖u‖₊ ^ 2) := by
  have hf : (fun x : E => ⟪x, u⟫) = innerSL ℝ u := by
    funext x; simp [real_inner_comm]
  rw [hf, IsGaussian.map_eq_gaussianReal, integral_strongDual_stdGaussian,
    variance_dual_stdGaussian, innerSL_apply_norm]
  congr 1
  ext
  simp

theorem stdGaussian_map_inner_of_norm_eq_one {u : E} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) :
    (stdGaussian E).map (fun x => ⟪x, u⟫) = gaussianReal 0 1 := by
  rw [stdGaussian_map_inner]
  congr 1
  ext
  simp [hu]

/-- The standard Gaussian is isotropic: `∫ ⟪x, u⟫ ⟪x, v⟫ = ⟪u, v⟫`. -/
theorem integral_inner_mul_inner_stdGaussian (u v : E) :
    ∫ x, ⟪x, u⟫ * ⟪x, v⟫ ∂stdGaussian E = ⟪u, v⟫ := by
  have h := covarianceBilin_apply (μ := stdGaussian E) IsGaussian.memLp_two_id u v
  rw [covarianceBilin_stdGaussian] at h
  simp only [id_eq, integral_id_stdGaussian, sub_zero] at h
  rw [innerSL_apply_apply] at h
  rw [h]
  congr 1
  funext x
  rw [real_inner_comm x u, real_inner_comm x v]

theorem integral_inner_sq_stdGaussian (u : E) : ∫ x, ⟪x, u⟫ ^ 2 ∂stdGaussian E = ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
  simpa [sq, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] using integral_inner_mul_inner_stdGaussian u u

theorem integral_norm_sq_stdGaussian : ∫ x, ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∂stdGaussian E = Module.finrank ℝ E := by
  let b := stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E
  have hsum : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, ⟪x, b i⟫ ^ 2 := fun x => (b.sum_sq_inner_left x).symm
  simp_rw [hsum]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_inner_sq_stdGaussian (b i)]
  simp [integral_inner_sq_stdGaussian, b.orthonormal.1]

variable (E) in
/-- The standard Gaussian density `(2π)^{-d/2} exp(-‖x‖²/2)` on `E`, `d = dim E`. -/
def gaussianDensity (x : E) : ℝ :=
  ((2 * Real.pi) ^ ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) / 2))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-‖x‖ ^ 2 / 2)

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] in
lemma gaussianDensity_nonneg (x : E) : 0 ≤ gaussianDensity E x := by
  unfold gaussianDensity; positivity

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] in
lemma continuous_gaussianDensity : Continuous (gaussianDensity E) := by
  unfold gaussianDensity; fun_prop

end Gaussian

section Polar

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]

lemma integrable_exp_neg_sq_norm_div_two : Integrable (fun x : E => Real.exp (-‖x‖ ^ 2 / 2)) := by
  have h := GaussianFourier.integral_rexp_neg_mul_sq_norm (V := E) (b := 1 / 2) (by norm_num)
  have hne : ∫ x : E, Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * ‖x‖ ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by rw [h]; positivity
  have hf : (fun x : E => Real.exp (-‖x‖ ^ 2 / 2)) = fun x => Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by
    funext x; congr 1; ring
  rw [hf]
  exact Integrable.of_integral_ne_zero hne

lemma integrable_gaussianDensity : Integrable (gaussianDensity E) :=
  integrable_exp_neg_sq_norm_div_two.const_mul _

lemma charFun_withDensity_gaussianDensity (t : E) :
    charFun ((volume : Measure E).withDensity fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianDensity E x)) t =
      Complex.exp (-(‖t‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) := by
  set c : ℝ := ((2 * Real.pi) ^ ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) / 2))⁻¹
  rw [charFun_apply, integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul
    (continuous_gaussianDensity.measurable.ennreal_ofReal)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
  have hpt : ∀ x : E, (ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianDensity E x)).toReal •
      Complex.exp (⟪x, t⟫ * Complex.I) =
      (c : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(1 / 2 : ℂ) * (‖x‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 + Complex.I * (⟪t, x⟫ : ℂ)) := by
    intro x
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (gaussianDensity_nonneg x), Complex.real_smul, gaussianDensity,
      Complex.ofReal_mul, mul_assoc, Complex.ofReal_exp, ← Complex.exp_add, real_inner_comm t x]
    congr 2
    push_cast
    ring
  simp_rw [hpt]
  rw [integral_const_mul, GaussianFourier.integral_cexp_neg_mul_sq_norm_add (V := E)
    (b := 1 / 2) (by norm_num) Complex.I t, ← mul_assoc]
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have hcpow : ((Real.pi : ℂ) / (1 / 2)) ^ ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℂ) / 2) =
      (((2 * Real.pi) ^ ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Complex.ofReal_cpow hpos]
    push_cast
    congr 1
    ring
  have hne : (((2 * Real.pi) ^ ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _).ne'
  rw [hcpow, Complex.ofReal_inv, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, one_mul, Complex.I_sq]
  congr 1
  ring

/-- The standard Gaussian has density `gaussianDensity E` with respect to volume. -/
theorem stdGaussian_eq_withDensity :
    stdGaussian E = (volume : Measure E).withDensity fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianDensity E x) := by
  have : IsFiniteMeasure ((volume : Measure E).withDensity
      fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianDensity E x)) :=
    isFiniteMeasure_withDensity_ofReal integrable_gaussianDensity.hasFiniteIntegral
  refine Measure.ext_of_charFun (funext fun t => ?_)
  rw [charFun_stdGaussian, charFun_withDensity_gaussianDensity]

lemma measurable_normalize : Measurable fun x : E => ‖x‖⁻¹ • x :=
  (measurable_norm.inv).smul measurable_id

/-- Polar decomposition of a radial law: if `ν` is a probability measure with density `g ‖x‖`
with respect to volume, then the direction `x ↦ ‖x‖⁻¹ • x` has the uniform law on the sphere. -/
theorem map_normalize_of_radial [Nontrivial E] (ν : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {g : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Measurable g)
    (hν : ν = (volume : Measure E).withDensity fun x => g ‖x‖) :
    ν.map (fun x => ‖x‖⁻¹ • x) = ambientSphereLaw E := by
  have hemb := (homeomorphUnitSphereProd E).measurableEmbedding
  have hmp := (volume : Measure E).measurePreserving_homeomorphUnitSphereProd
  set R := ∫⁻ r, g r ∂Measure.volumeIoiPow (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1)
  have key : ∀ B : Set E, MeasurableSet B →
      ν ((fun x : E => ‖x‖⁻¹ • x) ⁻¹' B) =
        (volume : Measure E).toSphere ((↑) ⁻¹' B) * R := by
    intro B hB
    have hS : MeasurableSet ((fun x : E => ‖x‖⁻¹ • x) ⁻¹' B) := measurable_normalize hB
    have hB' : MeasurableSet (((↑) : sphere (0 : E) 1 → E) ⁻¹' B) :=
      measurable_subtype_coe hB
    have hpt : ∀ z : ({0}ᶜ : Set E),
        ((fun x : E => ‖x‖⁻¹ • x) ⁻¹' B).indicator (fun x => g ‖x‖) (z : E) =
          (fun p : sphere (0 : E) 1 × Ioi (0 : ℝ) =>
            (((↑) : sphere (0 : E) 1 → E) ⁻¹' B).indicator 1 p.1 * g p.2)
            (homeomorphUnitSphereProd E z) := by
      intro z
      classical
      simp only [Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_preimage, homeomorphUnitSphereProd_apply_fst_coe,
        homeomorphUnitSphereProd_apply_snd_coe, Pi.one_apply]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    rw [hν, withDensity_apply _ hS, ← lintegral_indicator hS]
    calc ∫⁻ x, ((fun x : E => ‖x‖⁻¹ • x) ⁻¹' B).indicator (fun x => g ‖x‖) x
          = ∫⁻ x in ({0}ᶜ : Set E),
              ((fun x : E => ‖x‖⁻¹ • x) ⁻¹' B).indicator (fun x => g ‖x‖) x := by
            rw [restrict_compl_singleton]
      _ = ∫⁻ z : ({0}ᶜ : Set E),
              ((fun x : E => ‖x‖⁻¹ • x) ⁻¹' B).indicator (fun x => g ‖x‖) (z : E)
              ∂(volume : Measure E).comap (↑) :=
            (lintegral_subtype_comap (measurableSet_singleton _).compl _).symm
      _ = ∫⁻ p, (((↑) : sphere (0 : E) 1 → E) ⁻¹' B).indicator 1 p.1 * g p.2
              ∂((volume : Measure E).toSphere.prod
                (Measure.volumeIoiPow (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1))) := by
            simp_rw [hpt]
            exact hmp.lintegral_comp_emb hemb
              (fun p => (((↑) : sphere (0 : E) 1 → E) ⁻¹' B).indicator 1 p.1 * g p.2)
      _ = (∫⁻ s, (((↑) : sphere (0 : E) 1 → E) ⁻¹' B).indicator 1 s
              ∂(volume : Measure E).toSphere) * R :=
            lintegral_prod_mul ((measurable_one.indicator hB').aemeasurable)
              ((hg.comp measurable_subtype_coe).aemeasurable)
      _ = (volume : Measure E).toSphere ((↑) ⁻¹' B) * R := by
            rw [lintegral_indicator_one hB']
  have hR : R = ((volume : Measure E).toSphere univ)⁻¹ := by
    have h1 := key univ MeasurableSet.univ
    simp only [Set.preimage_univ, measure_univ] at h1
    rw [mul_comm] at h1
    exact ENNReal.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left h1.symm
  ext B hB
  rw [Measure.map_apply measurable_normalize hB, key B hB, hR, ambientSphereLaw_apply hB,
    sphereLaw_apply, mul_comm]

/-- If `g` is a standard Gaussian vector then `g / ‖g‖` is uniform on the sphere. -/
theorem stdGaussian_map_normalize [Nontrivial E] :
    (stdGaussian E).map (fun x => ‖x‖⁻¹ • x) = ambientSphereLaw E :=
  map_normalize_of_radial (stdGaussian E)
    (g := fun r => ENNReal.ofReal
      (((2 * Real.pi) ^ ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) / 2))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-r ^ 2 / 2)))
    (by fun_prop) stdGaussian_eq_withDensity

/-- Integrals against the uniform law on the sphere as Gaussian integrals of the direction. -/
theorem integral_ambientSphereLaw_eq_stdGaussian [Nontrivial E] {F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {f : E → F} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f
      (ambientSphereLaw E)) :
    ∫ x, f x ∂ambientSphereLaw E = ∫ x, f (‖x‖⁻¹ • x) ∂stdGaussian E := by
  rw [← stdGaussian_map_normalize] at hf ⊢
  exact integral_map measurable_normalize.aemeasurable hf

end Polar


end

end TheoremOS.Probability
