import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CartierSections.PolynomialValuation
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Order
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.PWO

namespace OAI

/-!
# Weighted valuations on formal power series

Dickson finiteness gives an exponent of least weight, even when some weights
vanish. Initial homogeneous series prove multiplicativity without requiring
a unique exponent of least weight.
-/

noncomputable section
open scoped BigOperators NNReal ENNReal
namespace CartierSections.FormalMonomial
section Ring
variable {σ k : Type*} [CommRing k]

/-- Literal coefficient-weight infimum of a formal power series. -/
def value (w : σ → ℝ≥0) (f : MvPowerSeries σ k) : ENNReal :=
  ⨅ (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (_ : MvPowerSeries.coeff d f ≠ 0), (Finsupp.weight w d : ENNReal)

lemma le_value_iff (w : σ → ℝ≥0) {f : MvPowerSeries σ k} {a : ENNReal} :
    a ≤ value w f ↔ ∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d f ≠ 0 →
      a ≤ (Finsupp.weight w d : ENNReal) := by
  simp only [value, le_iInf_iff]

lemma value_le_weight (w : σ → ℝ≥0) {f : MvPowerSeries σ k} {d : σ →₀ ℕ}
    (hd : MvPowerSeries.coeff d f ≠ 0) : value w f ≤ (Finsupp.weight w d : ENNReal) :=
  (le_value_iff w).mp le_rfl d hd

/-- Dickson finiteness gives finitely many minimal exponent vectors. -/
lemma finite_dominated_generators [Fintype σ] (S : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)) :
    ∃ T : Finset (σ →₀ ℕ), (↑T : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)) ⊆ S ∧
      ∀ d ∈ S, ∃ e ∈ T, e ≤ d := by
  classical
  let M : Set (σ →₀ ℕ) := {e | Minimal (fun a => a ∈ S) e}
  have hM : M.Finite := by
    apply WellQuasiOrderedLE.finite_of_isAntichain
    intro a ha b hb hne hab
    exact hne (le_antisymm hab (hb.2 ha.1 hab))
  refine ⟨hM.toFinset, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro e he
    exact (hM.mem_toFinset.mp he).1
  · intro d hd
    obtain ⟨e, hed, he⟩ := (Set.isPWO_of_wellQuasiOrderedLE S).exists_le_minimal hd
    exact ⟨e, hM.mem_toFinset.mpr he, hed⟩

lemma weight_mono (w : σ → ℝ≥0) : Monotone (Finsupp.weight w : (σ →₀ ℕ) →+ ℝ≥0) := by
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := exists_add_of_le hab
  rw [map_add]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right bot_le

lemma exists_initial [Fintype σ] (w : σ → ℝ≥0) {f : MvPowerSeries σ k} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d f ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ e, MvPowerSeries.coeff e f ≠ 0 → Finsupp.weight w d ≤ Finsupp.weight w e := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e, MvPowerSeries.coeff e f ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hf
    ext d
    simpa using h d
  obtain ⟨T, hTS, hT⟩ := finite_dominated_generators {d | MvPowerSeries.coeff d f ≠ 0}
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hae⟩ := hT e he
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hmin⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image T (Finsupp.weight w) ⟨a, ha⟩
  refine ⟨d, hTS hd, ?_⟩
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcb⟩ := hT b hb
  exact (hmin c hc).trans (weight_mono w hcb)

lemma value_eq_of_initial (w : σ → ℝ≥0) {f : MvPowerSeries σ k} {d : σ →₀ ℕ}
    (hd : MvPowerSeries.coeff d f ≠ 0)
    (hmin : ∀ e, MvPowerSeries.coeff e f ≠ 0 → Finsupp.weight w d ≤ Finsupp.weight w e) :
    value w f = (Finsupp.weight w d : ENNReal) := by
  apply le_antisymm (value_le_weight w hd)
  exact (le_value_iff w).mpr fun e he => ENNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr (hmin e he)

lemma value_attained [Fintype σ] (w : σ → ℝ≥0) {f : MvPowerSeries σ k} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d f ≠ 0 ∧ value w f = (Finsupp.weight w d : ENNReal) := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hmin⟩ := exists_initial w hf
  exact ⟨d, hd, value_eq_of_initial w hd hmin⟩

@[simp] lemma value_zero (w : σ → ℝ≥0) : value (k := k) w 0 = ⊤ := by
  simp [value]

@[simp] lemma value_one [IsDomain k] (w : σ → ℝ≥0) : value (k := k) w 1 = 0 := by
  have h : value (k := k) w 1 ≤ (Finsupp.weight w 0 : ENNReal) :=
    value_le_weight w (by simp)
  simpa using le_antisymm h bot_le

lemma value_add (w : σ → ℝ≥0) (f g : MvPowerSeries σ k) :
    min (value w f) (value w g) ≤ value w (f+g) := by
  apply (le_value_iff w).mpr
  intro d hd
  by_cases hf : MvPowerSeries.coeff d f = 0
  · have hg : MvPowerSeries.coeff d g ≠ 0 := by
      intro hg
      exact hd (by simp [hf, hg])
    exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (value_le_weight w hg)
  · exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (value_le_weight w hf)

lemma le_value_mul (w : σ → ℝ≥0) (f g : MvPowerSeries σ k) :
    value w f + value w g ≤ value w (f*g) := by
  classical
  apply (le_value_iff w).mpr
  intro d hd
  rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul] at hd
  obtain ⟨⟨a,b⟩, hab, hcoef⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hd
  have ha : MvPowerSeries.coeff a f ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hcoef
  have hb : MvPowerSeries.coeff b g ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hcoef
  have hab' : a+b = d := by simpa using hab
  rw [← hab', map_add, ENNReal.coe_add]
  exact add_le_add (value_le_weight w ha) (value_le_weight w hb)

/-- The initial homogeneous series of a given weight. -/
def component (w : σ → ℝ≥0) (a : ℝ≥0) (f : MvPowerSeries σ k) : MvPowerSeries σ k :=
  fun d => if Finsupp.weight w d = a then MvPowerSeries.coeff d f else 0

@[simp] lemma coeff_component (w : σ → ℝ≥0) (a : ℝ≥0)
    (f : MvPowerSeries σ k) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (component w a f) =
      if Finsupp.weight w d = a then MvPowerSeries.coeff d f else 0 := rfl

lemma component_mul_at_lower_bounds (w : σ → ℝ≥0) (f g : MvPowerSeries σ k)
    (a b : ℝ≥0)
    (hf : ∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d f ≠ 0 → a ≤ Finsupp.weight w d)
    (hg : ∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d g ≠ 0 → b ≤ Finsupp.weight w d) :
    component w (a+b) (f*g) = component w a f * component w b g := by
  classical
  ext d
  rw [coeff_component, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  by_cases hd : Finsupp.weight w d = a+b
  · rw [ite_eq_left hd]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro ij hij
    rw [coeff_component, coeff_component]
    by_cases hi : MvPowerSeries.coeff ij.1 f = 0
    · simp [hi]
    by_cases hj : MvPowerSeries.coeff ij.2 g = 0
    · simp [hj]
    have hi' := hf ij.1 hi
    have hj' := hg ij.2 hj
    have hs : Finsupp.weight w ij.1 + Finsupp.weight w ij.2 = a+b := by
      rw [← map_add, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hij, hd]
    have hia : Finsupp.weight w ij.1 = a := le_antisymm
      (le_of_add_le_add_right ((add_le_add (le_refl (Finsupp.weight w ij.1)) hj').trans_eq hs)) hi'
    have hjb : Finsupp.weight w ij.2 = b := by
      rw [hia] at hs
      exact add_left_cancel hs
    simp [hia, hjb]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hd]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro ij hij
    rw [coeff_component, coeff_component]
    by_cases hi : Finsupp.weight w ij.1 = a
    · have hj : Finsupp.weight w ij.2 ≠ b := by
        intro hj
        apply hd
        rw [← Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hij, map_add, hi, hj]
      simp [hj]
    · simp [hi]

lemma component_ne_zero (w : σ → ℝ≥0) (f : MvPowerSeries σ k)
    {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (hd : MvPowerSeries.coeff d f ≠ 0) :
    component w (Finsupp.weight w d) f ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hc := congrArg (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) h
  simp only [coeff_component, map_zero] at hc
  exact hd hc

end Ring

section Domain
variable {σ k : Type*} [Fintype σ] [CommRing k] [IsDomain k]

lemma value_mul (w : σ → ℝ≥0) (f g : MvPowerSeries σ k) :
    value w (f*g) = value w f + value w g := by
  classical
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · simp [hf]
  by_cases hg : g = 0
  · simp [hg]
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hmin_a⟩ := exists_initial w hf
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hmin_b⟩ := exists_initial w hg
  have hn : component w (Finsupp.weight w a + Finsupp.weight w b) (f*g) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [component_mul_at_lower_bounds w f g _ _ hmin_a hmin_b]
    exact mul_ne_zero (component_ne_zero w f ha) (component_ne_zero w g hb)
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d
      (component w (Finsupp.weight w a + Finsupp.weight w b) (f*g)) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hn
    ext d
    simpa using h d
  rw [coeff_component] at hd
  have heq : Finsupp.weight w d = Finsupp.weight w a + Finsupp.weight w b := by
    by_contra h
    exact hd (ite_eq_right h)
  have hcoef : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (f*g) ≠ 0 := by simpa [heq] using hd
  apply le_antisymm _ (le_value_mul w f g)
  rw [value_eq_of_initial w ha hmin_a, value_eq_of_initial w hb hmin_b,
    ← ENNReal.coe_add, ← heq]
  exact value_le_weight w hcoef

/-- Genuine monomial valuation on the formal regular local ring, including
faces with zero weights. -/
def valuation (w : σ → ℝ≥0) : AddValuation (MvPowerSeries σ k) ENNReal :=
  AddValuation.of (value w) (value_zero w) (value_one w) (value_add w) (value_mul w)

@[simp] lemma valuation_apply (w : σ → ℝ≥0) (f : MvPowerSeries σ k) :
    valuation w f = value w f := rfl

/-- Nonnegative combinations of weights dominate the corresponding values. -/
lemma combine_dominates {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℝ≥0)
    (w : ι → σ → ℝ≥0) (f : MvPowerSeries σ k) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, (c i : ENNReal) * valuation (w i) f ≤
      valuation (Monomial.combine s c w) f := by
  change _ ≤ value _ f
  apply (le_value_iff _).mpr
  intro d hd
  rw [Monomial.weight_combine, ENNReal.ofNNReal_finsetSum]
  simp_rw [ENNReal.coe_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i hi
  exact mul_le_mul_right (value_le_weight (w i) hd) _

end Domain
end CartierSections.FormalMonomial

end

end OAI

import Mathlib.RingTheory.Valuation.ExtendToLocalization
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.FractionRing
import Mathlib.Basic.ENNReal.Basic

namespace OAI

/-!
# Extending finite valuations to a fraction field

A finite nonnegative valuation on a domain extends uniquely to its fraction
field with values in the extended real line.
-/

noncomputable section
open scoped BigOperators NNReal ENNReal
namespace CartierSections

/-- ENNReal, used for nonnegative local-ring values, embedded in the extended
real additive group used on the fraction field. -/
def nonnegToExtendedReal : ENNReal →+ WithTop ℝ :=
  NNReal.toRealHom.toAddMonoidHom.withTopMap

@[simp] theorem nonnegToExtendedReal_top : nonnegToExtendedReal ⊤ = ⊤ := rfl
@[simp] theorem nonnegToExtendedReal_coe (a : NNReal) :
    nonnegToExtendedReal a = ((a : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ) := rfl

lemma nonnegToExtendedReal_monotone : Monotone nonnegToExtendedReal := by
  intro a b hab
  by_cases hb : b = ⊤
  · subst b; simp
  lift b to NNReal using hb with b
  have ha : a ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.coe_ne_top hab
  lift a to NNReal using ha with a
  simpa using hab

@[simp] lemma nonnegToExtendedReal_eq_top {a : ENNReal} :
    nonnegToExtendedReal a = ⊤ ↔ a = ⊤ := by
  by_cases ha : a = ⊤
  · simp [ha]
  · lift a to NNReal using ha with a
    simp

section LocalValuation
variable {A : Type*} [CommRing A]

/-- Regard a nonnegative valuation as an extended-real valuation. -/
noncomputable def realLocalValuation (v : AddValuation A ENNReal) : AddValuation A (WithTop ℝ) :=
  v.map nonnegToExtendedReal nonnegToExtendedReal_top nonnegToExtendedReal_monotone

@[simp] lemma realLocalValuation_apply (v : AddValuation A ENNReal) (a : A) :
    realLocalValuation v a = nonnegToExtendedReal (v a) := rfl

end LocalValuation

section FractionField
variable {A K : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Field K]
  [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]

lemma realLocalValuation_denominators (v : AddValuation A ENNReal)
    (hv : ∀ a ≠ 0, v a ≠ ⊤) :
    nonZeroDivisors A ≤ (AddValuation.toValuation (realLocalValuation v)).supp.primeCompl := by
  intro a ha
  change realLocalValuation v a ≠ ⊤
  simpa using hv a (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp ha)

/-- Extend a valuation that is finite on nonzero elements to the fraction field. -/
noncomputable def fractionValuation (v : AddValuation A ENNReal)
    (hv : ∀ a ≠ 0, v a ≠ ⊤) : AddValuation K (WithTop ℝ) :=
  AddValuation.ofValuation ((AddValuation.toValuation (realLocalValuation v)).extendToLocalization
    (realLocalValuation_denominators v hv) K)

@[simp] lemma fractionValuation_algebraMap (v : AddValuation A ENNReal)
    (hv : ∀ a ≠ 0, v a ≠ ⊤) (a : A) :
    fractionValuation (K := K) v hv (algebraMap A K a) = nonnegToExtendedReal (v a) := by
  exact Valuation.extendToLocalization_apply_map_apply
    (AddValuation.toValuation (realLocalValuation v))
    (realLocalValuation_denominators v hv) K a

lemma fractionValuation_ratio (v : AddValuation A ENNReal)
    (hv : ∀ a ≠ 0, v a ≠ ⊤) (a b : A) :
    fractionValuation (K := K) v hv (algebraMap A K a / algebraMap A K b) =
      nonnegToExtendedReal (v a) - nonnegToExtendedReal (v b) := by
  rw [AddValuation.map_div, fractionValuation_algebraMap, fractionValuation_algebraMap]

/-- The extension is unique as a valuation of the function field. -/
lemma fractionValuation_unique (v : AddValuation A ENNReal)
    (hv : ∀ a ≠ 0, v a ≠ ⊤) (u : AddValuation K (WithTop ℝ))
    (hu : ∀ a, u (algebraMap A K a) = nonnegToExtendedReal (v a)) :
    u = fractionValuation v hv := by
  apply DFunLike.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := A) x
  rw [u.map_div, hu, hu, fractionValuation_ratio]

end FractionField
end CartierSections

end

end OAI

import Mathlib.RingTheory.Etale.Basic
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Quotient.Operations

namespace OAI

/-!
# Infinitesimal neighbourhoods in formally étale charts

Formal smoothness and formal unramifiedness give compatible isomorphisms on the
quotients by powers of an ideal whenever the residue map is an isomorphism.
-/

namespace CartierSections

/-- The multiplication action of a commutative ring on itself forms a scalar tower. -/
theorem scalarTower_self {R : Type*} [CommRing R] : IsScalarTower R R R :=
  IsScalarTower.right

attribute [local instance 10001] scalarTower_self

section NilpotentLifting
variable {R A S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing S]
  [Algebra R A] [Algebra R S]

/-- The image of an ideal modulo a power of itself is nilpotent. -/
theorem quotient_reduction_nilpotent (I : Ideal S) (n : ℕ) :
    IsNilpotent (I.map (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (I^n))) := by
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [← Ideal.map_pow]
  exact Ideal.map_quotient_self _

/-- Formal smoothness lifts a residue map to every finite infinitesimal
neighbourhood. -/
theorem formally_smooth_lift_to_power [Algebra.FormallySmooth R A]
    (I : Ideal S) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (f : A →ₐ[R] S ⧸ I) :
    ∃ g : A →ₐ[R] S ⧸ I^n,
      (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ R (Ideal.pow_le_self hn.ne')).comp g = f := by
  let e := DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotOfLEₐ R (Ideal.pow_le_self (I := I) hn.ne')
  let g := Algebra.FormallySmooth.lift _ (quotient_reduction_nilpotent (R := R) I n)
    (e.symm.toAlgHom.comp f)
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  rw [← DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotOfLEₐ_comp_mkₐ R]
  rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc, Algebra.FormallySmooth.comp_lift]
  ext a
  exact e.apply_symm_apply (f a)

/-- Formal unramifiedness gives uniqueness of lifts of a residue map. -/
theorem formally_unramified_unique_to_power [Algebra.FormallyUnramified R A]
    (I : Ideal S) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (f g : A →ₐ[R] S ⧸ I^n)
    (h : (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ R (Ideal.pow_le_self hn.ne')).comp f =
      (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ R (Ideal.pow_le_self hn.ne')).comp g) : f = g := by
  apply Algebra.FormallyUnramified.lift_unique
    (I.map (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (I^n))) (quotient_reduction_nilpotent (R := R) I n)
  ext a
  apply (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotOfLEₐ R (Ideal.pow_le_self (I := I) hn.ne')).injective
  have he := DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotOfLEₐ_comp_mkₐ R
    (Ideal.pow_le_self (I := I) hn.ne')
  exact (AlgHom.congr_fun he (f a)).trans
    ((AlgHom.congr_fun h a).trans (AlgHom.congr_fun he (g a)).symm)
end NilpotentLifting

section QuotientIsomorphism
variable {R A : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]

/-- The map on each infinitesimal neighbourhood induced by the algebra map. -/
def quotientPowerMap (I : Ideal R) (n : ℕ) :
    R ⧸ I^n →ₐ[R] A ⧸ (I.map (algebraMap R A))^n :=
  Ideal.quotientMapₐ _ (Algebra.ofId R A) (by
    rw [← Ideal.map_pow]
    exact Ideal.le_comap_map)

@[simp] theorem quotientPowerMap_mk (I : Ideal R) (n : ℕ) (r : R) :
    quotientPowerMap (A := A) I n (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I^n) r) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I.map (algebraMap R A))^n) (algebraMap R A r) := rfl

@[simp] theorem quotientPowerMap_algebraMap (I : Ideal R) (n : ℕ) (r : R) :
    quotientPowerMap (A := A) I n (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I^n) r) =
      algebraMap R (A ⧸ (I.map (algebraMap R A))^n) r := by
  exact (quotientPowerMap (A := A) I n).commutes r

theorem quotientPowerMap_factor (I : Ideal R) {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
    (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ R (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := I.map (algebraMap R A)) h)).comp
        (quotientPowerMap I n) =
      (quotientPowerMap I m).comp (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ R (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := I) h)) := by
  ext r
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective r
  rfl

def quotientBaseMap (I : Ideal R) : R ⧸ I →ₐ[R] A ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R A) :=
  Ideal.quotientMapₐ _ (Algebra.ofId R A) Ideal.le_comap_map

/-- A formally étale map which is an isomorphism modulo I is an
isomorphism modulo every power of I. -/
theorem etale_quotient_power_bijective [Algebra.FormallyEtale R A]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : Function.Bijective (quotientBaseMap (A := A) I)) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (quotientPowerMap (A := A) I n) := by
  classical
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst n
    have : Subsingleton (R ⧸ I^0) := by simp only [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]; infer_instance
    have : Subsingleton (A ⧸ (I.map (algebraMap R A))^0) := by
      simp only [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]; infer_instance
    exact ⟨fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _, fun a => ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩
  have hn' : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
  let J := I.map (algebraMap R A)
  let φ₀ : R ⧸ I →ₐ[R] A ⧸ J :=
    Ideal.quotientMapₐ J (Algebra.ofId R A) Ideal.le_comap_map
  have hφ₀ : Function.Bijective φ₀ := hI
  let e := AlgEquiv.ofBijective φ₀ hφ₀
  let f : A →ₐ[R] R ⧸ I := e.symm.toAlgHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J)
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := formally_smooth_lift_to_power I hn' f
  have hkill : J^n ≤ RingHom.ker g := by
    dsimp [J]
    rw [← Ideal.map_pow, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro r hr
    change g (algebraMap R A r) = 0
    rw [g.commutes]
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hr
  let q : A ⧸ J^n →ₐ[R] R ⧸ I^n := Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (J^n) g
    (fun a ha => hkill ha)
  have hleft : Function.LeftInverse q (quotientPowerMap (A := A) I n) := by
    intro r
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective r
    exact g.commutes r
  have heq : (quotientPowerMap (A := A) I n).comp g = Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (J^n) := by
    apply formally_unramified_unique_to_power J hn'
    have hfactor :
        (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ R (Ideal.pow_le_self (I := J) hn)).comp
            (quotientPowerMap (A := A) I n) =
          φ₀.comp (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ R (Ideal.pow_le_self (I := I) hn)) := by
      ext r
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective r
      rfl
    rw [← AlgHom.comp_assoc, hfactor, AlgHom.comp_assoc, hg]
    ext a
    exact e.apply_symm_apply (Ideal.Quotient.mk J a)
  have hright : Function.RightInverse q (quotientPowerMap (A := A) I n) := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
    exact AlgHom.congr_fun heq a
  exact ⟨hleft.injective, hright.surjective⟩
end QuotientIsomorphism
end CartierSections

end OAI

import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.WeightedHomogeneous
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Valuation.Basic
import Mathlib.Basic.ENNReal.BigOperators
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

namespace OAI

/-!
# Weighted valuations on polynomial rings

The least weight of a nonzero coefficient defines a valuation, including
weights with ties or zero coordinates. Nonnegative combinations of weight
vectors give a domination inequality within a fixed coordinate chart.
-/

noncomputable section
open scoped BigOperators NNReal ENNReal
namespace CartierSections.Monomial

variable {σ k : Type*} [CommRing k]

/-- The value is the minimum monomial weight, with value infinity at zero. -/
def value (w : σ → ℝ≥0) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) : ENNReal :=
  p.support.inf fun d => (Finsupp.weight w d : ENNReal)

@[simp] lemma value_zero (w : σ → ℝ≥0) : value (k := k) w 0 = ⊤ := by
  simp [value]

lemma value_le_weight (w : σ → ℝ≥0) {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : σ →₀ ℕ}
    (hd : d ∈ p.support) : value w p ≤ (Finsupp.weight w d : ENNReal) :=
  Finset.inf_le hd

lemma le_value_iff (w : σ → ℝ≥0) {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {a : ENNReal} :
    a ≤ value w p ↔ ∀ d ∈ p.support, a ≤ (Finsupp.weight w d : ENNReal) :=
  Finset.le_inf_iff

lemma value_attained (w : σ → ℝ≥0) {p : MvPolynomial σ k} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d ∈ p.support, value w p = (Finsupp.weight w d : ENNReal) :=
  Finset.exists_mem_eq_inf p.support (MvPolynomial.support_nonempty.mpr hp) _

lemma value_lt_top (w : σ → ℝ≥0) {p : MvPolynomial σ k} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    value w p < ⊤ := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, he⟩ := value_attained w hp
  rw [he]
  exact ENNReal.coe_lt_top

@[simp] lemma value_one [Nontrivial k] (w : σ → ℝ≥0) : value (k := k) w 1 = 0 := by
  simp [value]

lemma value_add (w : σ → ℝ≥0) (p q : MvPolynomial σ k) :
    min (value w p) (value w q) ≤ value w (p+q) := by
  classical
  apply (le_value_iff w).mpr
  intro d hd
  have hd' := MvPolynomial.support_add hd
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hd' with hp | hq
  · exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (value_le_weight w hp)
  · exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (value_le_weight w hq)

/-- No cancellation can create a term below the sum of the two minima. -/
lemma le_value_mul (w : σ → ℝ≥0) (p q : MvPolynomial σ k) :
    value w p + value w q ≤ value w (p*q) := by
  classical
  apply (le_value_iff w).mpr
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Finset.mem_add.mp (MvPolynomial.support_mul p q hd)
  subst d
  simpa only [map_add, ENNReal.coe_add] using
    add_le_add (value_le_weight w ha) (value_le_weight w hb)

/-- At the sum of the lower bounds, the initial part of a product is the
product of the initial parts. This includes non-generic tied weights. -/
lemma component_mul_at_lower_bounds (w : σ → ℝ≥0) (p q : MvPolynomial σ k)
    (a b : ℝ≥0)
    (hp : ∀ d ∈ p.support, a ≤ Finsupp.weight w d)
    (hq : ∀ d ∈ q.support, b ≤ Finsupp.weight w d) :
    MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w (a+b) (p*q) =
      MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w a p *
        MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w b q := by
  classical
  ext d
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, MvPolynomial.coeff_mul,
    MvPolynomial.coeff_mul]
  by_cases hd : Finsupp.weight w d = a+b
  · rw [ite_eq_left hd]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro ij hij
    rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent,
      MvPolynomial.coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent]
    by_cases hi : p.coeff ij.1 = 0
    · simp [hi]
    by_cases hj : q.coeff ij.2 = 0
    · simp [hj]
    have hi' := hp ij.1 (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hi)
    have hj' := hq ij.2 (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hj)
    have hs : Finsupp.weight w ij.1 + Finsupp.weight w ij.2 = a+b := by
      rw [← map_add, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hij, hd]
    have hia : Finsupp.weight w ij.1 = a := le_antisymm
      (le_of_add_le_add_right ((add_le_add (le_refl (Finsupp.weight w ij.1)) hj').trans_eq hs)) hi'
    have hjb : Finsupp.weight w ij.2 = b := by
      rw [hia] at hs
      exact add_left_cancel hs
    simp [hia, hjb]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hd]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro ij hij
    rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent,
      MvPolynomial.coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent]
    by_cases hi : Finsupp.weight w ij.1 = a
    · have hj : Finsupp.weight w ij.2 ≠ b := by
        intro hj
        apply hd
        rw [← Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hij, map_add, hi, hj]
      simp [hj]
    · simp [hi]

lemma component_ne_zero_of_attained (w : σ → ℝ≥0) (p : MvPolynomial σ k)
    {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (hd : d ∈ p.support) :
    MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w (Finsupp.weight w d) p ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  intro h
  have hc := congrArg (fun p : MvPolynomial σ k => p.coeff d) h
  simp only [MvPolynomial.coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero] at hc
  exact MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hd hc

section Domain
variable [IsDomain k]

lemma value_mul (w : σ → ℝ≥0) (p q : MvPolynomial σ k) :
    value w (p*q) = value w p + value w q := by
  classical
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · simp [hp]
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · simp [hq]
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hea⟩ := value_attained w hp
  obtain ⟨b, hb, heb⟩ := value_attained w hq
  apply le_antisymm _ (le_value_mul w p q)
  have hpa : ∀ d ∈ p.support, Finsupp.weight w a ≤ Finsupp.weight w d := by
    intro d hd
    exact ENNReal.coe_le_coe.mp (hea ▸ value_le_weight w hd)
  have hqb : ∀ d ∈ q.support, Finsupp.weight w b ≤ Finsupp.weight w d := by
    intro d hd
    exact ENNReal.coe_le_coe.mp (heb ▸ value_le_weight w hd)
  have hn : MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w
      (Finsupp.weight w a + Finsupp.weight w b) (p*q) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [component_mul_at_lower_bounds w p q _ _ hpa hqb]
    exact mul_ne_zero (component_ne_zero_of_attained w p ha)
      (component_ne_zero_of_attained w q hb)
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := MvPolynomial.support_nonempty.mpr hn
  rw [MvPolynomial.support_weightedHomogeneousComponent, Finset.mem_filter] at hd
  rw [hea, heb, ← ENNReal.coe_add, ← hd.2]
  exact value_le_weight w hd.1

/-- Weighted monomial valuation on the genuine polynomial coordinate ring. -/
def valuation (w : σ → ℝ≥0) : AddValuation (MvPolynomial σ k) ENNReal :=
  AddValuation.of (value w) (value_zero w) (value_one w) (value_add w) (value_mul w)

@[simp] lemma valuation_apply (w : σ → ℝ≥0) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) :
    valuation w p = value w p := rfl

end Domain

section Convex
variable {ι : Type*}

/-- Coordinatewise nonnegative linear combination of weight vectors. -/
def combine (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℝ≥0) (w : ι → σ → ℝ≥0) : σ → ℝ≥0 :=
  fun j => ∑ i ∈ s, c i * w i j

lemma weight_combine (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℝ≥0) (w : ι → σ → ℝ≥0)
    (d : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    Finsupp.weight (combine s c w) d = ∑ i ∈ s, c i * Finsupp.weight (w i) d := by
  classical
  simp only [combine, Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum,
    nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

/-- Nonnegative combinations dominate the corresponding combination of values.
The homogeneous inequality needs no normalization of the coefficients. -/
lemma combine_dominates [IsDomain k] (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℝ≥0) (w : ι → σ → ℝ≥0)
    (p : MvPolynomial σ k) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, (c i : ENNReal) * valuation (w i) p ≤
      valuation (combine s c w) p := by
  change _ ≤ value _ p
  apply (le_value_iff _).mpr
  intro d hd
  rw [weight_combine, ENNReal.ofNNReal_finsetSum]
  simp_rw [ENNReal.coe_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i hi
  exact mul_le_mul_right (value_le_weight (w i) hd) _

/-- Equality of two monomial weights is preserved by nonnegative combinations. -/
lemma linear_equation_combine (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℝ≥0)
    (w : ι → σ → ℝ≥0) (a b : σ →₀ ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, Finsupp.weight (w i) a = Finsupp.weight (w i) b) :
    Finsupp.weight (combine s c w) a = Finsupp.weight (combine s c w) b := by
  rw [weight_combine, weight_combine]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [h i hi]

end Convex
end CartierSections.Monomial

end

end OAI

import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Archimedean.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Interval
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndependent.Defs
import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace OAI

/-!
# Real weights of exponent vectors

Real weights are additive on exponent vectors. Positive weights have finite sublevel sets,
and rationally independent weights distinguish exponents.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace CartierSections

section Weights
variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

noncomputable def realWeight (w : ι → ℝ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, w i * (d i : ℝ)

@[simp] theorem realWeight_zero (w : ι → ℝ) : realWeight w 0 = 0 := by
  simp [realWeight]

@[simp] theorem realWeight_add (w : ι → ℝ) (d e : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    realWeight w (d + e) = realWeight w d + realWeight w e := by
  simp [realWeight, Nat.cast_add, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

@[simp] theorem realWeight_nsmul (w : ι → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    realWeight w (n • d) = n * realWeight w d := by
  simp [realWeight, Finset.mul_sum, mul_left_comm]

theorem realWeight_nonneg {w : ι → ℝ} (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    0 ≤ realWeight w d :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw i) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

theorem realWeight_injective {w : ι → ℝ} (hw : LinearIndependent ℚ w) :
    Function.Injective (realWeight w) := by
  intro d e h
  have he : (fun i => (d i : ℚ)) = (fun i => (e i : ℚ)) :=
    hw.fintypeLinearCombination_injective (by
      simpa [Fintype.linearCombination_apply, realWeight, Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm] using h)
  ext i
  exact_mod_cast congrFun he i

/-- Positive weights give finite sublevel sets of exponent vectors. -/
theorem finite_weight_sublevel {w : ι → ℝ} (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (L : ℝ) :
    {d : ι →₀ ℕ | realWeight w d ≤ L}.Finite := by
  classical
  let b : ι →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm (fun i => ⌈L / w i⌉₊)
  apply (Set.finite_Iic b).subset
  intro d hd
  show d ≤ b
  intro i
  have hi : w i * (d i : ℝ) ≤ L :=
    le_trans (Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hw j).le (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) (Finset.mem_univ i)) hd
  change d i ≤ ⌈L / w i⌉₊
  apply (Nat.cast_le (α := ℝ)).mp
  exact (le_div_iff₀ (hw i)).mpr (by nlinarith) |>.trans (Nat.le_ceil _)
end Weights

end CartierSections

end OAI

import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CartierSections.FieldTopology
import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CartierSections.FieldRetraction

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open scoped BigOperators NNReal ENNReal
namespace CartierSections
section ClosedChartFieldTopology
universe u
local instance polynomialOrigin_isMaximal_topology {σ k : Type u} [Fintype σ] [Field k] :
    (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ k).IsMaximal :=
  polynomialOrigin_isMaximal

variable {σ k R A K : Type u} [Fintype σ] [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
  [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
  [IsDomain A] [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
  [Algebra (MvPolynomial σ k) R] [Algebra (MvPolynomial σ k) A]
  [Algebra k A] [IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial σ k) A]
  [Algebra R A] [IsScalarTower (MvPolynomial σ k) R A]
  [IsLocalization.AtPrime R (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ k)]
  [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R A)] [Algebra.FormallyUnramified R A]
  [Algebra.EssFiniteType R A] [Algebra.FormallyEtale (MvPolynomial σ k) A]

lemma isCompact_closedChartFieldRetraction_cone
    (a : σ → NNReal) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) :
    IsCompact ((fun w : σ → NNReal => fun x : K =>
      closedChartFieldRetraction (σ := σ) (k := k) (R := R) (A := A) w x) ''
      normalizedWeights a) := by
  simpa only [expandedFractionValuation, closedChartFieldRetraction,
    closedChartRetraction] using
    (isCompact_expandedFractionValuation_cone (K := K)
      (closedChartExpansion (σ := σ) (k := k) (R := R) (A := A))
      (closedChartExpansion_injective (σ := σ) (k := k) (R := R) (A := A)) a ha)
end ClosedChartFieldTopology

tasks.objective: Prove the frozen acceptance theorem OAI.FiniteCongruence.graph_criterion: for every finite lattice with bottom, Representable Lat iff HasGraphWitness Lat. It is the sole original target and the consumer of the two checked direction lemmas through graph_criterion_from_directions; do not replace it by a renamed statement.

Define OAI.FiniteCongruence.PolyCompatible alg f as the property that every congruence θ preserves the unary map f: ∀ θ u v, θ.1 u v → θ.1 (f u) (f v). This is the key closure notion for unary polynomial translations in the representable→witness direction. Intended consumers: polyCompatible_sanity, poly_generated_eqvGen, principal_isGraphWitness. The body must be a definition, not an axiom or an assumption.

Pin the new PolyCompatible definition by proving that the identity unary map is compatible with every congruence and that the composition of two compatible unary maps is compatible. This supplies the closure operations used by poly_generated_eqvGen; it is intentionally a small sanity lemma for the definition task.

Define OAI.FiniteCongruence.Principal alg x y as the least congruence containing the pair (x,y), implemented as the intersection over all congruences θ with θ.1 x y: relation a b ↦ ∀ θ, θ.1 x y → θ.1 a b. Intended consumers: principal_rel_iff and principal_isGraphWitness. The body must construct an actual Setoid and Compatible proof; no minimization axiom may be assumed.

Characterize the definition task Principal: prove (Principal alg x y).1 a b iff every congruence θ containing (x,y) also contains (a,b). This is the sanity and elimination lemma that turns minimality of principal congruences into relation membership; intended consumer: principal_isGraphWitness. First check the reflexive/symmetric/transitive congruence proof and the x y witness at the empty/singleton cases.

Prove the universal-algebra generation core for the reverse direction. Let S be a finite set of seed pairs and suppose (a,b) lies in every congruence containing all of S. Show (a,b) is in Relation.EqvGen of the pairs obtained by applying a PolyCompatible unary map to an edge of S. First construction: let R be that unary-translate relation and prove EqvGen R is itself a congruence by using coordinate unary maps f_i(x)=op(...,x,...) and the id/composition sanity lemma; then apply the hypothesis to EqvGen R. This is the exact bridge from principal-congruence joins to Marked chains; consumer: principal_isGraphWitness. Test first with S empty and S a singleton.

Prove the witness→representable direction directly from an IsGraphWitness color on Fin n, n>0. First construction: for a:Lat define the relation rho a x y := color x y ≤ a using the first three witness clauses for equivalence; build the algebra whose operations are all admissible unary self-maps of Fin n (classical finite subtype enumeration; use a Fintype.equivFin-style enumeration of the subtype). Prove rho a is compatible, every congruence θ equals rho of the finite supremum of color over θ-related pairs by the fifth witness clause, and a↦rho a is an order isomorphism by the separation clause. This is the exact direction lemma consumed by graph_criterion_from_directions; keep the construction data inside this task.

Prove that the principal-congruence coloring is a graph witness. Given n>0, an algebra on Fin n and an order isomorphism e : Lat ≃o Congruence alg, set color x y := e.symm (Principal alg x y). Establish symmetry and bottom separation, the latter from principal_bot_iff, the triangle inequality by mapping color x z ⊔ color z y forward and using that every congruence containing (x,z) and (z,y) contains (x,y), witness separation from two distinct congruences on a pair, and the fifth connectivity axiom by applying poly_generated_eqvGen to the seed set, identifying e(s) with the least congruence containing the seeds and using PolyCompatible maps as Marked placements. Consumer: representable_witness. The n>0 premise is essential: for Fin 0 the separation axiom is impossible for nontrivial Lat.

Unpack Representable Lat as a positive size, a finite algebra on Fin size and an order isomorphism e, then apply principal_isGraphWitness with the positivity witness to obtain HasGraphWitness Lat with the same nonempty size. This is the exact reverse direction consumed by graph_criterion_from_directions; no new mathematical construction should be needed once its dependency is checked.

Close the two-direction route: prove the frozen equivalence by combining witness_representable (HasGraphWitness→Representable) and representable_witness (Representable→HasGraphWitness). This closing lemma has exactly the original target type and is the lemma the original goal must reference; consumer: graph_criterion via the two_directions proof route.

Sharpen the principal-congruence construction: prove that the principal congruence generated by (x,y) is bottom exactly when x = y. Use principal_rel_iff and the fact that the bottom congruence is equality, while Principal alg x y contains (x,y). Intended consumer: principal_isGraphWitness, where this is exactly the bottom-separation field of IsGraphWitness; it also independently sanity-checks Principal before the long reverse-direction proof.

OAI.FiniteCongruence.principal_rel_iff {Carrier : Type} (alg : OAI.FiniteCongruence.Algebra Carrier)

import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Prod
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Pi
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.EquivFin
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Lattice.Fold
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Defs
import Mathlib.Data.Setoid.Basic
import Mathlib.Order.Hom.Basic

namespace OAI

namespace FiniteCongruence

structure Algebra (Carrier : Type) where
  numOps : ℕ
  arity : Fin numOps → ℕ
  op : (index : Fin numOps) → (Fin (arity index) → Carrier) → Carrier

def Compatible {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (rel : Setoid Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∀ (index : Fin alg.numOps) (left right : Fin (alg.arity index) → Carrier),
    (∀ coord, rel (left coord) (right coord)) → rel (alg.op index left) (alg.op index right)

def Congruence {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) :=
  {rel : Setoid Carrier // Compatible alg rel}

instance {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) : PartialOrder (Congruence alg) :=
  inferInstanceAs (PartialOrder {rel : Setoid Carrier // Compatible alg rel})

def Representable (Lat : Type) [PartialOrder Lat] : Prop :=
  ∃ size : ℕ, 0 < size ∧ ∃ alg : Algebra (Fin size), Nonempty (Lat ≃o Congruence alg)

def Admissible {Lat Carrier : Type} [LE Lat] (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat)
    (placement : Carrier → Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∀ left right, color (placement left) (placement right) ≤ color left right

def Marked {Lat Carrier : Type} [LE Lat] (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat)
    (seeds : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) (left right : Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∃ placement : Carrier → Carrier, Admissible color placement ∧
    ∃ edge ∈ seeds, placement edge.1 = left ∧ placement edge.2 = right

def Connected {Lat Carrier : Type} [LE Lat] (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat)
    (seeds : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) (left right : Carrier) : Prop :=
  Relation.EqvGen (Marked color seeds) left right

def IsGraphWitness {Lat Carrier : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat) : Prop :=
  (∀ left right, color left right = color right left) ∧
  (∀ left right, color left right = ⊥ ↔ left = right) ∧
  (∀ left right middle, color left right ≤ color left middle ⊔ color middle right) ∧
  (∀ lower upper : Lat, ¬ lower ≤ upper →
    ∃ left right, color left right ≤ lower ∧ ¬ color left right ≤ upper) ∧
  (∀ seeds : Finset (Carrier × Carrier), seeds.Nonempty → ∀ left right,
    color left right ≤ seeds.sup (fun edge => color edge.1 edge.2) →
      Connected color seeds left right)

def HasGraphWitness (Lat : Type) [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat] : Prop :=
  ∃ size : ℕ, 0 < size ∧ ∃ color : Fin size → Fin size → Lat, IsGraphWitness color

def Principal {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier) : Congruence alg where
  val :=
    { r := fun a b => ∀ θ : Congruence alg, θ.1 x y → θ.1 a b
      iseqv :=
        { refl := fun a θ _ => θ.1.refl a
          symm := fun h θ hxy => θ.1.symm (h θ hxy)
          trans := fun hab hbc θ hxy => θ.1.trans (hab θ hxy) (hbc θ hxy) } }
  property := by
    intro index left right h θ hxy
    exact θ.2 index left right (fun coord => h coord θ hxy)

theorem principal_rel_iff {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y a b : Carrier) :
    (Principal alg x y).1 a b ↔ ∀ θ : Congruence alg, θ.1 x y → θ.1 a b :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem Principal_mem_self {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier) :
    (Principal alg x y).1 x y := by
  rw [principal_rel_iff]
  intro θ h
  exact h

theorem Principal_le_iff {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier)
    (θ : Congruence alg) : Principal alg x y ≤ θ ↔ θ.1 x y := by
  change (Principal alg x y).1 ≤ θ.1 ↔ θ.1 x y
  rw [Setoid.le_def]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h (Principal_mem_self alg x y)
  · intro h a b hab
    exact (principal_rel_iff alg x y a b).1 hab θ h

theorem Principal_least {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) {x y : Carrier}
    (θ : Congruence alg) (h : θ.1 x y) : Principal alg x y ≤ θ :=
  (Principal_le_iff alg x y θ).2 h

theorem Principal_comm {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier) :
    Principal alg x y = Principal alg y x := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Setoid.ext
  intro a b
  rw [principal_rel_iff, principal_rel_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h θ hyx
    exact h θ (θ.1.symm hyx)
  · intro h θ hxy
    exact h θ (θ.1.symm hxy)

theorem Principal_trans_le {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) {x y z : Carrier}
    (θ : Congruence alg) (hxz : θ.1 x z) (hzy : θ.1 z y) : Principal alg x y ≤ θ :=
  Principal_least alg θ (θ.1.trans hxz hzy)

def Principal_diagonal {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) : Congruence alg where
  val :=
    { r := fun a b => a = b
      iseqv :=
        { refl := fun _ => rfl
          symm := fun h => h.symm
          trans := fun h₁ h₂ => h₁.trans h₂ } }
  property := by
    intro index left right h
    have hlr : left = right := funext fun coord => h coord
    rw [hlr]

theorem Principal_diagonal_le {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (θ : Congruence alg) : Principal_diagonal alg ≤ θ := by
  intro a b h
  subst h
  exact θ.1.refl a

theorem Principal_eq_diagonal_iff {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier) :
    Principal alg x y = Principal_diagonal alg ↔ x = y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hm : (Principal alg x y).1 x y := Principal_mem_self alg x y
    rw [h] at hm
    exact hm
  · intro h
    subst h
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply (Principal_le_iff alg x x (Principal_diagonal alg)).2
      rfl
    · exact Principal_diagonal_le alg (Principal alg x x)

instance principalBotCongruence {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) : Bot (Congruence alg) :=
  ⟨Principal_diagonal alg⟩

theorem principal_bot_iff {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier) :
    Principal alg x y = ⊥ ↔ x = y := by
  change Principal alg x y = Principal_diagonal alg ↔ x = y
  exact Principal_eq_diagonal_iff alg x y

def PolyCompatible {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (f : Carrier → Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∀ (θ : Congruence alg) (u v : Carrier), θ.1 u v → θ.1 (f u) (f v)

theorem eqvGen_closed_of_closed {Carrier : Type} {R : Carrier → Carrier → Prop}
    (g : Carrier → Carrier) (hgm : ∀ x y, R x y → R (g x) (g y)) :
    ∀ x y, Relation.EqvGen R x y → Relation.EqvGen R (g x) (g y) := by
  intro x y h
  induction h with
  | rel a b hab => exact Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (hgm a b hab)
  | refl a => exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  | symm a b hab ih => exact Relation.EqvGen.symm _ _ ih
  | trans a b c hab hbc ihab ihbc => exact Relation.EqvGen.trans _ _ _ ihab ihbc

def TranslateRel {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier))
    (u v : Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∃ p ∈ S, ∃ f : Carrier → Carrier, PolyCompatible alg f ∧ u = f p.1 ∧ v = f p.2

theorem polyCompatible_comp {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier} {f g : Carrier → Carrier}
    (hf : PolyCompatible alg f) (hg : PolyCompatible alg g) :
    PolyCompatible alg (fun x => f (g x)) := fun θ u v h => hf θ _ _ (hg θ u v h)

theorem translateRel_closed {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier}
    {S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)} {g : Carrier → Carrier} (hg : PolyCompatible alg g) :
    ∀ x y, TranslateRel alg S x y → TranslateRel alg S (g x) (g y) := by
  rintro x y ⟨p, hp, f, hf, rfl, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨p, hp, fun z => g (f z), polyCompatible_comp (alg := alg) hg hf, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem eqvGenTranslate_closed {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier}
    {S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)} {g : Carrier → Carrier} (hg : PolyCompatible alg g) :
    ∀ x y, Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) x y →
      Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (g x) (g y) :=
  eqvGen_closed_of_closed g (translateRel_closed (S := S) hg)

theorem coord_map_polyCompatible {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (index : Fin alg.numOps) (u : Fin (alg.arity index) → Carrier)
    (c : Fin (alg.arity index)) :
    PolyCompatible alg (fun x : Carrier => alg.op index (Function.update u c x)) := by
  intro θ l r hlr
  apply θ.2 index
  intro coord
  by_cases h : coord = c
  · subst h
    simpa using hlr
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne h, Function.update_of_ne h]

theorem op_eqvGen_of_forall {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) (index : Fin alg.numOps)
    (u v : Fin (alg.arity index) → Carrier)
    (huv : ∀ c, Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (u c) (v c)) :
    Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (alg.op index u) (alg.op index v) := by
  let w : Finset (Fin (alg.arity index)) → (Fin (alg.arity index) → Carrier) :=
    fun T c => if c ∈ T then v c else u c
  have hw_empty : w ∅ = u := by funext c; simp [w]
  have hw_univ : w Finset.univ = v := by funext c; simp [w]
  have hstep : ∀ (T : Finset (Fin (alg.arity index))) (c : Fin (alg.arity index)), c ∉ T →
      Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (alg.op index (w T))
        (alg.op index (w (insert c T))) := by
    intro T c hc
    have hwins : w (insert c T) = Function.update (w T) c (v c) := by
      funext d
      by_cases hd : d = c
      · subst hd; simp [w, Function.update_self]
      · simp [w, Finset.mem_insert, hd]
    rw [hwins]
    have hmem : w T c = if c ∈ T then v c else u c := rfl
    have hpoly : PolyCompatible alg (fun x : Carrier => alg.op index (Function.update (w T) c x)) :=
      coord_map_polyCompatible alg index (w T) c
    have := eqvGenTranslate_closed (S := S) hpoly (w T c) (v c) ?_
    · simpa [Function.update_self] using this
    · show Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (w T c) (v c)
      rw [hmem]
      rw [if_neg hc]
      exact huv c
  have hmain : ∀ T : Finset (Fin (alg.arity index)),
      Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (alg.op index u) (alg.op index (w T)) := by
    intro T
    induction T using Finset.induction with
    | empty => rw [hw_empty]; exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
    | insert a s ha ih => exact Relation.EqvGen.trans _ _ _ ih (hstep s a ha)
  have := hmain Finset.univ
  rwa [hw_univ] at this

theorem eqvGenTranslate_compatible {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) :
    Compatible alg (Relation.EqvGen.setoid (TranslateRel alg S)) := by
  intro index u v huv
  apply op_eqvGen_of_forall alg S index u v
  intro c
  exact huv c

theorem seed_mem_translateRel {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier}
    {S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)} {p : Carrier × Carrier} (hp : p ∈ S) :
    TranslateRel alg S p.1 p.2 :=
  ⟨p, hp, id, fun _ _ _ huv => huv, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem congruence_mk_rel {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier}
    {rel : Setoid Carrier} {hc : Compatible alg rel} (a b : Carrier) :
    (⟨rel, hc⟩ : Congruence alg).1 a b ↔ rel a b := Iff.rfl

theorem poly_generated_eqvGen {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) {a b : Carrier}
    (h : ∀ (θ : Congruence alg), (∀ p ∈ S, θ.1 p.1 p.2) → θ.1 a b) :
    Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) a b := by
  classical
  have hrel := congruence_mk_rel (alg := alg)
    (rel := Relation.EqvGen.setoid (TranslateRel alg S))
    (hc := eqvGenTranslate_compatible alg S) a b
  refine hrel.mp ?_
  refine h ⟨Relation.EqvGen.setoid (TranslateRel alg S), eqvGenTranslate_compatible alg S⟩ ?_
  intro p hp
  have hp' := congruence_mk_rel (alg := alg)
    (rel := Relation.EqvGen.setoid (TranslateRel alg S))
    (hc := eqvGenTranslate_compatible alg S) p.1 p.2
  exact hp'.mpr (Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (seed_mem_translateRel (alg := alg) (S := S) hp))

abbrev witnessOpType {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [LE Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) : Type :=
  { f : Fin n → Fin n // Admissible color f }

noncomputable instance witnessOpTypeFintype {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [LE Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) : Fintype (witnessOpType color) :=
  Fintype.ofFinite _

noncomputable abbrev witnessAlgebra {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [LE Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) : Algebra (Fin n) where
  numOps := Fintype.card (witnessOpType color)
  arity := fun _ => 1
  op := fun index left =>
    ((Fintype.equivFin (witnessOpType color)).symm index : witnessOpType color).1 (left 0)

noncomputable def witnessRho {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (h : IsGraphWitness color) (a : Lat) :
    Congruence (witnessAlgebra color) := by
  classical
  refine ⟨⟨fun x y => color x y ≤ a, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x
      have hxx : color x x = ⊥ := (h.2.1 x x).2 rfl
      rw [hxx]
      exact bot_le
    · intro x y hxy
      rwa [h.1 y x]
    · intro x y z hxy hyz
      calc
        color x z ≤ color x y ⊔ color y z := h.2.2.1 x z y
        _ ≤ a ⊔ a := sup_le (hxy.trans le_sup_left) (hyz.trans le_sup_right)
        _ = a := sup_idem a
  · intro index left right hcoord
    let e := Fintype.equivFin (witnessOpType color)
    let f : Fin n → Fin n := ((e.symm index : witnessOpType color)).1
    have hf : Admissible color f := (e.symm index).2
    change color (f (left 0)) (f (right 0)) ≤ a
    exact (hf (left 0) (right 0)).trans (hcoord 0)

lemma witnessAlgebra_admissible_apply {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    (f : Fin n → Fin n) (hf : Admissible color f) {u v : Fin n}
    (huv : θ.1 u v) : θ.1 (f u) (f v) := by
  classical
  let F : witnessOpType color := ⟨f, hf⟩
  let e := Fintype.equivFin (witnessOpType color)
  let index : Fin (witnessAlgebra color).numOps := e F
  have hleft : (witnessAlgebra color).op index
      (fun _ : Fin ((witnessAlgebra color).arity index) => u) = f u := by
    change ((e.symm index : witnessOpType color)).1 u = f u
    simp [index, e, F]
  have hright : (witnessAlgebra color).op index
      (fun _ : Fin ((witnessAlgebra color).arity index) => v) = f v := by
    change ((e.symm index : witnessOpType color)).1 v = f v
    simp [index, e, F]
  have h := θ.2 index (fun _ => u) (fun _ => v) (fun _ => huv)
  rwa [hleft, hright] at h

noncomputable def thetaSeeds {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color)) :
    Finset (Fin n × Fin n) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun edge => θ.1 edge.1 edge.2)

lemma thetaSeeds_mem {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    (edge : Fin n × Fin n) :
    edge ∈ thetaSeeds color θ ↔ θ.1 edge.1 edge.2 := by
  classical
  simp [thetaSeeds]

lemma thetaSeeds_nonempty {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    (hn : 0 < n) : (thetaSeeds color θ).Nonempty := by
  classical
  let x : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩
  refine ⟨(x, x), ?_⟩
  rw [thetaSeeds_mem]

lemma thetaSeeds_related {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    {edge : Fin n × Fin n} (h : edge ∈ thetaSeeds color θ) :
    θ.1 edge.1 edge.2 :=
  (thetaSeeds_mem color θ edge).1 h

lemma marked_mem_congruence {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    (seeds : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) (hseed : ∀ edge ∈ seeds, θ.1 edge.1 edge.2)
    {left right : Fin n} (hm : Marked color seeds left right) : θ.1 left right := by
  classical
  rcases hm with ⟨placement, hadmissible, edge, hedge, hleft, hright⟩
  rw [← hleft, ← hright]
  exact witnessAlgebra_admissible_apply color θ placement hadmissible (hseed edge hedge)

lemma connected_mem_congruence {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    (seeds : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) (hseed : ∀ edge ∈ seeds, θ.1 edge.1 edge.2)
    {left right : Fin n} (hc : Connected color seeds left right) : θ.1 left right := by
  classical
  induction hc with
  | rel a b hab =>
      exact marked_mem_congruence color θ seeds hseed hab
  | refl x =>
      exact θ.1.refl' x
  | symm a b hab ih =>
      exact θ.1.symm' ih
  | trans a b c hab hbc ihab ihbc =>
      exact θ.1.trans' ihab ihbc

noncomputable def witnessRhoSup {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color)) : Lat :=
  (thetaSeeds color θ).sup (fun edge => color edge.1 edge.2)

lemma mem_iff_rho_thetaSeeds {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (h : IsGraphWitness color)
    (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color)) (hn : 0 < n) (left right : Fin n) :
    θ.1 left right ↔
      color left right ≤ (thetaSeeds color θ).sup (fun edge => color edge.1 edge.2) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hrel
    exact Finset.le_sup (s := thetaSeeds color θ)
      (f := fun edge : Fin n × Fin n => color edge.1 edge.2) (b := (left, right))
      ((thetaSeeds_mem color θ (left, right)).2 hrel)
  · intro hcolor
    exact connected_mem_congruence color θ (thetaSeeds color θ)
      (fun edge hedge => thetaSeeds_related color θ hedge)
      (h.2.2.2.2 (thetaSeeds color θ) (thetaSeeds_nonempty color θ hn) left right hcolor)

lemma witnessRho_surjective {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (h : IsGraphWitness color) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Function.Surjective (witnessRho color h) := by
  classical
  intro θ
  refine ⟨witnessRhoSup color θ, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Setoid.ext
  intro left right
  exact (mem_iff_rho_thetaSeeds color h θ hn left right).symm

noncomputable def witnessEmbedding {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (h : IsGraphWitness color) :
    Lat ↪o Congruence (witnessAlgebra color) :=
  OrderEmbedding.ofMapLEIff (witnessRho color h) (by
    intro a b
    constructor
    · intro hle
      by_contra hnot
      rcases h.2.2.2.1 a b hnot with ⟨left, right, hleft, hright⟩
      exact hright (hle hleft)
    · intro hle left right hleft
      exact hleft.trans hle)

noncomputable def witnessOrderIso {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (h : IsGraphWitness color) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Lat ≃o Congruence (witnessAlgebra color) :=
  OrderIso.ofSurjective (witnessEmbedding color h) (witnessRho_surjective color h hn)

theorem witness_representable (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∀ {Lat : Type} [Fintype Lat] [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
      (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat), IsGraphWitness color → Representable Lat := by
  intro Lat _ _ _ color h
  exact ⟨n, hn, witnessAlgebra color, ⟨witnessOrderIso color h hn⟩⟩

theorem principal_isGraphWitness (n : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n) {Lat : Type} [Fintype Lat]
    [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (alg : Algebra (Fin n)) (e : Lat ≃o Congruence alg) :
    IsGraphWitness (fun x y : Fin n => e.symm (Principal alg x y)) := by
  classical
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y
    dsimp
    rw [Principal_comm]
  · intro x y
    dsimp
    have hbot : e (⊥ : Lat) = (⊥ : Congruence alg) := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · have h : (⊥ : Lat) ≤ e.symm (⊥ : Congruence alg) := bot_le
        have h' : e (⊥ : Lat) ≤ e (e.symm (⊥ : Congruence alg)) :=
          (e.le_iff_le).mpr h
        simpa using h'
      · change Principal_diagonal alg ≤ e (⊥ : Lat)
        exact Principal_diagonal_le alg (e (⊥ : Lat))
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h' : Principal alg x y = e (⊥ : Lat) := by
        have := congrArg e h
        simpa using this
      have h'' : Principal alg x y = (⊥ : Congruence alg) := by
        simpa [hbot] using h'
      exact (principal_bot_iff alg x y).1 h''
    · intro h
      have h' : Principal alg x y = (⊥ : Congruence alg) := (principal_bot_iff alg x y).2 h
      have h'' : Principal alg x y = e (⊥ : Lat) := by
        simpa [hbot] using h'
      have := congrArg e.symm h''
      simpa using this
  · intro x y z
    dsimp
    let a : Lat := e.symm (Principal alg x z)
    let b : Lat := e.symm (Principal alg z y)
    let θ : Congruence alg := e (a ⊔ b)
    have hxz : θ.1 x z := by
      have hle : Principal alg x z ≤ θ := by
        have h := (e.le_iff_le).mpr (le_sup_left : a ≤ a ⊔ b)
        simpa [θ, a] using h
      exact (Principal_le_iff alg x z θ).1 hle
    have hzy : θ.1 z y := by
      have hle : Principal alg z y ≤ θ := by
        have h := (e.le_iff_le).mpr (le_sup_right : b ≤ a ⊔ b)
        simpa [θ, b] using h
      exact (Principal_le_iff alg z y θ).1 hle
    have hxy : Principal alg x y ≤ θ := Principal_trans_le alg θ hxz hzy
    have h' : e (e.symm (Principal alg x y)) ≤ e (a ⊔ b) := by
      simpa [θ] using hxy
    have h'' := (e.le_iff_le).mp h'
    simpa [a, b] using h''
  · intro lower upper hnot
    have hnot' : ¬ e lower ≤ e upper := by
      intro h
      exact hnot ((e.le_iff_le).mp h)
    have hnotrel : ¬ (e lower).1 ≤ (e upper).1 := by
      change ¬ e lower ≤ e upper
      exact hnot'
    have hex : ∃ a b, (e lower).1 a b ∧ ¬ (e upper).1 a b := by
      by_contra h
      apply hnotrel
      rw [Setoid.le_def]
      intro a b hab
      by_contra hnab
      exact h ⟨a, b, hab, hnab⟩
    rcases hex with ⟨a, b, hab_lower, hab_not_upper⟩
    refine ⟨a, b, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hP : Principal alg a b ≤ e lower :=
        (Principal_le_iff alg a b (e lower)).2 hab_lower
      simpa using e.symm.monotone hP
    · intro hle
      have hP : Principal alg a b ≤ e upper := by
        have h := e.monotone hle
        simpa using h
      exact hab_not_upper ((Principal_le_iff alg a b (e upper)).1 hP)
  · intro seeds _hseeds x y hxy
    change Relation.EqvGen (Marked (fun x y : Fin n => e.symm (Principal alg x y)) seeds) x y
    have hgen : Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg seeds) x y := by
      refine poly_generated_eqvGen alg seeds ?_
      intro θ hθ
      let T : Lat := seeds.sup (fun edge => e.symm (Principal alg edge.1 edge.2))
      have hTle : T ≤ e.symm θ := by
        apply Finset.sup_le
        intro edge hedge
        have hP : Principal alg edge.1 edge.2 ≤ θ :=
          (Principal_le_iff alg edge.1 edge.2 θ).2 (hθ edge hedge)
        exact e.symm.monotone hP
      have heT : e T ≤ θ := by
        have h := e.monotone hTle
        simpa using h
      have hPxy : Principal alg x y ≤ e T := by
        have h := e.monotone hxy
        simpa [T] using h
      exact (Principal_le_iff alg x y θ).1 (le_trans hPxy heT)
    have hsubset : TranslateRel alg seeds ≤
        Marked (fun x y : Fin n => e.symm (Principal alg x y)) seeds := by
      intro u v huv
      rcases huv with ⟨p, hp, f, hf, rfl, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨f, ?_, p, hp, rfl, rfl⟩
      intro left right
      have hP : Principal alg (f left) (f right) ≤ Principal alg left right :=
        (Principal_le_iff alg (f left) (f right) (Principal alg left right)).2
          (hf (Principal alg left right) left right (Principal_mem_self alg left right))
      exact e.symm.monotone hP
    exact Relation.EqvGen.mono hsubset x y hgen

theorem representable_witness {Lat : Type} [Fintype Lat] [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (h : Representable Lat) : HasGraphWitness Lat := by
  rcases h with ⟨n, hn, alg, ⟨e⟩⟩
  exact ⟨n, hn, (fun x y : Fin n => e.symm (Principal alg x y)),
    principal_isGraphWitness n hn alg e⟩

theorem graph_criterion_from_directions (Lat : Type)
    [Fintype Lat] [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat] :
    Representable Lat ↔ HasGraphWitness Lat := by
  constructor
  · exact representable_witness
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨n, hn, color, hcolor⟩
    exact witness_representable n hn color hcolor

theorem graph_criterion (Lat : Type) [Fintype Lat] [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat] :
    Representable Lat ↔ HasGraphWitness Lat := by
  exact graph_criterion_from_directions Lat

end FiniteCongruence

import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Lattice.Fold
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Defs
import Mathlib.Data.Setoid.Basic
import Mathlib.Order.Hom.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Basic

namespace OAI

namespace FiniteCongruence

structure Algebra (Carrier : Type) where
  numOps : ℕ
  arity : Fin numOps → ℕ
  op : (index : Fin numOps) → (Fin (arity index) → Carrier) → Carrier

def Compatible {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (rel : Setoid Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∀ (index : Fin alg.numOps) (left right : Fin (alg.arity index) → Carrier),
    (∀ coord, rel (left coord) (right coord)) → rel (alg.op index left) (alg.op index right)

def Congruence {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) :=
  {rel : Setoid Carrier // Compatible alg rel}

instance {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) : PartialOrder (Congruence alg) :=
  inferInstanceAs (PartialOrder {rel : Setoid Carrier // Compatible alg rel})

def Representable (Lat : Type) [PartialOrder Lat] : Prop :=
  ∃ size : ℕ, 0 < size ∧ ∃ alg : Algebra (Fin size), Nonempty (Lat ≃o Congruence alg)

def Admissible {Lat Carrier : Type} [LE Lat] (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat)
    (placement : Carrier → Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∀ left right, color (placement left) (placement right) ≤ color left right

def Marked {Lat Carrier : Type} [LE Lat] (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat)
    (seeds : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) (left right : Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∃ placement : Carrier → Carrier, Admissible color placement ∧
    ∃ edge ∈ seeds, placement edge.1 = left ∧ placement edge.2 = right

def Connected {Lat Carrier : Type} [LE Lat] (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat)
    (seeds : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) (left right : Carrier) : Prop :=
  Relation.EqvGen (Marked color seeds) left right

def IsGraphWitness {Lat Carrier : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat) : Prop :=
  (∀ left right, color left right = color right left) ∧
  (∀ left right, color left right = ⊥ ↔ left = right) ∧
  (∀ left right middle, color left right ≤ color left middle ⊔ color middle right) ∧
  (∀ lower upper : Lat, ¬ lower ≤ upper →
    ∃ left right, color left right ≤ lower ∧ ¬ color left right ≤ upper) ∧
  (∀ seeds : Finset (Carrier × Carrier), seeds.Nonempty → ∀ left right,
    color left right ≤ seeds.sup (fun edge => color edge.1 edge.2) →
      Connected color seeds left right)

def HasGraphWitness (Lat : Type) [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat] : Prop :=
  ∃ size : ℕ, 0 < size ∧ ∃ color : Fin size → Fin size → Lat, IsGraphWitness color

def PolyCompatible {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (f : Carrier → Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∀ (θ : Congruence alg) (u v : Carrier), θ.1 u v → θ.1 (f u) (f v)

theorem polyCompatible_sanity {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) :
    (PolyCompatible alg (fun x : Carrier => x) ∧
     ∀ (f g : Carrier → Carrier), PolyCompatible alg f → PolyCompatible alg g →
       PolyCompatible alg (fun x : Carrier => f (g x))) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro θ u v huv; exact huv
  · intro f g hf hg θ u v huv
    exact hf θ _ _ (hg θ u v huv)

                                                                            
theorem eqvGen_closed_of_closed {Carrier : Type} {R : Carrier → Carrier → Prop}
    (g : Carrier → Carrier) (hgm : ∀ x y, R x y → R (g x) (g y)) :
    ∀ x y, Relation.EqvGen R x y → Relation.EqvGen R (g x) (g y) := by
  intro x y h
  induction h with
  | rel a b hab => exact Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (hgm a b hab)
  | refl a => exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  | symm a b hab ih => exact Relation.EqvGen.symm _ _ ih
  | trans a b c hab hbc ihab ihbc => exact Relation.EqvGen.trans _ _ _ ihab ihbc


def TranslateRel {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier))
    (u v : Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∃ p ∈ S, ∃ f : Carrier → Carrier, PolyCompatible alg f ∧ u = f p.1 ∧ v = f p.2

theorem polyCompatible_comp {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier} {f g : Carrier → Carrier}
    (hf : PolyCompatible alg f) (hg : PolyCompatible alg g) :
    PolyCompatible alg (fun x => f (g x)) := fun θ u v h => hf θ _ _ (hg θ u v h)

theorem translateRel_closed {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier}
    {S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)} {g : Carrier → Carrier} (hg : PolyCompatible alg g) :
    ∀ x y, TranslateRel alg S x y → TranslateRel alg S (g x) (g y) := by
  rintro x y ⟨p, hp, f, hf, rfl, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨p, hp, fun z => g (f z), polyCompatible_comp (alg := alg) hg hf, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem eqvGenTranslate_closed {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier}
    {S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)} {g : Carrier → Carrier} (hg : PolyCompatible alg g) :
    ∀ x y, Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) x y →
      Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (g x) (g y) :=
  eqvGen_closed_of_closed g (translateRel_closed (S := S) hg)

theorem coord_map_polyCompatible {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (index : Fin alg.numOps) (u : Fin (alg.arity index) → Carrier)
    (c : Fin (alg.arity index)) :
    PolyCompatible alg (fun x : Carrier => alg.op index (Function.update u c x)) := by
  intro θ l r hlr
  apply θ.2 index
  intro coord
  by_cases h : coord = c
  · subst h
    simpa using hlr
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne h, Function.update_of_ne h]



theorem op_eqvGen_of_forall {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) (index : Fin alg.numOps)
    (u v : Fin (alg.arity index) → Carrier)
    (huv : ∀ c, Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (u c) (v c)) :
    Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (alg.op index u) (alg.op index v) := by
  let w : Finset (Fin (alg.arity index)) → (Fin (alg.arity index) → Carrier) :=
    fun T c => if c ∈ T then v c else u c
  have hw_empty : w ∅ = u := by funext c; simp [w]
  have hw_univ : w Finset.univ = v := by funext c; simp [w]
  have hstep : ∀ (T : Finset (Fin (alg.arity index))) (c : Fin (alg.arity index)), c ∉ T →
      Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (alg.op index (w T))
        (alg.op index (w (insert c T))) := by
    intro T c hc
    have hwins : w (insert c T) = Function.update (w T) c (v c) := by
      funext d
      by_cases hd : d = c
      · subst hd; simp [w, Function.update_self]
      · simp [w, Finset.mem_insert, hd]
    rw [hwins]
    have hmem : w T c = if c ∈ T then v c else u c := rfl
    have hpoly : PolyCompatible alg (fun x : Carrier => alg.op index (Function.update (w T) c x)) :=
      coord_map_polyCompatible alg index (w T) c
    have := eqvGenTranslate_closed (S := S) hpoly (w T c) (v c) ?_
    · simpa [Function.update_self] using this
    · show Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (w T c) (v c)
      rw [hmem]
      rw [if_neg hc]
      exact huv c
  have hmain : ∀ T : Finset (Fin (alg.arity index)),
      Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (alg.op index u) (alg.op index (w T)) := by
    intro T
    induction T using Finset.induction with
    | empty => rw [hw_empty]; exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
    | insert a s ha ih => exact Relation.EqvGen.trans _ _ _ ih (hstep s a ha)
  have := hmain Finset.univ
  rwa [hw_univ] at this


theorem eqvGenTranslate_compatible {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) :
    Compatible alg (Relation.EqvGen.setoid (TranslateRel alg S)) := by
  intro index u v huv
  apply op_eqvGen_of_forall alg S index u v
  intro c
  exact huv c

theorem seed_mem_translateRel {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier}
    {S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)} {p : Carrier × Carrier} (hp : p ∈ S) :
    TranslateRel alg S p.1 p.2 :=
  ⟨p, hp, id, fun _ _ _ huv => huv, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem congruence_mk_rel {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier}
    {rel : Setoid Carrier} {hc : Compatible alg rel} (a b : Carrier) :
    (⟨rel, hc⟩ : Congruence alg).1 a b ↔ rel a b := Iff.rfl

theorem poly_generated_eqvGen {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) {a b : Carrier}
    (h : ∀ (θ : Congruence alg), (∀ p ∈ S, θ.1 p.1 p.2) → θ.1 a b) :
    Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) a b := by
  classical
  have hrel := congruence_mk_rel (alg := alg)
    (rel := Relation.EqvGen.setoid (TranslateRel alg S))
    (hc := eqvGenTranslate_compatible alg S) a b
  refine hrel.mp ?_
  refine h ⟨Relation.EqvGen.setoid (TranslateRel alg S), eqvGenTranslate_compatible alg S⟩ ?_
  intro p hp
  have hp' := congruence_mk_rel (alg := alg)
    (rel := Relation.EqvGen.setoid (TranslateRel alg S))
    (hc := eqvGenTranslate_compatible alg S) p.1 p.2
  exact hp'.mpr (Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (seed_mem_translateRel (alg := alg) (S := S) hp))


                                                                                         
                                                                       
end FiniteCongruence

end OAI

    (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat) : Prop :=
  (∀ left right, color left right = color right left) ∧
  (∀ left right, color left right = ⊥ ↔ left = right) ∧
  (∀ left right middle, color left right ≤ color left middle ⊔ color middle right) ∧
  (∀ lower upper : Lat, ¬ lower ≤ upper →
    ∃ left right, color left right ≤ lower ∧ ¬ color left right ≤ upper) ∧
  (∀ seeds : Finset (Carrier × Carrier), seeds.Nonempty → ∀ left right,

      Connected color seeds left right)
