          trans := fun hab hbc θ hxy => θ.1.trans (hab θ hxy) (hbc θ hxy) } }
  property := by
    intro index left right h θ hxy
    exact θ.2 index left right (fun coord => h coord θ hxy)
theorem principal_rel_iff {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y a b : Carrier) :
    (Principal alg x y).1 a b ↔ ∀ θ : Congruence alg, θ.1 x y → θ.1 a b :=
  Iff.rfl
theorem Principal_mem_self {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier) :
    (Principal alg x y).1 x y := by
  rw [principal_rel_iff]
  intro θ h
  exact h
theorem Principal_le_iff {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier)
    (θ : Congruence alg) : Principal alg x y ≤ θ ↔ θ.1 x y := by
  change (Principal alg x y).1 ≤ θ.1 ↔ θ.1 x y
  rw [Setoid.le_def]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h (Principal_mem_self alg x y)
  · intro h a b hab
    exact (principal_rel_iff alg x y a b).1 hab θ h
theorem Principal_least {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) {x y : Carrier}
    (θ : Congruence alg) (h : θ.1 x y) : Principal alg x y ≤ θ :=
  (Principal_le_iff alg x y θ).2 h
theorem Principal_comm {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier) :
    Principal alg x y = Principal alg y x := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Setoid.ext
  intro a b
  rw [principal_rel_iff, principal_rel_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h θ hyx
    exact h θ (θ.1.symm hyx)
  · intro h θ hxy
    exact h θ (θ.1.symm hxy)
theorem Principal_trans_le {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) {x y z : Carrier}
    (θ : Congruence alg) (hxz : θ.1 x z) (hzy : θ.1 z y) : Principal alg x y ≤ θ :=
  Principal_least alg θ (θ.1.trans hxz hzy)
def Principal_diagonal {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) : Congruence alg where
  val :=
    { r := fun a b => a = b
      iseqv :=
        { refl := fun _ => rfl
          symm := fun h => h.symm
          trans := fun h₁ h₂ => h₁.trans h₂ } }
  property := by
    intro index left right h
    have hlr : left = right := funext fun coord => h coord
    rw [hlr]
theorem Principal_diagonal_le {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (θ : Congruence alg) : Principal_diagonal alg ≤ θ := by
  intro a b h
  subst h
  exact θ.1.refl a
theorem Principal_eq_diagonal_iff {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier) :
    Principal alg x y = Principal_diagonal alg ↔ x = y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hm : (Principal alg x y).1 x y := Principal_mem_self alg x y
    rw [h] at hm
    exact hm
  · intro h
    subst h
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply (Principal_le_iff alg x x (Principal_diagonal alg)).2
      rfl
    · exact Principal_diagonal_le alg (Principal alg x x)
instance principalBotCongruence {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) : Bot (Congruence alg) :=
  ⟨Principal_diagonal alg⟩
theorem principal_bot_iff {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier) :
    Principal alg x y = ⊥ ↔ x = y := by
  change Principal alg x y = Principal_diagonal alg ↔ x = y
  exact Principal_eq_diagonal_iff alg x y
def PolyCompatible {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (f : Carrier → Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∀ (θ : Congruence alg) (u v : Carrier), θ.1 u v → θ.1 (f u) (f v)
theorem polyCompatible_sanity {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) :
    (PolyCompatible alg (fun x : Carrier => x) ∧
     ∀ (f g : Carrier → Carrier), PolyCompatible alg f → PolyCompatible alg g →
       PolyCompatible alg (fun x : Carrier => f (g x))) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro θ u v huv; exact huv
  · intro f g hf hg θ u v huv
    exact hf θ _ _ (hg θ u v huv)

-- R closed under compatible maps  =>  EqvGen R closed under compatible maps
theorem eqvGen_closed_of_closed {Carrier : Type} {R : Carrier → Carrier → Prop}
    (g : Carrier → Carrier) (hgm : ∀ x y, R x y → R (g x) (g y)) :
    ∀ x y, Relation.EqvGen R x y → Relation.EqvGen R (g x) (g y) := by
  intro x y h
  induction h with
  | rel a b hab => exact Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (hgm a b hab)
  | refl a => exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  | symm a b hab ih => exact Relation.EqvGen.symm _ _ ih
  | trans a b c hab hbc ihab ihbc => exact Relation.EqvGen.trans _ _ _ ihab ihbc
def TranslateRel {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier))
    (u v : Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∃ p ∈ S, ∃ f : Carrier → Carrier, PolyCompatible alg f ∧ u = f p.1 ∧ v = f p.2
theorem polyCompatible_comp {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier} {f g : Carrier → Carrier}
    (hf : PolyCompatible alg f) (hg : PolyCompatible alg g) :
    PolyCompatible alg (fun x => f (g x)) := fun θ u v h => hf θ _ _ (hg θ u v h)
theorem translateRel_closed {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier}
    {S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)} {g : Carrier → Carrier} (hg : PolyCompatible alg g) :
    ∀ x y, TranslateRel alg S x y → TranslateRel alg S (g x) (g y) := by
  rintro x y ⟨p, hp, f, hf, rfl, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨p, hp, fun z => g (f z), polyCompatible_comp (alg := alg) hg hf, rfl, rfl⟩
theorem eqvGenTranslate_closed {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier}
    {S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)} {g : Carrier → Carrier} (hg : PolyCompatible alg g) :
    ∀ x y, Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) x y →
      Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (g x) (g y) :=
  eqvGen_closed_of_closed g (translateRel_closed (S := S) hg)
theorem coord_map_polyCompatible {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (index : Fin alg.numOps) (u : Fin (alg.arity index) → Carrier)
    (c : Fin (alg.arity index)) :
    PolyCompatible alg (fun x : Carrier => alg.op index (Function.update u c x)) := by
  intro θ l r hlr
  apply θ.2 index
  intro coord
  by_cases h : coord = c
  · subst h
    simpa using hlr
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne h, Function.update_of_ne h]
theorem op_eqvGen_of_forall {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) (index : Fin alg.numOps)
    (u v : Fin (alg.arity index) → Carrier)
    (huv : ∀ c, Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (u c) (v c)) :
    Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (alg.op index u) (alg.op index v) := by
  let w : Finset (Fin (alg.arity index)) → (Fin (alg.arity index) → Carrier) :=
    fun T c => if c ∈ T then v c else u c
  have hw_empty : w ∅ = u := by funext c; simp [w]
  have hw_univ : w Finset.univ = v := by funext c; simp [w]
  have hstep : ∀ (T : Finset (Fin (alg.arity index))) (c : Fin (alg.arity index)), c ∉ T →
      Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (alg.op index (w T))
        (alg.op index (w (insert c T))) := by
    intro T c hc
    have hwins : w (insert c T) = Function.update (w T) c (v c) := by
      funext d
      by_cases hd : d = c
      · subst hd; simp [w, Function.update_self]
      · simp [w, Finset.mem_insert, hd]
    rw [hwins]
    have hmem : w T c = if c ∈ T then v c else u c := rfl
    have hpoly : PolyCompatible alg (fun x : Carrier => alg.op index (Function.update (w T) c x)) :=
      coord_map_polyCompatible alg index (w T) c
    have := eqvGenTranslate_closed (S := S) hpoly (w T c) (v c) ?_
    · simpa [Function.update_self] using this
    · show Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (w T c) (v c)
      rw [hmem]
      rw [if_neg hc]
      exact huv c
  have hmain : ∀ T : Finset (Fin (alg.arity index)),
      Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (alg.op index u) (alg.op index (w T)) := by
    intro T
    induction T using Finset.induction with
    | empty => rw [hw_empty]; exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
    | insert a s ha ih => exact Relation.EqvGen.trans _ _ _ ih (hstep s a ha)
  have := hmain Finset.univ
  rwa [hw_univ] at this
theorem eqvGenTranslate_compatible {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) :
    Compatible alg (Relation.EqvGen.setoid (TranslateRel alg S)) := by
  intro index u v huv
  apply op_eqvGen_of_forall alg S index u v
  intro c
  exact huv c
theorem seed_mem_translateRel {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier}
    {S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)} {p : Carrier × Carrier} (hp : p ∈ S) :
    TranslateRel alg S p.1 p.2 :=
  ⟨p, hp, id, fun _ _ _ huv => huv, rfl, rfl⟩
theorem congruence_mk_rel {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier}
    {rel : Setoid Carrier} {hc : Compatible alg rel} (a b : Carrier) :
    (⟨rel, hc⟩ : Congruence alg).1 a b ↔ rel a b := Iff.rfl
theorem poly_generated_eqvGen {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) {a b : Carrier}
    (h : ∀ (θ : Congruence alg), (∀ p ∈ S, θ.1 p.1 p.2) → θ.1 a b) :
    Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) a b := by
  classical
  have hrel := congruence_mk_rel (alg := alg)
    (rel := Relation.EqvGen.setoid (TranslateRel alg S))
    (hc := eqvGenTranslate_compatible alg S) a b
  refine hrel.mp ?_
  refine h ⟨Relation.EqvGen.setoid (TranslateRel alg S), eqvGenTranslate_compatible alg S⟩ ?_
  intro p hp
  have hp' := congruence_mk_rel (alg := alg)
    (rel := Relation.EqvGen.setoid (TranslateRel alg S))
    (hc := eqvGenTranslate_compatible alg S) p.1 p.2
  exact hp'.mpr (Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (seed_mem_translateRel (alg := alg) (S := S) hp))
abbrev witnessOpType {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [LE Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) : Type :=
  { f : Fin n → Fin n // Admissible color f }
noncomputable instance witnessOpTypeFintype {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [LE Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) : Fintype (witnessOpType color) :=
  Fintype.ofFinite _
noncomputable abbrev witnessAlgebra {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [LE Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) : Algebra (Fin n) where
  numOps := Fintype.card (witnessOpType color)
  arity := fun _ => 1
  op := fun index left =>
    ((Fintype.equivFin (witnessOpType color)).symm index : witnessOpType color).1 (left 0)
noncomputable def witnessRho {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (h : IsGraphWitness color) (a : Lat) :
    Congruence (witnessAlgebra color) := by
  classical
  refine ⟨⟨fun x y => color x y ≤ a, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x
      have hxx : color x x = ⊥ := (h.2.1 x x).2 rfl
      rw [hxx]
      exact bot_le
    · intro x y hxy
      rwa [h.1 y x]
    · intro x y z hxy hyz
      calc
        color x z ≤ color x y ⊔ color y z := h.2.2.1 x z y
        _ ≤ a ⊔ a := sup_le (hxy.trans le_sup_left) (hyz.trans le_sup_right)
        _ = a := sup_idem a
  · intro index left right hcoord
    let e := Fintype.equivFin (witnessOpType color)
    let f : Fin n → Fin n := ((e.symm index : witnessOpType color)).1
    have hf : Admissible color f := (e.symm index).2
    change color (f (left 0)) (f (right 0)) ≤ a
    exact (hf (left 0) (right 0)).trans (hcoord 0)
lemma witnessAlgebra_admissible_apply {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    (f : Fin n → Fin n) (hf : Admissible color f) {u v : Fin n}
    (huv : θ.1 u v) : θ.1 (f u) (f v) := by
  classical
  let F : witnessOpType color := ⟨f, hf⟩
  let e := Fintype.equivFin (witnessOpType color)
  let index : Fin (witnessAlgebra color).numOps := e F
  have hleft : (witnessAlgebra color).op index
      (fun _ : Fin ((witnessAlgebra color).arity index) => u) = f u := by
    change ((e.symm index : witnessOpType color)).1 u = f u
    simp [index, e, F]
  have hright : (witnessAlgebra color).op index
      (fun _ : Fin ((witnessAlgebra color).arity index) => v) = f v := by
    change ((e.symm index : witnessOpType color)).1 v = f v
    simp [index, e, F]
  have h := θ.2 index (fun _ => u) (fun _ => v) (fun _ => huv)
  rwa [hleft, hright] at h
noncomputable def thetaSeeds {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color)) :
    Finset (Fin n × Fin n) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun edge => θ.1 edge.1 edge.2)
lemma thetaSeeds_mem {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    (edge : Fin n × Fin n) :
    edge ∈ thetaSeeds color θ ↔ θ.1 edge.1 edge.2 := by
  classical
  simp [thetaSeeds]
lemma thetaSeeds_nonempty {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    (hn : 0 < n) : (thetaSeeds color θ).Nonempty := by
  classical
  let x : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩
  refine ⟨(x, x), ?_⟩
  rw [thetaSeeds_mem]
lemma thetaSeeds_related {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    {edge : Fin n × Fin n} (h : edge ∈ thetaSeeds color θ) :
    θ.1 edge.1 edge.2 :=
  (thetaSeeds_mem color θ edge).1 h
lemma marked_mem_congruence {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    (seeds : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) (hseed : ∀ edge ∈ seeds, θ.1 edge.1 edge.2)
    {left right : Fin n} (hm : Marked color seeds left right) : θ.1 left right := by
  classical
  rcases hm with ⟨placement, hadmissible, edge, hedge, hleft, hright⟩
  rw [← hleft, ← hright]
  exact witnessAlgebra_admissible_apply color θ placement hadmissible (hseed edge hedge)
lemma connected_mem_congruence {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    (seeds : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) (hseed : ∀ edge ∈ seeds, θ.1 edge.1 edge.2)
    {left right : Fin n} (hc : Connected color seeds left right) : θ.1 left right := by
  classical
  induction hc with
  | rel a b hab =>
      exact marked_mem_congruence color θ seeds hseed hab
  | refl x =>
      exact θ.1.refl' x
  | symm a b hab ih =>
      exact θ.1.symm' ih
  | trans a b c hab hbc ihab ihbc =>
      exact θ.1.trans' ihab ihbc
noncomputable def witnessRhoSup {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color)) : Lat :=
  (thetaSeeds color θ).sup (fun edge => color edge.1 edge.2)
lemma mem_iff_rho_thetaSeeds {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (h : IsGraphWitness color)
    (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color)) (hn : 0 < n) (left right : Fin n) :
    θ.1 left right ↔
      color left right ≤ (thetaSeeds color θ).sup (fun edge => color edge.1 edge.2) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hrel
    exact Finset.le_sup (s := thetaSeeds color θ)
      (f := fun edge : Fin n × Fin n => color edge.1 edge.2) (b := (left, right))
      ((thetaSeeds_mem color θ (left, right)).2 hrel)
  · intro hcolor
    exact connected_mem_congruence color θ (thetaSeeds color θ)
      (fun edge hedge => thetaSeeds_related color θ hedge)
      (h.2.2.2.2 (thetaSeeds color θ) (thetaSeeds_nonempty color θ hn) left right hcolor)
lemma witnessRho_surjective {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (h : IsGraphWitness color) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Function.Surjective (witnessRho color h) := by
  classical
  intro θ
  refine ⟨witnessRhoSup color θ, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Setoid.ext
  intro left right
  exact (mem_iff_rho_thetaSeeds color h θ hn left right).symm
noncomputable def witnessEmbedding {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (h : IsGraphWitness color) :
    Lat ↪o Congruence (witnessAlgebra color) :=
  OrderEmbedding.ofMapLEIff (witnessRho color h) (by
    intro a b
    constructor
    · intro hle
      by_contra hnot
      rcases h.2.2.2.1 a b hnot with ⟨left, right, hleft, hright⟩
      exact hright (hle hleft)
    · intro hle left right hleft
      exact hleft.trans hle)
noncomputable def witnessOrderIso {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (h : IsGraphWitness color) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Lat ≃o Congruence (witnessAlgebra color) :=
  OrderIso.ofSurjective (witnessEmbedding color h) (witnessRho_surjective color h hn)
theorem witness_representable (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∀ {Lat : Type} [Fintype Lat] [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
      (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat), IsGraphWitness color → Representable Lat := by
  intro Lat _ _ _ color h
  exact ⟨n, hn, witnessAlgebra color, ⟨witnessOrderIso color h hn⟩⟩
theorem principal_isGraphWitness (n : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n) {Lat : Type} [Fintype Lat]
    [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (alg : Algebra (Fin n)) (e : Lat ≃o Congruence alg) :
    IsGraphWitness (fun x y : Fin n => e.symm (Principal alg x y)) := by
  classical
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y
    dsimp
    rw [Principal_comm]
  · intro x y
    dsimp
    have hbot : e (⊥ : Lat) = (⊥ : Congruence alg) := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · have h : (⊥ : Lat) ≤ e.symm (⊥ : Congruence alg) := bot_le
        have h' : e (⊥ : Lat) ≤ e (e.symm (⊥ : Congruence alg)) :=
          (e.le_iff_le).mpr h
        simpa using h'
      · change Principal_diagonal alg ≤ e (⊥ : Lat)
        exact Principal_diagonal_le alg (e (⊥ : Lat))
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h' : Principal alg x y = e (⊥ : Lat) := by
        have := congrArg e h
        simpa using this
      have h'' : Principal alg x y = (⊥ : Congruence alg) := by
        simpa [hbot] using h'
      exact (principal_bot_iff alg x y).1 h''
    · intro h
      have h' : Principal alg x y = (⊥ : Congruence alg) := (principal_bot_iff alg x y).2 h
      have h'' : Principal alg x y = e (⊥ : Lat) := by
        simpa [hbot] using h'
      have := congrArg e.symm h''
      simpa using this
  · intro x y z
    dsimp
    let a : Lat := e.symm (Principal alg x z)
    let b : Lat := e.symm (Principal alg z y)
    let θ : Congruence alg := e (a ⊔ b)
    have hxz : θ.1 x z := by
      have hle : Principal alg x z ≤ θ := by
        have h := (e.le_iff_le).mpr (le_sup_left : a ≤ a ⊔ b)
        simpa [θ, a] using h
      exact (Principal_le_iff alg x z θ).1 hle
    have hzy : θ.1 z y := by
      have hle : Principal alg z y ≤ θ := by
        have h := (e.le_iff_le).mpr (le_sup_right : b ≤ a ⊔ b)
        simpa [θ, b] using h
      exact (Principal_le_iff alg z y θ).1 hle
    have hxy : Principal alg x y ≤ θ := Principal_trans_le alg θ hxz hzy
    have h' : e (e.symm (Principal alg x y)) ≤ e (a ⊔ b) := by
      simpa [θ] using hxy
    have h'' := (e.le_iff_le).mp h'
    simpa [a, b] using h''
  · intro lower upper hnot
    have hnot' : ¬ e lower ≤ e upper := by
      intro h
      exact hnot ((e.le_iff_le).mp h)
    have hnotrel : ¬ (e lower).1 ≤ (e upper).1 := by
      change ¬ e lower ≤ e upper
      exact hnot'
    have hex : ∃ a b, (e lower).1 a b ∧ ¬ (e upper).1 a b := by
      by_contra h
      apply hnotrel
      rw [Setoid.le_def]
      intro a b hab
      by_contra hnab
      exact h ⟨a, b, hab, hnab⟩
    rcases hex with ⟨a, b, hab_lower, hab_not_upper⟩
    refine ⟨a, b, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hP : Principal alg a b ≤ e lower :=
        (Principal_le_iff alg a b (e lower)).2 hab_lower
      simpa using e.symm.monotone hP
    · intro hle
      have hP : Principal alg a b ≤ e upper := by
        have h := e.monotone hle
        simpa using h
      exact hab_not_upper ((Principal_le_iff alg a b (e upper)).1 hP)
  · intro seeds _hseeds x y hxy
    change Relation.EqvGen (Marked (fun x y : Fin n => e.symm (Principal alg x y)) seeds) x y
    have hgen : Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg seeds) x y := by
      refine poly_generated_eqvGen alg seeds ?_
      intro θ hθ
      let T : Lat := seeds.sup (fun edge => e.symm (Principal alg edge.1 edge.2))
      have hTle : T ≤ e.symm θ := by
        apply Finset.sup_le
        intro edge hedge
        have hP : Principal alg edge.1 edge.2 ≤ θ :=
          (Principal_le_iff alg edge.1 edge.2 θ).2 (hθ edge hedge)
        exact e.symm.monotone hP
      have heT : e T ≤ θ := by
        have h := e.monotone hTle
        simpa using h
      have hPxy : Principal alg x y ≤ e T := by
        have h := e.monotone hxy
        simpa [T] using h
      exact (Principal_le_iff alg x y θ).1 (le_trans hPxy heT)
    have hsubset : TranslateRel alg seeds ≤
        Marked (fun x y : Fin n => e.symm (Principal alg x y)) seeds := by
      intro u v huv
      rcases huv with ⟨p, hp, f, hf, rfl, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨f, ?_, p, hp, rfl, rfl⟩
      intro left right
      have hP : Principal alg (f left) (f right) ≤ Principal alg left right :=
        (Principal_le_iff alg (f left) (f right) (Principal alg left right)).2
          (hf (Principal alg left right) left right (Principal_mem_self alg left right))
      exact e.symm.monotone hP
    exact Relation.EqvGen.mono hsubset x y hgen
theorem representable_witness {Lat : Type} [Fintype Lat] [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (h : Representable Lat) : HasGraphWitness Lat := by
  rcases h with ⟨n, hn, alg, ⟨e⟩⟩
  exact ⟨n, hn, (fun x y : Fin n => e.symm (Principal alg x y)),
    principal_isGraphWitness n hn alg e⟩
theorem graph_criterion_from_directions (Lat : Type)
    [Fintype Lat] [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat] :
    Representable Lat ↔ HasGraphWitness Lat := by
  constructor
  · exact representable_witness
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨n, hn, color, hcolor⟩
    exact witness_representable n hn color hcolor
/-- A finite lattice is representable as the full congruence lattice of a nonempty finite
algebra exactly when it has a finite nonempty colored-graph witness. -/
theorem graph_criterion (Lat : Type) [Fintype Lat] [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat] :
    Representable Lat ↔ HasGraphWitness Lat := by
  exact graph_criterion_from_directions Lat
end FiniteCongruence

end OAI

import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Lattice.Fold
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Defs
import Mathlib.Data.Setoid.Basic
import Mathlib.Order.Hom.Basic

namespace OAI

namespace FiniteCongruence

structure Algebra (Carrier : Type) where
  numOps : ℕ
  arity : Fin numOps → ℕ
  op : (index : Fin numOps) → (Fin (arity index) → Carrier) → Carrier

def Compatible {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (rel : Setoid Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∀ (index : Fin alg.numOps) (left right : Fin (alg.arity index) → Carrier),
    (∀ coord, rel (left coord) (right coord)) → rel (alg.op index left) (alg.op index right)

def Congruence {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) :=
  {rel : Setoid Carrier // Compatible alg rel}

instance {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) : PartialOrder (Congruence alg) :=
  inferInstanceAs (PartialOrder {rel : Setoid Carrier // Compatible alg rel})

def Representable (Lat : Type) [PartialOrder Lat] : Prop :=
  ∃ size : ℕ, 0 < size ∧ ∃ alg : Algebra (Fin size), Nonempty (Lat ≃o Congruence alg)

def Admissible {Lat Carrier : Type} [LE Lat] (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat)
    (placement : Carrier → Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∀ left right, color (placement left) (placement right) ≤ color left right

def Marked {Lat Carrier : Type} [LE Lat] (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat)
    (seeds : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) (left right : Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∃ placement : Carrier → Carrier, Admissible color placement ∧
    ∃ edge ∈ seeds, placement edge.1 = left ∧ placement edge.2 = right

def Connected {Lat Carrier : Type} [LE Lat] (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat)
    (seeds : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) (left right : Carrier) : Prop :=
  Relation.EqvGen (Marked color seeds) left right

def IsGraphWitness {Lat Carrier : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat) : Prop :=
  (∀ left right, color left right = color right left) ∧
  (∀ left right, color left right = ⊥ ↔ left = right) ∧
  (∀ left right middle, color left right ≤ color left middle ⊔ color middle right) ∧
  (∀ lower upper : Lat, ¬ lower ≤ upper →
    ∃ left right, color left right ≤ lower ∧ ¬ color left right ≤ upper) ∧
  (∀ seeds : Finset (Carrier × Carrier), seeds.Nonempty → ∀ left right,
    color left right ≤ seeds.sup (fun edge => color edge.1 edge.2) →
      Connected color seeds left right)

def HasGraphWitness (Lat : Type) [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat] : Prop :=
  ∃ size : ℕ, 0 < size ∧ ∃ color : Fin size → Fin size → Lat, IsGraphWitness color

/-- A finite lattice is representable as the full congruence lattice of a nonempty finite
algebra exactly when it has a finite nonempty colored-graph witness. -/
theorem graph_criterion (Lat : Type) [Fintype Lat] [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat] :
    Representable Lat ↔ HasGraphWitness Lat := by
  sorry

end FiniteCongruence

end OAI

import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Prod
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Pi
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.EquivFin
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Lattice.Fold
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Defs
import Mathlib.Data.Setoid.Basic
import Mathlib.Order.Hom.Basic

namespace OAI

namespace FiniteCongruence

structure Algebra (Carrier : Type) where
  numOps : ℕ
  arity : Fin numOps → ℕ
  op : (index : Fin numOps) → (Fin (arity index) → Carrier) → Carrier

def Compatible {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (rel : Setoid Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∀ (index : Fin alg.numOps) (left right : Fin (alg.arity index) → Carrier),
    (∀ coord, rel (left coord) (right coord)) → rel (alg.op index left) (alg.op index right)

def Congruence {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) :=
  {rel : Setoid Carrier // Compatible alg rel}

instance {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) : PartialOrder (Congruence alg) :=
  inferInstanceAs (PartialOrder {rel : Setoid Carrier // Compatible alg rel})

def Representable (Lat : Type) [PartialOrder Lat] : Prop :=
  ∃ size : ℕ, 0 < size ∧ ∃ alg : Algebra (Fin size), Nonempty (Lat ≃o Congruence alg)

def Admissible {Lat Carrier : Type} [LE Lat] (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat)
    (placement : Carrier → Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∀ left right, color (placement left) (placement right) ≤ color left right

def Marked {Lat Carrier : Type} [LE Lat] (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat)
    (seeds : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) (left right : Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∃ placement : Carrier → Carrier, Admissible color placement ∧
    ∃ edge ∈ seeds, placement edge.1 = left ∧ placement edge.2 = right

def Connected {Lat Carrier : Type} [LE Lat] (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat)
    (seeds : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) (left right : Carrier) : Prop :=
  Relation.EqvGen (Marked color seeds) left right

def IsGraphWitness {Lat Carrier : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat) : Prop :=
  (∀ left right, color left right = color right left) ∧
  (∀ left right, color left right = ⊥ ↔ left = right) ∧
  (∀ left right middle, color left right ≤ color left middle ⊔ color middle right) ∧
  (∀ lower upper : Lat, ¬ lower ≤ upper →
    ∃ left right, color left right ≤ lower ∧ ¬ color left right ≤ upper) ∧
  (∀ seeds : Finset (Carrier × Carrier), seeds.Nonempty → ∀ left right,
    color left right ≤ seeds.sup (fun edge => color edge.1 edge.2) →
      Connected color seeds left right)

def HasGraphWitness (Lat : Type) [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat] : Prop :=
  ∃ size : ℕ, 0 < size ∧ ∃ color : Fin size → Fin size → Lat, IsGraphWitness color

def Principal {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier) : Congruence alg where
  val :=
    { r := fun a b => ∀ θ : Congruence alg, θ.1 x y → θ.1 a b
      iseqv :=
        { refl := fun a θ _ => θ.1.refl a
          symm := fun h θ hxy => θ.1.symm (h θ hxy)
          trans := fun hab hbc θ hxy => θ.1.trans (hab θ hxy) (hbc θ hxy) } }
  property := by
    intro index left right h θ hxy
    exact θ.2 index left right (fun coord => h coord θ hxy)
theorem principal_rel_iff {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y a b : Carrier) :
    (Principal alg x y).1 a b ↔ ∀ θ : Congruence alg, θ.1 x y → θ.1 a b :=
  Iff.rfl
theorem Principal_mem_self {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier) :
    (Principal alg x y).1 x y := by
  rw [principal_rel_iff]
  intro θ h
  exact h
theorem Principal_le_iff {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier)
    (θ : Congruence alg) : Principal alg x y ≤ θ ↔ θ.1 x y := by
  change (Principal alg x y).1 ≤ θ.1 ↔ θ.1 x y
  rw [Setoid.le_def]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h (Principal_mem_self alg x y)
  · intro h a b hab
    exact (principal_rel_iff alg x y a b).1 hab θ h
theorem Principal_least {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) {x y : Carrier}
    (θ : Congruence alg) (h : θ.1 x y) : Principal alg x y ≤ θ :=
  (Principal_le_iff alg x y θ).2 h
theorem Principal_comm {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier) :
    Principal alg x y = Principal alg y x := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Setoid.ext
  intro a b
  rw [principal_rel_iff, principal_rel_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h θ hyx
    exact h θ (θ.1.symm hyx)
  · intro h θ hxy
    exact h θ (θ.1.symm hxy)
theorem Principal_trans_le {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) {x y z : Carrier}
    (θ : Congruence alg) (hxz : θ.1 x z) (hzy : θ.1 z y) : Principal alg x y ≤ θ :=
  Principal_least alg θ (θ.1.trans hxz hzy)
def Principal_diagonal {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) : Congruence alg where
  val :=
    { r := fun a b => a = b
      iseqv :=
        { refl := fun _ => rfl
          symm := fun h => h.symm
          trans := fun h₁ h₂ => h₁.trans h₂ } }
  property := by
    intro index left right h
    have hlr : left = right := funext fun coord => h coord
    rw [hlr]
theorem Principal_diagonal_le {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (θ : Congruence alg) : Principal_diagonal alg ≤ θ := by
  intro a b h
  subst h
  exact θ.1.refl a
theorem Principal_eq_diagonal_iff {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier) :
    Principal alg x y = Principal_diagonal alg ↔ x = y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hm : (Principal alg x y).1 x y := Principal_mem_self alg x y
    rw [h] at hm
    exact hm
  · intro h
    subst h
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply (Principal_le_iff alg x x (Principal_diagonal alg)).2
      rfl
    · exact Principal_diagonal_le alg (Principal alg x x)
instance principalBotCongruence {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) : Bot (Congruence alg) :=
  ⟨Principal_diagonal alg⟩
theorem principal_bot_iff {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (x y : Carrier) :
    Principal alg x y = ⊥ ↔ x = y := by
  change Principal alg x y = Principal_diagonal alg ↔ x = y
  exact Principal_eq_diagonal_iff alg x y
def PolyCompatible {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (f : Carrier → Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∀ (θ : Congruence alg) (u v : Carrier), θ.1 u v → θ.1 (f u) (f v)
theorem polyCompatible_sanity {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) :
    (PolyCompatible alg (fun x : Carrier => x) ∧
     ∀ (f g : Carrier → Carrier), PolyCompatible alg f → PolyCompatible alg g →
       PolyCompatible alg (fun x : Carrier => f (g x))) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro θ u v huv; exact huv
  · intro f g hf hg θ u v huv
    exact hf θ _ _ (hg θ u v huv)

-- R closed under compatible maps  =>  EqvGen R closed under compatible maps
theorem eqvGen_closed_of_closed {Carrier : Type} {R : Carrier → Carrier → Prop}
    (g : Carrier → Carrier) (hgm : ∀ x y, R x y → R (g x) (g y)) :
    ∀ x y, Relation.EqvGen R x y → Relation.EqvGen R (g x) (g y) := by
  intro x y h
  induction h with
  | rel a b hab => exact Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (hgm a b hab)
  | refl a => exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  | symm a b hab ih => exact Relation.EqvGen.symm _ _ ih
  | trans a b c hab hbc ihab ihbc => exact Relation.EqvGen.trans _ _ _ ihab ihbc
def TranslateRel {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier) (S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier))
    (u v : Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∃ p ∈ S, ∃ f : Carrier → Carrier, PolyCompatible alg f ∧ u = f p.1 ∧ v = f p.2
theorem polyCompatible_comp {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier} {f g : Carrier → Carrier}
    (hf : PolyCompatible alg f) (hg : PolyCompatible alg g) :
    PolyCompatible alg (fun x => f (g x)) := fun θ u v h => hf θ _ _ (hg θ u v h)
theorem translateRel_closed {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier}
    {S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)} {g : Carrier → Carrier} (hg : PolyCompatible alg g) :
    ∀ x y, TranslateRel alg S x y → TranslateRel alg S (g x) (g y) := by
  rintro x y ⟨p, hp, f, hf, rfl, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨p, hp, fun z => g (f z), polyCompatible_comp (alg := alg) hg hf, rfl, rfl⟩
theorem eqvGenTranslate_closed {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier}
    {S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)} {g : Carrier → Carrier} (hg : PolyCompatible alg g) :
    ∀ x y, Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) x y →
      Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (g x) (g y) :=
  eqvGen_closed_of_closed g (translateRel_closed (S := S) hg)
theorem coord_map_polyCompatible {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (index : Fin alg.numOps) (u : Fin (alg.arity index) → Carrier)
    (c : Fin (alg.arity index)) :
    PolyCompatible alg (fun x : Carrier => alg.op index (Function.update u c x)) := by
  intro θ l r hlr
  apply θ.2 index
  intro coord
  by_cases h : coord = c
  · subst h
    simpa using hlr
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne h, Function.update_of_ne h]
theorem op_eqvGen_of_forall {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) (index : Fin alg.numOps)
    (u v : Fin (alg.arity index) → Carrier)
    (huv : ∀ c, Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (u c) (v c)) :
    Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (alg.op index u) (alg.op index v) := by
  let w : Finset (Fin (alg.arity index)) → (Fin (alg.arity index) → Carrier) :=
    fun T c => if c ∈ T then v c else u c
  have hw_empty : w ∅ = u := by funext c; simp [w]
  have hw_univ : w Finset.univ = v := by funext c; simp [w]
  have hstep : ∀ (T : Finset (Fin (alg.arity index))) (c : Fin (alg.arity index)), c ∉ T →
      Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (alg.op index (w T))
        (alg.op index (w (insert c T))) := by
    intro T c hc
    have hwins : w (insert c T) = Function.update (w T) c (v c) := by
      funext d
      by_cases hd : d = c
      · subst hd; simp [w, Function.update_self]
      · simp [w, Finset.mem_insert, hd]
    rw [hwins]
    have hmem : w T c = if c ∈ T then v c else u c := rfl
    have hpoly : PolyCompatible alg (fun x : Carrier => alg.op index (Function.update (w T) c x)) :=
      coord_map_polyCompatible alg index (w T) c
    have := eqvGenTranslate_closed (S := S) hpoly (w T c) (v c) ?_
    · simpa [Function.update_self] using this
    · show Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (w T c) (v c)
      rw [hmem]
      rw [if_neg hc]
      exact huv c
  have hmain : ∀ T : Finset (Fin (alg.arity index)),
      Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) (alg.op index u) (alg.op index (w T)) := by
    intro T
    induction T using Finset.induction with
    | empty => rw [hw_empty]; exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
    | insert a s ha ih => exact Relation.EqvGen.trans _ _ _ ih (hstep s a ha)
  have := hmain Finset.univ
  rwa [hw_univ] at this
theorem eqvGenTranslate_compatible {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) :
    Compatible alg (Relation.EqvGen.setoid (TranslateRel alg S)) := by
  intro index u v huv
  apply op_eqvGen_of_forall alg S index u v
  intro c
  exact huv c
theorem seed_mem_translateRel {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier}
    {S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)} {p : Carrier × Carrier} (hp : p ∈ S) :
    TranslateRel alg S p.1 p.2 :=
  ⟨p, hp, id, fun _ _ _ huv => huv, rfl, rfl⟩
theorem congruence_mk_rel {Carrier : Type} {alg : Algebra Carrier}
    {rel : Setoid Carrier} {hc : Compatible alg rel} (a b : Carrier) :
    (⟨rel, hc⟩ : Congruence alg).1 a b ↔ rel a b := Iff.rfl
theorem poly_generated_eqvGen {Carrier : Type} (alg : Algebra Carrier)
    (S : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) {a b : Carrier}
    (h : ∀ (θ : Congruence alg), (∀ p ∈ S, θ.1 p.1 p.2) → θ.1 a b) :
    Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg S) a b := by
  classical
  have hrel := congruence_mk_rel (alg := alg)
    (rel := Relation.EqvGen.setoid (TranslateRel alg S))
    (hc := eqvGenTranslate_compatible alg S) a b
  refine hrel.mp ?_
  refine h ⟨Relation.EqvGen.setoid (TranslateRel alg S), eqvGenTranslate_compatible alg S⟩ ?_
  intro p hp
  have hp' := congruence_mk_rel (alg := alg)
    (rel := Relation.EqvGen.setoid (TranslateRel alg S))
    (hc := eqvGenTranslate_compatible alg S) p.1 p.2
  exact hp'.mpr (Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (seed_mem_translateRel (alg := alg) (S := S) hp))
abbrev witnessOpType {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [LE Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) : Type :=
  { f : Fin n → Fin n // Admissible color f }
noncomputable instance witnessOpTypeFintype {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [LE Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) : Fintype (witnessOpType color) :=
  Fintype.ofFinite _
noncomputable abbrev witnessAlgebra {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [LE Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) : Algebra (Fin n) where
  numOps := Fintype.card (witnessOpType color)
  arity := fun _ => 1
  op := fun index left =>
    ((Fintype.equivFin (witnessOpType color)).symm index : witnessOpType color).1 (left 0)
noncomputable def witnessRho {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (h : IsGraphWitness color) (a : Lat) :
    Congruence (witnessAlgebra color) := by
  classical
  refine ⟨⟨fun x y => color x y ≤ a, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x
      have hxx : color x x = ⊥ := (h.2.1 x x).2 rfl
      rw [hxx]
      exact bot_le
    · intro x y hxy
      rwa [h.1 y x]
    · intro x y z hxy hyz
      calc
        color x z ≤ color x y ⊔ color y z := h.2.2.1 x z y
        _ ≤ a ⊔ a := sup_le (hxy.trans le_sup_left) (hyz.trans le_sup_right)
        _ = a := sup_idem a
  · intro index left right hcoord
    let e := Fintype.equivFin (witnessOpType color)
    let f : Fin n → Fin n := ((e.symm index : witnessOpType color)).1
    have hf : Admissible color f := (e.symm index).2
    change color (f (left 0)) (f (right 0)) ≤ a
    exact (hf (left 0) (right 0)).trans (hcoord 0)
lemma witnessAlgebra_admissible_apply {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    (f : Fin n → Fin n) (hf : Admissible color f) {u v : Fin n}
    (huv : θ.1 u v) : θ.1 (f u) (f v) := by
  classical
  let F : witnessOpType color := ⟨f, hf⟩
  let e := Fintype.equivFin (witnessOpType color)
  let index : Fin (witnessAlgebra color).numOps := e F
  have hleft : (witnessAlgebra color).op index
      (fun _ : Fin ((witnessAlgebra color).arity index) => u) = f u := by
    change ((e.symm index : witnessOpType color)).1 u = f u
    simp [index, e, F]
  have hright : (witnessAlgebra color).op index
      (fun _ : Fin ((witnessAlgebra color).arity index) => v) = f v := by
    change ((e.symm index : witnessOpType color)).1 v = f v
    simp [index, e, F]
  have h := θ.2 index (fun _ => u) (fun _ => v) (fun _ => huv)
  rwa [hleft, hright] at h
noncomputable def thetaSeeds {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color)) :
    Finset (Fin n × Fin n) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun edge => θ.1 edge.1 edge.2)
lemma thetaSeeds_mem {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    (edge : Fin n × Fin n) :
    edge ∈ thetaSeeds color θ ↔ θ.1 edge.1 edge.2 := by
  classical
  simp [thetaSeeds]
lemma thetaSeeds_nonempty {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    (hn : 0 < n) : (thetaSeeds color θ).Nonempty := by
  classical
  let x : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩
  refine ⟨(x, x), ?_⟩
  rw [thetaSeeds_mem]
lemma thetaSeeds_related {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    {edge : Fin n × Fin n} (h : edge ∈ thetaSeeds color θ) :
    θ.1 edge.1 edge.2 :=
  (thetaSeeds_mem color θ edge).1 h
lemma marked_mem_congruence {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    (seeds : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) (hseed : ∀ edge ∈ seeds, θ.1 edge.1 edge.2)
    {left right : Fin n} (hm : Marked color seeds left right) : θ.1 left right := by
  classical
  rcases hm with ⟨placement, hadmissible, edge, hedge, hleft, hright⟩
  rw [← hleft, ← hright]
  exact witnessAlgebra_admissible_apply color θ placement hadmissible (hseed edge hedge)
lemma connected_mem_congruence {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color))
    (seeds : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) (hseed : ∀ edge ∈ seeds, θ.1 edge.1 edge.2)
    {left right : Fin n} (hc : Connected color seeds left right) : θ.1 left right := by
  classical
  induction hc with
  | rel a b hab =>
      exact marked_mem_congruence color θ seeds hseed hab
  | refl x =>
      exact θ.1.refl' x
  | symm a b hab ih =>
      exact θ.1.symm' ih
  | trans a b c hab hbc ihab ihbc =>
      exact θ.1.trans' ihab ihbc
noncomputable def witnessRhoSup {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color)) : Lat :=
  (thetaSeeds color θ).sup (fun edge => color edge.1 edge.2)
lemma mem_iff_rho_thetaSeeds {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (h : IsGraphWitness color)
    (θ : Congruence (witnessAlgebra color)) (hn : 0 < n) (left right : Fin n) :
    θ.1 left right ↔
      color left right ≤ (thetaSeeds color θ).sup (fun edge => color edge.1 edge.2) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hrel
    exact Finset.le_sup (s := thetaSeeds color θ)
      (f := fun edge : Fin n × Fin n => color edge.1 edge.2) (b := (left, right))
      ((thetaSeeds_mem color θ (left, right)).2 hrel)
  · intro hcolor
    exact connected_mem_congruence color θ (thetaSeeds color θ)
      (fun edge hedge => thetaSeeds_related color θ hedge)
      (h.2.2.2.2 (thetaSeeds color θ) (thetaSeeds_nonempty color θ hn) left right hcolor)
lemma witnessRho_surjective {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (h : IsGraphWitness color) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Function.Surjective (witnessRho color h) := by
  classical
  intro θ
  refine ⟨witnessRhoSup color θ, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Setoid.ext
  intro left right
  exact (mem_iff_rho_thetaSeeds color h θ hn left right).symm
noncomputable def witnessEmbedding {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (h : IsGraphWitness color) :
    Lat ↪o Congruence (witnessAlgebra color) :=
  OrderEmbedding.ofMapLEIff (witnessRho color h) (by
    intro a b
    constructor
    · intro hle
      by_contra hnot
      rcases h.2.2.2.1 a b hnot with ⟨left, right, hleft, hright⟩
      exact hright (hle hleft)
    · intro hle left right hleft
      exact hleft.trans hle)
noncomputable def witnessOrderIso {n : ℕ} {Lat : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat) (h : IsGraphWitness color) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Lat ≃o Congruence (witnessAlgebra color) :=
  OrderIso.ofSurjective (witnessEmbedding color h) (witnessRho_surjective color h hn)
theorem witness_representable (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∀ {Lat : Type} [Fintype Lat] [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
      (color : Fin n → Fin n → Lat), IsGraphWitness color → Representable Lat := by
  intro Lat _ _ _ color h
  exact ⟨n, hn, witnessAlgebra color, ⟨witnessOrderIso color h hn⟩⟩
theorem principal_isGraphWitness (n : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n) {Lat : Type} [Fintype Lat]
    [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (alg : Algebra (Fin n)) (e : Lat ≃o Congruence alg) :
    IsGraphWitness (fun x y : Fin n => e.symm (Principal alg x y)) := by
  classical
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y
    dsimp
    rw [Principal_comm]
  · intro x y
    dsimp
    have hbot : e (⊥ : Lat) = (⊥ : Congruence alg) := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · have h : (⊥ : Lat) ≤ e.symm (⊥ : Congruence alg) := bot_le
        have h' : e (⊥ : Lat) ≤ e (e.symm (⊥ : Congruence alg)) :=
          (e.le_iff_le).mpr h
        simpa using h'
      · change Principal_diagonal alg ≤ e (⊥ : Lat)
        exact Principal_diagonal_le alg (e (⊥ : Lat))
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h' : Principal alg x y = e (⊥ : Lat) := by
        have := congrArg e h
        simpa using this
      have h'' : Principal alg x y = (⊥ : Congruence alg) := by
        simpa [hbot] using h'
      exact (principal_bot_iff alg x y).1 h''
    · intro h
      have h' : Principal alg x y = (⊥ : Congruence alg) := (principal_bot_iff alg x y).2 h
      have h'' : Principal alg x y = e (⊥ : Lat) := by
        simpa [hbot] using h'
      have := congrArg e.symm h''
      simpa using this
  · intro x y z
    dsimp
    let a : Lat := e.symm (Principal alg x z)
    let b : Lat := e.symm (Principal alg z y)
    let θ : Congruence alg := e (a ⊔ b)
    have hxz : θ.1 x z := by
      have hle : Principal alg x z ≤ θ := by
        have h := (e.le_iff_le).mpr (le_sup_left : a ≤ a ⊔ b)
        simpa [θ, a] using h
      exact (Principal_le_iff alg x z θ).1 hle
    have hzy : θ.1 z y := by
      have hle : Principal alg z y ≤ θ := by
        have h := (e.le_iff_le).mpr (le_sup_right : b ≤ a ⊔ b)
        simpa [θ, b] using h
      exact (Principal_le_iff alg z y θ).1 hle
    have hxy : Principal alg x y ≤ θ := Principal_trans_le alg θ hxz hzy
    have h' : e (e.symm (Principal alg x y)) ≤ e (a ⊔ b) := by
      simpa [θ] using hxy
    have h'' := (e.le_iff_le).mp h'
    simpa [a, b] using h''
  · intro lower upper hnot
    have hnot' : ¬ e lower ≤ e upper := by
      intro h
      exact hnot ((e.le_iff_le).mp h)
    have hnotrel : ¬ (e lower).1 ≤ (e upper).1 := by
      change ¬ e lower ≤ e upper
      exact hnot'
    have hex : ∃ a b, (e lower).1 a b ∧ ¬ (e upper).1 a b := by
      by_contra h
      apply hnotrel
      rw [Setoid.le_def]
      intro a b hab
      by_contra hnab
      exact h ⟨a, b, hab, hnab⟩
    rcases hex with ⟨a, b, hab_lower, hab_not_upper⟩
    refine ⟨a, b, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hP : Principal alg a b ≤ e lower :=
        (Principal_le_iff alg a b (e lower)).2 hab_lower
      simpa using e.symm.monotone hP
    · intro hle
      have hP : Principal alg a b ≤ e upper := by
        have h := e.monotone hle
        simpa using h
      exact hab_not_upper ((Principal_le_iff alg a b (e upper)).1 hP)
  · intro seeds _hseeds x y hxy
    change Relation.EqvGen (Marked (fun x y : Fin n => e.symm (Principal alg x y)) seeds) x y
    have hgen : Relation.EqvGen (TranslateRel alg seeds) x y := by
      refine poly_generated_eqvGen alg seeds ?_
      intro θ hθ
      let T : Lat := seeds.sup (fun edge => e.symm (Principal alg edge.1 edge.2))
      have hTle : T ≤ e.symm θ := by
        apply Finset.sup_le
        intro edge hedge
        have hP : Principal alg edge.1 edge.2 ≤ θ :=
          (Principal_le_iff alg edge.1 edge.2 θ).2 (hθ edge hedge)
        exact e.symm.monotone hP
      have heT : e T ≤ θ := by
        have h := e.monotone hTle
        simpa using h
      have hPxy : Principal alg x y ≤ e T := by
        have h := e.monotone hxy
        simpa [T] using h
      exact (Principal_le_iff alg x y θ).1 (le_trans hPxy heT)
    have hsubset : TranslateRel alg seeds ≤
        Marked (fun x y : Fin n => e.symm (Principal alg x y)) seeds := by
      intro u v huv
      rcases huv with ⟨p, hp, f, hf, rfl, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨f, ?_, p, hp, rfl, rfl⟩
      intro left right
      have hP : Principal alg (f left) (f right) ≤ Principal alg left right :=
        (Principal_le_iff alg (f left) (f right) (Principal alg left right)).2
          (hf (Principal alg left right) left right (Principal_mem_self alg left right))
      exact e.symm.monotone hP
    exact Relation.EqvGen.mono hsubset x y hgen
theorem representable_witness {Lat : Type} [Fintype Lat] [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (h : Representable Lat) : HasGraphWitness Lat := by
  rcases h with ⟨n, hn, alg, ⟨e⟩⟩
  exact ⟨n, hn, (fun x y : Fin n => e.symm (Principal alg x y)),
    principal_isGraphWitness n hn alg e⟩
theorem graph_criterion_from_directions (Lat : Type)
    [Fintype Lat] [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat] :
    Representable Lat ↔ HasGraphWitness Lat := by
  constructor
  · exact representable_witness
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨n, hn, color, hcolor⟩
    exact witness_representable n hn color hcolor
/-- A finite lattice is representable as the full congruence lattice of a nonempty finite
algebra exactly when it has a finite nonempty colored-graph witness. -/
theorem graph_criterion (Lat : Type) [Fintype Lat] [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat] :
    Representable Lat ↔ HasGraphWitness Lat := by
  exact graph_criterion_from_directions Lat
end FiniteCongruence

For a class representative c in {up 0 0, down 0 0}, u p := log (partition c e s (2p)) is Subadditive by definitional unfolding of even_log_subadditive_*, and even_log_bddBelow_* feeds Fekete (Subadditive.tendsto_lim), so logPartition c e s (2p) -> A/2 with A := Subadditive.lim. Prove the corresponding lower bound for the down origin. Consumer: the real subadditive/Fekete lemma for the down class.
Derive subadditivity of the even up-origin log partition from partition_split_le, parity, and strict positivity. Consumer: Fekete for the up class.
Derive the analogous even subadditivity for the down origin. Consumer: Fekete for the down class.

Prove the generic parity criterion for atTop convergence in ℝ: if the even subsequence u (2*p) and the odd subsequence u (2*p+1) both tend to l, then u tends to l. First step: for each neighbourhood set of l extract thresholds N0 and N1 from the two subsequence limits; every n ≥ 2*max N0 N1 is even or odd (Nat.even_or_odd plus omega), so u n lies in the neighbourhood eventually. Consumer: glue_logPartition_converges and the final assembly of OAI.HoneycombForce.logPartition_tendsto; this is remaining obligation 1 of the advisory initial_goal_1 finding. No library search is required: Eventually/atTop reasoning and Nat.even_or_odd suffice.

Prove that every origin sequence logPartition c e s converges to some real A, using only the already checked split, positivity, even-subadditivity and lower-bound lemmas. Construction: u p := Real.log (partition c e s (2*p)); hypothesis hsub packages as Subadditive u, hypothesis hbdd feeds Subadditive.tendsto_lim, so u p / p → A and the even subsequence logPartition c e s (2*p) → A/2 (u p/(2p) = (u p/p)/2). Odd squeeze: C := max (partition (up 0 0) e s 1) (partition (down 0 0) e s 1) > 0 by partition_pos, L := Real.log C; partition_split_le at n = 1 gives log P(m+1) ≤ log P m + L, and applied at m+1 gives log P(m+1) ≥ log P(m+2) − L using partition_pos, Real.log_le_log and Real.log_mul. Divide by 2p+1: upper bracket ((u p)/p)*(2p/(2p+1)) + L/(2p+1), lower bracket ((u (p+1))/(p+1))*((2p+2)/(2p+1)) − L/(2p+1); both tend to A/2, so tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' gives logPartition c e s (2p+1) → A/2, and glue_even_odd yields the full sequence. Consumer: the closing assembly of the frozen goal, instantiated at c = up 0 0 and c = down 0 0 with even_log_subadditive_up/down and even_log_bddBelow_up/down, transferred to an arbitrary origin by partition_eq_of_up_eq, and converted to the freeEnergy limit by tendsto_nhds_limUnder. Hardest premise: the odd-squeeze inequalities at length 2p+1; first discriminating check: derive log P(2p+1) ≤ log P(2p) + L and log P(2p+2) ≤ log P(2p+1) + L and verify the two divided brackets share the limit A/2.

deliveries.summary: Consumer sufficiency for OAI.HoneycombForce.logPartition_tendsto is established mathematically from the 9 fixed typed inputs; the remaining work is Lean formalization only (no missing mathematics). Argument: tendsto_nhds_limUnder reduces the target to honest convergence of logPartition o e s. For a class representative c in {up 0 0, down 0 0}, u p := log (partition c e s (2p)) is Subadditive by definitional unfolding of even_log_subadditive_*, and even_log_bddBelow_* feeds Fekete (Subadditive.tendsto_lim), so logPartition c e s (2p) -> A/2 with A := Subadditive.lim. The odd subsequence is squeezed: partition_split_le at n=1 gives log (partition c e s (m+1)) <= log (partition c e s m) + log C with C := max (partition (up 0 0) e s 1) (partition (down 0 0) e s 1) > 0 by partition_pos, so logPartition c e s (2p+1) lies between b p*(2p/(2p+1)) + L/(2p+1) and b (p+1)*((2p+2)/(2p+1)) - L/(2p+1) where b p = u p / p -> A/2 and L = log C; both brackets tend to A/2, hence so does the odd subsequence. Even+odd convergence implies full convergence (locally proved tendsto_atTop_of_even_odd using Nat.even_or_odd' and eventually_atTop with threshold 2*max N1 N2 + 2). Arbitrary origin o transfers by partition_eq_of_up_eq with c = if o.up then up 0 0 else down 0 0. A_up and A_down need not coincide; only per-class convergence to A_c/2 is used. Corrigendum: the earlier continuation note's 'Q1 criticality/rho subadditivity gap' is not needed, since partition_split_le is a fixed input and odd lengths are handled by the single-step bound. Verified #check facts: tendsto_nhds_limUnder is available unqualified (Filter./TopologicalSpace. prefixed names do not resolve; limUnder is only usable via dot notation f.limUnder g); Subadditive.tendsto_lim, tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le', tendsto_one_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat, Real.log_le_log, Real.log_mul all present. Next obligations: (1) tendsto_atTop_of_even_odd, (2) even subsequence limit A/2, (3) odd squeeze limit A/2, (4) class case + transfer + limUnder glue; all helpers placed after freeEnergy and before logPartition_tendsto.

Argument (all formalized): split gamma in saws o (m+n) into prefix alpha := gamma.take (m+1) and suffix beta := gamma.drop m. (1) projection e (z+w) = projection e z + projection e w, so rho^(m+n)*exp(s*proj e (z+w)) factors as (rho^m*exp(s*proj e z))*(rho^n*exp(s*proj e w)); (2) displacement o gamma = displacement o alpha + displacement (endpoint o alpha) beta, using endpoint (endpoint o alpha) beta = endpoint o gamma; (3) alpha in saws o m (mem_walkLists_iff + IsChain.take + Nodup.sublist of take_sublist) and beta in saws (endpoint o alpha) n (head?_drop = some gamma[m] = endpoint o alpha, length_drop, IsChain.drop, Nodup.sublist of drop_sublist); (4) gamma |-> (take (m+1), drop m) is injective since gamma.take (m+1) ++ (gamma.drop m).tail = gamma unconditionally. Then partition (m+n) = sum over the image, <= sum over the Finset.sigma superset (all summands nonnegative), = double sum, and each inner sum is (rho^m*exp(...))*partition (endpoint o alpha) e s n <= (rho^m*exp(...))*M with M = max of the two canonical classes, because cases on (endpoint o alpha).up plus partition_eq_of_up_eq reduces any start vertex to up 0 0 or down 0 0. Prove nonnegativity of every partition sum. Consumer: partition_split_le; positive summands allow discarding concatenation repetitions.
Prove that partition is unchanged by an integer coordinate translation preserving the up flag. Consumer: partition_split_le, reducing every suffix sum to the corresponding origin class.

Prove the edge-splitting estimate for forced self-avoiding walks: after m edges, the suffix contribution is bounded by the larger of the two origin-class partitions. Consumer: even_log_subadditive_up/down and hence Fekete.

Prove strict positivity of every partition, first for n=0 and then using an explicit self-avoiding path for each length. Consumer: real logarithm multiplication in even_log_subadditive_up/down and the Fekete lower bound.
Prove a uniform lower bound for the normalized even log partition from the up origin. Consumer: the real subadditive/Fekete lemma for the up class.
Prove the corresponding lower bound for the down origin. Consumer: the real subadditive/Fekete lemma for the down class.
Derive subadditivity of the even up-origin log partition from partition_split_le, parity, and strict positivity. Consumer: Fekete for the up class.
Derive the analogous even subadditivity for the down origin. Consumer: Fekete for the down class.

Prove the generic parity criterion for atTop convergence in ℝ: if the even subsequence u (2*p) and the odd subsequence u (2*p+1) both tend to l, then u tends to l. First step: for each neighbourhood set of l extract thresholds N0 and N1 from the two subsequence limits; every n ≥ 2*max N0 N1 is even or odd (Nat.even_or_odd plus omega), so u n lies in the neighbourhood eventually. Consumer: glue_logPartition_converges and the final assembly of OAI.HoneycombForce.logPartition_tendsto; this is remaining obligation 1 of the advisory initial_goal_1 finding. No library search is required: Eventually/atTop reasoning and Nat.even_or_odd suffice.

Prove that every origin sequence logPartition c e s converges to some real A, using only the already checked split, positivity, even-subadditivity and lower-bound lemmas. Construction: u p := Real.log (partition c e s (2*p)); hypothesis hsub packages as Subadditive u, hypothesis hbdd feeds Subadditive.tendsto_lim, so u p / p → A and the even subsequence logPartition c e s (2*p) → A/2 (u p/(2p) = (u p/p)/2). Odd squeeze: C := max (partition (up 0 0) e s 1) (partition (down 0 0) e s 1) > 0 by partition_pos, L := Real.log C; partition_split_le at n = 1 gives log P(m+1) ≤ log P m + L, and applied at m+1 gives log P(m+1) ≥ log P(m+2) − L using partition_pos, Real.log_le_log and Real.log_mul. Divide by 2p+1: upper bracket ((u p)/p)*(2p/(2p+1)) + L/(2p+1), lower bracket ((u (p+1))/(p+1))*((2p+2)/(2p+1)) − L/(2p+1); both tend to A/2, so tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' gives logPartition c e s (2p+1) → A/2, and glue_even_odd yields the full sequence. Consumer: the closing assembly of the frozen goal, instantiated at c = up 0 0 and c = down 0 0 with even_log_subadditive_up/down and even_log_bddBelow_up/down, transferred to an arbitrary origin by partition_eq_of_up_eq, and converted to the freeEnergy limit by tendsto_nhds_limUnder. Hardest premise: the odd-squeeze inequalities at length 2p+1; first discriminating check: derive log P(2p+1) ≤ log P(2p) + L and log P(2p+2) ≤ log P(2p+1) + L and verify the two divided brackets share the limit A/2.

Argument: tendsto_nhds_limUnder reduces the target to honest convergence of logPartition o e s. For a class representative c in {up 0 0, down 0 0}, u p := log (partition c e s (2p)) is Subadditive by definitional unfolding of even_log_subadditive_*, and even_log_bddBelow_* feeds Fekete (Subadditive.tendsto_lim), so logPartition c e s (2p) -> A/2 with A := Subadditive.lim. The odd subsequence is squeezed: partition_split_le at n=1 gives log (partition c e s (m+1)) <= log (partition c e s m) + log C with C := max (partition (up 0 0) e s 1) (partition (down 0 0) e s 1) > 0 by partition_pos, so logPartition c e s (2p+1) lies between b p*(2p/(2p+1)) + L/(2p+1) and b (p+1)*((2p+2)/(2p+1)) - L/(2p+1) where b p = u p / p -> A/2 and L = log C; both brackets tend to A/2, hence so does the odd subsequence. Even+odd convergence implies full convergence (locally proved tendsto_atTop_of_even_odd using Nat.even_or_odd' and eventually_atTop with threshold 2*max N1 N2 + 2). Arbitrary origin o transfers by partition_eq_of_up_eq with c = if o.up then up 0 0 else down 0 0. A_up and A_down need not coincide; only per-class convergence to A_c/2 is used. Corrigendum: the earlier continuation note's 'Q1 criticality/rho subadditivity gap' is not needed, since partition_split_le is a fixed input and odd lengths are handled by the single-step bound. import Mathlib

namespace OAI

                                                                           

noncomputable section
open scoped ENNReal Topology
open Filter

namespace HoneycombForce

structure Vertex where
  col : ℤ
  row : ℤ
  up : Bool
  deriving DecidableEq

def up (i j : ℤ) : Vertex := ⟨i, j, true⟩

def down (i j : ℤ) : Vertex := ⟨i, j, false⟩

def rowSpacing : ℝ := Real.sqrt 3 / 2

def position (v : Vertex) : ℂ :=
  if v.up then
    ⟨(v.col : ℝ) + (v.row : ℝ) / 2 + 1/2,
      rowSpacing * ((v.row : ℝ) + 1/3)⟩
  else
    ⟨(v.col : ℝ) + (v.row : ℝ) / 2 + 1,
      rowSpacing * ((v.row : ℝ) + 2/3)⟩

def rho : ℝ := (Real.sqrt (2 + Real.sqrt 2))⁻¹

def neighbors (v : Vertex) : Finset Vertex :=
  if v.up then
    {down v.col (v.row-1), down v.col v.row, down (v.col-1) v.row}
  else
    {up v.col (v.row+1), up v.col v.row, up (v.col+1) v.row}

def walkLists (o : Vertex) : ℕ → Finset (List Vertex)
  | 0 => {[o]}
  | n+1 => (neighbors o).biUnion (fun v => (walkLists v n).image (List.cons o))

def saws (o : Vertex) (n : ℕ) : Finset (List Vertex) :=
  (walkLists o n).filter List.Nodup

def endpoint (o : Vertex) (γ : List Vertex) : Vertex := γ.getLastD o

def displacement (o : Vertex) (γ : List Vertex) : ℂ :=
  position (endpoint o γ) - position o

def projection (e z : ℂ) : ℝ := (star e * z).re

def partition (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ γ ∈ saws o n, rho ^ n * Real.exp (s * projection e (displacement o γ))

def logPartition (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (partition o e s n) / (n : ℝ)

def freeEnergy (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Filter.limUnder atTop (logPartition o e s)

theorem logPartition_tendsto (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (logPartition o e s) atTop (𝓝 (freeEnergy o e s)) := by
  sorry

end HoneycombForce

end

end OAI

def freeEnergy (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=

  have hrho : 0 ≤ rho := by unfold rho; positivity
  let f : List Vertex → Sigma (fun _ : List Vertex => List Vertex) :=

    rho ^ (m + n) * Real.exp (s * projection e (displacement o γ))

    simp only [W, V, f]

    rintro γ₁ γ₂ h
    have h1 : γ₁.take (m + 1) = γ₂.take (m + 1) := congrArg Sigma.fst h
    have h2 : γ₁.drop m = γ₂.drop m := eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp h).2
    rw [← splitP_take_append_drop_tail γ₁ m, ← splitP_take_append_drop_tail γ₂ m, h1, h2]
  have hsubset : (saws o (m + n)).image f ⊆
      (saws o m).sigma (fun α => saws (endpoint o α) n) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    exact Finset.mem_sigma.mpr ⟨splitP_take_mem_saws hγ, splitP_drop_mem_saws hγ⟩
  have hVnonneg : ∀ x ∈ (saws o m).sigma (fun α => saws (endpoint o α) n), 0 ≤ V x := by
    rintro ⟨α, β⟩ hx
    simp only [V]
    exact mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hrho m) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
      (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hrho n) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  have hpartition_le_M : ∀ α : List Vertex,
      partition (endpoint o α) e s n ≤ M := by
    intro α
    cases hup : (endpoint o α).up
    · have h := partition_eq_of_up_eq (o := endpoint o α) (o' := down 0 0)
        (by simpa [down] using hup) e s n
      rw [h, hM]
      exact le_max_right _ _
    · have h := partition_eq_of_up_eq (o := endpoint o α) (o' := up 0 0)
        (by simpa [up] using hup) e s n
      rw [h, hM]
      exact le_max_left _ _
  calc partition o e s (m + n)
      = ∑ γ ∈ saws o (m + n), W γ := rfl
    _ = ∑ γ ∈ saws o (m + n), V (f γ) := Finset.sum_congr rfl hW
    _ = ∑ x ∈ (saws o (m + n)).image f, V x := (Finset.sum_image hf_inj.injOn).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ (saws o m).sigma (fun α => saws (endpoint o α) n), V x :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
          (fun x hx _ => hVnonneg x hx)
    _ = ∑ α ∈ saws o m, ∑ β ∈ saws (endpoint o α) n, V ⟨α, β⟩ :=
        Finset.sum_sigma _ _ _
    _ = ∑ α ∈ saws o m,
          (rho ^ m * Real.exp (s * projection e (displacement o α))) *
            partition (endpoint o α) e s n := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro α hα
        rw [partition, Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ α ∈ saws o m,
          (rho ^ m * Real.exp (s * projection e (displacement o α))) * M := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro α hα
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpartition_le_M α)
          (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hrho m) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    _ = (∑ α ∈ saws o m,
          rho ^ m * Real.exp (s * projection e (displacement o α))) * M :=
        (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
    _ = partition o e s m * M := rfl

def logPartition (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (partition o e s n) / (n : ℝ)

def freeEnergy (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Filter.limUnder atTop (logPartition o e s)

end HoneycombForce

def pT_vtrans (k l : ℤ) (v : Vertex) : Vertex := ⟨v.col + k, v.row + l, v.up⟩

lemma pT_up (k l c r : ℤ) :
    pT_vtrans k l (up c r) = up (c + k) (r + l) := rfl

lemma pT_down (k l c r : ℤ) :
    pT_vtrans k l (down c r) = down (c + k) (r + l) := rfl

lemma pT_up_mk_eq (c r c' r' : ℤ) : (up c r = up c' r') ↔ c = c' ∧ r = r' := by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨congrArg Vertex.col h, congrArg Vertex.row h⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; rfl

lemma pT_down_mk_eq (c r c' r' : ℤ) : (down c r = down c' r') ↔ c = c' ∧ r = r' := by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨congrArg Vertex.col h, congrArg Vertex.row h⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; rfl

lemma pT_inv (k l : ℤ) (v : Vertex) : pT_vtrans (-k) (-l) (pT_vtrans k l v) = v := by
  rcases v with ⟨c, r, u⟩
  simp only [pT_vtrans, Vertex.mk.injEq, and_true]
  exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩

lemma pT_inv' (k l : ℤ) (v : Vertex) : pT_vtrans k l (pT_vtrans (-k) (-l) v) = v := by
  rcases v with ⟨c, r, u⟩
  simp only [pT_vtrans, Vertex.mk.injEq, and_true]
  exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩

lemma pT_injective (k l : ℤ) : Function.Injective (pT_vtrans k l) := by
  rintro ⟨c, r, u⟩ ⟨c', r', u'⟩ h
  simp only [pT_vtrans, Vertex.mk.injEq] at h
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h
  have h1' : c = c' := by omega
  have h2' : r = r' := by omega
  subst h1'; subst h2'; subst h3
  rfl

lemma pT_map_comp (k l : ℤ) (γ : List Vertex) :
    (γ.map (pT_vtrans k l)).map (pT_vtrans (-k) (-l)) = γ := by
  induction γ with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq]
      exact ⟨pT_inv k l a, ih⟩

lemma pT_map_comp' (k l : ℤ) (γ : List Vertex) :
    (γ.map (pT_vtrans (-k) (-l))).map (pT_vtrans k l) = γ := by
  induction γ with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq]
      exact ⟨pT_inv' k l a, ih⟩

lemma pT_map_injective (k l : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (fun γ : List Vertex => γ.map (pT_vtrans k l)) := by
  intro a b h
  have h' := congrArg (fun γ : List Vertex => γ.map (pT_vtrans (-k) (-l))) h
  rwa [pT_map_comp, pT_map_comp] at h'

lemma pT_mem_neighbors_up (c r : ℤ) (w : Vertex) :
    w ∈ neighbors (up c r) ↔ w = down c (r - 1) ∨ w = down c r ∨ w = down (c - 1) r := by
  simp only [neighbors, up, ite_true, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]

lemma pT_mem_neighbors_down (c r : ℤ) (w : Vertex) :
    w ∈ neighbors (down c r) ↔ w = up c (r + 1) ∨ w = up c r ∨ w = up (c + 1) r := by
  simp only [neighbors, down, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, Finset.mem_insert,
    Finset.mem_singleton]

lemma pT_down_not_mem_neighbors (c r c' r' : ℤ) :
    down c' r' ∉ neighbors (down c r) := by
  rw [pT_mem_neighbors_down]
  rintro (h | h | h) <;> exact Bool.noConfusion (congrArg Vertex.up h)

lemma pT_up_not_mem_neighbors (c r c' r' : ℤ) :
    up c' r' ∉ neighbors (up c r) := by
  rw [pT_mem_neighbors_up]
  rintro (h | h | h) <;> exact Bool.noConfusion (congrArg Vertex.up h)

lemma pT_mem_neighbors_iff (k l : ℤ) (a b : Vertex) :
    pT_vtrans k l b ∈ neighbors (pT_vtrans k l a) ↔ b ∈ neighbors a := by
  rcases a with ⟨c, r, u⟩
  rcases b with ⟨c', r', u'⟩
  cases u with
  | false =>
      cases u' with
      | false =>
          rw [show (⟨c, r, false⟩ : Vertex) = down c r from rfl,
            show (⟨c', r', false⟩ : Vertex) = down c' r' from rfl,
            pT_down, pT_down]
          exact ⟨fun h => absurd h (pT_down_not_mem_neighbors (c + k) (r + l) (c' + k) (r' + l)),
            fun h => absurd h (pT_down_not_mem_neighbors c r c' r')⟩
      | true =>
          rw [show (⟨c, r, false⟩ : Vertex) = down c r from rfl,
            show (⟨c', r', true⟩ : Vertex) = up c' r' from rfl,
            pT_down, pT_up, pT_mem_neighbors_down, pT_mem_neighbors_down]
          simp only [pT_up_mk_eq]
          omega
  | true =>
      cases u' with
      | false =>
          rw [show (⟨c, r, true⟩ : Vertex) = up c r from rfl,
            show (⟨c', r', false⟩ : Vertex) = down c' r' from rfl,
            pT_up, pT_down, pT_mem_neighbors_up, pT_mem_neighbors_up]
          simp only [pT_down_mk_eq]
          omega
      | true =>
          rw [show (⟨c, r, true⟩ : Vertex) = up c r from rfl,
            show (⟨c', r', true⟩ : Vertex) = up c' r' from rfl,
            pT_up, pT_up]
          exact ⟨fun h => absurd h (pT_up_not_mem_neighbors (c + k) (r + l) (c' + k) (r' + l)),
            fun h => absurd h (pT_up_not_mem_neighbors c r c' r')⟩

lemma pT_isChain_map_iff (k l : ℤ) (γ : List Vertex) :
    List.IsChain (fun a b : Vertex => b ∈ neighbors a) (γ.map (pT_vtrans k l)) ↔
      List.IsChain (fun a b : Vertex => b ∈ neighbors a) γ := by
  rw [List.isChain_map]
  exact List.IsChain.iff (fun a b => pT_mem_neighbors_iff k l a b)

lemma pT_mem_walkLists_map (k l : ℤ) {o : Vertex} {n : ℕ} {γ : List Vertex}
    (h : γ ∈ walkLists o n) : γ.map (pT_vtrans k l) ∈ walkLists (pT_vtrans k l o) n := by
  rw [mem_walkLists_iff] at h ⊢
  obtain ⟨hhead, hlen, hchain⟩ := h
  refine ⟨?_, by simp [hlen], (pT_isChain_map_iff k l γ).mpr hchain⟩
  rw [List.head?_map, hhead]
  rfl

lemma pT_mem_saws_map (k l : ℤ) {o : Vertex} {n : ℕ} {γ : List Vertex}
    (h : γ ∈ saws o n) : γ.map (pT_vtrans k l) ∈ saws (pT_vtrans k l o) n := by
  rw [saws, Finset.mem_filter] at h ⊢
  exact ⟨pT_mem_walkLists_map k l h.1, h.2.map (pT_injective k l)⟩

lemma pT_mem_saws_of_map (k l : ℤ) {o : Vertex} {n : ℕ} {γ : List Vertex}
    (h : γ.map (pT_vtrans k l) ∈ saws (pT_vtrans k l o) n) : γ ∈ saws o n := by
  have h' := pT_mem_saws_map (-k) (-l) h
  rw [pT_inv] at h'
  rwa [pT_map_comp] at h'

lemma pT_saws (k l : ℤ) (o : Vertex) (n : ℕ) :
    saws (pT_vtrans k l o) n = (saws o n).image (fun γ : List Vertex => γ.map (pT_vtrans k l)) := by
  ext γ
  rw [Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · intro hγ
    have hγ' : (γ.map (pT_vtrans (-k) (-l))).map (pT_vtrans k l) ∈ saws (pT_vtrans k l o) n := by
      rw [pT_map_comp']
      exact hγ
    exact ⟨γ.map (pT_vtrans (-k) (-l)), pT_mem_saws_of_map k l hγ', pT_map_comp' k l γ⟩
  · rintro ⟨δ, hδ, rfl⟩
    exact pT_mem_saws_map k l hδ

lemma pT_position_sub (k l : ℤ) (v w : Vertex) :
    position (pT_vtrans k l v) - position (pT_vtrans k l w) = position v - position w := by
  rcases v with ⟨c, r, u⟩
  rcases w with ⟨c', r', u'⟩
  cases u <;> cases u' <;>
    · apply Complex.ext <;>
        simp only [pT_vtrans, position, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true, Complex.sub_re,
          Complex.sub_im] <;>
        push_cast <;> ring

lemma pT_displacement_map (k l : ℤ) (o : Vertex) (γ : List Vertex) :
    displacement (pT_vtrans k l o) (γ.map (pT_vtrans k l)) = displacement o γ := by
  unfold displacement endpoint
  rw [List.getLastD_map]
  exact pT_position_sub k l _ o

lemma pT_partition (k l : ℤ) (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    partition (pT_vtrans k l o) e s n = partition o e s n := by
  unfold partition
  rw [pT_saws k l o n,
    Finset.sum_image (g := fun γ : List Vertex => γ.map (pT_vtrans k l))]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro γ hγ
    rw [pT_displacement_map]
  · intro a _ b _ hab
    exact pT_map_injective k l hab

lemma partition_eq_of_up_eq {o o' : Vertex} (h : o.up = o'.up) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    partition o e s n = partition o' e s n := by
  have ho : o' = pT_vtrans (o'.col - o.col) (o'.row - o.row) o := by
    rcases o with ⟨c, r, u⟩
    rcases o' with ⟨c', r', u'⟩
    simp only [pT_vtrans, Vertex.mk.injEq]
    exact ⟨by omega, by omega, h.symm⟩
  rw [ho]
  exact (pT_partition (o'.col - o.col) (o'.row - o.row) o e s n).symm

def spineWalk (o : Vertex) (n : ℕ) : List Vertex :=
  List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (n + 1) => spine o k)

lemma splitP_projection_add (e z w : ℂ) :
    projection e (z + w) = projection e z + projection e w := by
  simp [projection, mul_add]

lemma splitP_weight (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) (m n : ℕ) (z w : ℂ) :
    rho ^ (m + n) * Real.exp (s * projection e (z + w)) =
      (rho ^ m * Real.exp (s * projection e z)) *
        (rho ^ n * Real.exp (s * projection e w)) := by
  rw [splitP_projection_add, mul_add, Real.exp_add, pow_add]
  ring

lemma splitP_getLastD_drop {α : Type*} (l : List α) (i : ℕ) (h : i < l.length) (a b : α) :
    (l.drop i).getLastD a = l.getLastD b := by
  have hl : l ≠ [] := by intro h0; subst l; simp at h
  rw [List.getLastD_eq_getLast?, List.getLastD_eq_getLast?, List.getLast?_drop,
    if_neg (by omega : ¬ l.length ≤ i)]
  cases hlast : l.getLast? with
  | none => rw [List.getLast?_eq_none_iff] at hlast; exact absurd hlast hl
  | some x => simp

lemma splitP_getLastD_take_succ {α : Type*} (l : List α) (i : ℕ) (h : i < l.length) (a : α) :
    (l.take (i + 1)).getLastD a = l[i] := by
  rw [List.getLastD_eq_getLast?, List.getLast?_take, if_neg (by omega)]
  have hi : i + 1 - 1 = i := by omega
  rw [hi, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mpr ⟨h, rfl⟩]
  simp

lemma splitP_take_append_drop_tail {α : Type*} (γ : List α) (m : ℕ) :
    γ.take (m + 1) ++ (γ.drop m).tail = γ := by
  rcases lt_or_ge m γ.length with h | h
  · have htake : γ.take (m + 1) = γ.take m ++ [γ[m]] := by
      rw [List.take_add_one, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mpr ⟨h, rfl⟩]
      simp
    rw [htake, List.append_assoc]
    have hcons : [γ[m]] ++ (γ.drop m).tail = γ.drop m := by
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons h]
      simp
    rw [hcons, List.take_append_drop]
  · have htake : γ.take (m + 1) = γ := List.take_of_length_le (by omega)
    have hdrop : γ.drop m = [] := List.drop_eq_nil_iff.mpr h
    rw [htake, hdrop]
    simp

lemma splitP_take_mem_saws {o : Vertex} {m n : ℕ} {γ : List Vertex}
    (hγ : γ ∈ saws o (m + n)) :
    γ.take (m + 1) ∈ saws o m := by
  classical
  rw [saws, Finset.mem_filter] at hγ ⊢
  obtain ⟨hwalk, hnd⟩ := hγ
  obtain ⟨hhead, hlen, hchain⟩ := mem_walkLists_iff.mp hwalk
  refine ⟨mem_walkLists_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [List.head?_take, if_neg (by omega)]
    exact hhead
  · rw [List.length_take]
    omega
  · exact hchain.take (m + 1)
  · exact List.Nodup.sublist (List.take_sublist (m + 1) γ) hnd

lemma splitP_drop_mem_saws {o : Vertex} {m n : ℕ} {γ : List Vertex}
    (hγ : γ ∈ saws o (m + n)) :
    γ.drop m ∈ saws (endpoint o (γ.take (m + 1))) n := by
  classical
  rw [saws, Finset.mem_filter] at hγ ⊢
  obtain ⟨hwalk, hnd⟩ := hγ
  obtain ⟨hhead, hlen, hchain⟩ := mem_walkLists_iff.mp hwalk
  have hm : m < γ.length := by omega
  have hend : endpoint o (γ.take (m + 1)) = γ[m] :=
    splitP_getLastD_take_succ γ m hm o
  refine ⟨mem_walkLists_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [List.head?_drop, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mpr ⟨hm, rfl⟩, hend]
  · rw [List.length_drop]
    omega
  · exact hchain.drop m
  · exact List.Nodup.sublist (List.drop_sublist m γ) hnd

lemma splitP_endpoint_drop {o : Vertex} {m n : ℕ} {γ : List Vertex}
    (hγ : γ ∈ saws o (m + n)) :
    endpoint (endpoint o (γ.take (m + 1))) (γ.drop m) = endpoint o γ := by
  classical
  rw [saws, Finset.mem_filter, mem_walkLists_iff] at hγ
  obtain ⟨⟨_, hlen, _⟩, _⟩ := hγ
  have hm : m < γ.length := by omega
  unfold endpoint
  exact splitP_getLastD_drop γ m hm _ o

lemma splitP_displacement {o : Vertex} {m n : ℕ} {γ : List Vertex}
    (hγ : γ ∈ saws o (m + n)) :
    displacement o γ =
      displacement o (γ.take (m + 1)) +
        displacement (endpoint o (γ.take (m + 1))) (γ.drop m) := by
  unfold displacement
  rw [splitP_endpoint_drop hγ]
  ring

theorem partition_split_le (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) (m n : ℕ) :
    partition o e s (m + n) ≤
      partition o e s m *
        max (partition (up 0 0) e s n) (partition (down 0 0) e s n) := by
  classical
  set M := max (partition (up 0 0) e s n) (partition (down 0 0) e s n) with hM
  have hrho : 0 ≤ rho := by unfold rho; positivity
  let f : List Vertex → Sigma (fun _ : List Vertex => List Vertex) :=
    fun γ => ⟨γ.take (m + 1), γ.drop m⟩
  let V : Sigma (fun _ : List Vertex => List Vertex) → ℝ := fun x =>
    (rho ^ m * Real.exp (s * projection e (displacement o x.1))) *
      (rho ^ n * Real.exp (s * projection e (displacement (endpoint o x.1) x.2)))
  let W : List Vertex → ℝ := fun γ =>
    rho ^ (m + n) * Real.exp (s * projection e (displacement o γ))
  have hW : ∀ γ ∈ saws o (m + n), W γ = V (f γ) := by
    intro γ hγ
    simp only [W, V, f]
    rw [splitP_displacement hγ]
    exact splitP_weight e s m n _ _
  have hf_inj : Function.Injective f := by
    rintro γ₁ γ₂ h
    have h1 : γ₁.take (m + 1) = γ₂.take (m + 1) := congrArg Sigma.fst h
    have h2 : γ₁.drop m = γ₂.drop m := eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp h).2
    rw [← splitP_take_append_drop_tail γ₁ m, ← splitP_take_append_drop_tail γ₂ m, h1, h2]
  have hsubset : (saws o (m + n)).image f ⊆
      (saws o m).sigma (fun α => saws (endpoint o α) n) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    exact Finset.mem_sigma.mpr ⟨splitP_take_mem_saws hγ, splitP_drop_mem_saws hγ⟩
  have hVnonneg : ∀ x ∈ (saws o m).sigma (fun α => saws (endpoint o α) n), 0 ≤ V x := by
    rintro ⟨α, β⟩ hx
    simp only [V]
    exact mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hrho m) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
      (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hrho n) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  have hpartition_le_M : ∀ α : List Vertex,
      partition (endpoint o α) e s n ≤ M := by
    intro α
    cases hup : (endpoint o α).up
    · have h := partition_eq_of_up_eq (o := endpoint o α) (o' := down 0 0)
        (by simpa [down] using hup) e s n
      rw [h, hM]
      exact le_max_right _ _
    · have h := partition_eq_of_up_eq (o := endpoint o α) (o' := up 0 0)
        (by simpa [up] using hup) e s n
      rw [h, hM]
      exact le_max_left _ _
  calc partition o e s (m + n)
      = ∑ γ ∈ saws o (m + n), W γ := rfl
    _ = ∑ γ ∈ saws o (m + n), V (f γ) := Finset.sum_congr rfl hW
    _ = ∑ x ∈ (saws o (m + n)).image f, V x := (Finset.sum_image hf_inj.injOn).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ (saws o m).sigma (fun α => saws (endpoint o α) n), V x :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
          (fun x hx _ => hVnonneg x hx)
    _ = ∑ α ∈ saws o m, ∑ β ∈ saws (endpoint o α) n, V ⟨α, β⟩ :=
        Finset.sum_sigma _ _ _
    _ = ∑ α ∈ saws o m,
          (rho ^ m * Real.exp (s * projection e (displacement o α))) *
            partition (endpoint o α) e s n := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro α hα
        rw [partition, Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ α ∈ saws o m,
          (rho ^ m * Real.exp (s * projection e (displacement o α))) * M := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro α hα
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpartition_le_M α)
          (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hrho m) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    _ = (∑ α ∈ saws o m,
          rho ^ m * Real.exp (s * projection e (displacement o α))) * M :=
        (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
    _ = partition o e s m * M := rfl

def logPartition (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (partition o e s n) / (n : ℝ)

def freeEnergy (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Filter.limUnder atTop (logPartition o e s)

end HoneycombForce

end
