    (hsub : ∀ p q : ℕ, Real.log (partition c e s (2 * (p + q))) ≤
      Real.log (partition c e s (2 * p)) + Real.log (partition c e s (2 * q)))
    (hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range (fun p : ℕ =>
      Real.log (partition c e s (2 * p)) / (p : ℝ)))) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, Tendsto (logPartition c e s) atTop (𝓝 A) := by
  classical
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun p => Real.log (partition c e s (2 * p))
  let evenLog : ℕ → ℝ := fun p => logPartition c e s (2 * p)
  let M : ℝ := max (partition (up 0 0) e s 1) (partition (down 0 0) e s 1)
  let L : ℝ := Real.log M
  have hsubu : Subadditive u := fun p q => hsub p q
  let A : ℝ := hsubu.lim
  have hMpos : 0 < M := by
    dsimp [M]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (partition_pos (up 0 0) e s 1) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hfk : Tendsto (fun p : ℕ => u p / (p : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 A) := by
    have := hsubu.tendsto_lim (u := u) hbdd
    simpa [A] using this

    have h := hfk.div_const 2
    refine h.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with p hp
    dsimp [evenLog, u]
    rw [div_div]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring

    intro p
    have h := partition_split_le c e s (2 * p) 1

      partition c e s (2 * (p + 1)) ≤ partition c e s (2 * p + 1) * M := by
    intro p
    have h := partition_split_le c e s (2 * p + 1) 1
    have h' : (2 * p + 1) + 1 = 2 * (p + 1) := by omega
    rw [h'] at h
    simpa [M] using h
  let q : ℕ → ℝ := fun p => ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) / (((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
  let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun p => ((2 * (p + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
  let d : ℕ → ℝ := fun p => (1 : ℝ) / (((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
  have hDpos : ∀ p : ℕ, (0 : ℝ) < (((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    intro p
    have h : (0 : ℕ) < 2 * p + 1 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hupper_bound : ∀ᶠ p : ℕ in atTop,

    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with p hp
    have hp2 : ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      have h : (2 * p : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by omega
      exact_mod_cast h
    have hD : (((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hDpos p)

        rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (partition_pos c e s (2 * p + 1))) (ne_of_gt hMpos)]
      linarith
    calc
      evenLog (p + 1) * r p - L / (((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))

          dsimp [evenLog, r, logPartition]
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
          field_simp [hpE, hD]

    have hbase : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=

    have heq : (fun p : ℕ => L / (((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) =

      evenLog p * q p + L / (((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 (A / 2)) := by
    have h := (heven.mul hq).add hLd
    simpa using h
  have hlower_tend : Tendsto (fun p : ℕ =>
      evenLog (p + 1) * r p - L / (((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 (A / 2)) := by
    have hshift : Tendsto (fun p : ℕ => p + 1) atTop atTop := tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1

theorem logPartition_tendsto (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (logPartition o e s) atTop (𝓝 (freeEnergy o e s)) := by
  have hex : ∃ A : ℝ, Tendsto (logPartition o e s) atTop (𝓝 A) := by
    by_cases hu : o.up = true
    · -- up class
      have hsub : ∀ p q : ℕ, Real.log (partition (up 0 0) e s (2 * (p + q))) ≤
          Real.log (partition (up 0 0) e s (2 * p)) +
            Real.log (partition (up 0 0) e s (2 * q)) :=
        fun p q => even_log_subadditive_up e s p q
      have hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range (fun p : ℕ =>
          Real.log (partition (up 0 0) e s (2 * p)) / (p : ℝ))) :=
        even_log_bddBelow_up e s
      obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := glue_logPartition_converges (up 0 0) e s hsub hbdd
      refine ⟨A, ?_⟩
      have hpe : partition o e s = partition (up 0 0) e s := by
        funext n
        exact partition_eq_of_up_eq (by simpa [up] using hu) e s n
      have hlog : logPartition (up 0 0) e s = logPartition o e s := by
        funext n
        show Real.log (partition (up 0 0) e s n) / (n : ℝ) =
          Real.log (partition o e s n) / (n : ℝ)
        rw [show partition (up 0 0) e s n = partition o e s n from (congrFun hpe n).symm]
      exact hlog ▸ hA
    · -- down class
      have hfalse : o.up = false := by
        cases h : o.up with
        | false => rfl
        | true => exact absurd h hu
      have hsub : ∀ p q : ℕ, Real.log (partition (down 0 0) e s (2 * (p + q))) ≤
          Real.log (partition (down 0 0) e s (2 * p)) +
            Real.log (partition (down 0 0) e s (2 * q)) :=
        fun p q => even_log_subadditive_down e s p q
      have hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range (fun p : ℕ =>
          Real.log (partition (down 0 0) e s (2 * p)) / (p : ℝ))) :=
        even_log_bddBelow_down e s
      obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := glue_logPartition_converges (down 0 0) e s hsub hbdd
      refine ⟨A, ?_⟩
      have hpe : partition o e s = partition (down 0 0) e s := by
        funext n
        exact partition_eq_of_up_eq (by simpa [down] using hfalse) e s n
      have hlog : logPartition (down 0 0) e s = logPartition o e s := by
        funext n
        show Real.log (partition (down 0 0) e s n) / (n : ℝ) =
          Real.log (partition o e s n) / (n : ℝ)
        rw [show partition (down 0 0) e s n = partition o e s n from (congrFun hpe n).symm]
      exact hlog ▸ hA
  exact tendsto_nhds_limUnder hex

en.subtitle: A seven-coloring of the Euclidean plane
en.summary: The Euclidean plane admits a seven-coloring in which points at unit distance have different colors.

tasks.objective: Define an explicit triangular-lattice point function triPoint a b, with u=(3/4,0) and v=(3/8,3*sqrt(3)/8), so that later geometry and covering lemmas share one lattice. The intended consumer is lattice_norm, covering and triColor_def.

Pin the declared lattice scale and metric: the squared distance from triPoint a b to triPoint 0 0 is (3/4)^2*(a^2+a*b+b^2). This catches a wrong scale or wrong lattice angle before covering and norm consumers use triPoint.
Define the seven-valued lattice-coordinate color a-2b modulo 7 as a function ℤ → ℤ → Fin 7. The intended consumer is triColor_def and the congruence-kernel lemma colorOf_sanity.
Pin the modular meaning of colorOf: equality of colors is equivalent to 7 dividing (a-2b)-(c-2d). This is the exact interface used by sameColor_norm.
Prove the squared-distance formula for differences of triPoint values. This supplies the Eisenstein norm used by sameColor_dist_large and must use the chosen lattice basis orientation.

Prove the quantitative triangular-lattice covering lemma: every plane point is within 3/(4*sqrt 3) of triPoint a b for some integer coordinates. The first construction will reduce to a fundamental side-3/4 equilateral triangle and use the circumradius bound; the consumer is triColor_def and triColor_sanity.

Define the plane coloring by selecting, for each point, a covering lattice point via Classical.choose from covering and applying colorOf to its lattice coordinates. The intended consumer is triColor_sanity and proper_coloring.

Prove the defining property of triColor: it has a nearby lattice representative whose colorOf value is exactly the color. This connects covering and the selected coordinates for the final contradiction.

Show that two distinct lattice-coordinate pairs with the same color have Eisenstein norm-square at least 7. Substitute a-c=7k+2(b-d) and use positivity of the resulting integer factor; this is the arithmetic heart of the index-seven coloring.

Combine lattice_norm with sameColor_norm to prove the strict separation used by the final contradiction: distinct same-color lattice representatives are farther than 1 plus twice the covering radius. This is the direct input to proper_coloring.

Prove that triColor is a proper unit-distance coloring: take the nearby representatives from triColor_sanity; equal colors either force the same representative and distance below 1, or distinct representatives and distance above 1, contradicting distance one.
Close the frozen target by supplying triColor and proper_coloring as the required witness and proof for ProperColoring 7.

  nlinarith [h]

  have hβ : ((⌊β⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) + q = β := Int.floor_add_fract β
  have hX' : X = (3 / 4) * α + (3 / 8) * β := by
    rw [hαdef, hβdef]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hY' : Y = (3 * Real.sqrt 3 / 8) * β := by
    rw [hβdef]
    field_simp
  have hformula : ∀ (m n : ℤ) (u v : ℝ), u = α - m → v = β - n →

    intro m n u v hu hv

      rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq]

    unfold planeEis

    rw [div_pow, mul_pow, h3]
    norm_num
  have hfinish : ∀ (m n : ℤ) (u v : ℝ), u = α - m → v = β - n → planeEis u v ≤ 1 / 3 →
      dist x (triPoint m n) ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) := by
    intro m n u v hu hv hle
    have hd := hformula m n u v hu hv
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) := by positivity
    nlinarith [hd, hle, hr, hr0, dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := triPoint m n)]

  · refine ⟨⌊α⌋ + 1, ⌊β⌋, hfinish (⌊α⌋ + 1) ⌊β⌋ (p - 1) q ?_ ?_ h⟩
    · push_cast; linarith
    · linarith
  · refine ⟨⌊α⌋, ⌊β⌋ + 1, hfinish ⌊α⌋ (⌊β⌋ + 1) p (q - 1) ?_ ?_ h⟩
    · linarith
    · push_cast; linarith
  · refine ⟨⌊α⌋ + 1, ⌊β⌋ + 1, hfinish (⌊α⌋ + 1) (⌊β⌋ + 1) (p - 1) (q - 1) ?_ ?_ h⟩
    · push_cast; linarith
    · push_cast; linarith

noncomputable def triColor (x : Plane) : Fin 7 :=
  colorOf (Classical.choose (covering x))
    (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (covering x)))

theorem triColor_sanity (x : Plane) : ∃ a b : ℤ,
    dist x (triPoint a b) ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) ∧
      triColor x = colorOf a b := by
  let a : ℤ := Classical.choose (covering x)
  let h : ∃ b : ℤ, dist x (triPoint a b) ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) :=

  let b : ℤ := Classical.choose h

  dsimp only [triColor, a, b, h]

lemma covering_radius_lt_half : (3 : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) < 1 / 2 := by
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt 3 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
  have h3 : (Real.sqrt 3) ^ 2 = (3 : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)

  have habs : |(3 : ℝ)| < |2 * Real.sqrt 3| := sq_lt_sq.mp hsq

    have hbd : b = d := by simpa using congrArg Prod.snd hEq
    subst c
    subst d
    have htri : dist x y ≤ dist x (triPoint a b) + dist (triPoint a b) y :=
      dist_triangle x (triPoint a b) y
    have hcomm : dist (triPoint a b) y = dist y (triPoint a b) := dist_comm _ _
    have hlt : dist x y < 1 := by
      rw [hcomm] at htri
      nlinarith [htri, hx, hy, covering_radius_lt_half]
    linarith

    have h1 : dist (triPoint a b) x ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) := by
      simpa [dist_comm] using hx
    have h2 : dist x (triPoint c d) ≤ dist x y + dist y (triPoint c d) :=
      dist_triangle x y (triPoint c d)
    have h3 : dist (triPoint a b) (triPoint c d) ≤
        dist (triPoint a b) x + dist x (triPoint c d) :=
      dist_triangle (triPoint a b) x (triPoint c d)
    rw [hxy] at h2
    linarith

    nlinarith [h3]
  have hr : (3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3)) ^ 2 = (3 : ℝ) / 16 := by
    rw [div_pow, mul_pow, h3]
    norm_num
  have hfinish : ∀ (m n : ℤ) (u v : ℝ), u = α - m → v = β - n → planeEis u v ≤ 1 / 3 →
      dist x (triPoint m n) ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) := by
    intro m n u v hu hv hle
    have hd := hformula m n u v hu hv
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) := by positivity
    nlinarith [hd, hle, hr, hr0, dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := triPoint m n)]
  rcases planeEis_corners hp0 hp1.le hq0 hq1.le with h | h | h | h
  · refine ⟨⌊α⌋, ⌊β⌋, hfinish ⌊α⌋ ⌊β⌋ p q ?_ ?_ h⟩
    · linarith
    · linarith
  · refine ⟨⌊α⌋ + 1, ⌊β⌋, hfinish (⌊α⌋ + 1) ⌊β⌋ (p - 1) q ?_ ?_ h⟩
    · push_cast; linarith
    · linarith
  · refine ⟨⌊α⌋, ⌊β⌋ + 1, hfinish ⌊α⌋ (⌊β⌋ + 1) p (q - 1) ?_ ?_ h⟩
    · linarith
    · push_cast; linarith
  · refine ⟨⌊α⌋ + 1, ⌊β⌋ + 1, hfinish (⌊α⌋ + 1) (⌊β⌋ + 1) (p - 1) (q - 1) ?_ ?_ h⟩
    · push_cast; linarith
    · push_cast; linarith
noncomputable def triColor (x : Plane) : Fin 7 :=
  colorOf (Classical.choose (covering x))
    (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (covering x)))
theorem triColor_sanity (x : Plane) : ∃ a b : ℤ,
    dist x (triPoint a b) ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) ∧
      triColor x = colorOf a b := by
  let a : ℤ := Classical.choose (covering x)
  let h : ∃ b : ℤ, dist x (triPoint a b) ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (covering x)
  let b : ℤ := Classical.choose h
  refine ⟨a, b, Classical.choose_spec h, ?_⟩
  dsimp only [triColor, a, b, h]
lemma covering_radius_lt_half : (3 : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) < 1 / 2 := by
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt 3 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
  have h3 : (Real.sqrt 3) ^ 2 = (3 : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * Real.sqrt 3)]
  have hsq : (3 : ℝ) ^ 2 < (2 * Real.sqrt 3) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have habs : |(3 : ℝ)| < |2 * Real.sqrt 3| := sq_lt_sq.mp hsq
  have h2s : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt 3 := by positivity
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3), abs_of_nonneg h2s] at habs
  linarith
theorem proper_coloring : ∀ x y : Plane, dist x y = 1 → triColor x ≠ triColor y := by
  intro x y hxy hcol
  obtain ⟨a, b, hx, hcx⟩ := triColor_sanity x
  obtain ⟨c, d, hy, hcy⟩ := triColor_sanity y
  have hcolor : colorOf a b = colorOf c d := by rw [← hcx, hcol, hcy]
  by_cases hEq : (a, b) = (c, d)
  · have hac : a = c := by simpa using congrArg Prod.fst hEq
    have hbd : b = d := by simpa using congrArg Prod.snd hEq
    subst c
    subst d
    have htri : dist x y ≤ dist x (triPoint a b) + dist (triPoint a b) y :=
      dist_triangle x (triPoint a b) y
    have hcomm : dist (triPoint a b) y = dist y (triPoint a b) := dist_comm _ _
    have hlt : dist x y < 1 := by
      rw [hcomm] at htri
      nlinarith [htri, hx, hy, covering_radius_lt_half]
    linarith
  · have hlarge := sameColor_dist_large a b c d hcolor hEq
    have h1 : dist (triPoint a b) x ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) := by
      simpa [dist_comm] using hx
    have h2 : dist x (triPoint c d) ≤ dist x y + dist y (triPoint c d) :=
      dist_triangle x y (triPoint c d)
    have h3 : dist (triPoint a b) (triPoint c d) ≤
        dist (triPoint a b) x + dist x (triPoint c d) :=
      dist_triangle (triPoint a b) x (triPoint c d)
    rw [hxy] at h2
    linarith
theorem properColoring_seven : ProperColoring 7 :=
  ⟨triColor, proper_coloring⟩
end Problem160

import Mathlib

namespace OAI

noncomputable section

namespace Problem160

abbrev Plane := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)

def ProperColoring (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ c : Plane → Fin k,
    ∀ x y : Plane, dist x y = 1 → c x ≠ c y

def triPoint (a b : ℤ) : Plane :=
  !₂[((3 : ℝ) / 4) * (a : ℝ) + ((3 : ℝ) / 8) * (b : ℝ),
    ((3 * Real.sqrt 3) / 8) * (b : ℝ)]
lemma triPoint_fst (a b : ℤ) :
    triPoint a b 0 = ((3 : ℝ) / 4) * (a : ℝ) + ((3 : ℝ) / 8) * (b : ℝ) := rfl
lemma triPoint_snd (a b : ℤ) :
    triPoint a b 1 = ((3 * Real.sqrt 3) / 8) * (b : ℝ) := rfl
noncomputable def colorOf (a b : ℤ) : Fin 7 :=
  (ZMod.finEquiv 7).symm ((a - 2 * b : ℤ) : ZMod 7)
lemma colorOf_sanity (a b c d : ℤ) :
    colorOf a b = colorOf c d ↔ (7 : ℤ) ∣ (a - 2 * b) - (c - 2 * d) := by
  unfold colorOf
  rw [((ZMod.finEquiv 7).symm.injective).eq_iff, ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub]
  rw [show (c - 2 * d) - (a - 2 * b) = -((a - 2 * b) - (c - 2 * d)) by ring, Int.dvd_neg]
  norm_num
theorem triPoint_sanity : ∀ a b : ℤ,
    dist (triPoint a b) (triPoint 0 0) ^ 2 =
      (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((a : ℝ) ^ 2 + (a : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
  intro a b
  rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, triPoint]
  simp [mul_pow]
  ring_nf
  have h3 : |Real.sqrt 3| ^ 2 = 3 := by
    rw [sq_abs, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3)]
  rw [h3]
  ring
lemma sq_add_mul_add_sq_pos {p q : ℤ} (h : p ≠ 0 ∨ q ≠ 0) :
    0 < p ^ 2 + p * q + q ^ 2 := by
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ p ^ 2 + p * q + q ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * p + q), sq_nonneg q]
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hnonneg with h0 | hpos
  · exfalso
    have hq2 : q ^ 2 = 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * p + q), sq_nonneg q, h0]
    have hq0 : q = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hq2
    have hp2 : p ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rw [hq0] at h0
      simpa using h0.symm
    have hp0 : p = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hp2
    exact h.elim (fun hp => hp hp0) (fun hq => hq hq0)
  · exact hpos
theorem sameColor_norm : ∀ a b c d : ℤ,
    colorOf a b = colorOf c d → (a, b) ≠ (c, d) →
      (7 : ℤ) ≤ (a - c) ^ 2 + (a - c) * (b - d) + (b - d) ^ 2 := by
  intro a b c d h hne
  -- Same color means `7 ∣ (a - 2b) - (c - 2d)`, i.e. `7 ∣ (a-c) - 2(b-d)`.
  have hdvd : (7 : ℤ) ∣ (a - c) - 2 * (b - d) := by
    have h' := (colorOf_sanity a b c d).1 h
    rwa [show (a - 2 * b) - (c - 2 * d) = (a - c) - 2 * (b - d) by ring] at h'
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdvd
  set p := a - c with hp
  set q := b - d with hq
  -- Distinct lattice coordinates give a nonzero difference vector.
  have hpq : p ≠ 0 ∨ q ≠ 0 := by
    rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with hp0 | hp0
    · right
      intro hq0
      have ha : a = c := by linarith
      have hb : b = d := by linarith
      exact hne (by rw [ha, hb])
    · exact Or.inl hp0
  -- Substituting `p = 2q + 7k` shows `7` divides the Eisenstein norm.
  have hp' : p = 2 * q + 7 * k := by linarith
  have hdvdN : (7 : ℤ) ∣ p ^ 2 + p * q + q ^ 2 :=
    ⟨q ^ 2 + 5 * q * k + 7 * k ^ 2, by rw [hp']; ring⟩
  exact Int.le_of_dvd (sq_add_mul_add_sq_pos hpq) hdvdN
theorem lattice_norm : ∀ a b c d : ℤ,
    dist (triPoint a b) (triPoint c d) ^ 2 =
      (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        (((a - c : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ 2 + ((a - c : ℤ) : ℝ) * ((b - d : ℤ) : ℝ) +
          ((b - d : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
  intro a b c d
  rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, triPoint, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
  simp only [Real.dist_eq, sq_abs]
  ring_nf
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3)]
  push_cast
  ring
theorem sameColor_dist_large (a b c d : ℤ)
    (h : colorOf a b = colorOf c d) (hne : (a, b) ≠ (c, d)) :
    1 + 2 * (3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3)) <
      dist (triPoint a b) (triPoint c d) := by
  set x : ℤ := a - c
  set y : ℤ := b - d
  have hQint : (7 : ℤ) ≤ x ^ 2 + x * y + y ^ 2 := by
    simpa [x, y] using sameColor_norm a b c d h hne
  have hQreal : (7 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) ^ 2 + (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ) + (y : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast hQint
  have hln := lattice_norm a b c d
  have hd_sq : dist (triPoint a b) (triPoint c d) ^ 2 =
      (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((x : ℝ) ^ 2 + (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ) + (y : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    simpa [x, y] using hln
  have hd_sq_ge : (63 / 16 : ℝ) ≤ dist (triPoint a b) (triPoint c d) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hd_sq]
    nlinarith
  let r : ℝ := 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3)
  have hsqrt3_sq : (Real.sqrt 3) ^ 2 = (3 : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hsqrt3_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 3 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 3
  have hsqrt3_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt 3 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hr_lt_half : r < 1 / 2 := by
    dsimp [r]
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * Real.sqrt 3)]
    nlinarith
  have hr_sq : r ^ 2 = (3 / 16 : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [r]
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  let bnd : ℝ := 1 + 2 * r
  have hbnd_sq_lt : bnd ^ 2 < (63 / 16 : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [bnd]
    nlinarith
  have hbnd_nonneg : 0 ≤ bnd := by
    dsimp [bnd]
    positivity
  have hdist_nonneg : 0 ≤ dist (triPoint a b) (triPoint c d) := dist_nonneg
  have hsq : bnd ^ 2 < dist (triPoint a b) (triPoint c d) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith
  have habs : |bnd| < |dist (triPoint a b) (triPoint c d)| := (sq_lt_sq.mp hsq)
  have : bnd < dist (triPoint a b) (triPoint c d) := by
    simpa [abs_of_nonneg hbnd_nonneg, abs_of_nonneg hdist_nonneg] using habs
  simpa [bnd, r] using this
def planeEis (u v : ℝ) : ℝ := u ^ 2 + u * v + v ^ 2
lemma planeEis_corner00 {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hs : 2 * p + q ≤ 1)
    (ht : p + 2 * q ≤ 1) : planeEis p q ≤ 1 / 3 := by
  unfold planeEis
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * p + q), sq_nonneg (p + 2 * q), mul_nonneg hp hq,
    mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hs) (sub_nonneg.mpr ht)]
lemma planeEis_corner10 {p q : ℝ} (hp : p ≤ 1) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hpq : q ≤ p) (hs : 1 ≤ 2 * p + q)
    (ht : p + 2 * q ≤ 2) : planeEis (p - 1) q ≤ 1 / 3 := by
  unfold planeEis
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - p - 2 * q), sq_nonneg (2 * p + q - 1), sq_nonneg (1 - p - q),
    mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hp) hq]
lemma planeEis_corner01 {p q : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hq : q ≤ 1) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hs : 1 ≤ p + 2 * q)
    (ht : 2 * p + q ≤ 2) : planeEis p (q - 1) ≤ 1 / 3 := by
  have h := planeEis_corner10 hq hp0 hpq (by linarith : 1 ≤ 2 * q + p) (by linarith : q + 2 * p ≤ 2)
  unfold planeEis at *
  nlinarith [h]
lemma planeEis_corner11 {p q : ℝ} (hp : p ≤ 1) (hq : q ≤ 1) (hs : 2 ≤ 2 * p + q)
    (ht : 2 ≤ p + 2 * q) : planeEis (p - 1) (q - 1) ≤ 1 / 3 := by
  have a1 : 0 ≤ 1 - p := by linarith
  have b1 : 0 ≤ 1 - q := by linarith
  have e1 : 2 * (1 - p) + (1 - q) ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have e2 : (1 - p) + 2 * (1 - q) ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have h := planeEis_corner00 a1 b1 e1 e2
  unfold planeEis at *
  nlinarith [h]
lemma planeEis_corners {p q : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) :
    planeEis p q ≤ 1 / 3 ∨ planeEis (p - 1) q ≤ 1 / 3 ∨ planeEis p (q - 1) ≤ 1 / 3 ∨
      planeEis (p - 1) (q - 1) ≤ 1 / 3 := by
  by_cases hA : 2 * p + q ≤ 1 ∧ p + 2 * q ≤ 1
  · exact Or.inl (planeEis_corner00 hp0 hq0 hA.1 hA.2)
  by_cases hD : 2 ≤ 2 * p + q ∧ 2 ≤ p + 2 * q
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (planeEis_corner11 hp1 hq1 hD.1 hD.2)))
  rcases le_total q p with hqp | hpq
  · have h1 : 1 ≤ 2 * p + q := by
      rcases le_or_gt (2 * p + q) 1 with h | h
      · have h2 : 1 < p + 2 * q := by
          rcases le_or_gt (p + 2 * q) 1 with h2 | h2
          · exact absurd ⟨h, h2⟩ hA
          · exact h2
        linarith
      · exact h.le
    have h2 : p + 2 * q ≤ 2 := by
      rcases le_or_gt (p + 2 * q) 2 with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩ hD
    exact Or.inr (Or.inl (planeEis_corner10 hp1 hq0 hqp h1 h2))
  · have h1 : 1 ≤ p + 2 * q := by
      rcases le_or_gt (p + 2 * q) 1 with h | h
      · have h2 : 1 < 2 * p + q := by
          rcases le_or_gt (2 * p + q) 1 with h2 | h2
          · exact absurd ⟨h2, h⟩ hA
          · exact h2
        linarith
      · exact h.le
    have h2 : 2 * p + q ≤ 2 := by
      rcases le_or_gt (2 * p + q) 2 with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩ hD
    exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (planeEis_corner01 hp0 hq1 hpq h1 h2)))
theorem covering : ∀ x : Plane, ∃ a b : ℤ,
    dist x (triPoint a b) ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) := by
  intro x
  have h3 : Real.sqrt 3 ^ 2 = (3 : ℝ) := by
    rw [sq, Real.mul_self_sqrt (by norm_num)]
  set X : ℝ := x 0 with hX
  set Y : ℝ := x 1 with hY
  set α : ℝ := 4 * X / 3 - 4 * Y / (3 * Real.sqrt 3) with hαdef
  set β : ℝ := 8 * Y / (3 * Real.sqrt 3) with hβdef
  set p : ℝ := Int.fract α with hpdef
  set q : ℝ := Int.fract β with hqdef
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := Int.fract_nonneg α
  have hp1 : p < 1 := Int.fract_lt_one α
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := Int.fract_nonneg β
  have hq1 : q < 1 := Int.fract_lt_one β
  have hα : ((⌊α⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) + p = α := Int.floor_add_fract α
  have hβ : ((⌊β⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) + q = β := Int.floor_add_fract β
  have hX' : X = (3 / 4) * α + (3 / 8) * β := by
    rw [hαdef, hβdef]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hY' : Y = (3 * Real.sqrt 3 / 8) * β := by
    rw [hβdef]
    field_simp
  have hformula : ∀ (m n : ℤ) (u v : ℝ), u = α - m → v = β - n →
      dist x (triPoint m n) ^ 2 = (9 / 16) * planeEis u v := by
    intro m n u v hu hv
    have hd : dist x (triPoint m n) ^ 2 =
        (x 0 - triPoint m n 0) ^ 2 + (x 1 - triPoint m n 1) ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq]
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.dist_eq, sq_abs]
    rw [hd, triPoint_fst, triPoint_snd, ← hX, ← hY, hX', hY', hu, hv]
    unfold planeEis
    nlinarith [h3]
  have hr : (3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3)) ^ 2 = (3 : ℝ) / 16 := by
    rw [div_pow, mul_pow, h3]
    norm_num
  have hfinish : ∀ (m n : ℤ) (u v : ℝ), u = α - m → v = β - n → planeEis u v ≤ 1 / 3 →
      dist x (triPoint m n) ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) := by
    intro m n u v hu hv hle
    have hd := hformula m n u v hu hv
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) := by positivity
    nlinarith [hd, hle, hr, hr0, dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := triPoint m n)]
  rcases planeEis_corners hp0 hp1.le hq0 hq1.le with h | h | h | h
  · refine ⟨⌊α⌋, ⌊β⌋, hfinish ⌊α⌋ ⌊β⌋ p q ?_ ?_ h⟩
    · linarith
    · linarith
  · refine ⟨⌊α⌋ + 1, ⌊β⌋, hfinish (⌊α⌋ + 1) ⌊β⌋ (p - 1) q ?_ ?_ h⟩
    · push_cast; linarith
    · linarith
  · refine ⟨⌊α⌋, ⌊β⌋ + 1, hfinish ⌊α⌋ (⌊β⌋ + 1) p (q - 1) ?_ ?_ h⟩
    · linarith
    · push_cast; linarith
  · refine ⟨⌊α⌋ + 1, ⌊β⌋ + 1, hfinish (⌊α⌋ + 1) (⌊β⌋ + 1) (p - 1) (q - 1) ?_ ?_ h⟩
    · push_cast; linarith
    · push_cast; linarith
noncomputable def triColor (x : Plane) : Fin 7 :=
  colorOf (Classical.choose (covering x))
    (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (covering x)))
theorem triColor_sanity (x : Plane) : ∃ a b : ℤ,
    dist x (triPoint a b) ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) ∧
      triColor x = colorOf a b := by
  let a : ℤ := Classical.choose (covering x)
  let h : ∃ b : ℤ, dist x (triPoint a b) ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (covering x)
  let b : ℤ := Classical.choose h
  refine ⟨a, b, Classical.choose_spec h, ?_⟩
  dsimp only [triColor, a, b, h]
lemma covering_radius_lt_half : (3 : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) < 1 / 2 := by
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt 3 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
  have h3 : (Real.sqrt 3) ^ 2 = (3 : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * Real.sqrt 3)]
  have hsq : (3 : ℝ) ^ 2 < (2 * Real.sqrt 3) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have habs : |(3 : ℝ)| < |2 * Real.sqrt 3| := sq_lt_sq.mp hsq
  have h2s : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt 3 := by positivity
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3), abs_of_nonneg h2s] at habs
  linarith
theorem proper_coloring : ∀ x y : Plane, dist x y = 1 → triColor x ≠ triColor y := by
  intro x y hxy hcol
  obtain ⟨a, b, hx, hcx⟩ := triColor_sanity x
  obtain ⟨c, d, hy, hcy⟩ := triColor_sanity y
  have hcolor : colorOf a b = colorOf c d := by rw [← hcx, hcol, hcy]
  by_cases hEq : (a, b) = (c, d)
  · have hac : a = c := by simpa using congrArg Prod.fst hEq
    have hbd : b = d := by simpa using congrArg Prod.snd hEq
    subst c
    subst d
    have htri : dist x y ≤ dist x (triPoint a b) + dist (triPoint a b) y :=
      dist_triangle x (triPoint a b) y
    have hcomm : dist (triPoint a b) y = dist y (triPoint a b) := dist_comm _ _
    have hlt : dist x y < 1 := by
      rw [hcomm] at htri
      nlinarith [htri, hx, hy, covering_radius_lt_half]
    linarith
  · have hlarge := sameColor_dist_large a b c d hcolor hEq
    have h1 : dist (triPoint a b) x ≤ 3 / (4 * Real.sqrt 3) := by
      simpa [dist_comm] using hx
    have h2 : dist x (triPoint c d) ≤ dist x y + dist y (triPoint c d) :=
      dist_triangle x y (triPoint c d)
    have h3 : dist (triPoint a b) (triPoint c d) ≤
        dist (triPoint a b) x + dist x (triPoint c d) :=
      dist_triangle (triPoint a b) x (triPoint c d)
    rw [hxy] at h2
    linarith
theorem properColoring_seven : ProperColoring 7 :=
  ⟨triColor, proper_coloring⟩
end Problem160

import Mathlib

namespace OAI.SnakyConditional

abbrev Cell := ℤ × ℤ
def snaky : Finset Cell := {(0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0), (3, 0), (3, 1), (4, 1)}
def orient (r : Fin 8) (p : Cell) : Cell :=
  match r.val with
  | 0 => (p.1, p.2)
  | 1 => (p.2, p.1)
  | 2 => (p.1, -p.2)
  | 3 => (-p.2, p.1)
  | 4 => (-p.1, p.2)
  | 5 => (p.2, -p.1)
  | 6 => (-p.1, -p.2)
  | _ => (-p.2, -p.1)
def placement (r : Fin 8) (t p : Cell) : Cell := orient r p + t
def HasSnaky (M : Finset Cell) : Prop :=
  ∃ (r : Fin 8) (t : Cell), snaky.image (placement r t) ⊆ M

namespace OrdinaryStrategy

variable {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]

abbrev Policy (α : Type*) := ℕ → Finset α → Finset α → α
def playState (σ : Policy α) (N : ℕ) (β : ℕ → α) (M₀ B₀ : Finset α) :
    ℕ → Finset α × Finset α
  | 0 => (M₀, B₀)
  | k + 1 =>
      let state := playState σ N β M₀ B₀ k
      (insert (σ (N - k) state.1 state.2) state.1, insert (β k) state.2)
def makerAt (σ : Policy α) (N : ℕ) (β : ℕ → α) (M₀ B₀ : Finset α) (k : ℕ) : α :=
  let state := playState σ N β M₀ B₀ k
  σ (N - k) state.1 state.2
def LegalRepliesBeforeFinal (σ : Policy α) (N : ℕ) (β : ℕ → α)
    (M₀ B₀ : Finset α) : Prop :=
  ∀ k, k + 1 < N →
    β k ∉ insert (makerAt σ N β M₀ B₀ k) (playState σ N β M₀ B₀ k).1 ∧
    β k ∉ (playState σ N β M₀ B₀ k).2


def qhb (t : Lean.Syntax) : Lean.Elab.Tactic.TacticM Unit := Lean.withOptions (fun o => Lean.maxHeartbeats.set o 0) (withTheReader Lean.Core.Context (fun c => { c with maxHeartbeats := 0 }) (Lean.Elab.Tactic.evalTactic t))
noncomputable def freshCell [Infinite α] (M B : Finset α) : α := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (Classical.choose (Finset.exists_notMem (M ∪ B)))
def freshCell_legal [Infinite α] (M B : Finset α) :
    freshCell M B ∉ M ∧ freshCell M B ∉ B := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          have h := Classical.choose_spec (Finset.exists_notMem (M ∪ B))
          simpa only [freshCell,Finset.mem_union,not_or] using h)
def Winning [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) : ℕ → Finset α → Finset α → Prop
  | 0,M,_ => G M
  | n + 1,M,B => ∃ a : α,a ∉ M ∧ a ∉ B ∧
      ∀ b : α,b ∉ insert a M → b ∉ B → Winning G n (insert a M) (insert b B)

noncomputable def winningPolicy [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) : Policy α := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          classical
          exact fun n M B => if h : ∃ a : α,a ∉ M ∧ a ∉ B ∧
              ∀ b : α,b ∉ insert a M → b ∉ B → Winning G (n - 1) (insert a M) (insert b B)
            then Classical.choose h else freshCell M B)
def winningPolicy_legal [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) (n : ℕ) (M B : Finset α) :
    winningPolicy G n M B ∉ M ∧ winningPolicy G n M B ∉ B := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          classical
          unfold winningPolicy
          split_ifs with h
          · exact ⟨(Classical.choose_spec h).1,(Classical.choose_spec h).2.1⟩
          · exact freshCell_legal M B)
def winningPolicy_step [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) (n : ℕ) (M B : Finset α)
    (h : Winning G (n + 1) M B) (b : α)
    (hbM : b ∉ insert (winningPolicy G (n + 1) M B) M) (hbB : b ∉ B) :
    Winning G n (insert (winningPolicy G (n + 1) M B) M) (insert b B) := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          classical
          simp only [Winning] at h
          have hs : winningPolicy G (n + 1) M B = Classical.choose h := by
            simp only [winningPolicy,Nat.add_sub_cancel,dif_pos h]
          rw [hs] at hbM ⊢
          exact (Classical.choose_spec h).2.2 b hbM hbB)
def playState_card_maker [Infinite α] (σ : Policy α)
    (hσ : ∀ r M B,σ r M B ∉ M ∧ σ r M B ∉ B)
    (N : ℕ) (β : ℕ → α) (k : ℕ) :
    (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).1.card = k := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          induction k with
          | zero => simp [playState]
          | succ k ih =>
              simp only [playState,Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (hσ _ _ _).1,ih])
def playState_legal_before_final [Infinite α] (σ : Policy α)
    (hσ : ∀ r M B,σ r M B ∉ M ∧ σ r M B ∉ B)
    (N : ℕ) (β : ℕ → α) (hβ : LegalRepliesBeforeFinal σ N β ∅ ∅) :
    ∀ k,k < N →
      Disjoint (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).1 (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).2 ∧
      (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).2.card = k := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          intro k
          induction k with
          | zero => intro hk; simp [playState]
          | succ k ih =>
              intro hk
              obtain ⟨hd,hc⟩ := ih (by omega)
              obtain ⟨hbM,hbB⟩ := hβ k hk
              simp only [playState]
              constructor
              · apply Finset.disjoint_insert_right.mpr
                refine ⟨hbM,?_⟩
                exact Finset.disjoint_insert_left.mpr ⟨(hσ _ _ _).2,hd⟩
              · exact (Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hbB).trans (congrArg (· + 1) hc))
def playState_final_disjoint [Infinite α] (σ : Policy α)
    (hσ : ∀ r M B,σ r M B ∉ M ∧ σ r M B ∉ B)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (β : ℕ → α)
    (hβ : LegalRepliesBeforeFinal σ N β ∅ ∅) :
    Disjoint (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ N).1 (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ (N - 1)).2 := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          cases N with
          | zero => omega
          | succ n =>
              have hd := (playState_legal_before_final σ hσ (n + 1) β hβ n (by omega)).1
              simp only [Nat.succ_sub_one,playState]
              exact Finset.disjoint_insert_left.mpr ⟨(hσ _ _ _).2,hd⟩)
def winningPolicy_play_invariant [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) (N : ℕ)
    (hwin : Winning G N ∅ ∅) (β : ℕ → α)
    (hβ : LegalRepliesBeforeFinal (winningPolicy G) N β ∅ ∅) :
    ∀ k,k < N → Winning G (N - k)
      (playState (winningPolicy G) N β ∅ ∅ k).1
      (playState (winningPolicy G) N β ∅ ∅ k).2 := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          intro k
          induction k with
          | zero => intro hk; simpa only [Nat.sub_zero,playState] using hwin
          | succ k ih =>
              intro hk
              have hw := ih (by omega)
              obtain ⟨hbM,hbB⟩ := hβ k hk
              have hsub : N - k = (N - (k + 1)) + 1 := by omega
              rw [hsub] at hw
              have hs := winningPolicy_step G (N - (k + 1)) _ _ hw (β k)
              simp only [makerAt,hsub] at hbM
              have hh := hs hbM hbB
              simpa only [playState,hsub] using hh)
def winningPolicy_wins [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hwin : Winning G N ∅ ∅) (β : ℕ → α)
    (hβ : LegalRepliesBeforeFinal (winningPolicy G) N β ∅ ∅) :
    G (playState (winningPolicy G) N β ∅ ∅ N).1 := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          cases N with
          | zero => omega
          | succ n =>
              have hw := winningPolicy_play_invariant G (n + 1) hwin β hβ n (by omega)
              have hsub : n + 1 - n = 1 := by omega
              rw [hsub] at hw
              let M := (playState (winningPolicy G) (n + 1) β ∅ ∅ n).1
              let B := (playState (winningPolicy G) (n + 1) β ∅ ∅ n).2
              let a := winningPolicy G 1 M B
              let b := freshCell (insert a M) B
              have hb := freshCell_legal (insert a M) B
              have hh := winningPolicy_step G 0 M B hw b hb.1 hb.2
              change G (insert a M) at hh
              simpa only [playState,hsub] using hh)
def ordinary_policy_of_winning [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hwin : Winning G N ∅ ∅) :
    ∃ σ : Policy α,
      (∀ r M B,σ r M B ∉ M ∧ σ r M B ∉ B) ∧
      ∀ β : ℕ → α,LegalRepliesBeforeFinal σ N β ∅ ∅ →
        G (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ N).1 ∧
        (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ N).1.card = N ∧
        Disjoint (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ N).1 (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ (N - 1)).2 ∧
        ∀ k,k < N →
          Disjoint (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).1 (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).2 ∧
          (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).2.card = k := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          refine ⟨winningPolicy G,winningPolicy_legal G,?_⟩
          intro β hβ
          exact ⟨winningPolicy_wins G N hN hwin β hβ,
            playState_card_maker _ (winningPolicy_legal G) N β N,
            playState_final_disjoint _ (winningPolicy_legal G) N hN β hβ,
            playState_legal_before_final _ (winningPolicy_legal G) N β hβ⟩)
def winning_of_goal [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop)
    (hG : ∀ {M M'},M ⊆ M' → G M → G M')
    (n : ℕ) (M B : Finset α) (h : G M) : Winning G n M B := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          induction n generalizing M B with
          | zero => exact h
          | succ n ih =>
              let a := freshCell M B
              have ha := freshCell_legal M B
              refine ⟨a,ha.1,ha.2,?_⟩
              intro b hbM hbB
              exact ih (insert a M) (insert b B) (hG (Finset.subset_insert _ _) h))
def winning_mono_time [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop)
    (hG : ∀ {M M'},M ⊆ M' → G M → G M')
    {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) (M B : Finset α) (h : Winning G n M B) :
    Winning G m M B := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          induction n generalizing m M B with
          | zero => exact winning_of_goal G hG m M B h
          | succ n ih =>
              cases m with
              | zero => omega
              | succ m =>
                  obtain ⟨a,haM,haB,hs⟩ := h
                  refine ⟨a,haM,haB,?_⟩
                  intro b hbM hbB
                  exact ih (by omega) _ _ (hs b hbM hbB))
def Threat [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) (A H : Finset α) (n : ℕ) : Prop := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (∀ M B,A ⊆ M → Disjoint H B → Winning G n M B)
def threat_leaf [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop)
    (hG : ∀ {M M'},M ⊆ M' → G M → G M')
    (p : α) (S : Finset α) (hS : G S) : Threat G (S.erase p) S 1 := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          intro M B hA hB
          by_cases hpM : p ∈ M
          · apply winning_of_goal G hG 1 M B
            apply hG ?_ hS
            intro x hx
            by_cases hxp : x = p
            · simpa [hxp] using hpM
            · exact hA (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hxp,hx⟩)
          · by_cases hpS : p ∈ S
            · have hpB : p ∉ B := fun h => Finset.disjoint_left.mp hB hpS h

              intro b hbM hbB
              change G (insert p M)
              apply hG ?_ hS
              intro x hx
              by_cases hxp : x = p
              · simp [hxp]
              · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (hA (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hxp,hx⟩))

              apply hG ?_ hS
              intro x hx
              exact hA (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨fun h => hpS (h ▸ hx),hx⟩))
def winning_map [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) (e : α ≃ α)
    (hG : ∀ M,G M → G (M.image e))
    (n : ℕ) (M B : Finset α) (hw : Winning G n M B) :
    Winning G n (M.image e) (B.image e) := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          induction n generalizing M B with
          | zero => exact hG M hw
          | succ n ih =>

    (hG : ∀ M,G M → G (M.image e))
    (A H : Finset α) (n : ℕ) (hw : Threat G A H n) :
    Threat G (A.image e) (H.image e) n := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          intro M B hAM hHB
          have hA : A ⊆ M.image e.symm := by
            intro a ha
            have h := hAM (Finset.mem_image_of_mem e ha)
            simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using Finset.mem_image_of_mem e.symm h
          have hB : Disjoint H (B.image e.symm) := by
            apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
            intro a ha hab
            obtain ⟨b,hb,hab⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hab
            apply Finset.disjoint_left.mp hHB (Finset.mem_image_of_mem e ha)
            simpa [← hab] using hb
          have hh := winning_map G e hG n _ _ (hw _ _ hA hB)
          simpa only [Finset.image_image,Function.comp_def,Equiv.apply_symm_apply,
            Finset.image_id'] using hh)
abbrev ThreatData (α : Type*) := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (Finset α × Finset α × ℕ)
def ThreatData.threatDataA {α : Type*} (x : ThreatData α) : Finset α := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (x.1)
def ThreatData.threatDataH {α : Type*} (x : ThreatData α) : Finset α := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (x.2.1)
def ThreatData.threatDataHeight {α : Type*} (x : ThreatData α) : ℕ := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (x.2.2)
def threat_fork (G : Finset α → Prop) [Infinite α] (hG : ∀ {M M'},M ⊆ M' → G M → G M')
    (p : α) (ds : List (ThreatData α)) (hne : ds ≠ []) (n : ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ d ∈ ds,Threat G d.threatDataA d.threatDataH d.threatDataHeight)
    (hh : ∀ d ∈ ds,d.threatDataHeight ≤ n)
    (A H : Finset α)
    (hA : ∀ d ∈ ds,d.threatDataA ⊆ insert p A)
    (hH : ∀ d ∈ ds,d.threatDataH ⊆ H) (hpH : p ∈ H)
    (hcommon : ∀ b,(∀ d ∈ ds,b ∈ d.threatDataH) → b ∈ insert p A) :
    Threat G A H (n + 1) := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          intro M B hAM hHB
          have hMA : insert p A ⊆ insert p M := Finset.insert_subset_insert p hAM
          by_cases hpM : p ∈ M
          · obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil ds hne
            have hdA : d.threatDataA ⊆ M := by
              intro x hx
              rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp (hA d hd hx) with he | ha
              · simpa [he] using hpM
              · exact hAM ha
            have hdB : Disjoint d.threatDataH B := hHB.mono_left (hH d hd)
            exact winning_mono_time G hG (by have := hh d hd; omega) M B (hs d hd M B hdA hdB)
          · have hpB : p ∉ B := fun h => Finset.disjoint_left.mp hHB hpH h
            refine ⟨p,hpM,hpB,?_⟩
            intro b hbM hbB
            have hex : ∃ d ∈ ds,b ∉ d.threatDataH := by
              by_contra hx
              push_neg at hx
              have hb := hcommon b hx
              exact hbM (hMA hb)
            obtain ⟨d,hd,hbd⟩ := hex
            have hdB : Disjoint d.threatDataH (insert b B) :=
              Finset.disjoint_insert_right.mpr ⟨hbd,hHB.mono_left (hH d hd)⟩
            exact winning_mono_time G hG (hh d hd) _ _
              (hs d hd (insert p M) (insert b B) (fun x hx => hMA (hA d hd hx)) hdB))

end OrdinaryStrategy

def qmergeFuel (n : ℕ) : List qCell → List qCell → List qCell :=
  Nat.rec (fun xs ys => xs ++ ys) (fun _ rec xs ys => match xs,ys with
    | [],ys => ys
    | xs,[] => xs
    | a :: xs,b :: ys => if qcellLE a b then a :: rec xs (b :: ys) else b :: rec (a :: xs) ys) n

def qmergeFuel_mem (x : qCell) (n : ℕ) (xs ys : List qCell) :
    x ∈ qmergeFuel n xs ys ↔ x ∈ xs ∨ x ∈ ys := by
  set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
    induction n generalizing xs ys with
    | zero => exact List.mem_append
    | succ n ih =>
        cases xs with
        | nil => simp [qmergeFuel]
        | cons a xs =>
            cases ys with
            | nil => simp [qmergeFuel]
            | cons b ys =>
                change x ∈ (if qcellLE a b then a :: qmergeFuel n xs (b :: ys) else b :: qmergeFuel n (a :: xs) ys) ↔ _
                split_ifs <;> simp only [List.mem_cons,ih] <;> tauto

def qmerge (xs ys : List qCell) : List qCell := qmergeFuel (xs.length + ys.length) xs ys

def qmerge_mem (x : qCell) (xs ys : List qCell) : x ∈ qmerge xs ys ↔ x ∈ xs ∨ x ∈ ys :=

def qsortFuel (n : ℕ) : List qCell → List qCell :=
  Nat.rec id (fun _ rec xs => match xs with
    | [] => []
    | [a] => [a]
    | a :: b :: xs =>
        qmerge (rec ((a :: b :: xs).take ((xs.length + 3) / 2)))
          (rec ((a :: b :: xs).drop ((xs.length + 3) / 2)))) n

def qsortFuel_mem (x : qCell) (n : ℕ) (xs : List qCell) :

  set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in

    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
        cases xs with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons a xs =>
            cases xs with
            | nil => rfl
            | cons b xs =>
                change x ∈ qmerge (qsortFuel n ((a :: b :: xs).take ((xs.length + 3) / 2)))
                  (qsortFuel n ((a :: b :: xs).drop ((xs.length + 3) / 2))) ↔ _
                simp only [qmerge_mem,ih]
                rw [← List.mem_append,List.take_append_drop]

abbrev Cell := ℤ × ℤ
def snaky : Finset Cell := {(0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0), (3, 0), (3, 1), (4, 1)}
def orient (r : Fin 8) (p : Cell) : Cell :=
  match r.val with
  | 0 => (p.1, p.2)
  | 1 => (p.2, p.1)
  | 2 => (p.1, -p.2)
  | 3 => (-p.2, p.1)
  | 4 => (-p.1, p.2)
  | 5 => (p.2, -p.1)
  | 6 => (-p.1, -p.2)
  | _ => (-p.2, -p.1)
def placement (r : Fin 8) (t p : Cell) : Cell := orient r p + t
def HasSnaky (M : Finset Cell) : Prop :=
  ∃ (r : Fin 8) (t : Cell), snaky.image (placement r t) ⊆ M

              by_contra hx

            have hdB : Disjoint d.threatDataH (insert b B) :=
              Finset.disjoint_insert_right.mpr ⟨hbd,hHB.mono_left (hH d hd)⟩
            exact winning_mono_time G hG (hh d hd) _ _
              (hs d hd (insert p M) (insert b B) (fun x hx => hMA (hA d hd hx)) hdB))

def qcompactStep (a : qCell) (xs : List qCell) : List qCell :=
  match xs with

        · simp [qcompactStep,h]

def qcellLE (a b : qCell) : Bool := decide (a.1 < b.1 ∨ (a.1 = b.1 ∧ a.2 ≤ b.2))

def qmergeFuel (n : ℕ) : List qCell → List qCell → List qCell :=
  Nat.rec (fun xs ys => xs ++ ys) (fun _ rec xs ys => match xs,ys with
    | [],ys => ys
    | xs,[] => xs
    | a :: xs,b :: ys => if qcellLE a b then a :: rec xs (b :: ys) else b :: rec (a :: xs) ys) n

def qmergeFuel_mem (x : qCell) (n : ℕ) (xs ys : List qCell) :
    x ∈ qmergeFuel n xs ys ↔ x ∈ xs ∨ x ∈ ys := by
  set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
    induction n generalizing xs ys with
    | zero => exact List.mem_append
    | succ n ih =>
        cases xs with
        | nil => simp [qmergeFuel]
        | cons a xs =>
            cases ys with
            | nil => simp [qmergeFuel]
            | cons b ys =>
                change x ∈ (if qcellLE a b then a :: qmergeFuel n xs (b :: ys) else b :: qmergeFuel n (a :: xs) ys) ↔ _
                split_ifs <;> simp only [List.mem_cons,ih] <;> tauto

def qmerge_mem (x : qCell) (xs ys : List qCell) : x ∈ qmerge xs ys ↔ x ∈ xs ∨ x ∈ ys :=
  qmergeFuel_mem x _ _ _

def qsortFuel (n : ℕ) : List qCell → List qCell :=
  Nat.rec id (fun _ rec xs => match xs with
    | [] => []
    | [a] => [a]
    | a :: b :: xs =>
        qmerge (rec ((a :: b :: xs).take ((xs.length + 3) / 2)))
          (rec ((a :: b :: xs).drop ((xs.length + 3) / 2)))) n

def qsortFuel_mem (x : qCell) (n : ℕ) (xs : List qCell) :

  set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in

    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
        cases xs with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons a xs =>
            cases xs with
            | nil => rfl
            | cons b xs =>
                change x ∈ qmerge (qsortFuel n ((a :: b :: xs).take ((xs.length + 3) / 2)))
                  (qsortFuel n ((a :: b :: xs).drop ((xs.length + 3) / 2))) ↔ _
                simp only [qmerge_mem,ih]

    (s t u : Finset α) (o : α)

    (hu : u ⊆ s ∪ t) (ho : o ∉ u) :

  set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨hne, hmem⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hx
      have hbound := (Finset.mem_union.mp hmem).elim (fun h => hs h) (fun h => ht h)
      exact (Finset.mem_insert.mp hbound).resolve_left hne
    · intro hx
      have hne : x ≠ o := by
        intro he
        subst x
        exact ho hx
      exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne, hu hx⟩

    apply erase_union_eq_of_subset s t u o hs ht
    · exact fun _ hx => Finset.mem_union_left t (hu hx)
    · exact ho

namespace OAI.SnakyConditional

abbrev Cell := ℤ × ℤ
def snaky : Finset Cell := {(0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0), (3, 0), (3, 1), (4, 1)}
def orient (r : Fin 8) (p : Cell) : Cell :=
  match r.val with
  | 0 => (p.1, p.2)
  | 1 => (p.2, p.1)
  | 2 => (p.1, -p.2)
  | 3 => (-p.2, p.1)
  | 4 => (-p.1, p.2)
  | 5 => (p.2, -p.1)
  | 6 => (-p.1, -p.2)
  | _ => (-p.2, -p.1)
def placement (r : Fin 8) (t p : Cell) : Cell := orient r p + t
def HasSnaky (M : Finset Cell) : Prop :=
  ∃ (r : Fin 8) (t : Cell), snaky.image (placement r t) ⊆ M

abbrev Policy (α : Type*) := ℕ → Finset α → Finset α → α
def playState (σ : Policy α) (N : ℕ) (β : ℕ → α) (M₀ B₀ : Finset α) :
    ℕ → Finset α × Finset α
  | 0 => (M₀, B₀)
  | k + 1 =>
      let state := playState σ N β M₀ B₀ k
      (insert (σ (N - k) state.1 state.2) state.1, insert (β k) state.2)
def makerAt (σ : Policy α) (N : ℕ) (β : ℕ → α) (M₀ B₀ : Finset α) (k : ℕ) : α :=
  let state := playState σ N β M₀ B₀ k
  σ (N - k) state.1 state.2
def LegalRepliesBeforeFinal (σ : Policy α) (N : ℕ) (β : ℕ → α)
    (M₀ B₀ : Finset α) : Prop :=
  ∀ k, k + 1 < N →
    β k ∉ insert (makerAt σ N β M₀ B₀ k) (playState σ N β M₀ B₀ k).1 ∧
    β k ∉ (playState σ N β M₀ B₀ k).2

def qempty_winning_35 : Winning qGoal 35 ∅ ∅ := by

import Mathlib

namespace OAI.SnakyConditional

abbrev Cell := ℤ × ℤ
def snaky : Finset Cell := {(0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0), (3, 0), (3, 1), (4, 1)}
def orient (r : Fin 8) (p : Cell) : Cell :=
  match r.val with
  | 0 => (p.1, p.2)
  | 1 => (p.2, p.1)
  | 2 => (p.1, -p.2)
  | 3 => (-p.2, p.1)
  | 4 => (-p.1, p.2)
  | 5 => (p.2, -p.1)
  | 6 => (-p.1, -p.2)
  | _ => (-p.2, -p.1)
def placement (r : Fin 8) (t p : Cell) : Cell := orient r p + t
def HasSnaky (M : Finset Cell) : Prop :=
  ∃ (r : Fin 8) (t : Cell), snaky.image (placement r t) ⊆ M

namespace OrdinaryStrategy

variable {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]

abbrev Policy (α : Type*) := ℕ → Finset α → Finset α → α
def playState (σ : Policy α) (N : ℕ) (β : ℕ → α) (M₀ B₀ : Finset α) :
    ℕ → Finset α × Finset α
  | 0 => (M₀, B₀)
  | k + 1 =>
      let state := playState σ N β M₀ B₀ k
      (insert (σ (N - k) state.1 state.2) state.1, insert (β k) state.2)
def makerAt (σ : Policy α) (N : ℕ) (β : ℕ → α) (M₀ B₀ : Finset α) (k : ℕ) : α :=
  let state := playState σ N β M₀ B₀ k
  σ (N - k) state.1 state.2
def LegalRepliesBeforeFinal (σ : Policy α) (N : ℕ) (β : ℕ → α)
    (M₀ B₀ : Finset α) : Prop :=
  ∀ k, k + 1 < N →
    β k ∉ insert (makerAt σ N β M₀ B₀ k) (playState σ N β M₀ B₀ k).1 ∧
    β k ∉ (playState σ N β M₀ B₀ k).2
end OrdinaryStrategy

open OrdinaryStrategy

theorem snaky_winning_strategy_with_legal_states :
    ∃ σ : Policy Cell,
      (∀ r M B, σ r M B ∉ M ∧ σ r M B ∉ B) ∧
      ∀ β : ℕ → Cell, LegalRepliesBeforeFinal σ 35 β ∅ ∅ →
        HasSnaky (playState σ 35 β ∅ ∅ 35).1 ∧
        (playState σ 35 β ∅ ∅ 35).1.card = 35 ∧
        Disjoint (playState σ 35 β ∅ ∅ 35).1 (playState σ 35 β ∅ ∅ 34).2 ∧
        ∀ k, k < 35 →
          Disjoint (playState σ 35 β ∅ ∅ k).1 (playState σ 35 β ∅ ∅ k).2 ∧
          (playState σ 35 β ∅ ∅ k).2.card = k := by
  sorry

end OAI.SnakyConditional

import Mathlib

namespace OAI.SnakyConditional

abbrev Cell := ℤ × ℤ
def snaky : Finset Cell := {(0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0), (3, 0), (3, 1), (4, 1)}
def orient (r : Fin 8) (p : Cell) : Cell :=
  match r.val with
  | 0 => (p.1, p.2)
  | 1 => (p.2, p.1)
  | 2 => (p.1, -p.2)
  | 3 => (-p.2, p.1)
  | 4 => (-p.1, p.2)
  | 5 => (p.2, -p.1)
  | 6 => (-p.1, -p.2)
  | _ => (-p.2, -p.1)
def placement (r : Fin 8) (t p : Cell) : Cell := orient r p + t
def HasSnaky (M : Finset Cell) : Prop :=
  ∃ (r : Fin 8) (t : Cell), snaky.image (placement r t) ⊆ M

namespace OrdinaryStrategy

variable {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]

abbrev Policy (α : Type*) := ℕ → Finset α → Finset α → α
def playState (σ : Policy α) (N : ℕ) (β : ℕ → α) (M₀ B₀ : Finset α) :
    ℕ → Finset α × Finset α
  | 0 => (M₀, B₀)
  | k + 1 =>
      let state := playState σ N β M₀ B₀ k
      (insert (σ (N - k) state.1 state.2) state.1, insert (β k) state.2)
def makerAt (σ : Policy α) (N : ℕ) (β : ℕ → α) (M₀ B₀ : Finset α) (k : ℕ) : α :=
  let state := playState σ N β M₀ B₀ k
  σ (N - k) state.1 state.2
def LegalRepliesBeforeFinal (σ : Policy α) (N : ℕ) (β : ℕ → α)
    (M₀ B₀ : Finset α) : Prop :=
  ∀ k, k + 1 < N →
    β k ∉ insert (makerAt σ N β M₀ B₀ k) (playState σ N β M₀ B₀ k).1 ∧
    β k ∉ (playState σ N β M₀ B₀ k).2
end OrdinaryStrategy

open OrdinaryStrategy

def qhb (t : Lean.Syntax) : Lean.Elab.Tactic.TacticM Unit := Lean.withOptions (fun o => Lean.maxHeartbeats.set o 0) (withTheReader Lean.Core.Context (fun c => { c with maxHeartbeats := 0 }) (Lean.Elab.Tactic.evalTactic t))
noncomputable def freshCell {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (M B : Finset α) : α := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (Classical.choose (Finset.exists_notMem (M ∪ B)))
def freshCell_legal {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (M B : Finset α) :
    freshCell M B ∉ M ∧ freshCell M B ∉ B := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          have h := Classical.choose_spec (Finset.exists_notMem (M ∪ B))
          simpa only [freshCell,Finset.mem_union,not_or] using h)
def Winning {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) : ℕ → Finset α → Finset α → Prop
  | 0,M,_ => G M
  | n + 1,M,B => ∃ a : α,a ∉ M ∧ a ∉ B ∧
      ∀ b : α,b ∉ insert a M → b ∉ B → Winning G n (insert a M) (insert b B)
noncomputable def winningPolicy {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) : Policy α := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          classical
          exact fun n M B => if h : ∃ a : α,a ∉ M ∧ a ∉ B ∧
              ∀ b : α,b ∉ insert a M → b ∉ B → Winning G (n - 1) (insert a M) (insert b B)
            then Classical.choose h else freshCell M B)
def winningPolicy_legal {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) (n : ℕ) (M B : Finset α) :
    winningPolicy G n M B ∉ M ∧ winningPolicy G n M B ∉ B := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          classical
          unfold winningPolicy
          split_ifs with h
          · exact ⟨(Classical.choose_spec h).1,(Classical.choose_spec h).2.1⟩
          · exact freshCell_legal M B)
def winningPolicy_step {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) (n : ℕ) (M B : Finset α)
    (h : Winning G (n + 1) M B) (b : α)
    (hbM : b ∉ insert (winningPolicy G (n + 1) M B) M) (hbB : b ∉ B) :
    Winning G n (insert (winningPolicy G (n + 1) M B) M) (insert b B) := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          classical
          simp only [Winning] at h
          have hs : winningPolicy G (n + 1) M B = Classical.choose h := by
            simp only [winningPolicy,Nat.add_sub_cancel,dif_pos h]
          rw [hs] at hbM ⊢
          exact (Classical.choose_spec h).2.2 b hbM hbB)
def playState_card_maker {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (σ : Policy α)
    (hσ : ∀ r M B,σ r M B ∉ M ∧ σ r M B ∉ B)
    (N : ℕ) (β : ℕ → α) (k : ℕ) :
    (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).1.card = k := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          induction k with
          | zero => simp [playState]
          | succ k ih =>
              simp only [playState,Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (hσ _ _ _).1,ih])
def playState_legal_before_final {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (σ : Policy α)
    (hσ : ∀ r M B,σ r M B ∉ M ∧ σ r M B ∉ B)
    (N : ℕ) (β : ℕ → α) (hβ : LegalRepliesBeforeFinal σ N β ∅ ∅) :
    ∀ k,k < N →
      Disjoint (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).1 (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).2 ∧
      (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).2.card = k := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          intro k
          induction k with
          | zero => intro hk; simp [playState]
          | succ k ih =>
              intro hk
              obtain ⟨hd,hc⟩ := ih (by omega)
              obtain ⟨hbM,hbB⟩ := hβ k hk
              simp only [playState]
              constructor
              · apply Finset.disjoint_insert_right.mpr
                refine ⟨hbM,?_⟩
                exact Finset.disjoint_insert_left.mpr ⟨(hσ _ _ _).2,hd⟩
              · exact (Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hbB).trans (congrArg (· + 1) hc))
def playState_final_disjoint {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (σ : Policy α)
    (hσ : ∀ r M B,σ r M B ∉ M ∧ σ r M B ∉ B)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (β : ℕ → α)
    (hβ : LegalRepliesBeforeFinal σ N β ∅ ∅) :
    Disjoint (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ N).1 (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ (N - 1)).2 := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          cases N with
          | zero => omega
          | succ n =>
              have hd := (playState_legal_before_final σ hσ (n + 1) β hβ n (by omega)).1
              simp only [Nat.succ_sub_one,playState]
              exact Finset.disjoint_insert_left.mpr ⟨(hσ _ _ _).2,hd⟩)
def winningPolicy_play_invariant {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) (N : ℕ)
    (hwin : Winning G N ∅ ∅) (β : ℕ → α)
    (hβ : LegalRepliesBeforeFinal (winningPolicy G) N β ∅ ∅) :
    ∀ k,k < N → Winning G (N - k)
      (playState (winningPolicy G) N β ∅ ∅ k).1
      (playState (winningPolicy G) N β ∅ ∅ k).2 := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          intro k
          induction k with
          | zero => intro hk; simpa only [Nat.sub_zero,playState] using hwin
          | succ k ih =>
              intro hk
              have hw := ih (by omega)
              obtain ⟨hbM,hbB⟩ := hβ k hk
              have hsub : N - k = (N - (k + 1)) + 1 := by omega
              rw [hsub] at hw
              have hs := winningPolicy_step G (N - (k + 1)) _ _ hw (β k)
              simp only [makerAt,hsub] at hbM
              have hh := hs hbM hbB
              simpa only [playState,hsub] using hh)
def winningPolicy_wins {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hwin : Winning G N ∅ ∅) (β : ℕ → α)
    (hβ : LegalRepliesBeforeFinal (winningPolicy G) N β ∅ ∅) :
    G (playState (winningPolicy G) N β ∅ ∅ N).1 := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          cases N with
          | zero => omega
          | succ n =>
              have hw := winningPolicy_play_invariant G (n + 1) hwin β hβ n (by omega)
              have hsub : n + 1 - n = 1 := by omega
              rw [hsub] at hw
              let M := (playState (winningPolicy G) (n + 1) β ∅ ∅ n).1
              let B := (playState (winningPolicy G) (n + 1) β ∅ ∅ n).2
              let a := winningPolicy G 1 M B
              let b := freshCell (insert a M) B
              have hb := freshCell_legal (insert a M) B
              have hh := winningPolicy_step G 0 M B hw b hb.1 hb.2
              change G (insert a M) at hh
              simpa only [playState,hsub] using hh)
def ordinary_policy_of_winning {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hwin : Winning G N ∅ ∅) :
    ∃ σ : Policy α,
      (∀ r M B,σ r M B ∉ M ∧ σ r M B ∉ B) ∧
      ∀ β : ℕ → α,LegalRepliesBeforeFinal σ N β ∅ ∅ →
        G (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ N).1 ∧
        (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ N).1.card = N ∧
        Disjoint (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ N).1 (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ (N - 1)).2 ∧
        ∀ k,k < N →
          Disjoint (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).1 (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).2 ∧
          (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).2.card = k := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          refine ⟨winningPolicy G,winningPolicy_legal G,?_⟩
          intro β hβ
          exact ⟨winningPolicy_wins G N hN hwin β hβ,
            playState_card_maker _ (winningPolicy_legal G) N β N,
            playState_final_disjoint _ (winningPolicy_legal G) N hN β hβ,
            playState_legal_before_final _ (winningPolicy_legal G) N β hβ⟩)
def winning_of_goal {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop)
    (hG : ∀ {M M'},M ⊆ M' → G M → G M')
    (n : ℕ) (M B : Finset α) (h : G M) : Winning G n M B := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          induction n generalizing M B with
          | zero => exact h
          | succ n ih =>
              let a := freshCell M B
              have ha := freshCell_legal M B
              refine ⟨a,ha.1,ha.2,?_⟩
              intro b hbM hbB
              exact ih (insert a M) (insert b B) (hG (Finset.subset_insert _ _) h))
def winning_mono_time {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop)
    (hG : ∀ {M M'},M ⊆ M' → G M → G M')
    {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) (M B : Finset α) (h : Winning G n M B) :
    Winning G m M B := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          induction n generalizing m M B with
          | zero => exact winning_of_goal G hG m M B h
          | succ n ih =>
              cases m with
              | zero => omega
              | succ m =>
                  obtain ⟨a,haM,haB,hs⟩ := h
                  refine ⟨a,haM,haB,?_⟩
                  intro b hbM hbB
                  exact ih (by omega) _ _ (hs b hbM hbB))
def Threat {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) (A H : Finset α) (n : ℕ) : Prop := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (∀ M B,A ⊆ M → Disjoint H B → Winning G n M B)
def threat_leaf {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop)
    (hG : ∀ {M M'},M ⊆ M' → G M → G M')
    (p : α) (S : Finset α) (hS : G S) : Threat G (S.erase p) S 1 := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          intro M B hA hB
          by_cases hpM : p ∈ M
          · apply winning_of_goal G hG 1 M B
            apply hG ?_ hS
            intro x hx
            by_cases hxp : x = p
            · simpa [hxp] using hpM
            · exact hA (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hxp,hx⟩)
          · by_cases hpS : p ∈ S
            · have hpB : p ∉ B := fun h => Finset.disjoint_left.mp hB hpS h
              refine ⟨p,hpM,hpB,?_⟩
              intro b hbM hbB
              change G (insert p M)
              apply hG ?_ hS
              intro x hx
              by_cases hxp : x = p
              · simp [hxp]
              · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (hA (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hxp,hx⟩))
            · apply winning_of_goal G hG 1 M B
              apply hG ?_ hS
              intro x hx
              exact hA (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨fun h => hpS (h ▸ hx),hx⟩))
def winning_map {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) (e : α ≃ α)
    (hG : ∀ M,G M → G (M.image e))
    (n : ℕ) (M B : Finset α) (hw : Winning G n M B) :
    Winning G n (M.image e) (B.image e) := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          induction n generalizing M B with
          | zero => exact hG M hw
          | succ n ih =>
              obtain ⟨a,haM,haB,hs⟩ := hw
              refine ⟨e a,?_,?_,?_⟩
              · simpa using haM
              · simpa using haB
              · intro b hbM hbB
                have hbM' : e.symm b ∉ insert a M := by
                  intro h
                  apply hbM
                  simpa only [Finset.image_insert,Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using
                    (Finset.mem_image_of_mem e h)
                have hbB' : e.symm b ∉ B := by
                  intro h
                  apply hbB
                  simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using (Finset.mem_image_of_mem e h)
                simpa only [Finset.image_insert,Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using
                  (ih (insert a M) (insert (e.symm b) B) (hs _ hbM' hbB')))
def threat_map {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Infinite α] (G : Finset α → Prop) (e : α ≃ α)
    (hG : ∀ M,G M → G (M.image e))
    (A H : Finset α) (n : ℕ) (hw : Threat G A H n) :
    Threat G (A.image e) (H.image e) n := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (by
          intro M B hAM hHB
          have hA : A ⊆ M.image e.symm := by
            intro a ha
            have h := hAM (Finset.mem_image_of_mem e ha)
            simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using Finset.mem_image_of_mem e.symm h
          have hB : Disjoint H (B.image e.symm) := by
            apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
            intro a ha hab
            obtain ⟨b,hb,hab⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hab
            apply Finset.disjoint_left.mp hHB (Finset.mem_image_of_mem e ha)
            simpa [← hab] using hb
          have hh := winning_map G e hG n _ _ (hw _ _ hA hB)
          simpa only [Finset.image_image,Function.comp_def,Equiv.apply_symm_apply,
            Finset.image_id'] using hh)
abbrev ThreatData (α : Type*) := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (Finset α × Finset α × ℕ)
def ThreatData.threatDataA {α : Type*} (x : ThreatData α) : Finset α := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (x.1)
def ThreatData.threatDataH {α : Type*} (x : ThreatData α) : Finset α := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
    set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
      exact (x.2.1)
def ThreatData.threatDataHeight {α : Type*} (x : ThreatData α) : ℕ := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in

review.summary: Independent review of the frozen SnakyCertificate proof. (1) Original-context preservation: seed commit 0ec3c12 vs HEAD 5336885 shows generated/problem/Submission.lean changed only inside the file (11,204 insertions / 2 deletions). The deleted bytes are exactly the original final `sorry` and one blank line. The first 69,980 bytes (import Mathlib, namespace OAI / SnakyCertificate, all fixed definitions through AllRows) are byte-identical to the seed; helpers are inserted strictly after AllRows and before the theorem. The `theorem certificate_correct` statement is byte-identical (323 bytes, identical conjunction including placementCount = 1837 and all six Output/AllRows conjuncts). Challenge.lean is unmodified (sha256 591087a6...bedf, identical to the seed Submission.lean). Only the owned files RESEARCH.md and Submission.lean appear in git diff 0ec3c12..HEAD; no protected or package file changed. (2) Proof content: the only proof hole (`sorry`) is replaced. No `sorry`, `admit`, `native_decide`, `sorryAx`, `axiom`, `unsafe`, `partial`, `opaque`, `implemented_by`, `extern`, `addDecl`, `mkFreshExprMVar`, `run_cmd`, `#eval`, or `unsafeCast` occurs anywhere in Submission.lean (verified by token grep). The metaprogramming present is only three thin heartbeat-raising wrappers (`qhb`, `qhbGeometry`, `qhbSem`) plus `spEntryLookup`; each is a pure `evalTactic` call forwarding to ordinary tactics and adds no axiom or declaration. Real checking is still done by the kernel: 1,294 occurrences of `decide +kernel` produce proof terms rechecked by the kernel, and the sole non-decide reasoning is named-lemma rewriting (`me_*`/`mv_*`/`mo_*`, `rowData_ext`, interval_cases over 616 rows). (3) Environment evidence: the host check-lean run on the final saved source (sourceFiles digest b7dc0b28...9751, matching the on-disk file) returned exitCode 0, aborted false, timedOut false, sourceCurrent true, captureComplete true with 1,365 captured messages and zero errors (only linter.defProp/unusedVariables/unusedSimpArgs warnings). (4) Independent kernel axiom audit via `#print axioms` on the built olean: certificate_correct depends only on [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] — the three standard Mathlib axioms, with no sorryAx and no added axioms. (5) Type fidelity: a separate probe re-derived the exact published conjunction type by assigning certificate_correct directly to the restated goal, confirming the proved statement is precisely the publisher target. (6) Arithmetic corroboration from the original seed text only (independent of helper code): exactly 610 entry definitions with indices contiguous 6..615, 31 table chunks totalling 610 entries (size 20 each, last 10), and total term count 1,837 matching the stated placementCount. Verdict: accepted. This review is advisory; the native fixed review, all-original-target host kernel recheck, and the unchanged publisher comparator remain mandatory.

import Mathlib

namespace OAI

                                                              

open scoped BigOperators Matrix

namespace HadamardSix

abbrev Index := Fin 6
abbrev Matrix6 := Matrix Index Index ℂ

def Unimodular (H : Matrix6) : Prop := ∀ i j, ‖H i j‖ = 1

def IsComplexHadamard (H : Matrix6) : Prop :=
  Unimodular H ∧ H.conjTranspose * H = (6 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix6)

def entrywiseSquare (H : Matrix6) : Matrix6 := fun i j => H i j ^ 2

noncomputable def cubeFiber (v : Index → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : Finset Index := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun i => v i ^ 3 = z)

noncomputable def rowRatio (H : Matrix6) (i j : Index) : Index → ℂ :=
  fun k => H i k * star (H j k)

lemma rowRatio_cubeFiber_sum_zero {H : Matrix6} (hH : IsComplexHadamard H)
    (hs : IsComplexHadamard (entrywiseSquare H)) {i j : Index} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (a b : ℂ) (hne : a ≠ b)
    (hab : ∀ k, rowRatio H i j k ^ 3 = a ∨ rowRatio H i j k ^ 3 = b) :
    ∑ k ∈ cubeFiber (rowRatio H i j) a, H i k * star (H j k) = 0 := by
  classical
  have hrow_orthogonality : H * H.conjTranspose = (6 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix6) := by
    have hl : ((6 : ℂ)⁻¹ • H.conjTranspose) * H = 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.smul_mul, hH.2, smul_smul]
      norm_num
    have hr : H * ((6 : ℂ)⁻¹ • H.conjTranspose) = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hl
    calc
      H * H.conjTranspose =
          (6 : ℂ) • (H * ((6 : ℂ)⁻¹ • H.conjTranspose)) := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul]
        norm_num
      _ = (6 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix6) := by rw [hr]
  have hfirst : ∑ k, rowRatio H i j k = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix6 ↦ M i j) hrow_orthogonality
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
      Matrix.one_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h
    simpa [rowRatio, hij] using h
  have hsecond : ∑ k, rowRatio H i j k ^ 2 = 0 := by
                                                        
    have h' : ∑ k, entrywiseSquare H i k * star (entrywiseSquare H j k) = 0 := by
      have horth : entrywiseSquare H * (entrywiseSquare H).conjTranspose =
          (6 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix6) := by
        have hl : ((6 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (entrywiseSquare H).conjTranspose) *
            entrywiseSquare H = 1 := by
          rw [Matrix.smul_mul, hs.2, smul_smul]
          norm_num
        have hr : entrywiseSquare H *
            ((6 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (entrywiseSquare H).conjTranspose) = 1 :=
          mul_eq_one_comm.mp hl
        calc
          entrywiseSquare H * (entrywiseSquare H).conjTranspose =
              (6 : ℂ) • (entrywiseSquare H *
                ((6 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (entrywiseSquare H).conjTranspose)) := by
            rw [Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul]
            norm_num
          _ = (6 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix6) := by rw [hr]
      have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix6 ↦ M i j) horth
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
        Matrix.one_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h
      simpa [rowRatio, hij] using h
    simpa [rowRatio, entrywiseSquare, mul_pow, star_pow] using h'
  have hu : ∀ k, rowRatio H i j k * star (rowRatio H i j k) = 1 := by
    intro k
    have hnorm : ‖rowRatio H i j k‖ = 1 := by
      simp [rowRatio, hH.1 i k, hH.1 j k]
    have hsq := Complex.mul_conj' (rowRatio H i j k)
    rw [Complex.star_def, hsq, hnorm]
    norm_num
  have hmain : ∀ (v : Index → ℂ), (∀ k, v k * star (v k) = 1) →
      (∑ k, v k = 0) → (∑ k, v k ^ 2 = 0) → ∀ (c d : ℂ), c ≠ d →
      (∀ k, v k ^ 3 = c ∨ v k ^ 3 = d) →
      ∑ k ∈ cubeFiber v c, v k = 0 := by
    intro v hu hfirst hsecond c d hne hab
    have hstar : ∑ k, (star (v k)) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      simpa only [star_sum, star_pow, star_zero] using congrArg star hsecond
    have hpoint (k : Index) :
        (if v k ^ 3 = c then (c - d) * v k else 0) =
          c * (v k - d * (star (v k)) ^ 2) := by
      have hz : v k ^ 3 * (star (v k)) ^ 2 = v k := by
        have h : v k ^ 3 * (star (v k)) ^ 2 =
            v k * (v k * star (v k)) ^ 2 := by ring
        rw [h, hu k]
        ring
      rcases hab k with ha | hb
      · rw [ha] at hz
        rw [ite_eq_left ha]
        linear_combination d * hz
      · have hna : v k ^ 3 ≠ c := by rw [hb]; exact Ne.symm hne
        rw [hb] at hz
        rw [ite_eq_right hna]
        linear_combination c * hz
    have hsum := Finset.sum_congr (s₁ := Finset.univ) rfl (fun k _ ↦ hpoint k)
    have hrhs : (∑ k, c * (v k - d * (star (v k)) ^ 2)) = 0 := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hfirst, hstar]
      ring
    have hlhs : (c - d) * ∑ k ∈ cubeFiber v c, v k =
        ∑ k, if v k ^ 3 = c then (c - d) * v k else 0 := by
      rw [cubeFiber, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
    have hmul : (c - d) * ∑ k ∈ cubeFiber v c, v k = 0 := by
      rw [hlhs, hsum, hrhs]
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
  exact hmain (rowRatio H i j) hu hfirst hsecond a b hne hab

end HadamardSix

end OAI

import Mathlib

namespace OAI

/-! Cancellation of row ratios on a prescribed cubic fibre. -/

open scoped BigOperators Matrix

namespace HadamardSix

abbrev Index := Fin 6
abbrev Matrix6 := Matrix Index Index ℂ

def Unimodular (H : Matrix6) : Prop := ∀ i j, ‖H i j‖ = 1

def IsComplexHadamard (H : Matrix6) : Prop :=
  Unimodular H ∧ H.conjTranspose * H = (6 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix6)

def entrywiseSquare (H : Matrix6) : Matrix6 := fun i j => H i j ^ 2

noncomputable def cubeFiber (v : Index → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : Finset Index := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun i => v i ^ 3 = z)

noncomputable def rowRatio (H : Matrix6) (i j : Index) : Index → ℂ :=
  fun k => H i k * star (H j k)

lemma rowRatio_cubeFiber_sum_zero {H : Matrix6} (hH : IsComplexHadamard H)
    (hs : IsComplexHadamard (entrywiseSquare H)) {i j : Index} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (a b : ℂ) (hne : a ≠ b)
    (hab : ∀ k, rowRatio H i j k ^ 3 = a ∨ rowRatio H i j k ^ 3 = b) :
    ∑ k ∈ cubeFiber (rowRatio H i j) a, H i k * star (H j k) = 0 := by
  classical
  have hrow_orthogonality : H * H.conjTranspose = (6 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix6) := by
    have hl : ((6 : ℂ)⁻¹ • H.conjTranspose) * H = 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.smul_mul, hH.2, smul_smul]
      norm_num
    have hr : H * ((6 : ℂ)⁻¹ • H.conjTranspose) = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hl
    calc
      H * H.conjTranspose =
          (6 : ℂ) • (H * ((6 : ℂ)⁻¹ • H.conjTranspose)) := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul]
        norm_num
      _ = (6 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix6) := by rw [hr]
  have hfirst : ∑ k, rowRatio H i j k = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix6 ↦ M i j) hrow_orthogonality
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
      Matrix.one_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h
    simpa [rowRatio, hij] using h
  have hsecond : ∑ k, rowRatio H i j k ^ 2 = 0 := by
    -- The first moment for the entrywise square of `H`.
    have h' : ∑ k, entrywiseSquare H i k * star (entrywiseSquare H j k) = 0 := by
      have horth : entrywiseSquare H * (entrywiseSquare H).conjTranspose =
          (6 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix6) := by
        have hl : ((6 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (entrywiseSquare H).conjTranspose) *
            entrywiseSquare H = 1 := by
          rw [Matrix.smul_mul, hs.2, smul_smul]
          norm_num
        have hr : entrywiseSquare H *
            ((6 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (entrywiseSquare H).conjTranspose) = 1 :=
          mul_eq_one_comm.mp hl
        calc
          entrywiseSquare H * (entrywiseSquare H).conjTranspose =
              (6 : ℂ) • (entrywiseSquare H *
                ((6 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (entrywiseSquare H).conjTranspose)) := by
            rw [Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul]
            norm_num
          _ = (6 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix6) := by rw [hr]
      have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix6 ↦ M i j) horth
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
        Matrix.one_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h
      simpa [rowRatio, hij] using h
    simpa [rowRatio, entrywiseSquare, mul_pow, star_pow] using h'
  have hu : ∀ k, rowRatio H i j k * star (rowRatio H i j k) = 1 := by
    intro k
    have hnorm : ‖rowRatio H i j k‖ = 1 := by
      simp [rowRatio, hH.1 i k, hH.1 j k]
    have hsq := Complex.mul_conj' (rowRatio H i j k)
    rw [Complex.star_def, hsq, hnorm]
    norm_num
  have hmain : ∀ (v : Index → ℂ), (∀ k, v k * star (v k) = 1) →
      (∑ k, v k = 0) → (∑ k, v k ^ 2 = 0) → ∀ (c d : ℂ), c ≠ d →
      (∀ k, v k ^ 3 = c ∨ v k ^ 3 = d) →
      ∑ k ∈ cubeFiber v c, v k = 0 := by
    intro v hu hfirst hsecond c d hne hab
    have hstar : ∑ k, (star (v k)) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      simpa only [star_sum, star_pow, star_zero] using congrArg star hsecond
    have hpoint (k : Index) :
        (if v k ^ 3 = c then (c - d) * v k else 0) =
          c * (v k - d * (star (v k)) ^ 2) := by
      have hz : v k ^ 3 * (star (v k)) ^ 2 = v k := by
        have h : v k ^ 3 * (star (v k)) ^ 2 =
            v k * (v k * star (v k)) ^ 2 := by ring
        rw [h, hu k]
        ring
      rcases hab k with ha | hb
      · rw [ha] at hz
        rw [ite_eq_left ha]
        linear_combination d * hz
      · have hna : v k ^ 3 ≠ c := by rw [hb]; exact Ne.symm hne
        rw [hb] at hz
        rw [ite_eq_right hna]
        linear_combination c * hz
    have hsum := Finset.sum_congr (s₁ := Finset.univ) rfl (fun k _ ↦ hpoint k)
    have hrhs : (∑ k, c * (v k - d * (star (v k)) ^ 2)) = 0 := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hfirst, hstar]
      ring
    have hlhs : (c - d) * ∑ k ∈ cubeFiber v c, v k =
        ∑ k, if v k ^ 3 = c then (c - d) * v k else 0 := by
      rw [cubeFiber, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
    have hmul : (c - d) * ∑ k ∈ cubeFiber v c, v k = 0 := by
      rw [hlhs, hsum, hrhs]
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
  exact hmain (rowRatio H i j) hu hfirst hsecond a b hne hab
end HadamardSix

end OAI

    IsIntegrallyClosed (PowerSeries R) := by
  let K := FractionRing R

  have hg : Function.Injective g :=
    (IsFractionRing.injective B L).comp
      (PowerSeries.map_injective (algebraMap R K) (IsFractionRing.injective R K))
  haveI : IsScalarTower (PowerSeries R) B L := inferInstance
  let φ : F →ₐ[(PowerSeries R)] L := IsFractionRing.liftAlgHom (g := Algebra.ofId _ _) hg
  apply (isIntegrallyClosed_iff F).mpr

    simpa [Algebra.smul_def, hf, map_mul, map_pow, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (PowerSeries R) B L]

    congr 2
    ext i

      MvPowerSeries.toAdicCompletion_coe]
  have hm : (Ideal.map e
      (Ideal.span (Set.range (MvPowerSeries.X (σ := σ) (R := k))))).IsMaximal := by
    rw [hmap]
    exact AdicCompletion.isMaximal_map_of_le I I le_rfl (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars_fg σ k)
  have hm' : (Ideal.span (Set.range (MvPowerSeries.X (σ := σ) (R := k)))).IsMaximal :=
    (Ideal.isMaximal_map_iff_of_bijective e e.bijective).1 hm

lemma mvPowerSeries_complete (σ k : Type*) [Finite σ] [Field k] :
    IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries σ k)) (MvPowerSeries σ k) := by
  rw [IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_eq_span_vars]
  infer_instance

    IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin 3) ℂ)) (MvPowerSeries (Fin 3) ℂ) :=
